But then, a big man came and sat down next to them. He started to push Timmy's dad and mom away from the table. Timmy got scared and didn't know what to do. He remembered that he had a toy car in his pocket. He took it out and pushed it towards the man. The man got surprised and left the restaurant. Timmy's mom and dad were proud of him for being brave. They ordered some food and had a great dinner together.

Once upon a time there was a big purple furniture. It was big and tall, with lots of legs and drawers. Every day, the furniture would caught something. One day, it caught a butterfly.

The butterfly was purple too and it was beautiful! It had wings like a fan and was so small that it could fit in the palm of your hand.

The purple furniture and the butterfly got along so well, so they started to play together. They laughed and spun around and twirled. They were very happy!

But then, one day, a big wind came and it caught the butterfly away. The purple furniture was very sad and missed its friend.

But then the wind came back and brought the butterfly back! So the purple furniture was happy again and they kept playing and having a lot of fun!

Once upon a time, there lived two friends. They were very excited to have a dance party.

So, they went to a big house. It was an unusual house because it had lots of colorful decorations everywhere.

They put on their dancing shoes and began to dance. They twirled, jumped and spun around the house. They danced to the music that came out of the windows.

They didn't want it to end, but it was time to go home. So they said goodbye to the unusual house and left with big smiles on their faces.

Bob was an impatient boy. He loved to eat. He saw a menu outside a restaurant and he wanted to gain all the delicious food. He opened the door and walked in.

The restaurant was empty. He started to get his food and eat it. He wanted more and more. He ran around the restaurant and was very happy.

Suddenly, two big police officers came in. They saw Bob, and they were not happy. They said, "you cannot take other people's food, that's stealing!" They took Bob home.

Bob was so sad. He learned his lesson and never went back to the restaurant. He had gained nothing. He was very disappointed.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved pumpkins. One day, she saw the biggest pumpkin she had ever seen in her life. She wanted to pick it up and take it home with her. But when she tried to reach for it, the pumpkin suddenly began to roll away!

The little girl was very upset and began to panic. She tried to grab the pumpkin, but it rolled away faster and faster until it was out of sight. The little girl was devastated.

Later that day, the little girl's mom took her back to the pumpkin patch. But this time they had a big cart they could use to carry a pumpkin home.

The little girl was so excited and filled with joy that she could hardly contain herself. And soon enough, she had a big and beautiful pumpkin to take home with her. From then on she was never upset or panicked when she needed a pumpkin.

Once upon a time, a little girl was riding her bike in the park. Suddenly, an ambulance came zooming by! The siren was very loud, and the girl was scared. She quickly jumped off her bike and ran away.

The ambulance stopped and two people in white coats came out. They were talking in loud voices and were very angry. The little girl was scared, she hid behind a tree.

The people from the ambulance walked around and looked for something. They even looked under the little girl's bike. After a while, they got back into the ambulance and drove away.

The little girl was relieved! She was happy that she wasn't in trouble with the angry people in the ambulance. She quickly got back on her bike and rode away, grateful that she was safe. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max loved to run and play, but one day he got lost in the woods. He was very scared and didn't know what to do.

Luckily, a kind boy named Tim saw Max and wanted to help him. Tim put a leash on Max and took him home. Max was so tired from running around all day that he fell asleep right away.

The next day, Max's owner came to Tim's house to rescue him. Max was so happy to see his owner again and wagged his tail with joy. Max's owner thanked Tim for finding Max and giving him a safe place to stay. From that day on, Max never ran away again and always stayed close to his owner.

Once upon a time, there was a little pink bunny. The bunny liked to play with his friends in the big green park. One day, the bunny got lost and started to cry.

A kind guard saw the little pink bunny crying. He asked the bunny, "Why are you crying, little one?" The bunny said, "I can't find my friends, and I am very sad."

The kind guard took the little pink bunny by the hand. They walked and walked until they found the bunny's friends. The little pink bunny was so happy, he stopped crying. They all played in the big green park together, and the kind guard watched over them.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and watch cartoons all day. His mom always told him to clean his room but he never listened. One day, Timmy spilled his juice on the floor and didn't clean it up. His mom came in and saw the mess. She told Timmy to get the mop and clean it up. 

Timmy didn't want to clean it up because he was too lazy. His mom told him that it was important to clean up after himself and not be lazy. Timmy realized that his mom was right and got the mop to clean up the spilled juice. His mom was impressed with Timmy for listening and cleaning up the mess. 

The moral of the story is that it's important to clean up after yourself and not be lazy. When you listen to your parents, they will be impressed with you and proud of you.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and her dog, Max. One day, Lily's mom gave her a mop and asked her to clean the floor. Lily was ready to help her mom and started mopping the floor.

After she finished cleaning, Lily's mom told her that they needed to mail a letter to her grandma. Lily was excited to help and asked her mom what "mail" means. Her mom explained that it means to send a letter or a package to someone far away.

Lily put on her shoes and they walked to the mailbox to send the letter. She was happy to have helped her mom and couldn't wait to see her grandma's reaction when she received the letter.

Once upon a time, there was a big storm. It was very windy and it was raining hard. The wind was strong enough to break windows, and it even destroyed a house! Joe was a three year old boy who lived in the house with his mom. He was very scared as he watched the storm wreck his home. 

Joe's mom held him close and told him it was going to be ok. She said she had some news. Joe asked what it was and his mom said, "I'm sorry, but the house has been destroyed. We're going to have to find a new place to stay." 

Joe was so sad, he started to cry. He asked why the storm had to be so strong? His mom looked very serious as she said, "It was just too strong." She tried to comfort Joe and told him it was all going to be ok. She said they'd find a new home and the storm wouldn't be able to stop them. 

Joe was still scared but he felt a little better hearing his mom's words. He knew that she was right, and that the storm wouldn't be able to destroy their hope.

Once, there was a girl who wanted to write a story. She thought and thought about what she could write about. She felt it was too boring to just write about trees and flowers.

Suddenly, an idea came to her. She decided to write about her waist. She started to write about how her waist was round, and how it jiggled when she danced.

Her story was so fun and exciting! She wrote about how she liked to put a belt around her waist and how it made her feel smarter.

She even wrote a rhyme about her waist:

"My waist is round and jiggly,
And when I dance, it's so wiggly."

The girl was so proud of the story she wrote. She was no longer bored - writing about her waist was much more fun!

Once upon a time there was a small girl who was sad. Everywhere she went, the people were so rude! She was feeling very lonely.

One day, when the girl was walking around, she saw an old man sitting on a park bench. She went up to him and asked him why he was so sad. He told her he'd lost his purse and was worried he had no money.

The girl was very kind, so she reached into her pocket and put some money into the old man's purse. She gave him a big hug to comfort him.

The old man was so happy, he smiled and thanked the girl for being so nice. From that day on, the girl made sure she was always nice to people - she never wanted to be as rude as she'd seen other around her.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little girl who wanted to find something special. She set off on an adventure to find it. 

She travelled through the forest, over a hill and down a river. After a long time of searching, she finally found it! 

She found an ancient fuel, which glowed very brightly. She was so excited, she couldn't believe her luck. 

The little girl took the fuel home and planted it in her garden. It grew into a beautiful plant with different coloured flowers. 

The brave little girl was very pleased with her find. She always remembered that special day when she found the ancient fuel.

Once upon a time, there was a vendor named Tom. Tom had a big cart full of toys. He went to the park every day to sell his toys to kids. But it was difficult for Tom to push his cart because it was very heavy.

One day, a strong boy named Tim saw Tom and wanted to help. Tim was very good at lifting things. He said, "Tom, I can help you push your cart!" Tom was happy to have help from Tim.

Together, they pushed the cart to the park. Tim would lift the heavy toys up high for the kids to see. The kids loved the toys and Tom sold many of them. Tom and Tim became good friends and worked together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a big, wide river. The water in the river moved very fast, making lots of noise. A little bird wanted to cross the river, but it was too wide and the water was too bitter. 

The bird tried to fly across, but the wind was too strong and it couldn't move forward. The bird was sad and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, a kind fish appeared and offered to help. The fish swam to the other side of the river and let the bird ride on its back.

The bird was so happy and grateful to the fish for helping it cross the wide river. From that day on, the bird and the fish became good friends and played together every day. They knew that even though they were different, they could still help each other and have fun together.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play with trains. They had many toy trains and tracks in their room. They liked to make long rails and run their trains on them. They also liked to watch real trains go by on the big rail near their house.

One day, they received a big box from their grandma. They opened it and saw a new train set. It had a shiny engine, some cars, and a bridge. They were very happy and thanked their grandma on the phone. They wanted to try their new train set right away.

They set up the bridge on the floor and put the engine and the cars on it. They pushed a button and the train started to move. It made a funny sound, like a whistle. Tom and Lily laughed and clapped. They watched the train go over the bridge and back.

But then, something bad happened. The bridge was not very strong. It broke in the middle and the train fell down. The engine and the cars smashed on the floor. Tom and Lily were shocked and sad. They cried and hugged each other.

Their mom heard the noise and came to see what was wrong. She saw the broken train and the bridge. She felt sorry for Tom and Lily. She said, "Oh, no! Your new train set is ruined! I'm so sorry, my darlings. Maybe we can fix it or get a new one. Don't cry, it's not your fault."

But Tom and Lily did not stop crying. They loved their new train set and they did not want to lose it. They wished they had never received it. They wished they had played with their old trains and tracks instead. They learned a hard lesson. Sometimes, new things are not better than old things. And sometimes, funny things are not fun at all.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to travel with his family. One day, they went to the airport to go on a vacation. Timmy was so excited to fly on a big airplane.

While they were waiting for their flight, Timmy saw a little girl who looked troubled. She was crying because she lost her teddy bear. Timmy felt sad for her and wanted to help. He asked her if she needed help finding her teddy bear. The little girl smiled and said yes.

Timmy and his family helped the little girl find her teddy bear. She was so happy and grateful. Timmy's mom said, "Timmy, that was very kind of you. Always remember to help others in need. We all belong to one big family and we should take care of each other." Timmy nodded and felt proud of himself for helping someone in need.

Julie and her mom were walking through the park. Julie saw a tall statue. She liked it and wanted to catch it. She reached out to grab it, but it was too big and heavy. 

Mom saw that Julie was sad. She smiled at her and said, "Let's go get a snack instead." 

They went to the ice cream shop and ordered a sour lemon popsicle. Julie smiled and ate the popsicle with big licks. It tasted so good on that sunny day! 

When Julie was finished, she noticed a fuzzy bee flying around them. She chased the bee and tried to catch it! Mom laughed and said, "Now that's more like it!" 

Julie and mom giggled and went home. Even though Julie didn't catch the statue, she still had a great day!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He liked to make loud noises and have fun playing. One day, he went outside and saw an interesting thing. It was a guitar! He thought it seemed fun, so he tried to play it. But he couldn't make the right sounds, it just seemed too hard.

Then, the little boy noticed something else. The guitar had a smelly smell. It smelled like a bad cheese! He was so surprised that he stepped back and looked around. After a few minutes, he decided it was too smelly to play, so he left.

The little boy had a great day, but he never did figure out how to make the guitar sound nice. He kept thinking about it, though. He figured that one day he'd figure it out - and then he'd be able to make beautiful music!

Billy the puppy was always getting into the staff room. He wanted to play with the staff and laze around on the sofa. One day, he snuck in and started running around, asking the staff for treats. Everyone was amused - so no one ignored him.

But then one of the staff members got angry. He shouted at Billy and told him to go away. Billy didn't understand why he was being ignored and so he started crying.

Seeing this, the other staff members realised ignoring Billy was wrong. They scooped him up and hugged him, telling him that he was beautiful even if he did sometimes break the rules. Billy grinned and felt back at home.

The moral is that even if someone is naughty, they should not be ignored. Instead, they should be shown love and kindness.

Once upon a time, there was a big ball. It was so big that it could not fit in the room. A little boy tried to push it, but it did not move. So, he decided to spin it around. The ball went round and round until it hit the wall. 

Suddenly, the ball broke into many pieces. The little boy was sad because he did not want this result. He wanted to play with the big ball, but now it was gone forever. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a very intelligent angel who wanted to decorate her home. The angel got some pretty paper and shiny ribbons and started decorating the walls. She put up the paper and wound the ribbons around the windows and doors.

The angel then found some glitter and she sprinkled it around. It looked like a million stars had come and were twinkling in the corner. 

Next, the angel gathered some flowers and placed them in a vase near the windows. Red, yellow and purple petals were arranged in the most beautiful way. 

The angel smiled as she admired the decorations. Her house was so pretty and the angel felt so happy.

One day, two friends decided to go for an adventure. Toby the Toad was short and liked to hop, while Sol the Frog was green and enjoyed listening to the birds sing.

"Let's try to improve the pond," said Sol.

"That sounds unusual," smiled Toby.

So they both hopped over to the pond and began searching. After looking around, they found some unusual pieces of wood and a few stones. 

Toby said, "Let's put this wood and stones together to improve the pond."

So, under the watching eyes of the birds, Sol and Toby built a bridge over the pond. The bridge made the pond look much more unusual.

Toby said, "We've done an amazing job! Now, frogs can jump over the pond and have more fun."

Sol smiled and the two friends watched as a frog hopped across the bridge. It was an exciting improvement, and Toby and Sol were proud of their work.

Once upon a time, there was a sleepy bunny named Ben. Ben lived in a big forest with many trees and vines. One day, Ben saw a tasty vine hanging from a tree. He wanted to eat it, but it was too high for him to reach.

Ben had a friend named Tim, a tall giraffe. He thought Tim could help him get the vine. He went to Tim and mentioned the vine he wanted to eat. Tim agreed to help Ben, but only if Ben would help him find some tasty leaves later.

Together, they went to the tree with the vine. Tim lifted Ben up, and Ben got the vine. After that, Ben helped Tim find the best leaves to eat. They both shared their food and were very happy.

The moral of the story is that when we help each other, we can solve our problems and make everyone happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run around and play outside. One day, she put on her favorite red shoes and ran outside to play. Her shoes were so comfy and she loved how fast she could run in them.

As she was running, she saw a little harmless bug on the ground. She thought it was so cute and wanted to pick it up. But just as she was about to, she heard a loud buzzing noise. It was a bee! Lily got scared and started to run away as fast as she could in her speedy shoes.

When she got home, Lily's mom asked her why she was running so fast. Lily told her about the bee and how she was scared. Her mom hugged her and told her that bees are harmless if you don't bother them. From that day on, Lily knew to be careful around bees, but she still loved her speedy red shoes.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Quick. Quick was mild and kind. He loved to play with his friends in the park.

One day, Quick saw a big cat. The cat wanted to scare Quick. The cat jumped out and said, "Boo!" Quick was not scared. He just laughed and said, "You can't scare me!"

Quick and the big cat became friends. They played together every day. And they learned that being mild and kind is better than trying to scare each other. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big blackboard. It was very tall and perfect. Every day, the blackboard moved from one room to the other. Everyone was so excited to see the blackboard move.

One day, something special happened. A little 3 year old boy saw the blackboard and he was amazed. He loved the blackboard so much that he wanted to move it by himself. He grabbed the blackboard and started to move it away.

The little boy was so proud of himself because he could move the big blackboard. Everyone clapped and cheered for him. They were all so happy to see him do something so perfect. 

The little boy couldn't believe that he did something so amazing! He promised himself that he would always remember how perfect it felt to move the blackboard.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw with chalk on the sidewalk. One day, she went outside to draw and saw a bald man walking by. She said hello, but he didn't hear her.

Lily drew a beautiful picture of a flower with the chalk. She was so happy with it. But then, it started to rain. The rain washed away her picture and made the chalk disappear. Lily was sad that her drawing had ended so quickly.

She went inside to tell her mom about what happened. Her mom gave her a hug and told her that it was okay, because Lily could always draw another picture when the rain ended. And so, Lily waited for the rain to end and went back outside to draw again.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sam. She didnâ€™t like the fake sky. Sam hated it. She wished the sky would always be real.

One day, Sam went out to the park and saw a big, blue balloon floating up towards the sky. Its strings were long, so it floated far away. Sam thought it looked like it wanted to join the fake sky.

Sam wanted to help the balloon so she reached out with her hands and grabbed it. She thought if she let go of it, it might fly up to the sky and join the fake sky.

So, Sam let go and watched the balloon fly up, up, up until it joined the fake sky. This made Sam feel much better and she smiled. Sam was glad she could help the balloon go to the sky and join the fake sky.

Once upon a time, there was a little mouse who wanted to be adventurous. One day, he decided to go to the forest. He took a deep breath and started walking.

As he walked, he suddenly heard a loud noise. It was a tiger! The little mouse was scared and he quickly kneeled down. He closed his eyes and really hoped the tiger wouldn't see him.

The tiger looked around but didn't see the little mouse. He quietly crept away and was relieved when the tiger was gone.

When he opened his eyes, the little mouse saw a palace! He was so excited and he decided to explore it. He ran around happily and made lots of discoveries.

When the little mouse was done exploring, he kneeled down and said a prayer to thank the forest for allowing him such a wonderful adventure. He thanked the tiger too, even though the tiger didn't notice him!

The little mouse started his journey back home and he was a bit sad to go. He was glad to have been so adventurous and he promised himself that he would go back soon.

One day, the sun was shining brightly. Little Sue was in her garden, playing with her toys. She noticed a plant growing in the garden that she had never seen before. She went closer to take a better look.

"Look at that plant, mommy!" She said.

"Yes, Sue," replied Mommy. "It looks very organized. I'm sure it will shine brightly."

Little Sue looked at the plant with admiration. She wanted to reach out and touch it. But before she could do so, a gust of wind blew it away.

Little Sue was so sad. She had been so excited to see the plant growing in their garden. She cried and asked Mommy why the plant had been taken away.

Mommy looked around and said, "Sometimes, things just don't work out the way we want them to."

Sam likes to whistle. He whistles when he walks, when he plays, and when he is happy. He whistles loud and soft, high and low, fast and slow. He can whistle many songs and sounds.

One day, Sam goes with his mom to the city. He sees many big buildings. Some are tall, some are wide, some are shiny, some are old. He whistles at the buildings. He wants to say hello. He thinks the buildings are nice.

But some buildings do not like Sam's whistling. They are cold and mean. They do not want to hear Sam's songs and sounds. They make loud noises to scare Sam. They honk, they beep, they roar, they hiss. They make Sam feel sad and scared.

Sam stops whistling. He holds his mom's hand. He wants to go home. He does not like the cold and mean buildings. He misses his warm and friendly house.

His mom sees that Sam is sad and scared. She hugs him and kisses him. She tells him that she loves him and his whistling. She says that the cold and mean buildings are just noisy and rude. She says that Sam can whistle as much as he wants. She says that his whistling makes her happy.

Sam smiles and nods. He feels better. He starts to whistle again. He whistles loud and soft, high and low, fast and slow. He whistles his favorite song. He does not care about the cold and mean buildings. He only cares about his mom and his whistling. He is happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted a panda. She searched everywhere for one, but just couldn't find one.

Then one evening, she heard a noise outside her window. She opened the window and saw a big, thick panda!

"Do you want to come in?" The little girl asked the panda.

The panda nodded and hopped in the window. Now the little girl had a panda for her very own!

They became fast friends, playing together and having fun. The little girl was so happy to have her thick panda friend.

The end.

Once upon a time, a little girl was trying to balance a task. She held the task in one hand and wiggled and wobbled with the other one. She tried to be still and stay balanced, but it was difficult. Suddenly, something unusual happened. A tall giraffe reached down and held her hand. With one more try, she finally could balance the task! She felt so happy and thanked the giraffe. They became good friends and had fun balancing the task together! The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and explore the world around him. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a calendar with pictures of animals on it. Timmy loved the calendar and hung it on his wall.

But one day, Timmy noticed that the calendar was broken. The pages were stuck together and he couldn't see the pictures of the animals anymore. Timmy was sad and didn't know what to do.

Then, Timmy remembered that his dad had a special key that could unlock things. Timmy went to find his dad's key and tried to use it to unlock the calendar. At first, the key didn't work, but then Timmy remembered to turn it the other way and suddenly the calendar was fixed! Timmy was so happy and he could see all the pictures of the animals again. From that day on, Timmy knew that he could fix things if he tried hard enough.

Once upon a time there was a boy who wanted to meet new friends. He went to a new place and it was full of strange sights and sounds. He heard people speaking a language he had never heard before and he wondered what they were saying. He approached one of the people and asked a question, but the person didn't seem to understand him.

The boy felt sad because he couldn't talk to anyone. He decided to learn the unknown language so he could talk to his new friends. He worked hard and asked lots of questions. Eventually he figured out how to speak the strange language.

When the boy was able to speak the language, he was surprised at how many people he could talk to. He was no longer alone and could make new friends he never would have met without learning the language. The boy was happy and never stopped learning new things.

It was a warm summer day when Billy and his dog, Spot, went for a walk. They continued down the path, hand in hand. As they walked, the waist high grass swayed in the breeze.

Suddenly, Spot spied something shiny in the grass and scrambled to get it. Billy tugged on the leash, but Spot was too excited. Then Billy heard it, a loud 'Slam'. Spot had shut the gate behind him!

Billy dropped the leash and ran to the gate, but it was too late. Spot was nowhere to be seen. Billy was confused. He didn't know what to do.

Luckily, a friendly farmer saw the commotion and helped Billy open the gate. Spot was reunited with Billy and they continued on their walk, hand in hand.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy's mom called him inside and said, "Timmy, it's time to take a bath." Timmy didn't want to take a bath because he was having too much fun playing with his friends.

His mom said, "Timmy, if you don't take a bath, you won't be able to play with your friends tomorrow." Timmy didn't want to miss out on playing with his friends, so he went to take a bath.

While Timmy was taking a bath, he saw a dull rope hanging on the wall. He asked his mom, "What is that dull rope for?" His mom replied, "It's for hanging towels."

Timmy finished his bath and went to bed. The next day, he woke up early and went to play with his friends. They had so much fun playing together. Timmy was happy he took a bath so he could play with his friends again.

One day, a little girl named Lucy went for a walk. She saw a big, red strawberry. She thought it was mighty. She wanted to eat it.

Lucy picked the strawberry and took it home. She showed it to her mom. Her mom thought it was a mighty strawberry too. They decided to share it.

They cut the mighty strawberry in half. Lucy and her mom each took a bite. It was so sweet and yummy. They were happy they found the mighty strawberry.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She had an amazing idea for her birthday; she wanted to design her own luggage. She started drawing pictures, cutting out shapes and gluing on decorations. 

When she was done, Lucy was very proud of her design. She took the luggage to the store to get it made. But the store was closed - it was dead. No one was there so the luggage was not made. 

Lucy was disappointed, until she realized she could take the drawings and decorations home and use them to make her own luggage! After an afternoon of hard work, she was finished and was excited to show off her design to her friends. 

The end!

Once upon a time, there was a big fish named Bob. Bob loved to swim all day in the river. He had a lot of friends who liked to swim with him. They would play fun games and race each other.

One day, they saw a big mountain near the river. The mountain was very tall and had a lot of trees. Bob and his friends wanted to see what was on the other side of the mountain. They were very excited and started to swim faster.

But as they swam, the water got colder and colder. Bob and his friends started to feel miserable. They didn't like the cold water. They decided to go back to the warm river and play there. They swam back and had a lot of fun. From that day on, they never went near the big mountain again.

Once upon a time there was a poor little girl. She was very sad, quite miserable. One day, she decided to write a letter to her wish. She wrote that she wanted to travel far away, to visit a planet up in the sky.

The next day, something magical happened. Suddenly, the girl felt a strange wind whooshing around her. She looked outside and saw a big, shining spaceship. She quickly got inside and flew off into the cloudy sky.

Up, up and away! She flew higher and higher until she saw a beautiful planet in the distance. She felt warm and happy again, so she quickly landed on the planet.

The planet was so amazing and colorful. She smiled and ran around, exploring every corner. She found bright stars, big mountains and busy animals.

The girl had the best day ever. She felt much less miserable! She waved goodbye to the planet and flew back to her home. From that day onwards, she kept dreaming of visiting the planet again.

Once there was a little boy who wanted to go on an adventure. He found a pin lying in a nearby park. The pin was very shiny and he was so proud to have it. He invited his friends to come and join him in exploring. Everyone was excited and they quickly followed him.

They came across a stream with a rainbow in the sky. The little boy was so proud of the pin because it made the rainbow look even more beautiful. His friends could not believe how amazing it was.

Soon they reached the top of a hill where they had an amazing view of the world. They all sat together and ate ice cream. Everyone was so excited and happy to be on the adventure and the little boy was proud to have found the pin.

At the end of the day they said goodbye and the little boy went home. He was so proud of his pin and the wonderful adventure he had.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They lived in a dark wood. Every day they would make sure the wood was safe and they would teach each other new things.

One night, Jack whispered to Jill, "Why don't we sleep here tonight?" So they built a nest out of leaves and twigs and settled down for the night.

They stayed quiet and listened to the night-time noises. Jack and Jill heard the sounds of the animals in the wood. Then, they both fell asleep.

The next morning, Jack and Jill woke up with the sun. They were feeling very tired, so they decided to sleep for a little longer. After a few more hours, Jack and Jill opened their eyes. They had slept all through the dark night and now the morning was bright and sunny.

Jack and Jill were happy. They thanked each other for teaching them that it was safe enough to sleep in the dark wood.

Once upon a time, there was a man called Bob. Bob lived in a big city. He was very worried because he had broken a law. He thought he was in big trouble! So he went to the court to see the judge.

Bob was very scared. The judge asked him why he had broken the law. Bob told the truth. He said he was sorry. The judge looked at Bob carefully. He said he will receive an important decision. 

Bob went home. He was very worried. He didn't know what to do. He waited and waited.

A few days later Bob walked to the post box. Inside he found a letter from the court. He opened the letter and it said he did not have to go to prison. Bob was so happy. He had received a good decision!

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a daughter. The daughter was only three years old and she liked to play outside. Every day, the mommy would worry about her daughter because she loved her so much.

One day, the mommy was worried when her daughter did not come home after playing outside. She was very anxious and scared. She started to look for her daughter.

The mommy called out for her daughter, but there was no reply. She went to look for her in the park and at her best friendâ€™s house. She was so worried!

Finally, the mommy heard a small voice from behind a bush. It was her daughter! She had been playing hide and seek. The mommy was so relieved that she hugged her daughter tightly.

The mommy learned her lesson that day. From then on, she always kept an eye out on her daughter when she was out to play.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went for a walk in the park with her mommy. While they were walking, they saw a charming dog with a wagging tail. 

Lily wanted to pet the dog, but her mommy said, "Be careful, Lily. You need to ask the dog's owner if it's okay to pet him." 

Lily asked the owner, and he said yes. The dog was very friendly and licked Lily's foot. Lily giggled and said, "He's so cute! He behaves very well." 

The owner smiled and said, "Thank you. He's a good boy." Then Lily and her mommy continued their walk, happy to have met such a charming dog.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Tweety. Tweety loved to sing and play with his friends. One day, Tweety noticed that the sky was getting dark and cloudy. He flew to his friend's house and said, "I see the sky change. It looks like it will rain soon. Can I stay in your shelter?"

His friend replied, "Of course, Tweety! You can stay in my bright and cozy shelter until the rain stops."

Tweety was very happy and thanked his friend. They spent the day playing and singing together in the shelter. When the rain stopped, Tweety flew back to his own home, feeling grateful for his friend's help. From that day on, Tweety made sure to always check the sky and have a shelter to go to when it was going to rain.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with bubbles. She would blow and blow until she made a big, beautiful bubble. 

One day, Lily met a little boy named Max. Max was very fearful of bubbles. He didn't like them because they popped and disappeared. 

Lily asked Max if he wanted to play with her and the bubbles. Max was scared at first, but Lily showed him how to blow the bubbles gently. Max became less fearful and started to enjoy playing with the bubbles too. 

The moral of the story is that sometimes we can be scared of things, but if we try them out, we might become less fearful and even enjoy them.

Aidan was upset. He wanted to build a big tower with the nails, but his mom took them away. He shouted "No no!" and started to cry. 

His mom said: "Don't cry, sweetheart. We can make something else with the nails."

Aidan was still upset but he gave it a try. Mom put the nails in a pot and said, "Let's melt the nails and make something special!"

Aidan sat next to his mom and watched as the nails melted. He was excited to see what his mom was going to make. 

After the nails melted, his mom made a beautiful necklace for him. Aidan was so happy he hugged his mom and said: "Thank you, mommy! I love it."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a toy bunny that she loved very much. One day, she accidentally tore off one of its ears. She was very sad because she loved her bunny just the way it was. 

Her mom saw how upset she was and told her not to worry. She said they would replace the bunny's ear with a new one. Lily didn't know what "replace" meant, but her mom explained that they would fix the bunny so it would look just like the original. 

Lily was so happy to hear that. She made a wish that the bunny would be fixed right away. And the next day, her mom surprised her with the bunny all fixed up with a new ear. Lily was overjoyed and hugged her bunny tight. She was so happy to have her favorite toy back to its original self.

Timmy was in the kitchen with his mom. He watched as she mixed together different things. It was so fun to watch! She then drew a pattern with the mixed ingredients on the table. It was so funny! Timmy laughed with delight at the pattern.

His mom then asked him to get some other ingredients from the fridge. So Timmy opened the door and grabbed the things she said. Then he helped her mix them together. This time, he got to mix it with a spoon! He stirred and stirred and watched as a new pattern formed.

It was so exciting to watch the new pattern take shape. Then his mom put the mixed items in the oven to bake. Timmy waited and waited for the pattern to come out of the oven. When it was ready, it was so delicious and full of fun patterns!

One day Daisy was feeling a bit dizzy. She wanted to do something fun. So, she decided to go on a great adventure! She put on her shoes, grabbed her bag and opened the door.

When she stepped outside she was surprised to see a letter on the ground. She had never seen something like this before! She picked it up and opened it. Inside, there was a bright and colourful picture. Daisy smiled and realised that this must be a big surprise.

She decided to go on another adventure and find out where the letter had come from. She went down the street and soon arrived at a secret garden. It was full of flowers and strange plants. As Daisy walked around, she heard a voice. "You found my surprise," the voice said. Daisy looked up and saw a fairy. Daisy was so happy to see the creature and the fairy said, "This surprise is for you!"

Daisy was so excited. She took the letter and thanked the fairy. She ran home and showed her parents the surprise. They were so proud of her adventure and said it was the best surprise ever. Daisy smiled and went to bed, feeling very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia had a magic lamp. The lamp was very special. It could grow big and small. Mia loved her lamp very much.

One day, a foolish boy named Tom saw Mia's lamp. He wanted the lamp for himself. Tom tried to take the lamp away from Mia. Mia was sad and asked Tom to give her lamp back.

Tom saw how much Mia loved her lamp. He felt bad for being foolish. Tom gave the lamp back to Mia. Mia was happy again. The lamp grew big and bright. Mia and Tom became friends and played together every day.

One day, a gray bunny named Bobo went for a walk. He saw a track and thought it would be fun to bounce on it. So, Bobo started to bounce on the track. He liked how it felt under his feet. He bounced higher and higher.

As Bobo bounced, he saw a bird named Lulu. Lulu was blue and had a big smile. "Hi Lulu," said Bobo, "Do you want to bounce on the track with me?" Lulu thought for a moment and said, "Yes, that sounds like fun!"

So, Bobo and Lulu bounced on the track together. They laughed and played. They bounced so high that they could touch the sky. After a while, they were tired and sat down to rest. They looked at each other and said, "That was the best day ever!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who lived in a small house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily's mommy noticed that the pipe in the kitchen was leaking and they needed to fix it.

Lily's daddy tried to fix the pipe, but he needed some help. So, he asked Lily if she could be a helpful assistant and bring him some tools. Lily was happy to help and brought him a wrench and a screwdriver.

While her daddy fixed the pipe, Lily asked him, "Why do we need the pipe?" Her daddy explained that the pipe brings water to the house so they can drink, wash their hands, and take baths. Lily thought that was very important and was happy to have helped fix it.

Mummy and Baby said hello to each other. Mummy said, "Let's play with clay!"

Baby was very happy. He ran to the cupboard and pulled out the clay box. He opened it and saw lots of clean clay.

Mummy smiled. "Let's make something together," she said.

So Baby started to make a funny face in the clay. Then he stuck two pieces together to make arms and legs. 

Mummy laughed. "That looks wonderful," she said. 

Baby smiled. He was very proud of his clay creation. He hugged it tight. 

Mummy said, "Let's make some more! What should we make next?" 

Baby thought for a while, then he said, "Let's make a bird!" 

Mummy and Baby had lots of fun creating things out of clay and it was so much fun that they wanted to do it again and again.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to walk in the park with their mom and dad. They see many things in the park: trees, flowers, birds, dogs, and people.

One day, they see a big balloon in the sky. It is red and shiny. Lily and Ben point at the balloon and say, "Wow! Look at that!"

Mom and dad smile and say, "That is a hot air balloon. People can go inside and fly in the air."

Lily and Ben want to go inside the balloon. They ask, "Can we go, please?"

Mom and dad say, "Maybe another day. It is too high and too far for us. We can watch it from here."

Lily and Ben are a little sad, but they understand. They watch the balloon until it is very small. They wonder what the people inside see.

Mom and dad say, "They see the sky and the clouds and the sun. They see the world from above. The world is part of the universe. The universe is very big and has many things we cannot see."

Lily and Ben are curious. They ask, "What is the universe?"

Mom and dad say, "The universe is everything that exists. The stars, the moon, the planets, and us. We are all part of the universe. The universe is very beautiful and amazing."

Lily and Ben are amazed. They say, "Wow! We want to see the universe!"

Mom and dad say, "You can see the universe at night, when it is dark. You can look at the stars and the moon and make wishes. You can also read books and learn more about the universe. The universe is always there for you to discover."

Lily and Ben are happy. They say, "Thank you, mom and dad. You are the best. We love you and we love the universe."

Mom and dad hug them and say, "We love you too, Lily and Ben. You are our stars. You make our universe soft and bright."

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Brianna. She was only three years old and loved to play outside with her friends. Every day, she would support them to do something fun, like drawing or skipping.

One day, Brianna was feeling a bit upset. She wanted to eat a sausage but she had none in her kitchen. She asked her mom if she could have a sausage, but her mom said no. Brianna was very upset and went to find her friends to make her feel better.

Her friends gave her lots of support and made her feel better. They all went to the store together and bought some sausages for Brianna. She was so happy and was smiling from ear to ear.

From that day on, Brianna and her friends always supported each other and had lots of fun together. They always ate sausages and never got upset again!

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a gentle bunny and a coal train. The bunny and coal train were always together. They would go up and down the mountain, smiling and laughing all the way.

One day, the bunny saw something sparkling in the coal train. He reached in to find a gem. "It's so sparkly!", he said, with a big smile on his face.

He wanted to show his friend the gem, but was scared it might get lost if they took it somewhere else. But then the bunny had a great idea. He used the gem to decorate the coal train, creating a special train for the two friends.

They laughed and laughed as they took the special train around the mountain. From high in the sky, they could see the gentle bunny smiling at his coal train. They had created something special together!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park with her mom. They played on the swings and the slide, but then Lily saw a dog she didn't recognize. "Mommy, who's dog is that?" she asked. "I don't know, Lily. Maybe we should ask the owner," her mom replied.

So they went up to the dog's owner and asked who the dog belonged to. The owner said it was his dog and his name was Max. Lily recognized the name Max because it was the same name as her friend's dog. "Max is a nice name for a dog," she said.

As they were leaving the park, Lily's mom reminded her about the law that says dogs must be on a leash. "Why is that the law?" Lily asked. "It's to keep everyone safe," her mom explained. 

On the way home, they walked on a rough path and Lily stumbled a few times. "Be careful on this rough path, Lily," her mom said. "I will, Mommy," Lily replied. They continued walking and talking about their fun day at the park.

Once upon a time there was a careless orange. He was always playing and running around so much that he often forgot to stop and take care of himself. One day, he was outside playing in the sun when a big sneeze came out of him. He had been so careless that he hadn't covered his nose! Poor orange was a little embarrassed. 

He tried to keep playing, but every few minutes he sneezed again causing a bit of trouble. He started to feel a little bit silly, but noticed something very interesting! Each time he sneezed, a seed came out of his nose! 

At first he was confused, but he soon figured it out: the seed was from the orange he had been eating earlier! He collected the seeds and planted them in the ground. 

Beautiful orange flowers started to grow in the place where he had planted the seeds. From then on, everywhere the careless orange would go, he would remember to cover his nose when he sneezed so he could make more orange flowers!

Once upon a time, there was a pond. In the pond there lived a fierce creature. He liked to swim around and kept all of the other creatures in the pond away. Every day, he swam around and around, looking for something to share. 

One day, the fierce creature found a shiny, bright shell. He was so excited to share it with his friends, that he dived under the water and brought it to the other creatures in the pond. 

When the fierce creature offered the shell to them, they were very happy. They shared it between them, talking and laughing the whole time. Everyone was so happy with the shell, that they all decided to meet back at the pond every day to share different things with each other. 

The fierce creature was so pleased that everyone wanted to share with each other. He showed them how to look for special things, and soon the pond was full of happy creatures sharing things with each other. And they all lived happily ever after!

Lily was very happy today. She had a new suit. It was pink and soft and had a big bow. She wanted to show it to her friends at school. She put it on and looked at herself in the mirror. She smiled and said, "I look pretty!"

She ran downstairs and saw her mom and dad. They were also wearing new suits. They were going to a party. They hugged Lily and said, "You look very pretty, Lily. We are proud of you. But we have to go now. Grandma will take care of you."

Lily waved goodbye to her mom and dad. She was a little sad. She wanted to go to the party too. But she knew she had to stay with Grandma. Grandma was nice and fun. She made cookies and read stories. She also had a big dog named Spot. Spot was Lily's friend. He liked to play and cuddle.

Lily and Grandma had a good time. They ate cookies and read stories. They played with Spot and his toys. They sang songs and danced. Lily was happy again. She forgot about the party. She had fun with Grandma and Spot.

But soon it was dark outside. Grandma said, "It's time to sleep, Lily. You had a busy day. You need to rest. Tomorrow you can go to school and show your new suit to your friends."

Lily nodded. She was tired. She hugged Grandma and Spot and said, "Thank you, Grandma. Thank you, Spot. I love you. Good night."

She went to her room and put on her pajamas. She brushed her teeth and climbed into her bed. She closed her eyes and dreamed of her new suit and her friends. She was happy. She slept well.

Tom and Anna are twins. They like to play in the garden. Tom has a hammer. He likes to hit things with it. Anna has a flower. She likes to watch it grow.

One day, Tom sees Anna's flower. He thinks it is pretty. He wants to touch it. He walks to Anna and says, "Can I see your flower?"

Anna shakes her head. She says, "No, Tom. It is my flower. You have your hammer. Go play with it."

Tom feels angry. He says, "I want your flower. Give it to me." He raises his hammer.

Anna feels scared. She says, "No, Tom. Don't hit my flower. It will die."

But Tom does not hear her. He is deaf. He cannot hear anything. He swings his hammer and hits the flower. The flower breaks and falls to the ground.

Anna cries. She says, "Tom, you are bad. You killed my flower. I hate you."

Tom sees Anna cry. He sees the broken flower. He feels sorry. He says, "I'm sorry, Anna. I didn't know. I can't hear you. I love you."

He hugs Anna. He gives her his hammer. He says, "Here, Anna. You can have my hammer. I don't want it anymore."

Anna stops crying. She hugs Tom. She says, "Thank you, Tom. I love you too. But I don't want your hammer. I want a new flower."

They go to their mom. They tell her what happened. Their mom is sad. She says, "Tom, you should not hit things with your hammer. You should be gentle. Anna, you should share your flower with Tom. You should be kind."

She gives them a new flower. She says, "This is for both of you. You can take turns to watch it grow. You can help each other. You can be happy."

Tom and Anna smile. They say, "Thank you, mom. We will be good. We will be happy."

They go back to the garden. They plant the new flower. They water it. They watch it grow. They play together. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a lab named Max. Max loved to play fetch with Timmy. One day, Timmy threw a stick for Max to fetch, but Max ran away and didn't come back. Timmy was sad and frustrated because he loved Max and didn't know where he went.

Once there was a little dog that was very gentle and delicate. It always loved playing in the park and made lots of friends. One day, the dog was enjoying a nice day outside when a little girl called out to him.

The little girl was very happy and the two of them became the best friends. They played together all day and the tender little dog was very delicate with her. Every day they visited the park and the little girl said it felt like having her own pet dog.

Sam and Tom were brothers who liked to play in the attic. They found many old things there, like books, hats, and toys. One day, they saw a shiny metal thing under a dusty box. It looked like a gun, but smaller.

"Wow, look at this!" Sam said, picking up the metal thing. "It's a pistol!"

"What's a pistol?" Tom asked, curious.

"It's a thing that makes loud noises and hurts people," Sam said, pretending to know. "It's very ancient, like from a long time ago."

"Can I see it?" Tom said, reaching for the pistol.

"No, it's mine!" Sam said, holding it tight. "You can't touch it!"

"Please, Sam, let me see it!" Tom said, trying to grab it.

"Stop it, Tom, you'll break it!" Sam said, angry.

They fought over the pistol, pulling and pushing. They did not see that the pistol had a button on the side. The button was the trigger. The pistol was not ancient, it was real. And it was loaded.

BANG!

The pistol made a loud noise and a flash. Sam and Tom stopped fighting. They looked at each other, scared. Then they looked at the floor. There was blood. A lot of blood.

Sam had shot Tom in the chest.

"Tom, Tom, are you okay?" Sam asked, dropping the pistol. He ran to his brother and hugged him. "I'm sorry, Tom, I'm sorry!"

But Tom did not answer. He did not move. He did not breathe. He was gone.

Sam started to cry. He cried and cried, until he heard his mom coming up the stairs.

"Sam, Tom, what are you doing up there?" she asked, opening the door. "What's that noise?"

She saw the pistol, the blood, and her sons. She screamed. She screamed and screamed, until the neighbors heard. They called the police. The police came and took the pistol, the blood, and Sam. They took him away from his mom, his home, and his brother.

Sam never saw Tom again. He never stopped crying. He never stopped asking himself one question:

Why?

Once upon a time, there was a big ball. The ball was red and round. A little girl saw the ball and wanted to play with it. She rolled the ball on the grass and it was so much fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to watch television all day long. He would sit on the couch and watch cartoons for hours and hours. One day, Timmy's mom told him he couldn't watch TV anymore because he wasn't doing his homework.

Once upon a time, there was a nice girl named Lily. She was always very polite wherever she went.

But then one day, Emma found something that she could help with. She saw her mom cutting some meat and thought that maybe she could help.

So Emma asked her mom, "Can I help cut the meat?"

Her mom was hesitant at first, but then, she smiled and said, "Sure, you can help, Emma, just be very careful because the knife looks sharp."

So Emma carefully held the knife and helped her mom to cut the harmless meat. She was so proud of herself!

Finally, her mom said, "Well done, Emma. You were such a big help! Now let's go and cook it for dinner!"

And so Emma helped to make a delicious dinner for the family and was happy she was able to help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to pretend she was a popular princess. She lived in a big castle with her best friends, a cat and a dog.

One day, while playing in the castle, Lily found a big cobweb. The cobweb was in the way of her fun game. She wanted to get rid of it, but she was scared of the spider that lived there.

Lily asked her friends, the cat and the dog, to help her. They all worked together to clean the cobweb. The spider was sad, but it found a new home outside. Lily, the cat, and the dog were happy they could play without the cobweb in the way. And they all lived happily ever after.

Lila and Ben were playing in the park. They saw a big slide that looked fun. Lila wanted to go on the slide, but Ben was scared.

"Come on, Ben, let's go on the slide!" Lila said. "It's not scary, it's fun!"

Ben shook his head. "No, Lila, it's too high. I don't want to go."

Lila saw that Ben was holding his finger. He had a small cut on it from a thorn. "Does your finger hurt, Ben?" Lila asked.

"A little bit," Ben said. "But it's okay. I put a band-aid on it."

Lila smiled. "You know, Ben, you are very brave. You didn't cry when you hurt your finger. You can be brave on the slide, too. You can choose to go or not to go. It's up to you."

Ben looked at the slide again. He saw other kids going on it and laughing. He saw Lila holding his hand. He felt a little bit of courage in his heart.

"Okay, Lila, I'll try it. But you have to go with me," Ben said.

"Of course, Ben, I'll go with you. We'll go together," Lila said.

They climbed up the stairs and sat on the slide. They held hands and counted to three. Then they slid down the slide, feeling the wind in their hair and the sun on their faces. They landed on the ground and giggled.

"That was fun, Lila! That was fun, Ben!" they said to each other.

They hugged and ran to the slide again. They had a great time in the park. They were brave and happy. They were good friends.

Once there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They were playing in the park and saw something very strange. In front of them was an enormous old tree with branches reaching out as far as they could see, and it was covered in bright oranges and greens.

The two friends were amazed. Jack said, "What is that?" Jill replied, "I don't know, but I think it's beautiful." They both walked closer to get a better look, and they saw a small bird perched on one of the branches.

The bird had a long beak and feathers that sparkled in the sun, and it started to display its colors. First, it was yellow, then purple, then pink, and then it switched back to yellow again. Jack and Jill were mesmerised by the beauty of the bird and the colors it displayed. They stayed and watched until the bird flew away and disappeared into the big blue sky.

Once upon a time there was a magical knee. It was so rare that none of the other knees in the world knew about it. But the knee was special. Whenever someone shrank and put their foot on it, they would go on a wonderful adventure.

One day, a little girl named Sally put her foot on the knee. She clapped her hands and it began to sparkle. Suddenly, her body started to shrink until she was only as big as a mouse!

Sally was so excited as she looked around. The world around her was so much bigger than she had ever seen before. She could see tiny animals and beautiful flowers. She laughed and laughed with joy.

But then, much to her surprise, she started to grow again and quickly returned to her normal size. As she looked down at the magical knee, she knew she would never forget this wonderful adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a brave little angel. She wanted to fly around the world and make it a better place. She had seen many people fighting and not being nice to each other and she wanted to fix it.

So one day she flew down to earth, and saw a group of people around a big tree. They were all yelling and not listening to each other. 

The brave angel flew towards a little boy standing near the tree.

"What's wrong?" asked the angel.

The boy looked at her, surprised. Then he said, "My friends and I were playing, but we can't agree how to fix our game. Nobody can find an idea that works."

The angel thought for a moment. Then she said, "Let's make a picture instead! Then everyone can work together and make something beautiful to remember your day."

The boy smiled and told his friends. They all started working together, drawing pictures and making up stories. Soon they had made a wonderful mural on the side of the tree.

The brave angel flew away, knowing she had done something to make the world a little bit better.

Once upon a time, in a big forest, there lived a little girl named Anna. One day, as she walked through the forest, she observed a wolf. The wolf was very hungry and looking for something tasty to eat.

Anna said to the wolf, "Why are you so hungry, Mr. Wolf?" The wolf replied, "I have not had any food for days, and I am very hungry. I need to find something tasty to eat soon."

Anna felt sad for the wolf and wanted to help him. She had an idea. "I know a place where you can find tasty food," she said. The wolf's eyes lit up, and he asked, "Where is it?" Anna told the wolf to follow her, and they walked deeper into the forest.

As they walked, Anna found a big bush full of tasty berries. She showed the bush to the wolf and said, "Here you go, Mr. Wolf. You can eat these tasty berries to fill your belly." The wolf was very happy and thanked Anna for her help.

From that day on, Anna and the wolf became good friends. They always helped each other and shared tasty food in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a regular girl called Emily.
Emily liked to explore the world around her and every day she would look for something new.
One day, Emily found a copper bucket and she decided to take it home.
Once home, Emily filled the copper bucket with water and set it in the sun.
She watched as the water in the copper bucket slowly filled up with sunshine and soon it was full.
Emily was so excited, she knew the sunshine would fill her bucket with warmth.
From then on, Emily made sure to fill the copper bucket with sunshine every day.
It always made her feel so happy, like she had a secret place filled with warmth and love.

The End

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved going to the circus with his family. One day, they went to a circus with a big tent and lots of animals. Timmy saw elephants, lions, and even a giraffe! He clapped and cheered with the other kids, and they all applauded the performers.

After the show, Timmy's family went to a fancy restaurant. Timmy saw lots of fancy things he had never seen before, like crystal glasses and shiny silverware. He thought it was all so luxurious. "This place is so fancy!" he said to his parents. They smiled and ordered some food.

But then, something bad happened. Timmy accidentally spilled his drink all over the tablecloth. His parents were angry and embarrassed. "This is not fair," his mom said. "We have to pay for this now." Timmy felt sad and didn't know what to do. He wished he could make it better, but he couldn't. The end.

One day a little girl named Lily went with her mommy to the park. As they walked, Lily picked up many pretty things - a flower, a stone and a feather. Her mommy smiled and said "What a wonderful collection!"

When they reached the playground, Lily saw a swing and asked to try it. She grabbed the chains and started to swing high. When she stopped, she saw another girl sitting nearby.

Lily asked the other girl if she would like to play. The girl replied softly "No, thank you". Lily asked why, but the girl did not answer.

Lily felt uncomfortable so she said goodbye and played on the slide. She thought about how uncomfortable the girl must be, but she didn't know why.

As they were leaving, Lily's mommy said "Let's find a word to describe how she felt". Lily thought for a moment and said, "Picked".

Her mommy nodded and smiled. "Yes, she felt picked."

Once there was a fat man. He wanted to talk to his brain, but he didn't know how. So he kept asking his brain for help.

One day, the man asked his brain for help and his brain answered! It said that the man should do some exercises. So the man started running and jumping and swinging. He even put on some weights!

After a while, the man's brain said it was happy. The man was talking to his brain more and more. He was learning things like how to be kind and how to be helpful.

The man's brain became smarter and smarter! Soon, it was almost as smart as the fat man was.

That's how the fat man talked to his brain and became even smarter!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a little dog named Spot. Spot was very hungry and wanted Timmy to feed him. 

"Timmy, can you feed me please?" asked Spot.

"Sure, Spot. Let me get your food," said Timmy.

Timmy went to the kitchen and opened the bag of dog food. He poured some into Spot's bowl and then zipped the bag closed with the zipper. 

"Here you go, Spot. Enjoy your food," said Timmy.

Spot wagged his tail and happily ate his food. Timmy smiled and petted his little dog. They were both very happy. The end.

One day, Tommy was hungry. He looked around his house, but he couldn't find any food. Suddenly, Tommy heard someone call his name. It was his friend Emma. She was inviting Tommy to come visit her family's new building.

"Come on Tommy, let's go! My brothers are building it now," said Emma.

So, Tommy went with Emma. When they got there, the building was almost finished. It was really big and exciting. The brothers had done a great job!

Emma's family was so happy to see Tommy. They invited him to stay for lunch. Tommy was so excited. He ate a big, delicious lunch! After lunch, Emma showed Tommy around the building. She was so proud of her brothers for building it.

It was a great day for Tommy. He was happy to have been invited to a new building and to meet Emma's family. Plus, he was no longer hungry!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a playful puppy named Max. Timmy was so happy to have a new friend to play with.

Timmy and Max played together all day long. They ran around the yard and played fetch with a ball. Suddenly, Timmy's phone rang. It was his grandma calling to say hello. Timmy stepped inside to answer the phone while Max waited outside.

"Hi, Grandma!" Timmy said excitedly. "I have a new puppy named Max. He is so playful!"

"That sounds like so much fun, Timmy," Grandma said. "I can't wait to come over and play with Max too!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted to go to the park. He was so excited to get there that he started to run. But he was carrying something heavy in his hands - a weight. After running for a bit, he stopped and started to feel tired.

He took a deep breath, and remembered something his mom had said to him - to be patient. So, he started to walk slowly and patiently until he reached the park. He smiled as he saw all the nice things he could do there.

But then something happened. He was so excited that he started to run again! He quickly put down the weight, and ran around the park, chasing the birds and the butterflies. Eventually, though, he realized that he was getting tired, so he stopped and took a nap.

He slept until the sun started to go down. Then, remembering he still had to carry the weight, he gently picked it up and slowly made his way back home. As he walked, he was reminded of his mom's words, "to be patient".

The little boy was proud of himself - he was patient, even when he wanted to run and play. And, with help of the weight, he had an exciting and fun day in the park!

Once upon a time there was a tiny bear. He was very sad because he had just had a fight with his friend. All he wanted was for someone to make him feel better. Suddenly, he heard a voice say, â€œCome here, bear. I'm here to give you a big hug.â€

After that the tiny bear felt much better. He was happy and full of joy. He knew his mother was always there to help him, even when the fight felt too rough. He was glad to have someone to help him, because it made things a lot easier. 

Now the tiny bear and his friend are the best of friends and never fight again. Every time the tiny bear remembers the fight, his mother is there to comfort him and remind him how important it is to be kind.

Once upon a time there was a soft, white rabbit. He lived in a warm and cozy home in the woods. The rabbit was very happy. Each day, he would hop and play in the fields with his friends. The rabbit loved his home, his friends and his life.

One day, while the rabbit was hopping in the field, he noticed something behind a tree. It was a small girl, only 3 years old. The rabbit and the girl looked at each other. She reached out her hand and the rabbit came closer. The girl stroked the rabbit softly and the rabbit felt love.

The rabbit and the girl became friends. Every day, the girl would come and visit him. She would give him soft cuddles, sing him songs and they would play hide and seek. The rabbit loved the time they spent together and he loved the girl very much.

The rabbit and the girl were best friends and they were both very happy.

John and his mom were in the car, driving to the store. Suddenly, John's mom started to complain.

"Oh no, traffic is so thick!"

John looked out the window and saw all the cars on the road. He didn't understand why traffic was so bad.

John asked, "Mommy, what's wrong?" 

Mommy sighed. "We have to be very patient today. There is a lot of traffic, and so it's taking us a very long time to get to the store."

John didn't like the traffic. He started to complain too.

"It's too slow!" he said.

Mommy smiled and said, "Let's just listen to some music and have a happy car ride!"

John thought it was a good idea, so he stopped complaining and started to sing his favorite song. Pretty soon, they were at the store.

Once upon a time there was a big island. On the island there lived a lot of animals. Every day they all said hello to each other and welcomed new friends.

One day, a big boat appeared on the horizon. As it came closer, the animals could see that it was filled with little people! The animals were excited, and they ran down to the beach to welcome them. 

The little people were very friendly. They brought gifts and told stories. The animals were so happy and they celebrated with a great big party. Everyone ate and danced and sang.

The animals were so grateful for the little people, and they welcomed them to their island forever. Ever since, the people and the animals have lived together in harmony, and all enjoyed the big island.

Sandy loved to play with her colorful cubes. They were so playful and exciting to stack together. One day as she was happily building, a big breeze suddenly came and scattered all of her cubes across the room. Sandy gasped in surprise.

Mommy said, "Don't worry, sweetheart. Let's get them all back together." Momma and Sandy gathered up the cubes and began to stack them back into one big tower.

Then, something amazing happened. The cubes started to move!

Sandy's eyes sparkled with delight as the cubes danced around her room. She watched in amazement as they twirled and spun, creating shapes and patterns.

Mommy said, "I think your cubes have a magical power. They must like to be playful." She shrugged with a smile and said, "Maybe they just need a little more playing time with you."

Sandy smiled and nodded in agreement. She was so excited and ready to have more fun with her playful cubes!

Sara and Ben are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big dog. The dog is not nice. It barks and runs at them. Sara and Ben are scared.

"Help!" Sara cries. "The dog is bad!"

"Run!" Ben says. "We need to hide!"

They run to a big tree. They climb up the tree. The dog cannot climb. It stays under the tree. It barks and jumps. Sara and Ben hug each other. They are not happy.

"Will the dog go away?" Sara asks.

"I don't know," Ben says. "But we are fine. We are together. We are unite."

"What is unite?" Sara asks.

"Unite means we are one. We are strong. We are friends," Ben says.

Sara smiles. She likes Ben. She likes unite. She says, "Yes, we are unite. We are friends. We are fine."

They wait for the dog to leave. They hope someone will come and help them. They stay in the tree. They are unite. They are fine.

Once there was a person who wondered what was over the hill. The hill was very thick so they couldn't see what was on the other side.

The person started climbing the hill and after some time they made it to the top. They looked around and saw a beautiful garden full of colorful flowers and tall trees.

The person felt so amazed, and they wondered what else could be so special on the other side. They started walking down the hill and came across a small pond. The pond was very quiet and the water was crystal clear.

The person was so amazed by the beauty of nature. They splashed their feet through the cool water and enjoyed the silence around them.

The person looked up into the sky and wondered what else could be over the hill.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful bell. The bell glistened in the sun and sparkled in the night. It was so beautiful that everyone who walked by it stopped to stare. One day, a little boy walking by the bell stopped and said, "I want to hear the bell!" He took his hand and closed the bell. Then, he heard a beautiful sound that he'd never heard before. He was so happy that he laughed and smiled. Then, he closed the bell again and heard the same beautiful sound. Everyone around him clapped and cheered for the little boy's bravery. From then on, the bell was closed but the beautiful sound was never forgotten.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. He lived in the jungle with his friends. One day, the lion went for a walk and saw a branch on the ground. He picked it up and played with it. The branch was long and brown.

As the sun went down, the lion realized he was lost. The jungle became dark and scary. Suddenly, he heard a loud roar. It was a tiger! The lion tried to run away, but he couldn't. The tiger was too fast.

The next day, the lion's friends found the branch on the ground. They knew something was wrong because the lion never left his toys behind. They searched for him and found him lying on the ground. He had been attacked by the tiger. The lion's friends were very sad and missed him very much.

Once upon a time, there was a big, messy room. Toys were everywhere! A little girl named Lily wanted to clean it up, but she didn't know where to start. Suddenly, she found a rope on the floor. She thought it was too big, but then it started to shrink! The rope became small and easy to handle. Lily used it to tie up her toys and put them away. The room was clean and tidy, and Lily was happy. The end.

Once upon a time there was a cheerful young girl named Jane. Jane was full of energy and always had a smile on her face. She loved playing in the yard with her friends.

Once the tower was built, Jane and her friends cheered! She clapped her hands and felt so happy. They all agreed that it had been fun to build and promised to build more towers together soon.

The days went by and the brick tower stayed standing in Jane's yard. It was a reminder to all of them of the fun they had that day. Jane and her friends stayed cheerful, and they never forgot the day they all set out to build the tower.

Once upon a time, there was a special little girl named Lucy.

Mom smiled, â€œIâ€™m so proud of you, Lucy. Now whoâ€™s ready for ice cream?â€

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl. She liked to explore, and one day she found a big, big tent in a park. She recognized that it was a perfect place to play! She ran over and peeked inside, and saw that there was a surprise inside for her! 

She peeked inside, and saw a little puppy! She was so happy that she ran inside and hugged the puppy, who happily licked her face. The girl hugged him back and said, "Hi little puppy, I'm happy to meet you!" 

The puppy wrinkled his nose and smiled. He said, "Hi, I'm happy to meet you, too! What's your name?"

The little girl smiled and said her name. The puppy recognized her as his new friend, and the two of them had a wonderful day playing together in the big, big tent. They were so happy that they became the best of friends and spent many days playing together in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a wild purse. It was a very special purse because it had lots of nice things inside. The wild purse belonged to a young girl.

One day, she went outside to play with her friends. Suddenly, she realised she had lost her wild purse. She started to cry because she knew it had lots of her most special things inside.

Her friends were very kind. They wanted to help her find the wild purse. They looked everywhere. In the playground, behind the trees, in the street. But it was nowhere to be seen.

After a long time, the young girl's friends found the wild purse. The girl was so happy and she gave them a big hug. They all laughed and went to play with the things from the wild purse.

One day, a little girl called Abi was very sad and she cried. She wanted some pizza! Her mum saw her crying and knew the best way to make Abi feel better.

Mum said "Let's go get some pizza!", and Abi stopped crying and said "Yay!"

They went to the pizza shop and got two slices of pizza. Abi's eyes lit up and she smiled. She was so excited to eat the pizza that she started eating it before they got home.

When Abi and her Mum got home, Abi had finished both slices of pizza and felt nicely full. She felt much more normal now, and she jumped up and down with glee. She gave her mum a big hug and said she loved her pizzas!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved Christmas and all the pretty ornaments on the tree. One day, Lily's mom brought home a special ornament. It was shiny and sparkly, and Lily loved it more than any other ornament.

But Lily's brother, Max, was selfish. He always wanted what Lily had. One day, when Lily wasn't looking, Max took the special ornament and hid it away. Lily was so sad when she couldn't find it.

But then, on Christmas morning, Lily found a present under the tree. When she opened it, she saw the special ornament! Max had part of it all along, and he gave it back to her. Lily was so happy and forgave Max for being selfish. From that day on, they both shared the special ornament and were happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her bucket in the sand. One day, she saw a boy playing with a bigger bucket. She wanted to play with his bucket but was worried he wouldn't let her. 

Lily went up to the boy and said, "Hi, can I play with your bucket?" The boy said, "Sure, you can play with my bucket. I already gained a lot of sand." 

Lily was happy and played with the big bucket for a while. She gained a lot of sand too and had so much fun. The boy said, "You can keep playing with my bucket, I have to go home now." Lily was grateful and thanked the boy. She went home with her bucket and the memory of her fun day.

Lily and Max were playing with their toys in the living room. Lily had a pink doll that she liked to rock in her arms. Max had a tray with cars and trucks that he liked to zoom around. They were having fun, but they also wanted to share.

"Can I rock your doll?" Max asked Lily.

"OK, but be gentle," Lily said. She gave Max her doll and took his tray.

Max rocked the doll for a while, but he got bored. He wanted to make the doll go fast like his cars. He threw the doll in the air and caught it. He made loud noises with his mouth.

"Stop it! You are hurting my doll!" Lily cried. She ran to Max and tried to grab her doll.

"No, it's my turn!" Max said. He pulled the doll away from Lily.

They both tugged on the doll, but it was too much. The doll ripped in half and stuffing came out. Lily and Max gasped. They looked at the broken doll and then at each other.
