Once upon a time, there was a restless horse who lived in a barn. He always wanted to run and play outside, but his owner kept him locked up. One day, the horse managed to escape and ran free in the fields. He felt so happy and free, he stretched his legs and ran as fast as he could.

But the horse didn't know that there was a big hole in the ground. He didn't see it and he fell in. His owner found him and tried to help, but it was too late. The horse had hurt himself badly and couldn't be saved.

The moral of the story is that sometimes we want to do things that are not safe for us. We need to listen to those who care for us and trust them to keep us safe.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jim. Jim was very careful and never wanted to get into too much trouble. One day he decided to go exploring in the woods near his house. He had heard that there might be a secret hidden in the woods and he wanted to find it!

So Jim set off into the woods in search of the secret. He followed a winding path through the woods, being very careful as he went. Eventually, he came to a clearing! In the middle was a little house. Jim was very excited! He thought that the secret might be inside!

Jim went up to the door and knocked three times. Nothing happened. Then he tried calling out "Is anyone home?". Suddenly he heard a voice from the inside saying "Who is it?". Jim said his name and the door opened. An old man stood there. He said "Come inside, Jim. I have a special secret for you."

Jim followed the man inside. He was shown a special box which contained a secret treasure. The man said "This is your secret. I want you to take good care of it." Jim was delighted! He thanked the man for the secret and carefully took the box home with him. He now had a special secret of his own!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who loved to play outside. One day, while playing in the dirt, he fell into a hole and went underground. It was dark and scary down there, but the bunny was brave. He looked around and saw that everything was filthy and covered in dirt.

The bunny started to cry because he didn't like being underground. But then he remembered that he had a towel in his pocket. He took it out and used it to dry his tears. Then he wiped his dirty paws and face with the towel, and he felt a little bit better.

After a while, the bunny found a way to climb out of the hole and back into the sunshine. He was so happy to be outside again! From that day on, he made sure to be more careful when playing near holes in the ground. The end.

Once there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and very excited. Her parents told her it was time for a snack.

"What are we having?" Lucy asked.

"Let's see. Some cheese and crackers!" her parents said.

Lucy smiled and yawned. She was so happy to have a snack that she couldn't stop yawning. She gathered up the crackers and cheese and brought them to the table.

"Yummy," she said, taking a bite.

She munched away happily, taking in all the deliciousness of her cheesy snack. It was so good that she couldn't help but yawn a few more times.

When she was finished, she hugged her parents and said, "Thank you for the yummy snack. I'm so excited to have it."

Her parents smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lucy. It was our pleasure!"

Once upon a time there was a deaf onion. He lived in a big, green field with all of his friends. One day all the vegetables went to the river for a picnic. But the onion couldn't hear his friends, he felt so alone. 

His friends were all playing in the water and having so much fun. But the onion couldn't join them. He felt a bit sad and separated from the others. Suddenly, he saw a caterpillar come his way. 

The caterpillar said, "Don't be sad little onion. I can show you something fun to do!" So the onion followed the caterpillar to a beautiful, butterfly garden. There were butterflies of all kinds of colours, it was really pretty. 

The onion was so happy that he wasn't separated any more. He was having so much fun that he forgot about being deaf for a little bit. He spent many happy days in the garden, playing and exploring and making new friends. 

The onion and the caterpillar were best friends. Every day they played together and it made the onion forget all about his sadness. The deaf onion was no longer alone.

Once there was a beautiful judge. She was kind, and wanted to do the right thing. She was given a task, to attach two friends together.

The judge went to find the two friends. Finally, she found them and asked if they wanted to be attached.

The friends thought and then said, "Yes, we do! We want to be attached."

The judge smiled and said, "Good. Now you will always be together."

She then used a magical string to attach the friends together. The friends were so happy and thanked the judge for her wonderful work.

The judge smiled and waved goodbye. As she walked away, the friends knew that they were now best friends forever.

Once there was a kid who went to the park. The kid saw a big slide that they wanted to play on. The kid was so excited to play. All the other kids were sliding down the slide and the kid wanted to try it too.

The kid ran to get on the slide but when they got there, another kid was already playing on it. The kid was so envious! They wanted to play too.

The kid started to scream as loud as they could. The other kid was so scared that they ran away and the first kid got on the slide. The kid slid down the slide again and again, having so much fun.

Once upon a time there was a girl who wanted to go to the grocery. Every day she asked her mom, but her mom said she was too young. Then one day, her mom said she could go, but she had to understand the rules. The girl was very excited and promised to understand.

When they got to the grocery, the girl saw all the good things to eat. Everything was so colorful and shiny. She ran from aisle to aisle and touched everything. The girl's mom told her everything had to be smooth, so she had to be careful when touching things.

At last, it was time to go home. The girl was happy she got to understand how to go to the grocery. She promised herself she would understand even better next time and couldn't wait to go again.

Once upon a time there was a calm inchworm. He liked to explore and wander in the garden. One day he made his journey to the nearby pond. As he arrived, he saw lots of leaves scattered around it. He was excited to explore!

He started to inch closer and closer to the leaves. As he moved, he could feel the tiny wet drops of the pond on his back. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise and the leaves scattered in all different directions.

The inchworm was surprised, but still very calm. He watched as the leaves moved further and further away. After they were all gone, he turned around and made his way back home. He was happy he could survey the pond and see everything that had happened.

Once upon a time there was a gifted girl called Daisy. Daisy loved playing with her toys and wanted to record them every day. She had a special chain that she used to tie all of her toys together at the end of each day.

One day, Daisy was playing with her dolls when she had a wonderful idea. She wanted to record all of her dolls on video and save them forever! She got her dad's camera and started to make a movie of her dolls dancing and singing. Daisy was so excited to record her dolls - it was like she was making her own movie!

When Daisy had finished recording, she put all of her dolls back in a line and used her special chain to tie them together. The video was saved forever, and Daisy could watch it any time she liked. Everyone was so happy with Daisy's movie, and they all said she was so gifted!

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim got a new toy. It was a magic pen that could write with light. Tim was very happy and wanted to show his friend, Sue.

One day, Tim and Sue played in the park. Tim said, "Sue, look at my new toy! I can write with light!" Sue was excited and asked, "Can I try it too?" Tim said, "Yes, but we must wait for the night. The light will look very pretty in the dark."

The sun went down and it was dark. Tim and Sue went outside with the magic pen. Tim showed Sue how to write with light. They wrote their names in big, bright letters. They laughed and played all night long. And, just as Tim said, the light looked very pretty in the dark.

Lily was an adventurous cat. She liked to explore new places and find new things. One day, she saw a big tree in the garden. She wanted to climb it and see what was on top.

She ran to the tree and jumped on the lowest branch. She stretched her legs and claws and climbed higher and higher. She felt happy and brave. She looked around and saw birds and flowers and clouds. She felt like she was the queen of the garden.

But then she heard a loud bark. It was the dog from next door. He had seen Lily on the tree and wanted to chase her. He ran to the tree and jumped and barked. He tried to reach Lily, but he was too big and clumsy.

Lily was scared. She wanted to get down, but she did not know how. She was too high and the branches were too thin. She meowed and cried for help.

Her human heard her and came to the garden. He saw Lily on the tree and the dog on the ground. He shooed the dog away and got a ladder. He climbed the ladder and reached Lily. He picked her up and hugged her. He said, "Lily, you are a very adventurous cat, but you have to be careful. Climbing trees is fun, but it can also be dangerous. Next time, stay on the ground and play with your toys. I love you, Lily."

Lily felt sorry and grateful. She licked her human's face and purred. She learned her lesson. She decided to be more cautious and not to climb trees anymore. She still liked to explore, but she did it safely and with her human's permission. She was a happy and smart cat.

Lily liked to write. She had a big book with many pages. She wrote her name, her mom's name, and her cat's name. She wrote about what she saw and what she did. She wrote with a red pen and a blue pen.

One day, Lily found a hole in her book. Someone had torn a page. She was very sad and angry. Who did this? She asked her mom.

Mom looked at the hole and said, "I think I know who did this. It was your brother, Max. He is spoiled. He always wants what you have. He was jealous of your book. He tore a page when you were not looking."

Lily was very mad at Max. She went to his room and saw him playing with his cars. She said, "Max, you are bad. You tore my book. You are spoiled. You have many toys. Why did you take my book?"

Max looked at Lily and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. I wanted to write too. But I don't have a book. I don't know how to write. I tried to write with your pen, but I made a mess. I tore the page to hide it. I'm sorry. I love you."

Lily felt sorry for Max. She said, "It's okay, Max. I love you too. But you should not take my things. You should ask me. I can teach you how to write. You can have some of my pages. But you have to be careful. You have to be gentle. You have to respect my book."

Max nodded and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are nice. You are a good sister. I will be careful. I will be gentle. I will respect your book. Can you teach me how to write now?"

Lily smiled and said, "Yes, I can. Come with me. I will show you how to write your name, my name, and our cat's name. We can write about what we see and what we do. We can write with a red pen and a blue pen."

Lily and Max went to Lily's room and wrote in her book. They had fun. They learned. They shared. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there was a big black dog named Spot. Spot loved to run really fast and play with his toy ball. One day, Spot was playing with his ball when a mean cat came and took it away. Spot was very sad and didn't know what to do.

Then, Spot saw a stick on the ground and had an idea. He picked up the stick and split it in two with his strong teeth. He gave one half of the stick to the cat and kept the other half for himself. The cat was surprised and gave the ball back to Spot.

Spot was happy again and ran with great speed to play with his ball. From that day on, Spot and the cat became friends and played together every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved Thanksgiving because he got to eat a big turkey. One day, Timmy's mom went to the store to buy a turkey, but she accidentally bought a very small one. 

Timmy was sad because he wanted a large turkey to eat. He decided to request a bigger turkey from his mom. He said, "Mommy, can we please have a big turkey for Thanksgiving?" 

His mom understood and went back to the store to exchange the small turkey for a large one. Timmy was so happy when he saw the big turkey on the table. He ate so much turkey that he fell asleep and had dreams about turkeys. The end.

It was a sunny day at the park. Jack and Jill were playing with sand. Jack brought some of his farming tools with him. He was trying to make a farm in the sand.

Jill smiled and said "You can use my nail too!". She handed it over to Jack. He took it and said "I can use this to make a fence!". He stuck the nail into the sand and started making a farm.

It was hot outside and the sun was melting the sand. Jack and Jill were getting wet from the melting sand. Jack said "It's too hot! We need to go inside." Jill nodded in agreement. They packed up their tools and went inside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys in her room. One day, her mom came in and said, "Lily, let's measure your height!" 

Lily jumped up and down with excitement. "Yay! I want to see how tall I am!" 

Her mom got out a tape measure and stood Lily against the wall. She measured from the bottom of Lily's feet to the top of her head. "You are four feet tall, Lily! You are growing up so fast!" 

Lily smiled and said, "I am mighty tall now! Can we measure my toy bear too?" 

Her mom laughed and said, "Sure, let's measure your bear's side too!" They measured the bear's side and Lily was happy to see that her bear was almost as tall as she was. She hugged her bear and said, "We are both mighty big now!"

The little girl got on the bus. It was very busy inside. She was excited to go on the journey and have an adventure.

The bus driver smiled at her and gave her a ticket. She put her ticket in her pocket and watched as the bus drove away.

She looked out of the window and saw lots of things. There were people walking in the street and cars driving. She saw some children playing in the park and a cat chasing a bird.

The little girl was so busy watching the world go by that she didn't realise when the bus had already arrived at her stop. Luckily, the bus driver saw her and stopped the bus. She thanked the bus driver and happily stepped off the bus with her ticket in her hand. 

The little girl was so excited about the adventure she had on the bus. She knew she would never forget the things she had watched.

Sara and Ben like to play with colors. They have many crayons and papers. They make pictures of animals, flowers, and cars. Sometimes they paint on the wall, but Mommy does not like that. She says they have to be careful and not make a mess.

One day, Sara and Ben see a big truck outside their house. It has many cans of paint and brushes. A man gets out of the truck. He is a painter. He comes to their door and talks to Mommy. He says he will paint their house a new color. Mommy says yes and shows him the house.

Sara and Ben are curious. They want to see the painter work. They follow him to the back of the house. He opens a can of paint. It is blue. He dips his brush in the paint and starts to paint the wall. Sara and Ben think it looks pretty. They want to help.

They find some crayons and papers. They draw pictures of the painter and the house. They use blue, yellow, and red. They make the pictures wild and fun. They show them to the painter. He smiles and says they are very good. He says they are artists.

Sara and Ben are happy. They thank the painter for his nice words. They give him their pictures as a gift. He thanks them and says he will keep them. He says they are his friends. Sara and Ben hug him and say they are his friends too. They go back to Mommy and tell her about the painter. Mommy says they are very sweet and polite. She says she is proud of them. Sara and Ben smile and hug Mommy. They like the painter and the new color of their house.

Once upon a time there was a magical road. It was so amazing that made everyone want to go.

One sunny day a 3 year old child was playing in the garden when she saw the magical road. She wanted to go and explore it. She asked her mother:

"Mama, can I go to the road?"

Her mother looked at her and smiled.

"Yes, but mind yourself and be careful."

The little girl was very excited. She ran to the road and started exploring. She saw many amazing things, from shiny stones to colorful flowers. She found a lot of new friends and enjoyed playing with them.

After a while, the little girl started to get a bit tired. She remembered her mother's words and went home. She was very happy and couldn't wait to tell her mother about the amazing road.

Once there was a little girl who was very sad because she didn't have enough money to buy the things she wanted. She felt so miserable that she started to cry.

Then, she had an idea. She remembered the story her mom had told her about a magical laser that could create money. She knew she had to find that laser!

So, the little girl went on a journey. She went to the beach, the mountains, and even the deep forest. Everywhere she went, she asked people if they had seen the magical laser. But no one could help her.

Finally, the little girl arrived at the end of her journey. She was standing at the top of a hill, feeling sad and exhausted. But then she spotted something mysterious in the sky. It was the magical laser!

The little girl was so excited that she called out to the laser, begging it to help her. Suddenly, the air filled with money and the little girl realized she could buy anything she wanted. She was so happy that she started to dance. 

And that is how the little girl learned to pay for the things she wanted. Now sheâ€™s no longer miserable.

Once upon a time there was a festival. Everyone was so excited because it was a very special festival. Kids were running around, laughing and having fun.

Sam saw a clown jumping up and down and doing silly tricks. He became so excited and started to clap and cheered â€œBravo! Bravo!â€ The clown was really happy and laughed at Sam.

The clown said to Sam, â€œAnother round of applause for me, please!â€ Samâ€™s eyes lit up and he started to applaud even louder. Everyone else at the festival started to clap and cheer too. 

Then the clown started to do even crazier tricks and he juggled and somersaulted and the crowd went wild. Everyone was jumping and clapping and shouting and laughing.

The festival ended and everybody went off to bed, still talking about the crazy clown and thinking about the wonderful time they had.

One sunny day, a pirate was wandering through the woods. He had a big, shining hat, two swords and a wooden leg. Suddenly he heard a noise coming from the bushes. The pirate stopped and listened carefully.

"Ouch, it hurts", a small voice called out from the bushes.

The pirate went to investigate, and he saw a little girl, who was crying. The pirate asked her why she was crying, but she only shook her head.

The pirate lifted the little girl out of the bushes, and asked her again why she was so hurt. This time she told the pirate that she had been playing hide-and-seek with her friend, and had gotten lost.

The pirate put his arm around the little girl, and smiled down at her. He promised he would lead her home, so she wouldn't be hurt anymore. As the two walked, the pirate told her stories about his adventures of sailing the seven seas.

The pirate took the little girl home, and stayed to make sure she was safe. Both the little girl and the pirate were happy about this. The little girl had learned an important lesson - always listen to your parents, so you don't get lost. And the pirate had learned a lesson too - helping out others can make you feel good.

Once upon a time, there was a baby named Timmy. Timmy was very weak and couldn't walk or talk yet. One day, Timmy's mom put him down for a nap in his crib. When she came back to check on him, she saw that Timmy had vanished! She looked everywhere but couldn't find him. Timmy's mom was very worried and started to cry. Suddenly, she heard a little giggle coming from under the bed. She looked and there was Timmy, smiling and happy as can be!

Once upon a time, there was a frog called Freddie. Freddie was a happy frog and he liked to hop around in nature. He always loved the sound of the birds chirping and the water lapping against the rocks. One day, Freddie found something sharp on the ground. He picked it up and discovered it was a shiny rock! He marveled at how beautiful it was and wanted to show his friends.

He made sure to be extra careful with it, as it was very fragile. So, Freddie slowly hopped away, carrying the shiny rock in both hands. Everywhere he went, his friends were amazed by its beauty. They admired how sparkly the rock was and couldn't believe how lucky Freddie was. 

With a smile on his face, Freddie hopped back to nature with the rock. He gently placed it back where he found it and hopped away with a smile. He was glad he'd been extra careful with the fragile rock- after all, nature was a special place that should always be respected.

Once upon a time, there was a little dog named Spot. He was very restless and wanted to explore the world. One day, Spot went for a walk and found a treasure map. The map showed a land with lots of bones and toys. Spot was so excited that he followed the map.

After a long journey, Spot finally found the land on the map. It was full of bones and toys, just like the map said. Spot was very happy and started to play with all the toys. But after a while, he got tired and wanted to rest. He found a cozy spot under a tree and took a nap. When he woke up, he realized that he missed his home and his family. So, he followed the map back home and lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a girl. She was only three. Her name was Lisa. Every night before she went to sleep she would make a wish.

One night the moon was big and bright in the sky. It was gray. Lisa made a wish and looked up at the moon. Suddenly, something special happened.

The moon shot a sharp sparkle down at Lisa. Lisa thought it was the most beautiful thing she had ever seen.

Since that night, when Lisa sees the gray moon in the sky she remembers her special wish and hopes it will come true someday.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a toy top that he loved to spin around. One day, Timmy was playing with his top when his mom came in and asked him a question. Timmy was so focused on his top that he didn't hear his mom at first. But then, he became alert and turned to answer her question.

Timmy's mom asked him if he wanted to go to the park. Timmy was so excited that he quickly put his top away and ran to get his shoes on. When they got to the park, Timmy saw other kids playing and he wanted to join in. He ran over to the other kids and asked if he could play too. They all said yes and Timmy had so much fun playing with his new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went outside to play with her scooter. She rode it around and around until she got dizzy. 

Suddenly, Lily heard her mom call her from inside the house. She knew it was time to go inside because her mom always calls her when it's time to come in. 

Lily put her scooter away and went inside to see her mom. Her mom gave her a big hug and asked if she had fun playing outside. Lily nodded her head and smiled, feeling happy and tired from all the spinning on her scooter.

Ben and Mia were hungry. They wanted to eat something yummy. Mom said they could have sausage and bread for lunch. She put the sausage in a pan and the bread in a toaster.

"Can I help you, Mom?" Ben asked. He liked to be helpful.

"Sure, you can help me, Ben. You can get two plates and two cups from the cupboard," Mom said. She smiled at Ben.

Ben got the plates and cups and put them on the table. He felt proud. He was a good helper.

Mia came to the table. She saw the plates and cups. She saw the sausage and bread. She clapped her hands.

"Yay, sausage and bread! My favorite!" Mia said. She was happy.

Mom put the sausage and bread on the plates. She poured some juice in the cups. She gave one plate and one cup to Ben and one plate and one cup to Mia.

"Thank you, Mom. Thank you, Ben," Mia said. She took a bite of her sausage. It was hot and tasty.

"You're welcome, Mia. You're welcome, Mom," Ben said. He drank some juice. It was cold and sweet.

Mom sat down with them. She ate her sausage and bread. She drank her juice. She looked at Ben and Mia. They were eating and drinking. They were smiling and talking. She felt happy. They were a good family.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom was three years old and he was not happy. He was miserable because he had an exam coming up! Tom knew there was only one way to make himself feel better - to take a nice warm bath.

So Tom ran to the bathroom and grabbed a big soft towel. He filled the bathtub with warm bubbly water. He put some special soap in the bath and it smelled so nice.

Tom was so happy. He splashed and played in the bath for a long time. The warm water made him feel much better and soon he wasn't feeling so miserable.

After a long time, Tom finally got out of the bath. He felt relaxed and ready for his exam the next day. With a happy smile on his face, he said goodbye to his bath and dried off with his big soft towel.

Once upon a time there was a big yellow pillow. It was big and squishy just like a cloud. Little Lucy wanted to see what was inside so she opened up the pillow.

Inside the pillow she found something very special - a toy snake! The snake was long and flexible and it was brightly colored too. Lucy was so excited to find the toy.

Lucy had lots of fun playing with her new toy. She made the snake move around and even pretend to eat up her dolls. Indeed, it was the best pillow Lucy had ever opened!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved cats. She had a sweet cat named Mittens who loved to snuggle with her. One day, Lily saw a big, orange cat outside. "Look, Mommy! A cat!" she said.

Her mommy said, "Yes, that's a big cat. But we can't squeeze him. He might not like that."

Lily said, "I won't squeeze him. I just want to say hi." So, Lily went outside to say hi to the big, orange cat. The cat was friendly and let Lily pet him. She said, "You're a sweet cat. Mittens is sweet too."

The big, orange cat meowed and Lily said, "I think he likes you, Mommy. Can we keep him?" 

Her mommy laughed and said, "No, we can't keep him. But we can visit him again tomorrow." And so, Lily and Mittens made a new friend.

One day, a little girl and her mommy were walking in the park, looking at the flowers. The little girl saw something in the sky and said, â€œMommy, look!â€

Her mommy looked up and saw a jet in the sky. It was going very fast and it looked dangerous.

The little girl knew it was very special and she wanted to get a closer look. So, she kneeled down on the grass and concentrated very hard. Then, she made a wish for the jet.

The jet flew so high and fast. It flew away and disappeared from sight. The little girl stood up and smiled, happy that she had seen something so special. 

They walked back home and the little girl talked to her mommy about the jet and how exciting it was. She knew that it was safe and would never be dangerous.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He had a big belt that he loved to wear. One day, Timmy's mom gifted him a new toy car. Timmy was so happy and he played with his new toy all day long.

Later that day, Timmy's mom noticed a stain on his shirt. She asked Timmy if he had spilled something on it. Timmy nodded his head and said he accidentally rubbed his shirt against the dirty wall. His mom took off his belt and used it to rub the stain away. Timmy was amazed at how his mom gifted belt could clean his shirt.

Once upon a time, there was a small bird. Each day, the bird flew around and sang a happy song. The bird felt safe and loved, because its parents were always nearby. Every day, the parents would watch and protect the bird.

But one day, the bird saw something in the sky. It was the most beautiful thing it had ever seen. The bird wanted to fly up and touch it, so it flew higher and higher.

The bird's parents were worried. They called out for the bird to return, but the bird was too busy admiring the shiny thing. The bird's parents grew angry and shouted. They were harsh with their words.

Finally, the bird understood why they were angry and decided to fly back to them. As the bird got closer, its parents hugged it and said they were sorry. They still loved the bird, no matter what. The bird was glad to be back home again, safe and loved.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was very organized and loved to keep things neat. One day, she was playing with her toys, when something strange happened. She felt a pinch on her shoulder. She looked around and saw a bug! She quickly snatched it up with her hands and released it outside. She was so happy that she hadn't been pinched again! She went back to her toys and started to organize them in her special way. The girl smiled, feeling proud that all of her toys were very organized.

Once upon a time, there was a happy family who lived in a small town. They loved to play together and sing songs. One day, the sun started to rise early and the family was grateful for the beautiful day ahead.

As they walked through the town, they met a sad man who had lost his wallet. The family wanted to help him, so they looked for the wallet together. After a while, they found it and gave it back to the man. He was so grateful and thanked them.

Suddenly, a big storm came and the family got scared. They ran back to their home, but it was too late. The storm destroyed their house and they lost everything. The family was very sad and didn't know what to do. The man they helped earlier came to their rescue and took them to his home. They were grateful for his kindness, but they were still sad about losing their home.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Lizzy. Lizzy loved to eat yummy snacks but she wasn't allowed to eat too many because her mom said it wasn't healthy.

One day, Lizzy's mom decided to make a special treat for her. She started to mix together milk, sugar, and some other yummy ingredients. Lizzy was so excited! When it was ready, her mom served her the treat in a bowl.

Lizzy started to eat the treat with a spoon. It was so yummy! She couldn't believe how good it tasted. She ate it all up very quickly.

When she was done, Lizzy thanked her mom for making her such a yummy treat. From then on, every time Lizzy's mom made this treat, Lizzy was so excited to start eating it!

Once upon a time there was a girl, who was brave and strong. She wanted to make a perfect dress, with lots of colourful stitches. But she faced a problem, the dress kept falling apart no matter how many stitches she added. She kept trying to fix it, but it kept coming apart.

But then, one day, the girl had an idea. She took a tiny needle and thread and worked on the dress, carefully and slowly making small, tight stitches. The dress stayed together, no matter how hard she pulled it. The girl was so happy, as her hard work had finally paid off â€“ the dress was now perfect!

The girl knew she had to keep working on the dress, to make sure it stayed strong and perfect. But, no matter how hard she worked, the dress stayed together and resisted coming apart. The girl was so proud of her perfect dress. She knew she had used the perfect stitches.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore the world around her. One day, she went to the river to see the fish swim. Suddenly, something strange happened. The water started to rise and soon there was a big flood. 

Lily was scared and didn't know what to do. She saw a man walking by and asked, "What should I do? The water is too high!" The man replied, "Don't worry, I will help you. We need to go to higher ground." 

The man gifted Lily a toy to help her feel better. "Thank you," said Lily. They walked and walked until they found a safe place to stay. Lily was happy to be safe and thanked the man for his help. They talked and played games until the flood went away. From that day on, Lily knew that when something bad happens, there are always people who can help.

Once upon a time there was a bubble. It was thick and clear. The bubble wanted to be sharp. It had an idea. So it started to spin around and around. It spun faster and faster until it was so sharp it cut the air. It spun around and around until it was gone. Then, it was sharp. The bubble was happy. Everyone said it was the sharpest bubble ever! The End.

Bob and Dave were best friends. They liked to share everything they had. One day they went to the park. Dave had a red car and Bob had a blue car. They enjoyed driving their cars around the park. Suddenly, Bob's car ran out of gas. Dave was very happy to share his gas with Bob and so Bob was able to keep driving his car.

Bob was very thankful and he wanted to share something with Dave too. Bob saw that Dave really liked his blue car so he decided to share his car with Dave. Dave was very happy! He took the blue car and drove it around the park.

Suddenly, Bob felt a little jealous. He wished he had a car to play with. He quickly realized that jealousy was a bad feeling and decided to share something else with Dave instead. He shared a big hug with Dave and they both felt very happy.

Timmy was very happy. He was playing his favorite game, matching blocks. He had all the colors matched up, as if he were a real law maker. But then something happened which made Timmy feel uncomfortable. 

Suddenly his mom appeared and said, "Timmy, it's bedtime. It's time to stop playing and go to bed". 

Timmy knew the law so he stopped matching and started to get ready for bed. He was a bit sad but the law was the law. 

Just before going up to his bedroom, Timmy turned to his mom and said, "Please mommy can I just finish matching? I'm almost done!" 

His mom looked at Timmy and smiled. She said, "I know you are almost done Timmy. But it's way past your bed time. You have to get a good night's rest so you can finish matching tomorrow". 

Timmy nodded and went up to his bedroom, feeling a bit uncomfortable that he hadn't gotten to finish his game. But he knew mom was right and it was time for bed.

Lily and Tom were best friends. They liked to play in the park every day. They liked to swing, slide and run. But their favorite thing was to watch the sunrise.

One morning, they woke up very early. They put on their coats and hats and went to the park. It was still dark and quiet. They could see the stars and the moon. They found a bench and sat down.

"Look, Tom, the sky is changing color!" Lily said. She pointed at the horizon. "It is getting pink and orange and yellow. It is so pretty!"

Tom nodded. He smiled and held Lily's hand. "Yes, it is. And you know what? You are my best friend. I am happy to share this with you."

Lily hugged Tom. "You are my best friend too. Thank you for being here with me."

They watched the sunrise together. They felt warm and cozy. They learned that sharing is caring. And that some things are more beautiful when you have someone to hold.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy had a jolly day in her backyard, playing with her dolls. The sun was shining brightly and Daisy was so happy.

Suddenly, her mom came out of the house and called her. 'Daisy, come here! I have a surprise for you,' her mom said. Daisy was filled with excitement and quickly ran to her mom. 

'Here you go, darling. I bought this for you,' her mom said holding out a toy. Daisy was so excited, she thanked her mom for the surprise. 

After that, every day Daisy would ask her mom to supply her with new toys. And every day her mom would fulfill her wish. 

But one day, her mom told Daisy 'No' when Daisy asked her for a new toy. Daisy was so disappointed, she started crying and begging her mom. 

Her mom shook her head and said, 'I can't always supply you with everything you want, Daisy. You should learn to be content.'

This made Daisy understand that she shouldn't always expect to be given things. It was a bad ending, but it was good to learn a moral lesson. Excessive wanting is not always a good thing.

Once upon a time, there was a new pool in the park. The sun would shine on it every day. It was so pretty. All the kids liked to play in the pool. They would splash and laugh.

One day, a big dog came to the park. The dog liked the pool too. But the dog was not nice. It would jump in the pool and scare the kids. The kids were sad. They did not want to play in the pool with the big dog.

A little girl had an idea. She went to the store and got a big ball. She took the ball to the park. She threw the ball far away. The big dog saw the ball and ran after it. The dog liked the ball more than the pool. Now the kids could play in the pool again. They were happy and the sun kept shining on their new pool.

One day, there was a generous man. He had an ice cream cone. He saw a little girl who was 3 years old. He stepped up to her and said, "Hello little one, do you like ice cream?"

The little girl smiled and nodded. The generous man said, "It would be my pleasure to give you my cone". He handed the cone to the little girl and she said, "Thank you!"

The little girl was so happy. She closed her eyes and took a big lick of ice cream. It was so delicious. She opened her eyes and said, "This is the best ice cream ever!"

The generous man smiled and said, "I'm glad you like it."

The little girl smiled back and said, "Thank you very much. You are so generous."

The generous man nodded and said, "You're welcome". 

The little girl finished her cone and thanked the generous man again before she skipped off.

Tim and Sue were friends. They liked to play with toys and eat snacks. One day, they found a big bag of prunes in the kitchen. They thought prunes were yummy and sweet.

"Let's eat some prunes!" Tim said.

"OK!" Sue said.

They opened the bag and took out some prunes. They put them in their mouths and chewed. But the prunes were not yummy and sweet. They were dry and sour and bitter. They made their faces twist and their tongues hurt.

"Yuck!" Tim said. "These prunes are stupid!"

"Yuck!" Sue said. "They are bad!"

They spat out the prunes and threw them on the floor. They were angry and sad. They wanted something good to eat.

They looked around the kitchen and saw a big cake on the table. It was white and pink and had candles on it. It looked yummy and sweet.

"Let's eat some cake!" Tim said.

"OK!" Sue said.

They ran to the table and grabbed some cake. They put it in their mouths and smiled. It was yummy and sweet. It made their faces happy and their tongues glad.

"Mmm!" Tim said. "This cake is good!"

"Mmm!" Sue said. "It is nice!"

They ate more and more cake. They did not care about the prunes. They did not see the note on the table. It said: "Happy Birthday, Mom! Do not touch the cake!"

They ate all the cake. They felt full and sick. They clapped their hands and laughed. They thought they were clever and funny.

But they were not clever and funny. They were naughty and rude. They did not know that Mom was coming home soon. They did not know that Mom loved cake and wanted to share it with them. They did not know that Mom would be very angry and sad when she saw what they did.

They did not know that they were in big trouble.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a poor little girl. She lived on a shore by the sea. All day, she would guess deep and secret things that only she could know.

Sometimes she would guess what kind of fish lived beneath the waves. Other times, she would guess how long the day would last. Once, she even guessed how long it would take for the sun to set!

The poor little girl had many guesses, but she was never wrong. With each guess, she felt wiser and more independent.

Eventually, the poor little girl felt she had guessed everything there was to know. She smiled a happy smile and basked in the knowledge that she had worked out so many secrets.

The poor little girl had guessed a lot, but most of all, she had learned that things don't have to be hard to be valuable.

Once there was a girl called Julie. She needed to use a needle, so she asked her mom if she could lend it to her. Her mom said yes and showed Julie the needle. It was a pale needle, very thin and shiny. 

Julie was excited to use it. She carefully grabbed it with her fingers and started to show her mom what she wanted to do. Julie used the needle to make some new beautiful clothes for her doll. 

When she was finished, she asked her mom to lend her some brightly coloured thread too. Her mom got some from the drawer and Julie used it to sew the clothes together.

When Julie was done she smiled, happy that she could make something so nice with the needle and thread her mom had lent her. She hugged her mom and thanked her for the lend.

Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat was so big, it could fit many friends on it. One day, the boat hit a rock and got a big hole. Water started to come in the boat. The friends were scared because they didn't want to sink. One friend said, "I know how to repair the boat!" He got some lime and put it in the deep hole. The lime stopped the water from coming in and the boat was safe again. The friends were happy and continued to have fun on the big boat.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big jar of butter, but it was so heavy that she couldn't carry it. So, she asked her mommy to help her. Her mommy said, "Let's pull the jar together!" So, they both pulled the jar and carried it to the kitchen.

But when they opened the jar, they saw that the butter was very ugly. It had turned brown and smelled bad. Lily's mommy said, "This butter is not good anymore. We can't eat it." So, they threw the ugly butter away and went to the store to buy some fresh butter.

Lily was sad that she had wasted the butter, but her mommy told her that it was okay. They had tried their best to save it, but sometimes things just don't work out. And now they had learned to be more careful with their food.

Once upon a time, in a peaceful forest, there lived a little bird named Blue. Blue loved to sing and fly all day long.

One day, Blue found a small box. He was very curious about what was inside. He opened the box and found a tiny creature. The creature said, "Please release me, and I will give you a special gift." Blue opened the box and let the creature out.

The creature thanked Blue and gave him the gift of time. Now, Blue could enjoy his peaceful forest even more. He could fly and sing all day, and never run out of time. Blue was very happy and grateful for his new gift.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. She was having so much fun on the swings and the slide. Suddenly, she saw a thief trying to steal her friend's toy.

Lily shouted, "Help! Help! A thief is trying to take my friend's toy!" Her friends ran to her and saw the thief. They quickly went to the thief and told him to give the toy back. The thief was scared and gave the toy back.

After the thief left, Lily's friend said, "Thank you for helping me. You are a good friend." Lily smiled and said, "I like to help my friends." The sky was clear and the sun was shining. They played together until it was time to go home. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Daisy and a boy named Tim. Daisy and Tim wanted to have a picnic, so they packed their buckets and ran to the park. 

When they got there, the sun was shining and the birds were singing. Daisy and Tim spread out a big blanket on the grass and filled it with all kinds of yummy foods. 

After they finished eating, they wanted to go for a walk. They ran through the park and had lots of fun until they noticed something special. It was Tim's toy car! It was going so fast! Daisy and Tim ran after it, but the car was going too fast. 

Luckily, they saw a normal tree next to the path. Daisy and Tim quickly ran to the tree, and the car stopped right next to it. Daisy and Tim laughed and laughed. Finally, the fun picnic was over and Daisy and Tim went back home feeling happy.

Lily liked tuna very much. She liked to eat tuna with bread and cheese. She liked to smell tuna when Mom opened the can. She liked to share tuna with her cat, Mimi.

One day, Lily saw a big tuna at the store. It was in a glass box with ice. It had shiny scales and a long tail. Lily wanted to take the tuna home. She asked Mom, "Can we buy the tuna, please?"

Mom said, "No, Lily. The tuna is too big and too expensive. We have to pay a lot of money for it. We can buy a small can of tuna instead."

Lily was sad. She did not want a small can of tuna. She wanted the big tuna. She thought of a plan. She waited until Mom was busy with other things. She took the big tuna from the glass box. She hugged it tight. She ran to the door.

But the tuna was very heavy. Lily could not run fast. She slipped on the ice. She fell down. The tuna fell on top of her. It hurt. Lily cried. Mom heard her cry. She came to help her.

Mom was angry and worried. She said, "Lily, what did you do? You can't take the tuna without paying. That is wrong. And you could have hurt yourself. The tuna is not a toy. It is food."

Lily was sorry. She said, "I'm sorry, Mom. I just wanted the big tuna. I like tuna very much. Can we still buy a small can of tuna?"

Mom said, "Yes, Lily. We can buy a small can of tuna. But you have to promise me to never do that again. And you have to say sorry to the store man. He works hard to sell the tuna. He needs the money to buy food for his family."

Lily nodded. She said, "I promise, Mom. And I'm sorry, store man." She gave the big tuna back to the store man. He smiled and said, "It's okay, little girl. I'm glad you like tuna. Here, have a small can of tuna for free. But be careful next time."

Lily thanked the store man. She took the small can of tuna. She gave some to Mimi. She ate some with bread and cheese. She was happy. She learned a lesson. She never tried to take the big tuna again.

"Let's catch a fish!" Ben says. He takes a stick and tries to poke a fish. But the fish is fast and swims away.

"Let's make a boat!" Sara says. She takes a leaf and puts it on the water. She blows on it and makes it move.

They have fun with the stream. They splash and laugh and sing. They forget about the time.

But then they hear a roar. A fierce bear comes out of the woods. The bear is big and brown and angry. It sees the twins and growls.

"Run!" Sara says. She grabs Ben's hand and they run back to their house. They are scared and tired.

They reach their house and slam the door. They hug their mom and dad and tell them about the bear.

"Wow, that was a close call!" Dad says. "You are brave and smart. But you should not go near the stream alone. It is dangerous."

Sara and Ben nod. They drink their milk and eat their cookies. They go to their room and lie on their beds. They close their eyes and dream.

Together, the ancient plant and new seed grew. The young girl watered the plants everyday. After a few weeks, the new seed sprouted. The young girl was really happy. She cheered with joy as she watched her new plant grow.

She puts the present under the bed and waits for Lily to come out. She hopes Lily will like her surprise.

Lily sees the present and is curious. She sniffs the paper and hears something inside. She scratches the paper and makes a hole. She peeks inside and sees a soft blanket and a toy mouse.

Lily is happy and climbs into the box. She wraps herself in the blanket and plays with the toy mouse. She feels warm and safe.

Anna hears Lily purring and smiles. She crawls under the bed and joins Lily in the box. She hugs Lily and says "I love you, Lily. You are my best friend."

Lily licks Anna's face and says "Meow". She is not shy anymore. She loves Anna too. They are both happy.

Once upon a time, there was a tall man called Jack. One day, Jack had some trouble. He didn't know what to do. He needed some help.

The End

Once upon a time there was a little boy who wanted to go on a row. He believed that if he was small enough he could fit in a row. He asked his mom if he could join the small row. His mom said yes, and the little boy was so excited. 
He picked out a small row and got in it. Without thinking he started to row. He realized he was going too fast and tried to slow down, but he couldn't. He kept going faster and faster until he crashed into a rock. He was very scared but luckily he was fine.
His mom came to the rescue and helped him get out of the row. She brought him back home and hugged him tight. From that day forward, he never tried to row again. 
But he still believed in the power of the small row. He was determined to try it again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck. The duck was very glad because it had found a pond to swim in. The duck swam and swam and swam. Soon, a man came and put up a sign that said "No Ducks Allowed". The little duck was sad because it couldn't swim in the pond anymore. But then, the man saw how sad the little duck was and took down the sign. The little duck was glad again and swam happily in the pond. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the sun and drink cold lemonade. One day, Timmy saw a little bird lying on the ground. He picked it up and saw that it was dead. Timmy felt sad and asked his mommy why the bird was dead. His mommy told him that everything on earth has a life, and when it's time for it to go, it goes. Timmy understood and buried the bird in his backyard. From that day on, Timmy made sure to take care of all the little creatures on earth.

Sara and Ben are friends. They like to play in the garden. The garden has many flowers and trees and birds. Sara and Ben like to smell the flowers and watch the birds. They also like to run and jump and hide.

One day, they find a big rock in the garden. The rock is warm and smooth. Sara and Ben sit on the rock and talk.

"Look, a butterfly!" Sara says. She points to a yellow butterfly on a pink flower.

"It is pretty," Ben says. He tries to catch the butterfly, but it flies away.

"Let's follow it," Sara says. She jumps off the rock and runs after the butterfly.

Ben follows her. They run and run, but the butterfly is too fast. They get tired and stop.

They see a pond in the garden. The pond has water and fish and frogs. Sara and Ben go to the pond and sit on the grass.

They watch the fish and frogs. They hear the frogs croak and the fish splash.

"Do you like the pond?" Sara asks.

"I do," Ben says. "It is cool and fun."

"Do you like me?" Sara asks.

"I do," Ben says. "You are my friend."

Sara smiles. She leans over and kisses Ben on the cheek.

Ben blushes. He kisses Sara back on the cheek.

They hug and giggle. They are happy.

They hear a voice. It is Sara's mom.

"Sara, Ben, time to go home!" she calls.

Sara and Ben get up and wave. They hold hands and walk to the gate.

They say goodbye and promise to play again.

They leave the garden. The garden is quiet and lazy. The butterfly lands on the rock. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sophia. Sophia had a pet peacock called Billy. Every day, Sophia and Billy would go on fun adventures together.

One day, Sophia and Billy went for a walk in the woods. As they were walking, Sophia saw a big gray rock. She was so excited and she wanted to fit it in her pocket so she could take it home. She looked at Billy and asked, "Billy, can we fit this rock in my pocket?"

Billy said, "I don't think so! You need something even smaller so it fits."

Suddenly, Sophia saw a peach tree. She ran to the peach tree, grabbed the biggest peach and said, "Billy, try to fit this in my pocket."

Billy tried his best and eventually the peach fit perfectly in Sophia's pocket. Sophia was so happy and she thanked Billy for being so helpful. Then, they both walked home with the big gray peach in her pocket.

Once upon a time there was an ordinary little girl. She was out playing in the park when she noticed a pine tree. She had never seen a tree so big before so she decided to climb it. 

At the very top, she noticed a door. She was so curious, she opened the door and inside she found a secret room. It was filled with all kinds of toys. She ran around and around collecting a few of her favourites when, suddenly, the door closed and she was locked inside.

She started to get very scared but then she heard someone outside calling her name. It was her mom. She ran to the door and tried to open it but it was locked. She started to cry. 

Luckily, her mom had the key and soon enough she was out of the room. After that, she promised never to climb another pine tree again. The end.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl called Lucy. One day, Lucy was feeling very sad. She wanted to fly away so she could be happy but she was too young. 

Then, a bright flame appeared in the sky. She was scared at first, but then she saw that the flame was made of magic. 

Lucy asked the flame, "Can you let me fly away so I can be happy again?"

The flame answered, "Yes, I can permit you to fly away but first you must promise to take care of your family." 

Lucy smiled and said, "I will certainly take care of them. Please let me fly away!" 

The flame permitted Lucy to spread her arms and fly away into the night. She felt happy, free and no longer sad. Lucy waved goodbye to the flame and continued with her adventures.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Amy. She was always curious and wanted to explore the world. One day, while exploring her garden, she stumbled across a little puppy. The puppy was so attractive and eager to play, so Amy decided to take the puppy home and protect it.

After a long time of playing and exploring together, Amy and the puppy had become best friends. Every day, they did all sorts of fun activities, like exploring the park and going on long walks. The two were so close that they even talked to each other.

One day, while they were walking, the puppy stopped and looked up at Amy. "Why do you protect me all the time?" the puppy asked.

Amy smiled and said, "Because I love you, and I want us to be friends for a long time."

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant named Ellie. Ellie was enormous and loved to play with her friends. One day, Ellie and her friends were playing hide and seek in the jungle. Ellie was so good at hiding that nobody could find her.

After a while, Ellie's friends got worried and started looking for her. They searched high and low, but they couldn't find her anywhere. Suddenly, they heard Ellie's voice from a distance. She was stuck in a trap, and she couldn't get out.

Ellie's friends tried to help her, but they couldn't. They decided to go and get help from the other animals in the jungle. They went to the monkey and asked for his help. The monkey said, "I will help you, but we need to hurry. Ellie's condition will increase if we don't help her soon."

The monkey and Ellie's friends rushed back to the trap. When they got there, Ellie was in a lot of pain. The monkey tried to free her, but it was too late. Ellie's condition had increased too much, and she couldn't be saved. Ellie's friends were very sad, and they missed her very much. From that day on, they always made sure to point out any traps they saw in the jungle.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park with her mommy. When they arrived, they saw a long line of children waiting to enter the playground. The line was so busy that Lily thought they would never get to play.

Lily asked her mommy, "How long is the line?" Her mommy replied, "It's a very busy day, so we have to wait our turn." Lily looked at the other children and said, "I wish we could skip the line and go in faster."

Just then, a little boy turned around and said, "Hey, do you want to play with us?" Lily was so happy and excited that she forgot all about the line. They played together and had so much fun that they didn't even notice when it was their turn to enter the playground. When they finally went inside, Lily turned to the little boy and said, "Thank you for letting me play with you. You made my day!"

Once upon a time, there was a poor little girl named Lily. She lived in a small house with her mom and dad. They didn't have a lot of money, so they couldn't buy her many toys.

One day, Lily's parents allowed her to go play outside. She was so happy! She ran around and played with her friends. But then, she got into trouble when she accidentally broke a neighbor's flower pot. She felt very sad and scared.

When Lily went home and told her parents what happened, they hugged her and told her it was okay. They said they would help her fix the flower pot and that it was important to always tell the truth. Lily felt better knowing her parents still loved her even when she made a mistake.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside on his swing. His swing was very high and he would swing back and forth as the wind blew. 

One day, Timmy's mom made him a delicious sandwich. It had peanut butter and jelly in it. Timmy was very hungry and he ate his sandwich quickly. 

After he ate his sandwich, Timmy went outside to swing on his swing. The sun was shining and the sky was very light. Timmy felt happy as he swung back and forth on his swing.

Once upon a time, there was a wise man. He lived in a house next to a big machine. The machine had lots of bright lights and it made lots of noise. 

One day, the man decided that he wanted to see what the machine did. He went outside and he grabbed onto the machine and he pulled and pulled.

The machine made a different kind of noise and then it started moving. All the lights lit up and the man was so surprised that he jumped back!

The machine kept moving, going around and around. The man was so amazed that he just kept watching until it stopped.

The wise man realized that the machine could do some amazing things. He was very glad that he had pulled the machine and he smiled at the amazing sight.

Once upon a time, there was a red rhinoceros. He was a big, strong rhinoceros. Every day he would run around and play in the grass. 

One day, he saw a boy. The boy was only three years old, but he could understand what the rhinoceros was saying. The rhinoceros was so excited and he wanted to be friends with the boy.

But the boy was scared of the rhinoceros. He didn't understand why the rhinoceros was so big and red. 

The rhinoceros was sad because the boy was scared. He decided to bring the boy some flowers, so that the boy would understand that the rhinoceros was friendly. 

The boy was surprised to see all the beautiful flowers. He smiled and hugged the rhinoceros. He finally understood that the rhinoceros was his friend, and they played and laughed together.

Once upon a time there was a famous cat called Sam. He liked to crawl around his house. One day, he saw a big folder near the door. He had never seen it before. He climbed on top of it and started to have lots of fun.

He curled up and rolled around, purring with delight. He was so happy he didn't want to get off! Suddenly, the front door opened and in stepped a big human! Sam knew he was in trouble. He quickly crawled inside the folder, to hide.

The human walked over and picked up the folder. Sam was very scared but also curious. What would happen next? The human carried him out the door and down the garden path. He then put him on the ground by a fence.

Sam looked around
He was in a sunny field full of wildflowers. He had never seen anything so beautiful. He crawled around for the rest of the day, exploring and making new friends.

That night, Sam returned home feeling very happy. He had had a very famous adventure!

Once upon a time there was a little bunny called Chloe. Chloe was so excited because today she was going to have a nap. She took off down the garden path and hopped until she reached a beautiful tree. She saw a big, soft bed of grass and snuggled into it.

Just as Chloe was settling down, she heard a loud shock. She knew it wasn't thunder and it scared her. She opened her eyes and saw a big loud monster. Chloe looked so scared and sad.

The monster said, "Why did you come here? I was just about to have a nap! You ruined my nap, so now you have to leave". Chloe was so sad. She didn't want to lose her nap, so she said, "I'm sorry. I will leave".

The monster stopped for a minute and looked at Chloe. He said, "No, you can stay and have a nap. I will go and find somewhere else to sleep. Goodbye Chloe!"

So Chloe had a nice nap under the big tree, and never saw the monster again. The end.

Once upon a time, in a cheerful forest, there lived a little bunny named Ben. Ben was a happy bunny who loved to play with his friends all day. In the evening, Ben and his friends would play hide and seek.

One evening, Ben was hiding behind a big tree while his friend, Lily the squirrel, was looking for him. Lily looked everywhere, but she could not find Ben. "I give up," Lily said with a sigh. Ben heard her and knew that "give up" meant "surrender."

Ben hopped out from behind the tree and said, "Here I am, Lily! You did a good job looking for me!" Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Ben! Next time, I will find you for sure!"

They played until the sun went down, and then it was time to go home. Ben and Lily said goodbye to each other and went to their cozy homes. They knew that the next day would bring more fun and games in the cheerful forest.

Once upon a time, there were two sister called Jane and Sue. Jane's dress was very dull and plain, but Sue had the most beautiful dress. It was the color of a beautiful summer sky and had gorgeous velvet petals that bloomed in the sun. The dress twirled and sparkled when Sue spun around on the grass. 

One day, Jane grew very jealous of Sue's dress. She wished she had something as beautiful as her sister. The next morning, Jane got dressed and noticed her dull dress had bloomed with lovely, bright colors. Now her dress was just like Sue's!

Jane skipped to school, beaming with joy. When su see saw Jane she gasped with delight and asked if she had gotten a new dress. Jane smiled and said, "Nope, I guess my old one just bloomed!"

Once upon a time there was a nosy little girl named Jane. She was only three years old.

One day, Jane was playing in the backyard with her toys. She had a huge stack of blocks that she was playing with.

Suddenly, the sky became dark, and it started to rain. Jane's stack of blocks started to get wet.

Jane didn't want her blocks to get ruined, so she picked them up and brought them inside. But as she brought them in, some of them started to get soft and melt!

Jane was very sad to see her blocks melting. She wanted to play with them again.

She asked her mom for help and mom said, "Let's put them in the freezer."

Jane brought her stack of blocks to the freezer and put them in. And soon the blocks were nice and cool and solid again!

Jane was so happy that her blocks were back, she started building with them again. And everyone lived happily ever after. 

The end.

Once upon a time, there were two bears who lived in a big house. They loved to tell stories to each other. One day, the two bears decided to go outside and explore. As they explored, they came across a vine that was growing up a tall tree.

The bears looked at the vine, and knew it was special. They decided to take it home with them. When the bears got back to the house, they used the vine to make a swing. 

The bears had so much fun swinging on their new swing! Every day, the two bears took turns pushing each other, and now the house was filled with laughter and smiles. 

Eventually, the bears noticed that their vine was starting to wear down. It was too cheap to last. But the bears had already had so much fun that they decided to tell everyone they knew about their special vine and the joyful memories they made while swinging on it. 


The End.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to play outside and chase squirrels. One day, Max saw his friend, a little bird named Tweetie, flying in the sky. Max recognized Tweetie because they played together before. 

Tweetie had a folder in her beak. Max was curious and asked Tweetie what was inside. Tweetie said it was her favorite book. Max thought that was very graceful of Tweetie to carry her book in a folder to keep it safe. 

Max and Tweetie decided to read the book together. They sat under a tree and read about a magical land with talking animals. Max and Tweetie had so much fun reading together and became even better friends. From that day on, Max always recognized Tweetie and they would read books together whenever they had the chance.

Once upon a time there was a chubby little girl named Mary. Mary loved spending her days at the park, but one day it was closed. Mary started to complain that she wanted to go to the park. Her mum said they should go to the playground instead.

At the playground, Mary saw lots of other children and it made her very happy. She started playing on the swings at the playground. She even went on the slide!

Suddenly a chubby little boy came up to Mary. He said to her: "Hi, can I join you?" Mary smiled and said, "Yes!"

The two children started talking and playing together. Mary was no longer complaining about not being able to go to the park because she was having such a great time with her new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Snowy. Snowy was very white and fluffy. One day, Snowy wanted to travel to a new place. Snowy asked his friends if they wanted to come, but they all said no. Snowy was sad, but he decided to travel alone.

As Snowy was hopping along, he saw a bird who looked guilty. Snowy asked the bird what was wrong, and the bird said he had eaten all the seeds in the garden. Snowy told the bird it was not nice to eat all the seeds and that he should say sorry to the gardener.

Snowy continued on his journey and eventually found a beautiful meadow. Snowy was so happy he decided to take a nap. When he woke up, he saw that his friends had followed him and were playing nearby. Snowy was overjoyed that he was not alone anymore and they all played together in the meadow.

One day, Anna was having a picnic in the park. She was so excited for it! She had brought a red lunch box with her and she couldn't wait to open it.
