Once upon a time there was a little girl. She enjoyed pretending and often created imaginary worlds and adventures.

One day, her mommy took her to a park. She noticed an elderly person sitting on a bench and went over to say hello. The elderly person was delighted to meet the little girl and they began to chat. The elderly person showed the girl an old object he kept in his pocket. He told her it was a special object and he smiled when she pretended to imagine it was a magical wand. 

The elderly person explained that if you pretend, you can make really wonderful things happen and your dreams can come true. The little girl said goodbye and ran off to play in the park, but the elderly person's words stayed with her.

The moral of the story is that if you use your imagination, you can make anything possible. So always pretend and never stop dreaming!

Once upon a time, there was a fearful silver fox who lived deep in the forest. She was always very careful, for she knew that her enemies could be everywhere. One day, the fox noticed something shiny near the base of a giant tree. She cautiously crept over to investigate and saw that it was a silver plate filled with delicious food. The fox sniffed the plate and understood that it was meant to serve as a meal for her.

The fox slowly started to eat the food. She quickly realized that this was by far the most delicious meal she had ever tasted. She ate every last scrap and felt so happy and content. With her belly full, she remembered that this meal had been served to her and she promised to always be grateful. The fox thanked the mysterious figure and scurried off into the darkness, feeling thankful and safe.

Tom and Mia were playing in the garden. They had a big toy car that they could push and ride. Tom liked to go fast and make loud noises. Mia liked to go slow and look at the flowers.

"Let me drive, Tom!" Mia said. "You always drive!"

"No, I want to drive!" Tom said. "You are too slow!"

They started to fight over the toy car. They pulled and pushed and shouted. They did not see the frog that was sitting on the grass.

The frog was green and brown and had spots. It was very filthy. It had mud and leaves on its skin. It did not like the noise and the fighting. It wanted to be left alone.

The frog jumped on the toy car. It landed on the reverse button. The toy car started to go backwards. Tom and Mia were surprised. They stopped fighting. They looked at the frog.

"Ribbit!" the frog said. It looked at them with big eyes.

"Wow, a frog!" Mia said. "It is so filthy!"

"Maybe it wants to play with us!" Tom said. "Let's be nice to it!"

They smiled at the frog. They took it off the toy car. They washed it with water. They gave it some lettuce. They made a home for it with a box and some grass.

The frog was happy. It liked Tom and Mia. It croaked and hopped. It played with them. They became friends. They learned to share the toy car. They had fun in the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little bunny. This bunny was so excited to hop around the fields and have fun.

One day, the bunny found something strange: an oil spill! It was puddling all over the ground. So the bunny hopped over to get a closer look.

The bunny felt sad to see the oil spill and wanted to clean it up. So the bunny hopped around and found a nice, old towel.

The bunny was so happy that he had found a way to clean up the spill. He hopped over and wiped up the oil with the towel.

Once the bunny had finished, the field was nice and clean again! The bunny was so proud of himself for helping clean up the oil spill. The bunny hopped away, happy to have made a difference.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a teddy bear named Brownie. One day, Lily and Brownie went to the park to play. They saw a bee collecting honey from a flower. "What is the bee doing?" asked Lily. "The bee is getting honey from the flower," replied Brownie. 

Suddenly, it started to rain. Lily and Brownie ran to a nearby tree for shelter. "What should we do now?" asked Lily. "We can pray that the rain will stop soon," said Brownie. So, Lily and Brownie closed their eyes and prayed for the rain to stop. 

After a while, the rain stopped and the sun came out. Lily and Brownie were happy to see the rainbow in the sky. They went home and had some honey on their toast. "Yummy!" said Lily. "This honey is so sweet and delicious!"

The little boy wanted to go on an adventure. He wanted to see something new and exciting. He put on his purple shoes and grabbed his pail.

Then he moved toward the stream. He could hear the water flowing and he saw some birds chirping in the trees. He was so excited!

He walked closer to the stream. The water was shiny and the rocks were big and slippery. He moved the rocks around in the stream and he watched the bubbles come up. He then saw a bright purple fish!

The little boy was so excited that he ran back home to tell his mom about his adventure. He told her all about the stream and the purple fish. She smiled and said, "Sounds like you had the best adventure ever!"

He smiled and said, "I knew it was going to be fun!"

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun and feel the grass tickle her toes. One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She saw a big slide and ran to climb up it. She slid down and landed on the ground with a big clap! 

Lily's mom took out a snack and gave her a zip bag with some yummy crackers inside. Lily was so happy and felt important because she could hold the zip bag all by herself. She ate her crackers and then went to play on the swings. She swung so high that she felt like she was flying in the sky. 

When it was time to go home, Lily's mom gave her a big hug and told her how proud she was of her for being such a good girl at the park. Lily smiled and clapped her hands because she was happy too. She knew she would come back to the park again soon and have more fun. The end.

Sam and Ben are brothers. They like to play with their toys. Sam has a big truck and Ben has a small car. They make noises and pretend to drive on the road.

One day, Sam sees Ben's car and wants to play with it. He says, "Give me your car, Ben. It is nice and shiny. My truck is old and dirty."

Ben says, "No, Sam. This is my car. You have your truck. Go away."

Sam does not listen. He tries to pull the car from Ben's hand. Ben holds on tight. They pull and pull and pull. The car breaks in half. They both cry.

Mom hears the noise and comes to see what is wrong. She sees the broken car and the sad boys. She says, "What happened here? Why did you break Ben's car, Sam?"

Sam says, "I wanted to play with it. It has a good style. My truck is dead."

Mom says, "That is not nice, Sam. You cannot take things that are not yours. You have to ask first. And you cannot break things that are not yours. You have to be careful. Now you have to say sorry to Ben and help him fix his car."

Sam feels bad. He says, "Sorry, Ben. I was wrong. Can we fix your car?"

Ben says, "Maybe. But we need glue and tape. And we need to be gentle."

Mom says, "I have glue and tape. Come with me. We will fix the car together. And then you can share and play nicely."

Sam and Ben follow Mom. They fix the car with glue and tape. It is not as shiny as before, but it still works. They say thank you to Mom. They hug each other. They play with the car and the truck. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He liked to wear a big, dark hat. The hat was his favorite thing to wear. Tim wore the hat everywhere he went.

One day, Tim found a pencil on the ground. The pencil was small and yellow. Tim liked the pencil a lot. He put the pencil in his hat and took it with him.

Tim drew pictures with the pencil. He drew a sun, a tree, and a cat. Tim was very happy with his new pencil. He wore his dark hat and drew pictures every day.

Once there was a boy. He was very special, unique. He had an old pillow. His pillow had been passed down in his family since long ago. He would hug the pillow and feel special. 

One day he wanted to attach the pillow to something else special. He found a red balloon, also unique. He wanted to attach the pillow to the balloon, so he tied the balloon's string to the pillow using a knot.

He then took his pillow and went on an adventure. He flew so high in the sky and jumped across clouds with his pillow attached to the balloon! 

He had so much fun. When he came back, he kept the pillow with the balloon attached. He knew it was unique and special, like him.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and go on adventures. One day, she went to the park with her mom.

While they were walking, Lily saw a boy playing with a ball. She asked him, "Can I play with you?"

The boy said, "Sure! We can play together. Do you want to count how many times we can kick the ball back and forth?"

Lily replied, "Yes! I love to number things. It's a fun way to play."

So, they started to kick the ball and count. Lily was very happy because she made a new friend and had a fun way to play.

Jack saw a modern safe sitting on the table. The safe was shiny and new. He was very curious.

Jack wanted to open the safe. He asked his mom if he could try, but she told him no. She said it was too hard for him.

Jack was sad. He started to ignore his mom and focus on the safe. He tried to figure out how to open it. Jack looked around for tools and found a big key.

Jack thought this was the key to the safe. He tried to use it but the safe didn't open. His mom told him that the key was too old and it wouldn't work.

Jack was frustrated. He looked around and asked his mom "What key should I use?"

Her mom smiled and said "No key. The safe is made to stay closed so your things are safe inside. It has a modern design that stays closed and only I can open it".

Jack looked at the safe with a new respect and accepted that he had to ignore it. He knew that even though he couldn't open it, his things inside were safe.

Sara and Ben were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big hill near their house. They wanted to climb it and see what was on the other side. They asked their mom if they could go.

"OK, but be careful and don't go too far," their mom said. "And take this bag of snacks and water with you."

Sara and Ben thanked their mom and took the bag. They started to climb the hill, holding hands. They saw many flowers and birds and rocks on the way. They were happy and curious.

When they reached the top of the hill, they saw a lot of mist. It was white and soft and cold. They could not see very well. They wondered what was in the mist.

"Let's go and find out," Sara said.

"OK, but don't let go of my hand," Ben said.

They walked into the mist, holding hands. They felt like they were in a dream. They heard strange noises and saw strange shapes. They wandered for a long time.

They started to feel scared and lost. They wanted to go back to their mom. But they did not know which way to go. They could not see the hill or their house. They only saw mist.

"Mom, mom, where are you?" they cried.

"Help, help, we are lost!" they shouted.

Suddenly, they heard a bark. It was their dog, Spot. He had followed them from their house. He was a good and helpful dog. He ran to them and licked their faces. He wagged his tail and barked again.

"Spot, Spot, you found us!" Sara and Ben said.

They hugged their dog and felt happy and safe. They let Spot lead them out of the mist. He knew the way back to their house. He was a smart and helpful dog.

They followed Spot down the hill, holding hands. They saw their mom waiting for them at the door. She was worried and angry and happy.

"Where have you been? I was so worried about you!" she said.

"We were lost in the mist, but Spot found us and helped us," Sara and Ben said.

They told their mom what happened. They said they were sorry and they would not wander again. They gave their mom a big hug and kiss. They gave Spot a big hug and kiss too. They shared their snacks and water with him.

They learned their lesson. They never wandered into the mist again. They always listened to their mom. And they always loved their dog. He was a good and helpful dog. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two baby twins: Alex and Emily. They were always together and loved to play in the sunshine. One day, their mommy told them that it was time to turn in for the night. Emily was scared and looked for something to protect her in the dark. She asked, "Mommy, can you stay and protect us?" 

Mommy smiled and told her, "Don't worry Emily. I am here, and so is your brother Alex, and together we can protect each other all night long." Emily smiled back and snuggled into bed with Alex. 

The twins were so happy to have each other to keep each other safe, that even in the dark, they both felt safe, secure, and protected.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with their toys and make up stories. One day, they decided to pretend they were on a boat in a big lake. They used a big box as their boat and some sticks as their oars. They rowed and rowed and had fun.

But then, they heard a loud roar from behind a bush. They stopped rowing and looked around. They saw a big lion with a mane and sharp teeth. The lion was angry and hungry. It wanted to eat them.

Lily and Ben were scared. They did not know what to do. They hugged each other and hoped the lion would go away. But the lion did not go away. It came closer and closer to their boat.

"Help! Help!" Lily and Ben cried. "Who will save us?"

Then, they heard another roar. But this roar was different. It was not angry and hungry. It was brave and loyal. It was their dog, Rex. Rex was a big and strong dog. He loved Lily and Ben very much. He heard their cries and came to help them.

Rex ran to the bush and barked at the lion. He showed his teeth and wagged his tail. He told the lion to leave Lily and Ben alone. He said they were his friends and he would protect them.

The lion was surprised and scared. He did not want to fight Rex. He knew Rex was loyal and brave. He decided to run away and look for another meal. He roared one last time and ran away.

Lily and Ben were happy and relieved. They thanked Rex for saving them. They gave him a big hug and a treat. They said he was the best dog ever. They continued to play with their toys and make up stories. They were safe and happy with their loyal friend, Rex.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Annie. She was wearing a pink dress.

Annie said, "Oh wow!"

Mum said, "Let's watch them swim". 

Annie and her mum watched the pretty fish display themselves in the pond. One of the fish had a pink tail and Annie thought it was so lovely.

Annie said, "I like the pink fish!"

The sun was warm and it was a great day for Annie and Mum.

Once upon a time, there was a mechanic named Dave. He loved his job and enjoyed fixing things for people. One day, Dave got a very special job - he had to fix an orange truck. 

When Dave arrived at the garage, he couldn't believe his eyes. The truck was so orange! Dave was excited to get started on the job. 

But as he began to work, Dave realized it was a hard job. He worked and worked, but still the truck wouldn't work. 

Dave became discouraged, and was starting to give up. He thought to himself, "I don't think I can fix it!"

Just then, Dave heard the voice of his friend, who said, "Don't give up, Dave! If you try hard enough, you can do anything!"

With new determination and courage, Dave worked harder. In the end, he was able to fix the truck. He proved to himself that if you don't give up, and if you keep trying, you can achieve anything.

Once there were two friends, Sandy and Pete. Pete was bald and Sandy had lots of curly hair. One day Pete said to Sandy, "Letâ€™s go to the other side of town. I want to see all the traffic." So they decided to carry their bicycles across the bridge.

The bridge was very long, and when they had almost reached the other side, they noticed that there was a lot of traffic. The traffic was too much for them to carry their bicycles safely, so they decided to go back.

When they returned to the bridge, it had gotten much colder and the wind blew much stronger. Sandy was struggling to carry her bike and she was getting very tired. Suddenly, she realized that Pete had stopped moving. She turned around to see what had happened to him and realized he had slipped and fallen into the water!

Sandy was so scared that she started to cry. She tried to find Pete, but he was gone. Sandy had to go home alone. The bridge was no longer safe for her to cross and Sandy was sad that she wouldn't see Pete ever again.

Ben and Sam liked to play chess with their grandpa. Grandpa was old and had white hair and glasses. He taught them how to move the pieces and how to say checkmate. Ben and Sam had fun and learned a lot.

One day, they went to visit grandpa and saw him sitting on the couch with a book. He looked sad and tired. He did not smile when he saw them. He did not want to play chess. He said he had a headache and needed to rest.

Ben and Sam were worried. They wanted to make grandpa happy. They looked around the room and saw a big box. They opened it and found a lot of toys and games. They saw a puzzle, a ball, a teddy bear, a train, and a hat. They had an idea.

They took the toys and games and put them on the table. They made a sign that said "Grandpa's Fun Zone". They put the hat on grandpa's head and gave him the teddy bear. They asked him to join them and play.

Grandpa looked at the table and saw the toys and games. He saw the sign and the hat and the teddy bear. He felt a warm feeling in his heart. He put down his book and got up from the couch. He smiled and hugged Ben and Sam. He said he was sorry for being grumpy. He said he loved them very much. He said he would play with them and have fun.

Ben and Sam were happy. They played with grandpa and laughed and talked. They forgot about chess and headache. They had a wonderful time. Grandpa did not frown anymore. He was old, but he was young at heart.

Adam lived in a fancy house near a swamp. Every day he would go out and explore the swamp, looking for treasure and looking for new adventures. His parents encouraged him to explore and make new friends, to help him learn and grow. 

One afternoon, Adam came home unusually excited. He ran straight to his mom to tell her about a new discovery he had made. 

"Mom," he said, "I met a crocodile today and he said he wanted to be my friend!" 

His mom smiled and encouraged him, telling him that making new friends was a great way to have fun in the swamp. Adam thanked his mom and ran back to the swamp, ready to have adventures with his new friend.

Lily and Tom were very hot and thirsty. They were walking in the sand with their dad. They wanted to find water and shade. They saw some green trees and a blue lake far away. "Look, dad, an oasis!" Lily said. "Can we go there?"

"Yes, we can, but we have to be careful. There might be animals or people there who don't want to share," dad said. He held their hands and walked faster.

When they got to the oasis, they saw a camel and a man. The man was wearing a big hat and a long robe. He was sitting under a palm tree. He saw them and smiled. "Hello, friends. Welcome to my oasis. Do you need water?" he asked.

"Yes, please. We are very thirsty. Thank you for being kind," dad said. He and the children drank some water from a jug. The man gave them some dates and bread. "You are very hungry, too. Eat and rest. You can stay here as long as you want," he said.

Lily and Tom smiled. They liked the man and the camel. They played with them and ate some more. They felt happy and safe. They thought the oasis was a wonderful place. They did not know that it was very ordinary for the man. He lived there all the time. He was glad to have some visitors. He liked to share his oasis.

Once upon a time there was a rabbit and a mouse who were good friends. The rabbit was always very careful and thought before she moved. The mouse, who was very foolish, was always in a hurry and didn't think before he moved.

One day, the rabbit and mouse were walking along and saw a cactus. The mouse saw the cactus and was very excited. He quickly moved and touched it. But, to his surprise, he felt a sharp prick! He screamed in pain.

The rabbit quickly ran to the mouse. The rabbit said, "You're so foolish! Why did you move so fast? You should have thought before you moved. Always use caution when touching something you're not familiar with."

The mouse learned his lesson and was more careful after that. He thought before he moved and never made the same mistake again. Since then, the mouse and the rabbit had a great time exploring their new world. They never forgot the moral of their story: it is important to think before you move.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly lady. She loved to teach children all about the world. One day, she was teaching a three-year-old boy. She showed him a faucet and explained to him that it was used to get water. The little boy was fascinated and asked lots of questions.

The elderly lady then told him all sorts of stories about how water is used every day. She explained that you can take a shower and wash your hands at the faucet. She also showed him how to turn the faucet off and on. 

The little boy was amazed by all these new things he was learning. He watched intently as the elderly lady demonstrated how to turn the faucet handle and the water started coming out of the spout. 

At the end, the little boy thanked the elderly lady for teaching him about the faucet. He was so excited to tell his mom and dad all about it when he got home. The elderly lady smiled and said she was glad to have helped.

One day, Jojo was helping his mommy in the kitchen. She asked him to fetch a cloth and a bucket of water. Jojo ran quickly to the bathroom and took a cloth, then he filled the bucket with water from the tap.

Jojo and his mommy went to the kitchen together and Jojo put the cloth in the water. His mommy asked him to wash the table. Jojo was so happy to help, so he started scrubbing the table with the soapy cloth. Soon, the table was all clean and Jojo felt very cheerful.

Jojo's mommy was very pleased and she thanked him for helping. Jojo was thrilled at being able to help his mommy and he was smiling cheerfully. 

The next day, Jojo decided he would help his mommy more often. He knew it made her happy when he helped, and it was fun too!

Tom and Mia were playing with their toys. Tom had a big red rocket that made loud noises. Mia had a small blue rocket that had shiny stickers. Tom liked his rocket more than Mia's rocket. He wanted to play with both rockets.

"Give me your rocket, Mia," Tom said. "My rocket is better than yours."

"No, Tom," Mia said. "This is my rocket. You can't have it. You have your own rocket."

Tom was angry. He tried to grab Mia's rocket from her hands. Mia held on tight. They pulled and pushed and shouted.

"Stop it, Tom and Mia," Mom said. She came into the room and saw them fighting. "Why are you being so silly? You have enough toys to share. You can choose to play nicely or go to your rooms."

Tom and Mia looked at Mom. They felt sorry for being mean to each other. They did not want to go to their rooms.

"Sorry, Mom," Tom said. "Sorry, Mia."

"Sorry, Mom," Mia said. "Sorry, Tom."

Mom smiled. She gave them a hug. She told them to choose a game they could play together with their rockets.

Tom and Mia thought for a moment. Then they had an idea.

"Let's pretend we are astronauts," Tom said. "We can fly our rockets to the moon and see the stars."

"OK," Mia said. "That sounds fun. Let's go."

Tom and Mia took their rockets and ran to the backyard. They made zooming and beeping sounds. They had a blast. They chose to be friends.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Jessica. They were best buds and did everything together. One day they decided to plan a movie night.

"Let's go to the movies," said Jack.

"Yes!" Jessica said, "Let's go see a movie together."

So they planned and decided which movie to watch. It was going to be a special movie and they wanted to make everything perfect.

"We should get some popcorn," said Jack.

"And we could also get some drinks," said Jessica.

They worked together to plan the movie night. Jack picked up the tickets and Jessica bought the snacks. They invited their friends too so it would be a regular movie night with lots of fun.

Finally, it was time for the movie night. They all had a great time and enjoyed the movie. It was a night to remember, full of giggles, munching popcorn, and memories that will last forever.

Molly and Luke had a special day. They wanted to go to the beach for a fun surprise. When they got there, Molly gave Luke a surfboard. He was so excited! It was a big, beautiful surfboard. But it was fake. 

They both laughed at how silly it looked. Molly then told Luke she had a real surprise. She gave him a life jacket and they both ran into the ocean. 

The water was so cool and they had so much fun! Luke used his surfboard to surf the waves. Molly was so proud of him! The sun was shining and the waves were just right. They stayed in the ocean for hours until the sky was dark. 

At the end of the day, Molly and Luke were tired, but happy. They had a wonderful day at the beach and made so many wonderful memories.

Molly loves kangaroos. She likes to watch them hop and play. One day, Molly was in the park. She saw a kangaroo eating something sour. Molly wanted to try it too. She thought it might be nice.

Molly walked over to the kangaroo and asked, "Can I have some?" The kangaroo nodded and handed her a sour fruit. Molly took a bite and smiled. She loved the sour taste.

Molly was happy. She loved kangaroos and she loved the sour fruit. She thanked the kangaroo and ran off to play. From then on, Molly always looked forward to going to the park and eating sour fruit with her kangaroo friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved eating pasta for dinner. One day, her mom made her favorite spaghetti with tomato sauce. Lily was so happy and ate it all up.

After dinner, Lily went to play with her toys. Suddenly, she heard her mom say, "Lily, come here! The door is open and it's dangerous outside." Lily quickly ran to her mom and closed the door. 

"Thank you, Lily. You're so helpful," said her mom. Lily smiled and said, "I closed the door to keep us safe." Her mom hugged her and said, "You're such a smart girl." 

Lily felt proud of herself and went back to playing with her toys, feeling happy and safe.

One day there was a very adventurous little bear named Dave. Dave loved exploring the world around him. He was in search of a special treasure.

So Dave set out into the forest. He wanted to find some unique and beautiful things. As he was walking, it started to rain! Dave was not afraid though. He ran faster to find shelter.

He came across an old tree, it had a big cut in it. He wondered what he could do. He saw a hole in the cut, it was the perfect size for Dave to hide in. He crawled in, and the rain stopped.

Dave was excited, he had found a great hideout. But then he heard some voices. It was two other adventurous bears. They were looking for a treasure too!

''Do you want to join us on our adventure?'' one bear asked.

Dave smiled, ''Yes! I would love to join you!'' And so the three of them went on a wonderful treasure hunt.

The End

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim had a purple toy car that he loved very much. He played with it every day.

One day, Tim's mom said, "Tim, it's time to go to the store. Put on your buckle and come with me." Tim didn't want to go to the store. He wanted to play with his purple car. Tim said, "Mom, I hate going to the store. I want to play with my car."

Mom said, "Tim, we need to go to the store to buy food. You can bring your purple car with you." Tim thought about it, and then he put on his buckle and took his purple car with him to the store.

At the store, Tim pushed his purple car along the shelves while his mom picked out food. Tim was happy that he could play with his car and help his mom at the same time. When they got home, Tim said, "Mom, I don't hate going to the store with you anymore. I had fun with my purple car."

Once upon a time, there was a duck named Ducky. Ducky was very kind and generous to other ducks. One day, Ducky felt very tired and decided to take a nap by the pond. While Ducky was napping, some other ducks came by and saw how tired Ducky was. They decided to be generous and not disturb Ducky's nap. When Ducky woke up, Ducky felt very happy and thanked the other ducks for being so kind. From that day on, Ducky made sure to be generous to all the other ducks, just like they were to Ducky. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She was three years old and liked to play outside with her friends. One day, Lucy decided to go to the fair, and she asked her mother if she could go. Her mother said yes and gave her some money for the fair.

At the fair, Lucy had a lot of fun. She got to play games, and she even got a prize! She was so excited.

Soon, it was time to go home. When Lucy counted her money, she found she had zero left! She was sad. She wanted to buy something else, but she had no money for it. She went home feeling disappointed.

But the next day, Lucy's mom gave her a surprise. She had been very fair and had given Lucy more money for the fair. Lucy was so happy! This time, she was able to buy something she really wanted.

The end.

One day, Jack and his mommy went to the park. Jack was very excited. He saw lots of nice things. He saw swings, a slide and a big yellow ball he could kick.

Jack ran all around the park. He smiled and laughed and jumped. His mommy watched him with a smile.

Jack found a big, green tree that he liked. He climbed up and down. He liked how the leaves felt.

When it was time to go, Jack was sad. But he was still excited. He wanted to come back to the park tomorrow. His mommy said "Yes, Jack, we can come back to the park again soon. That would be nice". Jack smiled, and they went home.

Once there was a fat cat. He loved to eat food. Every day he would wait for his dinner to be served. But one day, the dinner switch happened. Instead of dinner, the cat was served breakfast. He was so surprised and confused. All he wanted was dinner, not breakfast! He meowed and looked unhappy, but he still ate it anyways.

The next day, he was excited to see what he was served. To his delight, dinner was served. He gobbled it up and was so pleased! From then on, he was always excited to see what meal he was served. He hoped dinner was switched to dinner every night. 

The cat found dinner was the best meal to serve. He had such fun eating the delicious food. And he was the happiest and most fat cat you've ever seen!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He liked to build things with his toys. One day, Tim had an idea. He wanted to make something original. He thought and thought about what to build.

Tim decided to build a toy gun. He used blocks and sticks to make it. He showed his toy gun to his friend, Sam. "Look, I made a gun!" said Tim. Sam thought it was cool and wanted to build one too.

Together, Tim and Sam built more toy guns. They played and had lots of fun. They showed their friends how to build toy guns too. And they all played together, happy with their original toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. He loved to play with his toy cars and trucks all day long. One day, Tim's mom told him they were going on a trip to the beach. Tim was so excited! He packed his favorite toys and they headed out.

When they arrived at the beach, Tim wanted to go swimming. His mom told him to wait a minute while she put sunscreen on him. Tim didn't like the sunscreen because it felt tight on his skin. "Mom, I don't want to wear this! It's too tight!" he said.

His mom explained that the sunscreen was important to protect his skin from the sun, which can be harmful. "Just like how we need oxygen to breathe, our skin needs protection from the sun," she said. Tim understood and agreed to wear the sunscreen. They had a great day at the beach and Tim was happy he listened to his mom's advice.

Lily and Ben were playing in the park. They liked to pretend they were knights and princesses. They had a big stick for a sword and a scarf for a cape.

"Look, there is a dragon!" Ben said, pointing to a slide. "We have to solve this problem. It is scaring the other kids."

Lily nodded. She was brave and smart. She had an idea. "Maybe the dragon is not mean. Maybe it is lonely and wants a friend. Let's talk to it."

They walked to the slide. The dragon was big and green. It had scales and wings and teeth. It roared when it saw them.

"Hello, dragon," Lily said in a soft voice. "We are Lily and Ben. We want to play with you. Do you want to play with us?"

The dragon stopped roaring. It looked at them with curious eyes. It tilted its head.

"Play?" it asked in a low voice. "What is play?"

Lily and Ben smiled. They explained what play was. They showed the dragon how to slide and swing and run. The dragon liked play. It was fun and nice. It laughed and flew and hugged.

"Thank you, Lily and Ben," the dragon said. "You are good friends. You solved my problem. I was lonely and sad. Now I am happy and glad."

Lily and Ben were happy too. They had made a new friend. They learned that sometimes problems can be solved with kindness and words. They also learned that dragons can be graceful and gentle. They played with the dragon until it was time to go home. They waved goodbye and promised to come back soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the morning when it was hot. But one day, Timmy's mom asked him to clean his room before he could go outside. Timmy didn't want to clean his room, he just wanted to play.

Timmy's mom told him that it was important to clean his room and that he couldn't go outside until he finished. Timmy was upset, but he knew he had to listen to his mom. So, he quit playing and started cleaning his room.

After he finished, Timmy went outside to play. He realized that listening to his mom was important and that sometimes he had to quit playing to do what was right. From that day on, Timmy always listened to his mom and did what he was supposed to do. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a mom and a dad who wanted to make a coat for their daughter. So, they got some nice fabric and asked their daughter to pick a colour. She picked yellow!

The mom and dad set out to work at making the coat. It took them a few days, but they finally made it and it looked beautiful.
They gave it to the daughter and she was so happy.
She wore it every day, even when it was cold outside.

The family was so happy to have a nice warm coat that was available to keep their daughter warm. Whenever she needed it, it was right there and ready to go. 
It made the parents feel good to know their daughter was kept safe and warm in her special coat. 
The family has enjoyed wearing their coat ever since and will always treasure it.

Once upon a time there was an adventurous girl called Ruby. Every morning she would pack her bag with muffins and head out to explore.

First, she would take her muffins to the river. She watched as the fish swam in the clear blue water. Then she continued on to the park. Here she saw lots of birds in the trees.

Next, she would go to the cliffs. It was very scary, but Ruby was brave and she loved to explore. She felt so brave and adventurous.

Finally, she would set off home. She had to pack up all of her muffins before she could go. Then she had a delicious snack before setting off on her next adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she found a big cardboard box in her backyard. It was enormous! She climbed inside and pretended she was in a castle. 

As the sun began to set, Lily noticed something strange. The box began to glow! She was amazed and excited. She thought maybe fairies had come to visit her. 

Lily played in the glowing cardboard castle until it got dark outside. Then, she went inside for dinner. She couldn't wait to tell her parents about the magical glowing box she had found.

Once upon a time, there was a fancy wedding. The bride and groom were wearing nice clothes and everyone was happy. They were going to get married.

Before the wedding started, the groom's best friend whispered something in his ear. The groom smiled and nodded. The best friend said, "Just wait until the reception, I have a surprise for you."

During the reception, the best friend turned on some music and the groom and his bride started dancing. Suddenly, the best friend came out with a big cake. The groom was surprised and happy. "Thank you for the cake," he said. "This is the best marriage ever!"

Once upon a time, in a faraway land, there lived a fair princess. She had a special power - she could shrink things! One day, the princess chose to shrink a flame. She watched as the flame became smaller and smaller until it completely disappeared.

The princess was amazed at her power and wanted to know what the flame was like when it was smaller. But, when she reached out to touch the tiny flame, it burned her finger!

The princess learned her lesson and from then on, she decided to only shrink things that couldn't hurt her. And, since then, she's been using her power for good and to help people in need.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who liked to wander. One day, she found a hammer in an unknown place. Curious, she picked up the hammer and decided to explore with it.

The hammer was so heavy and the girl felt special because she had something to carry on her journey. Everywhere she went, the hammer made a loud thump as it bumped against the ground.

Under a big tree she found something interesting that she had never seen before. She used the hammer to knock on the round object and it made a strange sound. She kept knocking until the unknown object opened up and sprang to life!

She had discovered a tiny little bird! The bird flew up in the sky and the girl waved goodbye. She put the hammer back in her pocket and continued to wander - wondering what else she might find!

Little Ben lived in a big country. He wanted to study and learn more about it. He asked his dad,"What is our country like?" His dad smiled and said," Lots of people live in our country and they speak different languages. It's very exciting!" Ben was excited too, but he wanted to know more.

He asked,"Why are some people ignorant?" His dad was confused and said," What do you mean by ignorant?" Ben thought hard and said, "Well, they don't know what other people are talking about." His dad said," Oh, you mean they don't understand? Yes, that happens when people don't take the time to study and learn about each other. That's why it's important to learn about new things."

Ben was happy to hear that and he said," I'm going to study our country and learn as much as I can!" His dad was proud and said," That's great, Ben! Just remember, there's so much to learn about the world. Have fun and be curious!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and run around in the grass. One day, she fell down and got a big boo-boo on her knee. Her mommy gave her a hug and put a stitch on her knee to make it all better.

Lily was very enthusiastic about going back outside to play, but she wondered if her knee would still hurt. She tried to stand up, and to her surprise, it didn't hurt at all! She was so happy that she ran around and played even more.

From that day on, Lily made sure to be extra careful when she played outside. But even if she fell down and got another boo-boo, she knew her mommy would always be there to put a stitch on it and make it all better.

One day there was a boy. He had time to wander. He looked out of his window and saw a big space. He was glad. He wanted to go there. So he opened the door and stepped out.

He went to the space. It was big and open and he felt free. He ran and ran and played lots of games. He laughed and smiled as he wandered around. Birds flew above him and the sun shone on his face.

He felt very glad in this space. He had lots of fun and he never wanted to go home. Then he heard his mother calling for him. He said goodbye to the space and went home. He fell asleep, dreaming of his wonderful time wandering.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his baseball. His baseball was blue and he loved it very much. One day, Timmy went outside to play with his baseball. He threw it up in the air and it went far away. Timmy went to discover where the baseball went. He walked and walked until he found it in a bush. Timmy was happy to find his blue baseball and played with it all day long. The end.

One day, a big dog named Max went for a walk. He saw a little boy named Tim. Tim had a red ball. Max wanted to play with the ball, so he asked Tim, "Can I play with your ball, please?"

Tim was very generous. He said, "Yes, you can play with my ball." Tim threw the ball far away, and Max ran to get it. Max was so happy that he gave Tim a big rub with his head.

Then, Tim's mom came and said, "It's time to go home, Tim." Tim looked at Max and said, "Max, I have to go now. But, I will release the ball for you to catch one more time." Tim threw the ball again, and Max ran after it. Max caught the ball and was very happy.

As Tim and his mom walked away, Max watched them go. He knew he had made a new friend. Max went back home, excited to play with Tim and the red ball again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to mail letters to her friends. Every day she would put her letters into her mailbox. One day when she went to mail her letters, she was surprised to see a big, juicy melon in the mailbox. She was so excited and didn't know what to do.

The girl decided to take the melon home with her. When she got there, she couldn't wait to cut it open! Inside the melon, she found lots of little seeds. She smiled as she thought about how much fun it would be to plant them and watch them grow.

The girl was determined to do this on her own. She spent the next few days learning how to plant the seeds and take care of them. Before long, the melon seeds had grown into big, beautiful melon plants.

The little girl was so proud of herself. She had done this all by herself, without anyone's help. She was so independent and it made her very happy.

The girl's friends came over one day and were amazed at what she had done. "You did this on your own?" they asked. The little girl smiled and said, "Yes! I'm so glad I decided to mail that melon home with me. It was the best decision I ever made!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing in the park with her friends and picking flowers. She always made sure to throw her trash away in the bin so the world would remain clean. 

One day, Lily and her friends were playing hide-and-seek. Lily found the perfect hiding spot behind a big tree. But when she peeked out, she saw something terrible. Someone had left a big pile of trash on the ground. 

Lily knew she had to do something to help the world remain clean. She picked up all the trash and put it in the bin. She felt proud of herself for doing the right thing. 

But later that day, Lily started feeling sick. She had accidentally touched something dirty while cleaning up the trash. Her mom took her to the doctor, but it was too late. Lily had caught a bad sickness and she couldn't get better. 

In the end, Lily passed away and her friends were very sad. They remembered how Lily always wanted to keep the world clean and they promised to do the same in her memory.

Once there was a girl named Sue. She was three years old. She had a hammer and a nail. She wanted to use them to build a birdhouse.

Sue started to hammer the nail. But it was hard to resist. The nail wanted to go in, but Sue wanted it to stay out. She kept pushing the nail, but it wouldn't go in.

Finally, Sue decided to try something else. She put some spicy sauce on the nail. The spicy sauce made the nail come out of the wood. It was easier for Sue to push the nail in.

Sue smiled at her accomplishment. With the nail in place, she was able to build the birdhouse. Sue was very proud of her work.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play in the park with his friends. One day, while they were playing, they saw a giant coming towards them. The giant was very tall and had black hair all over his body. Timmy and his friends were scared, so they decided to run away.

As they were running, they saw a river. Timmy's friend Johnny said, "Let's hide behind the bushes and wash our faces in the river." Timmy thought it was a good idea, so they all hid behind the bushes and washed their faces. While they were washing, they heard the giant's voice. "Hello, little ones. Why are you hiding?" asked the giant.

"We're scared of you because you're a giant," said Timmy. The giant smiled and said, "Don't be scared. I'm a friendly giant. I just wanted to say hello."

Timmy and his friends were surprised that the giant was friendly. They talked to him for a while and found out that he was looking for his pet cat. They decided to help him find his cat and they all became friends. From that day on, Timmy and his friends would often play with the giant and his cat in the park.

Lily liked to draw. She had many colors and papers. She made original pictures of animals and flowers. She showed them to her mom and dad. They smiled and said they were beautiful.

One day, Lily wanted to draw outside. It was cold and windy. Mom said, "Lily, you need a jacket. It is not warm outside." Lily nodded and put on her jacket. She took her colors and papers and went to the yard.

She found a big rock. She thought it was a good place to draw. She put her papers on the rock and started to color. She did not see the ants. The ants lived under the rock. They did not like Lily's papers. They wanted to take them away.

The ants crawled on the papers. They bit the edges. They tried to pull them down. Lily saw the ants. She was scared and angry. She said, "No, ants! These are my papers! Go away!" She tried to shoo them with her hand.

But the ants did not listen. They were many and strong. They kept biting and pulling. Lily cried. She wanted her mom. She wanted her papers. She did not know what to do.

A bird saw Lily. The bird liked to sing and fly. It also liked to help. It saw the ants and Lily. It knew the ants were bad. It flew to Lily. It said, "Lily, Lily, I warn you. The ants will take your papers. You have to move them. You have to find another place to draw."

Lily looked at the bird. She was surprised. She did not know birds could talk. She said, "Thank you, bird. You are kind and smart. How can I move my papers? The ants are too many."

The bird said, "I will help you. I have a beak and wings. I can pick up your papers and fly with them. You can follow me. I will show you a safe place to draw. A place with no ants."

Lily smiled. She said, "Yes, please, bird. You are a good friend. Let's go." She picked up her colors and followed the bird. The bird picked up her papers one by one and flew with them. The ants were angry. They hissed and chased. But they could not catch the bird and Lily.

The bird and Lily found a nice place. It was a bench under a tree. There were no ants. There were flowers and butterflies. Lily said, "This is a beautiful place, bird. Thank you for helping me. Can I draw you?"

The bird said, "Yes, Lily. You can draw me. I would like that. You are a good artist. You make original pictures. I will sing for you." The bird sang a happy song. Lily drew a picture of the bird. She used many colors. She was happy. She and the bird became friends.

Once upon a time, in a big friendly forest, there lived a little girl named Mia. Mia loved to play with her friends, the animals. She had a best friend named Ben, who was a very friendly bear.

One sunny day, Mia and Ben were playing near a big tree. They saw a little bird with a hurt foot. The bird said, "Help, my foot hurts!" Mia and Ben wanted to help their new friend. They thought of a plan to make the bird's foot feel better.

Mia said to Ben, "Let's lead the bird to the nice lake. The cool water will make the bird's foot feel good." Ben agreed, and they led the bird to the lake. The bird put its foot in the water and smiled. The bird said, "Thank you, Mia and Ben!" They all played together by the lake, and they were happy.

Billy was organizing his bedroom. He collected all his toys and put them in his big basket. He was feeling very proud of himself.

Suddenly his mom came in. She had brought her deaf friend. Billy was so surprised that he dropped the basket and all his toys went flying across the room.

Billy's mom was not happy. She yelled: â€œBilly, why did you do that? Now I have to help you organize your room all over again!â€

Billy's deaf friend smiled and said: â€œIt's okay. I can help him organize his toys. Let's put them back in the basket.â€

Once upon a time, there was a cop named Tim. He had a tight hat and a shiny badge. Tim loved to help people and keep them safe.

One day, Tim got a call that there was a big crowd of people. He went to see what was happening and saw that they were all trying to get into a small room. Tim knew that it was not safe for so many people to be in such a tight space.

He asked the people to separate and go to different rooms. They listened to him and soon everyone was safe. Tim felt happy that he could help people and keep them safe.

Ben and Lily were playing with their toys in the living room. They liked to pretend that they were tiny and their toys were big. They used a frame from a picture to make a door for their toy house.

"Knock, knock," Ben said, tapping on the frame. "Can I come in?"

"Of course, you can," Lily said, opening the frame. "You are very polite. Do you want some tea?"

"Yes, please," Ben said, sitting on a cushion. Lily poured some water from a bottle cap into a thimble. They pretended to sip their tea and chat.

Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. It was their mom, coming home from work. She saw the frame on the floor and picked it up.

"Oh, what a nice frame," she said. "I wonder where it came from. I think I'll hang it on the wall."

She did not see Ben and Lily inside the frame. They were too small. They shouted and waved, but their mom did not hear them.

"Help, help!" Ben cried. "We are in the frame!"

"How did we shrink?" Lily asked. "We need to get out!"

They looked around and saw a window in the frame. They ran to it and pushed it open. They saw a bird outside. They hoped it would not eat them.

"Maybe we can fly with the bird," Ben said. "Maybe it will take us to our mom."

They climbed on the bird's back and held on tight. The bird flew away with them. They hoped it would not fly too far. They wanted to go back to their mom and their toys. They wanted to be big again.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play with toys. One day, they found a big sack in the garage. They opened it and saw many things inside. There were books, clothes, tools, and a mixer.

"What is this?" Lily asked, pointing to the mixer.

"It is a thing that makes cakes and cookies," Ben said. "My mom has one in the kitchen. We can use it to make our own snacks."

They took the mixer out of the sack and plugged it in. They put some flour, sugar, eggs, and butter in a bowl. They turned on the mixer and watched it spin.

"Wow, this is fun!" Lily said.

"Let's add some more things," Ben said. He looked around and saw some ketchup, mustard, salt, and pepper. He poured them into the bowl.

"Stop, Ben, that is yucky!" Lily said.

"No, it is not. It will make our snacks tasty," Ben said.

They argued and pushed each other. The mixer fell off the table and broke. The bowl spilled all over the floor. The garage was a mess.

"What have you done?" a voice shouted. It was Ben's dad. He came into the garage and saw the disaster. He was very angry.

"You two are in big trouble!" he said. "You ruined my mixer and my stuff in the sack. Those were for a charity sale. Now I have to pay for them. And you made a huge mess. You have to clean it up right now. And no snacks for you today. Go to your rooms and think about what you did."

Lily and Ben felt very sorry and scared. They wished they had not played with the mixer and the sack. They learned their lesson. It was a bad day.

One day, the little boy was walking in the garden when he saw a tomato. He was so excited, because he had never seen one before and wanted to see what it tasted like. He reached out and picked it up, but when he went to take a bite, he noticed it was very squishy and broken. He was so sad and angry, he didn't know what to do.

Suddenly, he heard something. He looked up and saw a red bird fly by. The little boy was so happy, he had never seen one before! He reached up and tried to grab it, but the bird flew away. He was so frustrated, he couldn't believe it.

The little boy was so angry that he raised his hand and struck the tomato, splitting it into two halves. The little pieces of tomato flew everywhere, and he was so happy to watch them fly around.

He had fun playing with the pieces of tomato, and he loved to watch the little pieces go everywhere. Even though the tomato was broken, he still enjoyed playing with it. He had a great time with his broken tomato!

One day Sofia and her Mommy went to the farm. On the farm there were lots of animals, including a white goat. The goat was very playful and made Mommy and Sofia smile. Mommy and Sofia liked to watch the goat skip and jump and even dance. But the best part was when the goat started to sing!

The goat's singing was so sweet that Mommy and Sofia both started to sing too. They were all singing and dancing together and it was so much fun. Soon, other animals from the farm started to join in too - some ducks, some chickens, even a donkey! They all gathered around to listen to the goat singing and it was the most beautiful noise ever.

When it was time to go home, Mommy and Sofia said goodbye to the animals, especially the white goat. They waved and smiled and thanked the goat for the beautiful singing. They hoped they would see the goat again soon!

Once upon a time there was a big iron. It liked to sit all day, in the middle of the room. But one day, something changed. A little girl came into the room. 

The little girl was amazed at how big the iron was. She wanted to touch it and play with it. But the iron just stayed where it was, sitting still. 

The little girl tried to move the iron, but it was too heavy. She kept pushing but it didn't move at all. She wanted to sit on the iron like she saw her mom do, but she still couldn't move it. 

Just then, the girl's mom came into the room. She gently picked up the iron and put it back where it belonged. 

The girl was happy. With her mom's help, she could now sit on the big iron, just like her mom did. So the little girl and the big iron had a lot of fun together!

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max liked to go on walks. One sunny day, Max went on a walk with his friend, a little cat named Lily.

As they walked, Max saw something in a bush. He said, "Lily, look! What is that?" Lily looked and said, "I don't know, Max. Let's go see!" They went to the bush and found a box. They were very curious.

Max and Lily opened the box and found a surprise inside. It was a big, red ball! They were so happy. They took turns playing with the ball. Max was serious about playing with the ball. He said, "Lily, we must take good care of our new ball." Lily agreed and they played all day long.

Tilly had the best day! She woke up in the morning and put on her new pants. They were so big that they went all the way to the floor. She smiled and felt so happy. 

Tilly played with her friends all day. They laughed and played together. Every day, Tilly was growing bigger and the pants grew too. She loved to run around in them and feel the breeze. 

At the end of the day, when the sun had gone down, Tilly said goodbye to her friends. She took off her pants and put them on her bed. Each day, they kept growing! 

Tilly was so happy to have pants that could grow with her. She went to sleep feeling content and content, knowing she would have something new to look forward to the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a big building. Inside the building was a boy and a girl. The girl was jealous of the boy because she wanted to remain in the building all day.

The girl said to the boy, "Why can you stay here all day and I can't?"

The boy replied, "Because my mom said I can stay and play with the toys."

The girl was very jealous. She wanted to stay so she could have fun too.

Suddenly the girl had a great idea. She said, "Let's make a plan together! If your mom says yes, then we can stay together!" 

The boy was very happy and agreed with the girl's plan. He asked his mom, and she said yes.

So the boy and the girl remained in the building all day. They played together with the toys and had lots of fun. The girl wasn't jealous anymore and they were very happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had some dinner and was getting ready to eat. Suddenly, she saw something. It was a bird! It was sitting on her fence and waving its wings. The little girl waved back, and the bird flew away. 

The little girl was so happy. She finished her dinner and went outside to play. She looked all around and saw more birds. She started waving to them, and they waved back. 

The little girl enjoyed playing in her backyard. She saw more birds and gave them a big wave. They happily waved back at her. Then, the sun started to go down. 

All of the little birds went to their nests for the night. The little girl waved goodbye, and they waved goodbye too. With a smile, she went back inside for a good nightâ€™s sleep.

Once there was a little girl named Sarah. She was three years old and very naughty.

One day, Sarah heard a noise in her bedroom. It sounded like something cracking! She was very curious so she went to her bedroom to find out what it was. 

When she opened the door, Sarah saw a big crack in the wall. She saw something poking out of the crack and she quickly grabbed it.

It was a shiny toy! Sarah was delighted. She gave it a big kiss, then ran to show her parents.

"Look! I found a toy! Can I keep it?" said Sarah to her mom and dad.

Mom and Dad laughed. "Sweetheart, we don't know where this toy came from. You can't keep it," said Dad.

Sarah was very disappointed and started to cry.

But then Mom gave her a big hug and a kiss. "Don't worry sweetheart," she said, "we will buy you a new toy tomorrow."

Sarah was happy again, and thanked Mom with another kiss!

Anna and Ben were playing in the park with their ball. They saw a deer in the grass. The deer had brown fur and big ears. It looked at them with kind eyes.

"Can we go and say hello to the deer?" Anna asked Ben.

"OK, but we have to be very quiet and gentle," Ben said. "The deer might be scared of us."

They walked slowly to the deer. The deer did not run away. It sniffed their hands and let them touch its fur.

"Wow, it is so soft and warm," Anna said. "Can I rub its nose?"

"Yes, I think it likes that," Ben said. He rubbed the deer's nose too. The deer made a soft sound and licked their fingers.

They heard a loud noise. It was an unknown man with a big stick. He was coming to the park. He looked angry and mean.

"Run, Anna, run!" Ben shouted. "The man might hurt the deer!"

They ran away from the deer and the man. They hid behind a tree and watched. The man came closer to the deer. He raised his stick.

"Leave the deer alone!" Anna and Ben yelled. "It is our friend!"

The man stopped. He looked surprised and confused. He saw Anna and Ben behind the tree. He lowered his stick.

"Sorry, kids, I didn't know you were here," he said. "I was looking for a different deer. A bad deer that ate my flowers."

"This deer is not bad. It is good and nice," Anna said. "Please don't hurt it."

The man nodded. He smiled a little. He walked away from the deer and the park.

Anna and Ben came out from behind the tree. They hugged the deer and said goodbye. The deer wagged its tail and ran away to the woods.

Anna and Ben went back to their ball. They were happy and proud. They had saved the deer from the unknown man. They hoped to see the deer again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved dressing up in her princess costume and pretending to be a queen. One day, she went to the park and saw a boy named Max. Max was sad and didn't want to play.

Lily asked Max why he was sad. Max said he lost his toy truck and couldn't find it. Lily said she would help Max look for his truck. They searched and searched but couldn't find it. Lily said they should ask the park ranger for help. The park ranger was very peaceful and kind. He helped them look for the truck and answered all their questions.

Finally, they found Max's truck and Max was very happy. Lily was happy too because she helped her new friend. They played together and had lots of fun. Lily realized that helping others makes her feel good too.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Lizzie. She loved to buy things. She especially loved buying sheep because they were so soft and pretty. She found a whole field of sheep and looked around before she chose.

Suddenly, Lizzie heard a voice; it was the farmer! He said, "Hey, little girl! Would you like to buy one of these sheep?"

Lizzie was very surprised. She wanted to buy a sheep very much, but she didn't have any money. She said, "I don't have any coins, can I still buy a sheep?" 

The farmer was very nice. He said, "Yes, of course you can buy a sheep if you are easy and nice. Now, which one do you like best?" 

Lizzie looked around and saw the prettiest sheep she'd ever seen. She said, "I want that one!" The farmer smiled and said, "OK, that's easy. Now you can take your new sheep home!"

Lizzie was so happy. She took the sheep home and named him Fluffy. She was very proud of her new sheep and she loved him very much.
