Mikey and his mom went back inside and Mikey filled his room with the light from the flashlight. He knew he'd be back outside soon enough, looking for more interesting things with his flashlight.

This is a story about a girl. She had a goal to heal. She was very intelligent and knew what she had to do.

The girl gathered all the things she needed for healing. She found lots of natural items which she believed would help her. 

The girl followed her plan, and she worked hard towards her goal. She took courses to understand better how to heal.

After a lot of hard work and dedication, the girl was able to heal. She was very proud that she had achieved her goal. 

The girl was so intelligent and determined that she had used her skills and knowledge to heal. She was a great example to everyone that hard work pays off.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Max. She had a hurt knee and it was ouchy. Her mommy found some bandages to help make it better. She put them on and they matched her dress. They were very useful.

Max then wanted to go outside and play. She went to see her best friend, Lilly. Lilly had a scabby knee too and was sad about it. Max showed her the bandages and said they might help. Lilly said "yes please!"

Max put the bandages on Lilly's knee. The bandages matched her outfit and they were very useful. Lilly was so happy her knee felt better.

Max and Lilly smiled and went off to play. They were both happy to be able to run around and enjoy the day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, she saw a big slide and wanted to try it. She climbed up the ladder and slid down the slide. It was so much fun!

After playing for a while, Lily's friend Jack accidentally knocked over a pot. It broke into many pieces. Jack was scared that he would get in trouble, but Lily told him not to worry. She said it was just a harmless pot and they could clean it up together.

Their other friend, Sarah, saw what happened and came over to help. Together, they picked up the broken pieces and threw them away. Lily told Jack that it's always better to tell the truth and take responsibility for mistakes, even if it's scary. Jack felt better and they all continued to play happily.

Anna loved to play in the forest with her friends. She was adventurous and curious. She liked to explore new places and meet new animals. One day, she saw a red and fluffy animal hiding behind a tree. She wanted to say hello.

"Who are you?" she asked. "I am Anna. Do you want to play with me?"

The animal peeked out and looked at her. He had a long tail and pointy ears. He was a fox. He was shy and scared. He did not know Anna.

"I am Finn," he said. "I am a fox. I do not play with people. They are loud and mean. They chase me and my family."

Anna felt sad. She did not want to be loud and mean. She wanted to be friendly and kind. She wanted to be Finn's friend.

"I am not loud and mean," she said. "I am quiet and nice. I do not chase you and your family. I want to learn about you and your forest. Can I introduce you to my friends? They are quiet and nice too."

Finn thought for a moment. He was curious and lonely. He wanted to learn about Anna and her friends. He wanted to have fun and play. He decided to trust Anna.

"Okay," he said. "You can introduce me to your friends. But be careful. Some people are not quiet and nice. They are loud and mean. They have traps and guns. They hurt us and our forest."

Anna nodded. She knew some people were loud and mean. She did not like them. She wanted to protect Finn and his forest. She took his paw and led him to her friends. They were playing with a ball and a rope. They saw Anna and Finn.

"Hi, Anna!" they said. "Who is this?"

Anna smiled. She was happy and proud. She had a new friend. She introduced him to her friends.

"This is Finn," she said. "He is a fox. He lives in the forest. He is shy and scared. But he is also curious and lonely. He wants to play with us. He is adventurous and smart. He knows a lot about the forest. He is my friend."

Once upon a time, a young boy called Jake went to take a walk in the forest. He looked around and saw many animals. The birds were singing and the animals were playing. It was a wild and exciting place.

Suddenly, he heard a loud noise. It was a war! Jake looked up and saw some planes in the sky. There were battleships and soldiers on the ground. He was very scared and ran home quickly.

The next day, Jake and his family decided to go on a picnic. When they arrived, they looked up at the sky and saw a rainbow. It was so beautiful! They all smiled and laughed together. 

The war was far away and they enjoyed the day in the wild forest.

Lily and Ben are brother and sister. They like to play in the attic. The attic is a big room under the roof. It has many old things and toys.

One day, they find a big box in the attic. They open the box and see a lot of books. Lily loves books. She kneels down and picks one. She says, "Look, Ben, this book has pictures of animals. Let's read it."

But Ben does not like books. He likes cars. He sees a red car in the box. He grabs the car and says, "No, Lily, I want to play with this car. It is fast and shiny. Let's race it."

Lily and Ben start to fight. They pull the book and the car. They yell and cry. They are not happy.

Mom hears the noise. She comes to the attic. She sees Lily and Ben fighting. She is not happy. She says, "Stop, Lily and Ben. Why are you fighting? You have many things to play with. You can share and take turns. That is how you can be happy."

Lily and Ben listen to Mom. They say sorry to each other. They hug and smile. They decide to read the book and play with the car together. They are happy. Mom is happy. They have fun in the attic.

Once upon a time there was a little boy who wanted a new toy. He asked his mom for one and she suggested he worked for the money. He was very excited! He went to his dad and asked him for a license to work. His dad was confused, but he said yes. 

The little boy was so happy to have a license so he started working. He worked hard and saved up his money for his new toy. He was so close to getting it, but then something unexpected happened. Someone stole all his money and his dreams were ruined. He was so confused and sad.

The little boy was left with nothing and the story ended badly. He did not get his toy and had to start all over again. He was very disappointed.

Once upon a time there were two toddlers named Charlotte and Jimmy. They decided to try something new and went looking around their house for materials. They came across a plastic box in the cupboard.

Jimmy had the idea to bake something with it. They got some flour, butter, sugar and eggs from the kitchen and found a big bowl and spoon in the cupboard. Charlotte got to stirring and Jimmy put the ingredients together.

When it was all mixed, Jimmy put it in the plastic box and popped it in the oven. After a few moments it started to smell so yummy! When it was done, Jimmy & Charlotte took the box out of the oven and lifted the lid.

The cake was warm and looked very attractive. So they shared some with their family and all agreed it was delicious! Charlotte and Jimmy had fun baking and were so proud of their cake.

Lily liked to play with her pirate toys. She had a big ship, a hat, a sword and a parrot. She liked to pretend she was a pirate captain and sail to find treasure.

One day, she found a big box in the attic. It was full of old clothes and books and things. She opened it and saw something shiny. It was a gold coin! She took it out and looked at it. It had a picture of a pirate on it.

Lily was very happy. She thought she had found real pirate treasure. She wanted to fill her ship with coins and jewels. She looked in the box for more. But there was only one coin. She was sad.

Then she heard a voice. It said, "Ahoy, matey! Are you looking for treasure?" Lily turned around and saw a parrot. It was sitting on a shelf. It had red and green feathers and a black eye patch. It was an unusual parrot.

Lily was surprised. She said, "Hello, parrot. Are you a pirate parrot?"

The parrot nodded. It said, "Yes, I am. And I know where to find more treasure. Do you want to come with me?"

Lily smiled. She said, "Yes, please. I want to be a pirate too."

The parrot flew to her shoulder. It said, "Then follow me, captain. I will show you the way."

Lily put on her hat and took her sword. She grabbed her ship and the coin. She followed the parrot to a secret door in the attic. She opened it and saw a bright light. She stepped inside and saw a big island with palm trees and a cave. She saw more ships and pirates and treasure.

Lily was amazed. She said, "Wow, this is amazing. Is this where you live, parrot?"

The parrot said, "Yes, this is my home. And now it is yours too. Welcome to Pirate Land, captain. Here you can fill your ship with treasure and have fun all day."

Lily was very happy. She said, "Thank you, parrot. You are the best friend ever."

They hugged and sailed to the island. They had a great adventure. They filled their ship with treasure and shared it with the other pirates. They played games and sang songs and ate cake. They had a lot of fun.

Lily loved Pirate Land. She decided to stay there forever. She was the happiest pirate in the world.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They liked to play together every day.
One day they were walking in the park when they spotted a big sack. Jack wanted to open it and find out what was inside. He tugged on the sack to open it, but it was too strong. He felt helpless.

Suddenly, he saw a big button next to the sack. He thought it might help him open it so he pressed it. Immediately, the sack flew open and a bunch of butterflies flew out! Jack and Jill were so happy! They ran around, catching the butterflies and setting them free. They felt so excited to be able to release all these beautiful butterflies.

Jack and Jill spent the rest of the day playing outside. They were so happy to have released all the butterflies!

Once there was a little girl called Jane. She was three-years-old and she was very curious. She wanted to see a real, live lizard.

One day, her dad took her to a park. Jane was so excited to see what she could find. Suddenly, she spotted a little lizard hiding near a tree!

Jane was very impatient and she tried to catch the lizard. She reached out her hand but the lizard was too fast for her. Jane kept trying to use her hands to grab it but she just couldn't.

Suddenly, her dad said he had an idea. He gave Jane a jar and showed her how to trap the lizard inside. After a few tries, Jane did it!

The little girl was so happy. She had caught the lizard! Finally, she could take it home and show it to her friends.

Little John was a stubborn little boy. He was determined to do things his way, no matter what anyone said. One day, Little John decided to go on an adventure. He started skipping down the street, bouncing with delight.

As he walked, Little John heard a voice. It was soft and gentle, like a lullaby. He tried to follow it, but the voice seemed to always be just out of reach. With a smile, he kept going.

Little John soon reached the edge of a big, green field. He paused for a moment and looked around. Then he heard a voice, louder than before. It seemed to be coming from the other side of the field. Little John started to cross the field, determined to meet the voice.

It was getting closer, but then Little John heard the voice again. He was so close to meeting whoever was speaking. He was determined to find it, no matter what.

Little John reached the other side of the field and finally came face-to-face with the voice. To his surprise, it was his mom! She had been calling him the entire time, but he had been too stubborn to turn back. Little John couldn't help but laugh as he realized his mom had been looking out for him the entire time.

Jimmy was a little boy who loved to watch. He watched the birds fly in the sky, the clouds move across the sky and even the ants move around in their little ant hill. One day, he went to the park and saw a big purple butterfly. It had big, beautiful wings that were about an inch wide! Jimmy watched and watched as the butterfly flew around the flowers. 

He was so excited that he ran over to the butterfly and tried to catch it, but it flew away. He was very sad and started to cry. His mom hugged him and said, "It's okay sweetheart. Just watch and one day you'll catch one". Jimmy nodded and wiped his tears away He went back to the park and watched the butterflies in the garden.

He watched the purple butterfly come close, and just when it flew right over his head, he reached up and caught it! Jimmy was so happy, he laughed and smiled and hugged the butterfly. He ran home and showed his mom the purple butterfly that he had caught. 

Jimmy watched and watched the butterfly every day. Even on a cold winter day, he would sit by the window and watch the purple butterfly fly in and out of the garden. He was always happy and knew that with a little patience, he could catch a butterfly, even a purple one!

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to whistle. Every day she would go outside and stand in the garden, lean against a tree and whistle a happy tune. Her Mum and Dad were very grateful because they could always hear her howling away down the street.

One day the little girl was leaning against the tree, whistling as usual, when something extraordinary happened. She felt the breeze around her start to move and turned around - a magic bird was flying towards her!

The bird had bright colours and glittering wings, and was singing a beautiful song. It flew around her head, then perched atop a nearby branch and continued singing its song.

The little girl was so excited and incredibly grateful for the special moment. She watched the bird for what felt like hours until it flew away. She held a special place in her heart for the magical bird, knowing she would remember the moment for a lifetime.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved playing with his toys, especially his cars. One day, he wanted to play with his new toy car, but it wouldn't start. He tried and tried, but it just wouldn't go.

Timmy's friend, Billy, came over to play. Billy brought his toy sword, which was very thick and heavy. Timmy thought it looked like a weapon, but he knew it was just a toy. They played together and had fun, but Timmy still couldn't get his car to start.

Suddenly, Billy had an idea. He used his toy sword to hit the car's engine, and it started right up! Timmy was so happy and thanked Billy for his help. From then on, they played with their toys together and had lots of fun adventures.

Once there was an ordinary rat who lived in a hole in the ground. He had a friend, a little girl named Lucy. Each day, Lucy would come to visit the rat and they would get to know each other.

One day, Lucy asked the rat if she could trust him. The rat was not sure what to say. He thought for a while and then he said, "Yes, you can trust me". 

From that day on, Lucy and the rat were the best of friends. They trusted each other completely. They would spend hours talking and laughing together. 

Lucy knew that she could always rely on the rat and he knew that he could always rely on her. They became very close friends and their friendship grew each day. 

No matter what happened, Lucy and the rat knew that they could always trust each other completely. They were the best of friends forever!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy clean the house. One day, her mommy told her they needed a new mop because the old one was too heavy for her to use. Lily didn't understand what "heavy" meant, but she knew it must be hard to use.

The next day, Lily went to the store with her mommy. She saw a big, shiny mop and asked her mommy if they could buy it. Her mommy said they didn't have enough money for that one, but she promised to show Lily a special surprise when they got home.

When they got home, Lily's mommy showed her a brand new mop that was just the right size for her to use. Lily was so happy and excited to help clean the house with her new mop. She knew it wouldn't be heavy like the old one, and she couldn't wait to try it out. From that day on, Lily helped her mommy clean the house every day with her new, light mop.

One day, Mummy was in the garden with her 3 year old little girl, Sarah. Mummy asked Sarah to help her pick some radishes from the ground. Sarah was so excited to help her Mummy and ran to the radish bed.

When Sarah saw the radishes, she shouted "Hot! Hot!" because the radishes were very red and made Sarah think of something hot. Mummy laughed and told Sarah that the radishes were not hot. But they were warm from the sun.

Sarah started to pick the radishes, one by one. She was glad that she was helping Mummy, and she was very proud of all the radishes she had picked.

When Sarah had finished picking the radishes, she gave them to Mummy. Mummy gave Sarah a big hug and thanked her for all her hard work. Sarah was so happy to help and shouted "Yay!" with a big smile on her face!

'Once upon a time, there was a girl who loved to watch her television. There were so many numbers on the screen - they went up, down and around and around in circles. She loved to watch and count the numbers.

One day, the television stopped working. She was so sad. She kept pressing the buttons on the remote but nothing happened - it was too hard for her to fix. 

She asked her mom for help and together they tried harder, but still couldn't fix it.  Finally, Mom's friend came to visit and he was so smart - he fixed the television with ease. 

The little girl was so happy - she watched the numbers on the screen again and smiled as she counted them up, down and around. '

Once upon a time there was a strawberry. It was round and mild and red. Every day it sat in the sun, getting bigger and sweeter. 
One day, a wind came and twist the strawberry. It twirled and spun in the air, then it fell off its stem and landed on the ground. 
The strawberry was sad it had been twist away from its home. But then something wonderful happened. A little girl found it, picked it up and ate it. She smiled at the strawberry, then said "You taste yummy!" 
The strawberry was happy. Even though it had been twist away from its home, it made somebody happy.

Once upon a time, there was an intelligent horse. He could do all sorts of tricks, like stand on two feet! Every day he would go for a run in the forest. He loved the sunshine and feeling the wind in his mane. 

One day, the horse went for a run and stopped to have a rest in a cool, shady spot. He saw a little bowl filled with tasty looking pasta next to him. He was very hungry and wanted to eat it. So he put his nose in the bowl and started to eat. 

But suddenly, the bowl and the pasta disappeared! The horse looked around, but he couldn't see the bowl anywhere. He looked and looked, but he still couldn't find the pasta. Where could it have gone? 

The horse thought and thought, until he finally worked out where the pasta had gone. He realised that a clever fox had sneaked in and stolen it when the horse wasn't looking. The horse was sad, but he was very proud of how intelligent he was to work it out!

Once upon a time, there was a yellow squirrel who lived in the forest. Every day, the squirrel went out of its tree to look for food to supply its family. It found all kinds of tasty treats from nuts to fruits.

The squirrel was very careful not to get lost in the forest, so it made sure to remember all the turns it made. One day, the squirrel took a wrong turn and could not find its way home.

The yellow squirrel was scared and alone for two days, when one morning it saw a friendly animal. It was a green frog with big eyes. The frog saw the squirrel was lost, so it jumped to the squirrel's aid.

The frog saw the squirrel needed help to find its way home, so it supplied a few friendly hops and jumps to show the squirrel the right direction.

Finally, the yellow squirrel made it back to its family. All the little squirrels were so happy to see their brave family member. The yellow squirrel was proud of himself and thanked the frog for its help. From that day on, the yellow squirrel was careful never to take a wrong turn again.

Once upon a time, there was a huge dog named Max. Max was very big and very strong. He lived in a big house with a big yard. One day, Max saw a little girl named Lily. Lily was going on a tour of the big house with her mom and dad.

Max wanted to play with Lily, but he was too big. He tried to be gentle, but he would always knock things over. Max began to struggle. He tried to be small like Lily, but he just couldn't do it. Max was sad because he wanted to play with Lily and make her happy.

One day, Max had an idea. He found a big ball in the yard and rolled it to Lily. Lily saw the ball and smiled. She pushed the ball back to Max. They played with the ball all day long. Max was happy because he could play with Lily without knocking things over. And Lily was happy because she had a new friend in Max, the huge dog.

Lily and Max were playing in the snow. They made a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They gave him a carrot nose and two buttons for eyes. They were very happy.

Then they saw a big package on the porch. It had a red bow and a tag that said "To Lily and Max, from Grandma". They ran to the package and opened it. Inside, they found two sweaters, one pink and one blue. They were very soft and warm.

"Wow, thank you Grandma!" Lily said. She put on the pink sweater and hugged it. "It's so cozy!"

"Me too, thank you Grandma!" Max said. He put on the blue sweater and smiled. "It's so nice!"

They decided to show their snowman their new sweaters. They walked to the snowman and said hello. But the snowman did not say anything. He just looked at them with his button eyes.

"Snowman, do you like our sweaters?" Lily asked. She touched his scarf. "They are like your scarf, but warmer."

"Snowman, do you want a sweater too?" Max asked. He touched his hat. "They are like your hat, but softer."

But the snowman did not answer. He just stared at them with his button eyes.

Lily and Max felt sad. They wondered why the snowman did not talk to them. They thought he was their friend.

Then they heard a voice behind them. It was their mom. She came out of the house with a camera.

"Hi, kids, you look so cute in your new sweaters!" she said. "Can I take a picture of you and your snowman?"

Lily and Max turned around and saw their mom. They smiled and waved.

"Hi, mom, look at our sweaters!" they said. "They are from Grandma!"

"That's wonderful!" their mom said. "Grandma is very sweet. Now, say cheese!"

Lily and Max said cheese and posed with their snowman. Their mom took a picture.

"Good job, kids, you look great!" their mom said. "Now, let's go inside and have some hot chocolate. It's getting cold out here."

Lily and Max nodded. They were happy to go inside and have some hot chocolate. They said goodbye to their snowman and followed their mom.

They did not know that the snowman was not rude. He was not angry. He was not sad. He was just frozen. He could not talk or move. He could only look at them with his button eyes.

He thought they were very nice. He liked their sweaters. He wished he could have one too. But he knew he could not. He was a snowman. He would melt if he wore a sweater.

He felt terrible. He felt lonely. He wanted to be their friend. But he could not. He was a snowman. He could only freeze.

The elderly caterpillar wanted to add something to his life. He was feeling a bit lonely, so he decided to try something new. He started crawling around, looking for a new adventure.

One day, he spotted another caterpillar nearby. He slowly made his way closer and asked, "Hey! Hi there! Do you want to be my friend?" 

The other caterpillar said yes and they had a lot of fun together. They compared colors and patterns and even spun cocoons together. They liked each other so much that they decided they would add a best friend activity every day. 

They added jumping, singing, and even eating treats together. Soon, their friendship grew even stronger and their days were filled with laughter. 

The elderly caterpillar was grateful that he had added a new friend to his life. He knew that his days would never be lonely again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lily. Lily was so happy because it was daddy day! Lily loved spending time with her daddy.

They always did special things together, like playing in the park, going to the zoo and drawing pictures. Today, daddy said they were going to tidy up the house.

Lily helped daddy to pick up all of the toys, put away the blankets and wash the dishes. When they had finished, her daddy said â€œYouâ€™ve done such a good job Lily! Iâ€™m proud of youâ€. Then, he gave her a big kiss!

Daddy said they should now go outside and enjoy the sunshine. Lily was very happy, she felt so lucky to have a such a nice, tidy daddy!

Once there was a boy who wanted to be a fireman. He wanted to help people in need. To reach his goal, he had to follow a few steps.

First, he had to learn how a fire truck works. He asked his dad to teach him. His dad showed him how to put on the heavy gear and turn on the siren. 

Second, he had to be brave and strong. He practiced putting out fires with a water hose in the backyard. He had to get very close and it was often dirty.

Finally, his goal was within reach! He got a job at the fire station and was soon out on the truck helping people. He followed all the steps and was now living his dream. He was a real fireman!

Lily and Ben were playing in the garden. They liked to dig holes and find things. Sometimes they found worms, sometimes they found stones, sometimes they found nothing.

One day, they found a potato. It was big and brown and had eyes. Lily and Ben were very happy. They showed it to each other and laughed.

"Let's make a face on it!" Lily said. She took a stick and poked two holes for eyes, a line for a mouth, and a leaf for a nose. "Look, it's Mr. Potato!"

"Hello, Mr. Potato!" Ben said. He took another stick and poked two holes for ears, and a twig for a hat. "You are very funny!"

They put Mr. Potato on the grass and played with him. They pretended he could talk and sing and dance. They had a lot of fun.

But then, they heard their mom calling them. "Lily! Ben! It's time to return to the house! Lunch is ready!"

Lily and Ben ran to their mom. They were hungry and wanted to eat. They forgot about Mr. Potato.

Mr. Potato was alone on the grass. He felt sad and lonely. He wished Lily and Ben would come back and play with him. He looked at the sky and saw a bird. The bird was flying very high and far. It looked free and happy.

Mr. Potato wanted to fly too. He wanted to see the world and make new friends. He wanted to go to distant places and have adventures. He closed his eyes and wished very hard.

Suddenly, he felt a lift. He opened his eyes and saw that the bird had picked him up with its beak. It was taking him away from the garden. Mr. Potato was scared at first, but then he felt excited. He was flying!

"Goodbye, Lily and Ben!" he said. "Thank you for finding me and playing with me! Maybe I will see you again someday!"

The bird carried Mr. Potato over the trees and the houses and the fields. Mr. Potato saw many things he had never seen before. He smiled and enjoyed his ride.

He was happy. He was free. He was Mr. Potato.

Once upon a time, there was a special operation to protect a messy room. The room was very untidy. 

The mission started. A group of brave helpers came to the messy room. They had to get it looking super tidy. 

The helpers grabbed some brushes, buckets and scrubbers. They swept, mopped and vacuumed too. Every corner was cleaned up. The helpers worked hard until the room was sparkling clean. 

The tidy mission was a success! Everybody cheered for a job well done. From that day on, the helpers vowed to protect the clean room forever.

Once upon a time, there was an old man who had lots of pain. He couldn't do anything because he was too lazy. He was very worried, so he called for help.

Soon, a young girl appeared. She was smart and wrote lots of books. She had magical powers and she knew how to solve the man's pain.

The girl worked very hard and tried many things. Finally, she made a big medicine. She gave it to the man and he drank it very quickly. 

When the medicine was gone, the pain vanished! The man was very happy and so were the people around him. They all thanked the girl for solving the man's pain. 

The girl smiled and said, "you're welcome". Then she flew away in a big bubble, travelling to help more people. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a tiger. He was very big and independent.

One day he went out for a walk in the forest. He was hoping to find some adventure. Suddenly he saw something moving behind a tree. He slowly went up to it.

When he got there, he saw a little rabbit. The rabbit was sitting all alone, looking very sad. The tiger asked him why he was so sad and the bunny said, "I cannot find my way home."

The tiger was very kind and he offered to help the bunny so he could get back home. The tiger guided the bunny through the forest, until they got to his house. 

The bunny thanked the tiger for his help and hugged him. The bunny's family was very happy to see him and they invited the tiger to stay for dinner.

The tiger happily accepted and they all shared a nice dinner together. The tiger was very happy he could help the bunny. He was so glad he was independent and could help others.

The end.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to swing, slide and run. They saw a big dog with a man. The dog was brown and fluffy. The man was old and kind.

The man walked to Tom and Lily. He smiled and said, "Hello, children. Do you want to pet my dog? His name is Max. He is very friendly and gentle."

Tom and Lily looked at the dog. They liked dogs, but they did not know this dog. They felt uncomfortable. They did not say anything.

The man saw that they were shy. He said, "It's okay. You don't have to pet him if you don't want to. He won't bite. He likes children. He just wants to say hello."

He offered his hand to Tom and Lily. He said, "My name is Bob. What are your names?"

Tom and Lily heard his voice. He sounded nice and calm. They felt a little better. They took his hand and said, "I'm Tom. I'm Lily. We are playing in the park."

Bob nodded and said, "Nice to meet you, Tom and Lily. You are playing very well. Can I join you for a while?"

Tom and Lily looked at each other. They nodded and said, "Yes, you can. We can share our toys. And we can pet Max too."

Bob smiled and said, "Thank you, children. You are very kind and polite. Max and I are happy to play with you."

They walked to the swings. Tom and Lily petted Max. He wagged his tail and licked their faces. They laughed and hugged him. Bob pushed them on the swings. They had fun together. They made new friends. They were not uncomfortable anymore.

Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a girl named Lily. Lily had an orange cat named Max. They liked to play outside in the sun. One day, Lily found a big shield near her house. She picked it up and showed it to Max.

"Max, look what I found! Let's bring it home and play with it," said Lily.

Max meowed and followed Lily home. They played with the shield all day. But they did not know that the shield had magic powers. At night, when the moon was up, the shield began to glow.

The next day, a big wind came to the village. It blew the trees and the houses. Everyone was scared. Lily remembered the magic shield. She ran to get it and held it up high. The wind stopped and the village was safe.

"Thank you, Lily, for bringing the shield and saving us all," said the villagers. Lily smiled and hugged her orange cat, Max. They knew that the magic shield would always protect them.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lisa. She was very clever and loved to play. Whenever she was outside, she loved to play with her friends.

One day, Lisa was playing in the park when she heard a loud horn. She looked around and saw a big bus with a big horn. Lisa was so excited and started to play pretend with her friends. She pretended that she was driving a bus like the one with the horn.

Her friends thought Lisa was so clever for making up such a fun pretend game. They all took turns pretending to drive the bus, honking the horn whenever they did. Everyone was having so much fun honking the horn!

When they all got tired, they all said goodbye to each other before heading home. Lisa smiled to herself and thought about how much fun they had playing with the horn.

Once upon a time, there was a bright penguin. He liked to swim in the big oceans around the world. One day, he saw a big boat and decided to swim with it.

Once upon a time there was a snake. It was big and it wanted to eat. It came across a field full of juicy apples. But they were all in a tight bunch in one corner. The snake wanted to eat those apples, but he could not un-tighten them.

The snake tried and tried to loosen the apples, but it was no use. Then an idea came to the snake. He thought he should wrap himself around the apples and make himself tight, like a string. 

So the snake did just that. He wrapped himself around the apples and wriggled himself into a tight coil. Every apple was now loose and ready to be eaten! The snake ate as many apples as he could. After he was full, he curled up, happy and satisfied.

The snake went back to the same tight bunch of apples every day to eat. He even got to know the apples, by their taste and shape. He was happy because he could always count on those apples.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy called Theo. Theo was very healthy, and he liked to play outside in the sun.

Lily and Tom were friends who liked to play in the park. One day, they saw a big truck with a lot of oil cans in the back. They were curious and wanted to see what was inside.

"Can we look at the oil cans?" Lily asked the truck driver, who was busy on his phone.

Lily and Tom climbed on the truck and opened one of the oil cans. It smelled bad and made them cough.

"Yuck, this oil is rotten!" Tom said, holding his nose.

"Let's close it and try another one," Lily said, hoping to find something better.

They opened another oil can, but it was worse. It was full of worms and flies, and it made a loud hissing sound.

"Help, help, it's going to explode!" Tom shouted, dropping the can.

The truck driver heard the noise and turned around. He saw the oil can on the floor, spilling rotten oil and bugs everywhere. He was angry and scared.

"What have you done, you naughty kids?" he yelled, running towards them.

Lily and Tom were sorry and scared. They jumped off the truck and ran away as fast as they could.

They learned a lesson that day: never open things that are not yours, and never trust a truck driver who is not polite.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was stubborn, and he never wanted to do what his mom said. One day, she told him to put on his shoes. But he didn't want to! He sneezed, and he jumped on one knee. He laughed and laughed and he wouldn't put on his shoes.

His mom said, "You need to put your shoes on, Danny! It's time to go out!" But Danny was very stubborn and he just ignored her. He laughed and laughed and sneezed again.

Finally, his mom said, "That's it! I'm coming to sit on your knee!" Danny laughed and laughed some more. His mom came over and sat on his knee, and soon enough he agreed to put on his shoes. He was still a little bit stubborn, but at least he put his shoes on. The end!

Once upon a time, there was a clever bee named Buzz. Buzz was always looking for the sweetest honey to share with the other bees in his hive. 

One day, Buzz flew off on his own to find the sweetest honey. He flew from flower to flower, searching high and low.

Finally, Buzz thought he had found the perfect honey. He stopped to taste it, but it was too sour for his liking. Then, Buzz spotted a little mouse nearby. He watched as the mouse reached its tiny paw up to a tree and grabbed a single drop of honey. 

Buzz was amazed by the mouse's clever offer. Even though the mouse didn't have much, it was willing to share what it had. So he offered the mouse a better spot in the tree from which to get honey. 

Buzz was so happy when the mouse accepted his offer. From then on, they were friends, taking turns is getting honey from the same tree. It truly was a sweet friendship!

Once there was a little girl who loved the outdoors. One morning the girl went on a walk in the forest and the trees were so tall they blocked the sun in some places. The air was cold and the girl could see fog which was all around her. She had never seen anything so beautiful! Then the girl stopped and saw something even more amazing - it was a mist that was made up of little diamonds. It was so pretty that it felt like she was standing in a magical kingdom.

The little girl smiled and started making her way out of the freezing mist. But before she left the mist, she noticed the delicious smell of strawberries. It was like nothing she had ever smelled before. She followed the aroma and it led her to a yummy strawberry bush. She picked a few berries and ate them. The little girl was filled with so much happiness as she left the mist. She thanked her lucky stars for finding such a wonderful place. From that day on, it became her most favorite spot in the world.

Once an day, Jimmy and his mum went to the park. Jimmy was so excited to go on a special adventure. He saw a big wheel and wanted to go on it. Together he and his mum hopped on the wheel and soon it began to zoom around!

Jimmy was so delighted to go so high, he started to laugh and waved at the birds flying around him. Eventually the wheel stopped and the operator gave Jimmy a prize for his bravery! Jimmy was so excited to receive a prize that he ran around the park in celebration.

On the way home, Jimmy's mum was a little frustrated. She wanted to find a shortcut to get home quicker, but no matter which way they went they seemed to end up back at the park. Frustrated she decided to take the long way home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily's mom told her they were going to pack their bags and go see a movie. Lily was very excited! They got in the car and drove to the movie theater. 

Once they got there, they bought their tickets and went inside. Lily's mom got some popcorn, but Lily didn't like the taste. "It's bitter," she said.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited because today was her friend's birthday party. She put on her favorite gray dress and asked her mom to help her tie her hair with a pink ribbon.

Joey was a little boy of three years old. He loved going on walks to see the sights around him. One day he and his mommy took a walk. Mia and Leo are friends. They like to play with toys and eat snacks. One day, Mia has a peanut. She likes peanuts. They are crunchy and salty. Leo does not have a peanut. He wants a peanut. He is jealous of Mia.

"Can I have your peanut?" Leo asks Mia.

"No, it is mine. You have a cracker. Eat your cracker," Mia says.

"But I want a peanut. Please, Mia, give me your peanut," Leo begs.

"No, no, no. Go away, Leo. Leave me alone," Mia says. She puts the peanut in her mouth and chews.

Leo is sad and angry. He does not like Mia. He does not want to be her friend. He thinks Mia is mean and selfish. He runs away from Mia and cries.

Mia hears Leo cry. She feels sorry for Leo. She does not want to make him cry. She does not want to lose her friend. She spits out the peanut and runs after Leo.

"Leo, Leo, wait. I am sorry. I was mean. You can have my peanut. Here, take it," Mia says. She gives Leo the peanut.

Leo stops crying. He looks at Mia and the peanut. He smiles. He takes the peanut and says, "Thank you, Mia. You are a good friend. I am sorry, too. I was jealous. Can we share the peanut?"

Mia nods. She smiles, too. She says, "Yes, we can share the peanut. And we can share the cracker, too. And we can play with toys and eat snacks. We are friends, Leo."

Leo and Mia hug. They share the peanut and the cracker. They play with toys and eat snacks. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a great mommy who loved her daughter very much. Every day, the mommy would pray for her daughter to be happy and healthy, and kiss her little angel goodnight.

One night, it started to rain outside. The mommy took her daughter to the window to see the rainbow in the sky. "See that rainbow?" asked the mommy. "That's God's promise that everything will be okay."

The daughter smiled and said, "I'm going to pray for the rainbow, so it never goes away."

The mommy was so proud, and gave her daughter a big hug. "That's a great prayer," she said. "God will always listen to you, no matter how small you are."

The daughter smiled, feeling glad she could make her mommy happy. And ever since that day, she always says a prayer for the rainbow.

Once there was a big, wide dog. His name was Spot. Spot had a bone, and he held it tight. Every day, Spot would take his bone and go for a walk.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Amber. Amber was three years old and loved discovering new things. One day she went on a wonderful adventure. Once upon a time, there was a boy named John. Everyday John went to the park to play. He loved to pretend he was a firefighter. One day when John was in the park he saw a shiny truck. It had a flashing red light, a ladder and hoses. John was so excited and asked his mom if he could sit in it.

John was so happy

Once upon a time, there was a hippo named Bounce. Bounce the hippo was very gentle and harmless. She lived near a pond. One day, a young boy came to the pond and saw Bounce. The boy was scared of Bounce, but Bounce was so harmless, so he decided to come closer.

Once upon a time there was a fair boy named Jack. He loved to play in the park and have fun. One day, he saw a big zipper on the ground. He danced around it with excitement. He was so sure the zipper had something special inside. But no matter how hard he tried, he could not open it.

Once upon a time, there was a bear named Bill. He was very tired, having been out in the woods folding fur. As he climbed the mountain, he heard a loud roar. To his surprise, a big, angry lion was standing in his way.

The lion said, "What are you doing in my woods?" Bill replied nervously, "I'm just folding fur, sir." The lion scowled. "I don't like outsiders in my woods," he growled.

Bill knew he had to think of something quickly. He thought back to what his mum had said to him when he was just a cub---"be brave and kind, no matter what." So, he put on his bravest voice and said, "Can't I help? I'm very tired and could use a rest."

The lion thought for a moment and then smiled. He said, "Okay, you can stay. But you must help the other animals in the woods." Bill smiled. He was relieved.

So, Bill stayed in the woods, helping the animals with folding fur and doing other jobs. He soon became the lion's best friend!

Once upon a time, there was a loyal little girl named Jenna. Jenna loved drawing and designing. One day, Jenna decided to design a new shore. She thought of many things to put on the shore, such as flowers, trees, and birds. Jenna drew pictures of all her ideas on her paper.

One day Sam was walking home from school. He felt so happy and he smiled as he looked at the ground. As he walked he saw a rabbit. He wanted to follow it, so he started to run. Sam was so excited that he followed the rabbit. He started to dig and the rabbit hopped away. Sam followed it until the sun went down. Tom and Anna were twins who liked to play in the living room. They saw a big tree with shiny things on it. Mommy said the shiny things were ornaments and they were very pretty. She also said they were very fragile and they should not touch them.

But Tom and Anna were curious and wanted to see the ornaments up close. They waited until Mommy was busy in the kitchen and then they tiptoed to the tree. Mommy heard the noise and came to the living room. She saw the broken ornaments and the mess on the floor. She was very angry and sad. She said to Tom and Anna, "What have you done? You have destroyed the ornaments! They were very special to me. They were from Grandma and Grandpa. They are gone now and I can't fix them. You are very naughty and you have to go to your room. Once upon a time, there was a big, strong hippo. He was very powerful and could lift heavy things with his big, strong body. The clown began to smile. He knew he could make friends if he tried. So he began to jump up and down, singing and clapping.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who didn't blink. She wanted to, but no matter how hard she tried she couldn't make her eyes move.

Then with a big blink, she opened her eyes. She could finally blink like everyone else! She knew she could now discover all the wonders the world had to offer.

Once upon a time there was a silver fish. He was very adventurous and wanted to explore the big blue ocean. He swam and swam, looking for a new place to explore.

One day he came across a place he had never seen before. It was a shiny, silver cave! The fish was so excited that he swam inside. As he did, he felt something strange on his tail. He had been weighed down!

He looked around and saw that the cave was full of small silver coins. He realized that he had been weighed down with all the coins the cave contained. The fish was so happy that he started to swim around the cave with all the silver coins.

The adventurous fish had an amazing time in his silver cave and he visited it often. Every time he swam inside, he was weighed down with silver coins. What an amazing adventure he had!

Stella was walking through the park. She looked up and saw an owl, it was bouncing from tree to tree. Suddenly, the owl started to hoot very loudly and Stella was scared. 

"Hello, little owl" said Stella. 

The owl stared at Stella and replied "Tweet". 

Stella laughed and asked the owl if he wanted to play. The owl nodded and hopped closer to Stella. They played tag and Stella laughed as the owl bounced around. Soon it was time to go home, so Stella gave the owl a spicy snack and waved goodbye. 

The owl said "Tweet, tweet" and watched as Stella skipped away.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play with toys and eat snacks. One day, they go to Lily's house after school. Lily's mom gives them tuna sandwiches and apple juice. They are happy and say thank you.

They take their sandwiches and juice to Lily's room. They see many toys on the floor. They see dolls, cars, blocks, and books. They want to play with everything. They forget about their sandwiches and juice. They leave them on the table.

They play for a long time. They make stories with the dolls and cars. They build towers with the blocks. They look at the pictures in the books. They have fun and laugh.

Then, they hear a noise. They turn around and see Lily's cat. The cat is on the table. The cat is eating their sandwiches and juice. The cat likes tuna. The cat does not like apple juice. The cat spills the juice on the floor.

Lily and Tom are surprised. They say, "Oh no! The cat ate our sandwiches and juice! We forgot to eat them! We were too busy playing!"

Lily's mom hears them. She comes to Lily's room. She sees the cat, the sandwiches, the juice, and the mess. She is not angry. She is kind. She says, "Don't worry, kids. It's okay. The cat was hungry too. I can make you more sandwiches and juice. But first, let's clean up the mess together."

Lily and Tom say, "Okay, mom. We are sorry. We will help you. And we will remember to eat our sandwiches and juice next time."

They clean up the mess with Lily's mom. They wash their hands. They eat their new sandwiches and juice. They are full and happy. They thank Lily's mom. They hug the cat. The cat purrs. They are friends.

One sunny day, a little girl named Emma was playing outside with her dolls. She spotted a bright, colourful kite in the sky and was determined to catch it. She ran and ran until she was exhausted, but she simply couldn't catch the kite.

Discouraged, Emma plopped down in the grass and sighed. "I wish I had a kite," she said. Suddenly, something rustled behind her. She spun around and saw a small fairy with shiny wings and a big smile.

"I can get you a kite!" the fairy said. She waved her wand and a kite appeared in Emma's hands. Emma gasped with excitement and hugged the fairy.

"Thank you!" she said.

The fairy smiled and shrugged. "Stitches can help you find the kite," she said before she flew away. 

Emma smiled and looked at her kite. She closed her eyes and thought of the stitch that would help her find the kite in the sky. When she opened her eyes, the kite was soaring above her, bright and beautiful in the sky. Emma cheered with joy and raced off to catch it.

One day, there was an old man. He lived in the east, far away from the city. Whenever the sun went down, he liked to stand outside and look up at the stars. 

One night, the old man looked up and saw something very special. The moon was so big and so bright, it looked like it was touching the top of the sky. The old man was so excited, he wanted to show everyone how beautiful the moon was.

So the old man closed his eyes and began to pray. He prayed loud and clear, and his voice echoed over the trees. He prayed and prayed and then, suddenly, the moon began to shine brighter than ever before. The old man smiled, knowing his prayers had been answered. 

And from then on, every night the old man would go out, look up at the moon, and pray.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. He was creative and he wanted to build something. He looked around and he saw a big pile of blocks. He thought of an idea and he suggested to build a tower with the blocks.

The boy started building it right away. At first, it was very hard but eventually he was able to stack them together. When he finished, it was very tall! He was so proud of his tower.

He looked around and saw everyone looking at it. They all smiled and complimented him on how he was so creative. The boy was so happy! He was glad that he had been able to use his ideas to build something cool.

The boy enjoyed his tower for many days. He showed it to all of his friends and everyone was so impressed. His tower became the best thing ever and he was very proud of it.

Mom and Dad raised the little girl. They helped her have a safe home with furniture for comfort. Mom and Dad showed the little girl how to keep herself safe. She was careful not to touch any of the furniture without Mom and Dad there.

One day, Dad said he was going to raise something. The little girl was curious, so she followed. Dad was raising a new bed for the little girl. It was so special! Together, Dad and the little girl moved the furniture and put the new bed in just the right spot. The little girl was amazed. She couldn't wait to sleep in her safe and cozy new bed.

Mom and Dad watched proudly as the little girl giggled with glee. She thanked them for making her home so safe and comfortable. The little girl had never felt so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to eat cereal for breakfast every day. One morning, she wanted to pour her cereal by herself. But she was too short, and the cereal box was too high. 

Lily tried to reach the box, but she couldn't balance. She felt sad and wanted to give up. But her mom was patient and helped her. She lifted Lily up so she could pour the cereal into her bowl. 

Lily was so happy and thanked her mom. She ate her cereal and felt proud that she could do it with a little help. From that day on, Lily knew that if she couldn't balance, she could always ask for help.

Once upon a time, there was a town with a broken flag. Old Mr. Smith saw the broken flag and wanted to make it better. He was a very persistent man, so he worked for hours to repair it.

As he was working, the mayor of the town came by. "What are you doing?" asked the mayor.

Old Mr. Smith said, "I am fixing the flag. It was broken and I wanted to make it better."

The mayor said, "I am glad you want to help. We need more persistent people like you in town."

Old Mr. Smith smiled as he finished. The flag was as good as new. The town cheered as the flag waved in the wind. Everyone was proud that Old Mr. Smith had fixed the flag.

Once upon a time, there was a boy who enjoyed going for a drive. He had a little car that he could drive around his neighborhood.

On this particular day, the boy wanted to go for a drive but he couldn't find his car. He asked his dad for help. Dad said, "Try looking in the garage. I think I hooked your car there last week."

The boy went to the garage and sure enough, there was his car hooked to the wall. He smiled and unhooked it. He felt excited as he drove away.

Where was the boy going? He was going to a nearby park where he heard a harmless creature was living. He was eager to find the creature!

The boy drove through the park until he spotted the harmless creature. It was a beautiful butterfly! He was so happy that he drove around the park, following the butterfly so he could watch it flutter around. 

The boy had an amazing time that day. He went on a drive, found his car, and saw the harmless creature he had been looking for. It was an adventure he would never forget.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to read books, especially his big, thick dictionary. He thought it was very powerful because it had so many words inside.

One day, Timmy was reading his dictionary when his mom asked him a question. Timmy didn't hear her because he was so focused on his book. His mom asked again, and this time Timmy heard her. He looked up and nodded his head to show he was listening.

After that, Timmy learned to pay attention to his mom and not just his powerful dictionary. He still loved to read, but he also loved spending time with his mom. And sometimes, when he didn't know a word, he would look it up in his dictionary and nod his head with understanding.

Once upon a time there was a little boy. He was walking in the woods near his home when he heard a loud noise. He stopped to listen and heard a meow. He followed the sound and found a kitty stuck up in a tree. The little boy wanted to help. He saw a fisherman nearby so he shouted for him to come help.

The fisherman was very nice. He said he would help rescue the kitty. He quickly made a bossy plan to get it down. With the fisherman's help, the kitty was soon free from the tree.

The little boy was so happy his new friend was safe! He thanked the fisherman for his help. As the boy walked home, he felt like the brave rescuer. He could almost imagine himself as a brave fisherman, rescuing cats from trees.

Jenny went to bed and dreamed of the notebook she had seen earlier in the day. It was a heavy notebook with blue polka-dots on it and she wanted it very much. She thought of what she could use the notebook for.

The next day, Jenny asked her mom to buy her the notebook. Jenny's mom said yes and they went to the store together. Jenny was so excited to carry the heavy notebook home.

Once home, Jenny put her new notebook on her desk and opened it up. She used it to write a note to her best friend. She also drew pictures and made stories in the notebook.

Jenny used the notebook every day and soon filled it with stories, drawings and messages. She loved her heavy notebook and wouldn't let anyone touch it. Her notebook was very special to her.

Lucy and Mom were in the desert. Lucy saw a cactus. It was bigger than her head! She wanted to climb it but Mom said no. Then Mom saw a strange tree. It had a rope attached to it.

Mom said â€œLetâ€™s swing!â€ Lucy was so excited! She grabbed the rope and started to swing high. She could feel the wind in her face and she felt so happy!

Mom pushed her higher and higher until Lucy was almost too scared. Then suddenly something happened. The rope in her hands started to move on its own! It was an unknown force that pushed the rope back and forth!

Lucy felt so scared but she still held onto the rope. She thought it was magic! After some time, Mom said it was time to go home. Lucy had a great time and she still felt like she was flying!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to fish with her grandpa. One day, they went to the lake to catch some fish. Grandpa showed Lily how to put the hook on the fishing rod. "It's easy," he said. "You just have to part the line and put the hook on."

Lily tried to do it herself, but she was having a hard time. "It's too hard," she said. "Can you help me, grandpa?" Grandpa smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. It's not always easy to do things on your own." 

They finally got the hook on the line and started fishing. Lily caught a big fish! "Look, grandpa! I did it!" she said. Grandpa was so proud of her. "You did it all by yourself, Lily. You're a great fisher!" they said happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was very curious and brave.

One day, Lucy wanted to explore past the big, green woods. She put on her shoes and stepped into the woods. When she stepped further into the woods, Lucy saw something shimmering in the sun. She stepped closer to it and noticed it was a cell. Lucy stepped closer and picked it up. She was so excited.

When she brought the cell back home, her mom got very mad. She said to Lucy, â€œYou should never take something that is not yours. That was not a perfect thing to do.â€

Lucy understood her momâ€™s point and promised to never take something that was not hers. She learned her lesson that day and stepped away from the woods.

The moral of the story is: always respect other people's things and never take anything that does not belong to you.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Emma. Emma loved to build things. One day Emma found lots of different colours of squash on the ground. She decided to make something special with the squash.

She used some of them to make a unique house. She made walls from red squash, a door from yellow squash, and a roof from orange squash.

Then she decided to use the other squash to make a unique garden around the house. She made a pond from blue squash and added green squash for trees.

By the end of the day, Emma had built something very special and unique. All of the squash combined to make a beautiful house with a colourful garden. Emma was very proud of her work.

Once upon a time a young deer was born on a crisp spring morning. He was a special deer, with a carefully crafted antlers and a kind, friendly spirit. He was always looking for ways to be creative and explore the world around him. One day, he heard about a magical forest on the other side of the meadow, where only the most creative souls were allowed to go. He wanted to visit this place!

He was determined to explore the forest, and so he set off in the early morning light, weaving through the tall grass and hopping over the fallen logs. Soon he was there! The trees were so tall and their branches were so thick that the sunlight could barely shine through. He felt the creative spirit of the place and could not contain his excitement.

The deer was allowed to explore deeper into the forest and eventually he found a waterfall. He was mesmerized by how fast the water dropped over the edge and the vibrant colors of the rainbow it created. The deer shouted with joy and knew he was meant to share this beauty with the world. With that, he ran off to tell the other animals of his discovery. From then on, the magical forest was known as a place full of creativity and spirit.

Lily and Max were playing in the snow. They made a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They gave him a carrot nose and two buttons for eyes. They were very happy with their snowman.

"Look, he is smiling!" Lily said.

"Yes, he is! He likes us!" Max said.

They wanted to make their snowman more unique. They looked around for something else to add. They saw a shiny red ribbon on a nearby tree. It was from a present someone had left there.

"Let's wrap the ribbon around his toe!" Lily said.

"His toe? But he has no toes!" Max said.

"We can make one! Come on, it will be fun!" Lily said.

They took some snow and shaped it into a big toe. They stuck it on the snowman's foot. Then they took the ribbon and wrapped it around the toe. It looked very funny and colorful.

"There! Now he has a unique toe!" Lily said.

They laughed and hugged their snowman. They thought he was the best snowman ever.

Anna and Ben are playing with their baby brother, Sam. Sam is very small and cute, but he is also very persistent. He wants to grab everything he sees, even if it is not his.

"Look, Sam, this is a ball. You can roll it and bounce it," Anna says, showing him a red ball. She rolls it to him gently, and he smiles and tries to catch it.

"No, Sam, this is a book. You can read it and learn new words," Ben says, holding a colorful book. He opens it and points to a picture of a dog. "This is a dog. It says woof-woof."

Sam reaches for the book, but Ben pulls it away. "No, Sam, this is mine. You have the ball."

Sam frowns and starts to cry. He does not want the ball. He wants the book.

"Ben, don't be mean. Share with Sam. He is just curious," Anna says, taking the book from Ben. She gives it to Sam, who stops crying and laughs. He likes the book.

"Fine, I don't care. I have the ball," Ben says, rolling the ball away. He pretends he is not interested in the book.

But Sam is persistent. He crawls after Ben, dragging the book with him. He wants to share the book with Ben. He thinks Ben will like it too.

"Sam, leave me alone. I don't want the book. I want the ball," Ben says, pushing Sam away.

Sam does not give up. He keeps crawling and laughing. He thinks it is a game.

"Sam, stop it. You are annoying me," Ben says, getting angry.

Anna watches them and laughs too. She thinks they are funny. She loves her baby brother and her big brother. She knows they love each other too, even if they fight sometimes. She decides to join them and play with the ball and the book. She thinks they will have more fun together.

The ground was cool and soft. Sam had a big brown box. He tore it open and lots of bubbles came out. He laughed and smiled as the bubbles flew up in the air and scattered on the ground. The bubbles wiggled and danced as they popped in the air. Sam was giggling as he chased the bubbles. He was having so much fun that he forgot to be careful.

Suddenly, one of the bubbles flew inside a hole in the ground. Sam leaned down to see what happened and let out a loud gasp. He saw a little round yellow bird looking up at him. Sam was so surprised and excited. He reached down and gently picked up the bird and lifted it out of the ground. He softly cupped it in his hand. The bird was so cool.

Sam carefully put the bird back down on the ground. He watched as it flew away with a happy chirp. With a smile, Sam went back to chasing the bubbles. He had such a great time that day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she went to the park with her mommy. They saw a big fire in the distance. Lily asked her mommy, "What is that great sound?" 

Her mommy replied, "That's the sound of the fire burning." Lily was scared and asked, "Will the fire burn us too?" 

"No, don't worry. We're far away from it," her mommy assured her. They watched the fire burn from a safe distance. After a while, the firemen came and put out the fire. 

Lily was happy that the fire was gone and they could play in the park again. She said, "Thank you, firemen, for putting out the fire. Now we can have a great time in the park!"

Once upon a time, there was a new crystal. It was so shiny and sparkly. Jack and Jill wanted to play with it. 

Jack said, â€œLet me quit first!â€

But Jill said, â€œNo, my turn!â€ 

So they had a big fight. They both started to cry. 

Suddenly, they heard their mum call. She said, â€œItâ€™s okay. Thereâ€™s enough of the new crystal for both of you.â€

So they stopped crying and shared the new crystal. They both had fun playing with it together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with glue and make pretty pictures. She always made sure to put the glue away when she was done.

One day, Lily's mom asked her to get ready for bed. Lily got into her pajamas and brushed her teeth. But when she went to put the glue away, she couldn't find it! She started to panic and looked everywhere for it.

Finally, she found the glue under her bed. She was so happy to have found it that she forgot to put the cap back on. The next day, her little brother found the glue and accidentally spilled it all over himself. He got stuck and couldn't move. Lily's mom had to call for help, but it was too late. Her little brother had to go to the hospital and Lily felt very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful otter who lived by the river. He loved to swim and play with his friends. One day, he found a shiny rock on the riverbank. 

"Look at this pretty rock," said the otter to his friend, the duck. "It's so shiny!"

The duck replied, "Be careful, otter. That rock might not be safe."

But the otter didn't listen and kept playing with the rock. Later that day, the otter went to play with his other friends, the fish. 

"Hey, look at my shiny rock!" said the otter.

The fish all gasped in surprise. "That's not a rock, otter. That's a fisherman's lure. It's meant to match the color of a fish and trick them into getting caught!"

The otter felt sad and embarrassed. He realized that he should have listened to his friend, the duck. From that day on, the otter always listened to his friends and never played with strange things he found by the riverbank again.

Once upon a time, there was a thoughtful dog named Spot. Spot had a toy gun that he loved to play with. He would run around the yard and pretend to be a hero. Spot was very happy.

One day, Spot met a new friend named Fuzzy. Fuzzy asked, "Can I play with your gun?" Spot thought about it and decided to trust Fuzzy. They played with the gun together and had lots of fun.

Later, Spot and Fuzzy saw a big ball stuck in a tree. Spot had an idea. He used his toy gun to knock the ball down. Both friends were so happy. They knew that trusting each other was good, and they played together every day after that.

Tom and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their dad. Their dad is big and strong and hairy. He has a lot of hair on his chest and his arms and his face.

One day, they are playing in the living room. Their dad is lying on the couch and they are jumping on him. They are laughing and having fun.

"Tickle, tickle, tickle!" Tom says, as he tickles his dad's chest. His dad laughs and pretends to be ticklish.

"Stop, stop, stop!" his dad says, as he tickles Tom back. Tom laughs and squirms.

"Me too, me too, me too!" Sam says, as he joins the tickling. He tickles his dad's face. His dad laughs and pretends to be ticklish.

"Enough, enough, enough!" his dad says, as he tickles Sam back. Sam laughs and squirms.

They repeat this game for a while, until they are all tired and happy. They hug their dad and say they love him. Their dad hugs them back and says he loves them too.

They are a happy family. They like to play and laugh and repeat.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Tom. Tom wanted to behave as best as he could. Every morning, he was given a strip of paper and told to behave until the end of the day. But Tom could never quite keep his promise and he often ended up being naughty.

One day, Tom found a fragile butterfly. He wanted to play with it so badly, but his mom warned him not to. He needed to be extra careful because the butterfly was very delicate. But Tom couldn't resist the temptation and he soon started to play with the butterfly.

Unfortunately, he didn't handle the butterfly very carefully and it eventually broke its fragile wings. Tom felt very sad and he knew he shouldn't have disobeyed his mom. He quickly put the broken butterfly back in its place, but he had lost the strip of paper his mom gave him in the morning. Tom was afraid of getting punished, so he ran away and hid somewhere.

At the end of the day, Tom finally returned home. His mom was so happy to see him, she didn't even mention the strip of paper.

Tom learned his lesson and from then on he tried to always behave correctly.

Sam loved to play any kind of sport. One day, he wanted to try something new, so he decided to become a soccer player.

He ran out of the house with his soccer ball. He was so excited! He jumped over rocks and twigs as he ran.

When he got to the soccer field, he saw his friends. He said, "Hi, let's play soccer!"

His friends smiled and said, "Ok, let's go!"

They ran around the field and kicked the soccer ball. After a while, they all got tired, but they kept on playing.

When it was time to go home, Sam felt very tired, but he was also happy because he had become a soccer player.

Lily and Sam were playing with their toys in the backyard. Lily had a big doll and Sam had a small truck. Lily liked to be bossy and tell Sam what to do.

"Sam, you have to make your truck go where I say," Lily said. "My doll is the queen and your truck is her servant."

Sam did not like that. He wanted to make his truck go where he wanted. He had a secret plan. He had hidden something under a pile of leaves.

"No, Lily, I don't have to do that," Sam said. "My truck is not your doll's servant. My truck is a superhero and he has a surprise for your doll."

Lily was curious. She wanted to see the surprise. She followed Sam to the pile of leaves.

"What is it, Sam? What is the surprise?" Lily asked.

Sam smiled and moved the leaves away. He revealed a big plastic spider. He made the spider jump at Lily's doll.

"Boo!" Sam shouted. "My truck is Spider-Man and he is here to save the day!"

Lily screamed and dropped her doll. She did not like spiders. She ran away from Sam and his truck.

"Sam, that's not nice! That's scary!" Lily cried.

Sam laughed and picked up his truck and the spider. He was happy. He had taught Lily a lesson. He hoped she would not be so bossy next time.

Once upon a time, there was a happy bird named Blue. Blue liked to fly high in the sky and feel the wind in his feathers. One day, Blue woke up early and saw the sun rising over the trees. He felt very enthusiastic and wanted to fly even higher than usual.

Blue flew up and up until he was above the clouds. He looked down and saw the whole world below him. He felt so happy and free. Suddenly, he saw a butterfly fluttering by. Blue was so excited that he flew down to say hello. The butterfly was very small and colorful. Blue thought it was the most beautiful thing he had ever seen.

Blue and the butterfly became friends and flew around together. They had so much fun that Blue forgot about the time. When he looked down, he saw that the sun was setting and it was time to go home. Blue said goodbye to his new friend and flew back to his nest. He was tired but happy after his exciting adventure.

Once upon a time there was a big yellow boat that lived in the lake. The boat was old and needed to be fixed. So Papa and Maple, the little three-year-old girl, set out to restore the boat.

Maple asked, "What are we doing, Papa?"

Papa looked up from the boat and said, "We are restoring the boat, Maple. We need to make it look new again."

Maple nodded and said, "Yes! It will look so pretty!"

Papa warned Maple to be careful, for the lake was dangerous. Maple said, "Okay Papa, I will be careful."

So Papa and Maple worked together to restore the boat. They cleaned it, painted it and even placed a rainbow flag at the top! When they were finished, they looked at the little yellow boat with pride.

"It looks so pretty now, Papa!" Maple said.

"Yes, it does," Papa replied with a smile.

And from that day on, the little yellow boat in the lake was safe and restored.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat blueberries because they were her favorite fruit. One day, Lily's mom recommended that they go for a walk in the park. Lily was excited and happy to go on a walk with her mom. 

As they were walking, Lily saw a light shining in the bushes. She wanted to go see what it was, but her mom said it was too dangerous. Lily begged and begged, but her mom said no. 

Suddenly, a scary monster came out of the bushes and chased after them. Lily's mom tried to protect her, but the monster was too strong. They both got hurt and had to go to the hospital. Lily learned that it's important to listen to her mom's recommendations and stay safe.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Lucy. One day, they were walking in the park when they spotted a big bag lying in the grass.

Jack looked at Lucy, and said: "Let's choose what we can do with this bag."

Lucy smiled and said: "Let's take it home and have a great time exploring it!" 

Jack said: "That's a great idea! Let's go!".

So, Jack and Lucy put the bag on their shoulders and ran home. When they got home, they put the bag on the table and opened it. Inside, they found lots of wonderful toys and sweets.

Jack and Lucy were so excited. They chose the best toys and sweets and had a great time playing with them. 

From then on, every day Jack and Lucy chose something new from the bag to do together. They had lots of fun playing with their great finds from the bag!

Lily and Ben like to play in the garden. They have a big melon that they want to eat. But the melon is dirty. It has mud and bugs on it. Lily and Ben do not like dirty melon.

They ask Mom to help them. Mom says, "We need to fix the melon. We need to wash it and cut it." She takes the melon to the sink. She turns on the water. She rubs the melon with a cloth. She makes the melon clean. She says, "Now the melon is ready to cut."

She takes a knife and a board. She puts the melon on the board. She cuts the melon in half. She cuts the melon in pieces. She puts the pieces in a bowl. She says, "Now the melon is ready to eat."

She gives the bowl to Lily and Ben. They say, "Thank you, Mom!" They take the pieces and eat them. They say, "Yum, yum, yum! The melon is sweet and juicy. We like clean melon. We do not like dirty melon."

They share the melon with Mom. They are happy. They say, "We love melon. And we love Mom. She can fix anything." Mom smiles. She says, "I love you, too. You are my sweet and juicy melons." They hug and laugh. They have a good time.

Once there was a brave frog. He was looking for a home. He hopped and hopped for days. Suddenly, he came to a big swamp. He felt lonely, but he decided to explore it. 

As he hopped around, he saw something strange. Something seemed to happen in the middle of the swamp. He was curious. He hopped closer and saw a big orange snake. The snake seemed angry. 

The frog was scared, but he wanted to find out what was happening. He hopped closer and saw a pond nearby. That's when he noticed a small blue frog. It was in the water and the orange snake was trying to get it. 

The brave frog knew he had to help the little blue frog. He jumped right into the pond. The snake was taken by surprise and quickly left. The small blue frog thanked the brave frog.

The brave frog now had a new home, and he wasn't lonely anymore. He had a new friend in the swamp. Together they hopped around and explored the swamp. They made sure the orange snake never returned.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to climb trees in her backyard. One day, she saw a shiny nail on the ground. She picked it up and looked at it. It was sharp and pointy. She knew she had to be careful with it. 

Later that day, Lily went inside to get a snack. She asked her mom to open a bag of chips for her. Her mom used her hands to open the bag. Lily thought her mom was so strong. 

After her snack, Lily went back outside to climb more trees. She saw a bird's nest up high in one of the trees. She wanted to climb up and see it, but she was scared. She remembered the nail she found earlier and thought it might help her climb. She carefully used the nail to climb up the tree and was so happy when she saw the bird's nest.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved parties. But today, her party was disgusting. Food was everywhere and it looked very messy. The girl was sad and didn't know what to do.

Suddenly, an idea came to her. She ran to the kitchen, grabbed a cloth and some soap, and started to wipe the mess away. Wipe, wipe, wipe. She worked very hard and soon the mess was gone.

The girl was happy and wanted to call her friends to come back and enjoy the party. When they arrived, they all had a wonderful time because the girl had successfully wiped away the disgusting mess!

Once upon a time, there was a thin grape. It sat in a garden among the other fruits and vegetables. The grape was so small that it was barely visible.

On one sunny day, the grape felt it had been in the garden long enough. So, it decided to disappear. It slowly sneaked away and off it went.

It was a very exciting adventure. The grape did not know where it was headed, but it was happy with its surroundings. It hopped around, making many stops along the way.

As the grape was happily hopping, it was getting very tired. It decided to take a break, and that's when it disappeared. It just vanished, as if it had been never there in the first place. 

The grape had a magical time, and it never forgot that special day.

Lily listened to her mommy and stayed away from the machine. She played in the green grass with her toys instead. Later that day, Lily's daddy came home and saw the machine. He knew what it was and said, "This machine is used to cut the grass. It helps make the grass look nice and neat." 

Lily thought that was cool and asked if she could help use the machine. Her daddy said no because it was too dangerous for her. Lily was sad but knew that her daddy was just trying to keep her safe. From that day on, Lily played in the green grass and admired the machine from afar.

One day, Ann was looking for something special. She went to her Dad and asked him for help. Dad suggested that she could make a picture to put in a yellow frame. Ann thought it was a great idea and got to work. She chose her yellow crayon and started drawing a big sun in the sky.

Once upon a time there was a bird who wanted to soar. Every morning it tried to fly as high as it could, but it couldn't stay up in the air for very long.

One day the bird found something new - a slice of pizza! The bird had never tasted pizza before and he was so happy. He liked the pizza so much that he ate the whole slice.
