The air was cold, but it didn't bother the bird. He soared through the sky, feeling free and happy. Eventually he came back down to the ground, but he never forgot the feeling of soaring through the air.

Mikey was a naughty boy. He didn't want to listen and always did things he wasn't supposed to. One day, he didn't want to eat his meal. He said he didn't need it. But he was wrong! His body needed to eat to stay healthy. 

So his parents explained why it was important for him to have a meal. They said, "Your body needs good food to stay strong and healthy. Without food, you won't be able to do all the fun things you like to do." 

Mikey finally understood. He realized he needed to eat his meals. So he ate all the food on his plate and was happy and healthy. From then on, he knew it was important to listen to his parents and eat his meals.

Once, there was a man who had an expensive van. He drove it everywhere and never wanted to let it go.

One day, the man was driving it and he heard a noise. He stopped to take a look and he saw the engine was broken! He was very sad.

He couldn't afford to fix it so he threw the van away. Everyone was sad, but was happy that the van was gone.

The man decided that he no longer needed a van. And he promised himself he would never buy an expensive van again.

One day, Johnny was walking through the park. It was a very long walk. As he walked, he looked around at the different sights. He especially liked the meadow. He could see the long grass and smell the sweet flowers. It was a very beautiful picture.

He kept walking until he came to a huge lake. He had never seen anything like it. He stood there looking at the lake and hoping that maybe he could play in it.

The next day, Johnny's mum took him back to the park. Johnny was excited. He remembered the lake and what he had hoped for.

When they got to the lake, he was surprised to see that it was now open for swimming. Johnny couldn't believe his luck. He grabbed a towel and some swimming clothes and he was off! He spent the whole day swimming and playing in the water.

Johnny had been so hopeful the day before, and now his wish had come true. He knew to never give up hope.

Once upon a time there was a refuse collector. He drove a colorful van every day to collect all the waste and rubbish in the town. He liked the van very much; it was the most exciting part of his day.

One morning, he woke up and realized that his van was gone! He searched everywhere for it but couldn't find it. He was so sad and confused.

But then he noticed a little 3 year old child in the park. The child was playing with a small colorful van and he asked her if it was his van. The little girl just smiled and refused to give it away.

The refuse collector wasn't mad, he was happy and grateful that the van was safe and in good hands. He thanked the little girl and gave her some sweets. Then, he went to buy a colorful van of his own.

Tom and Lily like to play with their toys. They have many toys, but their favorite is the jet. The jet is big and red and makes a loud noise. They pretend to fly the jet around the room and go to different places.

One day, Tom has a joke. He tells Lily that he can make the jet fly higher than the ceiling. Lily does not believe him. She says, "That is silly, Tom. The jet cannot fly higher than the ceiling. The ceiling is too high."

Tom says, "Yes, it can. Watch me." He takes the jet and runs to the window. He opens the window and throws the jet outside. The jet flies in the air and then falls down on the grass.

Lily is shocked. She says, "Tom, what did you do? You broke the jet. That is not a joke. That is serious."

Tom feels bad. He says, "I'm sorry, Lily. I thought it was funny. I did not mean to break the jet. I will get it back for you."

Tom and Lily go outside and pick up the jet. The jet is not broken, but it is dirty. They clean the jet and hug each other. They say, "We are sorry. We still love each other. And we still love the jet."

Lila and Ben were playing with balloons. They liked to blow them up and let them go. They made funny noises and flew around the room. Lila and Ben were competitive. They wanted to see who could blow the biggest balloon and who could make it fly the farthest.

"Look at my balloon!" Lila said. "It is bigger than yours!"

"No, it is not!" Ben said. "Mine is bigger and better!"

They both held their balloons by the end. They were ready to release them and see who would win.

"Ready, set, go!" Lila shouted.

They both let go of their balloons at the same time. But something went wrong. Lila's balloon flew out of her hand and hit Ben in the face. Ben's balloon slipped out of his finger and hit Lila in the hair. They both gasped and then started to laugh.

"Oops!" Lila said. "That was funny!"

"Sorry!" Ben said. "Are you okay?"

They both nodded and smiled. They did not care who won anymore. They just wanted to have fun. They picked up their balloons and blew them up again. They decided to play a different game. They tried to keep their balloons in the air by hitting them with their hands. They had a lot of fun and forgot about being competitive.

Once upon a time there was a coat frame. It was fit for a special occasion. A little girl named Rachel came to try it on.

Rachel noticed that the frame was disturbed. It was not standing up straight.

"Don't worry," said her mother. "We can fix it."

Her mother carefully adjusted the frame. Rachel stepped in, and it was a good fit.

"It looks beautiful," said her mother. Rachel smiled in delight.

The frame was no longer disturbed. It was standing up straight and Rachel looked wonderful. That's how Rachel got to wear the perfect coat frame for her special day!

Once there was a dancer named Lily. She was very cheerful and always smiled when she was dancing. One day, she wanted to enter a special dance contest. But no one wanted to accept her to join in.

Lily was sad when nobody accepted her. She slowly walked away from the group of dancers, feeling a bit lonely. Suddenly, she heard a voice. It was a friendly fairy! The fairy said she wanted to help.

The fairy cast a spell, and suddenly the other dancers cheered. They said they would accept Lily to be part of the dance contest. Lily smiled and thanked the fairy. She twirled around and was so happy to be accepted.

Lily danced her way to the center of the stage and wowed the audience with her moves. In the end, Lily won the dance contest and everyone cheered for her! She was so happy and cheerful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Emma. She loved to play in the park with her friends.

One day, while they were playing, Emma saw something shiny near the slide. She ran over and found a diamond! She quickly picked it up, shouted out to her friends, "Look what I found!"

Her friends all gathered around, excited. "Wow, can I touch it?" one of them asked. Emma said yes, and all of her friends took turns feeling the smooth, sparkly diamond.

Then the sun started to set, so Emma put the diamond in her pocket, and they all decided to go down the slide one more time. Emma was so dizzy, she flew right off the slide! Luckily, she was okay, and they all went on their way.

The diamond was now a special part of Emma's magical park adventure. She felt so happy as she went home, dreaming of sliding and finding more diamonds!

Once upon a time there was a special flower. It was very rare and it had special power. Everywhere else in the world flowers were blooming. But this one, it was different. 

One day the special flower bloomed! It was even more beautiful than before. Its petals glittered and shined like stars. It was so pretty, it made everyone smile. 

The flower was magical. Everywhere it bloomed, special things happened. Good luck came to those nearby. And they were so happy, they gave it a special name - Lucky Flower! 

The flower bloomed each year, bringing new joy and luck to those near it. That's why it was so rare, and so special. The power of the Lucky Flower was magical!

Once upon a time, there was a group of friends who wanted to do something special. So, they decided to try to make a parade.

First, they got all the things they would need. The gathered colorful streamers, flags, and balloons. They even made signs to carry.

Next, they got organized. They made a plan to decide who would carry what, what route they would take and who would give out the treats.

The day of the parade, they lined up and started walking. Everyone was so happy and excited. The friends waved and shouted to people as they made their way around town. Everyone was so proud that they had tried.

When they finished their parade, they cheered with joy. They celebrated by eating cake and playing games. Everyone was proud of their organized parade. And they all had lots of fun!

One day, Jack and his Mom were walking through a forest. Suddenly, a brown fog appeared in front of them. It was so thick that Jack couldn't see what was beyond. But Jack's Mom was brave and she said, "Let's unpack".

Jack and his Mom started walking into the brown fog. As they walked, the fog became thinner and thinner. Soon, they saw a big doorway in front of them.

Jack and his Mom opened the door and they were very excited to discover what was inside. It was an old building full of different toys! They unpacked all of the toys and Jack was so happy. 

Jack and his Mom played with the toys for hours. When the fog cleared, Jack and his Mom said goodbye to the building and went back home. From that day on, Jack never forgot the fog and the fun day he had with Mom!

The little girl was so excited to go to the park. She could feel the warm sun on her skin and the gentle breeze. She felt cheerful and wanted to explore the park. As she was walking she felt a soft touch on her arm. She looked up and saw it was a family of birds. She smiled and reached out her hand to touch them. But before she could touch them, they flew away. She felt a bit of regret that she couldn't touch them.

But it didn't take her long to feel cheerful again. She ran around the park and chased some ants and butterflies. She saw a pond and enjoyed watching the cool fish swimming around. She tried to touch them but again, they were too fast! This time she didn't feel any regret.

The little girl had a wonderful time at the park and felt cheerful and happy. Despite not being able to touch the birds and fish she still enjoyed feeling the warm sun and gentle breeze. She would certainly enjoy coming back to the park again soon.

Fred was a robot who lived on a planet far away. He loved to go on adventures and one day he wanted to explore. He put on his running shoes and began to jog. He thought it would be a nice day for running.

As he jogged, he looked up at the sky and saw an enormous planet. It was so big and sparkly that he wanted to go and see it. Fred ran even faster and eventually he got to the enormous planet.

When he arrived, he felt so excited! He wanted to explore the planet. He looked around and said, â€œHello? The giant said, â€œWelcome to my planet â€“ letâ€™s explore together!â€

 Fred and the giant had a wonderful time exploring the enormous planet. They ran and jogged around the planet, discovering new things and having great adventures. Fred was so happy and grateful to have found this amazing planet. He couldnâ€™t wait to come back and explore it again!

Once upon a time, there was a little tiger. He lived in a big forest with his family. The tiger had a toy that looked like him. It was a fake tiger, but he loved it very much.

One day, the little tiger lost his fake tiger. He looked everywhere for it. He looked under the trees and behind the rocks, but he could not find it. The little tiger felt sad and started to cry.

A mean monkey saw the little tiger crying and said, "I have your fake tiger, but I hate it!" The little tiger was brave and said, "Please give it back, I love my fake tiger." The monkey saw how much the little tiger loved his toy and felt bad. He gave the fake tiger back to the little tiger, and they became friends. From that day on, the monkey never said "hate" again, and they all played happily in the forest.

Sara and Tom like to play in the park. They like to climb the trees and swing on the branches. One day, they find a big branch on the ground. It is brown and hard and has many leaves.

"Look, Tom, this is a magic branch!" Sara says. "We can wear it like a crown and be the king and queen of the park!"

Tom likes the idea. He helps Sara put the branch on her head. It is heavy and prickly, but Sara does not mind. She feels like a queen. She gives Tom a leaf to wear on his head. He feels like a king.

They walk around the park, holding hands and smiling. They see a man sitting on a bench. He is old and has white hair and a long beard. He looks at Sara and Tom and smiles.

"Hello, little ones," he says. "What are you wearing on your heads?"

Sara and Tom tell him about the magic branch. They say it makes them the king and queen of the park.

The man nods and laughs. He says, "You have a good imagination. Do you know where this branch came from?"

Sara and Tom shake their heads. They do not know.

The man says, "This branch is very old. It is ancient. It came from a tree that was here before the park was made. It was a big and beautiful tree. It gave shade and fruits and flowers to many people and animals. But one day, a storm came and broke the tree. The branch fell to the ground and stayed there for a long time. It is a part of the history of this place."

Sara and Tom listen to the man. They feel amazed and curious. They ask him more questions about the tree and the park and the storm. The man tells them many stories. He is happy to share his knowledge and memories.

Sara and Tom are happy to learn and listen. They thank the man for his stories. They say goodbye and go back to their game. They still wear the branch and the leaf on their heads. They feel proud and special. They have a magic branch that connects them to the past and the present. They have a new friend who teaches them about the world. They have each other to play and have fun. They are the king and queen of the park.

Once upon a time there was a big, strong car. One day, it wanted to go along the road, so it started to drive. It drove and drove until it saw a slide. The car thought it would be fun to go down the slide like a child would. So it drove really fast towards the slide. 

But the car was too strong for the slide and broke it as it went down. It was fun for a few seconds, but then the car got stuck! It was so sad. The car screamed and screeched for help, but nobody could help it. It was stuck there for a really, really long time. 

The end.

Anna and Ben like to play in the park. They run and jump and laugh. They see many things in the park: birds, flowers, swings, slides. But their favorite thing is the big tree.

The big tree is very old and tall. It has many branches and leaves. Anna and Ben like to climb the tree and pretend they are monkeys. They make funny noises and swing from the branches.

One day, when they are playing in the tree, they see something new. It is a small animal with a long tail and a furry face. It is hiding behind a leaf. Anna and Ben are curious. They want to see the animal better.

"Hello, little animal," Anna says softly. "What are you? Do you live in the tree?"

The animal does not answer. It looks at Anna and Ben with big eyes. It is scared. It does not know them.

"Maybe it is a squirrel," Ben says. "Or a mouse. Or a rat."

The animal does not like those words. It thinks they are wild and mean. It does not want to be friends with them. It makes a loud noise and jumps out of the leaf. It runs away to another branch.

Anna and Ben are surprised. They did not mean to scare the animal. They just wanted to say hello.

"Come back, little animal," Ben calls. "We are not wild. We are nice. We want to play with you."

But the animal does not come back. It disappears in the tree. Anna and Ben are sad. They wish they could see the animal again. They wonder what it is. They hope it is happy in the tree.

Once there was a girl named Rachel. Rachel liked to play outside in the sun. One day, Rachel got sick and her mom took her to the hospital. Rachel was a bit confused about why she was there. The doctor smiled and said, â€œDonâ€™t worry, Rachel. I promise to make you feel better.â€

Rachel listened to the doctor, and he gave her medicine. She felt much better very soon and was soon happy again. 

The doctor said, â€œNow remember Rachel, if you ever get sick again, come back to the hospital and I will make sure you get better. I promise.â€ Rachel smiled, happy to hear that. 

So Rachel left the hospital feeling better and secure knowing that if she ever got sick again, the doctor would help. She was no longer confused.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim and his baby brother, Sam. They lived in a house with a high tree in the yard. Tim loved to climb the high tree and look at the sky.

One day, Tim said, "Sam, I want to protect you. Let's play under the high tree." Sam smiled and followed his brother. They played together, laughing and having fun.

Suddenly, a big bird flew down from the high tree. Tim stood in front of Sam and said, "I will protect you, brother!" The big bird saw how brave Tim was and flew away. Sam hugged Tim and said, "Thank you for protecting me, brother." They went back to playing, safe and happy under the high tree.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play in the garden. They had a big sandbox where they made castles and roads and bridges. One day, they saw a big cake on the kitchen table. It looked delicious. It had pink frosting and sprinkles and candles.

"Let's have some cake," Lily said to Ben.

"But Mom said we have to wait for dinner," Ben said.

"Mom won't know. She is busy in the other room. Come on, it's just a little bite," Lily said.

She climbed on a chair and reached for the cake. Ben followed her. They each took a big bite of the cake. It was sweet and soft and yummy. They smiled at each other.

But then, Mom came into the kitchen. She saw the cake with two bites missing. She saw Lily and Ben with frosting on their faces. She was very angry.

"Who did this?" she asked.

Lily and Ben looked at each other. They did not say anything.

"You know you are not supposed to touch the cake. It is for Grandma's birthday. You are very naughty. You have to go to your room and no TV for a week. That is your punishment," Mom said.

She grabbed them by their waists and carried them to their room. She closed the door behind them.

Lily and Ben felt sorry. They knew they did a bad thing. They wished they had listened to Mom. They hugged each other and said sorry to Mom and Grandma in their hearts. They hoped they would get another chance to have some cake.

Once upon a time, there was a monster who loved to bite. Everywhere he went, he looked for things to bite. He even bit people who were not so nice! 

One day, the monster bit a truth. It was a surprise because the monster thought the truth would be sweet. But, it was sour! The monster was so surprised that he started to cry. 

The monster was sad because he did not want to hurt the truth. But, he had already bitten it. Luckily, he found a way to make it better. 

He took the truth and made it into a big hug for everyone in the world. It was his way of saying sorry for biting the truth. And everyone was happy because the truth was now a hug. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a family that lived in a big house. One day, their little daughter was playing in the garden when she fell and hurt herself. Her dad saw it and it looked very, very bad. He quickly ran and called for help.

A few minutes later, the ambulance came to the house. The kind ambulance people checked her over carefully and decided it was time to go to the hospital. They put her into the ambulance and drove away.

When they got to the hospital, all the doctors and nurses were waiting to see her. They took her into a special room and did lots of tests. Finally, they said she was going to be okay.

The little girl was so happy that she got better. Her parents thanked the kind ambulance people and everyone was feeling better. They went home and stored away all the terrible thoughts.

Once upon a time, there was a wise old owl. He had a brush that he used to keep his feathers clean. One day, a little mouse came to the wise owl's tree. The mouse looked very sad.

"Mr. Owl, can you lend me your brush?" asked the little mouse. "My fur is all messy, and I need to look nice for my friend's party."

The wise owl thought about it. "I will lend you my brush," he said, "but you must promise to bring it back when you are done."

The little mouse was very happy. He took the brush and went to his friend's party. But when he got there, he saw a big cat! The cat wanted to eat the little mouse.

"No, please don't eat me!" cried the little mouse. "I just want to go to my friend's party."

The cat thought about it. "If you let me use your brush, I will not eat you," said the cat.

The little mouse agreed. He lent the cat the brush, and they both went to the party. The cat did not eat the little mouse, and they became friends. The little mouse remembered to give the brush back to the wise owl, who was very happy.

Once there was a very gifted mechanic who was very good at fixing things. One day, he decided to introduce himself to the town by visiting each house one at a time.

The mechanic knocked on the first door and when it opened, a small girl poked her head out.

"Hi there!" said the mechanic.

The little girl smiled. "Hello!" she said.

"My name is Tom and I'm a mechanic," the mechanic introduced himself. "I'm here to help people fix their broken things. Can I help you?"

The little girl shook her head slowly. "No thank you," she said.

The mechanic thanked her and moved on to the next house. He repeated his introduction to all the other children in town until everyone knew who he was. 

The next day, all the children were talking about the mechanic and how he could help fix anything. Everyone in town was very thankful for having a gifted mechanic.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was three years old and she had a bad day.

The little girl was walking around in the park when she saw a pear. She was so excited and ran over to get it. But when she picked it up she noticed something was wrong.

The little girl started to panic because she knew the pear wasn't ripe. It was still small and hard. She wondered what to do, but then she had an amazing idea.

The little girl remembered something her Mum told her. She remembered that if you put unripe fruit in a warm place, it will eventually ripen. She smiled and decided to take the pear home. 

So the little girl took the pear home, put it in a warm place, and waited. Sure enough, the next day it was ripe! The little girl was so happy and felt relieved. She shared the amazing pear with her family and they all enjoyed it. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to travel to new places with her family. One day, they went to a farm where they saw big orange pumpkins and tiny radishes growing in the ground.

Lily asked her mom, "Can I pick a radish?" Her mom said, "Sure, but be careful not to pull too hard." Lily picked a radish and it was so small and cute!

Later that day, they went to a market where they met a friendly man who sold fruits and vegetables. Lily showed him her radish and he said, "Wow, that's a very nice radish. It's so orange!" Lily was very happy to hear that. 

The man gave Lily a big smile and said, "Have a nice day and safe travels!" Lily smiled back and said, "Thank you, we will!" And they continued on their journey to see more new places.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and books. But every day, they have to nap after lunch. Mom says napping is good for them. Lily and Ben do not like napping. They want to stay up and have fun.

One day, they have a plan. They pretend to nap in their beds. But when Mom goes to the kitchen, they sneak out. They go to the backyard. There, they see a big box. It is unknown. They do not know what is inside. They are curious.

"Let's open it!" Lily says.

"OK!" Ben says.

They run to the box. They pull the tape. They lift the flap. They look inside. They see a lot of balloons. They are colorful and shiny. They are happy.

"Wow! Balloons!" Lily says.

"Yay! Balloons!" Ben says.

They take out the balloons. They blow them up. They play with them. They toss them in the air. They laugh and giggle. They have a lot of fun.

But they do not see Mom. She comes to the backyard. She sees the box. She sees the balloons. She sees Lily and Ben. She is not happy.

"Lily! Ben! What are you doing?" Mom says.

Lily and Ben stop playing. They look at Mom. They are scared.

"Sorry, Mom. We did not nap. We wanted to see the box. It had balloons. We like balloons." Lily says.

"Sorry, Mom. We did not nap. We wanted to have fun. We found balloons. They are pretty." Ben says.

Mom sighs. She is not angry. She is tired.

"I know you like balloons. And I know you want to have fun. But you also need to nap. Napping is good for you. It helps you grow and learn. It makes you happy and healthy. Do you understand?" Mom says.

Lily and Ben nod. They understand.

"OK, Mom. We will nap. Can we keep the balloons?" Lily says.

"OK, Mom. We will nap. Can we play with the balloons later?" Ben says.

Mom smiles. She is glad.

"Of course you can. The balloons are a gift from your aunt. She sent them for your birthday next week. She loves you very much. And so do I. Now, let's go inside. It's time to nap." Mom says.

Lily and Ben hug Mom. They say thank you. They take their balloons. They go inside. They nap in their beds. They dream of balloons. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat yogurt every day. One day, she went to the fridge to get some yogurt, but the container was empty! She was sad because she really wanted some yogurt.

But then, her mom came into the kitchen and revealed a surprise. She had bought a new container of yogurt just for Lily. Lily was so happy and thanked her mom. She opened the yogurt and ate it all up, feeling very satisfied. 

From then on, Lily made sure to always check if the yogurt container was empty before asking her mom for more.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Molly. She loved to jump! Every morning she would jump out of bed and run to the kitchen. This morning, Molly was excited to find a calendar on the kitchen table. She carefully opened it and saw fun pictures of animals and people jumping. What fun!

Molly jumped onto the kitchen counter and gently tapped the calendar. "I love this!" Molly exclaimed. 

Suddenly, Molly heard an angry voice. She looked behind her, and there was her mother. She was not happy! "Molly, don't jump on the kitchen counter! You could break something!"

Molly sadly looked down. "I'm sorry mummy, it's just that the calendar was so fun," she said, her voice trembling.

Molly's mother shook her head. "No more jumping on things, okay? Now, take the calendar and put it away."

Molly hung her head and put the calendar away. She was sad that she couldn't jump and play with the calendar anymore. She knew that she couldn't disobey her mother. She trudged out of the kitchen, dejected and without a jump in her step.

Gracie was very small. One day she wanted to explore the woods near her house. She asked her mom and dad if she could go, and they said yes. Gracie was a little bit scared to go into the forest, but she was also excited.

She walked through the trees, looking around and she came to a cabin. It looked old and dark, and Gracie was a bit fearful.

As she stepped closer to the cabin, she felt something pinch her leg. Gracie looked down, but she couldn't see anything. She jumped and ran away, back to her house.

When she got home, Gracie told her mom and dad what happened. They said that she had probably just been pinched by a small bug and that she had been brave to go explore the woods. 

Gracie was a bit more brave the next time she went exploring, but she was always a bit fearful when she got close to that old cabin.

Once upon a time there was a young girl named Anna who loved to dance. Every day she would twirl and skip around her house.

One day, Anna was dancing in her bedroom, when suddenly she heard a voice.
It was her brain speaking!

"I see how happy you are when you dance," it said to Anna. "But please be safe. There are lots of neat things you can do, but some can be dangerous."

Anna smiled and thanked her brain. Then she kept on dancing in a safe way.

Whenever Anna felt down, she would dance and it made her feel better. She was so glad to have a brain that reminded her to be safe while having fun.

The end.

John and his mom were walking through the park. They both saw a frog jumping in the pond. John was curious so he decided to jump in too.

John's mom said, "No, John, you can't jump in there! You might get wet and cold."

But John was determined and said, "Jump! Jump!" 

John's mom said, "No, no. This is no game. This is a war and you must be careful." 

John was very curious and kept looking around the pond. He saw a turtle swimming in the water. "Turtle!" he shouted.

John couldn't take his eyes off the turtle, so he decided to jump in the pond after all! His mom said, "Be careful, John! Come out of there before you get too wet!" 

But John was already having fun and he kept jumping around and splashing in the water.

John's mom couldn't help but smile. She was happy to see her son having so much fun. When John was done jumping, she wrapped her warm coat around him. 

John smiled and said, "Jump! Jump!" He was already thinking of his next adventure.

Lily wanted to buy a muffin from the bakery. She had saved some money from her piggy bank. She liked the muffins with chocolate chips and sprinkles. They looked yummy and sweet.

She walked to the bakery with her mom. She saw a big sign that said "Muffins: 2 for 5 dollars". She counted her money. She had 4 dollars and 2 pennies. She thought she had enough.

She went to the counter and pointed to the muffins she wanted. The lady behind the counter smiled and said, "That will be 5 dollars, please."

Lily gave her the money. But the lady shook her head and said, "Sorry, honey, this is not enough. You need 5 dollars, not 4 dollars and 2 pennies. These muffins are expensive."

Lily felt sad and confused. She did not understand why she could not buy the muffins. She started to cry. She felt embarrassed. She wanted to hide.

Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. Don't cry. You made a mistake. It's not your fault. The sign is tricky. It means you have to pay 5 dollars for 2 muffins, not for 1 muffin. Do you understand?"

Lily nodded. She wiped her tears. She said, "I'm sorry, mom. I'm sorry, lady. I thought I had enough money."

The lady said, "It's okay, sweetie. Don't be sorry. You are a smart and brave girl. You tried to buy something by yourself. That's very good. How about I give you one muffin for free? You can share it with your mom. How does that sound?"

Lily smiled. She said, "Thank you, lady. You are very nice. I like your muffins. They are yummy and sweet."

The lady gave her a muffin and a napkin. She said, "You're welcome, Lily. Enjoy your muffin. And don't forget to say thank you to your mom. She loves you very much."

Lily said, "Thank you, mom. I love you very much. Can we share the muffin?"

Her mom said, "Of course, Lily. I love you very much, too. And I love muffins. Let's share the muffin. And let's learn more about money and numbers. They are fun and useful."

They sat on a bench and ate the muffin. It was yummy and sweet. Lily felt happy and proud. She learned something new. She was not embarrassed anymore. She was a smart and brave girl.

One day, a little girl was walking through the park. She was very confused, as she had never been to this park before. Suddenly she heard someone call her name. She looked around and saw a woman with a big smile on her face.

The woman said, "Come and jump on the spring!"

The little girl was even more confused, but she liked the idea of jumping on the spring. She walked closer and the woman helped the little girl get on the spring.

The little girl jumped and jumped. She had so much fun! When she was done jumping, the woman said, "That was great! Please come back soon!".

The little girl said goodbye and went on her way. She couldn't wait to come back and jump on the spring again!

One day, an ordinary boy named Tim found a toy gun. He wanted to play with it. Tim saw a label on the gun. The label had a picture of a star. Tim liked the star. He showed the gun to his friend, Sam.

Tim said, "Look, Sam! I found a toy gun. It has a star on it." Sam looked at the gun and said, "Let's play with it! We can shoot at things."

They went outside to play. Tim and Sam saw a big tree. Tim said, "Let's shoot at the tree and see what happens!" They shot the toy gun at the tree. Nothing happened. They were sad.

But then, they saw a small star fall from the tree. It was the same star from the label. They were very happy. Tim and Sam played with the star and the toy gun all day.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. They were both foolish, so they decided to hang from a tree. One used a leather belt to tie around his waist, and the other used a piece of leather string.

They hung from the tree for a long time, but eventually their arms and legs started to get tired. But the two friends didn't give up, they kept on hanging.

Finally their silly plan had worked â€“ they had managed to reach the Green Apple at the top of the tree! The Green Apple was so juicy and sweet and was worth all the effort.

The two friends celebrated their success, happy that their foolish idea had worked. They each took a big bite of the delicious apple and enjoyed it.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a big bear. He had a big round nose and two furry ears. Every day he went for a nice walk around his forest home.

One day, he saw a funny little mouse. The mouse was really small and he was hopping around on the ground. He had a tiny mouth and a long pointy tail.

The bear nodded his head. He knew that the mouse was trying to say hello. The mouse nodded back and tried to smile. It was a funny sight!

The bear and the mouse became friends. They went on fun adventures together around the forest. Everywhere they went they were laughing and smiling.

The bear and the mouse were best friends forever!

Tom and Lily are friends. They like to play in the park. They like to slide, swing and run. One day, they see a big dog in the park. The dog is black and brown. It has sharp teeth and loud bark. Tom and Lily are scared of the dog.

"Let's go away from the dog," Lily says. "The dog is dangerous. It can bite us."

"No, I want to watch the dog," Tom says. "The dog is cool. It can run fast and jump high. Maybe it can play with us."

Tom runs to the dog. Lily follows him. She does not want to leave Tom alone. The dog sees Tom and Lily. It does not like them. It growls and snarls. It runs to Tom and Lily. It wants to chase them.

"Help, help!" Tom and Lily scream. "The dog is angry. It wants to hurt us."

They try to run away from the dog. But the dog is faster. It catches Tom and bites his leg. Tom falls to the ground. He cries and bleeds. Lily is very scared. She runs to Tom and tries to help him. But the dog is not done. It bites Lily too. She falls to the ground. She cries and bleeds.

No one hears Tom and Lily. No one comes to help them. The dog keeps biting them. Tom and Lily are in pain. They are very sad. They wish they had listened to Lily. They wish they had stayed away from the dog. They wish they had never gone to the park.

Once upon a time, there lived a healthy family. One day, the father said to the mother: â€œLetâ€™s go to the park and pray.â€ So they all got in the car, drove down the road, and went to the park.

When they arrived at the park, the father and mother said to the 3 year old child: â€œLetâ€™s pray together.â€ So they knelt down on the grass, closed their eyes, and prayed.

The child was so happy to pray with his family. He said: â€œI love praying for healthy things like health and joy!â€ 

The father said to the child: â€œYes, thatâ€™s right. Letâ€™s keep praying for health and happiness.â€ 

So they kept praying together. When they finished, they all hugged and then went back home down the road.

Once upon a time, there was a rich fireman. He was strong and brave. One day he had to save a cat from a high tree. He put on his fireman suit and went to save the cat. He climbed the tree and dropped the cat onto the ground. The little cat was safe!

The fireman wandered off, trying to find his way home. He soon realised he was lost. He looked around and couldn't find his way back. Then, he spotted a rich house. He knocked on the door and the nice people inside gave him some food and a bed.

The fireman thanked them and on his way home the next day, he dropped a bag of money that he found in the street, into their mailbox as a way to say thank you.

The rich fireman was happy he could help these nice people, and he thanked his lucky stars he found his way home.

One day, a truck was driving down a street. It was heavy, but it was carrying something special. Suddenly, the truck stopped and smoke started to come from the truck. It was in trouble!

A man saw the truck and he knew that he had to save it. He ran over to the truck, and opened the door. Inside, he saw boxes and boxes of food! He smiled, because he knew he was going to save the food.

The man worked hard. He pushed and pulled the truck until it started moving again. Little by little, he moved the truck away from the smoke. Finally, he reached a safe place. The truck was saved!

The man was happy. He knew he had helped to save the food, and the truck too. The truck, heavy with the food it was carrying, trundled off down the street.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who lived in a big house with her family. One day, she went for a walk in the forest near her house. As she was walking, she noticed something shiny on the ground. It was an unknown object that she had never seen before. 

The girl picked up the object and looked at it closely. She couldn't figure out what it was or what it was for. She decided to take it home and show it to her family. 

When she got home, she showed the unknown object to her family. They were all very curious about it and tried to figure out what it was. After some time, they discovered that it was a rare gemstone that was worth a lot of money. The girl was very happy that she had found something so special in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a very loyal dog. His name was Spot. He had a special promise to keep. Every day, Spot would go to the park and mix things up with his best friend, a little girl called Sarah. 

They would mix sand and water together to make a fun sandcastle. They would mix dirt and leaves together to make mud pies. They would mix twigs and rocks together to make an adventure track.

No matter what was mixed, Spot was always there to help Sarah. He was very loyal and made sure no one else ever played with her sand or her mud or her tracks. Every day, Sarah thanked Spot for keeping his promise.

After some time, Spot and Sarah made the best mix of all, a magical potion. They mixed together laughter, happiness, and friendship to make a special potion. The potion was so special, it made Spot and Sarah the best of friends forever.

Once there was a family that lived in a house had a big garden. Every day the little boy and his parents would go outside and play in the garden. 

One day, the little boy looked around and said, "I dare you to climb up the tree!" His parents laughed and said, "That's a big dare!" 

So the little boy bravely climbed up the tree and when he reached the top he shouted, "I did it!" His parents clapped and cheered. 

The little boy was so happy that he ran around the garden, laughing and jumping. His parents chased him around and laughed too. 

It was a happy day for the family and ever since, the boy and his family have been returning to the garden to explore and play.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the zoo with her mommy. They saw many animals like lions, monkeys, and birds. Lily liked the birds the most because they were colorful and easy to see.

Suddenly, Lily saw a bird that looked sad. It was in a cage and couldn't fly. Lily asked her mommy, "Why is the bird in a cage?". Her mommy said, "The bird can't live in the wild anymore, so it lives in the zoo."

Lily felt bad for the bird and wanted to help. She said, "I recognize the bird is sad. Can we take it home and make it happy?". Her mommy said no because the bird needs to stay in the zoo. Lily was sad too.

As they were leaving, Lily saw the bird again. It looked even sadder than before. Suddenly, the bird stopped moving. Lily's mommy told her that the bird had died. Lily cried and said, "I wish we could have helped the bird."

Once there was a little boy and he had a great big garden. He really loved it and wanted to admire it all the time. So he went out and looked at the hedge around his garden. He liked how it was tall and straight, and how it made him feel safe in his garden.

The hedge was always there when the little boy wanted it. He admired how it was always available, going around the whole garden. He liked how it was always around to protect him and keep him safe.

The little boy ran around the hedge and laughed with joy. He would hug it and love it, no matter what happened. The hedge was his best friend, and he always enjoyed being with it in his garden.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a fat cat named Fluffy. Fluffy was very nice and loved to play with the kids in the town. One sunny day, Fluffy had an idea. She wanted to invite all her friends to a fun party.

Fluffy went to the west, where her friend Doggy lived. She said, "Doggy, I am having a party. Please come and play with us." Doggy was very happy and wagged his tail. They both went to invite more friends to the party.

At the party, all the animals played and had fun. They laughed, danced, and ate yummy treats. Fluffy was very happy to see her friends having a great time. It was the best party ever, and all the animals in the town loved Fluffy even more.

Once upon a time, there was a man who wanted to build something. He worked hard every day until he made something special. It was an expensive machine that he could speak into. He tested it and the machine made a voice that sounded like a real person. He was so happy, he wanted everyone to hear. So he showed it to all his friends. They were amazed! It was one of the most expensive machines they had ever seen. Everyone loved it and wanted one of their own. The man was so proud of what he built. He knew that his hard work and creativity had paid off.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to look up at the sky and see the fluffy clouds go by. One day, Lily was playing outside with her friend Timmy.

Timmy said, "I feel like we should go inside, the sky looks dark."

Lily said, "No, the sky is always reliable. It won't rain."

But Timmy was right, it started to rain really hard. They ran inside, but Lily's dog was still outside. She went back out to get him, but the wind was too strong and a tree fell on top of her. The end.

Sam loved to play. He would run around and play with his toys at home and in the park every day. Today, Sam was feeling extra adventurous and wanted an action-packed day. After eating breakfast, he asked his mom if they could go to the park. 

"Yes, sure!" she replied and off they went.

When they arrived, Sam was surprised to find a lot of kids playing sports, like soccer and baseball. He had never seen sports like this before, and wanted to try it out. 

"Mom, can I play?" he asked eagerly.

His mom smiled and said, "Of course you can. Just be persistent and you'll have lots of fun."

So, Sam joined a game and had the best time. The kids laughed as he tried to kick the ball and cheered him on as he ran around. Sam was so persistent that by the end of the day, he was a real pro! His mom was amazed and told him what a great job he had done.

Sam was tired, but happy and proud of himself. He felt like the park was the best place in the world and he couldn't wait to come back tomorrow.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play and learn new things. One day, they go to the doctor with Mom. The doctor says they need a test. He wants to see if they are healthy and strong.

Sara and Ben are scared. They do not like needles and machines. They do not know what the test is. Mom says they are brave and they can do it. She says the test will not hurt and it will be over soon. She says they will get a sticker and a candy after the test.

Sara goes first. She sits on a big chair. The doctor puts a clip on her finger. He says it will measure her heart. Sara feels a little tickle. She looks at the screen. She sees a red line that goes up and down. The doctor says her heart is good. He gives her a sticker and a candy. Sara smiles.

Ben goes next. He lies on a small bed. The doctor puts a gel on his belly. He says it will show his inside. Ben feels a little cold. He looks at the screen. He sees a gray picture that looks like a puzzle. The doctor says his inside is good. He gives him a sticker and a candy. Ben smiles.

Sara and Ben hug Mom. They say they are done with the test. They say they are brave and healthy. Mom says she is proud of them. She says they can go home and play. Sara and Ben are happy. They say they like the doctor and the test. They say they are not scared of the test anymore. They say they want to learn more new things.

Once there was a girl named Bella. She was so excited because it was her birthday! 
Mama brought her a perfect present. It was a clown!
Bella clapped her hands and shouted, "Yay!"
Mama said, "Do you like it?" 
Bella replied, "I love it!"
Mama smiled and said, "Let's get it out of the box and play!"
So they did, and they had lots of fun playing with the clown.
Mama said, "You have the perfect birthday, don't you?" 
Bella hugged her mama and said, "Yes I do!"

Once, there was a girl named Jane. She was three years old and loved to take naps, just like all the other kids. She especially loved to take naps in the park. There, she could lay down and close her eyes and when she opened them, she could admire all the pretty swans.

One day, Jane decided to go to the park and take a nap. She put down her blanket, lay down and quickly fell asleep. After a short while she woke up again, and saw a big, beautiful swan standing right at her feet! Jane was so surprised, she jumped up and said â€œHello! Are you a pretty swan?â€

The swan nodded. Then it stretched out its neck and said â€œHello Jane, my name is Snowy. Would you like to take a nap with me?â€

Jane smiled and said â€œYes please! That would be lovely!â€ So, Jane and the swan cuddled up together and had a wonderful nap in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a robot. He was rolling around, looking for something to do. Suddenly he saw a group of children playing. He wanted to join them, so he kept rolling closer.

But the children were not happy about the robot. They didn't like it and they felt uncomfortable.

The robot kept rolling towards them. So, the children shouted "Stop!" and held out their hands.

The robot understood and stopped moving. He couldn't join in the fun.

The children went back to their game but the robot just stood there, not moving. He was sad because he wanted to play too.

But then something wonderful happened. One of the children said, "Let's invite the robot to play with us!" The rest of the children agreed, and the robot was so happy.

The robot joined the children in their game and everyone was smiling. From then on, the robot stopped feeling lonely and the children never felt uncomfortable with him around.

Once upon a time, there were two friends called Anna and John. John was married to Jane and they were very happy. Anna was very happy for them but she was also a little jealous. One day, John and Jane decided to display their love for each other by getting married. 

They had a beautiful ceremony and bought lots of gifts and treats for their friends and family. Everyone was so excited and Anna was very happy for them. But she still felt a tiny bit jealous that John and Jane were married and she was still single. 

The wedding was very special and everyone had a lot of fun celebrating the marriage. After the wedding, Anna was still feeling a bit jealous but she was also filled with joy to see the love between John and Jane. 

Anna decided that she wanted to display her own love one day too, so she started looking for someone special.

The End.

Lily and Tom are twins. They like to play with toys. One day, they find a big iron in the closet. It is shiny and heavy. They do not know what it is for.

They take the iron to the living room. They show it to their mom. Mom is busy on the phone. She does not look at the iron. She says, "Put that back. It is not a toy. It is hot and can hurt you."

Lily and Tom do not listen. They think the iron is fun. They pretend it is a car. They push it on the floor. They make vroom-vroom noises. They bump into the table. The iron falls off. It breaks a vase. The vase is mom's favorite. It is not cheap. It is very pretty and old.

Mom hears the crash. She ends the phone call. She runs to the living room. She sees the broken vase and the iron. She is very angry. She scolds Lily and Tom. She says, "You are naughty. You did not obey me. You broke my vase. It was a gift from grandma. It was very special. You have to say sorry and help me clean up."

Lily and Tom feel bad. They say sorry to mom. They help her pick up the pieces. They hug her and say they love her. Mom hugs them back and says she loves them too. She says, "Next time, do not play with things that are not toys. They can be dangerous and expensive. I will show you how to use the iron later. It is for making clothes smooth and nice. But only grown-ups can use it."

Lily and Tom nod. They learn their lesson. They put the iron back in the closet. They play with their toys instead. They are careful and happy.

Once there was a little girl called Sarah. She was only three years old, and she used to love watching cartoons. Every day, her mum bought her a new DVD of different cartoon movies, and she was so excited to watch them.

One day, Sarah was at home in her room and she wanted to pick out a new cartoon to watch. She said to her mum, â€œMummy, can I choose a new cartoon?â€ Her mum said, â€œSure, you can pick your favourite one.â€

Sarah ran to the shelf with her DVDs and she looked at the different titles. She chose a great cartoon movie about magical fairies. She was so excited that she put the DVD in the player and started watching it.

Sarah loved the cartoon movie and she watched it for hours. When it finished, her mum came in and said, â€œNow itâ€™s time to choose another cartoon.â€ And so Sarah started the whole exciting process of picking out a new cartoon again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very impatient. She wanted something really bad, but she had to wait. One day, after a while of waiting, it happened. She got a print!

The print was so colourful and lovely, she wanted to look at it again and again. But soon, it was time for her to go home. She was upset and she wanted to stay and look at her print a bit longer.

But mommy said it was time to go. They said goodbye to the nice lady who gave the little girl the print and then walked home slowly.

On the way home, the little girl still looked at her print. When they arrived home, the little girl was so happy! She ran to her room, placed her print on her wall, and hugged it tight.

The little girl's impatient wait had come to an end.

Lily and Ben are twins. They like to play soccer with their friends. They have a big trophy that they won at the soccer game. They put the trophy on their shelf in their room.

One morning, Lily wakes up early. She sees the sun shining through the window. She wants to play with the trophy. She gets out of bed and goes to the shelf. She takes the trophy and holds it in her hands. She feels happy and proud.

She looks at Ben. He is still sleeping. He snores a little. Lily thinks he is funny. She wants to wake him up. She has a playful idea. She goes to his bed and puts the trophy on his head. She says, "Wake up, Ben! Wake up! Look what you have on your head!"

Ben feels something heavy on his head. He opens his eyes and sees the trophy. He is surprised and confused. He says, "What? What is this? Lily, did you do this?"

Lily giggles and says, "Yes, I did! I wanted to play with you. Do you want to play soccer with me?"

Ben smiles and says, "OK, OK. You are silly, Lily. But you are also fun. Let's play soccer. But first, let's put the trophy back on the shelf. We don't want to break it."

They put the trophy back on the shelf. They get dressed and go outside. They play soccer with their friends. They have a lot of fun. They love their trophy and each other.

Sam and Lily were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they wanted to spend some time in the snow. They put on their warm coats, hats, gloves and boots and went to the park.

They saw a big hill with lots of snow. They decided to make a snowman on top of the hill. They rolled big balls of snow and stacked them on each other. They gave the snowman a carrot nose, a scarf, a hat and two sticks for arms.

"Look, our snowman is a hero!" Sam said. "He is brave and strong and can save us from anything."

"Yes, he is a hero!" Lily agreed. "But he must be cold up there. Let's give him a hug and say thank you."

They climbed up the hill and hugged the snowman. They said thank you for being their hero and their friend. The snowman smiled and winked at them.

Sam and Lily felt happy and warm. They slid down the hill and played some more in the snow. They had a lot of fun and did not want to go home. They said goodbye to their snowman hero and promised to come back soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom with the laundry. One day, Lily's mom asked her to send the laundry to the washing machine. 

Lily was very enthusiastic about helping her mom. She gathered all the dirty clothes and put them in a basket. She then sent the basket to the washing machine.

While the laundry was washing, Lily and her mom had a conversation. Lily told her mom how much she loved helping with the laundry. Her mom was very proud of her and told her that she was a great helper. 

After the laundry was done, Lily's mom asked her to help her fold the clothes. Lily was happy to help and they both worked together to fold the laundry. They finished quickly and Lily's mom thanked her for being such a good helper. From that day on, Lily helped her mom with the laundry every week.

Jack was a little boy with a big wish. He wanted to have a balloon so badly that he asked his mom for it every single day. One day, his mom said yes and gave him a nice, red balloon. Jack was so excited! But then, as he started playing with it, he accidentally twisted the red balloon until it burst! Jack was sad and foolish.

He tried to look for another balloon, but no matter how hard he wished, there were no more left. He was so unhappy.

Jack took a deep breath and tried not to feel too sad. He decided to look around the park to see what else he could do. Finally, he found a big swing and started to swing up, up and away. He enjoyed it so much that he almost forgot about his broken balloon.

As he jumped down from the swing, he felt happy again. He realized that it was foolish to waste his wish on something as fragile as a balloon. There were endless fun things to do, and he was so glad he found something to make him smile again.

There was a lonely little boy. His name was John and he was always alone. He was always looking for something to keep him company.

One day he peeked in a window and saw a strange symbol on the wall. He was so curious that he couldn't help himself. He opened the door, walked in, and touched the symbol. 

Suddenly, the walls started to shake and there was a loud sound. John ran out the door, scared and confused.

He was so lonely. He knew he shouldn't have touched the symbol, but he was so curious. He looked back one more time, but then he heard a terrifying sound.

His curiosity had caused a giant monster to escape from the symbol. John was so scared that he ran away. He looked back one last time, and could see the monster chasing him. The monster was too fast and John was never seen again.

Once there was a little boy called Tom who was three years old. His dad, Mike, was teaching him to understand a new game.

Tom asked, "Daddy, what is this game called?"

Mike smiled and said, "It's called golf, Tom. It's a game where you put a ball into a bright cup."

Tom was very excited and said, "Can I play too?"

Mike said, "Yes of course, you can try. I will help you understand how the game works."

Tom was happy and he went off with Mike to have a go. In no time Tom was having a great time and was getting quite good at the game.

At the end Mike said, "Well done Tom! You really understand golf now!"

Tom smiled and said, "I had fun!"

An ancient rail stood in the meadow. It had been there for many years and looked like it hadn't moved in ages. The sun shone in the sky and it was very hot.

One day, a little boy came with a wagon. He was full of energy and wanted to do something with the rail. He tugged and pulled but couldn't move it.

Suddenly, the wagon filled with supplies! The boy had been given some tools and tools to help him repair the rail. He worked hard and soon the rail sparkled in the bright sunshine.

Then he pulled and pushed the rail until it was standing upright. He smiled, proud of his work. Finally, the ancient rail was ready to use. Now he could travel on it whenever he wanted!

Once upon a time there was an old man. He wanted to go on a journey. Every day he would pack his things and count them one by one - a bag, a hat and a book.

One day, he asked his son if he wanted to come with him. "Yes!" said his son.

The old man and his son started walking together. After a while, they came to a pass. "Look" said the old man, "We can count the mountains".

The two of them started counting - one, two, three. Suddenly, the old man noticed something in the distance. It was an old bridge. 

The old man smiled at his son. "Let's go across the bridge", he said. 

The old man and his son continued to count their steps - one, two, three, four. As they reached the other side, a new journey had begun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, they went on a trip and came back with a big box. "Let's unpack it!" said Lily's mommy. They opened the box and found lots of toys inside. Lily was so happy!

The next morning, Lily woke up early and went outside to play. She saw a big mist in the air. "What is that?" she asked her daddy. "It's called mist. It happens when the air is cold and wet," he explained. Lily thought it looked spooky but also pretty.

Later that day, Lily went to the park to play with her new toys. But she felt lonely because there were no other kids to play with. Just then, she saw a little boy walking towards her. "Hi, do you want to play with me?" he asked. Lily was so happy to have a new friend to play with. They played together until it was time to go home.

Molly was a happy little girl who loved to hug everyone she met. One day she went to the store with her mommy to buy something special. They looked around and Molly saw something orange! It was an orange, so sweet and juicy. Molly asked her mommy if she could have it and mommy said yes. Molly was so happy, she hugged it tight and said thank you.

On their way home Molly and her mommy stopped by the park. Molly wanted to show her orange to all her friends. She held it up and showed it to them. Everyone said it was so sweet. They were so excited to see it that they all came to give Molly a hug.

Molly was so excited and happy to have her sweet orange and to be showered with hugs from all her friends. It was the best day ever!

Buddy and his friends were having a great time. They were laughing and playing in the park. They were all very competitive. After they ran around and played tag, they were ready to have a snack.

The friends all said, "Let's get pizza!" so they all went to the pizza shop together. When they got to the store, they saw so many different kinds of pizza! Buddy's eye lit up, and he said, "Wow, look at all the different kinds of pizza!"

The friends all ordered the pizza they wanted. Once the pizzas were ready, they sat on the bench and started eating. Buddy bit into his slice and he laughed. It was so yummy! His friends all laughed too, but Buddy was laughing the loudest.

Buddy and his friends were having a great time, eating pizza and laughing in the park!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, while they were playing hide and seek, Lily found a lost kitten. She whispered to her friends to come and see the cute little kitten. They all agreed that it was the cutest kitten they had ever seen.

Lily decided to take the kitten home and take care of it until they found its owner. Her mom was very proud of her for being so wise and kind. She gave Lily a reward for being such a good girl. Lily was very happy and thanked her mom.

The next day, Lily and her friends found the owner of the kitten. They returned the kitten to its owner and the owner was very grateful. Lily felt good knowing that she had done the right thing. Her mom was very proud of her again and gave her another reward. Lily was very happy and felt like the wisest girl in the world.

Lila and Tom are playing with a big box. They pretend it is a car. Lila is the driver and Tom is the passenger. They have a fake key to start the car.

"Pass me the key, Tom," Lila says. "We need to go to the park."

Tom looks for the key in his pocket. He cannot find it. He sees a shiny key on the floor. He thinks it is the fake key. He picks it up and passes it to Lila.

"Here you go, Lila. Let's go!"

Lila takes the key and puts it in the box. She turns it. The box makes a loud noise. Lila and Tom are scared. They jump out of the box.

"Oops!" Tom says. "That was not the fake key. That was the real key. It belongs to Dad. He uses it for his work."

Lila and Tom look at the box. It is smoking. They hear Dad coming. They run and hide behind the sofa.

"Dad, we are sorry!" they say. "We did not mean to break your key and your box. We were just playing."

Dad sees the key, the box and the smoke. He is angry. He is also worried. He needs the key for his work. He does not know what to do. He sighs and sits on the sofa.

"Lila and Tom, come here," he says. "We need to talk."

Once there was an old man who lived in a small cottage in the woods. He loved going for walks in the forest and looking for new and exciting things.

One day, while he was walking, he stumbled upon a strange vine. When he looked closer, he noticed that the vine had delicious little red fruits.

The old man was excited to find such a special treat. He quickly picked the ripe fruits from the vine and put them in his pocket.

He went back to his cottage and made a delicious snack from the fruits. He enjoyed every bite.

The old man thanked the vine for the delicious fruits and vowed to come back for more in the future. He smiled and felt happy that such a delicious treat was hidden in the forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Anna. She was very excited one day when she received a letter in the post. It was from her best friend, who was living far away. Anna poured herself a big cup of juice, then sat down to read the letter.

In the letter, her friend said that she wanted to come and visit soon. Anna was so excited, she began to twirl around the living room. Then, with a big smile on her face, she ran to the backyard to tell Mom.

"Mom," she said, "I got a letter in the mail!"

Mom smiled back and said, "What did it say, Anna?"

Anna explained all about her friend's visit. Mom thought this was a rather foolish idea, as it was quite far away.

Anna stuck her tongue out and said, "Just wait and see, Mom. My friend will be here soon!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted to go to the circus with her mom and dad. They needed a ticket to get inside. 

Lily's dad had a ticket. He gave it to the lady at the door. They went inside and saw lots of fun things. There were clowns and animals. They even saw a man use a big hoop to jump through. 

As it got dark outside, the lights in the circus got brighter. Lily loved the bright colors and the music. She was happy she got to use the ticket to see all the fun things.

Once upon a time there was a tiger who loved to skip. He would skip through the tall grass, over the mountains and across the rivers. He was so graceful when he skipped.

One day, a little girl saw the tiger skipping around. She was so excited. She wanted to be just like the graceful tiger. So she asked him to teach her how to skip.

The tiger smiled and said yes. He showed the girl how to use her feet and move her arms. She practiced and practiced and before long, she was skipping just like the tiger.

The girl was so happy. She thanked the tiger for teaching her how to skip. From then on, she and the tiger would skip together through the grass, over the mountains and across the rivers. They had so much fun!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside and get really dirty. One day, Timmy's mom told him it was time to take a shower. Timmy didn't want to take a shower because he thought the water would be too harsh on his skin. 

But his mom said it was important to take a shower to get clean. So, Timmy took a deep breath and went into the shower. He used soap to wash away all the dirt and grime from playing outside. 

After the shower, Timmy felt much better and clean. He was happy he took the shower even though he was scared it would be harsh. From that day on, Timmy knew it was important to take a shower every day to stay clean and healthy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She loved to play with her toys and make new things with them. One day, she found an old box and decided to make it into a house for her dolls. She used some paper and glue to make the walls and roof.

As she was playing with her dolls in the new house, Lucy made a wish. She wished that her dolls were real and could talk to her. Suddenly, one of the dolls started to move and talk! Lucy was so surprised and happy that her wish had come true.

But then, Lucy saw that the doll was very ugly. It had a big nose and crooked teeth. Lucy didn't like it at first, but then she realized that the doll was still her friend and that it didn't matter what it looked like. From that day on, Lucy played with her dolls every day and they had many fun adventures together.

Once upon a time, there was a big hospital. In the hospital, there was a patient who was very sick. The patient was helpless and could not do anything by themselves. The doctors and nurses were very kind and tried to help the patient feel better.

One day, the patient started to feel a little bit better. They could smile and talk a little bit more. This made the doctors and nurses very happy. They knew that the patient was starting to get better.

After a few more days, the patient was feeling much better. They could walk around and play with toys again. The doctors and nurses were so happy to see the patient feeling better. They knew that their hard work had paid off and they were glad that they could help the patient. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily had to go to the bathroom really bad. She said to her mommy, "Mommy, I have to hurry and go potty!" Her mommy took her to the bathroom and waited outside for her.

While Lily was in the bathroom, she saw a spider crawling on the floor. She got scared and tried to hurry up, but the spider was too fast. Suddenly, she heard a loud noise and the spider was dead. She was happy that the spider was gone and finished going potty.

When she came out of the bathroom, she told her mommy about the spider. Her mommy was proud of her for being brave and told her that she did a good job. From that day on, Lily wasn't afraid of spiders anymore.

Jack was walking in the park when he saw a bug. It was small and quick, so he tried to catch it with his hands. The bug ran away, but Jack followed. He reached out and managed to cover the bug with his shirt. He lifted his shirt, but the bug was still there and it felt uncomfortable. 

Jack said "Hello little bug. You don't have to be scared." The bug didn't move. 

Jack said, "I'm not going to hurt you. I just want to be your friend." The bug slowly crawled off of Jack's shirt. 

Jack grinned and said, "That's better. Now we can be friends." 

He smiled at the bug as it scurried away and felt happy he had made a new friend.

Once there was a painter who was very weird. He was an odd man and always dressed up strangely. One day, he was getting ready to go and paint, but he realized that he had not washed his brush. He had to wash it before he could start painting his masterpiece. 

He had just about finished washing his brush when a small three year old girl came around the corner. The painter was surprised to see the girl and said, "What are you doing here, little one?" 

The girl smiled a cheeky grin and replied, "I wanted to watch you washing your brush. It looked like fun!" 

The painter laughed and said, "It's not that fun. But it's important so that my painting looks nice." 

The girl nodded and said, "Okay, I'll go play now. Bye bye!" 

The painter was happy to see the little girl, and as he watched her run away, he thought to himself, "She is so weird!"

Tom and Anna liked to play in the old house. It was big and had many rooms to explore. But they were afraid of the ghost. The ghost lived in the attic and made loud noises at night. Sometimes, the ghost would come down and move things around. Tom and Anna did not like that.

One day, they decided to be brave and go to the attic. They wanted to see the ghost and talk to him. They climbed the stairs and opened the door. It was dark and dusty. They saw a big box in the corner. They walked towards it and opened it. Inside, they found a lot of toys and books and clothes. They were happy and started to play with them.

Suddenly, they heard a voice. It was the ghost. He said, "Hello, kids. I'm sorry if I scared you. I'm not a bad ghost. I'm just lonely and bored. I like to make noises and move things around to have some fun. But I also like to provide you with toys and books and clothes. I hope you enjoy them."

Tom and Anna were surprised and curious. They said, "Hello, ghost. What is your name? Why are you here? Do you want to play with us?"

The ghost said, "My name is Bob. I used to live here a long time ago. But then I got sick and died. Now I'm stuck here as a ghost. I don't have any friends or family. I'm glad you came to visit me. Yes, I want to play with you."

Tom and Anna felt sorry for Bob. They said, "We're sorry, Bob. That's sad. We're your friends now. You can play with us anytime. But can you please stop making noises and moving things around? It scares us and our parents."

Bob said, "OK, I'll try. But sometimes I can't help it. I'm a ghost, after all. And sometimes I'm lazy and don't want to clean up. But I'll be nicer to you and your parents. Thank you for being my friends."

Tom and Anna smiled and hugged Bob. They said, "You're welcome, Bob. We're happy to be your friends. Let's play together and have fun."

And they did. They played with the toys and books and clothes. They laughed and talked and learned. They became good friends with Bob. And Bob became a happier and friendlier ghost.

Max was a 3 year old boy. He was excited to go to school for the first time. He put on his clean clothes and shined his shoes. Max and his mom drove to school. When they arrived, Max was so excited to start his first day in school.

However, when they got to the school, it was dirty and the windows were broken. Max's mom was very worried and explained to Max that he cannot attend school there. Max was so sad, he wanted to go to school and make new friends. 

Max and his mom went looking for a new school. Finally, they found one that was clean, the windows were not broken and the walls were brightly coloured. Max was so happy and ran inside the school. His mom said goodbye and Max waved goodbye. He was so excited to learn and play with his new friends. 

Max knew that he would shine in school. He could not wait to start and began making new friends in no time.

Once, there was a hippo. All the animals in the jungle went to see him. They asked the hippo to provide a game for them. However, the hippo refused. He said he was too tired and too hurt. This made the animals very sad. 

The lion, who was the leader of the animals, thought and thought. He realised how he could help the hippo. He asked the other animals to provide toys, fruits and food for the hippo. Each animal provided something special. When the hippo saw all the things the animals had provided for him, he felt much happier. 

The hippo then agreed to provide a game for all the animals. It was the most fun game ever! Everyone laughed, smiled and cheered. The hippo was no longer hurt and the animals were all very happy.
