As the log rolled down the river, Ducky and his friends followed it in a row. The water was calm and the sun was shining. Ducky felt happy and excited. Suddenly, the log hit a rock and stopped rolling. Ducky and his friends swam over to see what happened. They saw that the log had a big hole in it. They decided to take a break and rest on the log. They sat there in the calm water, feeling happy and calm too.

Once upon a time there was a turkey who was very sad. The turkey didn't have a family or a nice home to live in. He was all alone.

One day, a kind old man saw him and said, "I can fix that!" He took the turkey to his house and made him a big, warm bed. He showed the turkey his big garden and promised to give him lots of yummy food.

The old man wanted to make the turkey's life even better. He made the turkey some brand new, original clothes so he would be comfy and look nice. 

The old man was very happy because he had fixed the turkey's life and the turkey was thankful. The turkey lived happily ever after with the old man in his nice home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her garden, where she had a beautiful rose bush. Lily was always careful not to step on the flowers or pick them too roughly.

One day, Lily's friend Tommy came to play. He didn't know about the rose bush and accidentally stepped on one of the flowers. Lily was upset and told Tommy that he had to be careful. 

Later, while they were playing, Tommy accidentally knocked over a vase and broke it. Lily's mom saw what happened and told Tommy that he would be punished for being careless. Tommy felt bad and apologized to Lily.

The next day, Tommy brought Lily a new rose to replace the one he had stepped on. Lily forgave him and they continued to play together, being careful not to break anything else.

Once upon a time there was a bossy store. It was owned by a big bossy boss. Every day, the boss would come to the store and tell everyone what to do.

One day, the store was feeling very upset. Everything was happening backwards! Things that were supposed to be near the front were suddenly near the back. Things meant for sale were hidden away, and everyone was very confused.

Then, the bossy boss came over and said "I'm the boss and I know what to do!" He waved his hand and suddenly everything reversed. The store was back to normal in an instant and everyone was happy again.

The bossy boss smiled and said "Now, back to work!" And everyone in the store got to work, doing the things they were supposed to do. They were very glad that the boss was so bossy!

Once upon a time there was a cow and she was so proud. She loved to sing and the other animals loved to listen. One day a little mouse came up to the cow and asked, "Why do you sing so loud and happy?"

The cow smiled and said, "I sing because I'm proud that I can do it. I'm proud to show the world all the beauty of my singing. What about you?"

The mouse smiled and said, "I love to dance!"

The cow laughed and said, "Then dance! Show the world how proud you are!"

So the mouse danced and the cow sang, and together they showed the world how proud they were of their talents.

Once upon a time, there was a small dog. He was all alone, so he decided to go on a search. He walked and he hopped, but he didn't find anything. Then, he came to a big, empty room.

Suddenly, a big, friendly cat popped out from behind a box! The cat said, "Hello! My name is Kitty. Would you like to be my friend?" The dog was so happy. He said, "Yes!" and he introduced himself.

Kitty and the dog became the best of friends. They played games, and sang songs and chased each other around the empty room! The room was now full of happiness and laughter! They were so glad they found each other. The end.

Once there was a jolly farmer. He wanted to measure his cows and chickens. The farmer went to the shop and bought a tool. He went home with the tool and was very excited.

The farmer needed to measure his cows and chickens one by one. He counted all of them, and wrote down the number. Then he measured each one with the tool.

The farmer was happy with all of the measurements. He knew how big each cow and chicken was. Then the farmer gave all of his cows and chickens a jolly treat. They were all so happy.

The farmer was proud of his measurement tool. He kept it in his pocket and used it whenever he needed to measure something. He was never without it.

Once there were two bears, one big and one small. The big one was named Max and the small one was named Molly. They both loved going for walks in nature. Max especially liked taking Molly to show her the sights. And Molly always jumped up and down excitedly when they were out. 

One day, Max and Molly were walking through the woods when Molly suddenly stopped. Molly asked Max, â€œWhatâ€™s that?â€ Max looked up and smiled. â€œThatâ€™s a rainbow.â€ Mollyâ€™s eyes lit up like a lamp, she couldnâ€™t believe how beautiful it was. 

Max recognized the look in Mollyâ€™s eyes, she was envious of the rainbow. He chuckled and said â€œLetâ€™s make our own rainbow!â€ Max proceeded to collect all the colors of the rainbow from nature and they made their very own rainbow. Molly smiled and said â€œItâ€™s almost just as beautiful as the one in the sky.â€

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was wearing a colorful dress and her name was Lucy. She was out in the park playing with her friends, and they were all having lots of fun.

One day, they were all running around when suddenly Lucy stopped and said, "I need new clothes." All her friends asked her why, but she just shook her head.

A few days later, there was a big parade in the park, and everyone was wearing the most beautiful and colorful of clothes. Lucy saw all the amazing clothes, and wanted them too. So, she asked her mom if she could buy her some new clothes.

Her mom said, "No, Lucy. You already have plenty of clothes. We don't need any more." Lucy was so sad, but then her mom said, "Maybe next year we will buy you more clothes. Just remember, sharing is more important than having more stuff."

Lucy smiled and said, "OK". She knew that her mom was right, and that was the best lesson she could ever learn. From then on, she made sure to be a good friend and always help out by sharing her own things with her friends. In the end, she learned that one of the most important things in life is kindness and friendship.

Billy was very excited. His mom and dad had bought him some new paints. He had a brush, some paint pots and a big piece of paper. He wanted to make something special. 

Billy started to paint and he started to make some spots. They were bright and attractive and he wanted to add a few more. He dipped his brush into the pot and created some more spots of colour. 

He was having lots of fun. The spots were getting bigger and bigger. Some were red, some were blue and some were yellow. He was so proud of all the colours he had made. Billy was very happy with what he had painted. He thought it was very attractive. 

As the sun set in the sky, Billy's painting was finished. He smiled and said to his mom and dad, "Look at my painting, I'm so happy I painted a spot!"

Once upon a time, there was a wide open field. A young dancer came to the field every day to practice her moves. One day, when she was twirling and leaping, a big frown appeared on her face. She stopped dancing, sad and alone.

Suddenly, a 3 year old child came to the field. He shouted, "What is wrong? Why are you frowning?" The little dancer sighed and told the child, "I don't know how to do this dance right! I keep getting it wrong." 

The child smiled and said, "That's okay. Can I show you how to do it?" She smiled and nodded. The little dancer started to learn the dance with the help of the 3 year old.

Soon, the dance got easier and easier for the dancer. She was twirling, leaping and spinning with ease. Finally, she looked at the little child and said, "Thank you! You have helped me a lot."

The 3 year old smiled and said, "It was fun. Let's dance together the next time!"

Once upon a time, there was a little anchor who was very excited. He wanted to explore the world and see what amazing things were out there. So, he tucked away all of his things and decided to set sail.

He waved goodbye to his home and, before he knew it, the anchor was at sea. He floated around in the middle of the ocean and chewed on big, juicy pieces of seaweed.

Suddenly, he heard a distant voice coming from another boat. "Ahoy! Who's there?"

The anchor was very surprised but managed to shout back. "It's me! I'm a little anchor, out at sea."

The voice replied. "Well, anchor friend, would you like to join us? We're having a great adventure and we'd love to have you join us!"

The anchor couldn't believe his luck! He was so excited that he began to spin around in the water. He waved goodbye to the boat and followed them around the world, discovering all kinds of new and exciting things!

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny was very anxious because he wanted to decorate his burrow for Easter. He asked his friends for help, but they were too busy playing. 

Benny decided to decorate by himself. He found some pretty flowers and colorful eggs to put around his burrow. He was very happy with how it turned out.

But then, Benny heard a loud noise. It was a big scary dog! Benny was so scared, he tried to escape. He ran as fast as he could back to his burrow. 

Luckily, the dog didn't follow him. Benny felt safe in his decorated burrow and was happy his hard work paid off.

Jane was wearing a pretty dress. She took a piece of dull chalk and drew a big circle on the sidewalk. Inside the circle she drew lots of different shapes, circles and stars. It was so colourful and fun!

Then the wind started to blow. Jane's dress was blowing in the wind and the chalk started to smudge. The beautiful shapes were becoming sad and dull.

Jane tried her best to save her artwork. She put her hands up to the wind and tried to hold on to the chalk. She put on all her strength, but it was too late. The wind had won and the chalk was gone.

Jane was sad, but she decided to go and play with her friends. She put on her shoes, grabbed her favourite toy and went out to the playground. Soon, she was happy and smiling again.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved trains, and his favorite thing to do was watch them go by. He would stand by the tracks and wave at the conductor as the train chugged along.

One day, Timmy's mom took him to see a very special train. It was big and shiny, and it had lots of steam coming out of it. Timmy was so surprised when he saw it! He had never seen a train like this before.

As they watched the train go by, Timmy's mom told him that his grandpa used to work on trains just like this one. Timmy felt so proud to know that his grandpa was a train worker. From that day on, every time Timmy saw a train, he thought of his grandpa and felt proud to be his grandson.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She was so happy to go and visit the brilliant field. She went outside and stepped out into the marvelous field. The sun was so bright and the grass so green.

There were butterflies and birds flying around the field. Lucy was so excited that she began to twirl and dance in the sunshine. She stepped quickly and jumped over rocks, trying to catch the butterflies. She laughed and smiled with joy.

Then she stepped up onto a hill and looked around the field. It was so beautiful that she wanted to stay forever. She closed her eyes and felt the warm sun on her face. Lucy was happy to have found such a special place. 

Suddenly, a voice called out and she realized it was time to go home. With a little sadness, Lucy stepped away and made her way back. But, she knew she would always remember the wonderful time she had in the brilliant field.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved wearing her favorite jacket, but she couldn't zip it up by herself. One day, Lily's mom was busy doing some work, so she asked her dad for help with the zip. 

Dad came over and helped Lily zip up her jacket. He did it slowly, so Lily wouldn't get hurt. Lily was happy and warm in her jacket. She hugged her dad and thanked him for his help. 

From that day on, Lily tried to zip up her jacket by herself. It was hard at first, but with practice, she got better and better. Now, Lily is a big girl who can zip up her jacket all by herself!

Once upon a time, there was a loyal dog who loved to play with the children who lived in a nearby house. Every day the dog would wait eagerly by the door, hoping to be invited to join in their fun.

One day, an unexpected visitor appeared in the garden. It was a snake! The children were startled and started to cry. The loyal dog quickly sprang into action and started barking and growling at the snake. The snake, scared of the loyal dog, slivered away quickly.

The dog was very proud to have protected the children and they thanked him by giving him lots of hugs, pats and treats. The children and the loyal dog were happy to be safe and never, ever had a snake appear again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park. One day, she met a little boy named Max. Max was sad because he lost his toy car. 

Lily asked Max, "What's wrong? Why are you sad?"

Max replied, "I lost my toy car. It's gone."

Lily wanted to help Max feel better. She said, "Let's look for your toy car together. Maybe we can find it!" 

So, they searched the park and after a while, they found the toy car. Max was happy again and said, "Thank you, Lily! You set my heart free from being sad and cold." 

Lily smiled and said, "I'm glad we found it. Remember, if you ever feel sad again, you can always talk to me." 

From that day on, Max and Lily became good friends and they always looked out for each other. The moral of the story is that helping others can make you happy too.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to swing. She wore her special helmet each time she went outside to swing. One day, she was swinging with all of her might when suddenly a loud noise startled her. She looked around to try to find out what it was. 

It was a big truck that had rolled up the street. It was the loudest truck that the little girl had ever seen and it had the biggest wheels too! The little girl watched in awe as the truck slowly turned into her neighborhood. 

The truck driver got out and waved at the little girl. He was wearing a special helmet too just like hers. She waved back and smiled. 

The little girl was so excited that she ran to her swing as fast as she could. She put her helmet on and started swinging again. Every time the truck came by she tried to swing as high as she could, lifting her helmet up to the sky. 

The little girl knew that if she swung high enough, the truck driver would be sure to see her. She was so happy to have a friend like the truck driver that she would swing even higher every day.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly chicken. The chicken wanted to try new things! So it hopped out the door and started exploring.

First it tried flying, but it was too high! It tried swimming but it got too wet. It tried walking but it was slow.

Then it saw a juicy, red strawberry. It tried to eat it but it was too sour. So it hopped away to find something else.

It spotted some juicy, sweet melon. This time it tried to peck it and it was able to eat it! It was so delicious that the friendly chicken had a great time.

It hopped back home, excited that it had tried something new. From then on, it always looked for new things to try!

Mommy and Daddy were eating dinner. Mommy said, "What do you want for dinner?" Daddy looked at the menu and said, "I can't decide. It looks difficult to choose."

Then Daddy had an idea. He said, "Let's play a game. I'll count to three and on three you will forget everything you were thinking."

Mommy said, "Ok, that sounds fun!"

So Daddy started counting, "One, two, three!" As soon as he said three, Mommy forgot everything and said, "I don't know what I want!"

Daddy smiled and said, "How about the mac and cheese?" Mommy smiled too and said, "Yes, that sounds good!"

So Daddy and Mommy ordered the mac and cheese for dinner. They both enjoyed it and had a happy evening together.

Once there was a young nurse who drove in a car. She drove around the town, visiting many houses. Everywhere she went, people were happy to see her. 

The nurse was very kind and always helped the people she visited. First, she helped an old lady cross the street. She held the lady's hand and made sure she crossed safe and sound. 

Then, the nurse drove to the park. At the park, she saw a young boy playing by himself. She sat beside him and played with him for a while.

Finally, the nurse drove away. She waved goodbye to the happy people and drove off into the sunset.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Bob and Jim. They lived in a warm village. One day, it was extra warm so they decided to take a seat near the river. Bob took a seat and put something on the ground next to him. Jim thought it was a waste, and told Bob to pick it up. 

Bob just laughed and said, "I will leave it here for now, and it will be a surprise for later". So, he left it and they started playing. 

After a few hours, the sun was setting and the area started to cool down. Bob said it was time to leave, so he got up to go. He picked up the thing he put next to him. To Jim's surprise, it was a blanket! He put it around his shoulders and said, "It's so warm". 

The moral of this story is that even when things seem like a waste, it can be useful later!

Lily and Tom were playing with their dolls in the garden. They had a tea party with cups and plates and cookies. Lily was very careful with her doll, because it was delicate. She had a pink dress and a hat with flowers.

"Can I hold your doll, Lily?" Tom asked. He liked the hat with flowers.

"Okay, but be gentle. She is delicate," Lily said. She gave her doll to Tom.

Tom took the doll and looked at her. He tried to put the hat on his head, but it was too small. He pulled it hard and it ripped.

"Oh no! You broke my hat!" Lily cried. She took her doll back and saw the rip. She was very sad and angry.

"I'm sorry, Lily. I didn't mean to," Tom said. He felt bad for making Lily cry.

"You have to pay for my hat. It was my favorite," Lily said.

"How can I pay for it? I don't have money," Tom said.

"You can pay with your cookies. Give me all your cookies," Lily said.

"But I'm hungry. Can I keep one cookie?" Tom asked.

"No. You have to give me all your cookies. That's the deal," Lily said.

Tom sighed. He liked his cookies, but he wanted to make Lily happy. He gave her all his cookies and said sorry again.

Lily took the cookies and smiled. She was still sad about her hat, but she liked the cookies. She ate one and gave one to her doll.

"Thank you, Tom. You are a good friend," Lily said.

"You're welcome, Lily. Can we still play?" Tom asked.

"Okay. But next time, be careful with my doll. She is delicate," Lily said.

They hugged and played some more. They had fun in the garden.

Once upon a time there was a youth who loved to eat. Every day he would find something delicious to enjoy. One day he found a useful snack - it was a treat that was extra special. It tasted so good that the youth couldn't help but eat it all up.

The youth felt so full that he wondered if he could use the snack for something else. So he decided to save it for later. He put the snack in a special place where he could easily find it.

After a few days, the youth remembered it was there. He opened the box and it was still as fresh as the day he put it there. The youth then ate the snack and found it even more delicious than before! It had been a very useful snack indeed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who was only 3 years old. She was playing in a huge park with lots of other kids, when she saw a big path up ahead. The path was huge and meandered through the park and across the grassy fields.

The little girl wanted to follow the path, so she started walking along it. As she followed the path, she saw a big crack in the ground. The crack was so big that it made the path impossible to cross.

The little girl became very angry and sad. She asked her mom, "Mom, can you help me fix the crack in the path?"

Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, of course I can help. I'll get your dad and he can help us fix it."

Mom and Dad brought shovels from home and started digging around the edges of the crack. After a lot of work, the crack was filled and the path was fixed.

The little girl was so happy and excited! She smiled and ran back to her friends to tell them that the path was fixed. They all rejoiced and ran along the huge path together.

The End.

Once upon a time there was a small boy. His name was Tom. Tom was very polite. One day he wanted to have a nap. He went outside and saw a beautiful leaf. He thought it looked so cozy that he decided to lay down and have his nap there. He closed his eyes and started to dream. He dreamt of the leaf and how polite it was.

When he woke up, he picked up the leaf and lightly blew it away. The leaf flew away far into the sky. He watched it with a smile on his face. He was so happy he had been able to nap with the nice leaf. He thanked it before heading home with a happy skip in his step.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and twirl around in her pretty dress. One day, her mommy asked her to clean up her toys. Lily didn't like to clean up, but she wanted to impress her mommy.

So Lily decided to organize her toys by putting them in different boxes. She put all her dolls in one box, her blocks in another, and her stuffed animals in a third. When her mommy saw how clean and organized her room was, she was very impressed.

"Wow, Lily! Your room looks amazing! You did such a great job organizing your toys!" her mommy said.

Lily smiled and felt proud of herself. "Can we dance now, mommy?" she asked.

"Of course, sweetie! Let's put on some music and dance together!" her mommy replied.

And so, Lily and her mommy danced and twirled around in the clean and organized room. It was a happy and fun day for both of them.

Once upon a time, there was a popular sight. It was a big bouncy ball. The ball loved to bounce around and everyone loved to watch it go.

One day the ball went bouncing over to a girl. Her eyes were wide with excitement. She grabbed the ball and started bouncing it around. She bounced the ball high into the sky.

As she bounced it, she shouted out with joy. Her friends all came running to see her fun. They all started bouncing the big ball together. Bouncing, bouncing, up and down, they had so much fun.

The ball brought them all together and they were all happy. Together they shared a big hug and they all said goodbye. From then on they were forever friends and the bouncy ball was always a popular sight!

Once upon a time there was a girl named Anne. She lived near a big lake. One day, Anne went out to the lake in her special kayak. 

Anne floated around on the lake in her kayak and saw lots of weird things. She saw fish jumping out of the water and a snail crawling up a lily pad. 

Suddenly, Anne heard loud music coming from the middle of the lake. She paddled over to see what was happening and saw two fish getting married! The fish were wearing funny hats and singing happy songs.

Anne cheered for the happy couple and waved her arms in the air. It was the weirdest thing she had ever seen! The fish waved goodbye and Anne paddled back home in her kayak. 

The end.

Lila and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to pretend they were explorers. They saw a big hill with rocks and dirt. They wanted to climb it.

"Let's go to the top of the hill," Lila said. "Maybe we can see the whole park from there."

"OK, but be careful," Tom said. "The hill might be dangerous. It might be a volcano."

Lila and Tom started to climb the hill. They used their hands and feet to hold on to the rocks and dirt. They were almost at the top when they heard a loud noise.

"Boom!" The hill shook and smoke came out of it. Lila and Tom saw red and orange fire and lava. The hill was a volcano. It was glowing and spitting.

"Run!" Tom shouted. "The volcano is angry. It will hurt us."

Lila and Tom ran down the hill as fast as they could. They were scared and hot. They reached the bottom of the hill and ran to their mom and dad. They hugged them and told them what happened.

"Wow, you are very brave," Mom said. "But you should not play near volcanoes. They are very dangerous."

"We know, Mom," Lila said. "We are sorry. We will not do it again."

"Good," Dad said. "Now let's go home and have some ice cream. You need to cool down."

Lila and Tom smiled and nodded. They were happy to be safe and to have ice cream. They learned a lesson. They would not play near volcanoes anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big problem with her puzzle. She couldn't solve it! She tried and tried, but the pieces just wouldn't fit together. 

One day, Lily's mom came in with a surprise. She had printed out a picture of the finished puzzle! Lily was so happy and excited. She could finally see what the puzzle was supposed to look like. 

But there was a noisy distraction. The dog next door was barking loudly. Lily couldn't concentrate on the puzzle with all that noise. So, she went outside and asked the dog to be quiet. The dog listened and stopped barking. Now, Lily could finally solve her puzzle with no distractions.

Once upon a time, a big race was going to happen in the forest. Many animals were going to run. The race would include all the animals. The winner would get a big prize and feel the victory. 

One small rabbit was very intelligent. He liked to think and solve problems. He wanted to win the race. But he was not the fastest animal. He thought, "How can I win the race?"

The day of the race came. All the animals started to run. The rabbit had a plan. He saw a big tree that had fallen down. All the animals had to go around it. The rabbit thought, "I can jump over the tree and save time." So, he jumped over the tree and won the race. 

All the animals were happy for the rabbit. They learned that being intelligent can help you win. The moral of the story is that using your brain can lead to victory, even when you are not the strongest or the fastest.

The sun was bright and the sky was blue. One day, a pipe was in the field. It was long and green.

Every day, it started to increase. It got bigger and bigger until it was so tall it almost touched the sky. It was amazing!

But the people in the town nearby were ignorant of the pipe. They didn't know what it was or why it was growing so much. They looked around, confused.

Then one day, a small child began playing around the pipe. The child looked inside the pipe and he saw a whole new world! He had so much fun exploring that he shared the good news with everyone in the town.

The people in the town were so excited to find out the truth. They soon realised how the pipe had increased in size and how wonderful it was. From that day, the pipe became a beloved member of the town!

Once upon a time there was a bone. The bone was all alone in an empty room. The bone needed help to finish its task.

Just then, a three year old came into the room. The three year old had a smile on their face. They saw the bone and knew how to help.

The three year old took the bone outside and then shouted, "Run!" The bone didn't know what to do, but it ran anyway. The three year old ran after the bone, laughing and having fun.

Finally, the bone got tired and stopped running. The three year old knew it was time to finish. They picked up the bone and gave it a big hug. The bone was happy that it could finish its task and have a friend!

Once upon a time there was a big family who wanted to go on an adventure. On the weekend Mum, Dad and all their children went on a safari. They were looking for something special and exciting.

On their safari, they saw an enormous elephant. Everyone was so excited and they all wanted to touch it. They went up to the elephant and said hello. The elephant said hello back!

Soon they saw more animals. They saw lions, cheetahs, and zebras. One of the children asked Mum if they could feed the animals, so they bought some apples and carrots. All the animals were so happy to eat the food.

At the end of the safari, they all said goodbye to the animals. Soon it was time to go back home but everyone had a big smile on their face. It was an enormous adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a bunny. He wore a blue sweater and hopped around the garden happily.

One day he saw a big dog in the garden. He was scared and started to hop away. He said to himself, "I must jump away and go find my friends".

He was jumping along quickly and he repeated "I must jump away. I must jump away". Suddenly, he heard a voice. It said, "Wait, please don't jump away. I just want to be friends."

The bunny stopped and looked around. He saw a little puppy, wearing a red sweater. He wasn't scared anymore. He said, " Hi! I'm very happy to be your friend!"

The puppy smiled and said, "I'm glad too. Let's go for a jump around the garden!"

The bunny and the puppy hopped around the garden, playing and having fun all day. They were the best of friends.

Anna and Ben are restless. They do not want to nap. They want to play.

"Let's make a tunnel!" Anna says. She gets a big blanket and some chairs. She puts the blanket over the chairs. She makes a dark and cozy tunnel.

"Wow, that looks fun!" Ben says. He crawls into the tunnel with Anna. They pretend they are explorers. They see stars and planets and animals in the tunnel.

"Shh, be quiet!" Anna whispers. "There is a dragon in the tunnel. We have to sneak past it."

Ben nods. He sees the dragon. It is green and scaly and has big teeth. It is sleeping on a pile of pillows. Ben and Anna crawl very slowly and quietly. They do not want to wake the dragon.

But the dragon hears them. It opens one eye. It sees Ben and Anna. It roars and breathes fire.

"Ahh, run!" Ben and Anna scream. They crawl out of the tunnel as fast as they can. They run to their mom.

"Mom, mom, there is a dragon in the tunnel!" they say.

Mom smiles. She knows they are playing. She hugs them and says, "You are very brave, but you are also very tired. It is time for a nap."

Ben and Anna nod. They are not restless anymore. They are sleepy. They go to their bed and close their eyes. They dream of the tunnel and the dragon.

Once upon a time, there was a turkey named Tom. Tom was very dry because he didn't have any water to drink. One day, something very exciting happened. Tom found a big puddle of water! He drank and drank until he wasn't dry anymore. 

Tom was so happy that he started to dance around. He didn't know what to do with all his energy. Suddenly, he heard a noise. It was a farmer coming to take him away. Tom was scared, but then he remembered that he wasn't dry anymore. He flapped his wings and ran away as fast as he could. 

From that day on, Tom made sure to always find water to drink. He knew that if he stayed dry, he might not be able to run away again. And he lived happily ever after, running and dancing and drinking water whenever he could. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max was a loyal dog who loved to play with his owner, Lily. One day, Lily was knitting with her yarn when Max accidentally got tangled in the yarn. He started to yell for help, "Help! Help! I'm stuck!" 

Lily heard Max's yell and quickly ran to help him. She gently untangled him from the yarn and gave him a big hug. "Thank you for being such a loyal dog, Max," said Lily. 

Max barked happily and licked Lily's face. They continued to play together, with Max chasing after a ball and Lily knitting with her yarn. They were the best of friends and always looked out for each other.

Lily was very scared. She had to go to the hospital for an operation. She did not know what an operation was, but she heard it was when doctors cut you and fixed you. She did not want to be cut. She wanted to stay home with her toys and her cat.

She trembled as her mom and dad took her to the car. She cried and held her teddy bear. "Why do I have to go?" she asked. "Why can't I stay with you?"

Her mom hugged her and kissed her. "You have to go, sweetie, because you are sick. The operation will make you better. We will be with you the whole time. We love you very much."

Lily did not feel better. She felt worse. She saw the big building with the red cross. She saw the people in white clothes. She saw the beds with wheels. She saw the machines that beeped. She thought it was all crazy. She wanted to run away.

But her dad held her hand and smiled. "Don't be afraid, Lily. The doctors are very nice. They will give you a special medicine that will make you sleep. When you wake up, the operation will be over. And you will have a big band-aid and a sticker and a balloon."

Lily looked at her dad. She trusted him. He always told her the truth. She took a deep breath and nodded. "Okay, dad. I will be brave. But can I keep my teddy bear?"

"Of course, Lily. You can keep your teddy bear. He will be brave with you." Her dad said.

Lily hugged her teddy bear and followed her dad. She hoped the operation would be quick and painless. She hoped she would wake up soon and see her mom and dad and her cat. She hoped she would never have to go to the hospital again.

Once upon a time there was a girl and her name was Sarah. Sarah loved to share her toys with her friends. One day she went upstairs to her bedroom, and she saw something beautiful. It was a magical castle with a gate that opened up to reveal a pink garden. Sarah couldn't believe her eyes! She called her friends to come upstairs and see what she had found. Her friends were amazed when they saw the beautiful castle. They all decided to share in the fun and explore the magical garden. They all had such a fun time that day playing in the castle and exploring the garden.

Once upon a time, there was a big cupboard in a small house. Inside the cupboard, there were many things like plates, cups, and bowls. One day, a little girl named Lily was playing with her toys in the living room when her mom called out to her.

"Come help me in the kitchen, Lily," her mom said.

Lily got up and walked to the kitchen. Her mom asked her to get a big cup from the cupboard. Lily opened the cupboard and looked for the big cup. She found it and took it to her mom.

"Good job, Lily! Now, can you leave the cup on the counter?" her mom asked.

Lily put the cup on the counter and smiled. "I like helping you, Mommy," she said.

"I like it when you help me too, Lily," her mom replied, giving her a big hug.

A girl named Daisy was walking to the park. Suddenly, she saw an emergency truck with its siren flashing. She thought it was very attractive!

Daisy stopped and waved at the truck as it drove by. An emergency worker inside the truck saw her and waved back. 

Daisy decided to follow the truck, so she started running. She stumbled but then continued pushing forward. 

The truck stopped in the park. Daisy caught up with the truck and saw the emergency worker getting out. 

The emergency worker asked Daisy, "What do you think of this truck?"

Daisy smiled and said, "It's so attractive!" 

The emergency worker laughed. He said, "Come with me, I'll show you something very special in the truck!"

Daisy was so excited, she followed the man into the truck. 

Inside, Daisy was amazed at all the things she saw. The emergency worker explained everything to her and even let her press some buttons. Daisy was proud and happy!

One day, a woman named Jane went to the park. She saw a small, dead bug on the ground. Jane felt sad for the bug. She wanted to help it.

Jane found a big leaf and used it to wrap the bug. She held the wrapped bug in her hand and said, "Don't worry, little bug. I will take care of you."

A little girl saw Jane and asked, "What do you have there?" Jane showed her the wrapped bug and said, "I found this dead bug. I want to give it a nice place to rest." The little girl smiled and helped Jane dig a small hole in the ground. They put the wrapped bug inside and covered it with dirt. Jane and the little girl felt happy that they helped the bug. They played in the park and became good friends.

One day, a happy girl named Lily went for a jog in the park. She loved to jog and sing a song. Her song was about a brilliant sun that shined on everyone.

As she jogged, she saw a little boy who was sad. He had lost his toy. Lily wanted to help the boy. She thought of her song and the brilliant sun. She knew she could make the boy happy again.

Lily took the boy's hand and they jogged together. They sang her song about the brilliant sun. Soon, the boy started to smile. They found his toy under a tree. The boy was happy again. Lily learned that helping others can make you feel good too.

Lily was sick. She had a fever and a cough. She did not want to eat or play. She only wanted to sleep in her bed. Her mom was worried. She called the nurse to come and check on Lily.

The nurse came with a bag. She had a mask on her face and gloves on her hands. She smiled at Lily and said, "Hello, Lily. I am here to help you feel better. Can I take your temperature and listen to your chest?"

Lily nodded. She did not like the mask and the gloves, but she knew the nurse was nice. The nurse put a small thing in Lily's ear and said, "Beep. Your temperature is high. You have a fever. You need some medicine to bring it down." She gave Lily a spoon of syrup. It was sweet and sticky.

The nurse then put a big thing on Lily's chest and said, "Breathe in and out. Good. Your chest sounds a bit wheezy. You have a cough. You need some spray to clear your airways." She gave Lily a puff of spray. It was cold and minty.

The nurse said, "You are a brave girl, Lily. You took your medicine and your spray very well. Now you need to rest and drink lots of water. I will come back tomorrow to see how you are doing. Do you have any questions for me?"

Lily shook her head. She felt a little better, but still tired. She said, "Thank you, nurse. You are very kind. I hope I get well soon."

The nurse said, "You are welcome, Lily. I hope so too. I will see you tomorrow. Bye-bye." She waved and left.

Lily's mom hugged her and said, "I am so glad the nurse came. She helped you a lot. You are a good girl, Lily. I love you very much."

Lily said, "I love you too, mom. Can I have a story before I sleep?"

Lily's mom said, "Of course, my sweetie. What story do you want to hear?"

Lily said, "I want to hear the story of the monkey who climbed the tree and found a banana."

Lily's mom said, "OK, let me tell you the story of the monkey who climbed the tree and found a banana." She opened a book and began to read. Lily listened and smiled. She liked the story. She felt happy and sleepy. She closed her eyes and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a village with her mommy and daddy. The village was very calm and peaceful.

One day, Lily went to the park in the village. She saw a boy playing with a ball. She wanted to play too, so she asked him if she could play with him. The boy said yes, and they started playing together.

After a while, Lily's mommy and daddy came to the park. They saw Lily playing with the boy and they were happy. They clapped their hands and said, "Good job, Lily! You made a new friend!"

Lily was very happy that her mommy and daddy were proud of her. She smiled and clapped her hands too. She loved living in the calm and peaceful village with her family.

Once there was a little girl called Sarah. She wanted to go out and play, but her mum said she had to choose a guard first. Sarah knew that a guard was someone who looked after her and kept her safe.

Sarah saw two guards up ahead. One was tall and looked nice and friendly. The other guard was short and looked very grumpy. Sarah knew she had to choose one but she wasn't sure which one to pick.

Just then, one of the guards spoke: "My dear, why don't you choose me? The other guard is terrible and might scare you". Sarah thought about this, and decided the nice tall guard was the safer choice.

So Sarah said "Ok, I choose you!". The guard smiled and said "Very good choice! Let's go have some fun!".

Sarah was so happy and excited. She knew she had made the right choice.

Once upon a time, there was a poor family. The mom and dad were sad because they didn't have enough money to buy food.

One day, the mom got an idea. She took a piece of paper and wrote a letter. Then she put the letter in an envelope, sealed it, and took it to the mail box.

The mother sent her letter to Uncle Peter who was very wealthy. A few days later, a big box arrived for the family.

Inside the box was a big bag of food and a nice card from Uncle Peter. The mom, dad, and their three year old child were very excited!

But then something terrible happened. The house caught on fire and they had to leave.

The family was very sad and scared, but they knew they had enough food to get through the difficult time.

And that was how the poor family lived happily ever after, all thanks to the letter their mom had mailed to Uncle Peter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily was very thirsty, so she asked her mommy for a drink. Her mommy gave her a glass of water, and Lily drank it all up.

After she finished her drink, Lily wanted to play hide and seek. She told her mommy, "I want to search for you!" Her mommy said, "Okay, I will hide and you can try to find me."

Lily looked all around the house, but she couldn't find her mommy. Finally, she saw a closet door that was a little bit open. She went over to the closet and opened the door all the way. There was her mommy, hiding inside! They both laughed and hugged each other.

Once upon a time, there was a little old man. He had a long string in his hand. He wanted to share the string with some friends. So he went for a walk in the park.

On his walk, he met a butterfly. He asked the butterfly if it wanted to share the string. The butterfly said yes! So the old man carefully put the string between his two hands and open them so the butterfly could take the string from his hands.

When the butterfly flew away with the string in its hand, the old man smiled. He was happy that he had shared the string with his new friend.

After that, the old man kept walking. He met some more friends and shared more strings with them. He shared string with bees, birds and even with a caterpillar. Everyone was very happy that the old man had shared his string with them.

The end.

One day, a little lion named Leo was very hungry. He walked and walked, looking for something to eat. Then, he saw a big piece of beef on the ground. "Wow, this is great!" Leo said. He was so happy to find some food.

Leo wanted to eat the beef, but he heard a roar. It was a big bear named Ben. Ben said, "That's my beef! I found it first!" Leo was scared, but he was also very hungry. He did not want to give up the beef.

Leo thought for a moment and said, "Let's share the beef, Ben. We can both eat and be happy!" Ben thought about it and agreed. They both ate the beef and were very full. From that day on, Leo and Ben were great friends. They learned that sharing is better than fighting.

Once upon a time, two friends named John and Abigail played a competitive game of hide and seek. John wanted to hide first, so he rushed behind an old tree and closed his eyes tight. Abigail quickly counted to one hundred and looked around with soft light. Suddenly, she saw movement behind the tree. She shouted out: "I see you! You're tagged!" John groaned and stepped out, 'I can't be destroyed so easily!' Abigail giggled and replied, 'No, you're not! You have to be competitive next time!' John smiled and they laughed together as they walked off into the night.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Fin. Fin loved to swim in the big sea. One day, Fin saw a fancy shell on the sea floor. He wanted to show it to his friends. But, he could not pick up the shell. He needed help.

Fin saw a big wave coming. He asked the wave for help. "Wave, I need help to pick up this fancy shell," said Fin. The wave was kind and helped Fin. The wave pushed the fancy shell up to Fin's friends.

Fin's friends loved the fancy shell. They thanked the wave and Fin. They all learned that it is good to ask for help when you need it. And they lived happily ever after.

Once there was a 3 year old boy named Jack. Every day, Jack liked to help his Mom in the kitchen. Today, Jack wanted to bake something special for his Mom for her birthday. 

In the kitchen, Jack found some flour and sugar and other ingredients he needed. He mixed them together in a big bowl. Then, he started to stir the mixture. He stirred it round and round until it was thick and creamy. 

After he was done stirring the mixture, Jack put it in the oven. He set the oven to the right temperature and waited for it to finish baking. 

When the baking was done, Jack could smell the delicious aroma coming from his cake. He carefully took Take it out of the oven, and saw that it was a perfect fit. He let it cool down.

Once it was finally cooled down, Jack added some decorations. He put a beautiful flower on the top of the cake. He also put some icing on the top and sides of the cake. 

Finally, Jack put the cake on a comfortable chair next to his Mom's bed. He put his heel right next to the cake so she could see it when she woke up! 

Jack was very proud of his special cake. He could not wait to see his Mom's reaction when she saw the cake.

Once upon a time, there was a house made of wood. The house had a big door that could be opened and closed. Inside the house, there lived a family. There was a mommy, a daddy, and a little girl. The little girl liked to play outside in the woods. She would run and jump on the fallen leaves. One day, she found a big tree that had a hole in it. She peeked inside and saw that it was open. She decided to crawl inside the hole and found a secret room made of wood. It was a cozy little space with a small window that let the sunshine in. The little girl was so happy to have found her own secret place in the woods. She knew she would come back to play there every day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked going to school because her teacher was very nice. One day, Lily's teacher asked her to fill a cup with water. Lily was very excited to help, so she went to the sink and filled the cup all the way to the top. 

After class, Lily went to the playground to play with her friends. They played tag and jumped rope. But then Lily remembered that she had forgotten to fill her water bottle. She went back to the classroom and filled her water bottle up with water from the sink. 

At the end of the day, Lily went home and told her mom about how she helped fill a cup with water at school. Her mom was proud of her for being so helpful. Lily went to bed that night feeling happy and proud of herself.

Once upon a time, there was a wide meadow. All different animals lived in the meadow together. They all ate the same food, played together and had peace. 

One day, a little rabbit hopped through the meadow. He stopped at the edge of the meadow where there was a big tree with a swing. He hopped on it and the swing began to move. 

But then, a fox came by. He saw the rabbit and opened his mouth to bite him. The rabbit was so scared! 

But then the other animals noticed and together they chased the fox away. They shouted and banged their tails so the fox went away and the rabbit got off the swing and hopped into the meadow again. 

The animals were very happy and enjoyed the peace of the meadow again. They all hugged and laughed.

From then on everyone in the meadow was happy, and they always remembered the fox who tried to break the peace.

One day Pete was in a hurry. He needed to get to the stable quickly. Pete had a comfortable and fast horse so he knew he could get there quickly. 

He rode his horse through the field, fast, faster and fastest. He was almost at the stable now. Soon they were trotting across the grass and were nearly there.

When they arrived at the stable, Pete hopped off the horse and hurried to the door. It was heavy, but he opened it and went inside. It was hours before dark, but Pete wanted to make sure the horses were safe and comfortable. He put fresh food in their stalls and put clean water in the trough. When he was sure everything was alright he locked the stable door, gave his horse a pat and headed home. 

Pete was happy he had been able to hurry to the stable. He knew the horses were safe and that made him very happy.

One day, a little boy named Tim went to the park with his mom. They saw a chubby squirrel searching for food on the ground. Tim was excited and wanted to play with the squirrel.

Tim said, "Mom, can I play with the squirrel?" His mom smiled and said, "Yes, but be careful and don't scare it away."

Tim walked slowly towards the squirrel. He saw a ball near the squirrel and thought it would be fun to play catch. Tim picked up the ball and threw it gently to the squirrel. The squirrel caught the ball and threw it back to Tim. They played catch on the green pitch in the park.

Tim and the squirrel became good friends. They played together until it was time to go home. Tim said goodbye to the squirrel and promised to come back and play again soon.

Once there was a boy named Jack. He liked to play outside but he was not very good at it. He would often get frustrated. One day, he had an idea. He wanted to win a game so he could show everyone how great he was.

So, Jack decided to have a race. He asked his friends if they wanted to join. Everyone said yes and they all began to run.
Jack ran as hard as he could. Everyone cheered when he crossed the finish line. He had won!

Jack was so excited that he jumped up and down. Then he saw everyone else looking at something. He asked what it was and they told him it was a watch. Jack was so happy because he now had won a watch.

Jack put on his watch and he felt really proud. He had finally won something. From then on when anyone asked him to join a race, he said yes. He knew he now had the confidence to really try his hardest and maybe even win again.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish. The fish was very hot and helpless in the bright sun. The fish wanted to find a way to cool down, so it took a deep breath and dove into the sea. 

As the little fish dove down and down, it began to feel the lovely coolness of the sea. It was so nice and cool under the waves. The fish swam around, feeling more and more relaxed.

Soon the fish found an unfamiliar object. The object was made of metal and was getting warmer and warmer from the heat of the sun. It felt like a prison, trapping the little fish. 

But the fish was brave and it decided to dive even deeper. And as it dove and dove, the little fish finally found a secret cave. In the cave, it was much cooler and the little fish was safe.

The little fish was very happy that it had found the secret cave. The fish stayed there until its scales had cooled off and it felt no more heat. For the first time, the little fish felt cool and free.

Tom is a boy who likes to write. He has a new book with many pages. He writes his name on the first page. He writes what he sees on the second page. He sees a big mill near his house. The mill has a wheel that turns and turns.

One day, Tom goes to the mill with his dad. His dad works at the mill. He makes flour from wheat. Tom wants to write about the mill. He takes his book and a pen. He looks at the mill and writes what he sees. He writes "mill", "wheel", "flour", "wheat".

Tom is happy. He shows his book to his dad. His dad is proud. He says "You are a good writer, Tom. You write what you see. You write simple words. You write a nice story." Tom smiles. He likes to write. He likes his new book. He likes the mill.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. He loved playing outside in the sunshine. Tom was walking in the park when he stumbled upon a pebble in his path. He bent down to pick it up and decided he would keep it as a souvenir. 

Suddenly, Tom heard a voice. It was his mother. "Tom, be careful! Don't pick up strange pebbles," she warned. 

Tom replied, "But why Mom? This pebble is so shiny and pretty, and I like it!"

His mom shook her head. "It might seem nice now, but it would be a stupid thing to do. You should always listen when your parents tell you something." 

Tom nodded and put the pebble back down on the ground. "Okay, I won't pick it up again," he agreed. Then, he ran off to play with his friends, feeling safer now that he had listened to his mom. 

The end.

The sun was shining and the birds were singing. Mama and little Bobby walked together in the park. 

Mama said, "Let's pray together, okay Bobby?" Bobby crossed his hands and bowed his head. Mama said a prayer for Bobby, asking God to protect him always. Midway through the prayer, Bobby opened one eye to peek at his mama.

When she saw, she said, "Bobby! Close your eyes and keep praying!" He giggled and quickly closed his eyes again.

When the prayer was over, Bobby asked his mama, "Where can I get some boots like yours?"

Mama said, "Oh, I think I saw some red ones at the store. Why don't we go and look?"

So they went to the store and sure enough, they found a brand new pair of red boots. Bobby was so excited he almost forgot to put on his old shoes. Mama helped put the boots on his feet and said, "Now you look like a true cowboy."

On the way home, Bobby saw someone walking without shoes. He felt ashamed because he had new boots and they were walking without any. Mama said, "Let's pray for them Bobby. God will take care of them." So together they said a silent prayer for the person without shoes.

Once upon a time, a little girl was playing with her motor outside. She loved to watch it go vroom-vroom and zoom around. One day, the motor stopped working. The little girl got very angry and started to snap her fingers. She wanted to fix the motor.

The little girl looked around for help and saw an old man. She ran over to him and asked if he could fix her motor. The old man said of course he could, but then he looked at the motor and said it was too stupid to fix. He patted the little girl on the head and sent her away.

The little girl was sad. She started to snap her fingers and cry. She decided she would try to fix it herself. She looked at the motor carefully and tried to figure out what was wrong. After a few minutes of inspection, she found the problem. The motor had run out of gas. She filled up the tank and the motor came to life.

The little girl was very proud of herself. She started playing with her motor again and sang as it zipped around. She was so glad she had figured out the problem and never forgot how to make the motor work again.

Jimmy saw a strong man in the park. The strong man was playing a flute. Jimmy liked the sound of the flute. He wanted to try it too.

The man gave Jimmy the flute. Jimmy tried to play it but it was too hard. The strong man showed Jimmy how to move his fingers to make music with the flute. Jimmy practiced and practiced until he could make music too.
 
Jimmy was very happy. Every time he went to the park he would see the strong man and play the flute with him. They made lots of beautiful music together.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient rose. The rose was very special because it was old and beautiful. One day, a very tiny bug wanted to try the rose. So the bug flew over and started to chew. It chewed and chewed until the rose was all gone. The bug was very happy because the rose was so yummy. 

The next day, the ancient rose bloomed again. This time, the bug was careful and only ate one petal. The bug enjoyed the petal very much and went on its way. 

The tiny bug and the ancient rose became the best of friends. Every day the bug would come visit and only eat a little bit at a time. The rose was very thankful for the bug's respect. The two were happy together until one day, the bug did not come back.

But the ancient rose was not alone. A kind little girl came every day and said hello to the rose. She would tell the rose stories and they would laugh together. The ancient rose was very happy because it had a special friend.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a poor orphan girl named Jane. She didn't have any parents and she never had a proper home. Wherever she would end up, people would tell her to move on.

One day, Jane was walking near the palace gates and she saw a rich man in a beautiful vest. She admired it and wanted it for herself. She decided to snatch it and quickly ran away with it.

When the man noticed, he shouted, "Stop thief! Give me back my vest!"

Jane ignored him and kept running.

Eventually, a guard caught up with Jane. He grabbed her and made her drop the vest. Jane was so sad that she started to tear up.

The guard, seeing her tears, felt sorry for her and thought she deserved the vest. So, he decided to give it to her.

Jane was very happy and thanked the guard for his kindness.

She wore the vest with pride and felt rich with all the love it brought her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Emma. She was three years old, and she had a shiny, beautiful blouse.

One day, Emma went to the park with her family. She saw a big tree with lots of colourful leaves. Emma was so excited that she started to admire it. She admired the way the branches and leaves moved in the breeze.

The next day, Emma got to have a yummy treat - her favourite ice cream! She was so happy that she admired it too. She admired how yellow it was and how cold it felt in her hands.

The day after that, Emma tried on her favourite blouse. She looked in the mirror and admired the way it sparkled. She twirled around and she felt so pretty.

Emma had had a wonderful few days admiring all sorts of different things. She was so happy, and she couldn't wait for many more days like that!

Once there was a boy named Max. He was 3 years old and he loved to explore. One day, he decided to go for a walk. As he walked, he heard something very loud. He looked around and saw a tall bridge. He was so excited to see it. 

Max tried to reach it but it was too tall. He wanted to see what was on the other side of the bridge. Then he had an idea. He ran as fast as he could. He was so happy when he made it to the bridge.

Max looked at the bridge and wondered what was on the other side. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise coming from the bridge. It was a train! Max was so excited to see it. 

The bridge was very tall and strong and it crossed the river. Max ran across the bridge and saw what was on the other side of the bridge. It was a beautiful view of the town. Max was so happy to have explored the tall bridge.

One day, Joe was very troubled. He wanted to know why he was feeling so sad. He looked around his room, trying to figure out what was wrong. He peered out his window and saw a shower. That's when it hit him â€“ he wanted to go outside and play in the rain!

Joe knocked on his mom's door and said, â€œMommy, can I go outside and play in the rain? Please?â€ 

His mom smiled and said, â€œOf course, Joe! Just make sure you're back inside before it gets dark.â€

Joe eagerly opened the door and peered outside. He was so excited that he ran through the yard and jumped in the puddles. Joe was having so much fun that he forgot to look at the time. 

Suddenly, he heard his mom calling him from the porch. His mom said, â€œCome on in, Joe! It's time for your shower.â€ 

Joe smiled as he ran inside. He felt much better now that he had been able to peek at the shower outside.

Once there was big pine tree in the forest. One day, two children heard a strange call. They wondered, "What is that?" It was very loud and dangerous. The children were scared, but also curious.

The call was coming from the pine tree. When the children looked closer, they saw a huge, dangerous bird. The bird had a loud and scary call. The children wanted to move away from the pine tree, but felt brave enough to stay and watch.

The bird had a nest and two small babies inside. It kept calling and calling, trying to protect its children. Finally, the children walked away, leaving the pine tree and the bird in peace.

The children never forgot the experience of seeing the dangerous bird and its nest in the big pine tree.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to play in the garden. They liked to look at the flowers that had many colors and smells. They liked to touch the soft petals and the green leaves. They liked to pretend they were bees and butterflies.

One day, they saw a new flower that they had never seen before. It was big and white and had a long stem. It looked like a bell. Lily and Ben wanted to see it closer. They ran to the flower and bent down to smell it.

"Wow, it smells so sweet!" Lily said. "I wonder what it is."

"Maybe it is a magic flower," Ben said. "Maybe it can make wishes come true."

They both closed their eyes and made a wish. Lily wished for a new doll. Ben wished for a new bike. They opened their eyes and waited for their wishes to come true.

But nothing happened. The flower did not change. It did not give them anything. It only made a loud noise. It was not a flower at all. It was a trap. It was a snake that looked like a flower. It had been waiting for someone to come close. It had been waiting to bite.

The snake bit Lily and Ben on their arms. It hurt a lot. They screamed and cried. They tried to run away, but they were too slow. The snake bit them again and again. It had poison in its teeth. The poison made them feel sick and sleepy. They fell to the ground and did not get up.

The garden became gloomy. The sun hid behind the clouds. The wind blew the petals away. The other flowers did not bloom. They closed their buds and waited for the night. They were sad and scared. They had lost their friends. They had been fooled by the snake. They wished they had never seen the white flower. They wished they had never made a wish.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and eat candy. One day, Lily's mom cooked dinner and put salt on the food. Lily didn't like it and made a sad face.

Her mom asked, "What's wrong, Lily? Don't you like the food?" 

Lily replied, "No, Mommy. It's too salty. Can I have some candy instead?"

Her mom said, "No, Lily. You need to eat your dinner. I dare you to try it again and see if you like it." 

Lily took a small bite and to her surprise, it tasted good! She smiled and ate the rest of her dinner happily.

Once upon a time, there was a happy mommy who loved to bake. She decided to make some yummy cookies for her little girl. She got a tray and put it on the table. The tray was colorful with bright pink and blue stripes. 

Mommy mixed the cookie dough and put it on the tray. She put the tray in the oven to bake. The little girl watched as the cookies started to get golden brown. She could smell the sweet cookies baking in the oven.

After a while, mommy took the tray out of the oven and let it settle on the table. The little girl was so excited to try the colorful cookies. They were so delicious and she loved the bright colors on the tray. From that day on, mommy and her little girl baked cookies together all the time. The end.

Once there was a boy named Jake. He was three years old. Jake wanted to go to the river and have some fun.

He found a boat and tried to fit in it. The boat was small and flexible, so it fit perfectly. Jake began to row down the river. He was so happy.

Jake saw a lot of animals by the river. They were swimming around, jumping and soaring. He tried to join them, but he didn't fit. The animals laughed at him.

Jake realized he was too big for the river. But he had a lot of fun anyway. He rowed his boat back to the shore. He was flexible enough to fit back in the boat, and went home with a big smile.

Sally was a cheerful three year old living in the city. One day, she decided to go for a walk with her parents. On her way, she saw something shiny. It was a buckle! She touched it and it sparkled in the sunlight.

Sally loved the buckle, but her parents were worried. They said it was too risky. But Sally was so excited, that she decided to keep it anyway.

On the way home, Sally and her parents passed by a mild river. Excited, Sally dropped her buckle in the river and watched it float away. She smiled and touched the top of the river's water.

Suddenly, another buckle popped up. It was a mild, golden buckle. Sally smiled and said it was perfect! She grabbed the buckle and put it on her dress. Sally was very happy with her new buckle and she promised to keep it safe and sound.

Once there was a boy. He wanted to go for a walk in the park, but he had a terrible tear in his pants. He looked for help and soon found a friendly old lady. She saw his problem and said: "I can lend you a stitch, and fix your pants".

The boy was so happy. He thanked the lady and she agreed to help him. She gave him some thread, and showed him how to stitch. The boy was very careful, and within a few minutes his pants were all fixed.

The boy thanked the lady again and went off on his walk. He had a wonderful time in the park and his pants were no longer terrible. 

The boy was so happy, and he was thankful to the old lady for helping him fix his pants.

Once upon a time there was a boy who was very nervous. One day he decided to go sailing and trust the sea. He gathered his courage and stepped into the boat. The sun was shining and the water was calm. But the boy was still very nervous. As he sailed, he could see dolphins swimming near the boat. He was amazed and forgot all his troubles. He began to smile and relax. He trusted the sea and felt safe. It felt like nothing bad could ever happen. The boy finally reached his destination and thanked the sea for taking such good care of him. He learned that you can trust the sea and its creatures.

Once upon a time there was a little crane who lived in a pond. The crane was very happy because he could fly and splash around in the water. One day, he flew high in the sky and met a nice bird. They became good friends and had lots of fun together.

But then one day, the crane did something bad. He flew too close to the sun. The sun's heat was too hot for the crane, so he panicked and quickly flew away.

The other bird saw this and was very sad. He felt guilty for not warning the crane not to go so close to the sun. He wanted to help his friend but didn't know what to do.

Then the bird had an idea. He spread his wings and flew into the sun's heat. He was brave and protected his friend from harm.

The two were so happy and grateful. The crane thanked his friend and they flew away together. The sun smiled down on them as they flew away, happy and safe.

Paul and Matilda were best friends. One day, Matilda had a carrot, so she asked Paul to examine it. Paul was very intrigued and looked closely at the carrot. It was a very fine carrot, with a bright orange colour.

The two friends began to play with the carrot, rolling it around and around. They both laughed as they watched the carrot roll. Then, Paul thought of an idea. He ran to the kitchen and grabbed two pieces of string.

He gave one piece of string to Matilda, and the two of them tied the two pieces of string around the carrot. Paul and Matilda spun the carrot between them like a game of tug-of-war. They laughed and played until they were too tired.

Then, Paul and Matilda ate the carrot, savouring its deliciousness. They examined it closely as they chowed down. It was a very fine carrot, indeed. They decided to play with carrots more often.

Once upon a time, there was an old grandma. She loved to read stories to her grandson, Timmy. Timmy loved to hear stories from his grandma. One day, Timmy asked his grandma, "Can you teach me how to spell my name?" 

Grandma smiled and said, "Of course, Timmy! Let's try to spell your name together." They sat down with a piece of paper and a pencil. Grandma taught Timmy how to spell his name, and Timmy tried his best to write it down.

After a few tries, Timmy finally spelled his name correctly! He was so happy and proud of himself. "Good job, Timmy!" said grandma. "You are a smart boy."

From that day on, Timmy practiced spelling his name every day. And every time he got it right, he would smile and say, "I did it!"

Tom and Lily were playing with their toy sheep. They liked to pretend they were farmers and shear the wool from the sheep. They used scissors and a comb to cut and brush the wool. They made a big pile of wool on the floor.

"Look, we have so much wool!" Lily said. "We can make a sweater or a blanket or a hat!"

"Or we can make a pillow!" Tom said. "I'm tired. I want to take a nap."

Tom grabbed some wool and put it under his head. He closed his eyes and yawned.

Lily was not tired. She wanted to keep playing. She saw a big ball of wool on the shelf. She wanted to play with it. She climbed on a chair and reached for the ball.

"Be careful, Lily!" Tom said. "That's Mom's wool. She will be mad if you take it."

But Lily did not listen. She pulled the ball of wool and it fell off the shelf. It rolled on the floor and out of the door.

"Oh no!" Lily said. "The wool is leaving!"

She ran after the ball of wool. She did not see the cat that was chasing it too. The cat pounced on the ball of wool and scratched it with its claws. The wool got tangled and ripped.

Lily was sad. She knew she had done a bad thing. She picked up the ball of wool and brought it back to the room. She saw Tom sleeping on the floor. She woke him up.

"Tom, I'm sorry. I took Mom's wool and the cat ruined it. What can we do?" Lily said.

Tom opened his eyes and looked at the ball of wool. He saw how messy and torn it was. He hugged Lily and said:

"It's okay, Lily. We can tell Mom the truth and say we're sorry. Maybe she can fix it. Or maybe we can help her make a new ball of wool. Come on, let's go find Mom."

Tom and Lily held hands and left the room. They hoped Mom would not be too angry. They learned their lesson. They would not take things that did not belong to them. They would be good children.

Once upon a time, there was a kid named Leo. Leo was playful and always smiling. He loved to tell jokes and make people laugh. 

One day, Leo was playing in the park when he saw a funny looking creature. "Wow!" Leo said, his eyes wide.

The creature smiled and asked, "Do you believe in me?" Leo nodded. 

The creature said, "I'm an elf, and I'm here to make sure you have a fun day." Leo laughed.

The creature said, "I will be back tomorrow with a very special joke just for you!" 

The next day, the elf came back with a big smile on his face. He said, "I have a very special joke for you, Leo. It will make you laugh." 

Leo laughed and laughed! The elf's joke was so funny that he couldn't keep from smiling. Leo thanked the elf for the playful joke and promised to remember it forever.

Once there was an ordinary flashlight. It lived in the top drawer and it was often very lonely. One day, the flashlight heard a soft voice outside saying 'welcome'. It peered out of the drawer and saw a little 3-year-old standing there. She had curly hair and big eyes and she was smiling.

The flashlight was so excited that she welcomed it out of the drawer and was ready to give it a new home. She took it outside and they both laughed and ran around in the sunshine. Suddenly, the flashlight lit up and they both screamed with delighted. They played together all day long, until the sun went down and the flashlight had to go back inside its drawer. 

The flashlight looked up at the little girl and said â€œBye bye! I had a lot of fun today. Will you welcome me back tomorrow?â€
The girl smiled and said â€œOf course! Now I know that ordinary flashlight can be very fun.â€ 

And from then on, the little girl welcomed her flashlight to come out and play in the sunshine every day.

Mrs. Brown had a very tidy bedroom. Every week, she would take some time to dress it up with new things. She put new pillows on the bed and some bright curtains on the window. Mrs. Brown loved to get dressed up too. Every Sunday she would put on her best dress. It was her favorite yellow one with the big bow. She would make her hair nice and tidy and then put on some jewellery. Mrs. Brown loved to make her bedroom and herself look neat and tidy every week.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily's mom gave her a yummy yogurt for breakfast. Lily loved yogurt so much that she ate it all up very quickly. 

After breakfast, Lily went outside to play with her friends. They were having so much fun running and jumping. Suddenly, Lily heard her mom calling her. She stopped and listened. Her mom wanted her to come inside for a minute. 

Lily went inside and saw that her mom was watching the news on TV. The news was talking about a big storm that was coming. Lily's mom was very alert and wanted to make sure they were ready. She told Lily to pause her playtime and help her get the house ready for the storm. 

Lily helped her mom put away the toys outside and bring in the chairs. They also made sure they had enough food and water in case the storm lasted a long time. Lily was happy to help her mom and felt proud that she could be a good helper.

Once upon a time, there was a family that was very excited. It was December and Christmas was coming! On the wall was a calendar and each day was one step closer to Christmas.

When the family woke up one day, it was very icy outside. Everyone put on their warmest clothes and went outside to have fun. The snow was crunchy and the trees were sparkling in the cold.

Once the family was back inside, the parents put up a red and green Christmas tree. It was so pretty, it reminded them of the holiday. It was time to start putting presents under it!

When the family was done decorating, the kids moved the calendar to the next day. They were getting very close to Christmas! Every day the calendar gave them a gentle reminder that Christmas was coming soon.

The family was so excited that the days would fly by until Christmas morning. That was when they would get to see what they got!

Once upon a time there was a delicate penny. It was lying in the grass, and it glowed in the sunshine.

One day, a little girl came by and saw it. She bent down and carefully picked it up. She smiled at the sight of it.

The little girl put the penny in her pocket and went to look for a special place to keep it. She thought and thought until she had a plan. She went to the kitchen and got a pretty jar and placed the penny inside. 

The little girl couldn't believe it was now a part of her collection. She shook it and smiled as she heard it jingle.

Every day, the little girl would take out the delicate penny and look at it with wonder. Then she'd put it back in the jar.

The little girl felt lucky to have found such a special penny and she vowed to take care of it always.

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside, but he didn't like when mosquitoes buzzed around him and bit him. One day, Timmy's friend Sally came to play with him. Sally saw that Timmy was getting bitten by mosquitoes and wanted to help him. 

Sally told Timmy that if he wore bug spray, the mosquitoes wouldn't bother him anymore. Timmy was happy that Sally wanted to help him and he put on the bug spray. They played outside for a long time and no mosquitoes bothered them. 

After they finished playing, Timmy thanked Sally for her help. Sally was happy to help her friend and they promised to play together again soon. From then on, whenever Timmy played outside, he made sure to wear bug spray to keep the mosquitoes away.

One day, a kangaroo wanted something. He wanted something attractive. He had seen it in the trees before. He wanted to get it and have it for himself. He hopped around the trees looking for it. Suddenly, he saw it! It was a nice, attractive plant. He wanted it. The kangaroo hopped closer. He reached out his paw and he took it! Now he had it and he was so happy! He hopped away with his new attractive plant. From then on, he was the happiest kangaroo around.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys and books. They are lively and happy. But sometimes they get tired and need a nap.

One day, Sara and Ben are playing with their blocks. They build a big tower and a bridge. They are having fun. But then Sara yawns. She feels sleepy. She says to Ben, "I want a nap. Do you want a nap?"

Ben shakes his head. He is not sleepy. He wants to play more. He says to Sara, "No, I don't want a nap. I want to play. You can nap. I will play."

Sara nods. She goes to her bed. She takes her teddy bear and her blanket. She lies down and closes her eyes. She falls asleep.

Ben stays with his blocks. He tries to make the tower and the bridge bigger. He is busy and noisy. He does not see that mom is coming. Mom has a glass of water in her hand. She wants to give Ben some water. She says to Ben, "Ben, you are thirsty. Drink some water."

But Ben does not hear mom. He is too loud. He knocks down the tower and the bridge. The blocks fall everywhere. Some blocks hit the glass. The glass breaks. The water spills. Mom is angry. She says to Ben, "Ben, you are naughty. You broke the glass. You made a mess. You need a nap. Go to your bed. Now."

Ben is scared. He is sorry. He says to mom, "I'm sorry, mom. I did not mean to break the glass. I did not see you. I was playing."

Mom sighs. She says to Ben, "I know, Ben. But you need to be careful. And you need to rest. You are tired. Go to your bed. I will clean the mess. And I will check on Sara."

Ben goes to his bed. He takes his truck and his pillow. He lies down and opens his eyes. He does not want to sleep. But he is quiet. He thinks about the glass and the blocks. He thinks about mom and Sara. He feels sad. He closes his eyes. He falls asleep.

Lila and Sam were friends. They lived in a big city with many cars and buildings. They liked to play in the park and go to school. But Lila was sad. She missed her country.

"Where are you from, Lila?" Sam asked her one day.

"I am from a far country. It is very different from here. It has mountains and rivers and trees. It is very pretty. But it is also very poor. Many people have no food or clothes or toys. My mom and dad worked hard, but we had little money. That is why we came here. To find a better life." Lila said.

Sam felt sorry for Lila. He wanted to make her happy. He thought of a plan.

"Come with me, Lila. I have something to show you." He said.

He took her hand and led her to his house. He showed her his room. He had many toys and books and games. He picked one of his favorite toys. It was a truck with wheels and lights and sounds.

"Look, Lila. This is my truck. I like it a lot. But I want to give it to you. You can have it. It is yours now." He said.

Lila was surprised. She looked at the truck. It was shiny and new and fun. She smiled. She hugged Sam.
