Lily felt bad for her neighbor, so she asked her mom if they could share their umbrella with Mrs. Johnson. Her mom said yes, so Lily ran outside and gave the umbrella to Mrs. Johnson.

Mrs. Johnson was so grateful and thanked Lily and her mom. Even though it was raining, Lily felt happy because she helped her neighbor. From that day on, Lily and Mrs. Johnson became good friends and enjoyed spending time together.

Once upon a time, there were two friends who lived near a lumberyard. They enjoyed playing in the mill together on the weekends.

One day, when the friends were playing, they saw something move inside the lumberyard. It was a big rabbit!

The friends ran to get a closer look, but it was very dark and they couldn't see very far.

So one of the friends said, â€œLet's talk to it. Maybe it will come out if we talk to it kindly.â€ 

The other agreed, and called out in a mild voice, â€œHello there, little rabbit. Are you coming out to play with us?â€

Just then, the friends heard a rustling from the lumber. It was the rabbit! It had heard the friends' kind invitation and had come out to play.

The friends were so happy to have made a new friend. They learned a valuable lesson that dayâ€” that good things can happen when you talk nicely to others.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim had his own toy grill. He loved to pretend to cook food for his friends. One day, Tim wanted to have a big cookout for all his friends.

Tim invited all his friends to his house. They played and had fun. Then, it was time for Tim to cook on his toy grill. He put pretend food on the grill and pretended to cook it. But, oh no! The food looked terrible. It was all burnt and yucky.

Tim's friends laughed and said it was okay. They all played and had fun anyway. They knew Tim was still learning how to cook on his toy grill. In the end, they all had a great time, and Tim promised to practice more on his grill.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl in a peaceful, calm village. Everyone loved the village because it was surrounded by a beautiful green landscape. But one day, something changed. A big giant appeared and wanted to take over the village. The little girl wanted to help the people resist the giant, but she was so small that she wasn't sure what she could do.

Fortunately, she had a great idea! She knew that the landscape was very important to her village so she decided to help keep it free by picking dandelions and wildflowers every day. The little girl was so happy to see that with her help, the bright flowers began to blossom everywhere. 

This made the giant so angry that he backed away. Everyone was so pleased to see the little girl helping her village stay calm and peaceful. The little girl had helped everyone resist the giant and keep the beautiful landscape safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a shiny key that he loved to play with. One day, Timmy went outside to play and it was very cold. The ground was icy and slippery. Timmy slipped on the ice and fell down. He was very sad because he thought he lost his key. 

Timmy looked around and saw his key on the ground. He was so happy that he found his key. Timmy picked up his key and went back inside to warm up. From that day on, Timmy made sure to be careful when he went outside on icy days.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy, a daddy and a little girl. The little girl was three years old. Her parents were really nice and they loved to take her outside.

Every evening, the parents would take the girl by her hands and lead her outside. The air was nice and the sky was warm. The evening felt safe.

The family would walk around the park and pick pretty flowers. This made the little girl so happy. She loved to pick the flowers and give them to her mommy and daddy.

From time to time, the family would play games together. Daddy and the little girl would blow bubbles in the sky and try to catch them with their hands. Mommy would laugh and smile with them.

Every evening was different, but one thing stayed the same. The family always felt safe and happy when they were together.

Lily liked to play with her drum. She banged it with her hands and made loud noises. She liked to sing along with her drum and make up songs. She was happy and healthy.

One day, Lily saw a big fire in the yard. She was curious and wanted to see it. She ran to the fire and saw that it was very bright and hot. She felt the heat on her face and hands. She thought the fire was pretty and wanted to touch it.

But Lily did not know that fire can burn. Fire can hurt and make things black and broken. Fire is not a toy. Fire is dangerous.

Lily reached out her hand to the fire and touched a stick that was burning. She felt a sharp pain and screamed. She pulled back her hand and saw that it was red and sore. She cried and ran to her mom.

Her mom saw her hand and hugged her. She said, "Lily, you are hurt. Fire can burn. Fire can hurt. You should never play with fire. Fire is not a toy. Fire is dangerous." She took Lily inside and put some cold water and a bandage on her hand. She gave her a kiss and said, "I love you, Lily. You are my brave girl. But please be careful and stay away from fire."

Lily nodded and said, "I love you, mom. I am sorry. I did not know fire can burn. I will not play with fire again. I will play with my drum. My drum is fun and safe. My drum is my toy." She smiled and hugged her mom. She learned a lesson and was happy and healthy again.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Molly. Molly was sleepy and went to bed early one night. Before she went to bed, Molly told her mom a funny joke. Her mom laughed and tucked her in.

After Molly fell asleep, something strange happened. Her mom said the joke disappeared! No one could see it or find it. Everyone was so surprised and looked around to try and find the joke.

But the joke was gone! No one ever saw it again. Molly had the best night's sleep ever and didn't know her joke had disappeared.

The next morning, Molly asked her mom to tell her the joke. But her mom said the joke had gone away. Molly was sad but later went to play and soon forgot about the disappearing joke.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly bear called Big Ted. Big Ted lived in a huge forest surrounded by tall trees. Every Tuesday, Big Ted would wake up feeling calm. He would stretch his arms and lay down on the grass for a snooze. He would take a deep breath and watch the clouds roll by. After his snooze, he often explored the forest and made new friends with animals. He especially liked to go on long walks and search for special treats. Big Ted was always very calm and loved Tuesdays!

Lily and Tom were playing in the park. They liked to run, jump and slide on the grass and the swings. They saw a big hill with many bright flowers. They wanted to climb the hill and see the sky.

"Come on, Lily, let's go up the hill!" Tom said.

"OK, Tom, let's go!" Lily said.

They held hands and started to climb. The hill was steep and slippery. They had to be careful not to fall. They saw bees, butterflies and birds on the way. They smiled and laughed.

They reached the top of the hill. They looked at the sky. It was blue and sunny. They saw clouds, planes and a rainbow. They felt happy and proud.

"Wow, look at the sky, Lily! It's so pretty!" Tom said.

"Yes, Tom, it's so pretty! We did it!" Lily said.

They hugged and cheered. They decided to lie down on the grass and watch the sky. They felt the warm sun on their faces. They closed their eyes and dreamed.

After a while, they heard a voice. It was their mom. She was calling them from the bottom of the hill.

"Lily, Tom, it's time to go home! Come down, please!" Mom said.

Lily and Tom opened their eyes. They saw their mom waving at them. They sighed. They did not want to leave the hill and the sky. They wanted to stay and play.

"Mom, can we stay a little longer? We like it here!" Lily said.

"Sorry, kids, we have to go. It's getting late and we have to eat dinner. Come on, hurry up!" Mom said.

Lily and Tom got up and held hands again. They started to climb down the hill. They were careful not to fall. They said goodbye to the flowers, the bees, the butterflies and the birds. They looked at the sky one last time. They saw the rainbow fading away. They felt sad and tired.

They reached the bottom of the hill. They ran to their mom and hugged her. She smiled and kissed them.

"Did you have fun, kids?" Mom asked.

"Yes, Mom, we had fun. We climbed the hill and saw the sky. It was bright and pretty. But we are sad to leave." Lily said.

"I understand, kids. But don't worry, we can come back another day. Now let's go home and have some yummy dinner. You must be hungry." Mom said.

Lily and Tom nodded. They followed their mom to the car. They looked at the park and the hill. They hoped to come back soon. They felt happy and loved.

Once upon a time, there were two people who were very happy - their names were Jack and Jane.
They loved each other very much, and so they decided to get married. They had a big party, and all the people at the party were happy and excited.

After they got married, Jack and Jane went to sleep in their cozy bed. They were so tired from all the excitement that they fell asleep very quickly.

The next morning, Jack and Jane woke up and hugged each other. They were very happy because they were married now, and they loved each other very much. 

Jack and Jane were so happy that they went back to sleep, cuddling each other. So they slept and stayed very tired, but they were still very happy and in love. 

The end.

Lily was a gifted girl who liked to make things. She had a big box of old toys, wires, and batteries that she used to invent new gadgets. One day, she decided to make a robot that could stir her soup for her.

She took a spoon, a battery, some tape, and a small motor from an old car toy. She taped the spoon to the motor and the motor to the battery. Then she turned on the switch and watched the spoon spin around. She was very proud of her robot.

She ran to the kitchen with her robot and put it in a pot of soup that her mom was cooking. She said, "Look, mom, I made a robot that can stir the soup for you!"

Her mom was surprised and smiled. She said, "Wow, Lily, that's very clever of you! But you know, you shouldn't put batteries in the soup. They can be dangerous and make the soup taste bad."

Lily didn't know that. She said, "Oh, I'm sorry, mom. I didn't mean to make the soup bad. I just wanted to help you."

Her mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. I appreciate your help. But next time, ask me before you use my things, okay? And maybe you can find a safer way to make your robot work."

Lily nodded and said, "Okay, mom. I love you."

Her mom said, "I love you too, Lily. You are a gifted girl who can do amazing things. But you also need to be careful and learn from your mistakes."

Once there was a little boy called John. He was only three years old. One day, he had an idea. He wanted to swing in his garden. So he looked around for something he could use. Suddenly he saw a green rope! He took the rope and ran to the biggest tree in the garden. John demanded that his mum help him to tie the rope to the tree.

Mum smiled and carefully tied the green rope around the tree. John got very excited and jumped onto the rope. He laughed and laughed as he swung higher and higher! He had so much fun in his garden that day.

It was very tiring, so at the end of the day, John curled up in his favourite chair, ready to take a nap. It was going to be a special summer.

One day, a little girl went to the strawberry patch. She was very excited to pick some of the sweet and juicy berries. She carefully selected the ripest and biggest ones and placed them in her basket. As she walked away from the patch, she looked around her and noticed how calm and peaceful the world was.

The girl took the strawberries home and showed them to her family. Everyone was impressed by how plump and red the fruits were. To celebrate her find, the family decided to make a delicious strawberry pie.

The little girl felt so proud and valued for bringing the strawberries home. It made her realize how important it was to appreciate the things that the world can offer. From that day on, she always made sure to value even the smallest things.

Once upon a time, there was a man who loved to sleep. He had a wife who was very pretty. She liked to cook and clean, but sometimes she was careless and broke things. One day, the man was sleeping and his wife accidentally knocked over a vase. It made a big noise and woke him up. He wasn't happy, but he knew it was just an accident. So, he forgave his wife and they went back to sleep together. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to collect pretty rocks and shells from the beach. One day, she met a painter who was painting a picture of the ocean. The painter was very nice and dependable. 

Lily showed the painter her collection of rocks and shells. The painter was impressed and said that they would make a great addition to her painting. So, Lily gave the painter some of her rocks and shells to use in the painting. 

After the painting was finished, the painter gave Lily a picture of the ocean with her rocks and shells in it. Lily was very happy and thanked the dependable painter. From that day on, Lily continued to collect more rocks and shells to share with her new friend, the painter.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved flowers and always played in her garden. One day, she saw a tiny seed in the ground. She watered it every day and waited patiently for it to grow.

One morning, she woke up and saw a beautiful flower had bloomed! It was a pretty pink color and had soft velvet petals. She was so happy and ran to tell her mom.

"Mommy, mommy! Look at my flower! It bloomed!" said Lily.

Her mom smiled and said, "Wow, that's amazing! It looks so soft and pretty like velvet."

Lily was so happy, but then she accidentally touched a thorn on the stem and it hurt her finger. Her mom quickly kissed her finger to make it feel better.

"Be careful, sweetie. Even pretty flowers can hurt sometimes," said her mom.

Lily nodded and promised to be more careful. She was still happy because her flower was so beautiful and made her garden look even more special.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was feeling very miserable. She had been sick for a long time, so her mom gave her some medicine. But Lucy didnâ€™t like the medicine. She thought it tasted yucky.

Mom told Lucy that if she took her medicine, she would feel better soon. Lucy knew that her mom was right, but she was still sad.

So her mom tied the medicine up in a special bow. It looked like a nice, big present! Lucy smiled when she saw it and she took the medicine.

Soon, Lucy felt much better. She wasnâ€™t miserable anymore. She was so happy that her mom had tied the medicine up in a pretty bow.

Once upon a time there lived a little girl. Her name was Daisy and she loved to play. One day she found an old video in the attic. She was very curious and decided to watch it. 

The video was about a mysterious land Full of strange creatures. Daisy couldn't believe what she was seeing.

Daisy decided to go and explore the land but her mum said it was too dangerous. She was so sad and angry.

"Why can't I go?" Said Daisy, "I want to see the creatures!"

"It's too harsh sweetheart," said Daisy's mum.

Daisy was disappointed but she trusted her mum and stayed home. She still believed that the world in the video really existed, somewhere.

Ben and Sam are brothers. They like to play with their toy tools. They have a hammer, a saw, a drill and some nails. They pretend to be builders and fix things around the house.

One day, they see a hole in the roof of their playhouse. They decide to fix it. They get their tools and a piece of wood. They climb on a ladder and go to the roof.

"Be careful, Ben," Sam says. "The roof is high and the hole is big."

"I am careful, Sam," Ben says. "And I am strong. I can fix the hole."

Ben puts the wood over the hole and nails it with his hammer. He makes a loud bang-bang sound. Sam holds the wood and the ladder. He cheers for Ben.

"You did it, Ben!" Sam says. "You fixed the roof. You are a great builder."

"Thank you, Sam," Ben says. "You are a great helper. We make a good team."

They climb down the ladder and admire their work. They are proud of themselves. They go inside their playhouse and play some more. They are happy.

Once there was a small girl. She wanted to go on an adventure. So she stepped outside of her house and started to explore. First, she stepped through a meadow. Then she stepped over a hill. Finally, she stepped into a different country. It was so exciting! 

She couldn't believe she had stepped so far away. The country was so small but there were so many fun things to do. The girl explored the country and she saw a river, a forest, and some mountains. She even met a few new friends along the way! 

It was the best adventure ever. Before she knew it, it was time to head home. The girl stepped back over the hill, through the meadow, and finally back to her house. She smiled and knew that she would always remember her small country adventure.

Lily and Tom were playing in the park with their ball. They liked to kick the ball to each other and run after it. Sometimes the ball went too far and they had to look for it in the grass or behind the trees.

One time, the ball went over the fence and into the street. Lily and Tom ran to the fence and saw a big car coming fast. They were scared and did not know what to do. They panic.

"Help! Help!" they shouted. "Our ball is in the street and the car is coming!"

A figure came running from the other side of the street. It was their dad. He saw the ball and the car and ran to get the ball. He was brave and fast. He got the ball and threw it back to the park. Then he crossed the street again and came to the fence.

"Lily, Tom, are you okay?" he asked. He was worried and angry.

"Yes, dad, we are okay," they said. They were happy and sorry.

"Never go into the street without me, do you understand?" he said. "The street is dangerous and the cars are not nice. They can hurt you and the ball."

"We understand, dad," they said. "We are sorry. We will not do it again."

He hugged them and said, "I love you. Come on, let's go home. We can play with the ball in the backyard. It is open and safe."

They nodded and said, "We love you too, dad. Thank you for saving our ball."

They took his hand and walked home with him. They were glad and relieved. They learned a lesson and had a story to tell.

Lily and Ben are playing hide and seek in the park. Lily is the seeker and Ben is the hider. Lily counts to ten and then looks for Ben.

She sees a big tree with many leaves. She thinks Ben might be hiding behind it. She walks to the tree and peeks around it. But she does not see Ben. She only sees a squirrel with a long tail. The squirrel sees Lily and runs away.

Lily hears a giggle from behind a bush. She thinks Ben might be hiding there. She runs to the bush and peeks under it. But she does not see Ben. She only sees a frog with a short tail. The frog sees Lily and hops away.

Lily feels a tap on her shoulder. She turns around and sees Ben. He is smiling and holding a rock.

"Boo!" he says. "I found a hard rock. Do you want to see it?"

Lily laughs and hugs Ben. She is happy to see him.

"You are a good hider, Ben," she says. "But I am a good seeker, too. I saw a squirrel and a frog. They have tails, too. But not like your rock."

They look at the rock together. It is hard and smooth and has a funny shape.

"Maybe it is a dinosaur tail," Ben says.

"Maybe it is a magic tail," Lily says.

They decide to keep the rock as a treasure. They put it in their pocket and go to play some more. They have fun in the park.

Tom and Sam are friends. They like to play in the field near their home. The field has many flowers and trees and birds. Sometimes they see a big horse in the field. The horse is brown and has a long mane and tail.

One day, Tom and Sam go to the field and see the horse again. They want to pet the horse, but they are afraid. The horse is very big and powerful. They do not know if the horse is friendly or not.

"Hello, horse," Tom says. "We are Tom and Sam. We like you. Can we pet you?"

The horse looks at Tom and Sam. He neighs softly and walks towards them. He lets them touch his nose and ears. He is gentle and warm.

"Wow, the horse is nice," Sam says. "He knows we are not bad. He likes us too."

Tom and Sam smile. They feel happy and brave. They pet the horse and talk to him. They make a new friend in the field.

Once there was an elderly man who lived in a small house. He loved to take walks in the park everyday and it made him very happy. One day, the elderly man was walking in the park and he saw a sauce on the ground. He was so excited to find it, so he picked it up. 

He took the sauce home and kept it in his kitchen. He often made dishes with the sauce and he always shared it with his neighbours. He never felt alone with all of the nice neighbours around.

One day, he decided to spoil himself with his sauce and he made a big bowl of noodles. He was so excited to eat it, but when he started eating it, he realised it tasted a bit funny and waaaay too salty. He figured out that he had accidentally spoiled it. He was so sad that his delicious dish was all gone. 

But his neighbours heard what happened, so they all came together and cooked him a delicious new dish with his sauce. He was so happy and grateful to his neighbours and their kindness.He never again spoiled his sauce because he was so careful about it after this experience.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play together. They had many toys, but their favorite was a big red truck. They pretended the truck could take them to different places, like the park, the zoo, or the moon.

One day, their mom said they could have dessert after dinner, but only if they were helpful and cleaned their room. Lily and Ben agreed, and ran to their room. They started to put their toys in a big box, but then they saw the red truck.

"Let's play with the truck first," Ben said. "We can clean later."

"No, we have to be helpful," Lily said. "Mom will be happy if we clean now, and then we can have dessert."

"But I want to play with the truck," Ben said. "It's so fun. I believe it can fly."

Lily thought for a moment. She liked the truck too, but she also wanted dessert. She had an idea.

"OK, let's play with the truck, but only for a little bit," she said. "And then we can use the truck to help us clean. We can put the toys in the truck, and drive them to the box. It will be faster and more fun."

Ben liked the idea. He smiled and nodded.

"OK, let's do that," he said. "The truck is helpful too."

They played with the truck for a little bit, and then they used it to help them clean. They drove the truck around the room, and picked up the toys. They made vroom and beep sounds, and pretended they were on a mission.

Soon, their room was clean, and their mom came to check on them.

"Wow, you did a great job," she said. "You were very helpful. I'm proud of you. Now you can have dessert."

Lily and Ben were happy. They thanked their mom, and followed her to the kitchen. They saw a big cake with chocolate and sprinkles.

"Wow, that looks yummy," Lily said.

"Yes, it does," Ben said. "Can we have a big piece?"

"Sure, you can," their mom said. "You earned it. You were very helpful."

Lily and Ben smiled. They ate their cake, and shared some with the truck. They believed the truck was happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the bright sun. One day, Lily went for a walk in the forest. She saw many trees and birds, but the sun was hidden behind the clouds. 

Suddenly, it started to rain and Lily got very wet. She needed to find a place to cover herself from the rain. She saw a big tree and ran towards it. The tree was so big that it covered her from the rain. 

Lily sat under the tree and waited for the rain to stop. She looked up and saw that the sun was shining again. She was so happy that she started to dance and sing. The sun was no longer hidden and Lily continued her walk in the forest with a big smile on her face.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly cat named Mittens. Mittens loved to explore and go on adventures. One day, Mittens found a map that showed a big park with lots of trees and birds.

Mittens wanted to go to the park, so she asked her friend, a dog named Max, to come with her. Max was happy to join Mittens on her adventure.

As they walked to the park, Mittens and Max listened to the birds singing and the leaves rustling in the wind. When they finally arrived, they played together and had so much fun.

From then on, Mittens and Max went on many adventures together, always listening to the sounds around them and using their trusty map to guide them.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly man. Every day, he liked to take a walk in the park. One day, he saw a frog in the park. He wanted to pick it up so he could show it to everyone. He lifted the frog carefully and the frog croaked. It croaked so loudly that everyone in the park stopped and looked.

The elderly man thought to himself, if he could make the frog croak again for everyone in the park, everyone would be so happy! He put the frog back down, and made his way around the park. Everywhere he went, he asked the same question to everyone, "Do you know how to make a frog jump and croak?"

At the end of the park, he asked an old woman. She said, "Yes, but it will take some time. You must give it a few pieces of bread, and then it will jump and croak." With that, the elderly man gathered a few pieces of bread and made his way back to the frog. He lifted the frog again, and this time it jumped and croaked - just as the old woman said.

Everyone in the park cheered and applauded the elderly man. They clapped and laughed and thanked him for the wonderful show. Suddenly, the elderly man realised that he had done something special. He had made the frog croak for everyone, and everyone was really happy.

Once upon a time, there was a famous finger living in a big city. Every day it would deliver mail to the people there! 

The finger was very proud of its job. One day, as it was delivering mail, a little 3 year old saw it. She was so excited, she had never seen a famous finger before!

"Hello", said the little girl. "What are you delivering?"

The finger looked at the little girl. "Mail, of course!" the finger replied.

The little girl was so amazed that she wanted to help the finger. She begged and begged, but the finger wouldn't let her assist.

The finger kept delivering mail until it was so exhausted it couldn't continue. It lay down on the ground, never to deliver mail again.

The little girl was so sad that she ran away, crying. She didn't know what happened to the famous finger.

Once upon a time there was a big, strong bear. The bear had a nice cabin all by himself. He was always content in it.

One day, the bear went on a walk in the woods. Suddenly, he heard a noise from a nearby bush. He went to investigate and saw a small rabbit complaining.

"What's wrong?" asked the bear.

"My home is too small," said the rabbit.

The bear thought for a moment. "Would you like to live in my big cabin?" he asked.

The rabbit's eyes lit up. "Yes!"

The bear and the rabbit went back to the bear's cabin and the rabbit moved in. Since then, the bear and the rabbit have been very happy in their big cabin.

Ben and Lily were twins who liked to play with their toys. One day, they found a big box in the garage. It was heavy and had a label that said "Do not open". Ben and Lily were curious and wanted to see what was inside.

They pushed and pulled the box until they moved it to the living room. They used a scissors to cut the tape and opened the box. Inside, they saw a lot of shiny things that looked like stars. They were happy and started to take them out and play with them.

But the shiny things were not stars. They were fireworks that their dad had bought for a special night. The scissors made a spark when they cut the tape, and the spark lit one of the fireworks. The firework made a loud noise and flew out of the box. It hit the curtains and set them on fire.

Ben and Lily were scared and ran away. They heard more noises and saw more fire. They hid under the bed and cried. Their mom and dad came home and saw the smoke and the flames. They called the firemen and tried to put out the fire.

The firemen came and stopped the fire. They asked Ben and Lily what happened. Ben and Lily felt guilty and told them the truth. They said they were sorry and that they did not know the shiny things were dangerous. Their mom and dad were angry and sad. They gave Ben and Lily a big hug and said they were glad they were safe. But they also said they had to pay a lot of money to fix the house and the things that were burned. They said Ben and Lily had to give away some of their toys and do extra chores to help. Ben and Lily nodded and said they would. They wished they had never opened the box.

Once upon a time, there was a little oyster named Ollie. Ollie lived in the sea with his friends. Ollie was a dependable friend. He always helped his friends when they needed him.

One day, Ollie and his friends wanted to play a game. They wanted to dare each other to do fun things. Ollie's friend, the fish, dared Ollie to jump high out of the water. Ollie was scared, but he wanted to try.

Ollie tried very hard to jump high. His friends cheered for him. With one big jump, Ollie came out of the water. Ollie was so happy that he dared to do it. His friends were happy too. They knew they could always count on dependable Ollie.

Once upon a time there was a King. He always wanted people to agree with him. If they didn't, he got hot and angry.

One day he called everyone to his palace. Everyone was so excited and couldn't wait to see their King.

The King said, "Do you all agree I am the best King?" Everyone nodded and said, "Yes we do!"

The King smiled and said, "Thank you for agreeing with me".

But one brave girl stepped forwards and said, "I don't agree with you! You are not the best King".

This made the King really hot and angry. He shouted, "Who said that? Who disagrees with me?"

The girl stepped forwards and said, "It was me! I disagree with you!".

The King smiled and said, "I respect your opinion, even if you don't agree with me. You have a brave heart and I will make you my advisor".

And from then on, the King listened to her opinion and the people respected her bravery.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved pizza very much. One day, Timmy's mom made him a pizza for dinner. Timmy was so excited to eat it, but he accidentally dropped it on the floor. "Oh no!" cried Timmy.

"Don't worry, Timmy. We can wash it off and it will be okay," said his mom. Timmy was happy to hear that and they washed the pizza together in the sink. Even though the pizza was a little dirty, it still tasted good.

After dinner, Timmy went to take a bath. The water was very harsh and he didn't like it. "Mommy, the water is too harsh," said Timmy. "I'm sorry, Timmy. I will make it warmer for you," said his mom. Timmy was happy again and he enjoyed his bath. After he was done, he put on his pajamas and went to bed. He dreamed about pizza and how he washed it with his mom. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Timmy and Tommy. They loved to play together, but sometimes they would quarrel over toys. One day, they went to a big temple with their families. Inside, it was very quiet and peaceful, but Timmy and Tommy started to feel uncomfortable. They wanted to play and run around, but they had to be quiet and respectful. They started to quarrel again, but their parents told them to stop and be kind to each other. Timmy and Tommy realized that it was important to be respectful in the temple and to be kind to their friends. From then on, they played together happily without any quarrels.

Once upon a time there was a bald man. His name was Mr. Smith. He liked to go to the museum. He liked to match up the different things he found there. He could match the different shapes, colours and sizes of the things he found. He even had a book to help him match the things the right way. He was always so happy to go to the museum. He never came back without something to match!

One day, a funny cat named Tom found a big television. Tom wanted to watch his favorite show, but he could not reach the buttons. So, he had an idea. He would push a chair to the television.

Tom pushed the chair closer and closer. Finally, he could reach the buttons. He turned on the television and found his favorite show. Tom was very happy and started to dance.

Just then, Tom's friend, a dog named Max, came in. Max saw Tom dancing and laughed. "What are you doing, Tom?" asked Max. Tom said, "I am watching my favorite show on the television! I pushed the chair to reach the buttons. Come and watch with me!" Max joined Tom, and they both had a great time watching the show and dancing together.

Once there was a little girl called Mary. Mary did not like to take a bath and she always said she was too busy.

Once there was a small girl called Annie. She was very delicate and was often sad. One day she had a special surprise - her family was taking her camping! Annie was so excited; she couldn't believe it.

When they arrived at the campsite, her parents helped her to set up the tent. She loved the way it looked; it was big and strong and kept them all safe at night.

But soon after sunset, the sky began to weep. It was raining heavily and the tent was beginning to look wet. Annie started to cry, she wanted to stay and enjoy the camping trip but now it looked like it was ruined.

But then something magical happened. The clouds parted and the stars came out. Annie saw the stars for the first time and smiled. She knew her camping trip would be special after all.

Once there was a little girl. She loved exploring and one day she went outside to the playground.
She noticed a pebble on the ground and she picked it up. It was so dull and dull. She wanted to do something with it.

The little girl decided to count with it. She put the pebble in one hand and then she used her other hand to count how many pebbles she had in her first hand. 

One, two, three ... all the way until she got to ten. She was so excited when she reached ten! She showed her mom how she could count and she was so proud of herself.

The little girl kept playing and exploring but she always had her pebble with her. Every once in while she would take out her pebble and count all over again. 

Counting was fun for the little girl and she was so happy that she found her dull pebble.

One day, a little girl named Lily went to the kitchen. She wanted to make lemon juice. She saw a big bowl on the table. Lily picked up a lemon and began to squeeze it into the bowl. The juice went into the bowl, and Lily was happy.

Just then, Lily's dog, Max, came into the kitchen. He barked loud, "Woof! Woof!" Lily said, "Max, you are so loud! I am making lemon juice. Do you want some?" Max wagged his tail and barked again, "Woof! Woof!"

Lily poured some lemon juice into a small bowl for Max. He lapped it up and made a funny face. "It's sour, isn't it, Max?" Lily giggled. Max barked softly, "Woof!" They both laughed and enjoyed the lemon juice together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Alice. She loved to go on adventures! Her favorite thing was to get her passport and check out different places around the world.

One day, Alice asked her mom if she could get her passport and go on an adventure. But her mom was feeling a bit grumpy and said no.
Alice was very unhappy and started to cry. "What did I do wrong?" she asked.

Alice's mom looked at her with a smile and said, "That's okay my darling. You can still have an adventure, just not with a passport. I can tell you a story about a far away place that would be fun for you to explore!"

Alice nodded her head and smiled. Soon, she was off exploring this magical world her mom had told her about. She had an amazing time, and realized that sometimes even without a passport you can still have a great adventure!

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play with their toys in the garden. Lily has a blue bike and Ben has a red car. They race each other and have fun.

One day, Lily's bike breaks. The wheel falls off and she falls down. She cries and Ben runs to help her.

"Are you okay, Lily?" Ben asks.

"My bike is broken. I can't ride it anymore. It makes me sad," Lily says.

Ben looks at the bike. He sees a row of screws on the wheel. He has an idea.

"I can repair your bike, Lily. I have a tool box in my house. Wait here, I will be back soon," Ben says.

He runs to his house and gets his tool box. He comes back and finds the screws. He uses a screwdriver to fix the wheel. He works hard and fast.

"Look, Lily, your bike is repaired. You can ride it again," Ben says.

Lily smiles and hugs Ben. She is happy.

"Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend. You are very clever," Lily says.

They get on their toys and race again. They laugh and have fun. They are happy.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play pretend. One day, they found a big glass jar in the kitchen. They decided to use it as a magic lamp.

"Let's pretend we are in a fairy tale and this lamp has a genie inside," said Lily.

"OK, but how do we make the genie come out?" asked Ben.

Lily thought for a moment. She remembered a story her mom had read to them. "We have to rub the lamp and say 'I believe in magic'," she said.

They took turns rubbing the lamp and saying the words. But nothing happened. They rubbed harder and louder. Still nothing.

"I don't think this lamp is magic at all," said Ben, feeling impatient. "Maybe it's broken."

Lily did not give up. She believed that there was a genie inside. She rubbed the lamp one more time and said, "I believe in magic, please come out, genie!"

Suddenly, the lid of the lamp popped open and a cloud of smoke came out. Lily and Ben gasped. They saw a bright blue figure with a long beard and a turban. It was the genie!

"Hello, little ones," the genie said with a smile. "You have awakened me from a long sleep. I am here to grant you three wishes. What do you want?"

Lily and Ben could not believe their eyes. They looked at each other and smiled. They had found a real magic lamp! They started to think of all the things they could wish for. They were very happy and excited. They thanked the genie and began to make their wishes.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Stella. Stella was a very curious three year old who loved to explore.

One day, Stella's mom decided to take her to a very special place called a palace. When they arrived, Stella's eyes sparkled in amazement. The palace garden was filled with beautiful flowers and the walls were made of shiny white stones.

Stella asked her mom, "What is this place?" Her mom replied, "This is a very popular castle. Everyone wants to visit this wonderful place!"

Stella ran through the hallways and up the grand stairways. Everywhere she looked, there was something new and exciting. She saw portraits, tapestries and many other grand decorations.

At the end of the day, Stella's mom asked her if she enjoyed the palace. She said, "Yes, it was wonderful! I would highly recommend it to all my friends!"

Sophie started to cry but then she heard a voice. It was coming from the swamp. It said, "What's the matter?"

"Oh thank you!" said Sophie. She thanked the frog several times, but the frog said, "No need to thank me, I was just being nice."

Sophie realized that he was being very selfless, when some of her other adventures had been selfish. She wanted to stay and thank the frog, but he jumped away into the swamp. "Good luck Sophie!" he said as he left.

Once upon a time there was a little girl, who loved to write. She had all the different colors of pens and paper. Every day, she would take out her paper and pens and she would write stories. 

One day, she wanted to write outside, so she went outside with her mitten. She found a nice and clean spot in the garden and sat down. All of a sudden, the little girl saw a butterfly flying above her head. She was so excited!

"Butterfly! Hello!" the little girl shouted. 
The butterfly replied, "Hello little girl, why are you here?"

The little girl smiled and said, "I am here to write a story. Can you help me?" 
The butterfly said kindly, â€œYes of course! Letâ€™s get started.â€

So the little girl and the butterfly wrote a story together and when they were done, the little girl put away her paper and pens and put on her clean mitten. She was so proud of her story that she wanted to share it with everyone! 

The End.

Once upon a time there was an uncomfortable lake. It was dark and cold, and the water looked sad. One day a little girl called Lisa decided to go near the lake. She was a brave girl, and she wanted to see what it was like.

When she got to the lake, she saw a big bird leaning over it. The bird was so tall and heavy that it was almost like it was a part of the lake itself. Lisa was scared, but then the bird opened its wings and flew away.

Now Lisa was brave enough to get closer to the lake. She leaned down and touched the cold water with her finger. It was so very cold and uncomfortable, but Lisa enjoyed the feeling. She kept leaning over the lake, until suddenly the sun came out from behind the clouds. The ugly lake suddenly started to look more friendly, and Lisa smiled happily.

Once upon a time there was a truck. It was big and yellow and it liked to go out for rides. One day, the truck was driving down the road and it saw a little girl. She was very polite. 

The truck stopped and said, "Hello there, I'm truck! Would you like to take a ride?"
The little girl nodded with excitement. 

The truck said, "Let's go look around the town. I think you'll like it!" 

The little girl smiled and said, "Thank you, Truck! That sounds like fun!"

They drove around the town and the truck pointed out lots of interesting things to the girl. They even stopped for ice cream. 

When the ride was over, the little girl said, "Thank you for the ride, Truck. That was so much fun!"

The truck smiled and answered, "You're most welcome. It was my pleasure." 

The little girl and truck waved goodbye, and the truck drove off down the road.

Once upon a time there was a spoiled giant. The giant loved taking baths, but he never wanted to take a bath when he was supposed to. One day, the giant's mom grew tired of his spoiled behavior and sat him down for a talk. The giant's mom explained that taking baths is a very important part of taking care of his health and hygiene. The giant understood and went to take a bath. 

The giant was surprised to find that taking a bath changed the way he felt. After a good clean bath, he felt fresh and happy. From then on, the giant made sure to take a bath when it was time. 

The moral of the story is that taking a bath is a very important part of being clean and healthy, and it can make you feel better too.

Once there was a big family. They had a big house and all the children were so happy. One day, the parents wanted to provide the children with a special treat.

They decided to buy each of the children a cell phone. The children were so excited to have their own phomes to play with and explore.

They each had to be careful with their phones, so the parents gave them an important lesson about being responsible and taking care of them. The kids agreed to follow the rules about being safe and taking care of their phones.

However, one of the kids was careless with his phone and he ended up breaking it. His parents were sad that he had damaged the phone and he was very sorry for being so careless.

Luckily, his parents were able to provide him with a new phone so that he and his siblings could continue to explore and have fun with their devices. The child learned his lesson and was more careful with his new phone.

Tommy loves to watch cartoons on TV. He likes the ones with funny animals and cars. He laughs when they do silly things and make noises. Sometimes he pretends to be a cartoon too.

One day, Tommy's mom says, "Tommy, it's time to go to bed. Turn off the TV and brush your teeth." Tommy does not want to go to bed. He wants to watch more cartoons. He says, "No, mom, please. Just one more cartoon. Please, please, please."

Mom says, "No, Tommy, you have to sleep. You have school tomorrow. You can watch cartoons again in the morning. Come on, let's go to your room." She takes Tommy by the hand and leads him to his room.

Tommy is sad and angry. He does not say good night to mom. He does not hug her. He just gets into his bed and pulls the blanket over his head. He covers his eyes and ears. He thinks, "Maybe if I cover myself, mom will think I'm not here. Maybe she will let me watch cartoons again."

But mom knows what Tommy is doing. She sees the blanket moving. She hears him mumbling. She smiles and says, "Tommy, I know you're under there. I can see you and hear you. You can't hide from me. I love you, Tommy. You're my sweet boy. Now, please, uncover yourself and say good night to me."

Tommy feels mom's hand on his blanket. He feels her love. He feels sorry for being rude. He uncovers himself and says, "I'm sorry, mom. I love you too. Good night, mom." He gives her a kiss and a hug. Mom says, "Good night, Tommy. Sweet dreams." She turns off the light and leaves the room.

Tommy closes his eyes and thinks about cartoons. He imagines he is a cartoon too. He smiles and falls asleep. He dreams of funny animals and cars. He dreams of mom. He is happy.

Once upon a time there was a big black bear. The bear wanted to get ready for the noon. So he raised up out of bed and started to do some exercises. He lifted his arms up high and then he lowered them down low. He jumped up and down to make his muscles strong. After the bear was done with his exercises he got ready for noon. He put on a black shirt and brushed his fur until it was shiny and smooth. He was ready for the noon! The bear smiled as he stepped out of his den and into the sunshine. He started to raise his arms and twirl around in the sun. It was a beautiful noon! He was so happy that he sang a song and smiled the whole time. After the noon passed, the bear tired and happy, curled up for a nap. He dreamed of the next noon, when he could raise his arms and sing in the sun again.

Once upon a time, there was a funny little frog named Fred. Fred liked to jump and play with his friends in the pond. One day, Fred found a stick. He thought it was a weapon, but it was just a stick.

Fred showed the stick to his friend, the fish. "Look at my weapon!" said Fred. The fish looked at the stick and laughed. "That's not a weapon, that's a stick!" said the fish. "You can't order anyone with that!"

Fred felt silly, but he still had fun playing with the stick. He and the fish took turns tossing the stick in the water and watching it float. They had a great day playing together, and they learned that a stick can be fun, even if it's not a weapon.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Jojo and Teri. They were always together, looking for fun things to do. 
One day, they decided to go outside and play. The sun was shining and the sky was blue. But as they started to play, a storm was coming. The clouds were grey and fluffy, and the wind was fierce.

Will they keep playing or will they have to go inside? Jojo and Teri smiled at each other and decided to keep playing. They teased each other, rolling around in the grass, and forgot all about the coming storm. 

But soon enough, the fierce storm was upon them. Jojo and Teri were very scared, so they ran inside quickly. The storm was very loud, and the lightning was so bright. The storm raged on and on, but eventually it passed.

The storm was gone and it was time to go outside and play again. Jojo and Teri, relieved, ran out to play once more. They laughed and joked, and Jojo even teased Teri with a flower he found. 

And from then on, no matter what, Jojo and Teri never forgot to watch out for the storm. They always enjoyed their time together and made sure to take breaks from their games to keep an eye on the sky.

Once there was a boy called Tom. Tom's mummy brought him a thermometer from the shop. It was an original thermometer, not a copy. 
Tom was very excited to see it. He wanted to show it to all of his friends, so he brought the thermometer to school. 
At school, all of Tom's friends were very impressed! They loved the original thermometer and wanted to touch it. Tom was very proud to show it off. 
He brought it back home to keep it safe. Now, Tom and his mummy can use the thermometer to measure everyone's temperature when they are not feeling well.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play together. One day, they go to the park with their moms. The park is near the city.

They see many big buildings in the city. They see cars and buses and people. They see lights and colors and shapes.

"Wow, look at the city!" Anna says. "It is so big and bright!"

"Yes, it is!" Ben says. "It is very beautiful!"

They discuss the city. They talk about what they see and what they like. They ask their moms questions.

"Mom, what is that tall building?" Anna asks.

"That is a hotel, Anna. People stay there when they visit the city," Anna's mom says.

"Mom, what is that round thing?" Ben asks.

"That is a ferris wheel, Ben. It is a ride that goes up and down and around," Ben's mom says.

Anna and Ben want to go to the city. They want to see more things and have fun. They ask their moms if they can go.

"Maybe another day, sweeties," their moms say. "Today we are here to enjoy the park."

Anna and Ben are a little sad. But they understand. They say okay. They go back to playing in the park. They have a lot of fun. They still think the city is beautiful.

Once upon a time, there was a white kite. The kite liked to fly high up in the sky. It was very happy when the wind blew it around.

One day, a little girl named Lily played with the white kite. She ran and laughed as the kite flew behind her. But then, the wind blew very strong. The white kite got stuck in a big tree.

Lily was sad. She said "sorry" to the kite. The white kite forgave her. They were still friends. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who had a tutor. Her tutor was very kind and taught her many things. One day, Lily found a secret box in her room. She was very curious about what was inside, but she couldn't open it. She asked her tutor for help, and her tutor revealed that the box was a special gift from her parents.

Lily was very happy to know that the box was a gift from her parents. She learned that it's important to ask for help when you need it. Her tutor also told her that it's important to be patient and wait for the right time to open a gift. Lily was very grateful to have such a kind and fierce tutor who always taught her important lessons. From that day on, Lily always remembered the lesson her tutor taught her and became a better person.

Lila and Ben are twins. They like to play outside in the sun. They have a big ball and a small bike. They share them and have fun.

One day, it is very hot. The sun is bright and makes them sweat. They drink some water and look for some shade. They see a big tree with thin branches. They run to the tree and sit under it.

"Ah, this is nice," Lila says. "The tree is cool and the sun is not in our eyes."

"Yes, it is," Ben agrees. "But I want to play some more. Let's go back to the ball and the bike."

"No, I don't want to," Lila says. "It is too hot. I want to stay here."

"Please, Lila," Ben says. "It is boring here. Come on, just for a little while."

"No, Ben," Lila says. "You go if you want to. I will stay here."

Ben is sad. He wants to play with his sister. He does not want to play alone. He tries to make Lila change her mind. He says nice things and funny things. He makes faces and noises. He tickles her and hugs her. But Lila does not move. She shuts her eyes and her ears. She does not listen to Ben. She does not look at Ben. She does not talk to Ben.

Ben is angry. He does not like Lila's behavior. He thinks she is selfish and rude. He decides to teach her a lesson. He takes the ball and the bike. He goes to the other side of the tree. He plays with them by himself. He makes loud sounds and happy shouts. He pretends he is having a lot of fun. He hopes Lila will hear him and feel sorry. He hopes she will come and join him.

But Lila does not hear him. She does not feel sorry. She does not come and join him. She is asleep. She is tired from the heat and the play. She is dreaming of the sun and the tree and the ball and the bike. She is dreaming of Ben and Lila. She is dreaming of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a big octopus. The octopus was very careful. It lived in a store under the sea.

One day, the octopus found a toy. The toy was lost. The octopus wanted to help. It was a careful octopus, so it did not break the toy.

The octopus took the toy to the store. It asked other sea animals if they lost a toy. At last, the octopus found the toy's home. The toy was happy, and the octopus was happy too. The end.

Once there was a boy named Jake. Jake was very excited because he was going to the zoo for the first time ever. He saw lots of cool animals like monkeys and lions. He also saw lots of birds and that made him even more excited.

At the zoo, Jake stopped at the ice cream stand and got a cone. Suddenly, Jake saw a big elephant eating his ice cream with a big fork! Jake started to cry because he didn't want to share. But then the elephant looked at him and smiled.

The elephant was very kind and offered to give Jake a bite. Jake smiled too and tried a bite. It was delicious! He was so happy! 

So Jake and the elephant shared the ice cream and everyone was happy. Jake was excited to share and the elephant was happy too. They were friends!

Once there was a little boy named Jack. He was very impatient. He walked outside and remembered there was an oasis nearby.

So he started to carry his bucket and walked to the oasis. On the way, he spotted a dragonfly and swatted at it, but it flew away. After a few more minutes of walking, he reached the oasis.

Jack was very excited. He could feel the cool water on his feet. He started to carry a bucket of water back home. Every time he took a step, he felt a little happier.

Finally he reached home. He put the water in the bucket down and ran inside to tell his mom how excited he was. He waited until his mom got back before he could go to the oasis again. Jack couldn't wait to go back!

Once upon a time, there was a brave little boy named Jack. He liked to explore his home and find new and exciting things to do. One day, Jack decided to see what was inside the oven. He opened the door and peeked inside. Jack saw the oven was very hot, so he poked it with his finger. The heat inside was so fast that Jack quickly pulled his finger away. He didn't want to get burnt. Then, he heard a funny noise coming from the oven. To his surprise, a delicious, warm cookie was there! Jack took it out of the oven and ate it. Yummy! From then on, Jack explored the oven every day, looking for fun surprises. The end.

Once upon a time, there was an orange island in the sea. It was a very special place, full of things to explore.

One day, a boat sailed to the island. A big pirate with a big beard stepped out from the boat. He was the leader of the pirates and wanted to find some treasure on the island.

The pirate explored the island, looking for something special. He found a hidden cave filled with treasure! All the pirates jumped for joy! Now they had lots of gold and jewels.

The Pirates followed their leader as he sailed away from the island. Soon the pirate ship was out of sight, leading the way on a long journey.

The orange island was soon just a tiny speck in the sea. But the lovely island still remains in the memories of the Pirates, who followed their leader and found great treasure.

Maya was a three year old girl who loved watching videos. She loved them because they were so interesting and she could learn so many new things from them.

John was a brave boy. Every morning he hopped out of bed and went to school. His teacher gave him a folder every day and asked him to perform a new task.

One day, a fast dog named Spot and a slow turtle named Tim were friends. They liked to play together. They wanted to send a letter to their friend, Cat. But they needed a stamp to send the letter.

Spot said, "I will go to the store to get a stamp. I am fast." Tim said, "I will support you, Spot. I will wait here."

Spot ran to the store very fast. But there was a big rock in the way. Spot could not jump over the rock. He was sad. Tim came and saw Spot was sad.

Tim said, "I will help you, Spot. We can go around the rock together." Spot said, "Thank you, Tim." They went around the rock and got the stamp. They sent the letter to Cat. They were happy friends.

Sara and Tom are twins. They are three years old. Today is their birthday. They are very happy. They want to celebrate.

They put on their new clothes. Sara wears a pink dress. Tom wears a blue shirt. They look at themselves in the mirror. They smile.

"You look pretty, Sara," Tom says.

"You look handsome, Tom," Sara says.

They hug each other. They are honest. They always say nice things.

They go to the living room. They see a big cake. It has candles. It has their names. They see their mom and dad. They see their friends. They see balloons and toys.

"Surprise!" everyone shouts.

Sara and Tom are very surprised. They are very excited. They clap their hands.

"Happy birthday, Sara and Tom!" everyone says.

Sara and Tom blow the candles. They make a wish. They cut the cake. They share it with everyone. They play with their friends. They open their gifts. They say thank you.

Once there was a purple butterfly who lived in a garden. Every day it flew around the garden looking for flowers to flutter near. It was a happy butterfly until one day it saw a jar of creamy butter sitting on a large rock.

The butterfly was very tempted by the butter and flew closer to get a better look. But as soon as it touched the butter it stuck to its wings! The butterfly struggled to fly away but it was too late. Its wings were so sticky that it couldn't escape.

The butterfly was so sad because it knew it couldn't fly away, it regreted its decision. Everyone hoped that the butterfly would be rescued but no one could help. The butterfly stayed stuck to the butter forever, a sad reminder of the regret it felt.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Quackers. Quackers lived on a pond with his family and friends. One day, it started to rain really hard and the pond got too full. The water started to soak the land around it, making it all wet and muddy.

Quackers and his family got really serious because they didn't want to get washed away by the rain. They decided to swim to a safer place where the land was higher and the water couldn't reach them. They swam and swam until they found a big tree on a hill. They climbed up the tree and waited for the rain to stop.

After a while, the rain stopped and the sun came out. Quackers and his family were happy because they were safe and dry. They looked down at the land below and saw that it was still wet and muddy. They knew they would have to wait a while before they could go back to their pond. But for now, they were just happy to be together and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a fancy dress that she loved to wear. One day, Lily's mom gave her a pot and asked her to walk to the garden to pick some flowers.

Lily walked to the garden and saw a big, scary dog. She was afraid and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, she remembered her pot and used it to make a loud noise. The dog got scared and ran away.

Lily picked some pretty flowers and walked back home. She showed her mom the flowers and told her about the big, scary dog. Her mom was proud of Lily for being brave and using her pot to scare the dog away. From that day on, Lily always walked with her pot, just in case she needed it again.

Mira and Leo were twins who lived in a big house with their wealthy parents. They had many toys and books and clothes, but they also liked to explore the kitchen and see what was in the fridge. Sometimes they found yummy things like cheese and fruit and juice, and sometimes they found icky things like green stuff and sour milk and smelly fish.

One day, Mira and Leo decided to play a game. They would take turns opening the fridge and picking something to eat or drink, and the other one had to try it too. Mira went first and opened the fridge. She saw a carton of chocolate milk and smiled. She loved chocolate milk. She took it out and poured some in a cup for herself and one for Leo.

"Here, Leo, drink this. It's good," she said, handing him the cup.

Leo looked at the cup and made a face. He didn't like chocolate milk. He thought it was too sweet and brown. He wanted something else.

"No, Mira, I don't want this. I want water. Water is better," he said, pushing the cup away.

Mira frowned. She didn't like water. She thought it was too plain and boring. She wanted Leo to drink the chocolate milk.

"No, Leo, you have to drink this. It's the game. You have to try what I pick. Come on, drink it," she said, trying to give him the cup again.

Leo shook his head. He didn't want to play the game anymore. He wanted to drink water.

"No, Mira, I don't have to drink this. It's not fair. You always pick what you like. I want to pick what I like. Let me open the fridge," he said, getting up from his chair.

Mira and Leo started to argue. They both wanted to open the fridge and pick something. They both wanted to have their way. They both insisted that they were right. They raised their voices and tugged at the fridge door. They didn't notice that their parents were watching them from the living room.

"Mira, Leo, what are you doing?" their mother asked, walking into the kitchen. "Why are you fighting over the fridge?"

Mira and Leo stopped and looked at their mother. They felt ashamed and sorry. They knew they had been naughty and rude. They lowered their heads and mumbled.

"We were playing a game, but we didn't agree on what to eat or drink," Mira said.

Anna was a wealthy girl who had many toys and clothes. She liked to play with her dolls and dress them up. But she did not like to share with her friends. She was selfish and mean.

One day, her friend Lily came over to play. Lily saw a beautiful doll with long hair and a pink dress. She asked Anna if she could play with it.

"No, you can't!" Anna shouted. "This is my doll and only I can play with it. Go away!"

Lily felt sad and hurt. She did not understand why Anna was so rude. She wanted to be friends with Anna, but Anna did not care about her feelings.

Anna's mother heard the noise and came to see what was wrong. She saw Anna holding the doll and Lily crying.

"Anna, what are you doing?" she asked. "Why are you being so unkind to Lily?"

"Because this is my doll and I don't want to share!" Anna said.

"Anna, that is not how you treat your friends. Sharing is good and makes others happy. Being selfish is bad and makes others sad. You have a heart, don't you? How would you feel if Lily did the same to you?"

Anna did not answer. She looked down and felt ashamed.

"Anna, you need to learn a lesson. You are going to punish yourself for being selfish. You are going to give your doll to Lily and say sorry. And you are not going to play with any of your toys for the rest of the day. Do you understand?"

Anna nodded. She did not like the idea of giving her doll to Lily and not playing with her toys. But she knew she had done wrong and had to make up for it.

She walked over to Lily and handed her the doll. She looked at her and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. I was mean to you. You can play with my doll. Do you want to be friends?"

Lily smiled and hugged Anna. She said, "Thank you, Anna. I forgive you. You are very nice. Yes, I want to be friends."

Anna felt a warm feeling in her heart. She realized that sharing was better than being selfish. She learned a valuable lesson that day. She and Lily became good friends and played happily together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One night, she was feeling very cold in her bed. So, she asked her mommy to bring her a blanket. Her mommy brought her a cozy blanket that made her feel warm and happy.

As she was snuggling under her blanket, she started to imagine a magical world where everything was made of candy. She imagined candy trees, candy houses, and candy animals. It was a very fun and sweet dream.

Once upon a time, there were two birds. They were friends, but they were different. One bird was blue and the other was red. They liked to play together on a branch. One day, the blue bird saw a shiny rock on the ground. The blue bird wanted the rock, but the red bird saw it too. The blue bird thought, "I will take the rock when the red bird is not looking." 

But the red bird saw what the blue bird was doing. The red bird whispered, "That is not nice. Friends share things." The blue bird felt bad and gave the rock to the red bird. From that day on, the blue bird learned that it is better to share with friends than to keep things for yourself.

One day, a big thief came to a small town. He wanted to take things that were not his. The people in the town were frustrated. They did not like the thief.

The zebra was excited. She said "Yes!", and the two new friends went on an adventure! They raced around the pond, jumping and swimming together. The zebra had so much fun that she didn't even care that the lion's teeth were big. From then on, they were the best of friends.

Lily and Ben were playing with their toy boats in the tub. They liked to pretend they were sailors and explorers, and they had a big harbor made of blocks and cups. They had different kinds of boats: some were big and some were small, some were red and some were blue, some had sails and some had motors.

"Look at my boat, Lily!" Ben said. "It is the biggest and the fastest and the strongest. It can go anywhere and do anything. It is a rich boat!"

Lily looked at her boat. It was smaller and slower and weaker than Ben's boat. It had a hole in its side and a broken sail. It was not a rich boat. Lily felt sad and angry.

"Your boat is not so great, Ben!" Lily said. "It is too big and too loud and too rude. It does not share or care or play nice. It is a mean boat!"

"My boat is the best, Lily!" Ben said. "It can beat your boat any day. Watch this!"

Ben took his boat and ran it into Lily's boat. He made a loud crash sound and laughed. Lily's boat flipped over and sank in the water. Lily gasped and cried.

"Ben, you are a bad boy!" Lily said. "You broke my boat and hurt my feelings. You are not my friend anymore!"

Lily took her boat and tried to fix it. She found a piece of tape and tried to attach it to the hole. She hoped it would work.

Ben saw what Lily was doing. He felt sorry and guilty.

"Lily, I am sorry," Ben said. "I was wrong to crash your boat and make you cry. I was just playing, but I played too rough. Can we be friends again?"

Ben nodded and smiled.

"Yes, Lily, we can do that," Ben said. "Your boat is a good boat. It is brave and smart and kind. It is a rich boat too!"

They took their boats and put them back in the harbor. They played together and had fun. They were happy.

"Look, Mia, I found a big shell!" Tom says. He shows Mia his shell. It is pink and smooth.

"Wow, Tom, that is a good shell!" Mia says. She wants to find one too. She looks around the sand.

Suddenly, they hear a loud noise. It is a big wave. It comes fast and high. Tom and Mia are scared. They run to their moms.

"Freeze, Tom and Mia!" their moms say. They hold their hands and tell them to stop. They do not want them to get hurt by the wave.

The wave crashes on the shore. It makes a lot of foam and spray. Tom and Mia watch it. They are safe with their moms.

"Are you okay, Tom and Mia?" their moms ask. They hug them and check them.

"Yes, mom, we are okay," Tom and Mia say. They are glad their moms are there.

Tom and Mia feel proud and happy. They thank their moms and hug them back. They still like the beach, but they also like their moms. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo lived in a small coral reef with his friends. One day, Nemo and his friends went on an adventure to the deep blue sea. They swam fast and saw many different creatures like a big whale and a funny looking crab.

As they swam deeper, they saw a big octopus hiding behind a rock. The octopus had many arms and was very big. Nemo and his friends were scared and tried to swim away fast. But the octopus was too fast and caught them in its arms.

Nemo remembered what his dad had told him about how to escape from an octopus. He leaned to the side and swam fast in the opposite direction. His friends followed him and soon they were free from the octopus's arms. They swam back to their coral reef and were happy to be safe. From that day on, Nemo and his friends knew how to escape from an octopus and they never went on an adventure without being prepared.

The end.

Ben and Lily liked to play in the garden. They had a big box of toys. They had balls, cars, dolls, and books. But their favorite toy was a big iron star. It was shiny and heavy. They liked to hold it and pretend it was magic.

One day, they saw a new sign on the fence. It said "No trespassing. Danger. Keep out." Ben and Lily were curious. They wanted to see what was behind the fence. They took their iron star and climbed over the fence. They saw a big factory. It had smoke and noise and machines. They were scared, but they wanted to explore.

They walked around the factory. They saw pipes and wires and buttons. They saw workers in helmets and gloves. They saw a big furnace. It was hot and red. Ben and Lily went closer. They saw something shiny inside the furnace. It looked like their iron star, but bigger and brighter. They wanted to touch it.

They threw their iron star into the furnace. They hoped it would make their star glow too. But they made a big mistake. The iron star was not magic. It was metal. And metal melts in the furnace. The iron star melted and made a loud bang. It made sparks and flames. It made the furnace explode.

The workers heard the explosion. They ran to the furnace. They saw Ben and Lily. They were dirty and scared, but not hurt. They were lucky. The workers were angry and worried. They asked Ben and Lily why they did that. Ben and Lily said they were sorry. They said they wanted to make their star glow.

The workers were not happy. They said Ben and Lily were naughty and foolish. They said they could have caused a big fire. They said they had to pay for the damage. They said they had to give them their iron star. But Ben and Lily said no. They said their iron star was their favorite toy. They said they loved it.

The workers saw how sad Ben and Lily were. They felt sorry for them. They remembered how they liked to play when they were little. They decided to be generous. They said Ben and Lily could keep their iron star. But they had to promise to never come back to the factory. And they had to promise to be careful with their toys.

Ben and Lily were happy. They said thank you. They said they were sorry. They said they would keep their promise. They took their iron star and climbed over the fence. They went back to the garden. They hugged their iron star. It was still shiny and heavy. But it did not glow. And they did not mind.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny loved to play outside in the forest, but he was always scared of the big animals that lived there. One day, Benny found a magazine that had a picture of a strong and brave bear on it. Benny wanted to be like the bear and protect himself from the scary animals.

Benny asked his mommy to help him make a tight cape just like the bear's. His mommy made it for him and Benny felt very brave wearing it. When he went outside to play, he saw a big wolf coming towards him. Benny remembered what he learned from the magazine and put on his cape, feeling very strong.

The wolf tried to scare Benny, but Benny stood tall and protected himself with his cape. The wolf ran away and Benny felt very proud of himself. From that day on, Benny knew that he didn't have to be scared anymore. He had his tight cape to protect him and he felt very brave. The moral of the story is that we can protect ourselves by being brave and using the things we have.

Jack couldn't believe what he was looking at - there was a big blue car parked in front of the gas station! John smiled and told Jack that the car was his and that he was allowed to drive it around if he was careful. Jack was really excited and knew that he had to be careful when driving the blue car around. From that day on, John and Jack went for drives together in the blue car and Jack became a very happy little boy.

Once upon a time there was a family that lived in a big house. Every morning the family would get up together and be ready for the day. One day the family decided to take a walk to the park. 

When they arrived, the family saw something sparkly in a bush. It was gold! They couldnâ€™t believe their luck. They all hurried over to the bush and the father was ready to lift it up. He carefully reached in and pulled out the gold. Everyone gasped in amazement - they had just found a real gold treasure!

The family was very excited. They all lifted the gold in the air and cheered. They had never seen something so beautiful! The mother said they should go home and put it in a safe place. So they hugged one another and lifted the gold off towards their home.

The family kept the gold in their home safe and sound ever since, and every time they opened it up, it reminded them of the special day when they found it. 

The end!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mary. Mary was three years old, and she loved believing in magical things.

One day, Mary found a beautiful jewel in her garden. She couldn't believe her eyes! She picked it up and it was so shiny and sparkly. Mary thought the jewel must be magical!

She kept the jewel safe in her pocket and spent the day believing in its magic. That night, she put the jewel underneath her pillow and went to sleep.

When she woke up the next morning, something very sweet had happened. When she looked for her jewel, it was gone! In its place was a bowl of yummy strawberries. 

Mary couldn't believe it! The jewel must have used its magic! She was so excited that she ate all the strawberries and smiled the rest of the day.

Anna and Ben love to sail. They have a small boat with a white sail. They take the boat to the lake with their dad. The lake is big and blue. It has many fish and ducks.

Anna and Ben sit in the boat and help their dad. They hold the rope and steer the boat. They feel the wind and the sun on their faces. They see the water splash and sparkle. They hear the birds sing and the fish jump.

Sometimes they stop the boat and look at the water. They see colorful things in the water. They see red and yellow and green and purple. They are flowers and rocks and shells. They are very pretty. Anna and Ben pick some of them and put them in a bucket. They want to show them to their mom.

They sail for a long time and have a lot of fun. They smile and laugh and sing. They are happy. They love to sail.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and sing songs. One day, Lily's mommy noticed that the sink in the kitchen was leaking. 

"Uh oh, we have a problem," said Lily's mommy.

"What problem?" asked Lily.

"The sink is leaking. We need to fix it," said her mommy.

Lily wanted to help, so she got her toy tool kit and pretended to perform a repair. Her mommy was so happy to see her trying to help. 

"Good job, Lily. You are such a helpful girl," said her mommy.

Lily was so happy to make her mommy proud. From that day on, whenever something needed fixing, Lily was always ready to perform her toy tool kit magic.

Peter was a little rabbit. One day he was feeling hot so he decided to do some exercise. He hopped up the hill. As he hopped, he felt the warm sun on his back. It was so hot!

He hopped faster and when he reached the top he was panting. He took a deep breath and hopped around. He leaped and skipped in the open field. The sun was shining very bright and everything was hot. Peter hopped for a long time. He felt happy and strong.

When the sun started to go down, Peter stopped to rest. He lay down in the warm grass and laughed. He had had so much fun exercising. Peter hopped home happily. He was tired but he had enjoyed himself. He was ready for bed.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Amy who was very shy. She never wanted to talk and her face was always red. Every day, Amy sat alone in the park, dreaming of her future. 

One day, she saw a boy carrying a pistol. She was so scared that she started to cry. The boy said "Don't be scared, I won't hurt you. I promise!"

Amy looked up at the boy and he smiled. She slowly smiled back, feeling a little bit braver. The boy said, "Would you like to come play with me?" She nodded and he showed her how to use the pistol. 

Amy was so excited that she had made a new friend. She even said a few words, speaking for the first time! She and the boy played together every day and Amy got braver and braver.

The boy and Amy promised each other that they would always be friends. And they kept that promise - forever.

Tom is a fireman. He wears a red uniform and a big hat. He drives a powerful truck with a loud siren. He helps people when there is a fire.

One day, Tom gets a call. There is a fire at a school. He and his friends rush to the scene. They see smoke and flames. They hear children crying. Tom is brave. He grabs a hose and sprays water at the fire.

"Help, help!" a voice shouts. Tom looks around. He sees a little girl trapped in a window. She is scared and hot. Tom climbs a ladder and reaches the window. He breaks the glass and pulls the girl out. He wraps her in a blanket and carries her to safety.

"Thank you, thank you!" the girl says. She hugs Tom. "You are a hero!"

Tom smiles. He is happy he saved the girl. He gives her a bottle of water. "Here, drink this. It will make you feel better."

The girl drinks the water. She feels cooler and calmer. She looks at Tom's uniform. She thinks he is very cool. She says, "When I grow up, I want to be a fireman like you!"

Tom laughs. He says, "You can be anything you want to be. Just remember to be brave and kind."

The girl nods. She says, "I will. And I will always remember you, Tom the fireman!"

The end.
