Ben and Lily ran after the cat, but they could not catch it. They lost sight of the cat and the bird. They stopped and cried. They wished they could save the bird and bring it back to its place. They felt restless and angry. They did not want to play anymore.

Their mom saw them and came to them. She hugged them and asked them what was wrong. They told her what they saw and how they felt. She said she was sorry and that she understood. She said sometimes bad things happen and we cannot stop them. She said they did their best to protect the bird and that they should be proud. She said they could still remember the bird and its song. She said they could still love the park and each other.

But Ben and Lily did not feel better. They still felt sad and restless. They wanted the bird back. They did not like the cat. They did not like the park. They did not like the day. They wanted to go home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and explore. One day, she saw a big house with a pretty garden. She decided to go inside and see what was there.

When she got inside, she saw that the house was very tidy. Everything was in its place and there was no mess anywhere. Lily saw a lady in the kitchen and said, "Hello! Your house is very tidy."

The lady smiled and said, "Thank you, dear. Would you like to touch the flowers in my garden?"

Lily was excited and ran outside to touch the flowers. They were so pretty and smelled so good. She thanked the lady and went on her way, happy and content with her adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play on the beach with her mom and dad. One day, she saw the tide coming in and it made her happy. She loved the sound of the waves and the feeling of the sand between her toes.

But then, she saw a crab that was hurt. It was trying to crawl back to the water, but it couldn't because of its hurt leg. Lily felt sad for the crab and wanted to help it. She asked her mom and dad if they could help the crab, and they said yes.

Together, they gently picked up the crab and put it back in the water. The crab was so happy and it scuttled away. Lily felt proud that they were able to improve the crab's day. She smiled and said to her parents, "I love the beach. It's fun and we can help animals too."

Once upon a time, there was a kind mommy. She had a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play at the park. There was a big slide there that he liked to go down. One day, Timmy's tummy started to rumble. He was hungry! 

Mommy knew it was time to feed Timmy. She took him to the picnic table and gave him a sandwich. Timmy ate it up and felt much better. After he was done, he went back to the slide and played some more. Timmy was happy and grateful for his kind mommy who always made sure he was fed and happy.

Sam and Lily were bored. They had no toys to play with. Their mom said they had no money to buy new toys. She said they had to use their imagination.

Sam had an idea. He saw a big cardboard box in the garage. He dragged it to the living room. He said to Lily, "Let's make a fort with this box. We can cut a door and a window. We can draw pictures on it. We can pretend it is a castle or a spaceship or a cave."

Lily nodded. She liked Sam's idea. She helped him cut and draw on the box. They used scissors and crayons and tape. They made a fort with the cardboard box. They crawled inside and closed the door.

They played for a long time. They pretended they were kings and queens, astronauts and aliens, explorers and animals. They had fun with their cardboard fort. They forgot they had no toys.

Their mom came to see them. She smiled. She said, "You two are very creative. You made a wonderful fort with a cheap box. I'm proud of you. Do you want some cookies and milk?"

Sam and Lily nodded. They came out of their fort. They hugged their mom. They said, "Thank you, mom. We love you. We love our fort. Can we keep it?"

Their mom nodded. She said, "Of course you can. As long as you don't make a mess. Now, enjoy your cookies and milk. And keep using your imagination."

Once upon a time, there was a cute bear named Ben. Ben liked to explore the forest. One day, he found a spot by a clear stream. He decided to take a soak in its cool water. 

As Ben was splashing around, he saw something glimmer. It was a gold coin on the bottom of the stream. Ben quickly grabbed it and put it in his pocket. 

Ben was so excited that he stumbled out of the stream. He was already planning what to do with his newfound treasure. Then, he heard a voice. It was coming from the other side of the stream. "Who has my gold?" 

Ben realized that the coin must have belonged to someone else. Then, suddenly a little rabbit hopped over to Ben. It was the same rabbit Ben had seen earlier. The little rabbit looked so cute, hopping around and looking for its lost treasure. 

Ben knew what to do. He quickly returned the gold coin to the little rabbit. Ben smiled as the rabbit happily hopped away. Ben was glad that he could help the bunny and he learned an important lesson that day.

Anna and Ben are friends. They like to play with blocks and cars. But today, they are not happy. They want the same car. The car is red and shiny. It makes noises when you push it.

"Give me the car!" Anna says. "It is mine!"

"No, it is mine!" Ben says. "I saw it first!"

They pull the car from each other. They are angry. They start to fight. They push and kick and shout.

"Stop it!" Mom says. She comes into the room. She sees the fight. She is frustrated. "Why are you fighting? You are friends!"

"Mom, he took my car!" Anna says.

"Mom, she took my car!" Ben says.

Mom looks at the car. She sees a sticker on it. The sticker has a name. The name is Max.

"Look, this is not your car. This is Max's car. He is your neighbor. He lent you the car yesterday. You have to give it back to him. You have to share and be nice."

Anna and Ben feel ashamed. They did not remember. They say sorry to each other. They hug and make up.

"Can we still play with the car?" Anna asks.

"Only if you take turns," Mom says. "And don't fight again."

"Okay, Mom," Anna and Ben say.

They decide to play with the car together. They have fun. They make noises and pretend to drive. They are happy again.

"Can I go first?" Anna asks.

"Sure, you can go first," Ben says. "But I dare you to go fast!"

Anna smiles. She likes a dare. She pushes the car fast. Ben cheers. They laugh and play. They are friends.

One day, a little girl named Jane found a small plant. The plant was tough and did not grow well. Jane wanted to help the plant. She asked her mom, "How can I help the plant?"

Her mom said, "Give it water and sun." So Jane did that. But the plant still did not grow. Jane was sad. She wanted her plant to be big and strong.

One day, a big dog came to play. The dog ran and jumped near the plant. Jane was scared. She said, "No, dog! You will hurt my plant!" The dog stopped and looked at Jane. Then, the dog bowed to Jane and walked away.

The next day, Jane saw that her plant had grown a little. She was happy. The plant was getting stronger. Jane knew that her love and care helped the plant grow. And the dog learned to be careful too.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Max. On a nice sunny day, Max and his family went to the park. They arrived at the park and saw a big, beautiful lawn. It was so green and grassy! Max was so excited to play on the lawn. 

Max knew that he needed to be polite, so he asked his mom and dad if he could play on the lawn. His parents said yes, so Max ran onto the lawn and started to play. He ran around in circles and laughed the whole time. Then Max took a break and sat on the lawn to rest. 

Max stayed on the lawn until it was time to go. His mom and dad said they needed to go now and thanked him for being so polite. They waved goodbye to the lawn and drove home with Max. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Ryan. He really wanted a truck. He thought to himself: "If I'm lucky, maybe I'll get a truck".

One day, he wanted to try his luck, so he put on his hat and went outside. He looked in the driveway and he saw a truck! He got so excited and cheered.

He ran to the truck and hopped in the driver's seat. He pretended to drive and he made "vroom vroom" noises like a truck. He had so much fun driving around and he felt so lucky!

Soon it was time to go back inside. He got out of the truck, waved goodbye and ran inside. He was so happy, he couldn't stop smiling. He went to bed and thought, "Maybe today I'm lucky, but tomorrow I'll be even luckier".

Once upon a time there was a great castle. Inside the castle was a prince and princess, who lived happily together. 
Every night they would listen together to the sounds of the night.
They would listen to the frogs croaking, the crickets chirping, and the wolves howling. 
One night, they heard something special. A beautiful song filled the air, and the prince and princess listened to the lovely melody. 
Suddenly, there was a bright light, and out stepped a fairy! She had come to grant them a wish for listening to her beautiful music.
The prince and princess wished for their castle to be great forever.
The fairy smiled and waved her wand, and their wish was granted.
The prince and princess lived happily in their great castle forever.

Once upon a time there was a small, blue bird named Kelly. Kelly was happy to spring out of her nest each morning and sing to her friends, the squirrels and rabbits.

Since Kelly loved to fly, she wanted to brush her feathers to make them look pretty every day. But, it was not easy to brush her feathers as they were small and delicate.

One day, Kelly asked the rabbit for help. The rabbit said, "I think it is too hard for you to do it on your own. Maybe you should ask your friends for help".

So, Kelly asked the other animals for help and it was now easy for her to brush her feathers. The other animals were happy to help Kelly, and they all celebrated by singing and dancing together.

The moral of the story is that it is always better to ask your friends for help because nothing is too hard when you do it together!

One day, Jake was on a walk with his mom. He saw an interesting log lying on the ground. He wanted to buy it, so he asked his mom. She said, "No, Jake. That log could be dangerous. Let's keep walking."

They kept walking for a bit, and then Jake saw a store! He was very excited because he knew the store sold things. He asked his mom if he could buy the log from the store. She looked at the log and said, "Yes, this log looks safe enough. Go ahead and buy it!"

When Jake got home, he was very excited to show his log to everyone. Mama suggested they use the log to build an awesome fort. Jake was so happy because he and his friends were going to have lots of fun with it!

Once upon a time there was a dog. His name was Rex and he loved to run and play. One day, while playing with his friend, they started to twist and tumble. They were having so much fun! Then, out of nowhere Rex felt a sharp pain in his paw. He yelped and stopped playing.

Rex and his friend sat in the grass and his friend said, "Let me see your paw". Rex slowly lifted it, as it was hurting a lot. His friend gasped. "Oh no!" he said. "Your paw is twisted. I think you might have broken it!"

Rex was very sad. He knew he wouldn't be able to play for a long time. He slowly limped away and went home. His days of running and playing had come to an end.

"Look, mommy!" said Jerry as he gazed at the muffin in the bakery window. The muffin was a work of art - it was a swirl of different colors, and had a chocolate chip to top it off. Jerry was in awe.

"It's beautiful, isn't it?" said Mom. "Would you like to have one?"

Jerry nodded eagerly, and Mom bought him the muffin.

As he took his first bite, Jerry savored the sweet taste of the muffin. As he continued to gaze at it, he had an idea.

"Mommy," he said excitedly, "can we make creative muffins like this one at home?"

Mom smiled. "Yes, of course we can," she said. "We can make any kind of muffins you want!"

Jerry grinned, pleased that Mom was just as excited about making muffins as he was. He couldn't wait to get home and start making his imaginative creations.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tom. Tom loved to travel to new places. He had a map that showed him all the popular spots to visit. One day, Tom decided to go on a trip to the beach with his mom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. She was a cheerful girl who loved to play outside. One day, she found a birdcage in her backyard. She was very happy and thought, "I want to find a bird for this birdcage!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, even when it was icy and cold. One day, she met a wise tutor who was very kind.

Once upon a time, there was a car named Red. Red loved to drive fast and go on adventures. One day, Red was driving on a road when he saw a sign that said "Low Fuel". Miss Kate saw the pupils playing with the expensive toy car. She knew it was not Tim's car. She asked Tim, "Where did you get this car?" Tim didn't want to tell the truth. He lied and said, "My mom bought it for me." Miss Kate knew Tim was not telling the truth. She called his mom and found out he took the car from the shop.

Tim got in big trouble. His mom was very sad and angry. She made Tim return the toy car to the shop and say sorry. Tim learned that taking things without asking is wrong. He felt bad and promised never to do it again. But because he lied, his friends and Miss Kate did not trust him anymore. Tim was very sad and lonely.

Once upon a time there was a bird who loved to fly. He lived in the forest with his friends and was the most colourful of them all. Every morning he would spread out his wings and soar up high into the sky, higher than any of the other birds.

One day he decided to fly even higher. He sailed over the trees and mountains and up into the clouds until he could go no higher. It was here he found a nice place to rest.

The bird looked down and he was right on top of a castle! He could see two people standing side by side looking up at him.

The man said, "Wow. You can really soar! You are such a special bird!"

The bird was so happy that he made it to the top of the tower. From here he could look down and see his friends in the forest far below. He flew back down to rest amongst them and kept soaring up very high each and every day.

Once upon a time there was a rat who was very fat. He lived far away from other rats and was lonely. One day, the rat found a group of other fat rats. He was so excited. He asked the other rats if he could unite with them. They all said yes!

The rat was so happy, he smiled and danced. But then one of the fat rats said, "No! He can't join us. He's different." The rat was so sad. He didn't know what to do.

The other rats saw how sad he was, and they decided to unite with him! They all held hands, and welcomed the rat into the group. Now they were all one big, happy family! They were never lonely again.

One day, Joe was playing in his bedroom. His room was a busy place. He had lots of toys and would sometimes kick them around. Joe kicked his toys in the air and he was having lots of fun. He thought nothing could ruin his day.

Suddenly, he heard a loud noise and felt a sharp pain on his foot. He looked down and saw a hole in the wall from where he had kicked his toys. 'Oh no", thought Joe. He had made a big mess.

Joe knew he would be in trouble for what he had done. He was afraid that his mom would be mad at him. He waited for her to finish her chores and when she arrived, she was very angry. She said Joe had to clean the whole room and he was very sad.

Joe worked hard to clean up the mess, but no matter what he did, he realized that he couldn't undo the harm he had caused. The day had gone very wrong and Joe learned a valuable lesson- kicking toys around can lead to bad endings.

Tim and Tom were two squirrels who lived in a big park. They liked to play and find nuts to eat. One day, they saw a big tree with many nuts on it. They ran to the tree and started to climb.

"Look at all these nuts!" Tim said. "We can have a feast!"

"Yes, and we can store some for winter!" Tom said. "But we have to be careful. There are other animals who want nuts too."

They reached the top of the tree and began to pick the nuts. They were so happy and busy that they did not notice a wild cat sneaking up on them. The cat saw the squirrels and licked its lips. It jumped on the tree and tried to catch them.

"Help! Help!" Tim and Tom shouted. "There is a wild cat!"

They dropped their nuts and ran down the tree. The cat followed them, but it was not good at climbing. It slipped and fell to the ground. It hurt its paw and ran away.

Tim and Tom were safe, but they had lost their nuts. They felt sad and hungry. They looked around and saw a group of children playing in the park. The children had a basket of nuts that they had brought for a picnic. They saw the squirrels and smiled.

"Hello, squirrels!" one of the children said. "Do you want some nuts?"

The children threw some nuts to Tim and Tom. The squirrels were surprised and happy. They ate the nuts and thanked the children.

"Thank you, children!" Tim and Tom said. "You are very kind and generous!"

The children were happy too. They liked to share and make friends. They clapped their hands and applauded the squirrels.

"Yay, squirrels!" the children said. "You are very brave and smart!"

Tim and Tom learned a lesson that day. They learned that nuts are good, but friends are better. They learned that sharing is caring, and that kindness is rewarded. They learned that wild cats are bad, but children are good. They learned to applaud the good and avoid the bad.

Once upon a time, there was a big tank near a village. Lots of fish lived in the tank and villagers loved to catch them. One day, a little boy went to the tank to catch some fish. He reached into the water, but he couldn't catch any fish. He tried and tried, but he still couldn't catch any. 

Suddenly, he saw a dead fish floating on the surface of the water. He felt sad for the fish and thought about why it had died. Then he realized that he had been trying to catch the fish all wrong. The little boy learned a valuable lesson that day. He realized that sometimes we need to change the way we do things to be kinder to others. From that day on, he always used a net to catch fish and he never hurt any of them again.

Once upon a time, there was a huge penguin named Pete. Pete lived in a cold place with lots of snow and ice. He liked to slide on his belly and swim in the water.

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. The lion was very powerful and strong. He lived in a jungle with his friends. One day, the lion decided to lead his friends to a new place. They walked and walked until it was noon. 

The sun was shining bright and they were all very tired. The lion saw a big tree and told his friends to rest under it. They all sat down and had some food. The lion was happy that he was able to lead his friends to a safe place. 

After they rested, the lion led his friends to a river where they could drink water and play. They all had fun and enjoyed their day. From that day on, the lion became the leader of their group and they all followed him wherever he went.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy who loved to explore. One day, Timmy went to a spooky house. He saw a skeleton and it scared him. He ran away and bumped into his friend, Sarah.

Once there was a wealthy family who owned a big house.

They decided to keep the glass jug forever as a reminder of their luck.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big, red balloon that she loved very much. She would hold it tight and jump up and down with excitement.

Dog and Cat were best friends. One day they were playing in the garden when they spotted something strange. It was a smelly old box. Curiosity got the better of them and the two pets decided to take a closer look. 

Dog pricked up his ears and said, "I think I can hear something inside." Cat carefully used her claws to cut open the top of the box and out popped a little purple mouse! It was holding a shiny golden key in its paws.

The mouse saw the two pets and started to shiver. It had been trying to steal the key when they found it! Dog and Cat quickly scooped it up and set it free.

The mouse thanked them and scurried away, leaving the wonderful golden key behind. Dog and Cat looked at each other in surprise and couldn't help but laugh. They had caught the thief and saved the day!

Sara and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. One day, they see a big slide. Sara wants to go on the slide. Tom is scared of the slide.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily heard a loud noise outside. She wondered what it could be.

Mom and Dad give them a big box. They open it. Inside is a car. A red car. A car that can move by itself. Tom and Lily clap their hands. They say, "Thank you, Mom and Dad!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the grass and look for insects. One day, she found a pretty butterfly with fair wings.

"Look, dad, I have a fish!" Sam says. He pulls his pole hard. The fish is big and shiny. It jumps and splashes in the water.

"I want to keep it. I want to show mom," Sam says. He is happy and proud.

Lily watches Sam and wants to catch a fish too. She throws her hook in the water and waits. She hopes a fish will bite. She thinks fishing is easy.

But no fish comes to her hook. She waits and waits. She feels bored and sad. She looks at Sam's fish in the bucket and wishes she had one too.

"Dad, why can't I catch a fish?" Lily asks. She sounds sad.

Lily smiles and hugs dad back. She looks at her fish and Sam's fish in the bucket. She feels happy and proud too.

"Can we show mom our fish?" she asks.

"Of course we can. Let's go home and show mom our fish. And maybe we can cook them for dinner," dad says.

"Yummy!" Sam and Lily say. They pick up their poles and their bucket. They walk with dad to the car. They had a good day fishing. They can't wait to tell mom.

Suddenly, the cake started to smoke and catch on fire! Lily's mommy quickly grabbed her and they ran outside. They watched as the fire trucks came and put out the fire. They were both okay, but their house was ruined. 

Lily was sad and cried, "I'm sorry, mommy. I didn't mean to make a mess." Her mommy hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. We can always make a new cake. What's important is that we're safe."

There was a kind man named Tom. Tom loved music. He liked to play jazz. Every day, he played his saxophone. His friends liked to listen to Tom play.

One day, Tom's friend, Sam, had an idea. "Let's have a music party," Sam said. "You can play jazz for us." Tom thought that was a great idea. He wanted to make his friends happy with his music.

Tom was a reliable friend. He always did what he said. So, Tom and his friends had a jazz party. They danced and laughed all day. Everyone loved Tom's music.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy bear. His name was Bob and he lived in the woods. Every week Bob did nothing all day long.

One day, Bob smelled something delicious. He followed the smell and found a campfire. He saw a hot dog and it smelled so good.

Bob got too close and his fur started to burn. He screamed and scuttled away.

The next day, Bob decided to stay away from the campfire. He thought, "It's too hot. I'm not going near it!"

But the day after that, Bob heard someone calling his name. It was his friend, Joe. 

Joe said, "Bob, why don't you join us around the campfire? It's so nice and warm! You won't get burned I promise."

Bob thought about it and decided that getting warm by the campfire would be better than being cold and lazy. He went over and stood at a safe distance and enjoyed the warm fire for the rest of the week.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big smile and loved to play with her toys. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a gift. It was a little teddy bear with a red bow.

Lily was so happy that she hugged her mommy and said "thank you". She loved her new little friend and decided to take it with her everywhere she went. Lily and her teddy bear would go on adventures together, exploring the park and playing in the sandbox.

As the sun started to go down, Lily knew it was time to go back home. She gave her little teddy bear a big hug and said "goodbye" until tomorrow. Lily went home with a smile on her face, feeling grateful for her new gift and her little friend.

One day, a little girl named Sue and her mom were talking. Sue said, "Mom, I want a holiday." Mom smiled and said, "We can plan a fun trip, but not too expensive."

They looked at a big book with pictures of places. Sue saw a picture of a beach. She said, "I want to go here!" Mom said, "That's a nice beach. Let's save money for our trip."

Sue helped Mom save money. She put coins in a jar. One day, the jar was full. Mom said, "We have enough money for our holiday!"

They went to the beach. Sue played in the sand and swam in the water. She was very happy. At the end of the day, Sue said, "Thank you, Mom, for our fun holiday!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called William. William loved to sing. He sang all the time. One day, his mum bought a vest for him. It was a warm, red vest with a pocket on the front. William loved it.

Every morning, William put on his vest and sang a song. He sang about birds in the sky, flowers in the garden and the nice sunshine. William sang so lovely that all the birds in the trees would listen.

One day, William went to the park with his mum. She found a tasty apple in the grass. William smiled and sang a happy song as he ate the apple. Everyone was happy to hear him sing. 

William kept singing wherever he went. He sang while walking, while playing and while eating his dinner. He even sang when he went to bed. William's parents were so proud to hear their little boy singing all the time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and look at all the bugs and insects. One day, she saw a butterfly and it was perfect! It had bright colors and big wings. 

Lily said, "Hello, little butterfly! Do you want to dance with me?" 

The butterfly fluttered its wings and danced with Lily. They twirled and spun around in circles. Lily was so happy to dance with the perfect insect. 

After they finished dancing, the butterfly flew away. Lily looked up at the sky and said, "Thank you for dancing with me, perfect butterfly!"

Once upon a time, there was a weak puppy. He was all alone and feeling sad. He was looking for someone to lend a friendly welcome. 

One day, he met a kind girl. She was kind and friendly and wanted to be his friend. She asked him if he wanted to borrow her toy bear. She said her bear would give him a big warm hug. 

The puppy was happy and excited. Together, they played with the bear, hugged and cuddled it. The puppy felt so much better with a friend to welcome him. He was safe and happy.

From that day on, the puppy and the girl were friends. Whenever the puppy felt weak, she would borrow her bear to him and he would feel happy and strong again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jane. She had a small room which was filled with lots of toys and decorations. One day, Jane wanted to play with her favourite ornament. She walked up to it and saw that it was dirty. She looked puzzled and said, "What happened to my ornament?" 

Then Jane heard a voice, it was her mom. She said, "I was cleaning these ornaments in your room and I didn't see your favourite one. I'm sorry it's a bit dirty now."

Jane thought hard and said, "I know what we can do. Let's go get some soap and a cloth and stand by the sink."

Her mom smiled and said, "Good idea! Let's go!"

So they went to the kitchen, found some soap and a cloth, and stood by the sink. With a few rinses, Jane and her mom cleaned the ornament and made it good as new.

Jane was really happy and said, "That looks great now. We did a wonderful job!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "You sure did! Now you can put it back in your room and enjoy it for a long time." 

Jane smiled and hugged her mom. From then on, Jane was proud of her ornament and kept it clean and sparkling.

Once there was a little boy named Jack. He was three years old and loved to play outside. 

One day, Jack was playing outside and he was running around so much that he bumped into a tree. He felt sad. He looked down and saw his sunglasses had broken. 

Jack started to cry and his mom came running out to him. She hugged him and gave him a delicious ice cream cone to make him feel better. 

Jack was so happy he started to laugh and smile again. He was glad that even though his sunglasses were broken, he still had his mom to give him a hug and yummy ice cream.

Once upon a time, there was a shy little girl named Lily. She had a model of a puppy that she loved very much. One day, Lily's big brother came into her room and accidentally knocked over her model. It fell off the table and broke into pieces. Lily was very sad and didn't know what to do. 

But then, her brother picked up the broken pieces and started to push them back together. He used some glue and soon the model was as good as new! Lily was so happy and gave her brother a big hug. From then on, Lily wasn't so shy anymore and she played with her model puppy all the time.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She loved to play and explore. One day, she was in her room when she noticed something strange.

On a shelf on the wall, there was a pale, wooden box. She hadn't seen this box before and was curious. She walked over to the shelf and asked the box why it was there.

But the box didn't answer. Instead, it stayed quiet.

The little girl thought it was strange but she decided to take a closer look. When she touched it, it opened up and inside there was a big surprise. It was filled with chocolates, sweets, and toys!

The little girl was so excited and she said happily, "Thank you, box!" She quickly took a few of her favorite sweets and ate them.

The little girl was very happy and she put the box back on the shelf where she found it. She wanted to remember to come back and thank the box for its surprise.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mommy in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mommy asked her to help make cookies. Lily was so happy and excited to help. She put on her apron and got to work.

As they were mixing the dough, Lily's mommy asked her if she was nervous about starting school soon. Lily said yes, she was nervous because she didn't know what to expect. Her mommy told her not to worry and that she would study and learn new things.

Lily felt better and they continued making the cookies. When they were finished, they put them in the oven and waited for them to bake. As they were waiting, Lily's daddy came into the kitchen and said, "Mmm, something smells delicious!" Lily proudly told him that she helped make the cookies. They all sat down together and enjoyed the yummy treats.

One day, there was an old, rough motorcycle. It was noisy and rusty, but it still ran. For a long time, it was alone. Then one day, a little girl saw the motorcycle. She was very excited and ran over to it. She liked it very much. She wanted to try it and be like a grown up.

The girl climbed onto the motorcycle and put her hands on the handles. She smiled and started pushing down on the accelerator. The motorcycle rumbled and it moved forward. The girl was happy, she was on a motorcycle adventure!

The girl continued to ride the motorcycle for a long time, but eventually she had to stop. She had to go back home. The girl said goodbye to the rough motorcycle and waved as she walked away. She would always remember the day she took her motorcycle adventure.

Anna and Ben are twins. They like to play with their toys in their room. But they do not like to tidy up their toys when they are done. Their mom always tells them to tidy up, but they do not listen.

One day, mom gives them a big book. It is a dictionary. She says it has many words and pictures. She says they can learn new words from it. Anna and Ben are curious. They open the book and look at it.

"Wow, look at this word!" Anna says. "It is elephant. It is a big animal with a long nose."

"I know that word!" Ben says. "Look at this word. It is rainbow. It is a colorful thing in the sky."

They turn the pages and find more words and pictures. They are having fun. They forget about their toys on the floor.

Mom comes to their room. She sees the dictionary on the bed and the toys on the floor. She is not happy.

"Anna and Ben, what are you doing?" she asks. "You did not tidy up your toys. You made a mess."

"Sorry, mom," Anna and Ben say. "We were looking at the dictionary. It is a nice book. It has many words and pictures."

Mom smiles. She is glad they like the dictionary. But she is still not happy about the mess.

"I am happy you like the dictionary," she says. "But you still have to tidy up your toys. You have to be responsible. You have to take care of your things."

Anna and Ben nod. They understand. They put the dictionary on the shelf. They pick up their toys and put them in the box. They make their room tidy.

Mom hugs them. She is proud of them. She says they are good twins. She says they can look at the dictionary again after they tidy up. Anna and Ben smile. They like the dictionary. They also like to make mom happy. They seem to learn a lot from the dictionary.

Once upon a time there was a friendly nap. The nap was very long and warm. It made the little girl very happy! The little girl thought of the best way to enjoy the nap. She decided to cut it up with scissors. She carefully cut the nap into small pieces. 

The little girl made the pieces into many shapes. She made them into stars and hearts. She even cut out her own face! The little girl was so excited by her friendly nap shapes that she took a nap right there. When she woke up, all of the friendly shapes were still there. 

The little girl smiled and thanked the nap for being friendly. She was so happy she had a nap to cut up. From then on, the little girl loved taking long naps and cutting them into different shapes.

Once upon a time there was a little girl. Her name was Mia. One day Mia saw a thief.
The thief had a big bag of presents and was walking away with them. Mia was angry because she knew the presents were hers! She shouted out "stop thief!"
Suddenly, a policeman came running over. He grabbed the bag from the thief and said, "these presents belong to Mia, not you. You are a fake thief!".
The policeman then gave the presents back to Mia. 
Mia was very happy and said to the policeman "thank you! You are a very nice man".
The policeman smiled and said "you are welcome, it's my job to keep people safe". Then he gave Mia a big hug and a high five.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to wear her pink scarf everywhere she went. One day, she went to the park to play with her friend, Max. Max said, "Wow, your scarf is so pretty! Is it new?" 

Lily replied, "Yes, my mommy bought it for me. She said it was very expensive." 

Max said, "I wish I had a scarf like that." 

Lily smiled and said, "I can remind my mommy to buy you one!" 

Max was happy and said, "Thank you, Lily! You're such a good friend." 

From that day on, Lily and Max played together at the park every day. They never forgot to wear their scarves and always reminded each other to bring them. They were the best of friends forever.

Once upon a time there was a sleepy poppy. The poppy was so sleepy it could barely stand. 
Suddenly, a little 3-year-old girl named Lucy came along. Lucy noticed the sleepy poppy and said, â€œHi, sleepy poppy! Would you like to come out and play?â€

The sleepy poppy responded, â€œStand happy.â€ This confused Lucy, so she asked again, â€œAre you happy?â€ The poppy replied, â€œYes, stand happy.â€ 

Lucy smiled and said, â€œWell, if youâ€™re happy letâ€™s go outside and play.â€ So, Lucy and the poppy went outside and had a fun time playing in the sunshine. 

At the end of the day, Lucy said goodbye to the poppy and thanked him for the wonderful day. The poppy quietly replied, â€œStand happy.â€ 

Lucy smiled and waved goodbye. And they both lived happily ever after.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play with toys. One day, they find a big box in the yard. The box has many screws and tools inside.

"Wow, look at this!" Tom says. He picks up a screw and a screwdriver. "I can make something with this."

"What can you make?" Mia asks. She waves a hammer in the air. "Can I help you?"

Tom nods. He is happy. He likes to share with Mia. He puts the screw on a piece of wood and turns the screwdriver. The screw goes in the wood.

"Good job, Tom!" Mia says. She claps her hands. "Can I try?"

Tom gives Mia the screwdriver and another screw. Mia puts the screw on another piece of wood and turns the screwdriver. The screw does not go in the wood. Mia tries harder. The screwdriver slips and scratches her hand.

"Ow!" Mia cries. She drops the screwdriver and the screw. She holds her hand and tears come out of her eyes.

Tom sees Mia is hurt. He feels bad. He is anxious. He does not want Mia to be sad. He puts down his wood and runs to Mia.

"I'm sorry, Mia!" Tom says. He hugs Mia and gives her a band-aid. "Are you okay?"

Mia sniffles and nods. She puts the band-aid on her hand. She smiles at Tom.

"Thank you, Tom!" Mia says. She hugs Tom back. "You are a good friend."

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play with toys. They are careful with the screws and tools. They have fun.

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to play in the park. They had a ball, a bike and a kite. They had fun running, riding and flying. They saw many things in the park: trees, flowers, birds and dogs.

One day, they saw something new in the park. It was small and brown and had a long tail. It was a rat. Tim and Sam were curious. They wanted to see the rat better. They followed the rat to a big pile of trash. The rat went inside the trash and hid.

"Let's whistle and make the rat come out," Tim said. He knew how to whistle with his mouth. He showed Sam how to do it. Sam tried to whistle, but he could only make a funny sound. Tim laughed. He whistled louder and louder.

The rat heard the whistling. It did not like the noise. It was scared and angry. It wanted to be left alone. It came out of the trash and saw Tim and Sam. It bared its teeth and hissed. It ran towards them.

Tim and Sam were scared too. They did not know the rat was mean. They turned around and ran away. But the rat was faster. It caught up with Sam and bit his leg. Sam cried out in pain. He fell to the ground. Tim ran back to help him. He kicked the rat away. He hugged Sam and called for help.

A man who was walking his dog heard the cry. He came to see what was wrong. He saw the rat, the bite and the blood. He called an ambulance. He said the rat was dirty and dangerous. He said Sam needed a shot. He said Tim and Sam should not play with rats.

Tim and Sam were sad and sorry. They did not want to play with rats. They wanted to go home. They wanted to be safe and comfortable. They learned a hard lesson. They never whistled at rats again.

Once upon a time, there was a zoo full of all kinds of animals. The zoo was very important because it was home to so many animals.

One day, a little girl named Sally went to the zoo. She loved to watch all the animals, like the noisy monkeys, the silly zebras, and the cuddly pandas.

On this day, Sally asked the zookeepers if she could lend a hand. They were very pleased and said yes!

So Sally helped the zookeepers feed the animals, clean the cages, and she even got to pet a giraffe! The zookeepers were so happy with her help that they gave her a special reward for being so kind and helpful. 

Sally was very happy to lend a hand at the zoo and it was an important lesson for her to learn.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird. He had a big, soft wing. His family lived in a tree in a gloomy forest. One day, he was all alone in the forest. Suddenly, he heard a scary noise! He got very scared and quickly flew away! He flapped his wing so hard and soon he was back with his family in the tree. Everyone was so happy to see him! The little bird was never so scared again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved soup, especially chicken soup. One day, his mom made him soup for lunch. But Timmy didn't want to eat it because he thought it was difficult to eat with a spoon.

"Mommy, soup is difficult to eat. Can I have a sandwich instead?" Timmy asked.

"No, Timmy. You need to eat your soup. It's good for you," his mom replied.

Timmy didn't want to stay at the table and eat his soup, but his mom said he couldn't leave until he finished it. So, Timmy stayed at the table and ate his soup. And you know what? He ended up liking it after all!

Once upon a time there was a dad and his daughter. Every day, the dad would come home from work and say to his daughter, "Hello, my blue daughter." The daughter would smile and then they would play together.

Sometimes they would play outside in their garden, and they would laugh when they saw all the blue flowers. Other times they would go on a bike ride and daughter would point out all the blue things she could find.

One day, the dad said, "Let's go to the blue shop and buy something fun." So they went and the daughter picked out a blue toy. She smiled and hugged the toy. 

The Dad said, "Let's go home now and play with it." They went home and had lots of fun playing together with the new blue toy. 

The daughter said, "I love you, Daddy!"  Dad then gave her a big hug and said, "I love you too, my blue daughter."

Lily was a small girl who liked to draw. She had many crayons and papers to make pictures. She wanted to show her mom and dad how much she cared for them. She decided to draw a message for them.

She took a big paper and wrote "I love you" with her red crayon. She also drew a heart and a smiley face. She was very proud of her message. She ran to the kitchen to find her mom and dad.

"Mom, dad, look what I made for you!" she said, holding up her paper.

Her mom and dad smiled and hugged her. They looked at her message and said, "Wow, Lily, this is so beautiful! Thank you for your message. We love you too, very much. You are such a sweet and caring girl."

Lily felt happy and warm. She gave her mom and dad a big kiss. She said, "You are welcome. I like to make you happy. Can I put my message on the fridge?"

Her mom and dad nodded and helped her stick her message on the fridge with a magnet. They said, "Of course you can. We will always see your message and remember how much you care for us."

Lily smiled and said, "Yay! I love you, mom and dad. You are the best."

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lucy. She loved playing outside and exploring the world. One day, she came across a big puddle. "Oh wow!â€ She beamed. â€œCome on, let's touch it!" She said to her friend, Paul.

Paul nodded and they both stepped closer to the puddle. It was warm and wet. They both reached out and touched it. â€œFeel how squishy it is!" said Lucy excitedly.

Suddenly, they heard a loud rumble. It was a storm! Rain started pouring down, and the puddle started getting bigger and bigger. Lucy laughed as the warm water splashed her. Paul grabbed her hand and they ran and jumped into the puddle. They splashed and laughed, playing until the sun came out again. 

When they were ready to go home, Lucy said, "Let's come back again tomorrow, okay Paul? We can play in the puddle again!" 

Paul smiled and said, "Yes, let's come back tomorrow!"

Bob and Sue were going to a party. They were celebrating Sue's birthday. When they arrived, Bob started kicking the ball around. He was having lots of fun. But before long, Sue came over and said, "No, Bob, don't be so foolish. It's my birthday party!" Bob stopped to listen, then gave the ball a big kick. He and Sue laughed and ran around the party together. Everyone had a great time.

Once upon a time, there was a nice little boy. His name was Jack. Jack wanted to create something special.

So one day, Jack went outside and collected some wood. He brought it back inside the house and started to create.

Jack's mom saw what Jack was doing and said: "What are you creating, Jack?"

Jack said: "I'm making something special, Mommy!"

Jack's mom smiled and said: "That's great, Jack. Let me help."

So Jack and his mom worked together. They used the wood to create a beautiful toy castle.

When they were finished, the toy castle was cold - but warm enough for Jack to play with.

Jack was so happy! He had made something special with his mom.

Mandy and Toby were best friends. Every morning, Toby would come over to Mandy's house and help her prepare for the day.
Today, Mandy was feeling tired and asked Toby for help.
"Toby, can you please help me wake up?" she asked.
Toby moved closer to Mandy and put his arms around her. He used his gentle voice and told her, "Come on Mandy, let's get up. You can do it."
Mandy slowly opened her eyes and smiled. She was thankful to have a spoiled friend like Toby by her side.
They both got out of bed and while Mandy was brushing her teeth and getting dressed, Toby prepared breakfast.
They both enjoyed their tasty breakfast together and had a lovely start to the day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play by the stream. She would skip rocks and chase butterflies all day long. One day, as she was playing, she saw a shiny key on the ground. 

Excitedly, she picked up the key and went to her mommy. "Mommy, can we find the lock that this key goes to?" she asked. 

Her mommy smiled and said, "Sure, let's go on an adventure!" They walked along the stream, looking for a lock. Suddenly, they saw a high fence with a locked gate. The key fit perfectly and they were able to unlock the gate. 

Lily was so happy that they found the lock and she got to use the key. She hugged her mommy and said, "I love going on adventures with you!"

Mum was in the kitchen. She was holding a jar and pointing to it. "Let's get some ice-cream!" She said. "Yay!" said her little daughter. She was only three years old.

Mum opened the jar and took out some ice-cream. It was cold. She put the cold ice-cream in two bowls and gave one to her daughter.

The little girl was happy and started eating her cold ice-cream. She was happy and said "Thank you, mum!" She happily ate the cold ice-cream from the jar.

Mum smiled and said "You're welcome, sweetheart!" She was happy that her daughter liked the cold treat from the jar. And they both finished their cold treats from the jar. Yum!

Once upon a time, there was a little ball named Billy. Billy loved to roll around the park. One day, he saw a big frame near the trees. It was a new thing for him, so he felt worried.

Billy called his friend, a small bird named Polly. "Polly, what is this big frame?" he asked. Polly flew closer and looked at the frame. "Don't be worried, Billy," said Polly. "It's just a frame to play with. You can roll through it."

Billy was excited to try it. He rolled through the frame and laughed. Polly cheered for him. They played together all day long. Billy was no longer worried about the frame, and he had lots of fun with his friend Polly.

Once there was a little girl and her name was Lily.
One day, Lily was playing in her back garden when she noticed something dry and round near her feet. 
She picked up the round thing and it was a wheel.
"Wow!" she thought.
She started to play with the wheel, rolling it back and forth along the path. But suddenly, the wheel rolled away from her, across to the other side of the garden. 
Lily chased after it but she was too slow.
Finally, she stopped running and saw a man with the wheel in his hand. He had a friendly smile on his face and said, "Do you want your wheel back?"
Lily nodded and gratefully took the wheel from him. 
Then, the man said, "I think it's time for you to learn how to ride a bike now. Would you like me to show you?"
"Yes please!" Lily said. 
The man smiled and together they started to teach Lily how to ride a bike. 
Lily was excited, and she knew that with the help of the wheel and the nice man, she could reach her goal.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. She was very curious and loved to explore.

One day, Sarah found a big bowl with some hairy stuff inside. She smelled it and decided to mix it with her hands. She mixed it and mixed it until it became dough.

Sarah was so proud of herself. She wanted to make something special with the dough.

She rolled the dough into small balls and put them in the oven. After a while they started to smell nice and were golden-brown.

Sarah had made cookies! She was so happy, she gave them to all her friends and family. Everyone loved them and it was the best day ever.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play together. One day, they want to act like teachers and students. Tom is the teacher and Mia is the student.

Tom says, "Mia, do you have your pencil?"

Mia says, "Yes, I have my pencil. Here it is."

Tom says, "Good. Now, write your name on this paper."

Mia tries to write her name, but the pencil is too harsh. It makes a loud noise and breaks the paper.

Mia says, "Oh no, the pencil is harsh. It hurts the paper. I can't write my name."

Tom says, "Don't worry, Mia. It's not your fault. The pencil is bad. We need a new pencil. Let's go and find one."

Tom and Mia go to look for a new pencil. They find a soft pencil that is nice to the paper. They go back to their game and write their names. They are happy. They act like teachers and students. They have fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside with her friends. One day, she saw her friend Emma playing on a swing. Lily wanted to play on the swing too, but there was only one swing.

Lily said, "Emma, can I play on the swing too?"

Emma said, "Sure, but you have to wait your turn. I'm not finished yet."

Lily waited patiently for her turn. While she waited, she saw a spider hanging from a web. She thought it was cool how the spider made a network of webs to catch its food.

When it was Lily's turn to play on the swing, Emma watched her. Emma felt a little jealous because she wanted to play on the swing again. But she didn't say anything, and Lily had fun swinging back and forth.

Jill and Joe loved to play in the park. One day as they were walking, they noticed something high up in a tree. It was a bright red box! Joe thought it must be a gift. They didn't know how to get it down so they leaned against the tree. Suddenly the box shook and fell to the ground. Jill and Joe ran to pick it up. Inside they found a toy car! They were so excited and thanked their lucky stars for the special gift. They played with the car all afternoon.

Tom likes to print. He has a big machine that makes pictures on paper. He can print animals, cars, flowers and more. He likes to print for his friends and family.

One day, Tom prints a picture of a medal. It is shiny and round and has a star on it. He thinks it is very pretty. He wants to give it to his mom, because she is the best mom in the world.

He runs to his mom and shows her the picture. He says, "Mom, look what I print for you. It is a medal. You are a star mom. I love you."

Mom smiles and hugs Tom. She says, "Thank you, Tom. This is a very nice print. You are a star son. I love you too."

She puts the print on the fridge with a magnet. Tom is happy. He thinks his mom is happy too. He thinks printing is normal, but mom thinks it is special.

Once upon a time, there was a big brown cow. The cow had a long horn on her head. She liked to play in the green grass with her friends. One day, the cow saw a big rock in the field. She wanted to show her friends the rock.

The cow went to her friend, the little duck. "Look, duck," said the cow. "I found a big rock in the field. Let's go play near the rock!" The duck was happy and said, "Yes, let's go play!"

The cow and the duck went to the rock. They played near the rock all day. They jumped over the rock and hid behind it. The sun was shining, and they had lots of fun. At the end of the day, the cow and the duck were tired but happy. They went home to rest and said, "We will come back to play near the rock again tomorrow!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to talk and play with her friends. One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She saw a boy sitting alone on a bench. Lily went up to him and said, "Hi! Do you want to play with me?"

The boy looked up and smiled. "Yes, please!" he said. Lily and the boy played together for a while. They laughed and had fun. Then, Lily's mom called her over. "Lily, it's time to go home," she said.

Lily turned to the boy and said, "Goodbye! I hope we can play again soon." The boy smiled and said, "Me too. Thank you for being my friend." Lily felt happy inside. She learned that even if you don't speak the same language, you can still have fun and be friends. Sometimes it's nice to be quiet and just play together.

One day Alice was walking down the street. She was only three years old but she was a very gifted girl. Soon she saw an old man in the street. He was standing outside a cafe and seemed very sad.

Alice walked up to him and asked why he was so sad. He said that he wanted to talk to the people inside the cafe but he didn't understand what they were saying. He told Alice he felt lonely.

Alice had an idea. She offered to be the old man's friend and showed him into the cafe. As they walked inside she explained everything the people inside were saying in words he could understand.

One day, a big bird and a small bird saw a shiny thing on a tree. They both wanted the shiny thing for themselves. They flew to the tree and tried to grab the shiny thing with their beaks.

"Mine!" said the big bird. "I saw it first!"

"No, mine!" said the small bird. "I am faster!"

They began to quarrel and peck at each other. They made a lot of noise and did not see the cat that was hiding under the tree. The cat was hungry and saw the birds as a tasty snack. He waited for the right moment to pounce.

Suddenly, a powerful wind blew and made the shiny thing fall from the tree. The big bird and the small bird stopped quarreling and looked at the shiny thing. It was a ring with a stone that sparkled in the sun.

"Wow!" they said together. "It is so pretty!"

They flew down to the ground to get the ring. But as soon as they landed, the cat jumped out of his hiding place and ran towards them. He opened his mouth and showed his sharp teeth.

"Run!" said the big bird. "The cat is here!"

They forgot about the ring and flew away as fast as they could. The cat was angry and sad. He missed his chance to catch the birds. He looked at the ring and sniffed it. It did not smell good. He did not want it. He walked away and looked for something else to eat.

The big bird and the small bird were safe. They realized that they had been silly to quarrel over the shiny thing. They apologized to each other and became friends. They decided to share the things they found and to watch out for the cat. They flew back to the tree and sang a happy song.

Once upon a time there lived an old man and a young boy. The old man loved to garden and each day he planted one bean in his garden. That's how the garden grew bigger and bigger.
