When Sally got to school, she saw that everything was different from what she expected. She saw that all the other students had the same clothing and she noticed that all of them carried a book with a feather in it. 

Sally approached one of the students and asked him what it was. The student smiled and said: "It's an ink pen with special ink that allows us to change the words we write.

Sally took the ink pen and started writing. Little did she know that the pen changed everything she wrote into a different color. She felt embarrassed but the student told her that it was a good thing. He said that it taught her a valuable lesson: no matter how noisy it may seem, one should be careful and thoughtful when making changes because sometimes, it's best to not change a thing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a purple scooter that she loved to ride. One day, Lily went to the park to play with her scooter. She saw her friend Timmy and said, "Hi Timmy! Do you want to play with me?" Timmy said, "Yes, I want to play with you and your scooter."

Lily and Timmy rode their scooters around the park. They had so much fun! But then, Lily's mom called out to her. "Lily, it's time to go home now. We have to leave." Lily said, "Okay, Mom. I'm coming." She turned to Timmy and said, "I have to go now. Bye, Timmy!" Timmy said, "Bye, Lily! I had fun riding your purple scooter." And Lily smiled and said, "I'm glad you liked it. Maybe we can play again tomorrow."

Once upon a time, there was a fairy who wanted to protect her friends. She loved them very much and wanted to keep them safe.

She flew around with her magic wand looking for a place she could feel comfortable. She wanted to find a special spot so her friends would always be safe.

She found the perfect spot in the middle of the forest. It was filled with tall trees and lots of flowers. She knew she had found a place her friends could stay.

The fairy waved her wand and made big walls to protect her friends. She made sure the walls were very strong so no bad things could get inside. 

The fairy was happy. She felt good that she could protect her friends and help them feel comfortable. The fairy smiled and hugged her friends. They were all safe and happy together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a thumb that she loved to suck on. One day, Lily's mommy told her they were going to the store. Lily got very excited and wanted to go right away, but her mommy said they had to wait until she was ready. 

When they got to the store, Lily saw lots of toys she wanted to play with. But her mommy reminded her to behave and not touch things without asking first. Lily listened to her mommy and was very good. 

After they finished shopping, Lily's mommy gave her a treat for being so well-behaved. Lily was happy and proud of herself. She went home and sucked on her thumb while playing with her new toy. The end.

The sun was shining brightly in the sky and it was a very cool day. Jack and Sally were playing in the park together. They were running around and playing tag. Jack then decided to go and pick a big fluffy cloud in the sky. 

Sally was not happy with this idea because she wanted to stay and play. She said, "No, Jack! We stay here and play tag." But Jack was determined to pick the cloud. He just had to have it.

Sally then got frustrated and tried to stop him. But Jack was too strong and he pulled himself up onto the cloud. Sally got even more angry and started to cry. But Jack was too busy picking the cloud as if he was picking some apples from a tree.

Finally, Sally shouted at Jack and said, "Stop Jack! It's not yours to pick!" Jack knew she was right so he carefully hopped down from the cloud. The two friends hugged and went back to the park to play together. It was the coolest experience ever!

Once upon a time, there was a man. The man liked to help people. One day, it rained a lot. The man saw a cat in the rain. The cat was wet and sad. The man wanted to help the cat.

The man took the cat to his home. He used a smooth towel to dry the cat. The cat liked the smooth towel. The cat was happy and warm. The man was happy too.

The man and the cat became best friends. They played together every day. The cat was always dry and happy. The man was happy too. They lived happily ever after.

On a nice day, I saw an Angel and a cloud. The Angel had beautiful wings and was wearing a white dress. She was singing loudly and happily. 

I asked her why she was singing and she said, â€œIâ€™m singing because Iâ€™m so happy! Iâ€™m singing to make the cloudy day more cheerful.â€

The cloud drifted slowly across the sky and the Angel grew quiet. I asked her if she was sad. She shook her head and smiled. â€œNo, Iâ€™m not sad. Iâ€™m just looking at how dependable the clouds are. Theyâ€™re always there no matter what.â€

She started singing again and soon I joined her. We sang until the sun came out and the clouds cleared away. Then we said goodbye. The Angel flew up to the sky and the cloud drifted away.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went outside to play with her toys. She had a doll that was very delicate, and she loved it very much. She held it close to her and said, "I love you, my pretty doll."

Suddenly, Lily's little brother came running outside. He was playing with a ball, and accidentally hit the delicate doll. Lily was very upset and said, "You broke my doll! It's a delicate object and now it needs to rest."

Her brother felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, Lily. I didn't mean to break your doll. Can I help you fix it?" Lily thought for a moment and said, "Yes, that would be nice. Thank you for offering." They worked together to fix the delicate doll and it was as good as new. From that day on, Lily's brother was more careful around her toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom loved to play with his toys and cuddle with his favorite blanket. Every night, Tom's mom would tuck him into bed with his cozy sheet and kiss him goodnight.

One night, Tom's mom seemed worried when she set his sheet on the bed. Tom didn't understand why, but he felt a little scared. As he drifted off to sleep, he heard a strange noise outside his window.

Tom's heart raced as he peeked out from under his sheet. Suddenly, a gust of wind blew the sheet off of him and onto the floor. But then, he saw something amazing - his favorite toy had fallen out of bed and onto the sheet, making it look like a magic carpet!

Tom hopped onto the sheet and rode it out the window, soaring through the night sky. He knew that he didn't have to be worried anymore, because he had his trusty sheet and his favorite toy by his side. From that night on, Tom never forgot the power of his sheet and the joy of a little bit of magic.

Once there was a fox who was very thirsty. He looked around for something to drink, but he could not find anything. He was getting very worried.

Then he saw something - a big pond with lots of water inside! The fox was so happy. He went to the edge of the pond and drank and drank. He drank so much water that he wasn't thirsty anymore!

The fox went back home feeling happy and satisfied. He knew he was lucky to have found the pond full of water. He would never forget it.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Sam. He was three years old and liked to play with his friends.

One day, Sam and his friends were playing hide and seek in the park. All of a sudden, Sam saw something shiny in the grass. It was a big, yellow lemon! He wanted to pick it up, but he knew he shouldn't.

He ran back to his friends and asked if anyone knew whose lemon it was. His friend Petey said, "I think it's Mrs. Smith's lemon tree. She won't be happy if you take it!"

Sam felt guilty, but he couldn't resist the temptation. He slowly gained the lemon and put it in his pocket.

Sam continued to play with his friends, but he couldn't stop thinking about the lemon. After a while, he decided to do the right thing and take the lemon back to Mrs. Smith.

When Sam got to Mrs. Smith's house, she was very pleased. She said, "Thank you for being a good person, Sam. You did the right thing."

Sam smiled. He was glad that he learned that it's always better to do the right thing.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing with her toy cars and pretending to drive them around. One day, she saw a great big car parked outside her house. It was so big that she couldn't even see the top of it!

Lily went to her mom and said, "Mommy, look at the great big car outside! Can we go see it?"

Her mom said, "Sure, let's go take a look." So they went outside to see the car. As they were standing there, a man came up to them and said, "Excuse me, do you know whose car this is?"

Lily's mom said, "No, we don't. Why?"

The man said, "Well, it's blocking my driveway and I can't get my car out. I need to leave for work soon."

Lily's mom apologized and they quickly moved the car so the man could leave. From then on, Lily always made sure to be careful where she parked her toy cars so she wouldn't cause any problems for others.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went for a walk in the park with her mom. Lily loved to run and jump, but her mom told her to be careful because the ground was wet from the rain. Suddenly, Lily saw a big puddle in front of her and she wanted to jump in it. 

Her mom said, "Lily, be careful! The water is very heavy and you might get wet." 

Lily replied, "Mommy, I want to jump in the puddle! Can I step in it just one time?" 

Her mom smiled and said, "Okay, but just one step." 

Lily took one big step and felt the spring in the water. She giggled and said, "That was fun! Can we do it again?" 

Her mom laughed and said, "Maybe next time, Lily." And they continued their walk in the park.

Max was a curious 3-year-old boy. He liked to explore the world around him. One day, he was visiting his grandmother's house and he found a mattress in her bedroom. He wanted to touch it and it looked so soft, so he reached out and touched it. 

But the mattress was fragile and his touch made it crumble. His grandma shouted in surprise. Max felt worried and guilty. He had broken his grandma's mattress. 

His grandma knew that mistakes happen and was gentle with him. She hugged him and said, "Don't worry Max, accidents happen." His grandma then got him to help her find something that could be used to fix the mattress. They found a patch and his grandma showed him how to put it on.

Max was so proud that he had helped fix his grandma's mattress. He touched the patch and smiled. Now the mattress was good as new!

John was on a special trip. Everywhere he went he liked to wander around. As he wandered, he saw something that caught his eye. It was a very gentle treat. It was a very sweet stallion! John just had to take it home with him.

He came up close to the horse and stroked it's very gentle mane. The horse seemed to trust John. Suddenly, the horse followed him. He was absolutely amazed! He couldn't believe his luck!

John took the horse home with him and was so excited to show his mom! She was also amazed and smiled very widely. They fed the horse and gave it some special treats. They even took it on a walk and wandered around the park.

John and his mom had a wonderful time with their new horse. They spent many days together and enjoyed the gentle horse's company. John was so delighted to have the horse as a new friend.

Jimmy wanted to create something new. He went to the big bin in the garage and started to look for interesting things. There were lots of bits of cardboard and plastic. Some were boring, but others were colourful and exciting.

He took some of the pieces and created a model rocket. He used glue to stick them all together, and threaded a piece of string through the rocket so he could fly it. He went outside and flew it around in the garden.

Jimmy tried different shapes and colours each time he created something. He was very excited by what he could make. He was so busy that he forgot to check the time and it started to get dark.

His parents found him sitting in the middle of the bin looking for more materials. They couldn't help laughing because Jimmy was so creative. They took him inside and explained that he had to wait until tomorrow to create more things. Jimmy didn't mind though; he had had a fun time!

Once upon a time, there was a little ant named Andy. Andy lived in a big garden with his family and friends. One day, Andy saw a big computer in the garden. He crawled up to it and looked at it. He felt helpless because he didn't know what it was.

Andy went back to his ant hill and told his family and friends about the strange thing he saw. His friend, Annie, said, "Maybe we can ask the humans what it is." Andy thought that was a good idea, so he crawled back to the computer and waited for a human to come.

Soon, a little girl came to the garden. Andy crawled up to her and said, "Excuse me, can you help us? We don't know what this thing is." The little girl smiled and said, "That's a computer. It helps people do things like play games and write stories." Andy and his friends were very happy to learn about the computer. They thanked the little girl and crawled back to their ant hill, excited to share their new knowledge with their family and friends.

One day, a little girl named Lucy discovered a yellow pond. It was sparkling in the sun and filled with fish. Lucy was curious. She wanted to know what was in the water. She put her hand in the pond and felt something cold and slimy! It was a frog! It was yellow too! Lucy was so excited that she squealed with joy. She then lifted the frog out of the pond and admired its beauty. It blinked at her with its big eyes and made a funny sound. Then it hopped away. From that day on, the yellow pond was one of Lucy's favorite places. She often returned to discover what new surprises the pond would offer her.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a telephone to use. Timmy was very excited to use the telephone.

Timmy picked up the telephone and said, "Hello, who is there?" But no one answered because the person on the other side was very distant. Timmy was sad that he couldn't talk to anyone.

Then, Timmy's mom told him that sometimes people are too far away to talk on the telephone. She said that it's important to talk to people who are close to us and to spend time with them. Timmy learned that it's not always about the things we use, but the people we spend time with that make us happy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very good. She liked to help her mom around the house and in the garden. 
One day, the little girl decided to help her mom cook dinner. As she was getting the ingredients together, she spotted a funny-looking thing in the cupboard. She took it out and asked her mom what it was. 
Her mom said it was called ash and that it was used for cooking. The little girl put a little bit of ash in the pot and stirred it around.

When the food was ready, it smelled really good. The little girl tasted it and it was delicious! She had settled the ingredients just right. All the flavors had melded together perfectly.

The little girl felt proud of herself for settling the ingredients so nicely. From that day on, she kept helping her mom in the kitchen and always settled the ingredients the right way.

One day, a young boy named Jose ventured out on a wonderful adventure. As he walked, he could feel the warm sun stretching out its arms on his back. It felt so nice! 

Soon, Jose noticed something strange in the grass. He bent down to take a closer look and saw a tiny print. It was so small, but it was there. He became curious and followed the print, stretching his legs as he walked. 

The print lead Jose to a humble house in the woods. He knocked and a kind old woman opened the door. She handed him a package of tasty treats and said they were just for him--a reward for following the print. 

Jose thanked the old woman and went on his way. He ate the treats as he walked and smiled, for his wonderful adventure was over.

Once upon a time there was a lady who wanted to give a special gift. She thought and thought about what to give and finally came up with an idea.

The lady went to a shop and bought some blocks and pieces. She brought them home and put them together to make a structure. Everyone was amazed at how tall it was! It was so big that it almost touched the sky!

The lady loved the structure very much, but one day something bad happened; someone rude came along and destroyed the structure. The lady was very sad and almost cried.

But then, something wonderful happened. All the people around her came together and helped her build the structure again. They put all the blocks and pieces together and soon it was back in its original state.

The lady was so very happy! She thanked everyone for their help, understanding how important it was to her.

From that day forward, the lady was very careful to make sure nothing bad ever happened to the structure again.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Bob and Sally. They liked to play games together. One day they were playing a game that was very tough. Bob wanted to keep playing but Sally thought it was too hard and wanted to quit. 

Bob tried to talk Sally into staying, but she just shook her head. She said she was tired and wanted to quit. Bob felt disappointed, but still wanted to be friends. So he promised Sally they could find another game later. 

That made Sally smile. She said goodbye to Bob and they hugged. Bob said they should find an easier game the next time they played. Sally agreed with Bob and went home. 

Bob went to find a new game and soon found one that was fun but not too tough. Now he and Sally can play this game together and have lots of fun. The End.

Maisy was a 3 year old girl who wanted to succeed. She wanted to be like her parents and do something special. She thought about it for a long time. 

One day, Maisy saw a gorilla. He was a big, strong animal who looked like he could do anything. She watched him silently, admiring how he easily carried heavy things. Maisy wanted to be like the gorilla and succeed.

So, she decided to work hard. She practiced picking up heavy things and carried them from one place to another. She also learned how to swing from tree to tree, like the gorilla, while holding the heavy things. She kept practicing and practicing, and eventually, she succeeded. 

Maisy was so proud of herself. She saw that if you worked hard and never gave up, you could do anything you wanted.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Today was his first day of school and he was so eager to go. He put on his new shoes and backpack and waved goodbye to his mommy.

When Timmy got to school, he felt a little scared. But his teacher, Mrs. Smith, gave him a big smile and encouraged him to have fun. Timmy made some new friends and played games with them.

At the end of the day, Timmy felt very happy. He couldn't wait to go back to school tomorrow. He told his mommy all about his day and she was so proud of him. Timmy went to bed with a big smile on his face, feeling encouraged and excited for tomorrow.

Lily and Tom were friends. They liked to play outside. One day, it was raining. Lily and Tom did not like rain. They wanted to see the sun.

Lily had a big umbrella. It was pink and had flowers on it. She said to Tom, "Let's use my umbrella. We can go for a walk and look for rainbows." Tom nodded. He liked rainbows. They were pretty.

They put on their boots and coats. Lily opened her umbrella. They held hands and walked out the door. They splashed in the puddles. They saw a worm. Tom said, "Ew, that is disgusting." Lily said, "No, it is not. It is just a worm. It likes the rain." She picked up the worm and put it on a leaf. She smiled. She liked worms. They were funny.

They walked some more. They saw a snail. Lily said, "Look, a snail. It has a shell on its back. It is slow." Tom said, "Yes, it is slow. It is boring." He poked the snail with a stick. The snail hid in its shell. Tom laughed. He liked to tease snails. They were silly.

They walked some more. They saw a rainbow. Lily and Tom said, "Wow, a rainbow. It has many colors. It is beautiful." They smiled. They liked rainbows. They were happy. They hugged each other. They said, "We are friends. We like to play outside. Even when it rains." They walked back home. They had fun.

Once there was a clever girl called Molly who had a lovely blouse with white flowers. Every day when she wore it she felt so happy. But one day she noticed something was wrong with the blouse. A button had fallen off!

Molly was very sad and tried to fix her blouse but she couldn't do it. She asked her mum to help and her mum said she was too busy. Molly was about to give up but then she had an idea.

She asked her dad for help and he said yes! He was very clever and soon he fixed her blouse with a shiny new button. Molly was so pleased to have her special blouse back and she gave her dad a big hug!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited to go to the mall with her mommy. They walked around and looked at all the stores. Suddenly, they saw an elevator and Lily wanted to go inside. 

"Mommy, can we go up and down in the elevator?" Lily asked.

"Sure, let's go!" her mommy replied.

They went inside the elevator and went up and down. It was so much fun! After that, they went to a store and saw a very expensive toy.

"Mommy, can I have that toy?" Lily asked.

"No, it's too expensive," her mommy replied.

Lily was sad, but then she saw a spring toy that was much cheaper. She was so happy and played with it all day. The end.

Once upon a time there was a pesky bunny who loved the outdoors. He liked to explore and never wanted to stay put. One day, the bunny decided to take a walk in the woods. As he hop hopped around, exploring the space, something caught his eye. It was a stubborn, old stump. The bunny wanted to cover the stump with something and give it a lovely surprise.

But what to use? Suddenly, he had an idea. He hopped off to go and find something to cover the stump with.

After a while, he had gathered enough leaves and branches to cover the whole stump. He hopped around it, and carefully placed each leaf and branch over the stump until he had covered it completely.

The bunny then stepped back to admire his work! "Wow," he thought, "it looks so nice and warm, just like a little home!" He hopped around it happily and decided to name the whole thing 'Bunny's House'.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a friend named Sally. Sally was very nice and they liked to play together. One day, Timmy and Sally were playing with a ball. Timmy tried to throw the ball to Sally, but it went the wrong way. Timmy didn't know what to do, so he shrugged his shoulders. Sally said it was okay and showed Timmy how to be more flexible with his throws. From then on, Timmy and Sally had even more fun playing together. The end.

Once upon a time there was a mom and a dad who had a huge garden. One day, mom noticed that the needles of a evergreen bush were starting to dry up.

"Oh dear, what can we do to prevent this?", said mom.
Dad thought for a moment, then he said: "I know, we will get a huge bucket of water and moisten the needles so they don't dry out."

So they did just that, they got a huge bucket filled with water and poured it carefully on the branches of the evergreen bush. Soon the needles were lush and full of moisture again.

The mom and dad were very pleased with themselves. "See?", said dad. "Sometimes we just need a needle and a lot of water!"

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Emily. She had a mop she loved. Every day, she used it to sweep her room. She was so proud of it. 

One day, Emily was using her mop and it slipped out of her hands. It fell onto the floor and the handle broke. Emily was frightened. She didn't know what to do.

Then, her mommy came in. She saw what had happened and smiled. She asked Emily to get a broom from the pantry. Emily did what she said, and in no time, she had swept up all the pieces of broken mop.

Then, Emily's mommy took her to the store. They bought a new mop and when they got home, Emily used it to sweep her room. She was so excited. 

The end!

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a modern pond. All the animals liked to play near the pond. One day, a duck and a frog had a little fight. The duck did not permit the frog to play in the pond.

The frog was very sad. He went to his mom and told her about the duck. The mom frog said, "Do not worry, my little frog. Let's talk to the duck's mom."

So, the frog and his mom went to the duck's mom. They told her about the fight. The duck's mom said, "I will talk to my little duck. He should permit all friends to play in the pond."

The next day, the duck said sorry to the frog. They played together in the modern pond. All the animals were happy again. They knew that sharing the pond was the best way to have fun.

Once there was a little girl named Lidia. She had purple hair and skin. She was very special.

Every day, Lidia liked to go outside and play. As she played, she would grow bigger and bigger. Her hair even got longer and her legs grew.

One day, a butterfly flew over to Lidia. It was bright purple with orange spots. Lidia loved the butterfly, and it felt the same way about her.

The butterfly taught Lidia about the world. They talked about colors and nature. Soon, Lidia grew to love everything around her.

Every day, Lidia and the butterfly would play together, and she would grow a little more. Eventually, Lidia was so big she could run and jump. She felt smarter and wiser.

Lidia was so grateful to the purple butterfly for teaching her and helping her grow. From then on, the girl and the butterfly were the best of friends.

Once upon a time there was a mummy and a baby. The mummy loved the baby and the baby loved the mummy.

One evening, the baby was feeling sleepy so the mummy picked him up and held him close. The baby gave the mummy a hug and snuggled into her neck.

The mummy kissed the baby on the cheek and said, "Goodnight my sweet baby. You are so special."

The baby smiled and said, "Kiss me on the waist."

The mummy laughed and gave the baby a kiss right on his tiny waist.

The baby smiled again and said, "Thank you mummy!"

The mummy said, "You're welcome my love. Now go to sleep - it is time for bed."

The mummy and the baby hugged one more time, and then the baby fell asleep. He was so sleepy and happy, with a big smile on his face. 

The End.

Ben and Lily were having lunch with Mom and Dad. They liked to eat cheese sandwiches and apple juice. Mom gave them each a napkin to wipe their mouths. Ben and Lily said thank you.

After lunch, Mom and Dad said they had to do some work. They told Ben and Lily to play quietly in their room. Ben and Lily nodded. They went to their room and took out their toys. They had a lot of fun playing with their cars and dolls.

But soon, Ben and Lily felt sleepy. They yawned and rubbed their eyes. They decided to take a nap on their beds. They put away their toys and climbed on their beds. They pulled their blankets over them and closed their eyes.

But Ben forgot something. He forgot to put his napkin in the trash. He left it on the floor next to his bed. He did not notice it. He fell asleep.

A little later, a mouse came into their room. The mouse smelled the cheese on the napkin. The mouse was hungry. It ran to the napkin and started to nibble on it. It made a lot of noise.

Ben heard the noise. He opened his eyes and saw the mouse. He was scared. He screamed. "Lily, Lily, there is a mouse on my napkin!"

Lily heard Ben scream. She opened her eyes and saw the mouse too. She was scared too. She screamed. "Mom, Dad, there is a mouse in our room!"

Mom and Dad heard Ben and Lily scream. They ran to their room and saw the mouse. They were not scared. They shooed the mouse away and took the napkin. They told Ben and Lily to calm down. They said it was just a little mouse. They said they should always put their napkins in the trash.

Ben and Lily said they were sorry. They said they would not forget again. They hugged Mom and Dad. They said they loved them. Mom and Dad said they loved them too. They said they could finish their nap or play some more. Ben and Lily said they wanted to nap. They were still sleepy. They cuddled with Mom and Dad and fell asleep again. The mouse did not come back.

Once there was a strong man. He lived near the beach and he loved going for walks in the sand. 
One day the strong man went for a long walk. He walked and walked, until he could walk no more. He sat down in the sand and was determined to remain there until he found something special. He looked around but all he could see was sand.

Suddenly, he noticed something sparkling in the sand. He reached out, and pulled out a beautiful rare diamond. He was so happy. He climbed back up to his feet and hugged the diamond close to his chest.

The strong man never forgot the lesson that he had learnt - that if you remain patient and strong you will be rewarded. No matter what the sand might hide, it will always be filled with surprises.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the park with her friends. One day, Lily and her friends found a treasure map. The map showed that the treasure was under a big tree.

Lily said, "Let's follow the map and find the treasure!" Her friends agreed and followed her. Lily led the way and they walked to the big tree. They looked under it and found a box full of shiny jewels!

One of Lily's friends said, "Wow, Lily! You're not stupid, you're a great leader!" Lily smiled and said, "Thanks, friends! Let's share the treasure!" They all cheered and ran home to show their families. It was a fun day at the park for Lily and her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a mighty elephant who loved to swing on the trees. One day, the elephant saw a little bird who was very sad. The bird said that she was hungry and couldn't find any food to eat. The elephant felt sad for the little bird and decided to help.

The elephant went to the nearby tree and found a big avocado. He picked it up with his trunk and gave it to the little bird. The bird was very happy and thanked the elephant. The elephant felt very happy too.

The moral of the story is that it's always good to help others, even if you are mighty and strong.

Once, there was a cute little dog. He went to the park to do fun things. He saw a shelter there and wanted to do something inside it. He went in and it felt nice and warm. He played and played, and he felt happy.

The dog went back to the shelter every day. He would do nice things, like sleep and eat a yummy bone. He also made friends with some other dogs who liked the shelter too.

One day it was raining, and the little dog was scared. He wondered what to do. Then he thought about the shelter. He ran over and quickly went inside. He was glad he had a shelter to keep him safe and warm from the rain.

He stayed in the shelter until the rain stopped. After that, he went back to the park. He had lots of fun, and he was glad he had a shelter to go to when he needed one.

Once upon a time, there was a well. It was very mysterious. No one knew what was inside. Everyone wanted to test it, but no one was brave enough.

One day, a brave three year old wanted to test the well. He had some friends with him. They all were so excited! The three year old climbed down the ladder inside the well.

When he reached the bottom, it was very dark and scary. But after searching around, he found something. It was a secret room filled with treasures. He grabbed some and showed his friends.

Their faces lit up when they saw what he had found. What a great test that was! They all couldn't believe it. What a mystery the well was!

Once upon a time there was a big, fluffy pillow. It was very, very soft. The pillow was sitting in the middle of an icy lake. 

A small boy walked up to the lake. He looked around, but he couldn't see the pillow. The lake was cold and icy, and the little boy was freezing! 

The little boy plucked up the courage to walk bravely into the icy water. When he reached the pillow he was surprised. He thought it was so comfy! He quickly scooped it up and sat down on it in the middle of the lake. 

The little boy closed his eyes and drifted off to sleep, snuggled safely on his pillow. He had a peaceful sleep until morning, when the icy water became warmer and the sun rose. 

The little boy blinked his eyes open and looked around. He had a big smile as he realised he was still sitting on his pillow in the middle of the lake. He stood up and gathered it in his arms, and ran happily to his warm home with his pillow.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a nice toy car that he loved to play with. One day, Timmy accidentally dropped his toy car and it broke into many pieces. Timmy was sad and didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, Timmy saw some smoke coming from the kitchen. His mommy was cooking dinner and the food smelled nice. Timmy forgot about his broken toy car and ran to the kitchen. 

After dinner, Timmy went to bed feeling sad about his toy car. But the next morning, Timmy woke up to a surprise. His mommy had fixed his toy car and it looked as good as new! Timmy was so happy and played with his toy car all day long.

Tom and Sam were friends who liked to play with boats. They had many boats of different colors and sizes. They pretended to be sailors and went on adventures on the water.

One day, Tom had a new boat. It was big and red and shiny. It had a great sail with a star on it. Tom was very proud of his boat. He showed it to Sam and said, "Look at my boat. It is the best boat ever. Do you want to play with it?"

Sam looked at the boat and felt jealous. He wanted to have a boat like that. He said, "No, I don't want to play with your boat. It is not a good boat. It is too big and too red and too shiny. It will sink in the water. My boat is better. It is small and blue and smooth. It can go fast and far. Let's play with my boat."

Tom was angry. He did not like what Sam said. He said, "No, your boat is not better. It is too small and too blue and too smooth. It will get lost in the water. My boat is better. It can catch the wind and fly. Let's play with my boat."

Sam and Tom started to argue. They shouted and pushed each other. They did not want to share or play together. They wanted to have the best boat.

Then, a big dog came. It saw the boats and thought they were toys. It ran to the boats and grabbed them with its mouth. It bit and tore and chewed them. It made them into pieces. Sam and Tom stopped arguing and looked at the dog. They were shocked and sad. They cried and ran to their boats. But it was too late. The boats were broken and ruined. The dog ran away with the pieces.

Sam and Tom had no boats to play with. They had no friends to play with. They had nothing but their tears. They wished they had not fought. They wished they had listened to each other. They wished they had suggested to play with both boats. But it was too late. The end.

Once there was a little girl. She was three years old and loved to play with her toys. One day, the girl found a new toy. It was a test! She was so excited and decided to try it out. 

But the test was too hard! The girl got frustrated and said the test was stupid. She was sad and tried to figure out the answer but she couldn't. 

The girl's mom saw her and said, "Don't worry. Let's find something easier for you to do." They found a much simpler toy and the little girl was thrilled! She played with the new toy and had much more fun.

The lesson the girl learned was not to give up. She was very proud of herself and promised never to call anything stupid again.  That's why the little girl loves to play with her toys!

Once upon a time there was a brave girl named Lucy. She was invited to a fancy party. Her invitation was special because it was made of nice paper and had glittery blue letters. 

But when the day of the party came, the sky turned dark and it started to rain. Lucy was worried the party would be cancelled.

When she rock up to the party, she noticed that everything was wet. The party was still on though. Lucy was happy and she danced and laughed. 

But then, disaster struck! The rain had made the ground so wet that it started to rock. The party was in danger!

In an act of bravery, Lucy quickly asked everyone to join hands and rock together. The rocking absorbed some of the shock and the party was saved!

Tony and Sara were best friends. Every day they played together in the park. One day they wanted to play tag, but Sara wanted to go one way and Tony wanted to go the other.

The two began to fight. Tony yelled that he wanted to run the other way and Sara screamed back that she wanted to go the other. They both were getting madder and madder.

Their faces were red and they were shouting crazy words. Suddenly, a yellow butterfly flew between them. They both stopped fighting and watched the butterfly flutter around them.

The butterfly made Tony and Sara laugh and remember why they were best friends. They both smiled and then ran off together, chasing the butterfly in the park.

One day, Dave and his mom decided to take a trip. They packed their things and drove to the harbor. There, they saw lots of boats, but the biggest one was a harmless looking tugboat.

At first they were scared to get on such a big boat, but Dave's mom gave him a hug and said, "It's okay. When you try something new, it might seem scary but if it looks harmless, it is safe to try it."

So they got on the tugboat, and it was the best ride ever. Dave was so happy! When they got back to shore, his mom gave him another hug and said, "What have we learned today, Dave?"

Dave thought for a moment and then said, "That even when things look unfamiliar, if they seem harmless, it's okay to try them out." 

His mom smiled and nodded. "That's right! It's important to be brave and explore new things, but only if they look harmless." 

That day, Dave learned an important lesson about being brave and trying new things if they seem safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Andy. He loved to explore and watch the world around him. Everywhere he went, Andy was curious and wanted to know more.

One day, Andy saw an interesting clock. He was very curious and asked his mom, "What's that?"
