Tom and Lily were playing with their toys in the living room. They had a lot of fun making noises and pretending to be animals. Tom was a lion and Lily was a zebra. They chased each other around the couch and the table.

But then they saw a big plate of cookies on the kitchen counter. They both wanted a cookie very much. They ran to the kitchen and tried to reach the plate. But it was too high for them. They jumped and stretched, but they could not get a cookie.

They looked at each other and had an idea. They decided to work together. Tom climbed on a chair and Lily climbed on his back. They were very careful not to fall. Tom reached the plate and grabbed a cookie. He gave it to Lily and she smiled. Then he took another cookie for himself.

They climbed down and ran back to the living room. They sat on the floor and ate their cookies. They were very happy and proud. They shared their cookies with their toys and pretended they were having a party.

But then they heard their mom coming. She saw the plate on the counter and the crumbs on the floor. She knew what they had done. She was not happy. She asked them who took the cookies.

Tom and Lily looked at each other and felt scared. They did not want to get in trouble. They did not know what to say. They thought mom would be angry and take away their toys.

But then they had another idea. They decided to be honest. They said they were sorry and they took the cookies. They said they were hungry and they worked together. They said they would not do it again.

Mom looked at them and smiled. She was not angry. She was glad they told the truth. She said they were good kids and she loved them. She said they could have one more cookie each, but only after dinner. She said they had to clean up the mess and wash their hands.

Tom and Lily said thank you and hugged mom. They were happy and relieved. They cleaned up the mess and washed their hands. They went back to the living room and played with their toys. They said they would not take cookies without asking again. They said they would always tell the truth. They said they were the best team ever. They said they had a funny day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Emily. She loved to go to the park with her dad. Today, though, Emily was feeling very sad. Her dad asked her why she was so sad and Emily said, "My shirt is old and doesn't fit me anymore."

Her dad said, "That's okay, Emily. We will go out and find you a new shirt." So they went to the store and Emily picked out a pretty, new shirt.

When they got home, Emily said, "I feel better now that I have a new shirt!" Her dad smiled and said, "It's important to replace things when they get old or worn out. That way, we can all stay healthy!"

Emily felt very happy and hugged her dad. She said, "Thanks daddy!" And they both smiled, happy to be together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went to her grandma's house. She had a big bag with her. When she got there, she said, "Hi, Grandma! I am here to unpack my bag."

Lily started to unpack her bag. She took out a long, crazy string. It had a zigzag shape. Lily and her grandma played with the string. They laughed and had fun. Then, Lily's grandma said, "Lily, let's be kind and share the string with your friends."

So, Lily and her grandma went to the park. They found Lily's friends and shared the crazy zigzag string with them. All the kids played together and had a great time. They learned that sharing with others can make everyone happy. And that was the moral of the story.

Molly was a small puppy. She had a fluffy black coat and soft, brown eyes. One day, Molly went outside to play in the snow. It was very cold and her paws were soon freezing! She started to shiver when she noticed a small bird on the ground. 

Molly wanted to help the bird keep warm, so she held her tiny paw over the bird and kept it nice and cosy. The bird stayed there for a while until it was nice and warm. It thanked Molly for helping and flew away.

Molly was so happy that she had done a good deed, but soon she was cold again. She ran back to her parents to find some warmth. They cuddled her close and soon she was no longer cold. She was so happy that she didn't have to be cold ever again.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy called Ben. He was three years old and loved exploring the world around him. One day, he found a big box in the garden. He was very curious and wanted to see what was inside. 

Ben opened the box and found a unique toy inside. He was so excited and couldn't wait to play with it! He reached out to grab it but stopped when he heard a funny noise.

"Uh oh, who's there?" he said.

Then a voice replied, "It's me, the toy that was in the box! I'm alive!" 

Ben was very surprised. He asked the toy its name and it said, "I'm Bob, the toy that's one of a kind!"

Ben and Bob became great friends and played together all day. Eventually, when it was time to go to bed, Ben carefully closed the box and said goodbye to Bob. 

The two were sad to say goodbye, but they both knew that they would see each other again soon.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went to the farm with her mommy and daddy. At the farm, Lily saw a big goose. The goose was white and fluffy. Lily wanted to pet the goose, but her mommy said the goose might peck her.

Lily and her family walked around the farm and saw lots of animals. They saw cows, pigs, and chickens. Then, they went to the apple orchard. It was a hot day and Lily was thirsty. Her daddy picked an apple for her to eat. The apple was red and juicy. Lily loved it!

After a fun day at the farm, Lily and her family went home. Lily was tired but happy. She fell asleep thinking about the cute goose and the yummy apple she picked.

Lily and Ben were friends who liked to swim in the lake. They also liked to build castles with sand and sticks. One day, they found a big and pretty castle near the water. It had many rooms and towers and flags.

"Wow, look at this castle!" Lily said. "Can we play in it?"

"Sure, let's go inside!" Ben said. They ran to the castle and opened the door.

But inside the castle, there was a mean and big dog. It barked and growled at them. It had sharp teeth and claws. It wanted to bite them.

"Help, help!" Lily and Ben screamed. They were very scared. They tried to run away, but the dog was faster. It chased them out of the castle and into the lake.

Lily and Ben swam as fast as they could. They hoped the dog would not follow them. But the dog did not like water. It stopped at the shore and watched them.

"Ha, ha, ha!" The dog laughed. "You are silly and weak. You should not touch my castle. It is mine, not yours. Go away and never come back!"

Lily and Ben felt very ashamed. They had made a big mistake. They had entered a castle that was not theirs. They had angered a dog that was not friendly. They had no fun at all.

They swam back to their own sand castle. It was small and plain, but it was theirs. They hugged each other and cried. They wished they had never seen the big and pretty castle. They learned a hard lesson. They should not be greedy and curious. They should be happy and careful.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Bop. Bop loved to hop all day long. He would hop in the grass, hop on the dirt, and hop with his friends. Bop was very brave and liked to hop high and far.

One day, Bop and his friends were playing near the big tree. They were hopping and laughing, having lots of fun. Then, it was time for dinner. Bop's mom called him and his friends to come eat. They all hopped back to Bop's home.

At dinner, Bop and his friends ate yummy food. They had carrots, lettuce, and apples. Bop's mom told them stories about brave bunnies who hopped very high and very far. Bop and his friends listened and smiled. They wanted to be brave like the bunnies in the stories.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance and twirl around in her pretty pink dress. One day, she looked up at the sky and saw the universe. It was big and full of stars. Lily thought it was so pretty.

Suddenly, she heard a scary noise. It was a monster! "Oh no!" cried Lily. "What should I do?" Just then, her mommy came outside. "What's wrong, Lily?" she asked.

"There's a scary monster!" said Lily. "Don't worry," said mommy. "Monsters aren't real. Let's dance together and forget all about it." So, they danced and twirled under the stars in the big, beautiful universe. Lily was happy and forgot all about the scary monster.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived with her mommy and daddy in a big house. One day, Lily's mommy had to go to the office. Lily didn't want her mommy to go, but she had to. 

After her mommy left, Lily played with her toys for a while. But then, she started to feel a little bit bitter because she missed her mommy. She decided to take a nap and closed her eyes. 

Suddenly, she heard a loud noise and woke up. It was her mommy coming back from the office! Lily was so happy to see her mommy again. They hugged and played together. From that day on, Lily knew that even though her mommy had to go to the office sometimes, she would always come back to her. The end.

One day, Lily and Ben went to the park with their mom. They saw a big slide, a swing, and a sandbox. They wanted to play with everything.

"Can we go on the slide, mom?" Lily asked.

"Sure, but be careful. There are some holes in the ground. Don't step on them or you might fall," mom said.

Lily and Ben nodded and ran to the slide. They took turns sliding down and laughing. They had a lot of fun.

But then, Ben saw something shiny in the grass. He ran to it and picked it up. It was a brilliant coin. He was very happy.

"Look, Lily, I found a coin! It's so shiny and pretty!" Ben said.

"Wow, that's cool! Can I see it?" Lily said.

Ben showed her the coin. He was very proud.

"Where did you find it?" Lily asked.

"Over there, in the grass. Maybe there are more. Let's go and look," Ben said.

He ran to the grass again, but he did not watch where he was going. He stepped on a hole and tripped. He fell and hurt his knee. He dropped the coin and it rolled away.

"Ow, ow, ow!" Ben cried.

Lily and mom heard him and ran to him. They helped him up and checked his knee. It was bleeding a little.

"Are you okay, Ben?" mom asked.

"It hurts, mom. And I lost my coin," Ben said.

"I'm sorry, Ben. But you should have listened to me. I told you not to step on the holes. They are dangerous. You have to be careful where you walk," mom said.

"I know, mom. I was silly. I only cared about the coin. I should have watched where I was going," Ben said.

He hugged mom and said he was sorry. Mom hugged him back and said she forgave him. She put a band-aid on his knee and gave him a kiss.

Lily gave him a hug too and said she was sorry he lost his coin. She said she would share her toys with him.

Ben smiled and thanked her. He said he was lucky to have a mom and a sister who loved him. He said he learned his lesson. He said he would be more careful and not step on holes again.

The end.

Moral value: The story teaches the value of being careful, listening to advice, and caring more about people than things.

Mom had lots of special boxes. She stacked them all together in a neat row. She told the young boy it was time to unpack. So he set to work, opening each box one at a time.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Max. One day, Max decided to go outside to play. The sun was shining and the grass was so green.

Max hopped around and found a spot in the grass to sit. He then tip-toed as close as he could so he could gaze at the beautiful spring flowers. Max was so happy.

Suddenly, a heavy rain came and the sky grew dark. Max was so scared that he didn't know what to do! He started to cry.

Then a beautiful butterfly flew by and said to Max, "Don't worry Max, be brave. I will keep you safe." She then flew around Max and guided him to a nearby cave.

Max was so relieved. He thanked the butterfly as he entered the cave. The butterfly said "You are safe now, bye Max." 

Max peeked out of the cave to gaze at the sky one last time. The sun started to shine again and the heavy rain stopped. Max smiled and hopped out of the cave and happily jumped into the grass.

Timmy was excited to go to the park with his mom. He wanted to play on the slide, the swing, and the sandbox. He put on his hat, his shoes, and his backpack. He said, "Let's go, Mom!"

Mom smiled and took his hand. They walked to the park and saw many other kids and moms. Timmy ran to the slide and climbed up the ladder. He slid down fast and laughed. He did it again and again. He had so much fun.

But then he saw something shiny in the grass. He went closer and saw a big ant. The ant was carrying a crumb. Timmy was curious. He wanted to touch the ant. He reached out his finger and poked the ant.

"Ow!" Timmy cried. The ant bit his finger. It hurt a lot. He dropped the crumb and ran to his mom. He showed her his finger and said, "Mom, the ant bit me!"

Mom hugged him and said, "I'm sorry, Timmy. The ant was scared. He thought you wanted his crumb. He was trying to protect his food. You should not touch ants. They can bite."

Timmy nodded and said, "I'm sorry, ant. I didn't mean to bother you." He looked at his finger and saw a red spot. Mom put a band-aid on it and said, "It will be okay. Do you want to play some more?"

Once upon a time, there was a baby named Timmy. Timmy was bald and loved to drink milk from his bottle. One day, Timmy's mommy took him to the park. Timmy saw a big, scary dog and started to scream. 

His mommy picked him up and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. The dog won't hurt you." But Timmy kept screaming and wouldn't stop. 

As they walked home, Timmy's mommy noticed a man following them. She tried to hurry, but the man caught up to them and grabbed Timmy's bottle. Timmy started to cry, and his mommy screamed for help. But no one came to help them. 

The man ran away with Timmy's bottle, and Timmy was left without milk. From that day on, Timmy was always scared to go to the park, and his mommy made sure to hold onto his bottle tightly.

Once upon a time, there were two boys who were very brave. They often went on adventures together. One day, the boys dared each other to go into a dark cave. They went together, but they were scared. 

The boys made it to the cave's entrance and paused. They looked at each other and the taller boy said, "We have to go in there? That is a difficult fight!" 

The smaller boy nodded, but neither of them wanted to take a step forward. They both knew something was waiting on the other side of the cave. 

Suddenly, the smaller boy stumbled and fell into the cave. He screamed and the taller boy had to help him. Then they knew they had to go forward. 

The smaller boy was afraid and begged not to go, but the taller boy had no choice. He had to help his friend. So, the boys continued further into the dark cave, looking for the scary thing that was waiting for them. 

When they made it to the other side, they were faced with two large dragons. The boys tried to fight their way out, but it was too difficult. The dragons defeated them and the boys knew they had lost the fight. 

The boys never returned from the dark cave again.

Moral of the story: It is important to think before rushing into something you are afraid of.

In the park, there was a big slide. Jack's eyes lit up as he ran up to it, looking handsome in his cute blue trousers and yellow shirt.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play in the kitchen while her mom cooked. One day, her mom was making a cake and she let Lily help. Lily poured the flour and sugar into a big bowl and then her mom gave her a spoon to measure some powder.

Once upon a time there lived a lonely bear. He lived in a big forest all by himself. Every day he would imagine what it would be like to have a friend.

Once upon a time, there lived a boy named Max. He was very brave, but he was also very scared of the things he couldn't see. One day, he decided to take a turn in the deep dark forest. He was frightened and worried, but he wanted to see what was inside.

The prince said, â€œLet her go!â€ The wolf laughed and said, "No way! She's my dinner!â€ But the prince was very helpful and brave. He said, "I'm the prince and I promise to help you if you free her." 

The wolf thought for a moment and then decided that he wanted to help, so he sprang and freed the girl. She ran all the way home and thanked the helpful prince for rescuing her. The prince waved goodbye, feeling very proud of himself. He couldn't believe he had faced a big bad wolf and won!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to wake up early in the morning to watch the sunrise. One day, she saw something weird in the sky. It was a bird with a rainbow tail. 

Lily said to her mom, "Look, Mommy! A weird bird!" 

Her mom said, "Wow, that's amazing! Do you want some milk to drink?" 

Lily nodded and her mom poured her a glass of milk. They sat together and watched the sunrise while Lily drank her milk. It was a beautiful morning and they felt happy to be together.

Once there was a happy little boy named James. He liked to paint. One day he went to an office. There were lots of colors and he was so excited. He got out a paintbrush and started to paint. James painted a healthy sun and a green tree. He also painted a blue fish and a yellow duck.

He smiled as he looked at his paintings. He had done a very good job. Everyone in the office was very proud of James. Everyone laughed and cheered as he showed them his pictures. 

Then James put down his paintbrush and took a deep breath. He was so relieved that he had finished his painting. The office filled with love and joy. All the colors looked so bright and healthy against the white walls. 

James had made a masterpiece that day. Everyone agreed that his painting was beautiful.

One day Joe went to the palace. It was a big, bright place. Joe saw a lot of musicians performing inside. The musicians were wearing sparkly clothes and they were playing happy music. Joe was so excited to watch them.

Suddenly the music stopped and everything became quiet. Joe looked around and noticed that the musicians had all gone dead. They were not moving at all! Joe was very scared and wanted to go home.

Luckily, the palace was still alive and filled with sounds. Joe started to walk down the hall and then he heard music. He followed the sound and saw a little band of musicians. They were singing and playing their instruments. Joe smiled and began to dance.

The musicians were playing such cheerful music that Joe was soon not scared anymore. He was happy again. Joe danced and swayed to the music until it was time to go home.

Johnny was an adventurous boy. He was always looking for new things to explore. One day, he wandered off into the deep, icy forest. As he walked, he looked for things to discover. 

Suddenly, he heard a strange noise. Johnny was curious and decided to investigate the noise. As he got closer, he was able to reveal a huge dinner table in the middle of the forest. 

Johnny was excited. He had never seen a dinner table like this before. He ran over to it and started to eat all the food he could find. Suddenly, a creature came out of the darkness. It was a scary monster! 

Johnny was so scared that he started to run away. But the monster was too fast and it caught him! Johnny was never seen or heard from again. He was gone forever. The fearful monster had revealed its icy dinner.

Sharon was walking in the park when she heard a loud scream. She was frightened and stopped in her tracks. She could tell the scream had come from the pond nearby. Sharon walked closer and saw a little girl playing in the water with a bottle.

The girl was shivering and seemed very scared. Sharon asked her what was wrong and the girl said she had dropped her bottle in the water and couldn't get it out. Sharon smiled and said she could help. She reached in and grabbed the bottle.

The girl was so relieved. She hugged Sharon and thanked her. Sharon said she was happy to help. She tucked the bottle under her arm and they walked home together. Sharon was glad she was able to make the little girl stop screaming.

John woke up early one morning. He was excited because he wanted to wear his special shoes. They were heavy, but he liked them. He put them on and began to run around the house. He was so happy they fit! He wished he could wear them everywhere.

John went outside. He ran around the yard and jumped over some rocks. His shoes were so heavy, but he didn't mind. He laughed and kept running. His mom watched and smiled.

John kept playing until he got tired. So, he went back inside and took off his shoes. He was sad, but he was happy he had them. He put them back in their special spot and went to bed. 

John smiled as he drifted to sleep, thinking about his special shoes.

Once upon a time, a little boy named Tim had a toy rocket. It was old but he loved it very much. He played with it every day. He would run with it, fly it in the air, and make it zoom around his room.

One sunny day, Tim took his rocket outside to play. He wandered around his yard, making the rocket fly high up in the sky. He laughed as it swooped and spun around the trees. He was so happy playing with his rocket.

After a while, it was time for Tim to go inside. He looked for his rocket, but it was gone. Tim searched and searched, but he could not find it. He felt sad and went inside. The next day, Tim found his rocket under a big tree. He was so happy to have his old rocket back. They played together every day and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Mia. She was smart, and loved playing with her toys. 
One day, she put her toy car on the floor, and it started to move forward. She was so surprised, and clapped her hands in delight.

Mia's Mum watched her play and called out, â€œMia, you can make the car go backwards,â€ she said.

Mia looked at her Mum. She had never thought of it before. â€œHow do I do that?â€ She asked.

Mia's Mum smiled. â€œWatch me,â€ she said. She placed her hand on the car, and with a movement, she reversed it.

Mia was mesmerised. She ran to her Mum and gave her a big hug. â€œThank you, Mum!â€

To celebrate, Mia's mum gave Mia a muffin. It was chocolaty and delicious. Mia smiled gratefully and said, â€œThank you, Mum. You are so smart!â€

Once upon a time there was a modest family who lived in a small house. Every night, the dad cooked dinner for the family. He included some yummy meat in each dinner. The kids loved the dinners because they were so tasty. Even the mom enjoyed the meals because the dad included lots of love in his cooking.

One night, dad cooked a special dinner for the family. He included a special surprise: a tasty meat pie. Everyone was very excited! It not only smelled good, but it tasted even better. The family ate their fill and there was enough leftover to have some the next day.

The family was so thankful for the dad who cooked the yummy dinner. Even if the meal was modest, it included lots love!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very lucky because she had a big family who loved her. One day, Lily and her family went to the park. They played on the swings and the slide. Then, they sat on a blanket and ate sandwiches. 

Suddenly, Lily heard a bird singing. She told her family to listen. They heard the bird too! Lily was very happy because she loved listening to birds. She said, "I hear a bird every year at the park!" Her family smiled and said they were lucky to have Lily in their family.

Anna and Ben were playing in the garden. They found a big hole in the ground. They wanted to see what was inside.

"Let's fill the hole with water and make a pond!" said Anna.

"No, let's fill the hole with sand and make a castle!" said Ben.

They started to argue. They did not want to share the hole.

Suddenly, they saw something shiny in the hole. They stopped arguing and looked closer. It was a tooth!

"Wow, a tooth! Whose tooth is it?" asked Anna.

"Maybe it is a dinosaur tooth!" said Ben.

"Maybe it is a fairy tooth!" said Anna.

They picked up the tooth and examined it. It was big and white and had a mysterious mark on it.

They heard a loud roar behind them. They turned around and saw a lion. The lion was angry. He had a gap in his mouth where the tooth was missing.

"Give me back my tooth!" he roared.

Anna and Ben were scared. They dropped the tooth and ran away. They hid behind a tree.

They realized they had been silly. They should not have fought over the hole. They should have respected the lion's tooth.

They learned a lesson. They decided to be kind and share with each other. They also decided to leave the hole alone. It was not theirs to fill.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and run around in the park. One day, she found a big ball and started to squeeze it. It was so much fun!

Lily's mom told her that it's important to exercise every day, so Lily started doing jumping jacks and running in place. She loved how it made her feel strong and happy.

After playing for a while, Lily noticed that her hands were dirty from playing with the ball. She went to wash them with soap and water, and felt much better. She was ready to go back outside and play some more!

Once upon a time, there was an old lady named Mrs. Smith. She was very spoiled and always got what she wanted. One day, Mrs. Smith wanted a new toy from the store. She was sad when her mom said no. She sighed and looked out the window.

Suddenly, Mrs. Smith saw something amazing! It was a puppy! Mrs. Smith ran outside and the puppy wagged its tail. Mrs. Smith was so happy and ran around the yard with the puppy. All of the neighbors smiled and laughed.

Mrs. Smith took the puppy home and named him Rusty. She hugged him every day and gave him anything he wanted. He was the most spoiled puppy in town.

Mrs. Smith and Rusty were so happy together. Whenever Mrs. Smith sighed, Rusty would come and make her happy again. They were the best of friends and they spent all day playing and cuddling.

Once upon a time, there was a family with two children, a boy and a girl. One day, the boy wanted something for his birthday. He asked his mama, "Can you give me something for my birthday?" 

Mama smiled and said, "Sure, I can give you something." She went out and came back with a big box. The boy opened it and there inside was a big red ball! Mama had given him a ball. 

The girl wanted something too, so Mama gave her a box as well. When the girl opened her box, she found a beautiful hat. Mama had given her a hat. 

The children were so happy but then it started to rain. They ran inside and Mama said, "Oh no, it's getting wet outside."

Mama had to buy things for her children. But all the good things were very expensive. Mama had to save for a long time before she could give them what they wanted. 

Finally, after a lot of saving, Mama was able to give her children their presents. The boy and girl were so happy and they thanked Mama. They would never forget the day when Mama gave them something special.

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with their toys in the garden. One day, Lily brought a new doll. It had long hair and a pretty dress. Ben wanted to play with it.

"Can I see your doll?" Ben asked.

"OK, but be careful," Lily said. She gave him the doll.

Ben looked at the doll. He liked it very much. He wanted to keep it. He had an idea.

"Let's trade," he said. "You can have my car. It is fast and shiny."

Lily liked the car, but she loved her doll more. She shook her head.

"No, thank you. I want my doll back," she said.

Ben did not listen. He ran away with the doll. He hid it behind a bush. He thought Lily would not find it.

Lily was very sad. She wept. She looked for her doll. She could not see it.

"Ben, give me my doll. That is not nice," she cried.

Ben did not answer. He was happy with the doll. He did not care about Lily.

Lily wept louder. She wanted her doll. She wanted her friend.

A grown-up heard Lily. She came to the garden. She saw Lily weeping. She saw Ben hiding.

"What is wrong, Lily?" the grown-up asked.

"Ben took my doll. He traded it for his car. He hid it. I want my doll," Lily sobbed.

The grown-up frowned. She went to Ben. She found the doll behind the bush.

"Ben, that is not nice. You should not take Lily's doll. You should not trade without asking. You should not hide things. You should say sorry," the grown-up said.

Ben felt bad. He knew he was wrong. He gave the doll back to Lily.

"I am sorry, Lily. I was mean. Can we be friends again?" he said.

Lily smiled. She hugged her doll. She hugged Ben.

"I forgive you, Ben. We can be friends again. But next time, ask before you trade," she said.

The grown-up smiled. She was glad they made up. She gave them a cookie each.

They ate the cookies. They played with their toys. They shared and took turns. They were happy.

Sarah was walking in the park with her mom. She was looking around and noticed a big building that she hadn't seen before.

"Mom, what's that building?" she asked.

"That's the university," her mom answered.

"What's a university?" Sarah asked.

"It's a place where people learn," her mom said. "They learn lots of amazing things!"

Sarah thought about the university for a moment. She thought it must be amazing to learn so much.

"Can I go to a university when I'm older?" Sarah asked.

"Yes, you can," her mom said. "That would be amazing!"

Sarah smiled and thought about the amazing things she could learn at the university when she grew up. She was sure that it would be an amazing experience.

The little girl was outside playing in the park. It was a cold day, and the girl shivered from the cold. She soon noticed that something was unusual. The park was unusually quiet. Then, the girl saw something sparkle on the ground.

She walked closer and saw that it was a small battery. Thinking it was a toy, she picked it up and put it in her pocket. Suddenly, she heard a loud boing noise and felt her pocket vibrating. She shivered, it was both exciting and a little scary.

The little girl had found an unusual battery - it was a magical battery. She quickly returned it to the ground and hoped that no one else would ever find it.

Once upon a time there was a boy who was very sad. He was so sad that he wanted to leave his home. He walked away, feeling miserable. As the boy walked away, he noticed a big tree with lots of shade under it. He was so happy to see the shade that he ran over to it and sat down. He felt happy and not so lonely anymore.

The boy felt so happy that he started singing. He sang and sang until the birds came to join him. They landed on the branches of the tree and started singing too. The boy was so happy to have the birds join him, it made him feel less lonely.

The sun started to go down, and it was time for the boy to leave. He waved goodbye to the birds and thanked them for making him feel less miserable. He walked back home feeling much happier.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play with blocks. They had many blocks of different colors and shapes. They could make houses, cars, towers and animals with their blocks.

One day, they decided to make a big castle with all their blocks. They worked hard and used their creative minds. They made walls, doors, windows and flags. They also made a seat for the king and queen of the castle.

"Look at our castle, it is so beautiful!" Lily said.

"Yes, it is. But who will be the king and queen?" Ben asked.

"I want to be the queen, and you can be the king," Lily said.

"No, I want to be the king, and you can be the queen," Ben said.

They started to argue and pull the seat. They both wanted to sit on the seat and rule the castle. They did not want to share or take turns.

Suddenly, the seat broke into two pieces. The twins were shocked and sad. They had broken their seat and their castle.

They looked at each other and felt sorry. They did not want to fight anymore. They wanted to be friends and have fun.

They hugged and said, "I'm sorry, I love you."

They decided to unite the two pieces of the seat and make a new seat. They also fixed their castle and added more blocks. They agreed to be the king and queen together and share the seat.

They smiled and said, "We are the best twins ever!"

They played happily with their castle and their blocks. They learned to be kind and creative. They had a lot of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a man who wanted to marry. He put on his best clothes and went to find a nice lady. He looked all around but could not find anyone to marry.

One day, he went home and found a lady in his living room. She was watching his TV. He was so surprised that he asked her to marry him.

The lady said yes and they celebrated. They held a big party at his house with lots of food and music. His friends were there and they were so glad he found someone to marry.

After they married, they were very happy. They watched TV together every night and the lady even taught the man how to be strong. She was a very kind lady and they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and eat yummy snacks. One day, she went to visit her friend Timmy. Timmy had a big bell in his backyard. Lily loved to ring the bell and hear its loud sound.

Before they played, Timmy's mom gave them some juice to drink. Lily was very thirsty and drank her juice quickly. Timmy, on the other hand, was selfish and didn't want to share his juice. 

As they played in the backyard, Lily noticed a pretty flower by the bell. She wanted to pick it, but Timmy said it was his flower. Lily remembered how selfish Timmy was with his juice and decided to ring the bell loudly. The loud sound scared Timmy and he spilled his juice. 

Lily helped Timmy clean up the mess and they became good friends. From that day on, Timmy learned to share and not be selfish with his things. And every time they played in the backyard, they would ring the bell and drink their juice happily together.

Sammy was always a curious little boy. He loved to study things around him. One day his mom gave him a special magazine. She showed him all the pictures of healthy foods. The magazine was full of things to learn about. 

Sammy wasn't sure what to think of it. He was a little uncertain, but he was curious. He studied it for a long time. He looked at all the pictures of the food and he read about it. 

He learned about all the healthy things he could eat. He liked the pictures of the fresh fruit and vegetables. He also saw pictures of healthy snacks. He was excited to learn something new. 

Sammy kept the magazine close to him. He kept studying and learning from it. He was so proud that he was learning how to eat healthy. It made him feel good. 

The magazine was a favorite of Sammy's. He loved studying it and learning all about healthy foods. He was becoming a pro at it! He was so proud of himself.

Once upon a time there was a spoiled child. He was always taking naps. One cold day, he decided to have a nap outside. He lay down on the grass and closed his eyes. Suddenly he felt a drop of rain. The sky was full of dark grey clouds and it started pouring rain.

The spoiled child quickly ran back inside. He was shivering from the cold! He curled up in his warm bed and closed his eyes. Soon he was fast asleep, taking a nap to keep him warm and cozy. 

The spoiled child slept for a long time until he woke up to the sound of sunshine. He smiled and jumped out of bed ready to start the day. No more cold naps for him! He was glad he had stayed inside!

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play with toys and books. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big white truck. The truck has a ladder and a hose. The truck is a fire truck.

"Wow, look at the fire truck!" Tom says. "It is so big and white. I want to see it up close."

"Me too," Anna says. "Maybe we can talk to the firemen. They do good work. They help people and animals."

They run to the fire truck. Their moms follow them. They see two firemen. The firemen are wearing helmets and coats. They smile at Tom and Anna.

"Hello, kids," one fireman says. "Do you like our fire truck?"

"Yes, we do," Tom and Anna say. "Can we see inside?"

"Sure, you can," the other fireman says. "But be careful. It is not a toy. It is a tool. We use it to fight fires and save lives."

He opens the door of the fire truck. He lets Tom and Anna sit in the front seat. They see many buttons and switches. They see a radio and a siren. They see a steering wheel and a horn.

"This is so cool," Tom says. "Can I press the buttons?"

"No, you can't," the fireman says. "They are not for playing. They are for working. If you press them, something might happen. Something bad."

"Like what?" Anna asks.

"Like this," the fireman says. He presses a button. The siren makes a loud noise. Tom and Anna cover their ears. They are scared. The fireman laughs. He turns off the siren.

"Sorry, kids," he says. "I was just joking. It was not a bad thing. It was a funny thing. Did you like it?"

Tom and Anna look at each other. They smile. They laugh.

"Yes, we did," they say. "It was funny. Thank you for showing us your fire truck. You are nice firemen."

"You are welcome, kids," the firemen say. "We are glad you like our fire truck. But remember, it is not a toy. It is a tool. We use it to help people and animals. That is our work. And we love our work."

Tom and Anna nod. They hug the firemen. They say goodbye. They go back to their moms. They tell them about the fire truck. They are happy. They learned something new. They had fun.

Once, there was a crab who lived by the sea. The crab was difficult and did not like to share. He had many friends, but he always refused to play with them. His friends were sad.

One day, a big wave came and took away the crab's home. The crab was very sad and scared. He needed help to find a new home, but he had been difficult with his friends.

The crab went to his friends and said, "I am sorry for being difficult. I need help to find a new home." His friends were kind and helped the crab. They all played together and found a new home for the crab. The crab was happy and never refused to play with his friends again.

Once there was a mommy and a baby. Every day, Mommy took Baby for a bath. Baby loved bathtime! All around the bathtub there were yummy smelling bubble bars and a big rubber ducky.

First, Mommy filled the tub with hot water. Then Baby slipped in and started to splash around. Mommy then put in a special letter. Baby wanted to grab the letter, but Mommy said not to because it was special.

The letter began to soak in the water. Baby watched as the letter changed from white to red. Soon the tub was full of red water. Baby giggled as the red water went around and around and made big bubbles. 

Finally, it was time for Baby to get out of the bath. Baby felt so clean and refreshed!  Mommy gave Baby a big hug and said it was time for a nap. 

Before Baby went to sleep, Mommy gave Baby the special red letter. Baby was so happy to finally get the letter! 
 
The End.

Lily was a smart girl who liked to read books and learn new things. She also liked to eat sandwiches with cheese and ham. One day, she went to the park with her mom and dad. They brought a big basket with sandwiches and juice and cookies.

Lily saw a big slide in the park. She wanted to go on it, but she was too small. She tried to stretch her legs and arms, but she was still too small. She felt sad and angry. She did not want to play with anything else.

She saw a boy who was bigger than her. He had a sandwich in his hand. He was going to the slide. Lily had an idea. She ran to the boy and said, "Can I have your sandwich? I am very hungry." The boy looked at her and said, "No, this is my sandwich. Go away."

Lily did not go away. She grabbed the sandwich from the boy's hand and ran away. The boy was mad. He chased her and shouted, "Give me back my sandwich! That is not nice!"

Lily ran to the slide. She thought she was smart. She thought she could eat the sandwich and go on the slide. But she was wrong. The slide was too high and too fast. She was scared. She dropped the sandwich and screamed.

The boy caught up with her. He picked up his sandwich and said, "Ha! That is what you get for being mean and greedy. You should say sorry and share." He went on the slide and had fun.

Lily felt bad. She knew she did a bad thing. She wanted to say sorry and make friends. She learned a lesson. She decided to be nice and share. She went to the boy and said, "I am sorry. I was wrong. Can I have some of your sandwich? Can I play with you?" The boy smiled and said, "Sure. You can have half of my sandwich. You can play with me. But you have to be careful on the slide. It is not for little kids." They ate the sandwich and played together. They became friends. Lily was happy. She was smart and nice.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear her favorite dress every day. One day, her mom gifted her a shiny new pan. Lily was so happy and thanked her mom. 

Lily's mom said, "You should be careful with the pan, it's special." 

Lily replied, "I will be careful and wear my apron when I cook." 

Lily learned that when someone gives you a special gift, you should take care of it. She was happy to have her new pan and wore her apron every time she cooked.

Anna and Lily are sisters. They like to play with dolls and blocks. But sometimes they fight over toys. Anna wants to play with Lily's pink doll. Lily says no. Anna gets mad and yells at Lily. Lily yells back at Anna.

Mom hears them yell. She comes to their room. She is not happy. She tells them to stop yelling and share. Anna and Lily say sorry. Mom gives them a hug and leaves. Anna and Lily smile at each other.

But Anna still wants the pink doll. She waits for Lily to look away. Then she grabs the doll and runs. Lily sees her and runs after her. She wants her doll back. They run to the kitchen. They bump into the table. The table has a vase with flowers. The vase falls and breaks. Water and glass go everywhere.

Mom hears the crash. She comes to the kitchen. She sees the mess. She sees Anna and Lily with the doll. She is very angry. She yells at them. She says they are naughty and careless. She takes the doll away. She sends them to their room. She says they can't play with any toys until they clean up.

Anna and Lily cry. They wish they had been patient and nice. They wish they had not yelled and fought. They wish they had not broken the vase. They are sorry. But it is too late. They have no toys and no fun. They have a bad day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the park with her mom and dad. One day, they went to the park and saw a vendor selling ice cream. The vendor had a fierce-looking truck that was painted bright colors.

Lily's mom said, "Do you remember the last time we got ice cream from a vendor?" Lily nodded her head and said, "Yes, it was yummy!" They went up to the vendor and asked for three ice creams. The vendor was very nice and gave them big scoops of ice cream.

Lily's dad said, "This is the best ice cream I've ever had!" The vendor smiled and said, "Thank you, I make it myself." Lily and her family enjoyed their ice cream and played at the park until it was time to go home. They said goodbye to the vendor and promised to come back soon. From that day on, Lily always remembered the nice vendor and the yummy ice cream.

Tommy had a mission. He was searching for something special. He went to the park and looked around the little benches and trees. But nothing seemed quite right to him. 

Then he noticed a small cactus. It was so tiny and cute. He decided to go see it. He got close to it and reached out to touch it. Suddenly, a voice called out to him. 

"Oh, I'm very sorry," the voice said. "That cactus is very special. I'm looking for it and I've been searching for days." 

Tommy was confused. What was so special about this small cactus? He hoped to find out one day.

Turns out, the cactus was magical! It had a secret power that could grant wishes. Everyone in town was searching for it so they could make their dreams come true. 

Tommy was so excited to tell his mom and dad about the special cactus he found. He couldn't wait to use its power too!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play on his rug with his toys. One day, Timmy's sister accidentally hurt his foot while they were playing. Timmy cried and cried because his foot hurt so much.

Timmy's mom came to see what happened and she saw that Timmy was hurt. She picked him up and put him on the couch. Timmy's sister felt really bad and wanted to make him feel better. She asked Timmy if he wanted to marry her favorite toy, a teddy bear.

Timmy thought that was a great idea and he stopped crying. He hugged the teddy bear and smiled. Timmy's sister was happy that he wasn't sad anymore and they continued playing on the rug together.

The little girl wanted a jeep. She struggled to open the big box with her small hands. She pulled and pulled but it was too heavy! 

Suddenly, her dad came over and carried the box into the living room. Gently, he opened it and the little girl couldn't believe her eyes. It was a pink, shiny jeep!

The little girl was so excited and quickly jumped in, but then she spotted some dirt on the jeep. She took a cloth and quietly started to clean it. After some hard work, the jeep was as clean as new.

The little girl wanted to take it for a ride, but her dad said it was too late now. He said they would go for a ride to the park the next day.

The little girl said goodnight to the jeep and went to bed with a smile. She was very happy that she could now enjoy a quieter life with her new jeep.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily wanted to go to the park. She put on her shoes and asked her mom, "Can I go to the park, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful, and don't go too far."

At the park, Lily saw a fragile butterfly. She wanted to play with it. She tried to turn around to catch it, but she was not fast enough. The butterfly flew away. Lily was sad and wanted to find the butterfly again.

Lily looked everywhere in the park for the butterfly. She saw a big tree and thought the butterfly might be there. As she went to the tree, she found a boy named Tim. Tim was also looking for the butterfly. They both wanted the butterfly, but there was only one. They decided to take turns to catch it. Lily tried first, but she could not catch it. Then Tim tried, and he caught the butterfly. He shared it with Lily, and they both were happy. They played together at the park until it was time to go home.

Daddy and the little girl went outside in the garden. Sun was shining and there were big, white clouds in the sky. Daddy gave the little girl a big red balloon. It was round and cute.

The little girl held tight onto the string. Daddy said "Let the balloon go up and see how far it can go." The little girl waved goodbye to the red balloon as it flew away. 

Daddy then took out a kite from the shed. He put it together and said "Let's see how high we can make it fly." He showed the little girl how to hold it. Daddy ran with the kite in his hand and the little girl ran after him, still holding onto the string. 

The kite flew up high in the sky. Daddy said: "See all the wonderful things the wind can provide!" The little girl waved goodbye to the kite as it disappeared into the clouds.

Once upon a time, there was a cheerful bird living in a big tree. The bird was so happy every day, and soon, many other animals came to the tree to join it.

But one day, the bird was in danger! A big cat was chasing it, and it wanted to catch the bird. The bird felt a wave of fear in its heart, and knew it had to escape. So, the bird flew away as fast as it could. 

The bird managed to escape, but it had to leave its friends behind. The bird was really sad now, and knew it had to be careful. 

The moral of this story is that it is important to be brave and try to escape if you find yourself in danger. But sometimes, escape can mean leaving your friends behind, and that can make your heart very sad.

Lily and her mom went to the market. Lily liked the market. She saw many pretty things. She saw fruits, flowers, toys and books. She wanted to touch everything.

"Mom, can I have this?" Lily asked. She pointed to a red ball. It was shiny and bouncy.

"Maybe later, sweetie. We have to buy some food first," her mom said. She took Lily's hand and walked to the next stall.

Lily was sad. She really wanted the ball. She saw a man selling balloons. He had many colors. Lily liked the pink one. It had a smiley face on it.

"Mom, can I have that?" Lily asked. She pointed to the balloon.

"Not now, honey. We have to hurry. The market will close soon," her mom said. She pulled Lily's hand and walked faster.

Lily was angry. She did not like to hurry. She wanted to have fun. She wanted the ball and the balloon. She did not want to go home.

She let go of her mom's hand. She ran back to the ball. She grabbed it and hugged it. She smiled.

"Hey, that's mine!" the seller shouted. He tried to take the ball from Lily.

Lily did not want to give the ball. She screamed. She screamed very loud. She screamed so loud that everyone in the market heard her.

Her mom heard her too. She turned around and saw Lily. She saw the seller. She saw the ball. She was shocked.

"Lily, what are you doing?" her mom asked. She ran to Lily. She took the ball from her. She gave it back to the seller. She said sorry.

Lily did not say sorry. She was still screaming. She wanted the ball. She wanted the balloon. She wanted everything.

Her mom was upset. She picked up Lily and carried her. She left the market. She did not buy anything.

Lily cried all the way home. She did not have a good day. She learned a hard lesson. She learned that she cannot have everything. She learned that she has to listen to her mom. She learned that screaming is not nice.

Once upon a time, there was a big, grumpy bear. He had a sore muscle in his leg, and it hurt a lot. He tried to walk, but it hurt too much. 

One day, the bear felt like he needed to sneeze. He tried to hold it in, but he couldn't. When he sneezed, his muscle hurt even more. 

The bear was very sad. He couldn't walk anymore, and he felt very grumpy all the time. One day, he went to sleep and never woke up. His muscle hurt him so much that he died. 

The other animals in the forest were very sad, too. They missed the big, grumpy bear. They wished they could have helped him before it was too late.

Once upon a time, a mitten went on a travel. The mitten was big and impressive. It was red and soft. The mitten wanted to see new places and meet new friends.

One day, the mitten met a cat. The cat was small and furry. The cat said, "Hello, mitten! You are big and impressive. Can I come with you on your travel?" The mitten said, "Yes, cat! Let's go together!"

So, the cat and the mitten traveled together. They saw many fun places. They met new friends. And they were happy. The end.

Lily and Tom were playing with their toys in the garden. Lily had a doll and Tom had a car. They liked to pretend that the doll and the car were friends and went on adventures together.

One day, a big boy came to the garden. He saw Lily and Tom and their toys. He wanted to play with them, but he was not nice. He said, "Your toys are stupid. They are old and dirty. My toys are better. They are new and shiny. Give me your toys and I will give you mine."

Lily and Tom did not like the big boy. They did not want to give him their toys. They said, "No, thank you. We like our toys. They are not stupid. They are fun and we value them. They are our friends. We do not want your toys. They are not nice. They are mean and you are mean."

The big boy got angry. He tried to grab Lily's doll and Tom's car. Lily and Tom held on to their toys and shouted, "Stop! Go away! Leave us alone!"

The big boy did not stop. He pulled and pushed and kicked. He was very rude. He made Lily and Tom cry. He made their toys fall on the ground.

Then, Lily's mom and Tom's dad came to the garden. They saw what the big boy was doing. They were very mad. They said, "What are you doing? How dare you hurt Lily and Tom and their toys? You are a very bad boy. You should be ashamed of yourself. Go home and do not come back."

The big boy was scared. He ran away. He did not say sorry. He did not take his toys. He left them on the ground.

Lily's mom and Tom's dad picked up Lily and Tom and their toys. They hugged them and kissed them. They said, "Are you okay? We are sorry that the big boy was so mean to you. You are very brave and kind. We are proud of you. We love you and we value you. You are our friends."

Lily and Tom smiled. They said, "Thank you, mom and dad. We love you and we value you too. You are our friends."

They went inside the house. They put their toys on a post. They said, "You are our friends too. We are sorry that the big boy was so mean to you. We value you and we will take care of you."

They played with their toys happily. They forgot about the big boy. They had fun and they were happy.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey named Max. Max loved to eat bananas. One day, Max found a big banana and he was very happy. He wanted to eat it right away, but he was feeling very sleepy.

Max's friend, a bird named Bella, saw him and asked, "Max, why are you so sleepy?" Max replied, "I'm feeling sleepy because I ate too many bananas." Bella said, "Maybe you should cover yourself with some leaves and take a nap." Max thought it was a great idea, so he covered himself with some leaves and fell asleep. When he woke up, he felt much better and ate his big banana happily.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat tuna sandwiches for lunch. One day, her mom made her a tuna sandwich, but it was cold. Lily didn't like it when her sandwich was cold because it didn't taste as good.

Her mom asked her if she understood why the sandwich was cold. Lily said "yes, it was in the fridge". Her mom smiled and said "that's right, Lily. It's important to keep our food in the fridge so it stays fresh and safe to eat."

Lily learned that sometimes her food might be cold, but it's for a good reason. From that day on, she always made sure to ask her mom if her sandwich was cold or not before taking a bite.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. Lucy was 3 years old, and she loved to learn new things.

One day, her parents told her that she could go to university when she was older. Lucy thought this was very exciting, and she wanted to know more about it.

Her parents explained that she had to do lots of important things to get into university. For example, she had to study hard in school, do well in her exams, and get good grades.

Lucy thought these things sounded very important, and she decided that she would work hard to get into university when she was older.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Rachel. Rachel loved to ride her bike. She asked her mom if she could ride outside. Her mom said yes and told her to be careful. 

Rachel got on her bike and rode around in circles. She was having so much fun! Then she noticed something huge on the other side of the street. Rachel thought it was a table. 

Rachel was curious, so she decided to take a closer look. She got off her bike and walked over to the table. When she got closer, she couldn't believe her eyes. It was an enormous table! 

Rachel said to herself, "I wish I could ride this table!" Then she heard a voice say, "You can ride it if you want!" 

Rachel looked around and she saw a fairy. The fairy said, "I can make your wish come true. Just hop on the table and the magic will begin!" 

Rachel was so excited! She hopped onto the huge table and closed her eyes. Suddenly, the table started to move. Rachel was riding the table! She was amazed and shouted out in joy, "This is so much fun!"

Once upon a time, there was a gray cat named Fluffy. Fluffy liked to play outside in the garden. One day, Fluffy saw a big crystal on the ground. The crystal was shiny and pretty. Fluffy wanted to play with it, so she pushed it with her paw. The crystal started to slide on the ground. Fluffy chased after it and had so much fun playing with the crystal. The end.

Ben and Mia liked to ride the subway with their mom. They liked to see the big trains and the people and the lights. Sometimes they played a game of counting the colors of the trains.

One day, they saw a new train. It was very big and shiny and had a big star on it. Ben and Mia wanted to see it up close.

"Mom, can we go see the star train?" Ben asked.

"Sure, but be careful. The star train is very powerful and fast. We have to wait for the green light before we cross the tracks," Mom said.

Ben and Mia nodded and held Mom's hand. They walked to the edge of the platform and looked at the star train. It was very pretty and made a loud noise.

Suddenly, they heard a beep. The green light turned red. The star train was going to move.

"Come on, let's go back. The star train is leaving," Mom said.

But Ben and Mia did not listen. They wanted to touch the star train. They let go of Mom's hand and ran towards the train.

"Ben! Mia! Stop!" Mom shouted.

She ran after them. She was scared. The star train was very powerful and fast. It could hurt Ben and Mia.

She reached them just in time. She grabbed them and pulled them back. She prevented them from touching the star train.

The star train zoomed past them. It made a loud noise and a big wind. Ben and Mia felt the wind and the noise. They were scared too.

They hugged Mom. They were sorry. They did not mean to be bad.

"Mom, we're sorry. We just wanted to see the star train," Ben said.

"We're sorry. We did not listen to you," Mia said.

Mom hugged them back. She was glad. She was glad they were safe.

"It's okay. I know you were curious. But you have to be careful. The star train is very powerful and fast. It can hurt you. You have to listen to me and wait for the green light before you cross the tracks. Do you understand?" Mom said.

Ben and Mia nodded. They understood. They learned their lesson.

They said sorry to the star train too. They waved goodbye to it.

They went back to Mom's side. They held her hand. They waited for the green light.

They rode the subway with Mom. They liked to see the big trains and the people and the lights. They played their game of counting the colors of the trains.

They did not run away from Mom again. They did not touch the star train again.

They were good.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, even when it was very cold and the ground was icy. One day, she was playing with her friend Timmy when they saw a beautiful bird in a tree. 

"Look, Timmy! Look at the pretty bird!" said Lily, pointing with her finger. 

Timmy looked up and his eyes got very big. "Wow, that bird is so cool! It makes me excited!" he said. 

Lily and Timmy watched the bird for a while, but then it flew away. They were sad that they couldn't see it anymore. 

"Maybe we can see it again another day," said Lily. "But we should remember to always appreciate the beautiful things we see with our eyes, even if they don't stay with us forever." 

"Okay, Lily," said Timmy. "I will remember that." 

And from that day on, Lily and Timmy always looked for the beauty in the world around them, even when it was icy and cold outside.

Lily was a dancer. She liked to dance with her friends at school. They had a show for their moms and dads. Lily was number four. She had to wait for her turn.

But Tim was number three. He did not like to dance. He liked to run and jump and play. He did not want to do the show. He said, "Dancing is silly. I don't want to be number three. I want to be number one."

He pushed Lily and took her spot. Lily was sad and angry. She said, "No, Tim. That is not fair. You are number three. I am number four. You have to wait like me."

Tim said, "No, I don't. I am bigger and faster than you. I can do whatever I want. You are a small and slow dancer. You can't stop me."

Lily felt tears in her eyes. She did not know what to do. She looked for her teacher. But her teacher was busy with the other dancers. She looked for her mom. But her mom was in the audience. She felt alone and scared.

Then she saw Ben. Ben was number five. He was her friend. He liked to dance and to help. He saw what Tim did. He said, "Tim, that is not nice. You have to follow the rules. You have to be number three. Lily is number four. She worked hard for her spot. You have to give it back to her."

Tim said, "No, I don't. You are a small and slow dancer too. You can't make me."

Ben said, "Yes, I can. I am not small and slow. I am strong and brave. And I have a huge surprise for you."

He ran to the stage. He grabbed a big balloon. He popped it. It made a loud noise. Tim was scared. He jumped and screamed. He ran away from the stage. He dropped his number.

Lily ran to the stage. She picked up her number. She smiled and hugged Ben. She said, "Thank you, Ben. You are a good friend. You are a great dancer. You are my hero."

Ben said, "You are welcome, Lily. You are a good friend too. You are a beautiful dancer. You are my star."

They went to their spots. They waited for their turn. They did their show. They danced with joy. Their moms and dads clapped and cheered. They were happy. They were proud. They were dancers.

Once there were two friends called Jack and Kate. They liked to visit each other's houses.

One day Jack said to Kate, "You should come and visit my house again. We can play a game together!"

Kate was enthusiastic. "Sounds great!" she said.

When she arrived Jack had a surprise. He said, "I have a new toy. You can guess what it is!"

Kate was really excited and started to look around the room. After a few minutes, she guessed, "Is it a monster truck?"

Jack laughed. "Yes, it is!" he said.

They spent the rest of the day playing with the monster truck and had so much fun.

Once upon a time, in a small garden, there was a little caterpillar. The caterpillar was green and liked to eat leaves. He had many friends in the garden, like the birds and the bees.

One sunny day, the caterpillar was feeling dizzy. He didn't know why. His friend, the bird, saw him and said, "Let's go to the pond and splash some water on you." The caterpillar thought it was a good idea.

They went to the pond together. The bird picked up the caterpillar with its beak and splashed water on him. The caterpillar felt better after the splash. He was not dizzy anymore. They both laughed and played by the pond. The caterpillar was happy to have such a good friend.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play catch with a ball. They throw the ball to each other and catch it with their arms. Sometimes they miss the ball and it rolls away. Then they run after it and laugh.

One day, they see a brilliant rainbow in the sky. It has many colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. They think it is very pretty. They wonder if they can catch the rainbow with their ball.

They try to throw the ball at the rainbow, but it does not work. The ball comes back to them or falls on the ground. The rainbow is too far and too high. They cannot catch it with their ball.

They are sad, but then they have an idea. They hold hands and spin around. They make their own rainbow with their arms. They smile and giggle. They catch the rainbow with their friendship. They are happy.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man named Tom. He liked to spend his time outside in the sun. One day, he went for a walk under the big tree. He saw a bird's nest under the leaves. Tom was happy to see the baby birds inside. He decided to spend some time watching them grow. Every day, Tom would come back to the tree to see the baby birds. They grew bigger and stronger each day. Tom loved spending time under the tree with the birds.

David was a brave boy. He loved ice-cream and wanted to have it every day. One day, his mommy asked him if he dare go to the store to get the ice-cream. David washappy and he said yes. He put on his coat and went out. He crossed the road very carefully and soon he was at the store.

Inside the store, there were many flavors of ice-cream. David chose the delicate strawberry flavor. He paid for it and he went back home. When he got there, he opened the box and he ate the delicious ice-cream. David was happy! He had dare to go to the store, and he had gotten the ice-cream he wanted.

Lily was feeling miserable that day. She was so sad that her brows were scrunched together and her mouth made a big, unhappy frown. She walked into her kitchen to find her mom, who asked, "Lily, what's the matter?"

Lily sighed, "I'm so sad. I want something yummy to eat." Lily's mom smiled. She reached down into the cupboard and pulled out a tin of tuna. She opened it and scooped some onto a plate for Lily.

Lily's frown slowly turned upside-down. "Tuna!" she exclaimed. She started to eat, and before long, her smile was back. "Thank you so much, Mom!" she said, and gave her mom a big hug.

Lily was no longer feeling miserable. She was happy because her mom had given her a tasty, snack.

Once upon a time there were two friends named Fluffy and Daisy. They were very playful and loved to watch the world together. 
One day, they decided to go on an adventure. They walked around the meadow and watched the birds as they chirped and flew through the sky. 
The friends stopped to admire a nearby pond, where they saw a patient old turtle watching them. Daisy, the more playful of the two, was determined to say hello. She waddled up to the turtle and said â€œHello, are you watching too?â€. 
The turtle smiled and quietly replied â€œYes, I always watch the world around meâ€. 
Fluffy and Daisy and the turtle enjoyed watching the world for a while together. When it was time for them to go, Daisy waved goodbye, and the two friends continued their journey!

Once upon a time there was a happy little boy and his name was Jack. He was playing with his tool in the garden. He was so excited to try and pass it between his hands.

Jack's friend, Emma, came up to him and said, "Hi Jack!"

Jack waved his tool and said, "Hello Emma!" 

Emma said, "Jack, what do you have there?"

Jack smiled and said, "It's my tool. I'm trying to pass it between my hands."

Emma smiled and said, "Let me try!" She started to pass the tool back and forth between her hands. Suddenly, she made a sour face.

Jack asked, "What's wrong?"

Emma said, "This tool is too sour for me. I can't pass it anymore!"

Jack laughed and said, "That's alright, Emma. Let me have it back." Jack passed the tool back to himself and kept playing with it.

The End.

One day, there was a handle in the sky. It was fair and shiny, and everyone wanted to try it.

But only one special person could fly with it. That special person was called Jack. He was very excited to fly with the handle.

Jack put his hands on the handle, and he flew high and low, round and round in the sky. All the people below him watched in amazement as he went past.

When Jack got tired, he let go of the handle. He slowly drifted back down to the ground. Everyone cheered and clapped as he landed.

The handle was fair and Jack had a lot of fun flying with it. He smiled and said to himself, "I'm going to fly with this handle every day!"

Once there was a boy named George. He wanted to get a haircut because he was getting big. His mommy took him to the barber's chair and he sat down. George was a little scared but the barber was very friendly.

The barber took out his scissors and comb and started to give George a haircut. George felt the cool air from the scissors and the bristles from the comb tickling his head. He felt silly but he was also kind of proud.

When the barber was done, George looked in the mirror. He saw that he looked big and handsome! His mommy was also very proud. She gave him a big hug and said she was glad he was so brave.

George was thrilled with his new haircut and he couldn't stop smiling. He was happy and proud of himself and that made his mommy extra happy too.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Lily. She loved flowers and would often go outside to pick them. One day, she found a beautiful flower and decided to sing to it. The flower looked happy and danced in the breeze as Lily sang.

Lily was a patient girl and waited for the flower to grow bigger and stronger. Every day, she would water it and sing to it. One day, the flower bloomed into a big, colorful flower. Lily was so happy and continued to sing to it every day.

From then on, Lily would sing to all the flowers in her garden. She loved how they would dance and sway to her singing. And the flowers loved Lily too, because she was so patient and kind to them. The end.

Lila was a princess who had a crown. Her crown was unusual. It was not shiny or sparkly. It was made of flowers and leaves. Lila liked her crown because it smelled nice and looked pretty.

One day, Lila went to the garden to play with her friends. She saw a boy who had a crown too. His crown was shiny and sparkly. It was made of gold and jewels. He looked proud and snooty.

"Hello, I am Leo. I am a prince who has a crown. My crown is the best crown in the world. What is your name and what is that on your head?" he asked.

"Hello, I am Lila. I am a princess who has a crown too. My crown is made of flowers and leaves. I like my crown because it smells nice and looks pretty," she answered.

"That is not a crown. That is a silly hat. You should have a real crown like mine. It is shiny and sparkly. It shows that I am rich and powerful. You should give me your hat and I will give you my crown," he said.

Lila felt sad and angry. She did not want to give him her crown. She liked her crown. She did not care about his crown. She thought he was rude and mean.

"No, thank you. I do not want your crown. I like my crown. It is not a silly hat. It is a beautiful crown. You should be nice and share. You should not be rude and mean," she said.

Leo felt surprised and annoyed. He did not want to share his crown. He liked his crown. He did not care about her crown. He thought she was silly and stupid.

"No, thank you. I do not want to share my crown. I like my crown. It is not a beautiful crown. It is a silly hat. You should be smart and trade. You should not be silly and stupid," he said.

They both stared at each other. They both held their crowns. They both did not want to change. They both did not want to play. They both walked away. They both felt lonely and unhappy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very sleepy, but she didn't want to go to bed. Her mommy insisted that it was time for her to sleep, but Lily didn't want to. She wanted to play with her toys and watch cartoons. 

Finally, Lily's mommy said, "If you go to sleep now, I promise you'll wake up with a big smile on your face." Lily thought about it for a moment, and then she realized that her mommy was right. She was very tired and needed to sleep. 

So, Lily climbed into her cozy bed and closed her eyes. She felt very sleepy, but she couldn't help but smile because she knew that her mommy was right. She needed to sleep so that she could wake up feeling happy and refreshed in the morning.

Once, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and she liked adventures. One day, she decided to make a plan to find a hidden jellyfish. She put on her swimming suit and grabbed a net, then she took her boat out to sea.

She sailed around for hours, looking for the hidden jellyfish. She looked up and down, all around. Suddenly, she spotted something strange beneath the waves. To her surprise, it was a jellyfish! She put down her net and grabbed the jellyfish.

Lucy was so excited! She brought the jellyfish back to the shore and showed it to her mommy and daddy. They were so proud of her. Lucy had a very special day. She learned about how jellyfish like to hide and also how to plan a fun adventure.

Tom and Lily were twins who liked to play outside. But it was winter and very cold. The snow was thick and white on the ground. They had to wear warm coats and hats and boots.

One day, they decided to build a snowman in their backyard. They rolled big balls of snow and stacked them on top of each other. They gave the snowman a carrot nose, a scarf, and a hat. They were very proud of their snowman.

But then, Lily had an idea. She wanted to make the snowman look more funny. She took the hat off the snowman and put it on her own head. She said, "Look, Tom, I'm the snowman now!"

Tom did not like that. He liked the hat on the snowman. He said, "No, Lily, give the hat back to the snowman. He needs it to keep warm."

Lily did not want to give the hat back. She said, "No, Tom, I like the hat. It's mine now."

Tom and Lily started to argue. They both wanted the hat. They pulled and tugged at the hat. They did not notice that the snowman was getting restless. He did not like to be without his hat. He felt cold and sad.

The snowman decided to call for help. He opened his mouth and said, "Help! Help! Give me back my hat!"

Tom and Lily were very surprised. They stopped fighting and looked at the snowman. They heard him speak. They felt sorry for him. They said, "Sorry, Mr. Snowman. We did not mean to make you unhappy. Here is your hat."

They put the hat back on the snowman's head. The snowman smiled and said, "Thank you, Tom and Lily. You are very kind. Now we can all be friends."

Tom and Lily hugged the snowman. They said, "You're welcome, Mr. Snowman. You are very cool. Can we play with you?"

The snowman said, "Of course, you can. Let's have some fun in the snow."

Tom and Lily and the snowman played together until it was time to go inside. They had a lot of fun in the winter. They learned to share and to be nice to each other. They also made a new friend.

The little girl was very excited this morning. She had just found out that she was going to borrow a cartoon from her neighbour. The little girl loved cartoons and she couldn't wait to get started.

She grabbed her favourite toy and headed off to her neighbour's house. When she arrived, her neighbour opened the door and smiled. She invited the little girl inside and told her she could pick any cartoon she wanted. 

The little girl picked out a dirty cartoon. She looked at it and asked her neighbour, "What's this?" Her neighbour laughed and said, "That's a dirty cartoon. But I'm sure you'll love it." 

The little girl smiled and thanked her neighbour. Then she hurried home with her new cartoon. As soon as she got home she popped it in the DVD player and settled in to watch it. 

What a great day it had been. The little girl had borrowed a cartoon and now she was ready for an afternoon of entertainment!

Lily and Sam went to the beach with Mom and Dad. They liked the beach a lot. They felt the warm sand on their feet and the cool water on their toes. They saw many things at the beach: shells, crabs, birds, and boats.

"Look, Lily, a big shell!" Sam said. He picked up the shell and showed it to his sister. "It is pretty and shiny. Do you want it?"

"Yes, please, Sam. Thank you!" Lily said. She took the shell and smiled. She put it in her bucket with other shells. She liked to collect shells.

Lily and Sam were playful. They ran and jumped and splashed in the water. They made a sandcastle with Mom and Dad. They decorated it with shells and seaweed. They were happy and proud of their sandcastle.

"Wow, what a beautiful sandcastle!" Mom said. "You did a great job, Lily and Sam!"

"Thank you, Mom!" Lily and Sam said. They hugged Mom and Dad. They felt loved and safe at the beach. They had a lot of fun.

Ben and Mia like to play with their toy cars. They have many cars of different colors and sizes. They make noises and pretend to drive them on the floor. One day, they find a big white car in the garage. It is their dad's car, but he is not home.

"Can we play with the white car?" Ben asks Mia.

"I don't know. Dad said we can't touch it," Mia says.

"But it looks so fun. And it is white, like snow," Ben says.

He opens the door and climbs inside. Mia follows him. They see many buttons and levers. They want to try them all.

Ben pushes a button. The car makes a loud sound. He turns a lever. The car moves a little. He pushes another button. Smoke comes out of the car.

"Uh-oh. What did you do?" Mia says.

"I don't know. The car is angry," Ben says.

They see the smoke is black and smells bad. They are scared. They want to get out of the car. But the door is locked. They cry and rub their eyes.

"Help! Help!" they shout.

Their mom hears them. She runs to the garage. She sees the smoke and the car. She is angry and worried. She opens the door and takes them out.

"What were you doing in the car?" she asks.

"We wanted to play. We are sorry," Ben and Mia say.

Mom hugs them and checks if they are hurt. She is glad they are okay. She tells them to never touch the car again. She says it is dangerous and not a toy. She takes them inside and gives them some water and cookies.

Ben and Mia say they are sorry again. They promise to listen to mom and dad. They decide to play with their toy cars instead. They are happy and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max liked to dig holes in the yard and chase squirrels. One day, Max was playing in the yard and he found a bone. He was so excited that he started to chew it.

But then, Max swallowed the bone and it got stuck in his throat. He couldn't breathe and he started to cough. His owner took him to the vet and they did an x-ray. The x-ray showed that the bone was stuck in Max's throat and he needed surgery.

During the surgery, Max's heart stopped and the vet couldn't save him. Everyone felt guilty for not watching Max more closely. They learned that sometimes, things that seem like fun can be dangerous and it's important to stop and think before doing something.

Tom and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to slide, swing and run. But they did not like the big tree. The big tree had a hole in its trunk. It looked like a mouth. Tom and Lily thought the big tree was scary.

One day, Tom had an idea. He wanted to scare Lily. He said, "Lily, let's play hide and seek. You count to ten and I hide." Lily agreed. She closed her eyes and counted. Tom ran to the big tree. He climbed inside the hole. He thought, "This will be fun. Lily will be so scared when I jump out."

Lily finished counting. She opened her eyes and looked for Tom. She saw his shoes sticking out of the hole. She smiled. She knew where he was. She tiptoed to the big tree. She said, "I found you, Tom. You are in the big tree." She reached for his shoes. But then, something happened.

Tom heard a loud noise. He felt something move in the hole. He looked up. He saw a big, furry head. It had sharp teeth and yellow eyes. It was a raccoon. The raccoon was angry. It did not like Tom in its home. It growled and hissed. Tom was terrified. He screamed and ran out of the hole.
