Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Daisy who loved to cook. One day, Daisy went to the kitchen. She was about to cook when she saw a rat! 

"Hello, Rat!" said Daisy. "I am going to cook something! Can you be my helper?"

But the rat was very impatient and ran away. Daisy was disappointed and said "That's ok. I can still cook by myself!"

Daisy started to look for ingredients. She saw some apples, some oranges, some carrots and some potatoes.

"This is perfect for my cooking!" she said. 

Daisy washed, chopped and cooked all the ingredients. Then, she put them in a bowl and started to stir.

But all of a sudden, she heard a noise. It was the rat! The rat came back and wanted some food. So Daisy gave the rat some of her food.

The rat was happy and said "Thank you, Daisy!"

Daisy smiled and said "You are very welcome!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Ginny. She was a very active 3-year-old who loved to jog. One day, Ginny went for a jog but suddenly, something incredible happened. She stumbled into a portal that removed her from her home and family.

Ginny found herself in a strange and scary place. She looked around and tried to figure out how to get back home. Suddenly, she saw a big castle very far away. Ginny was brave, so she decided to jog to the castle.

But, when she got there, the castle was dark and empty. She tried to find a way out, but nothing worked. The door was too big and the windows were too high. She was stuck!

After many hours, Ginny was tired and exhausted. Sadly, she was never able to remove herself from the castle. She still remains stuck there to this day.

Once upon a time, there lived two friends, Jack and Jane. They always went to the park together to run around and have fun.

One day, as they were walking in the park, they saw a weird wink. They could not quite figure out what it was. Jack thought it was funny while Jane thought it was strange.

Jack: "Let's go closer and have a look," he said.

Jane was a bit scared but she followed Jack anyway. As they slowly passed by, the wink slowly moved away. It was so weird!

Jack and Jane ran back to tell their parents about the weird wink. It was the most exciting thing ever!

Their parents listened to them carefully and smiled. They were so proud of their children for being brave enough to pass by the weird wink. That was the end of their story!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her yard. One day, she saw something unusual in the grass. It was a shiny rock that glowed in the sun. Lily was so happy and ran inside to show her mom. 

Mom was surprised to see the unusual rock and asked Lily where she found it. Lily led her to the yard and pointed to the spot where she found it. Mom picked up the rock and examined it. She said it was a special rock that glowed in the dark too. 

Lily was so excited and couldn't wait for it to get dark so she could see the rock glow. As soon as the sun went down, they went back outside and the rock started to glow. Lily was amazed and couldn't stop staring at it. From that day on, Lily and her mom always looked for unusual things in the yard that glowed.

Ben and Lily were going on a trip with their mom and dad. They were very excited to fly on a big plane and see a new place. They packed their bags and went to the airport.

When they got on the plane, Ben and Lily looked out the window and saw the clouds and the sky. They felt like they were flying too. They asked their mom and dad many questions about the trip. "Where are we going?" "How long will it take?" "What will we do there?"

Mom and dad smiled and answered their questions. They told them they were going to a city with many buildings and people. They said it would take a few hours to get there. They said they would stay in a hotel and visit some parks and museums.

Ben and Lily were happy and curious. They wanted to see everything. They played with their toys and read some books on the plane. They also ate some snacks and drank some juice.

But then, something bad happened. Lily felt sick in her tummy. She told her mom she needed to go to the bathroom. Mom took her by the hand and walked to the back of the plane. But before they got there, Lily threw up on the floor. She felt very bad and ashamed. She started to cry.

Mom hugged her and said, "It's okay, Lily. It's not your fault. Sometimes people get sick on planes. It's normal. Don't worry. We will clean it up and you will feel better soon."

Lily nodded and wiped her tears. She said, "I'm sorry, Mom. I'm sorry, Ben. I'm sorry, everyone."

Mom said, "It's okay, Lily. Everyone understands. Ben is not mad at you. He loves you. And so do I. And so does Dad. And so do the people on the plane. They are nice and kind. They will help us."

Lily smiled a little and said, "Thank you, Mom. I love you too. And I love Ben. And I love Dad. And I love the people on the plane. They are nice and kind."

Mom and Lily went to the bathroom and cleaned up. Then they went back to their seats. Ben gave Lily a hug and a kiss. He said, "I'm glad you're okay, Lily. You're my best sister. I can't wait to see the hotel with you. It will be fun."

Lily said, "Thank you, Ben. You're my best brother. I can't wait to see the hotel with you too. It will be fun."

Mom and Dad smiled and said, "We're proud of you, Ben and Lily. You're brave and sweet. We love you very much. We're almost there. Are you ready to see the city?"

Ben and Lily said, "Yes, we are. We're ready to see the city. We're ready to have fun. We're ready to fly."

Once, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a pretty, pale dress. Lily loved her dress very much. She also had a small, friendly cat named Tom. They played together all day.

One day, Lily and Tom were in the room. They saw a lamp. The lamp was shiny and bright. Lily wanted to touch the lamp. Tom looked at Lily and said, "Be careful, Lily!"

Lily felt an urge to touch the lamp. She reached out her hand. Tom jumped up and said, "No, Lily! It's hot!" Lily listened to Tom and did not touch the lamp. She said, "Thank you, Tom!"

Lily and Tom played with their toys instead. They had a fun day together. They were very happy and safe.

Bob was very excited. He was going to the gym for the first time. He heard his mom say he would get to see lots of fun things. 

When he arrived, Bob saw a huge room filled with lots of things. He wanted to explore it all at once. He saw some balls and hoops and lots of colorful shapes. 

Bob's mom told him to be organized. She wanted him to look at one thing at a time. Bob carefully looked around the gym. He heard funny noises coming from the corner. When he looked over, he saw people laughing and playing with a big blue ball that was bouncing all over the place.

Bob shouted with joy. He couldn't believe how much fun he was having. He ran over to join the game. Everyone welcomed him happily and showed him how to play. Bob had a wonderful time at the gym and couldn't wait to come back the next week.

Anna and Ben are playing in the park. They see a big slide. Anna wants to go first. She runs to the slide and climbs up the ladder. Ben follows her.

"Wait for me, Anna!" Ben says.

Anna does not wait. She sits on the slide and slides down fast. She laughs and shouts, "Whee!"

Ben is sad. He wanted to slide with Anna. He sits on the slide and slides down slow. He does not laugh. He does not shout.

Anna sees Ben's face. He looks unhappy. She feels sorry. She runs to Ben and hugs him.

"I'm sorry, Ben. I did not mean to make you sad. Do you want to slide with me again?" Anna says.

Ben nods. He smiles. He hugs Anna back.

"Okay, Anna. Let's slide together. But this time, let's go slow and enjoy the ride." Ben says.

Anna agrees. They hold hands and walk to the slide. They kneel on the slide and slide down slow. They look at the sky, the trees, and the birds. They see a pink balloon flying in the air. They point and say, "Look, a pink balloon!"

They laugh and shout, "Whee!" together. They are happy. They are friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a vest that she loved to wear every day. One day, her mom told her it was time to wash the vest. But Lily was stubborn and didn't want to take it off.

Her mom tried to show her how dirty the vest was, but Lily didn't want to listen. She wore the vest for another day and got very sick. Her mom took her to the doctor, who told her that she got sick because of the dirty vest.

Lily learned that it's important to listen to her mom and take care of her things. From then on, she made sure to wash her vest and other clothes regularly. The end.

Once upon a time there was a small girl named Anna. She was only three years old and loved to go for walks in the park with her mom. One day, as she was walking in the park, she stopped and looked around. She realized something was different and that it was very quiet. 

She asked her mom why it was so quiet and her mom told her that everyone was deaf. Anna had never seen a deaf person before and wanted to find out more. She continued to walk around the park and soon she saw a group of people signing to each other. She was so excited! 

Anna watched them for a while, and then went to get a drink of juice. As she was drinking her juice, she overheared some of the people talking. She realized they were actually speaking with their hands! She felt so happy and excited to learn a new way of communicating. 

From that day on, Anna kept learning more and more about different ways of communicating. She was so excited to realize that deaf people could enjoy the beauty of the park just like everyone else.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play at the park with her friends. One day, they found a mystery box hidden under a bush. They opened it and found some shiny rocks and a note that said "keep this secret". 

Lily's friend, Tom, was envious of the rocks and wanted to keep them for himself. But Lily reminded him of the note and they agreed to keep it a secret. 

The next day, Tom couldn't keep the secret any longer and told everyone about the rocks. The mystery box was gone when they went back to the park. They felt sad and disappointed. 

Lily said, "We should have kept the secret. Now we'll never know who left the mystery box." They all agreed and walked home with heavy hearts.

Once upon a time, there was a wild parrot.
It flew high and far into the sky, exploring all the world.
One day it found a task it wanted to complete.
It looked all around and found a nest in a tree.
The parrot decided it wanted to build the nest and make it its own.
So, the wild parrot got to work.
It gathered twigs and made its nest complete.
The parrot fluffed up the soft feathers and made a cozy home.
Now the wild parrot has a safe place to rest and enjoy its freedom.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play on the beach. One day, she saw some jellyfish in the water. They looked like big blobs of jelly! She was scared of them and didn't want to go near the water.

Her mom saw that she was scared and asked her what was wrong. Lily told her about the jellyfish and how they scared her. Her mom said, "Don't worry, sweetie. We can scatter them away so they won't bother us."

Together, they threw some rocks into the water to scatter the jellyfish. Lily felt much better and went back to playing on the beach. She learned that sometimes things can be scary, but there's always a way to make them go away.

Once upon there was a young bull named Bob. Every day, Bob would go to the same meadow to play with all his friends. One day, Bob noticed that his friends were sad. He was so thoughtful and wanted to make them smile. So he started to sing a special song. Everyone in the meadow was so happy they started to dance. Bob kept singing and everyone kept on dancing until the sun went down. Bob's heart was so full of happiness, he knew he had made his friends smile. He said goodbye to his friends and went back home feeling proud.

One day, a squirrel named Tom was in the park. He was very happy because he had a big nut. Tom was ready to eat the nut. He gazed at the nut and smiled.

A bird named Sam saw Tom and the nut. Sam flew down and said, "Hey, Tom! Can I have some of your nut?" Tom looked at Sam and said, "No, it's my nut. I found it first."

Sam was sad but he had an idea. He told Tom, "Look over there! A bigger nut!" Tom looked away, and Sam took the nut. Tom was sad and angry. He learned not to trust Sam again.

Lily was very happy. Today was her birthday. She had a big cake with candles and a lovely dress with flowers. She wanted to share her cake with her friends. She asked her mom if she could invite them to her house.

Mom said yes, but she had a surprise for Lily. She said Lily would meet someone new and get a special present. Lily was curious. Who could it be? What could it be? She hoped it was something fun and nice.

Mom took Lily to the car and drove to a big place with many animals. Lily loved animals. She saw dogs, cats, birds, rabbits, and more. She wanted to pet them all. Mom said they were here to adopt one of them. Lily was very excited. She could have a new friend!

Mom took Lily to a room where a lady was waiting. The lady smiled and said hello. She had a box in her hands. She said it was for Lily. She opened the box and Lily saw a small, fluffy, white kitten. The kitten looked at Lily with big, blue eyes and meowed softly. Lily gasped. She loved the kitten. She reached out and touched its fur. It was soft and warm. The kitten licked her hand and purred.

Lily hugged the kitten and thanked the lady. She thanked her mom too. She said it was the best present ever. She named the kitten Snowy. She said Snowy was her new best friend. She was very happy. She couldn't wait to show Snowy to her other friends and share her cake with them. She knew they would love Snowy too. It was a lovely birthday.

Once there was a little girl who was very scared. She was scared to go to church because it was big and loud and she didn't know what to expect.

One day, her mommy told her that she could go to church with her. The little girl was a bit nervous but was excited too.

When they got to church, her mommy hugged her tight and encouraged her to talk to the other children. Her mommy told her that there was nothing to be scared of.

The little girl took a deep breath and made some new friends. She sang some new songs with everyone. In the end, she was so happy she went.

Church felt like a safe place for her and she was glad her mommy encouraged her to go. Every Sunday from then on, she was excited to go back and see her friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big jungle. Lots of animals lived there. One day, a poor monkey was very hungry. He had no food to eat. Then, a kind elephant saw the monkey and wanted to help. The elephant gave the monkey a banana to eat. The monkey was happy and thanked the elephant. From that day on, the monkey and the elephant were good friends in the jungle.

Once upon a time, there was a happy otter who lived in a river. The otter loved to swim and dive in the water. One day, a deaf rabbit came to the river and asked the otter for help. The rabbit said, "I can't find my carrot. Can you help me find it?"

The otter replied, "Sure, I can help you find your carrot. Let's dive into the water and look for it together." So, the otter and the rabbit dove into the water and searched for the carrot. But, they couldn't find it anywhere.

Suddenly, a big bird swooped down and snatched the rabbit away. The otter was sad and couldn't believe what had happened. The otter realized that sometimes bad things happen and there's nothing we can do to stop them. From that day on, the otter swam alone and missed his friend, the rabbit.

Once upon a time, in a small and friendly town, there lived a girl named Amy. Amy loved to plan fun things to do with her friends. One day, she had a great idea. She wanted to plant a bean in her garden.

Amy and her friends got together and dug a small hole in the ground. They put the bean in the hole and covered it with dirt. Then, they gave the bean some water. They were very excited to see the bean grow.

Days went by, and the bean began to grow into a tall plant. Amy and her friends were so happy. They took care of the plant every day. Soon, the plant had a big bean on it. They picked the bean and shared it with their friends in the friendly town. Everyone loved the bean, and they all thanked Amy for her great plan.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jo. Jo was very hungry, but there was nothing to eat in her kitchen! She looked in her fridge and there was zero! She looked in her cupboards and again found zero! 

Jo was so hungry she began to cry. Then she had an idea. She went outside and started walking. She went to her friend's house and asked if she had something to eat. Her friend said no but she said she could help her. She gave Jo an apple and a banana.

Jo was so excited! She thanked her friend and went back home. When she got there, she frowned because her kitchen was still empty. But then she thought about the apple and banana. She smiled and shrugged. She knew she wouldn't be hungry anymore. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a dead copper who lived inside a big, blue box. One day, the sky opened up and sent out a big snow cloud. When the cloud came close, it sent down a big surprise - it made everything freeze!

The dead copper was scared and started to shiver. He didn't like the cold at all and wished he could find a way to stay warm. He looked around for something warm to hug or someone to talk to.

Then, he saw a friendly-looking flower. The flower said, "I can help you stay warm. Just come and give me a hug!"

So, the dead copper hugged the flower, and he felt warm again. From then on, whenever the copper felt cold, he always went back to the flower for a hug. The flower and the copper became good friends. And, as long as the copper had the flower nearby, he was never cold again!

Lily and Ben are friends. They like to play games. One day, they play a game with cards. The cards have pictures of animals. Lily and Ben have to turn over two cards and see if they match. If they match, they keep the cards. If they don't match, they turn them back over.

Lily is good at the game. She has a good memory. She remembers where the cards are. She finds many matches. She has a big pile of cards. Ben is not so good at the game. He forgets where the cards are. He does not find many matches. He has a small pile of cards.

Ben feels sad. He says, "Lily, you are too good at this game. I can't win. I don't like this game."

Lily sees that Ben is sad. She does not want to make him sad. She says, "Ben, don't be sad. It's just a game. You can be good at other things. Maybe you can teach me something you are good at."

Ben thinks for a moment. He says, "Lily, do you know how to draw a dinosaur?"

Lily says, "No, I don't. Can you show me?"

Ben says, "Yes, I can. I am good at drawing dinosaurs. Come, I will get some paper and crayons."

Lily and Ben go to get some paper and crayons. They sit down and draw dinosaurs. Ben shows Lily how to draw the head, the body, the tail, and the legs. Lily follows Ben's instructions. She draws a dinosaur. She is happy. She says, "Ben, thank you for teaching me how to draw a dinosaur. You are very good at it. I like your dinosaur."

Ben smiles. He says, "Lily, thank you for playing the card game with me. You are very good at it. I like your cards."

Lily and Ben hug. They are happy. They are friends.

The moral of the story is: Everyone has different skills and talents. We can learn from each other and appreciate each other. We can have fun and be friends.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to go outside and explore her neighborhood. One day she wandered into a big park and noticed a friendly old man. He smiled and asked her if she wanted to hear a story.

The girl said yes, excitedly. He smiled and whispered: â€œOnce upon a time there was a brave knight who carried a bow. He was gentle, kind and compassionate. He used his bow to protect the people in his kingdom and they were very grateful.

The man then asked the little girl, â€œDo you know what the most important thing was to the brave knight?â€

The little girl shook her head. â€œItâ€™s his compassion. He was able to show kindness to everyone and help make the kingdom a better place.â€ 

The man smiled warmly and the little girl thanked him for the story. She went home feeling inspired and determined to be kind like the brave knight, who never stopped using his bow and showing compassion to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a sister named Rosie. Rosie was very naughty sometimes. One day, Lily and Rosie went to the park to play. 

Lily wanted to play on the swings, but Rosie wanted to play on the slide. They argued about it. Lily said, "I want to go on the swings first." Rosie said, "No, I want to go on the slide first." 

Suddenly, Lily had an idea. She said, "Let's play a game. We'll go on the swings first, and then we'll go on the slide." Rosie agreed. They went on the swings, and then they went on the slide. They both had fun. 

Lily was happy that they didn't fight anymore. She said, "I'm glad we played together nicely." Rosie smiled and said, "Me too, Lily. You're a good sister."

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lucy got an invitation to a party. She was very excited. The invitation had a clear picture of a big cake on it. Lucy wanted to make a cake too.

Lucy asked her mom to help her measure the flour, sugar, and milk. They mixed everything in a big bowl. Lucy's mom put the cake in the oven to bake. Lucy was happy and danced around the kitchen.

The cake smelled so good. But Lucy was too excited and forgot to wait for her mom. She opened the oven and tried to take the cake out. But the cake was too hot! Lucy dropped the cake on the floor. She cried because there was no cake for the party.

Lily and Ben went to the park with Mom. They saw a big fountain with water that went up and down. Lily and Ben liked the fountain. They ran to it and tried to touch the water.

"Look, Mom, look!" Lily shouted. "The water is so pretty!"

Mom smiled and took a picture of them. "Be careful, don't get wet!" she said.

Then they saw a duck swimming in the fountain. The duck was yellow and brown. It had a long neck and a flat beak. Lily and Ben thought the duck was cute.

"Quack, quack!" the duck said.

"Hello, duck!" Lily and Ben said. They clapped their hands and waved to the duck.

The duck liked Lily and Ben. It swam closer to them and splashed some water with its wings.

Lily and Ben laughed and clapped some more. They had fun with the duck and the fountain. Mom was happy to see them. She gave them a hug and a snack. They thanked the duck and said goodbye. They had a good day at the park.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Tim. One day, Tim wanted to visit his friend. He put on his shoes and picked up his toy car to take with him. 

Tim's friend lived in a safe place. As Tim walked to his friend's house, he saw the bright sun and the blue sky. He also saw a big puddle in the road. So, he decided to take a detour to stay dry.

When Tim arrived at his friendâ€™s house, he was so excited. They played together in the garden and had lots of fun. Soon, it was time for Tim to leave. So, he gave his friend a hug, got back in his toy car, and went home.

Tim was very happy that he had been able to visit his friend in a safe and dry place.

Lily and Ben were playing on the beach. They saw a big boat in the water. It was white and shiny. It had a flag and a sail.

"Wow, look at that boat!" Lily said. "It is so pretty!"

"That is not a boat, Lily. That is a yacht," Ben said. He was older than Lily and knew more words. "A yacht is a very big and fancy boat. Only rich people have yachts."

Lily nodded. She wanted to see the yacht up close. She ran to the water and waved at the yacht. "Hello, yacht! Can I come and play with you?"

Ben followed her. He was worried. The water was deep and the yacht was far. "Lily, stop! You can't go to the yacht. It is not safe. You can't swim that far. You need a life jacket and a boat."

Lily stopped. She looked at the water. It was blue and sparkly. She looked at the yacht. It was white and shiny. She looked at Ben. He was frowning and scared.

"Sorry, Ben. I forgot. The water is not easy. It can be dangerous. You remind me to be careful. Thank you, Ben."

Ben smiled. He hugged Lily. "You're welcome, Lily. I'm glad you are safe. You are my sister and I love you."

They went back to the sand. They made a sand castle. They pretended it was a yacht. They had fun. They were happy.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Jack who loved playing outside. He would climb the fence and play with the birds.

One day, Jack was playing and he got very dirty in the mud. His mom called him and said, "Jack, you need to take a bath right now!"

But Jack didn't want to. "No, I don't want to take a bath," he shouted.

But his mom insisted. "Jack, you must bathe before dinner," she said.

So Jack reluctantly went to the bath. But when he got there, the bath was too messy. He started to cry.

His mom came in and saw the mess. She sighed. "Jack, why didn't you take a bath when I asked you to?" she said.

Jack just cried and said nothing. His mom gave him a hug and said, "No matter what, I still love you."

But Jack was still very sad. He knew he had made a big mistake. He had not listened to his mom and he had not taken a bath.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max loved to play outside and chase squirrels. One day, Max found a bone in the yard. He picked it up and started to run around with it. Suddenly, he saw a little boy named Timmy. Timmy wanted to play with Max, so Max led him to the bone. 

Later that day, Max's owner gave him some wine in his bowl. Max didn't like the taste of the harsh wine, so he didn't drink it. Instead, he went outside to play with Timmy some more. They ran and played until it was time for Timmy to go home. Max was sad to see him go, but he knew they would play again soon. From that day on, Max and Timmy were the best of friends.

Mummy and Daddy took little Tommy to a field of flowers. He couldn't believe his eyes. Everywhere he looked, he could see colourful petals - red, yellow, blue and green! Little Tommy said, "Wow!"

He ran around, gazing at the flowers. When he got tired, he sat down. He noticed something nearby that he hadn't seen before. It was a cord.

He touched it with his finger, being very careful and polite. The cord was cool and smooth. He liked it. What could it be for? 

Daddy smiled and said, "That's a skipping rope. Would you like to have a go at skipping?" Little Tommy beamed and said, "Yes!"

Mummy and Daddy found some sticks and held them steady. Little Tommy jumped over the cord, giggling with delight.

He had so much fun skipping over the cord! He jumped and jumped until he was out of breath, then he fell down into Mummy's arms, worn out and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to go on adventures in the forest with his dog, Spot. One day, Timmy and Spot went on an adventurous hike in the forest. They followed a trail that led them deep into the woods.

As they were walking, Timmy noticed that he was lost. He didn't know which way to go to get back home. He started to feel scared and worried. But then he remembered that he had his trusty compass with him. He used the compass to find his way back home.

From that day on, Timmy learned that it's important to always be prepared when going on an adventure. He realized that having a compass and knowing how to use it can be very helpful. Timmy was proud of himself for being brave and adventurous, and for finding his way back home.

Once upon a time, there was a grumpy bunny. He lived on a big hill. The bunny was grumpy because he never won any games. He had many friends, but they always won.

One day, the grumpy bunny and his friends played a game. They had to run to the top of the hill. The bunny wanted to win. He ran as fast as he could.

The grumpy bunny ran and ran. He ran faster than his friends. He was the first to reach the top of the hill. The grumpy bunny won the game! He was so happy. From that day on, he was not grumpy anymore.

Lily was a little girl who loved to sing. She sang every day at home, at school, and with her friends. She had a big dream: to sing on a famous stage with many people watching her.

One day, she got a chance to make her dream come true. Her teacher told her that she could sing at the school show. Lily was very happy and excited. She practiced her song every day with her teacher and her friends.

The day of the show came. Lily put on a pretty dress and a shiny necklace. She waited backstage with her teacher and her friends. She could hear the people in the seats talking and clapping. She could see the bright lights and the big curtains. She felt her heart beat fast and her hands tremble.

"Lily, you're next. Are you ready?" her teacher asked.

Lily nodded, but she felt scared. She wanted to sing, but she also wanted to hide.

"Don't worry, Lily. You can do it. You have a beautiful voice and a wonderful song. Just remember to smile and have fun. I'm very proud of you," her teacher said.

Lily took a deep breath and smiled. She held her teacher's hand and walked to the stage. She saw the big bulb that said her name. She heard the people cheer and clap. She felt a warm glow in her chest.

She opened her mouth and sang. She sang with all her heart and soul. She sang like a star. She sang like a dream. She sang like Lily.

Once there was a bear named Gray. He was very dull and didnâ€™t like to play. Every morning he would just sit and rest. No other bear played with him, he was the only one who was so unrest. 

But one day a special bear came to Gray. This bear had a very bright smile and twinkle in her eye. She said, â€œHey Gray! Letâ€™s go rub this big tree!â€ 

Gray was so happy! He decided to rub the tree with the special bear. As they both rubbed the rough bark, Gray felt so happy and alive. The special bear smiled and said, â€œSee, youâ€™re not so dull after all!â€ 

They rubbed the tree together until the stars came out. Now they play together every day, and Gray loves it!

Once there was a little girl who liked to play with her dolls. One day she was in her room and saw a hanger. She thought it looked fun so she grabbed it and started to pull.

The hanger suddenly started to move across the floor and the little girl followed it. It went all the way out of her bedroom and out of the house.

The little girl followed it into the garden. As she followed the hanger, she noticed that the garden was so peaceful and it smelled so nice.

Suddenly, the hanger stopped in the middle of the garden. The little girl looked up and saw a big tree. She could see something hanging from the branches.

The little girl smiled and said: "What is that hanger doing in the tree, mommy?"

Mommy looked up and said: "Oh, I hung the hanger there â€“ itâ€™s a birdhouse. Now the birds can come and make their little home in it. Isn't that wonderful?" 

The little girl smiled and said: "Yes, it is. I'm so glad you put the hanger there."

Then mommy and the little girl put their hands together and watched the birds fly in and out of their new home. The little girl was filled with happiness and the garden was once again peaceful.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Lily. She was always making silly sounds. One day, Lily was in the garden when she accidentally made too much noise. 

The noise was so loud that it made her parents come outside to see what was happening. When they saw her, they both looked very embarrassed. Lily then shrugged her shoulders and said sorry. 

Her parents were still very embarrassed, but Lily's dad said it was okay. He gave her a big hug and told her that it was okay to make sounds, but she must try not to get too noisy. 

Lily smiled and nodded her head. Then, she hugged her dad and smiled. She was so relieved that she wasn't in trouble. 

From that day on, Lily was more careful with the sounds she made. She sometimes still made silly noises, but she was careful not to make too much noise.

Once there was a girl called Lucy. She was very kind and smiled a lot. One day she was walking near a park when she saw an old woman. The old woman was very rude and didn't acknowledge Lucy at all.

Lucy felt very sad, so she decided to kneel down in front of the old woman. She held out her purse in her hands and asked the old woman if she needed help. The old woman was taken aback by Lucy's kindness and finally smiled at her.

The old woman was so happy to have received Lucy's generosity that she gave Lucy a big hug and thanked her. Lucy smiled and ran off to play in the park with her friends. She was so happy to have made someone smile with her kindness.

Sam was quite excited. He was going to polish the glass. It was a fragile glass that had come all the way from the other side of the world. It had survived a powerful hurricane.

Sam carefully put on some gloves. He was taking it very seriously! He wanted to make the glass look beautiful. He took a cloth and polished it in small circles. It was fun! The glass sparkled in the sun.

Suddenly, Sam heard someone speaking. It was his mom. She said, "That's enough! You need to stop polishing now". Sam was disappointed but he put away the cloth and the gloves. The glass still looked lovely!

Lily and Ben were playing in the snow. They wanted to make an igloo, like the ones they saw in a book. They rolled big balls of snow and piled them up. But the snow was heavy and hard to move.

"I can't do it," Lily said. "It's too hard."

"Yes, you can," Ben said. "You are strong and smart. I will help you. We can do it together."

He encouraged her to keep trying. They pushed and lifted the snow balls. They made a hole for the door. They smoothed the walls. They were very proud of their igloo.

"Look, we did it!" Ben said. "We made an igloo!"

"It's so cool!" Lily said. "Can we go inside?"

They crawled into the igloo. It was cozy and warm. They smiled at each other.

"We are the best igloo makers ever!" they said.

Once upon a time, there was a kangaroo named Joey. Joey was a big kangaroo who liked to hop and play all day. One day, Joey got lost in the forest and he was confused. He didn't know which way to go to find his way back home.

Joey sat down and started to plan. He thought about the way he came and tried to remember the trees and bushes he saw. After a while, Joey figured out the right way and started to hop towards home. 

When Joey finally made it back home, all his kangaroo friends were so happy to see him. They asked him where he had been and Joey explained that he got lost but he made a plan to find his way back. From that day on, Joey was known as the smartest kangaroo in the forest.

Tom and Amy are friends. They like to play with blocks. They build a big network of blocks. They put blocks on top of blocks. They make bridges and towers and houses.

"Look at our network!" Tom says. "It is so big and cool!"

"Yes, it is!" Amy says. "We are good builders!"

They smile at each other. They are happy and proud.

But then, a heavy ball rolls into the room. It is Bob's ball. Bob is Tom's big brother. He likes to play soccer. He does not see the network of blocks. He kicks the ball hard.

The ball hits the network. The blocks fall down. They make a loud noise. The network is gone.

Tom and Amy are sad and angry. They look at Bob. Bob looks at them. He sees the mess. He says, "Oops! I'm sorry!"

Tom and Amy do not say anything. They do not smile. They pick up the blocks. They start to build again.

Once upon a time there was a harmless little girl. She loved to roll around and play in the garden. One day she decided to go on an adventure.

She went to a restaurant that she had never been to before. It smelled really yummy inside so she went in. She looked around and noticed the walls were blue and the chairs were red. 

She found a table and started to roll around it. Suddenly, the floor started shaking and she realized it was a rolling chair! She laughed and hopped up and down.

She got so excited she forgot to leave the restaurant. She happily rolled around the restaurant for hours until it was time to go home. 

As she walked out of the restaurant, she waved goodbye and promised herself to come back again someday.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and run around in the park. One day, she went to the park and saw her friend Max.

"Hi Max, do you want to play with me?" asked Lily.

"Yes, I would enjoy that," said Max with a smile.

Lily and Max played together, swinging on the swings and sliding down the slide. They were very happy and had a lot of fun. Suddenly, Lily saw a butterfly and ran after it. Max followed her and they chased the butterfly together.

After a while, they got tired and sat down on the grass. "I feel so happy when I play with you, Max," said Lily.

"I feel the same way, Lily. It's the spirit of friendship," said Max.

Lily and Max hugged each other and smiled. They had a wonderful day together at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to dance all day long. Dancing made her very happy.

One day, Lily had to go visit her grandma. She had to miss her dance class. Lily was sad because she loved her dance class so much. She knew it would be hard to not dance.

When Lily got to her grandma's house, she told her grandma how much she missed her dance class. Her grandma had an idea. They danced together in the living room. Lily was happy again. She learned that even if she missed her dance class, she could still dance and have fun.

Lily and Sam liked to play outside in the snow. They had a red wagon that they used to pull each other around. One day, they saw a big hill that looked fun to slide down.

"Let's go down the hill in the wagon!" Sam said.

"OK, but be careful. The snow is icy and slippery," Lily said.

They put the wagon at the top of the hill and climbed in. Sam held the handle and Lily held on to the sides. They were ready to go.

"Ready, set, go!" Sam shouted and pushed the wagon.

The wagon started to roll down the hill, faster and faster. Lily and Sam laughed and screamed as they felt the wind in their faces. The wagon went over bumps and made funny noises.

But then, they saw a problem. At the bottom of the hill, there was a big tree. The wagon was going too fast to stop or turn.

"Look out!" Lily yelled.

"Close your eyes!" Sam said.

They closed their eyes and hoped for the best. The wagon hit the tree with a loud bang. Lily and Sam flew out of the wagon and landed in the snow. They were not hurt, but they were very cold and wet.

They opened their eyes and saw the wagon. It was broken and bent. They felt sad and sorry.

"Oh no, our wagon!" Lily cried.

"I'm sorry, Lily. It was my fault. I should have been more careful," Sam said.

They hugged each other and tried to cheer up.

"It's OK, Sam. It was fun while it lasted. Maybe we can fix it later. Or maybe we can get a new one for Christmas," Lily said.

They got up and walked back to their house, holding hands. They left the wagon behind, but they took their memories with them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mommy asked her to go to the grocery store to buy some milk. Lily was very excited to go on her own.

She walked to the store and picked up the milk. But on her way back home, she saw some pretty flowers and started picking them. She played for a while and then went home. But when she got there, her mommy was very mad. Lily had forgotten the milk!

Lily felt ashamed and said sorry to her mommy. She promised to never forget again. From that day on, Lily always remembered to get the groceries her mommy asked for.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who went to the market with her mum. The girl was very excited, as the market was full of exciting things to see.

When they got to the market, the girl saw many different stalls. She saw stalls full of toys, and clothes, and food. But one stall caught her eye because it was full of coal. It looked shiny and dark, and it seemed so special.

When she asked her mum about it, her mum said it was for sale. The coal at the stall was very cheap - much cheaper than anywhere else. So her mum bought some coal for the girl to take home.

When they got back home, the girl went to her room and put the coal in a bucket. Then she ran off to tell her mum what she had found at the market. She excitedly told her mum all about the coal and how cheap it was. 

The little girl was so happy that she kept the coal with her all the time. Whenever her mum tried to put it away, the little girl would tell her it was her special coal that she had bought at the market.

Sara likes to walk with her mom and dad. They walk to the park and see many things. Sara sees a dog, a bird, a ball and a slide. She wants to play with everything.

Sara sees a big stack of blocks. She runs to the blocks and picks one up. She puts it on the ground and picks another one. She puts it on top of the first one. She makes a tower with the blocks. She thinks it is easy and fun.

But then a boy comes and kicks the tower. The blocks fall down and make a loud noise. Sara is sad and angry. She cries and shouts at the boy. The boy laughs and runs away.

Sara's mom and dad come and hug her. They tell her it is okay. They help her pick up the blocks and make a new tower. They make it bigger and stronger. They tell her she is smart and brave.

Sara smiles and says thank you. She likes her new tower and her mom and dad. She is happy again. She walks with them to the swing and swings high. She feels the wind and the sun. She thinks it is a good day.

Once there was a naughty boy named Jack. He loved to play in the mud and climb trees every day. One day, Jack was playing outside when something strange happened. He was climbing an old tree when a big shock came out of it! Jack was very scared and ran home quickly.

When he got home, his mom asked him why he was suddenly so scared. Jack told her the story and his mom became angry. She said that he should never climb old trees because it can be dangerous. Jack promised he would never do it again.

He thought he had been very naughty and decided to try and be better. He helped his mom do chores and was very kind. Everybody noticed the difference and was very happy. Jack was happy too because he knew he was no longer naughty!

Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Max. He was very excited because today he was going on a journey! He and his family were taking a train to visit his grandpa. Max had never been on a train before, so he was a bit nervous.

When the time to leave arrived, they all got on their train. Max couldn't believe how helpful the train driver was. He gave Max and his family lots of advice on what to do on their journey. Max was so excited, he couldn't wait to get to his grandpa's house.

The train arrived at his grandpa's house. Max hopped off and ran to the front door. He couldn't wait to give his grandpa a big hug. When his grandpa opened the door, Max was the happiest child ever! He had the best day with his grandpa. They played lots of games, ate yummy food, and laughed until their bellies hurt.

Max was so thankful for his helpful train ride. He knew he would never forget his special adventure!

Jenna went to the park with her dad. She liked playing in the park, especially when the sun was shining. Jenna saw a yellow taxi drive by. She smiled at it and waved. The taxi stopped and a lady got out. Jenna was very surprised. The lady opened her arms and said "hello Jenna!" It was Jenna's grandma. She had come to take Jenna for an adventure! Jenna was scared but excited. She was never in a taxi and was worried about what might happen. Her dad said it was safe and she hopped in. As they drove off, Jenna was full of surprises. She had no idea where they were going but she knew it would be a fun adventure.

One day, John and his mom were walking in the park when they heard a sound coming from the bushes. Mom looked around and, to her surprise, revealed a large, grey kitten.

"What should we do with it?" asked John.

"Let's take it home," said Mom.

The two carefully took the kitten in their arms and loaded her into the car.

When they got home, Mom gave the kitten a bowl of milk and a warm blanket. But then they heard another sound coming from outside the window.

Peeking out, they revealed a large dog in the backyard. He was barking and growling at the kitten!

Mom quickly ran outside and yelled at the dog. He barked a few times more and then ran away.

John and his mom smiled as they watched the kitten curl up in its blanket. They were grateful that they were able to keep the kitten safe from the large, scary dog.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play outside. One day, he went to the park with his mom.

Tim saw a big swing and wanted to try it. His mom helped him get on the swing and pushed him back and forth. Tim laughed and giggled as he swung higher and higher.

After playing on the swing, Tim and his mom went to a tent. They went inside and sat down. Tim said, "This tent is cool!" His mom said, "Yes, it's a normal tent."

Tim and his mom had a fun day at the park, swinging and playing in the tent. When they went home, Tim told his dad all about his adventures.

Once upon a time, there were two friends who liked to play together all the time. Their names were Alice and Bob. They loved to have fun. One day they decided to have a picnic. They found a nice spot near the lake.

Alice and Bob laughed and teased each other as they ate their yummy sandwiches and drank their juice. They even played a crazy game of tag. After the picnic was over, Alice and Bob decided to lay down in the sun and talk about what a great time they had.

Suddenly, a fly came buzzing around them. It was so noisy! Alice and Bob couldn't help but laugh. Alice started to tease Bob and Bob teased Alice right back. They had so much fun being silly together.

Alice and Bob spent the rest of the day at the picnic. They never forgot their crazy, fun-filled afternoon.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play outside and run around. One day, he was playing with his friends and he stepped on a rock. Ouch! It hurt his foot. 

Timmy's mom took him to the doctor to get an x-ray. The x-ray machine took a picture of Timmy's foot. The doctor looked at the picture and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. Your foot is okay. It's just a little bruised. You'll be fine soon." 

Timmy was happy to hear that his foot was harmless. He went back to playing with his friends, but this time he was more careful where he stepped. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little red bear. He was sad because his fur had become worn and faded. One day he saw a magical fairy flying nearby.

"Fairy, can you help me?" asked the bear.

The fairy smiled. "I can," she said. She waved her wand and used her magic to restore the bear's fur. Instantly, the fur was bright and shiny, turning an even brighter red.

The bear was so happy. "Thank you so much, Fairy!"

The fairy smiled and said, "You're welcome." She flew away, leaving the bear happy and restored.

The bear ran off, excited to show off his beautiful red fur to all his friends!

Once upon a time there was a pretty fly. It was orange and had big wings. The sun was shining and the fly was happy.

The fly went buzzing around, looking for food. Suddenly he noticed a bright yellow flower. It had lots of yummy nectar!

He flew over to the flower and started drinking the nectar. It was so sweet and delicious! As he drank, he closed his eyes and blinked in content.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was a bee! The bee said: "Hi there, fly! What are you doing here? This flower is mine!"

The fly flew away in a hurry. He was feeling a bit scared. But then he saw something even prettier - a rainbow up in the sky. It was so big and colourful! He just had to go and look closer. 

He flew up to the rainbow and sat on a pot of gold. He blinked a few times in amazement. Then he smiled and said: "This is the prettiest place I have ever seen!"

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Stitch. Stitch was a happy puppy and loved to dance!

Once upon a time there was a patient little boy. His name was Jack and he was three years old. He loved playing in the garden of his house. One day he noticed something new. In the corner of the garden, there was an independent little birdie.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby fish named Fin. Fin lived in the sea with his family. They were all very happy. But one day, Fin saw a big boat enter the sea. The boat scared all the other fish away.

Fin swam up to the boat and said, "Please go away. You are scaring my friends." The boat did not listen to Fin. It kept coming closer and closer to the sea where the fish lived.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys on the table. One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, it's time to clean the table." Lily replied, "Okay, mommy!"

One day, John wanted to clean his yard. He got a powerful hose and pointed it in the direction of the piles of leaves. He turned on the hose, and the powerful water shot out and made the leaves scatter in all directions.

But then, Lily's doll fell from the swing and broke her arm. Lily cried and hugged her doll. She was very sad and angry.

Tom is a mailman. He has a big bag of letters and packages. He likes to deliver them to people's houses. He has a bike with a horn. He honks the horn when he comes to a house.

One day, he has a very important package. It is for Lisa, who lives at the end of the street. She is his friend. She is sick and cannot go outside. Tom wants to make her happy. He puts the package in his bag and rides his bike fast.

He honks his horn when he gets to Lisa's house. He knocks on the door. Lisa's mom opens the door. She smiles and says, "Hello, Tom. Do you have something for Lisa?"

Tom waves goodbye. He goes back to his bike. He honks his horn and rides away. He feels good. He likes to deliver important packages. He likes to make people happy. He is a good mailman.

Once upon a time there was a very tall man called Bob. One day, Bob decided he wanted to go for a bike ride. But, when he looked in his garage, he saw his bicycle had no pedals.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a humble dog named Bobo. Bobo was a little dog who loved to run and play. One day, Bobo saw a post near his home. It was a very tall post, and Bobo wanted to see what was on top.

Bobo agreed and climbed down the post. He was happy to be with his friend Mimi, and they played together all day long. They had so much fun, and Bobo forgot all about the cold and the tall post.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Anna. She was three years old. Anna's mum and dad wanted to introduce her to the library. Anna was excited but a bit scared.

Once upon a time there was a rabbit. He was soft and white and his fur was soft and fluffy. He had a big appetite and loved to eat.

One day he was hopping through the forest and he smelled something strange. It was a smelly smell and he knew it was coming from somewhere. He hopped closer and he saw a cat!

The cat saw the rabbit and started to chase him. The rabbit was scared and he ran and hopped as fast as he could. But the cat was fast and it was getting closer. The rabbit was so scared!

But then the rabbit came to a nearby tree. He was so tired he couldn't run anymore. He jumped into the tree and caught a branch. The branch went up high and he was safe!

The cat was angry that the rabbit got away. He hissed and spat but the rabbit stayed in the tree. The cat walked away, leaving the rabbit behind. The rabbit sighed with relief and he knew he was safe. He was so happy he had caught the branch!

Lily and Ben were best friends. They liked to play with their toys and share their snacks. One day, they went to the park with their moms. There were many swings, slides and sandboxes in the park. Lily and Ben wanted to try them all.

They ran to the swings first. But there were no swings available. All the swings had other kids on them. Lily and Ben felt sad. They asked their moms if they could wait for a swing. Their moms said yes, but they had to be patient and polite.

Lily and Ben waited for a long time. They watched the other kids swing high and low. They wanted to have fun too. They started to feel angry. They thought the other kids were mean and selfish. They wanted to take a swing from them.

"Let's go and push them off the swings!" Lily whispered to Ben.

"No, that's not nice. That's rude and wrong." Ben whispered back.

"But they are not sharing! They are hogging the swings!" Lily argued.

"That doesn't matter. We can't hurt them or make them cry. We have to wait for our turn." Ben said.

Lily and Ben kept waiting. They saw a girl get off a swing. They ran to the swing. But another boy got there first. He jumped on the swing and started to swing. Lily and Ben felt more angry. They wanted to yell at the boy.

"Hey, that's not fair! We were here first!" Lily shouted.

"Sorry, I didn't see you. I just wanted to swing." The boy said.

"Well, you have to share. You can't take the swing from us." Ben said.

The boy looked at Lily and Ben. He saw their sad and angry faces. He realized he was not being kind. He felt sorry. He decided to do the right thing.

"Okay, I'm sorry. You can have the swing. I'll go and play somewhere else." The boy said.

He got off the swing and gave it to Lily and Ben. Lily and Ben were surprised. They didn't expect the boy to be nice. They felt happy. They thanked the boy and got on the swing. They started to swing high and low. They had fun.

They learned a lesson. They learned that sharing is caring. They learned that being kind and polite is better than being mean and rude. They learned that waiting for their turn is fair and good. They realized they liked the park. They liked the swings. They liked the boy. They liked each other. They were best friends.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sally. Sally loved looking up at the sky. She would lay in the grass and admire the pretty colours. One day when Sally was looking up, she saw something scary in the sky. It was a big monster! Sally got scared and ran as fast as she could away from it.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One evening, Lily went to take a bath before bed. She liked to soak in the warm water and play with her rubber duck.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Anna. She wanted to plant a pretty flower in her garden, so she went outside to look for a place to put it. Anna saw a gray patch of soil. Once upon a time, there was a weak little monkey. He went on a walk in the jungle and came across a skull. It made the little monkey scared and he frowned. He thought the skull might hurt him! Ben and Lily were playing in the yard. They saw a big fire in the woods. They wanted to help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a house with her mommy and daddy. Their neighbor was a nice lady named Mrs. Smith. Lily loved to visit Mrs. Smith because she always had cookies and milk.

Tom and Lily like to play with their toys. Tom has a camera that can take pictures. Lily has a doll that can talk. They have fun together.

Lily says, "No, Tom. Go away. Find your own toy."

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Jack. He was very excited because he was at the beach with his mom.

The sun was shining and the sea was very calm. Jack saw a big, blue wave rolling in and asked, "Mom, can I go and play?"

Mama nodded, "Yes, be careful. Have fun!"

Jack hopped on the sand and danced, spinning and twirling around on his toes. He laughed as the wind blew through his hair, like a big hug.

Then, he heard something. Jack turned and saw a pretty, pink kite flying above him. He waved at it and shouted, "Hi!"

The kite spun in circles above Jack's head. He smiled and felt so happy, like he was dancing in the sky.

Jack and the kite played together all afternoon. They spun together, over the sea and the smooth sand. 

"Bye-bye kite," Jack waved as the sun went down and it was time to go home.

The kite waved back, spinning one last time. Then it flew away, taking all of Jack's happy memories with it.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful bear. He was very proud of his shiny black coat and he liked to stand tall. Everywhere he went people thought he was beautiful. Once upon a time, there was a wealthy family. Every day, Daddy was so busy trying to make money. One day, he decided to buy a new pipe.

So the Daddy bought the pipe. The family was so excited to try it out. They went to a big park and everyone had so much fun. Daddy showed them how to make the pipe talk, and the whole family laughed when Daddy blew bubbles in the air. 

The next day, they all enjoyed their new pipe, and Daddy was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was so happy because she was getting ready to go to sleep. She put on her cozy pajamas and tucked herself into bed. She snuggled beneath her blankets and turned off the light. 

She could hear the tap in the kitchen and thought it was so beautiful. She smiled and drifted off to sleep. 

Suddenly, she was no longer in her room! She had dreamed that she was in a magical kingdom with a beautiful tap that sparkled like stars. She spent all day playing in the kingdom, made friends with all the animals, and even ate candy from the tap! 

But before she knew it, it was time to go back to bed. She said goodbye to all her friends and headed back to her room. She snuggled up in bed and soon fell into a deep sleep.

Once upon a time, there was a very intelligent fox. His name was Max. Max was always looking for something special. He had heard of a secret chest that was full of gold and he wanted to find it. 

One day, Max decided to mail a special letter to his friend, Furr. The letter explained that Max was hunting for the chest and asked his friend if he could help him. 

When Furr got the letter he was very excited. He knew exactly where the chest was and he wanted to help Max find it. So, Furr helped Max to mail a reply letter to himself with the directions to the chest. 

The next day Max followed the directions that Furr had mailed him. It wasn't long before Max found the secret chest. He opened it and found it full of gold! Max was very happy and thanked Furr for being so intelligent and helping him find it. 

Max and Furr lived happily ever after with their big chest of gold!

There was a little girl named Daisy. One day, Daisy saw a hero walking outside her window. He looked so strong and brave! Daisy began to peek through the window to get a better look at her hero. Suddenly, the hero turned around and caught Daisy peeking. He smiled and waved to her; it was so adorable!

Daisy and the hero played together all day until it was time for him to go. Daisy waved goodbye to her hero as he walked away. 

Daisy never forgot the day she met her hero. Every time she sees him, she peeks out the window to get a glimpse of him. Daisy and her hero will always be best of friends, and Daisy will always remember how adorable he was that day.

Once upon a time, there was a naughty boy named James. He had big, blue eyes that twinkled in the sunshine.

Suddenly, he heard a soft giggle. It was the sunshine, playing with James! He laughed and jumped up, chasing the sunshine. As he ran, his eyes blinked even more as he couldn't help himself from smiling. 

The sunshine kept playing with James for a very long time. Eventually, it was time for dinner and James had to go inside. He waved goodbye to the sunshine and went inside with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time there were two friends, John and Sally. They liked to play together all the time. One day, they started to fight over a chain. John was being very loud and loud and would not let Sally near it. Sally was very sad that her friend was not being nice to her.

Eventually, an old man came and saw what was happening. He saw the chain they were both fighting over. He told them he wanted to help. He put a modest chain around each of their necks. He said that this would help them stop fighting.

John and Sally felt much better after the old man put the chain around their necks. They started to play together again and all was good. They learned a valuable lesson that day and never fought over things again.

Once there was a very kind boy named Max. One day he went out to the grocery store to buy some lemons.

Once there was a blue basketball. The basketball was in the garden on a hot summer day. It was melting in the sun.

Sara and Ben like to play in the park. They like to run, swing, slide and climb. One day, they see a big tree with many branches. They want to climb the tree and see what is up there.

They hold hands and start to climb. They are careful not to fall. They see many birds and squirrels on the way. They hear them chirp and chatter. They are happy and curious.

They reach a high branch and see a nest. The nest is made of sticks and leaves. It has four eggs inside. The eggs are blue and speckled. They are beautiful. Sara and Ben want to examine the nest and the eggs. They lean closer and stretch their hands.

But then they hear a loud screech. A big bird flies towards them. It has a sharp beak and claws. It is angry and protective. It is the mother of the eggs. It wants to chase Sara and Ben away from the nest.

Sara and Ben are fearful. They scream and let go of the nest. They quickly climb down the tree. They run to the ground and hug each other. They are safe and sorry. Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to march around the house like a soldier. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a map to play with. Timmy was glad to have a new toy.

But when they opened the chest, they saw that it was full of spiders. Timmy and Billy were scared and ran away. Timmy's mom told him that sometimes things that look good can be bad. Timmy learned to be careful and not trust everything he sees on a map.

Ben and Lily were adventurous twins who liked to explore new places. One day, they found a big suitcase in the attic. It was old and dusty, but it had a shiny buckle on it.

"Let's open it and see what's inside!" Ben said.

"Okay, but be careful. It might be locked or have something scary in it." Lily said.

They tried to pull the buckle, but it was too hard. They pushed and twisted it, but it did not move.

"I don't understand. How do we open it?" Ben asked.

"Maybe we need a key or a code or something." Lily said.

They looked around the attic for clues, but they did not find anything. They were about to give up, when they heard a voice.

"Hello, children. Do you want to play a game?" The voice came from the suitcase.

Ben and Lily were surprised and curious. They went closer to the suitcase and saw a small speaker on it.

"Who are you? Where are you?" Ben asked.

"I am the suitcase. I have been waiting for someone to open me for a long time. I have many secrets and treasures inside, but you have to solve a riddle to unlock me." The voice said.

"A riddle? What is a riddle?" Lily asked.

"A riddle is a question that has a clever or funny answer. If you guess the answer, you can open the buckle. If you don't, you can try again later. Do you want to try?" The voice said.

Ben and Lily nodded. They liked games and puzzles. They wanted to see what was inside the suitcase.

"Okay, here is the riddle. Listen carefully. What has a face and two hands, but no arms or legs?" The voice said.

Ben and Lily thought hard. They looked at each other and whispered.

"Is it a clock?" Ben said.

"Or a watch?" Lily said.

They decided to say both answers, just in case.

"A clock or a watch!" They shouted together.

The voice laughed.

"Very good, children. You are smart and adventurous. You guessed the riddle. You can open the buckle now. Go ahead and see what I have for you." The voice said.

Ben and Lily were excited. They pulled the buckle again, and this time it opened. They lifted the lid of the suitcase and saw a lot of colorful things inside. There were books and toys and clothes and pictures and more.

"Wow, look at all this stuff!" Ben said.

"It's amazing! It's like a treasure chest!" Lily said.

They started to take out the things and play with them. They found a storybook about pirates and a teddy bear with a patch and a dress with sparkles and a camera with a flash and more.

They thanked the voice and the suitcase for the game and the gifts. They had a lot of fun and learned new things. They decided to keep the suitcase as their secret friend and visit it often. They were happy and adventurous twins.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing in the park with her friends. One day, her friend Jack fell down and hurt his leg. Ben and Lily were playing in the park. They liked to swing on the swings and slide on the slides. They saw a big tire hanging from a tree. It looked like fun.

"Can we play with the tire?" Ben asked Lily.

"Sure, let's go!" Lily said. They ran to the tire and took turns to sit in it and push each other.

Soon, a boy came to the tire. He was bigger than Ben and Lily. He had a mean face and a loud voice.

"Get off my tire!" he shouted. "This is my tire and you can't play with it!"

Ben and Lily were scared. They got off the tire and tried to walk away.

"That's rude!" Lily said. "We were here first and we were sharing!"

The boy did not care. He grabbed the tire and tried to hold it. But the tire was too heavy for him. He lost his balance and fell to the ground. The tire rolled away and hit a fence.

"Ow! Ow! Ow!" he cried. He rubbed his head and his knee.

Ben and Lily felt sorry for him. They went to him and helped him up.

"Are you okay?" Ben asked.

"That hurt!" the boy said. He looked at the tire and then at Ben and Lily. He felt bad for being rude.

"I'm sorry," he said. "I was mean to you. Can we be friends?"

Ben and Lily smiled. They nodded and held his hands.

"Sure, we can be friends," Lily said. "And we can play with the tire together!"

They all hugged and laughed. They went to the tire and had fun. They learned to share and be kind.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Tim. He was playing outside in his garden when he saw a strange shape in a tree. He went closer to take a look and, to his surprise, he found a drum. Tim was so excited and picked up the drum and asked, "What's this?".

Suddenly, there was a fierce roar from the tree and a bear appeared. The bear said, "That's my drum. You can't have it." Tim was scared but he said bravely, "Please can I have it?" The bear replied, "No, I need it for my special music."

Tim thought for a moment and said, "I can repair your drum and make it sound better. Then you can have the best music ever." The bear was so happy and agreed to let Tim have the drum.

Tim spent the morning with the bear, fixing up the drum. And, sure enough, when he finished, it sounded even better than before. The bear was so excited and thanked Tim for his help. He smiled and told him to keep the drum. 

From then on, Tim played his drum everywhere he went. He always made sure to play it with a fierce roar just like the bear had.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went outside to play. She saw her friend, a little boy named Timmy, and ran over to him.

"Hi Timmy, what are you doing?" asked Lily.

"Can I help you catch it?" asked Lily.

"Yes please," said Timmy.

Lily threw the ball to Timmy and he caught it. They played catch together for a long time and had lots of fun. When it started to get dark, they said goodbye and went home.

Once upon a time, there was a big fat cat named Fluffy. Fluffy lived in a cozy house with her owner, a kind lady named Sarah. Every day, Fluffy would look out the window and dream of exploring the valley beyond the house.

One day, Sarah decided to take Fluffy on a walk in the valley. Fluffy was so excited to finally see what was beyond her window. As they walked, Fluffy noticed a big, scary dog in the distance. Sarah tried to protect Fluffy, but the dog attacked and Fluffy suffered a big bite.

Fluffy was rushed to the vet, but unfortunately, the bite was too severe and Fluffy did not survive. Sarah was heartbroken and wished she had never taken Fluffy into the valley. From that day on, Sarah made sure to keep all her furry friends safe and sound inside the cozy house.

As he dove deep into the water, he noticed something really exciting - he could see hundreds of colorful fish swimming around him! He quickly swam back up to the surface and looked around, but there was nobody around. He had discovered a secret underwater paradise, all for himself. The zebra was so happy that he splashed and jumped in the water, feeling free and joyous. He dove back down to the bottom one more time and looked around, smiling and laughing, before heading back up to the surface.

Once upon a time, there lived a bear named Jack. He was a strong and brave bear and he liked to protect his friends. One day, Jack met a little duck who was very sad. The duck had lost her beautiful striped feathers and she was feeling miserable. So Jack decided to help the duck.

He took the duck to a special place with a pond and lots of trees. There were also many colourful feathers that were very soft and comfortable. Jack told the duck to stay by the pond and he went off to find some snacks for her.

Jack also gathered many colourful feathers to make a blanket for the duck. He worked very hard creating the beautiful blanket and soon he had made the most beautiful striped blanket ever!

The little duck was so happy when she saw the blanket Jack had made. She thanked Jack for protecting her and helping her to feel warm and safe. From that day on, the little duck had her own special striped blanket to keep her warm, and she never felt sad again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play at the park every day. One day, she met a new friend named Timmy. They played together on the swings and had so much fun.

Suddenly, Timmy said, "Hey Lily, do you want to take a quiz?" Lily didn't know what a quiz was, but she said yes anyway. Timmy asked her questions like "What color is the sky?" and "What sound does a dog make?" Lily answered all of them correctly and felt very proud of herself.

After the quiz, they went back to the swings. Timmy started swinging really high and Lily got a little scared. She said, "Timmy, you're swinging crazy!" Timmy laughed and said, "It's so much fun!" Once upon a time, there was a man named Tom and his wife, Sue. They lived in a small house. Tom and Sue were poor, but they loved each other very much.

One day, Tom said to Sue, "I will study hard to get a good job, so we can have more things." Sue was happy and said, "I will help you study, and we will be happy together."

Tom studied every day with Sue's help. They worked together and learned many things. Soon, Tom got a good job, and they were not poor anymore. They were very happy and thanked each other for their love and hard work.

Tom and Lily were playing with their toy cars. They liked to pretend they were racing on a big road. Tom had a blue car and Lily had an orange car. They made noises like vroom and beep.

"Let's see who is faster," Tom said. "We start here and finish there." He pointed to a line on the floor.

"OK," Lily said. "But we need fuel first. Our cars are hungry." She picked up a bottle of water and poured some on her car. "There, now you have fuel."

Tom laughed. "That's not fuel, that's water. Water is for drinking, not for cars. My car has real fuel." He showed Lily a can of juice. "This is fuel. It makes my car go fast."

Lily frowned. "But juice is for drinking too. And it's sticky. It will make your car dirty."

Tom shrugged. "I don't care. I want to win. Ready, set, go!" He pushed his car hard and zoomed ahead of Lily.

Lily followed him with her car. She saw Tom's car leave a trail of juice on the floor. She thought it looked funny. She smiled and kept playing.

Soon, Tom reached the finish line. He cheered. "I won, I won! I told you my car is faster. My fuel is better."

Lily reached the finish line too. She clapped. "Good job, Tom. You are fast. But look at your car. It's all sticky and wet. And look at the floor. It's all messy and slippery. You made a big mess."

Tom looked at his car. He touched it and felt the juice. He looked at the floor. He saw the juice. He felt bad. He realized he was wrong. He said sorry to Lily. "You're right, Lily. I made a big mess. Water is not fuel, and juice is not fuel either. They are for drinking. I was silly and rude. Can you forgive me?"

Lily nodded. She hugged Tom. "Of course I forgive you, Tom. You are my friend. And you know what? I like your car. It's blue and shiny. And I like my car too. It's orange and bright. They are both nice cars. They don't need fuel. They need love."

Tom smiled. He hugged Lily back. "You're right, Lily. They are both nice cars. And they both have love. And we have love too. We are friends. And friends don't fight over silly things. They share and care."

They cleaned up the mess together. They played with their cars some more. They had fun. They learned a lesson. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a kind boy named Tim. Tim lived in a small village near a big forest. Tim loved to play in the forest and collect lumber. One day, Tim went to the forest and found a big pile of lumber. He was so happy and started to collect it.

Suddenly, a big bear appeared and scared Tim. The bear was angry and said, "Why are you taking my lumber? I will punish you!" Tim was scared and said, "I didn't know it was yours. I'm sorry. Please don't punish me."

The bear thought for a moment and said, "Okay, I won't punish you this time. But next time, make sure you ask before taking my lumber." Tim nodded his head and thanked the bear for being kind. From that day on, Tim always asked before taking lumber from the forest.

Once upon a time, in a small kitchen, there was a chubby cat named Mittens. Mittens loved to cook and bake with his owner, Lucy. One day, Lucy wanted to make a cake. She asked Mittens, "Do you want to help me make a cake?"

Mittens was very happy and said, "Yes, I want to help!" So, Lucy and Mittens started to make the cake. They used a measure to pour the flour into a big bowl. Then, they added sugar, eggs, and milk. Mittens helped stir the mix with a big spoon. He stirred and stirred until it was smooth.

When the cake was ready, Lucy put it in the oven to bake. Mittens and Lucy waited and waited. The cake smelled so good! When the cake was done, they took it out of the oven. They let it cool down and then put sweet icing on top. Mittens and Lucy shared the cake with their friends. Everyone loved the cake and had a great time.

Soon, all the children in the village learned to share the toys from the chest. They learned that sharing was good and made everyone happy. The helpful man, Tom, was happy to see the children playing together.

The moral of the story is that sharing is a good thing, and being helpful can make everyone happy.

"You're welcome, Ben. Do you want more?" Lily asks.

"No, thank you. I'm full," Ben says. He puts the cup and the plate on the tray.

They carry the tray to the kitchen. They give it to their mom.

"Good job, Lily and Ben. You played nicely with your tray," their mom says. She smiles and hugs them.
