After a while, they came to a beautiful waterfall. Lily loved the sound of the water falling down. 

"This journey is so much fun!" Lily said.

"I'm glad you're having a good time, sweetie," her daddy said. 

After a long day of walking, they went back home. Lily was tired but happy from her journey in the green forest.

John and his mom were at the store. They looked at all the things for sale, but none of them felt special. Everything was so cheap. Suddenly, Mom noticed an item in the corner that caught her eye. It was expensive, so she paused. She looked desperately at John and said, "It's not very often that something like this comes at such a good price. Maybe we should buy it". John's heart raced with excitement. He wanted it so badly. 

With one look, Mom knew and said, "Let's buy it. It'll be a memory that we'll never forget". John smiled and they made their purchase. On their way out of the store they passed by the cheap items they had looked at earlier. The silence was deafening. 

John and Mom made it all the way home with the new item when, suddenly--with a crash--it broke. It was ruined. John was so disappointed as he stared at the broken item. Mom was heartbroken too. She had ruined the only memory she'd been able to give her son.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her dolls and her favorite doll was named Rosie. One day, Lily was playing with Rosie when she accidentally dropped her on the ground. Rosie's hair got all tangled up and Lily didn't know what to do.

Lily's mom came over and saw what happened. She said, "It's okay, Lily. We can fix Rosie's hair. Let's get some oil and gently brush it out." Lily watched as her mom repeated the process until Rosie's hair was all smooth again.

"Thank you, Mommy!" Lily said as she hugged her mom. From then on, Lily made sure to be more careful when playing with Rosie.

Once there was a little girl named Amy. She lived with her mom and dad in the countryside. One day, she went outside to explore the garden. As she walked around, she saw a little squirrel and decided to follow it.

The squirrel played in the dirt and Amy laughed. Suddenly, it jumped up and teased her. Amy laughed harder and kept walking.

Soon she saw a bird and chased after it. The bird flew up and landed on top of a tree. When Amy reached the tree, she noticed a delicious berry nestled in the dust. She couldn't resist and ate the berry.

Amy smiled, pleased with herself. She danced around, teasing the squirrel with her dancing. The squirrel was too shy to come any closer, so Amy laughed and kept walking.

One day, a girl named Lucy went with her mom to mail a letter. Lucy walked slow because she liked to watch her shadow. She saw her shadow get big and small as she moved. "Look, Mommy! My shadow is dancing!" Lucy said.

"Wow, Lucy! Your shadow likes to dance with you," Mommy said. They both laughed and danced with their shadows all the way to the mailbox. When they got there, Lucy helped Mommy put the letter in the mailbox. "Good job, Lucy!" Mommy said.

On their way back home, Lucy saw a boy who was sad. His shadow was not dancing. Lucy went to him and said, "Hi! My name is Lucy. Let's dance with our shadows!" The boy smiled and danced with Lucy and his shadow. They all had fun. The moral of the story is to be kind and share your joy with others.

Little Mary was baking in the kitchen with her Mom. Mary's Mom was wearing a pretty white apron and she helped Mary mix flour and sugar together. Mary always liked to sniff the sweet smelling dough, but this time it didn't smell sweet, it smelt sour. Mary made a disgusted face and began to cry. Her Mom put her hands around Mary and tried to make her feel better. She said that accidents happen, and that sometimes you have to start over. Mary wiped away her tears and nodded her head. Her Mom took off her apron and handed it to Mary. With her apron, Mary could mix the ingredients together again. Little by little, she tore the apron into pieces and used it to mix the dough until it smelt sweet again. When it was ready, she proudly showed it to her Mom and together they made the most delicious cookies.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely little girl named Lucy. She liked to play with her toys and wear pretty clothes. One day, Lucy's mom bought her a new dress. It was pink and had a big bow on the front. Lucy was very happy.

Lucy put on her new dress and went outside to play. She saw her friend, Tom, playing with his ball. "Hi, Tom!" said Lucy. "Look at my new dress!" Tom looked at Lucy's dress and said, "Wow, that's a lovely dress, Lucy!"

Lucy and Tom played together all day. They played catch with the ball and ran around in the grass. When it was time to go home, Lucy's dress was dirty. She was sad, but her mom said, "Don't worry, Lucy. We can wash your dress and it will be clean again."

Lucy's mom washed her dress and hung it up to dry. The next day, Lucy put on her clean dress and said, "Thank you, Mom, for washing my dress. It looks lovely again!" Her mom smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lucy. Now go have fun and play with your friends!"

And so, Lucy went outside to play with her friends, wearing her lovely clean dress. She was happy and thankful for her mom who helped her keep her clothes clean.

Sara loves flowers. She likes to look at them and smell them. She has a small garden with many flowers. She waters them every day and talks to them.

One day, she sees a new flower in her garden. It is bright yellow and has many petals. Sara is happy. She runs to the flower and says, "Hello, flower! You are so pretty! What is your name?"

The flower does not answer. Sara thinks maybe the flower is shy. She says, "Don't be afraid, flower. I am Sara. I care for you. I will give you water and sun. You can be my friend."

The flower still does not answer. Sara is sad. She thinks maybe the flower does not like her. She says, "Please, flower, talk to me. I want to hear your voice. Do you like me?"

The flower still does not answer. Sara is about to cry. She thinks maybe the flower is sick. She says, "Are you okay, flower? Do you need something? I will help you."

Then, she hears a small voice. It is the flower. The flower says, "Hello, Sara. I am sorry I did not talk to you. I was asleep. I am a sunflower. I only wake up when the sun is bright. Thank you for caring for me. You are very kind. I like you."

Sara is happy. She smiles and hugs the flower. She says, "I am glad you are awake, sunflower. You are very beautiful. I am happy to be your friend."

The flower smiles and nods. It says, "I am happy to be your friend, too, Sara. You make me feel warm and loved. Let's talk and play together."

Sara and the sunflower become good friends. They talk and play every day. They care for each other and make each other happy. They are the brightest flowers in the garden.

Once upon a time there was a sailor who had a boat. He wanted to go on an adventure so he set off with his boat. Then, something bad happened. His boat split in two with a loud bang. The sailor was very sad because his boat was broken. 

He was all alone and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, he saw something in the distance. It was a rainbow! He knew he had to follow it.

The sailor swam and swam, following the bright colors of the rainbow. Finally, he made it to a sunny beach. He was so happy! 

The sailor was so grateful that he built a new boat from the broken pieces of his old one. Then, he set off on a new adventure in his new boat beneath the rainbow.

Anna likes to read books. She has many books on her bookshelf. She likes to look at the pictures and learn new words. Sometimes she reads to her teddy bear.

One day, Anna sees a new book on her bookshelf. It is big and brown and has no pictures. It has many words that Anna does not know. Anna does not like the new book. She thinks it is ugly and boring.

She picks up the book and goes to her mom. She says, "Mom, I don't want this book. It is ugly and boring. Can I have a different book?"

Mom looks at the book and smiles. She says, "This book is not for you, Anna. It is for me. It is a book about history. I like to read about history. It is not ugly and boring to me. It is interesting and fun."

Anna frowns. She does not understand why mom likes the book. She says, "But mom, it has no pictures. How can you read it without pictures?"

Mom says, "I can read it because I know many words. When I read the words, I can imagine the pictures in my head. It is like a movie in my head. Do you want to try?"

Anna thinks for a moment. She likes movies. She says, "Okay, mom. I will try. Can you read it to me?"

Mom says, "Sure, Anna. Come, sit with me on the couch. I will read it to you and show you the pictures in my head."

Anna and mom sit on the couch. Mom opens the book and starts to read. Anna listens and tries to imagine the pictures. She sees people and places and things that she has never seen before. She feels curious and excited. She asks mom many questions. Mom answers and explains. Anna and mom have fun reading the book.

Anna learns that books can be different and that different people can like different books. She learns that books can take her to new worlds and teach her new things. She learns that books can be interesting and fun, even without pictures. She smiles and hugs mom. She says, "Thank you, mom. I like this book now. Can we read more?"

John was a good boy. He liked to create new things. One day, he wanted to make some boots. His mom gave him some supplies and he got to work. He glued different pieces of fabric together and sewed on some laces. When he finished, he was very proud of his boots. 

â€œMommy, look!â€ he said, holding up the boots.

â€œOh, wow!â€ his mom said. â€œYou did a really good job.â€

John smiled. He wore his new boots outside and ran around in the sunshine. He was proud of his creative work and was happy to have made something all on his own.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy was very sleepy because he had played all day. His mommy told him it was time for bed, but Timmy was too busy looking for a snack in the fridge. He found some yummy cheese and crackers, but his mommy said he had to hurry and eat quickly so he could go to bed. Timmy ate as fast as he could and then climbed into his cozy bed. He fell asleep right away and dreamed of all the fun things he would do the next day.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with blocks and build tall towers. One day, Tim's dad helped him build a big bridge with the blocks. The bridge was easy to make because the blocks were big and not too hard to stack.

Tim was so happy with his new bridge that he wanted to show it to his friends. He asked his mom if they could go for a walk to the park. When they got to the park, Tim ran over to the big river. He showed his friends the bridge he and his dad built. They were so impressed that they all wanted to try to cross it.

Tim's friends took turns crossing the bridge. It was a little scary at first, but they all made it across safely. Tim was so proud of his bridge and happy that his friends enjoyed it too. From that day on, Tim and his friends built many more things together, but the bridge they built together was always their favorite.

Once there was a little train engine named Bob. Bob lived in the countryside with his friends, and every day he pulled a little red train around the hills. 

One day Bob was feeling a bit different. He was feeling a bit fearful. He was worried â€“ what if he couldn't pull the train around the hills like he usually did? 

Bob's friend the steam engine noticed how worried Bob was. He said to him, "Hey Bob, why don't you use your engine? I'm sure it will help you do what you need to do today."

Bob thought about it and decided to give it a try. He lifted up his engine, and slowly he began to move around the hills. And sure enough, it worked â€“ Bob was able to pull the train around the hills just like he usually did.

Bob was so relieved. He smiled and said, "Thank you for your help, steam engine! I'm so glad I was able to use my engine and not be so fearful anymore!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Thomas. One day, he was playing in his bedroom and he found a pretty red bracelet. Thomas was so happy, he wanted to put the bracelet on right away. 

"Mommy, look at the bracelet!" he shouted.

His mother saw the bracelet, and said, "No, Thomas. You can't keep the bracelet. It must belong to someone else."

Thomas was very disappointed. But suddenly, he had an idea. He said to his mother, "Let me keep it for just one day. Please?"

His mother thought about it for a moment, and said, "All right. You can keep the bracelet for one day. But then you must shut it away in a safe place and never take it out again".

Thomas was so excited. He put the red bracelet on and ran out to show it to his friends. The day passed quickly and before he knew it, it was time to keep the bracelet safe. 

Thomas shut the bracelet away in a special box and put it in his mother's drawer. Every time he would look inside the drawer, he would remember that special day when he found the pretty red bracelet.

Once there was a little girl called Molly. She was three years old and loved adventure. One day, Molly decided to go out and explore.

She took a walk and soon came upon a park. She spotted a hill and went to check it out.

"This is a great spot for zooming!" said Molly, who quickly set off running up the hill. When she got to the top, Molly started spinning around, creating a big clean whirl. Then, she raised her arms and shouted "I'm zooming! I'm zooming!" 

Suddenly, a friendly scratch came flying over the top of the hill and landed beside her. It was a tiny fairy.

"Hello there," said the fairy. "What are you doing?"

Molly smiled. "I'm zooming. Would you like to join me?"

The fairy agreed and soon the two were happily spinning and zooming around the hill. After a while, the fairy said "that was so much fun! Can I request one more zoom?"

Molly smiled and said, "Of course. Let's go!" And they zoomed around the hill one more time, with laughter and smiles all around.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his ball. One day, he went to the park to play with his ball. He kicked the ball so hard that it went over the fence.

Timmy was sad because he couldn't get his ball back. Then, he saw a switch on the fence. He wondered what it did. He flicked the switch and the fence opened. Timmy was happy that he could get his ball back.

Suddenly, a man came and asked Timmy if he had opened the fence. Timmy said yes and the man thanked him. The man said that the fence was smooth and needed a switch to open it. Timmy was happy that he could help the man. They both went home with a smile on their faces. The end.

Timmy was walking in the stadium. He was very excited because it was his first time visiting such a big place. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise coming from a distance. Timmy was confused and he stopped in his tracks. 

A big figure appeared in front of him. "I'm the Stadium Guard," he said in a serious voice. "You need to stay safe. So I will warn you - don't wander off!" 

Timmy was scared and confused. He didn't understand what the guard was saying. The guard tried to explain one more time, but Timmy still didn't understand. 

The Guard was getting impatient. So he pointed towards a group of children in the distance, to show Timmy it was safe to explore. He said, "Those children are having lots of fun - see?"

Timmy smiled and thanked the guard. He was glad he was warned and that he could join the other children. He walked away knowing he was safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat tuna sandwiches for lunch. One day, her mom bought a new can of tuna from the store. 

Lily was so excited to try the new tuna. She measured out just the right amount to put on her sandwich. It tasted really good! 

Later that day, Lily went to the park with her friends. They played on the swings and the slide. When it was time to go home, Lily's mom measured her height to see how much she had grown. 

Lily was happy to see that she was a little bit taller than last time. She went home and had another tuna sandwich for dinner. It was a very good day.

Once upon a time there was a cupboard. It was big and brown and felt very happy. Then one day, something changed. Something bad happened to the cupboard. It became spoiled. 

The cupboard felt very sad. Nothing wanted to be near it because it looked so different now. Then one day, a little girl called Lily saw it. She smiled and said that she could make it better. 

Lily took out a brush and some paint. She painted the cupboard all the colours of the rainbow. She added some sparkles and made the cupboard look beautiful again. And when she finished, she opened the cupboard to find it full of special presents. 

The cupboard was so happy! It hugged Lily and thanked her for making it feel special. The cupboard and Lily became very good friends. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time there was a car, and the car was broken! The car's owner went to find a mechanic. When the mechanic arrived, it was unusual - he was very small!

The mechanic explained what was wrong with the car; he said it needed a new part. He said the part was hard to find, but he was confident he could get it. 

The mechanic went away and worked hard to find the part. When he returned, he fixed the car with the special part. The car was happy and ran perfectly again!

The mechanic was very pleased with himself. He explained to the car's owner how he had fixed the car. The car's owner thanked the mechanic, and they all went home. The end.

Once there was a little girl who wanted to go outside and play. She stepped outside and saw a big field full of sheep. She was so excited! She started to point at each sheep, counting them one by one.

"One, two, three, four!" she exclaimed. "Look how many sheep there are!"

Suddenly, one of the sheep bleated and ran over to the girl. She was so surprised! The sheep was very soft and cuddly. She wrapped her arms around it, giving it a big hug.

"Oh, hello sheep," she said. "I'm so glad you're here."

The sheep happily bleated and the little girl smiled. She decided to spend the whole afternoon playing with her new friend. They ran around and laughed together in the sunshine until it was time for the little girl to go inside.

As she waved goodbye, she shouted out "Bye bye sheep!" The sheep bleated one final time in response. The little girl couldn't stop smiling, knowing that her day outside had been so much fun.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. Yesterday, they went to the park with their moms. They saw a big slide. Lily wanted to go on the slide, but Tom was scared.

"Come on, Tom, let's go on the slide. It is fun!" Lily said.

"No, Lily, I don't want to. The slide is too high. I might fall," Tom said.

Lily was persistent. She tried to make Tom go on the slide. She said, "Don't be scared, Tom. I will go with you. We can hold hands. It will be easy."

Tom still said no. He shook his head. He said, "No, Lily, I don't like the slide. I like the swings. Let's go on the swings."

Lily was sad. She wanted to go on the slide with Tom. She said, "Please, Tom, just try it once. Maybe you will like it. It is not scary. It is fun."

Tom looked at the slide. He looked at Lily. He saw that she was sad. He did not want to make her sad. He said, "Okay, Lily, I will try it once. But only once. And you have to hold my hand."

Lily smiled. She said, "Thank you, Tom. You are a good friend. I will hold your hand. Don't worry."

They went on the slide together. They held hands. They slid down fast. They felt the wind in their hair. They laughed.

They reached the bottom. They looked at each other. They were happy.

"Wow, that was fun!" Tom said.

"See, I told you!" Lily said.

They hugged. They went on the slide again. And again. And again. They had a lot of fun. Their moms were proud of them. They were brave and persistent. They were good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a pet cat named Fluffy. Fluffy had soft fur that Lily loved to pet.

One day, Lily and her mom went to the store to buy a new toy for Fluffy. They found a cheap toy that Fluffy would love. Lily was so excited to give it to Fluffy.

But when they got home, Lily forgot to give the toy to Fluffy. Fluffy kept meowing and rubbing against Lily's legs, but she couldn't remember what she forgot to do.

Lily's mom asked her, "Did you forget something for Fluffy?" Lily remembered and ran to get the toy. Fluffy was so happy to play with his new toy and Lily was happy too.

Once upon a time there was a small boy. He was walking in the forest and he saw something that he wanted. He saw a snack, and quickly ran toward it.

The snack looked so yummy that he did not want to stop. But then he heard someone calling him. It was his dad. 

The boy's dad said,"Stop, boy. That snack does not belong to you!"

But the little boy was too excited. He kept running towards the snack.

The dad shouted again,"Stop, or else I will be very mad!"

But the little boy was too distracted. He jumped up and grabbed the snack. Suddenly his dad grabbed his arm and said,"You disobeyed me! No snack for you today."

The little boy was sad and ran away. He knew he had done something bad and now there was no snack.

Once upon a time, there was a reliable chef named Chef Joe. Every night he cooked a delicious meal for his family. Tonight, he was cooking something special with avocado.

The family gathered around the dinner table, ready to give it a try. Little Hermione was especially excited to see what Chef Joe had cooked up. She asked, 'What is it?'

Chef Joe smiled and said, 'Can you guess?' Little Hermione thought about it for a moment. Suddenly, she figured it out and exclaimed, 'It's guacamole!'

Chef Joe nodded and said, 'That's right! I made guacamole with avocado.' Little Hermione smiled and took a big bite. It was delicious!

Chef Joe's family was very proud of him. They could always count on him to cook a reliable and delicious meal.

Once upon a time, there lived a jolly little piggy. He loved to have fun and during the holidays, he loved to decorate his house with shiny and colorful decorations. One day, he decided to have a decorating party with all of his animal friends. They all brought gum and cupcakes to snack on while they decorated. 

The piggy found some pretty rainbow garlands to wrap around the windows and doors. He hung sparkly stars over the flower bed, and they all put up some colorful banners with streamers to celebrate. 

The most exciting decoration of all was the gum. The little piggy got some colorful pieces of gum and hung them around the house. The other animals helped, and soon the house was filled with bright and tasty decorations! The little piggy was so excited, and their party was very jolly indeed!

One day there was a humble triangle. It was small but had plenty of uses.

"My triangle is the best!" said a 3-year-old.

The triangle kept its calm and kept on being humble. It said nothing, because it knew it could be used in different ways.

The 3-year-old then picked up the triangle and used it to make a paper airplane. She was so delighted and said, "Oh wow! Look at my triangle, it made a great paper airplane!" 

The triangle was still content and humble. It was happy that it could be used to make something so cool. It was the perfect shape for it. 

The 3-year-old thanked the triangle for being so useful. The triangle smiled knowing it had made someone so happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a job, he had to help his mom with the dishes. Timmy didn't like his job, he wanted to play outside. One day, Timmy's mom asked him to help her with the dishes, but Timmy said no. 

"I want to run and play outside," said Timmy. 

"But Timmy, helping with the dishes is useful," said his mom. 

Timmy didn't listen and ran outside to play. While he was running, he tripped and fell. He hurt his knee really bad and had to go to the hospital. Timmy learned that sometimes it's important to do your job and listen to your mom.

Lila was a modest girl who liked to help her mom and dad. She did not ask for many toys or treats. She was happy with her books and dolls. One day, she saw a big train at the park. It had many cars and a loud whistle. Lila wanted to ride the train, but she was afraid.

She asked her mom, "Can I ride the train, please?"

Her mom said, "Yes, you can, but you have to try. It is not scary, it is fun. You can hold my hand if you want."

Lila nodded and followed her mom to the train. She saw a long line of people waiting to get on. She saw some kids who were excited and some who were nervous. She felt her heart beat fast.

When it was their turn, her mom helped her climb on the train. She sat on a seat near the rail. She held her mom's hand tight. She heard the whistle blow and the train start to move. She closed her eyes.

Her mom said, "Look, Lila, look at the trees and the flowers and the animals. They are so pretty. The train is going fast, but it is safe. You are brave, Lila, you are trying something new."

Lila opened her eyes and looked around. She saw the green grass and the blue sky and the yellow sun. She saw the birds and the squirrels and the rabbits. She saw the other kids smiling and waving. She felt the wind in her hair and the sun on her face. She felt her mom's hand warm and soft. She felt a smile on her lips.

She said, "Mom, I like the train. It is fun. Thank you for helping me try."

Her mom said, "You are welcome, Lila. I am proud of you. You learned that trying new things can be good. You are a modest and brave girl, Lila, and I love you."

They hugged and enjoyed the rest of the ride. Lila was happy. She had tried something new and she had liked it. She had learned a lesson. She had made her mom proud.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. Jane was three years old and loved music.

One day her mommy suggested, "Let's go and see a band!" Jane was so excited. She put on her special dress and went with her mommy to the band show.

The show was loud and harsh, but Jane still liked it. She saw many people playing different instruments and singing. She wanted to join them but she was a bit shy.

So her mommy said, "Let's suggest you go to the stage and sing with them."

Jane thought about it for a few moments then said, "Okay mommy, I'll go sing with them!"

So she went on the stage, sang her favorite song and had a great time. Everyone clapped and cheered for her.

Jane had a great time and she never forgot that day when she sang with the band!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had long hair that she loved to brush every day. One day, Lily's mom suggested that they try a new hairstyle. "Let's braid your hair!" said Lily's mom. 

Lily thought it sounded like a difficult task, but she was willing to try. "Okay, I will sit still," said Lily. Her mom started to braid her hair and it was a bit tricky at first, but they worked together and soon it was done. 

Lily looked in the mirror and saw her new hairstyle. "Wow, I love it!" she exclaimed. Her mom smiled and said, "I'm glad you like it. You look so pretty!" From that day on, Lily loved trying new hairstyles with her mom and it was always so much fun.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Sarah. One day, Sarah took a walk in the woods. It was so cold that she shivered. Suddenly, she saw a large smiling bear. Sarah was scared at first, but the bear looked kind and friendly.

The bear invited her to share his icy juice. Sarah was hesitant, but thirsty, so she agreed. She sat down and enjoyed the drink, which was surprisingly tasty.

The bear noticed Sarah and started to smile. She realized the bear must recognize her from her last visit to the woods. Sarah waved, happy to have made a new friend.

The bear left shortly after the juice. Sarah waved goodbye and then looked around the woods again. She smiled, knowing that she recognized a special friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to drink juice because it was sweet and tasty. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a big glass of juice to drink. Lily was so happy and drank it all up. 

After drinking the juice, Lily wanted to play. She loved to act like a princess and dance around. But her mommy told her to be careful because she might fall and get hurt. Lily listened to her mommy and was very careful while she played. 

Soon it was time for bed and Lily was very tired. She snuggled up in her cozy bed and fell asleep. When she woke up in the morning, she was excited to have more juice and act like a princess again. The end.

Once there was a dead tree in the forest. All the leaves had gone away, and the tree was sad. Then one day, a strong wind blew into the forest. It was so strong that it knocked the dead tree down.

The strong wind also blew pieces of cardboard around the forest. The wind even blew some cardboard under the dead tree.

The sun came out and shone down on the tree and the cardboard. It wasn't long before the cardboard began to dry. When it was all dry, the people found a new use for the cardboard. They put it around the dead tree, and it made a really cool treehouse!

The people had lots of fun playing in the treehouse. They liked living in the dead tree, even though it was no longer alive. The dead tree was alive again for the children, and it was all thanks to the dry cardboard!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to wear her pink dress with flowers on it. She wore it every day, even when it was too hot outside. One day, Lily's mommy said, "Lily, let's go to a hotel for a fun vacation!" Lily was so excited to go to a hotel.

When they got to the hotel, Lily saw a big swimming pool. She wanted to jump in right away! But then she saw some other kids playing a game. "What are you playing?" Lily asked. "We're having a competitive race!" one of the kids said. "Can I play too?" Lily asked. "Of course!" the kids said.

Lily put on her swimsuit and joined the race. It was so much fun! She didn't win, but that didn't matter. She made new friends and had a great time at the hotel. When they went back to their room, Lily said, "Mommy, can we come back to this hotel again?" Her mommy smiled and said, "Of course, Lily. We can come back anytime you want."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Toby. She loved to dance and play all day. She had a band of special friends who she played in the park with.

One day, Toby's friends said to her, "Let's all jump together!" Toby was excited and said, "Yes! That sounds like a lot of fun!"

They went to the park and stood in a circle. They held hands and jumped together in the warm sunshine. Toby couldn't help but laugh and smile.

When they had finished jumping, Toby's friends said, "We should do this every day!" Toby agreed and said, "I'm so happy we can jump and play together!"

Once there was a brave girl called Jessie. Jessie really loved exploring the woods near her house.

One day, Jessie went out in the woods and saw a spark on the ground. She was curious to find out what it was, so she decided to use it.

When she touched the spark, Jessie saw a big, scary monster. The monster said, "I will eat you if you don't give me some candy!" 

Jessie did not have any candy so she tried to run away. But the monster was too fast and caught her. He ate Jessie and the spark was never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on adventures with her mommy and daddy. One day, they went to a car store to buy a new jeep. Lily saw a shiny red jeep and pointed to it. "Mommy, daddy, that one!" she said.

But her parents said, "That jeep is too expensive. Let's look for a cheaper one." Lily was sad, but then she saw a blue jeep that was just as cool. "Look, mommy, daddy, that one!" she said, pointing again.

Once upon a time, there was a wise village near a river. The people of the village were good friends with the river. The river gave them fish to eat and clay to use to make things. The clay was used to create cups and vases, so their homes were very colourful and nice.

One day, the people had a problem. Their village was very sick, and no one knew how to make it better. They didn't know what to do, but they trusted the wise river. So they asked the river for help.

The river used its magic and made a special clay out of the clay from the riverbank. Everyone put a bit of the special clay around the village, and soon the village began to heal. 

The people were so happy with the help from the river, and were grateful for its wisdom. The wise river saved their village and now the people of the village celebrated the river every day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called 'Lil'. She was three years old and loved to explore new things.

One day, she went to the kitchen to find something fun to do. On the table she saw a plate. She went to examine it carefully. It was a blue plate with circles all around it. She smiled as she touched it.

But when she went to look closer at the plate, Lil noticed a smelly smell coming from it. She wrinkled up her nose and backed away.

Lil didn't know what to do but decided to ask her mum. Once she explained what had happened, her mum laughed and said, "Oh Lil, I think it was food gone bad." Her mum then took the plate away and put it in the bin.

Lil smiled. The mystery was solved - and she had had some fun exploring!

Once upon a time there was a brave girl. Her name was Melinda and she was very persistent. Melinda had a special velvet cape and she liked to wear it when she needed courage.

One day, Melinda wanted to join a game that the other children were playing. She took off her cape and ran to join them, but the children said no. They did not want her to play.

Melinda felt sad but she was still persistent. She asked them again to let her join the game, but the children said no.

Then, suddenly, Melinda remembered her velvet cape. She put it on and ran back to the game. She was so brave and determined that the other kids were surprised. They let her join and Melinda had the most fun ever!

Lily was sick. She had a fever and a sore throat. She felt very hot and very cold at the same time. She shivered under her blanket and hugged her teddy bear. She wanted her mommy to make her feel better.

Mommy came into Lily's room with a tray. She had a glass of water, a spoon and a bottle of pink medicine. She smiled at Lily and said, "You are a very brave and patient girl, Lily. I know you don't like the medicine, but it will help you get well soon. Can you try to take some for me?"

Lily nodded and opened her mouth. Mommy poured a little bit of the pink medicine on the spoon and gave it to Lily. Lily swallowed it and made a face. It tasted bitter and yucky. She wanted to spit it out, but she didn't. She drank some water to wash it down. She said, "Thank you, Mommy. I love you."

Mommy kissed Lily's forehead and said, "I love you too, Lily. You are a very good girl. Now, try to rest and sleep. I will check on you later." She tucked Lily in and turned off the light. She left the door open a little bit.

Lily closed her eyes and cuddled with her teddy bear. She still felt hot and cold and shivery, but she also felt a little bit better. She knew Mommy was taking care of her and the pink medicine was working. She hoped she would be well soon and play with her friends again. She fell asleep and dreamed of happy things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside, but it was very cold outside. The ground was icy and slippery, so she had to be very careful when she walked. 

One day, Lily was walking near a big bridge when she saw a little bird that had fallen down and hurt its wing. Lily felt sad for the little bird and decided to help it. She picked up the bird and took it to her home. 

Lily's mommy helped her take care of the little bird and soon it was feeling much better. The little bird was so happy that it started to sing a beautiful song. Lily was very happy too and said, "Thank you for singing such a pretty song!" 

From that day on, whenever Lily walked near the bridge, she remembered the little bird and felt happy. And the little bird was happy too, because it had found a new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a big bear. His name was Benny. Benny had a large arm and he loved to spread it out wide. One day, Benny met a little rabbit named Rosie.

"Hello, Benny!" said Rosie. "Why do you have such a large arm?"

"I use it to give big hugs!" said Benny, spreading his arm out wide.

"That's so nice!" said Rosie. "Can I have a hug too?"

"Of course!" said Benny, wrapping his large arm around Rosie. "Spread the love, little friend."

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Bobb. He was three years old and the world was a magical place to him. One summer, Bobb's parents decided to take him on vacation to a grand hotel.

When they arrived, Bobb's eyes glowed in amazement. The hotel was so original and beautiful! He screamed in delight at the sight. 

That night, Bobb's parents took him to the hotel's swimming pool. It was so sparkly and blue that Bobb couldn't believe his eyes. He wanted to jump in and swim, but his parents warned him that the pool was too hot. 

Bobb couldn't help but squeal in disagreement. "I wanna go in the pool, I wanna go in the pool!" he declared.

His dad smiled and said, "Bobb, if you go in the pool, you might get too hot. Let's go and get some ice cream instead. How does that sound?"

Bobb smiled and shouted, "Sounds perfect!" It turned out to be the best vacation ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was three years old and loved to explore the world around her. 

One day, she went outside to play and found a mosquito. She wanted to tie the mosquito, so she found a piece of string and tied it around the mosquito's feet. 

The next day, she decided to take her mosquito for a picnic. She spread a blanket and tied a delicious sandwich to the blanket. She then tied the mosquito next to the sandwich so it could enjoy the picnic, too. 

Sally and the mosquito spent the rest of the day eating the delicious sandwich and enjoying the summer sunshine. They had a wonderful time together!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a shiny red bicycle that he loved to ride. One day, Timmy's friend Billy came over to play. Billy saw Timmy's bicycle and felt jealous because he didn't have one. 

Timmy let Billy ride his bicycle and they had fun together. They rode around the block and marked their path with chalk on the ground. Billy felt happy to ride the bicycle and forgot about feeling jealous. 

After they finished riding, Timmy and Billy went inside to have some snacks. Timmy's mom gave them cookies and milk. They talked about how much fun they had riding the bicycle together. Billy realized that he didn't need to be jealous because he had a good friend like Timmy.

John was ready for an adventure. He looked around and wondered what he should do. Suddenly he saw something he had never seen before. It was long and pointed and huge! It was a thermometer. He had no idea what a thermometer was, but he was ready to find out. 

John walked over to the thermometer and saw it had markings on it. He wondered what they meant. He touched it and felt something he had never felt before. It was cool, so he wondered if it was telling him the temperature outside. 

John thought it was exciting to try something new. He looked around to see if anyone else knew what the thermometer meant, but no one was in sight. He decided to explore some more and see what else he could discover.

Once upon a time, there was a playful dog named Max. Max loved to run and jump and play with his toys. One day, Max saw a sign that said "No Dogs Allowed". Max didn't understand why he couldn't play in that area.

Max tried to go past the sign, but a man came and held him back. The man told Max's owner that dogs were not allowed in that area. Max's owner was sad and didn't know what to do.

But then, Max had an idea. He decided to release all of his toys and play with them in another area. Max and his owner found a new place to play where dogs were allowed. Max was happy again and played with all of his toys.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside and explore the world around him. One day, he found a shiny rock on the ground. "Look, Mommy! I found a pretty mineral!" he exclaimed. 

His mom smiled and said, "Wow, that's really cool, Timmy. But be careful not to lose it. Maybe we should lock it up in a safe place." 

Timmy nodded and put the mineral in a small box. He was very persistent in keeping it safe and made sure to lock the box tightly. 

Later that day, Timmy's friend came over to play. "What's in the box?" his friend asked. 

"It's my special mineral," Timmy replied. "I locked it up to keep it safe." 

His friend was impressed and they spent the rest of the day playing with Timmy's other toys. Timmy was happy knowing that his special mineral was safe and sound, locked up tight in its box.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, something scary happened. Timmy fell off his bike and hit his head. His mom took him to the doctor and they found out he had a big bump on his skull. Timmy was very frightened, but his mom hugged him and told him everything would be okay. After a few days, Timmy felt much better and was back to playing with his friends. From that day on, Timmy always wore a helmet when he rode his bike to make sure nothing scary would happen again.

Molly was a 3 year old girl who loved animals. One day, she went for a walk with her parents in the park. They found a bush and Molly was so excited. Her mom said, "Let's explore the bush!" So they walked into the bush and it was very scary. Molly was scared but her dad said, "Don't be scared, Molly. Let's see what we can find!"

Then, they heard something in the bush. It was a noisy little mouse. Molly was so happy and asked, "Can I invite the mouse to come with us?" Her parents thought that was a great idea, so they all kept walking. Molly kept talking to the mouse and they became good friends.

At the end of the day, Molly said goodbye to the mouse. She invited him to come play with her at the park again soon. Then, Molly, her mom, and her dad all went home together.

Tom and Mia are friends. They like to play together. One day, they want to create a pizza. They go to the kitchen and find some bread, cheese, sauce and ham. They put the sauce on the bread, then the cheese and ham on top. They are happy.

They put the pizza in the oven and wait. They smell something good. They are hungry. They want to eat the pizza. They open the oven and take out the pizza. It is hot and yummy.

But then, Ben comes in. Ben is rude. He sees the pizza and says, "That is my pizza. Give it to me." He tries to grab the pizza from Tom and Mia. They say, "No, Ben. This is our pizza. We create it. You did not help. Go away."

Ben is angry. He pushes Tom and Mia. He takes the pizza and runs away. He laughs and says, "Ha ha, I have the pizza. You have nothing." He is very rude.

Tom and Mia are sad. They cry. They work hard to create the pizza. They want to share it. But Ben is rude and takes it. They do not like Ben. They say, "Ben is not our friend. He is rude. We do not play with him." They hug each other and go to find something else to play. They hope Ben will learn to be nice.

Once upon a time, there was a little squirrel named Sammy. Sammy loved to play and have fun. One day, Sammy found a big acorn and he was so happy! He ran around with it and showed it to all his friends.

But then, Sammy got a little too playful. He started throwing the acorn up in the air and catching it. Suddenly, he threw it too high and it got stuck in a tree. Sammy was sad because he couldn't get his acorn back.

Sammy's friend, Tommy the turtle, saw how sad Sammy was and wanted to make him feel better. Tommy told Sammy a joke and Sammy laughed so hard that he forgot all about his lost acorn. The moral of the story is that sometimes things can get messy, but laughter can make everything better.

Once upon a time, there was a big, heavy truck. The truck liked to drive fast. One day, the truck broke down. It needed help.

A nice mechanic came to help the truck. He had a big toolbox. The mechanic worked hard to fix the truck. He asked his friend, a small car, to join him. The car was happy to help.

Together, the mechanic and the car fixed the heavy truck. The truck was so happy. They all became good friends. They played and drove around together. And they all lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a hungry kitty. She wanted to find something good to eat. She noticed a nice piece of cheese, and she wanted it very much. But when she bit the cheese, it made a loud noise. The kitty got a bit scared and jumped back.

She was very confused and could not understand what had happened. Then she noticed that the cheese had made a big hole in the wall. She realized that the cheese was NOT food. It was something called an 'explosion'.

The result of her biting the cheese was lots of smoke and a big mess in her home. She was so confused about what had happened. She quickly ran away and found something safe to eat. The kitty didn't bite anything else after that!

Young Billy was full of energy and loved playing outside. One of his favorite things to do was to take his red wagon and number the leaves as he pulled it along.

Every day, he would number each leaf he saw as he went down the sidewalk. He would say the numbers out loud in order. One, two, three, four... Sometimes he would take turns with other friends in the neighborhood, giving them a turn to number the leaves.

Billy would count over and over until he reached the end of the street. Then he and the wagon would turn around and do it all over again.

Billy loved this game, and in no time, he would be able to number up to one hundred. He looked around and saw all the other young kids in the neighborhood counting and playing with their wagons, too. It was a beautiful day, and Billy was filled with a feeling of joy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat grapes, they were her favorite fruit. One day, while she was walking in the park, she saw a very attractive boy playing with his ball.

Lily went to the boy and asked, "Can I play with you?" The boy said, "Sure!" and they started to play together. Suddenly, Lily saw a grape on the ground and wanted to pick it up. But when she tried to pick it up, it was too small and she couldn't do it.

The boy saw Lily struggling and said, "Here, let me help you." He pinched the grape and gave it to Lily. She was so happy and said, "Thank you, you are my new friend!" From that day on, they played together every day and always shared their grapes.

Tommy was a very eager boy. He was always ready to do something new and exciting.

One day, Tommy went outside with some chalk. He kneeled on the sidewalk and began to draw a big picture. He was so excited about it!

When he was done, he stood proudly and showed it to his mom. His mom smiled and said, â€œWow Tommy, thatâ€™s so beautiful! What did you make?â€ Tommy beamed and replied, â€œItâ€™s a rainbow!â€

His mom hugged him and said â€œIâ€™m so proud of you, Tommy. You did a wonderful job.â€ Tommy smiled and gave his mom a hug. He was so happy he made something special!

Once upon a time, a 3 year old boy named John was playing in the garden. He went to the pretty flower bed and rubbed the soft petals of the roses. The pretty colors made him laugh and smile. While he was rubbing the petals, he heard a loud noise.

John looked up, and saw an enormous bird flying above him. He was so surprised that he forgot all about the flower petals. The bird looked so beautiful, so he started to search for it in the sky.

John's dad saw his son looking up, so he called out: "What are you looking for my boy?"

John replied, "I'm searching for the enormous bird daddy!" 

His dad said, "Let's keep looking together. It must have gone somewhere!

So John and his dad kept searching for the bird. But no matter how hard they looked, they couldn't find it. After a while, John's dad had to go back to work, so he said goodbye to his son.

But John was determined to find the bird. He kept searching until nightfall. He kept searching until he finally found the enormous bird!

John was so excited. He waved goodbye to the bird and hugged his dad when he got home. No matter how long it took, nothing could stop him from finding what he was looking for.

Lila was upset. She missed her mom. Her mom went to work in the sky. She flew in a big metal bird. She said she would be back soon. But Lila did not know when soon was.

She looked out the window. She saw the moon and the stars. They were bright and shiny. She wondered if her mom could see them too. She wondered if her mom was in the universe. She wanted to talk to her mom.

She picked up her phone. She pressed the green button. She heard a beep. She said, "Mom, are you there? I miss you. I love you. Come back soon."

She waited for an answer. She heard another beep. She heard a voice. It was her mom. She said, "Lila, I'm here. I miss you too. I love you more. I'm in the sky, but I can see the moon and the stars. They are beautiful. Just like you. I'll be back soon. I promise."

Lila smiled. She felt happy. She said, "Mom, you are beautiful too. I'm glad you can see the moon and the stars. They are in the universe. Just like us. I'll wait for you. I promise."

She pressed the red button. She put down her phone. She hugged her teddy bear. She looked out the window again. She waved to the moon and the stars. She said, "Good night, mom. Good night, universe."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a nice doll that she loved to play with every day. One day, Lily's friend came to visit her and they played together. Suddenly, a big dog appeared and scared them. 

Lily's friend said, "I'm scared, what will happen?" 

Lily replied, "Don't worry, I will protect you from the threat." 

Lily picked up her doll and waved it at the dog. The dog ran away and the girls were safe. 

Lily's friend said, "Thank you, you are so nice." 

Lily smiled and they continued to play with her doll happily ever after.

Once there was a girl. Her name was Sue. One day, Sue was walking past an office. She looked inside and saw a delicate lady. Sue questioned why the lady was in the office.

The next day, Sue went back to the office to find out the answer. The lady said she was there to do some important work. Sue questioned what kind of work and the lady smiled. 

The lady told Sue she was looking after some delicate flowers. Sue asked if she could help. The lady said yes and showed Sue how to take care of them. 

Then, every day, Sue and the lady looked after the flowers together. Sue was very happy to learn how to be delicate with the flowers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and go on adventures. One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy. They were having fun on the swings when Lily saw a scary bug.

"Mommy, look at that scary bug!" Lily said.

"It's okay, Lily. Bugs are our friends. They help us by eating other bugs," her mommy said.

Lily was still scared. "But what if it bites me and I suffer?"

"Don't worry, Lily. This bug is harmless. Let's go play on the slide instead," her mommy said.

Lily forgot about the scary bug and went to play on the slide. She had so much fun with her mommy and was happy that she didn't have to suffer from the scary bug's bite.

Once upon a time, there was a graceful cat named Kitty. She loved to play with her ball and jump around the house. Kitty was very happy and liked to make her friends laugh.

One day, Kitty saw a tap in the garden. She was very curious about it. She wanted to see if she could make water come out. So, she jumped onto the tap and tried to squeeze it with her paws. But nothing happened.

Kitty tried again and again to squeeze the tap, but still no water came out. Then, her friend, a wise old dog named Rover, came to help her. Rover showed her how to turn the tap on, and water came splashing out! Kitty was so happy, and they both played in the water all day long.

Once upon a time, a little dog named Bobo loved to play in the mud. One day, Bobo played in the mud for a very long time. He got very dirty. His fur was all brown and sticky. Bobo's mom saw him and knew it was time for a bath.

Bobo did not like to take a bath. He did not want to be clean. He wanted to play in the mud some more. But his mom said, "No, Bobo, you must bathe now." Bobo was sad and did not want to listen. He tried to run away, but his mom caught him.

Bobo's mom put him in the bath. She washed him with soap and warm water. At first, Bobo was not happy. But then, he started to feel good. The warm water made him feel nice. When the bath was over, Bobo was clean and his fur was soft. He was grateful to his mom for the bath. Now, Bobo liked to play in the mud and take baths too.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sarah. She was only 3 years old and she loved the color yellow. One day, she was in her yard playing with her toys when she noticed something was wrong. There was a problem to solve!

Sarah looked around her yard and noticed a lot of yellow things; a yellow leaf, a yellow flower, and a yellow butterfly! But that wasn't what she needed to solve the problem. She then saw an old yellow bucket and she had a great idea. She picked up the bucket and filled it with some of the yellow things around her yard.

Then Sarah noticed something else. There were two little yellow birds in her yard. They were chirping and flapping their wings. She smiled and filled the bucket with the birds too.

Sarah took the bucket over to her mom.

"Mommy," she said. "I solved the problem!"

Her mom smiled and said, "You sure did, sweetheart. Good job!" 

Sarah was very proud and went back to playing in her yellow yard. She had solved the problem!

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Daisy. She had a special rocking chair which her Daddy had made for her. Every day when Daisy was tired, she would sit down in the rocker and her Daddy would give her a big push and say, 'One, two, three, rock!'

Sometimes Daisy's little sister, Annabelle, would join in. She would carefully climb on to Daisy's lap and hug her tight. Then Daisy and Annabelle would hold on as Daddy pushed them back and forth.

When Daisy rocked, she felt so safe and happy. She would close her eyes and feel the rocking going faster and faster, until it felt like they were flying. "Wheee!" cried Daisy with a huge grin. 

Annabelle would squeal with delight, and Daddy would laugh, too. Then the rocking slowed down until it came to a gentle stop.

"That was the best ever!" said Daisy, hugging her Daddy and her little sister close. "Rock me again, please!" 

And so dad Patiently pushed Daisy and Annabelle back and forth, again and again, in their special rocking chair, until Daisy was sleepy and ready for a nap. 

And that's what happened every time Daisy and Annabelle went for a ride in their rocking chair.

Once upon a time there was a family with two kids. One day, when they were outside, it started to rain hard. The rain came down really fast and soon the ground was all wet. The kids said to their parents, "Look, it's a flood!"

The water was coming up higher and higher and it started to come into the house. The parents were worried and said, "Come on, let's go upstairs so we can be safe." Upstairs, the family watched as the flood water kept coming in. The water was so high that it was touching the roof.

The kids were getting scared and started to cry. Their mom said, "It's okay, sweeties. Everything will be alright." But soon the water kept getting higher and the family had to go outside.

The flood was so strong that it hurt the family. They had to hold onto each other to stay safe. Finally, the flood stopped and the family was safe. The family was so happy to be safe and said, "We made it!"

Joe and Jane were great friends. They always had fun together.
Every morning they would run around and laugh.
One day, Joe got into trouble. He got lost. Jane searched the whole day but couldn't find him.

But then, Jane had an idea. She said "I love Joe, I know he will find his way". Then she sang a song.

Soon, Joe heard the song and followed it. He found his way back to Jane. When they saw each other, they hugged and laughed. They were so happy to be together again.

Joe and Jane knew that true friends love each other, no matter what the trouble. They were forever grateful for the great friendship they shared.

Once upon a time, there was a poor boy named Timmy. Timmy lived in a small house with his mommy and daddy. They didn't have a lot of money, so they couldn't buy Timmy many toys.

One day, Timmy saw a missile in a store. He wanted it so badly, but his mommy and daddy couldn't buy it for him. Timmy was sad, but he didn't give up hope.

One night, Timmy snuck out of his house and stole the missile. He was so happy to have it, but he didn't realize how dangerous it was. When he played with it, the missile exploded and hurt Timmy very badly. He was rushed to the hospital, but it was too late. Timmy didn't make it.

Timmy's mommy and daddy were very sad. They missed their little boy so much. They wished they could have bought him the missile so he wouldn't have had to steal it. They thanked God for the time they had with Timmy, but they were still very sad.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her hoop in the park. One day, she went to the park with her friends, but the park was very messy. There were toys everywhere and the children were running around and screaming. 

Lily decided to help her friends organize the toys. She asked her friends to gather all the toys and put them in one place. They worked together and soon all the toys were organized. 

After they finished, Lily and her friends played with the hoop. They were very calm and happy because they had organized the toys. They had a great time playing together and promised to always keep the park clean and organized.

Ricky was in his classroom and it was time for naptime. Everyone was supposed to freeze and be quiet. Ricky did not want to freeze, he wanted to move and make noise. 

Suddenly, Ricky had an idea. He thought if he froze really still like a statue, he would be able to move without anyone noticing. He held his breath and became as still as he could, not even blinking his eyes.

Slowly, Ricky began to move his feet and creep around the classroom on tip toe. He shuffled his feet across the light blue carpet and passed by the desks and chairs, careful not to make a sound. 

Ricky was so thrilled that he was able to move without anyone noticing. He couldn't help but giggle and smile as he continued his sneaking around the classroom. Eventually, he decided it was time to freeze again and sneak back to his desk. Even though he had to rest after naptime, he felt like a secret spy!

The sky was gray and it was time for a game. Bob and his mom stood in the backyard and rolled a big, wild ball. 

"Let's roll the ball around," yelled Bob.

He and his mom smiled and started to roll the ball together. Bob laughed and soon he forgot all about the dreary sky. 

But then the ball came to a stop in the middle of the backyard. Bob and his mom looked inside the ball and found something wild â€“ a gray cat! 

The cat jumped out of the ball and ran away. Bob and his mom were so excited and decided to go find the cat. 

Bob and his mom looked and looked until they found the gray cat in the neighbor's garden. The cat led them to a big pile of gray kittens! 

Bob and his mom were so happy that they found a family of wild cats. They all smiled and happily went back home together.

Frankie and Jack were best friends who loved exploring nature together. One day they spotted something very unusual while walking through the forest. What was it?

Frankie whispered to Jack, "It looks like a big, clever bird". Jack was so curious he ran towards it, leaving Frankie behind. 

Frankie, being the clever friend he was, realised it was not a bird but a very big, angry animal! He shouted for Jack to stop and come back, but it was too late. The animal attacked Jack and before Frankie could help, it was too late. Jack was gone.

Frankie was so sad and he knew he would never go exploring nature again with his best friend. He never should have let Jack run off. He should have been more careful. 

The end.

Once there was a little boy who loved to zoom! One day he was zoom and zoom, running around the house making lots of noise. His parents were very busy and didn't see the messy mess he was making.

But then the little boy heard a loud screech coming from the living room. He zoomed in to see what was happening and saw a big mess! There were papers, books and toys all spread across the floor. He made an even bigger mess as he was zooming around.

His parents were so shocked when they saw the mess and scolded him for not being careful. He felt so sad and apologised to them for the noise and mess he had made.

But then his parents smiled and took out a big stack of paper and markers. Together, they all zoomed around, drawing and colouring. The boy had lots of fun and soon the messy mess was gone.

The end.

Tim was very excited. He had been working very hard to build something special. After weeks of building, Tim was ready to show off his special creation. He had been frustrated when things wouldn't work, but he never gave up.

Finally, the day arrived for Tim to show off his special creation. He held it proudly in his hands as he walked up to the stage. Everyone clapped as he was handed a pretty medal.

Tim was so happy. He had achieved something that he had worked so hard to build! He felt so proud of himself holding the medal. He felt like he could build anything!

Once upon a time, there were two mighty friends. Their names were Jack and Jill. Jack and Jill lived together, and they were always having lots of fun. One day, Jack had an important challenge for them to try. He wanted them to resist the strong wind.

Jack and Jill were mighty, so they took on the challenge. They stood with their feet planted firmly on the ground and resisted the wind. The wind blew and blew, but Jack and Jill wouldn't give up. Finally, after a long time, Jack and Jill won.

They both felt very proud that they had resisted the wind. They celebrated their win by dancing and singing together. They were very happy that they had been victorious against the mighty wind.

Once upon a time, there was an old train. The train was very old and it was not working well. One day, a little boy saw the train and he wanted to play with it. But when he tried to play with the train, it did not work. The little boy got very sad and angry.

Then, an old man came and saw the little boy. The old man asked the little boy what was wrong. The little boy told the old man about the old train that did not work. The old man said to the little boy, "You should forgive the train. It is old and it cannot work like it used to."

The little boy thought about what the old man said and he realized that he should forgive the old train. He went back to the train and said, "I forgive you, old train. You are still special to me." The train started to work again and the little boy was very happy. He learned that sometimes we need to forgive things that are old and not working well.

Once upon a time there were two best friends called Sarah and Zoe. Zoe was invited to Sarah's bedroom for a special treat. Zoe was very excited to go.

When Zoe arrived at Sarah's bedroom, she saw a very smooth bed. On the bed there were lots of pillows and a very special quilt.

Sarah invited Zoe to sit on the bed. Zoe was so happy and couldn't believe how soft and smooth it was.

After that, Sarah told Zoe to close her eyes. When Zoe opened them, she saw a box full of chocolates!

They both cheered and enjoyed the chocolates together. They had lots of laughs and fun for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time there was a graceful princess who lived in a beautiful palace. She had long golden hair and a bright blue dress. One day, the princess went for a walk. As she walked, she saw an old lady wearing a purple hat. 

The princess said, "Hello! I like your hat!" 
The old lady smiled and said, "Thank you! I wear this hat every day!" 

The princess thanked her and continued to walk until she arrived at a magnificent palace with tall white walls and golden towers. The princess was amazed and said, "This palace is so beautiful!"
