Days passed, and Lily was happy to see that her other bugs were healthy and happy. She learned that being ready and taking care of her things could prevent problems from happening. And most importantly, she learned that helping others is always a good thing to do.

Once upon a time there was a fisherman. He went out on a boat to get fish for his family. On the way out, he noticed something in the water. It was a broken boat. He ordered his boat to go closer so he could see it better. When they got closer, he saw a big hole in the boat. He knew that it must have been broken by something big. When the fisherman got close enough he ordered his crew to help the other boat. 

His crew worked together to fix the boat and soon it was back in one piece again. The fisherman and his crew were happy that they were able to help. They said goodbye to the boat and its crew and headed back home. When they returned home the fisherman told his family about helping the broken boat and they were all so happy. Everyone thanked the fisherman and his crew for their hard work.

Andy and Emma were two best friends. They were always doing fun things together. One day, they decided to have a race. They grabbed their old camera so they could take pictures of their race.

 Emma got to the finish line first. Andy tried to catch up, but he was too slow. He giggled as he watched Emma reach the wall first.

They looked at the pictures on the old camera. They laughed at the silly poses they made as they raced. Andy and Emma had so much fun racing together and taking pictures that they decided to do it again!

Once upon a time there was a young guard. He was always very friendly to everyone he saw. One day, he decided to go for a walk. As he was walking, he saw something that matched his coat. It was a beautiful necklace! He knew he had to have it.

The guard went to the store and asked how much the necklace was. The store clerk told him it would cost a bit of money. The young guard only had a few coins. He didn't have enough to buy the necklace.

The store clerk saw how much the guard wanted the necklace. He decided to give it to him for free. The guard was so happy with his new necklace and he thanked the store clerk for being so kind. Then, he happily took his necklace and went back to his job.

From then on, the young guard always wore his new necklace everywhere he went. He was very proud of it and felt like it made him look even more official when guarding the city. The guard and his necklace were a perfect match!

Once upon a time there was a girl called Lucy. She loved to swing all day long. One summer she decided to visit a special park. It was a maze and in the middle she found a swing. Lucy was so excited and hopped on the swing right away.

As she was swinging Lucy noticed a bitter smell in the air. She wondered what could be making a smell like that. Looking around she spotted a big tree in the corner of the maze and she decided to go and see it.

When she got close to the tree Lucy was surprised. She saw that there were lots of tiny little fruit growing from the branches. They were so bitter that it made her eyes water. Lucy decided to take one home and planted it in her garden.

Every day Lucy would swing and watch her little tree grow until it was full of bitter fruit. She would pick the fruit and make a delicious tart with them. Lucy enjoyed the tart every day and she was able to swing and play in the maze more than ever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a shiny jewel that she loved to wear every day. One day, her friend Timmy came to visit her. Timmy said, "Your jewel is so pretty, can I borrow it?" Lily thought for a moment and said, "Okay, but you have to give it back to me later."

Timmy wore the jewel and went to play with his friends. But he forgot to give it back to Lily. When Lily asked for her jewel back, Timmy said, "I lost it, sorry." Lily was sad and said, "That's boring, I really liked that jewel."

Lily's mother saw her sad and asked what happened. Lily told her the story. Her mother said, "It's okay, we can buy you a new jewel. But next time, make sure you don't lend anything that is important to you." Lily nodded and learned a lesson that day.

Sara and Ben are twins. They like to play in the big building where Mom works. Mom says they can go up and down the elevator, but they have to stay with her. One day, Sara and Ben are bored. They want to see what is on the top floor. They sneak into the elevator when Mom is not looking. They push the button with the highest number.

The elevator goes up and up and up. Sara and Ben are excited. They wonder what they will find on the top floor. Maybe there are toys or candy or animals. But when the elevator stops, the door does not open. Sara and Ben are stuck. They push the buttons again and again, but nothing happens. They call for Mom, but no one hears them. They start to feel scared.

The elevator is dark and cold. Sara and Ben shiver. They hug each other and wish Mom would come. They hear a loud noise. It sounds like thunder. The elevator shakes and rattles. Sara and Ben scream. They think the elevator will fall. They cry and pray for help.

After a long time, the noise stops. The elevator door opens. Sara and Ben see Mom and a man in a uniform. Mom is angry and worried. She hugs Sara and Ben and scolds them for running away. The man in the uniform says the elevator was broken by a storm. He says he fixed it and he is sorry for the trouble. Sara and Ben say they are sorry too. They promise to never sneak into the elevator again. They are happy to see Mom and the light. They are happy to be safe.

Once upon a time, there was a friendly bunny named Benny. Benny loved to hop around the forest and play with his animal friends. One day, Benny found a shiny piece of coal on the ground. He didn't know what it was, but he thought it looked pretty.

Later that day, Benny was playing hide-and-seek with his friends when he heard a loud noise. He looked up and saw a big, dark cloud coming towards them. Benny didn't know what it was, but he knew it didn't look friendly.

Suddenly, the cloud got closer and closer, and all of Benny's friends started to vanish one by one. Benny was scared, but he remembered the shiny piece of coal he found earlier. He picked it up and held it tight. Just as the cloud was about to swallow him up, Benny threw the coal at it. The coal hit the cloud and made it vanish, just like that! Benny's friends reappeared, and they all hugged and thanked him for being so brave. From that day on, Benny knew that even the smallest things could make a big difference.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Bella. She was very stubborn, and always wanted things in her own way.

One day, Bella saw a big, colorful balloon in the sky. She wanted the balloon, so she started crying and stamping her feet. 

Bella's mom came to her and said, "oh Bella, don't be so stubborn. You can't get the balloon, so please try to calm down." 

But Bella kept on crying and shouting, "I want the balloon! I want the balloon!" 

So her mom said, "If you'll stop crying and settle down, I'll get you a balloon from the store. Will that make you happy?" 

Bella stopped crying and smiled. She said, "Yes please, that would make me feel so much better."

So Bella's mom bought her a lovely, shiny new balloon. Bella was so excited to have her balloon, and hugged it tight. She never was so stubborn again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved surprises and always kept her eyes open for something new and exciting. One day, Lily's mom gave her a bright, shiny toy car as a surprise. Lily was so happy that she kept the car with her all the time.

She would play with it during the day and keep it close to her at night. One evening, Lily's little brother saw the car and wanted to play with it too. Lily didn't want to share her surprise toy, but her mom told her that it was important to keep her brother happy too.

So, Lily decided to share her surprise with her brother and they played together happily. From that day on, Lily realized that keeping her loved ones happy was more important than keeping her toys to herself.

Once upon a time, there were two best friends. Jack and Jill were very polite to each other. They were always laughing and playing together.

One day, Jack and Jill noticed a table outside with a special game on it. It was a game called chess. They had never seen it before, so they looked at the pieces carefully.

The game looked fun. So, Jill asked Jack to learn how to play the game with her.

Jack said yes, and he quickly signed up for tutorial lessons. Jack and Jill practiced each day and soon they knew how all the pieces moved.

After a few weeks, Jack and Jill were very good at playing chess. They were very polite while they played, always saying 'good move' or 'well done'.

They would play the game together all the time. They had so much fun!

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Andy and Bob. They liked to do the same things together and have a good time. On this special day, Andy suggested that they go to a party. Bob was so excited!

When they got there, they noticed there was a lot of wine. Andy thought they should not drink any, so they promised to behave. They spent the night dancing and playing games. The music was loud, and the night was so cool. Everyone had so much fun!

In the morning, they said goodbye to their friends and thanked them for the great time. As they left, they remembered to behave, and they said they wouldn't have any wine. They were very proud of themselves and happy that they had such a fun night. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Tom. He loved the outdoors and he especially loved going to the big field near his home. He loved to run around and play in the warm, sunny grass.

One day, Tom was in the field and he saw a shiny object glittering in the sun. He walked over and picked it up. When he looked closer, he realised it was a ruby. It was so bright and sparkly, it made Tom smile. 

Tom couldn't wait to show his mum what he had found. His mum looked at the ruby and said, "Oh, Tom! It's beautiful. It needs some polish though." 

So Tom and his mum travelled to the store. They bought some polish and went back to the field. Tom's mum showed him how to use the polish and he started buffing the ruby with a cloth. 

Finally, the ruby was shining as bright as the day it had been found. Tom was so proud of his work. As they walked home, they stopped at a bakery and Tom's mum bought him a tasty chocolate eclair. It was the perfect end to a special day!

Once upon a time, there was a big, fat bear named Benny. Benny loved to eat honey all day long. One day, Benny saw a tunnel in the forest. He wanted to explore it, but he was scared. Benny asked his friends, the rabbits, to come with him. But the rabbits didn't want to go because they were afraid too.

Benny felt sad and alone. He thought about it and decided to accept the challenge. Benny went inside the tunnel, and it was very dark. He couldn't see anything, but he kept going. Suddenly, he heard a strange noise. Benny felt scared again, but he kept walking. Finally, he saw the light at the end of the tunnel. It was beautiful!

Benny was so happy that he went through the tunnel. He realized that sometimes you have to face your fears to discover new things. Benny went back to his friends and told them about his adventure. They were impressed and wanted to go through the tunnel too. Benny felt proud of himself for being brave and for accepting the challenge.

Once upon a time, there was a playful puppy named Max. Max loved to run around and play with his toys. One day, Max saw a cobweb in the corner of the room. He barked at it, but it didn't move.

Max's owner, Sarah, came into the room and saw Max barking at the cobweb. "What's wrong, Max?" she asked. Max replied, "There's a cobweb in the corner and it won't play with me."

Sarah smiled and said, "Cobwebs can't play, Max. But I can whistle and we can play together!" So Sarah whistled a happy tune and Max wagged his tail and jumped up and down. They played together until Max was tired and fell asleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved watching movies on his big screen TV. One day, Timmy's mom asked him what movie he wanted to watch. Timmy said, "I want to watch a great movie about dinosaurs!"

So, Timmy's mom put on a movie about dinosaurs. At first, Timmy was excited to see the big, scary dinosaurs on the screen. But then, one of the dinosaurs started to scare him. Timmy said, "Mom, I don't like this movie anymore. The scary dinosaur is making me scared."

Timmy's mom turned off the movie and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. We can watch a different movie. Let's watch a great movie about animals instead." Timmy smiled and said, "Okay, that sounds fun!" And they watched a great movie about animals that didn't scare Timmy at all.

Once upon a time, there was a big train. It went chugga chugga choo choo all day long. One day, the train got tired and needed to rest. 

The train found a nice spot under a tree and took a nap. It felt much better after a good rest. 

Later, a kind man came by and gave the train some water and snacks. The man was very generous and the train was very happy. 

From then on, the train made sure to rest and take breaks when it needed to. And it always remembered the generous man who helped it when it was tired.

Once upon a time, there was a little bear. He was a silly old bear and he liked to sleep a lot. One day he decided he would try to sleep 10,000 inches. It sounded very fun to him, but it was also very difficult.

So he started to sleep. He slept and he slept, until he was very tired. He had already slept 3,000 inches, but 7,000 more were still ahead.

The little bear was so tired that he nearly fell asleep standing up, but he knew he had to keep going if he wanted to sleep 10,000 inches. So he kept going. He counted every inch he slept. He slept 1 inch, then he slept 2 inches, and then he slept some more.

Finally, after what felt like forever, the little bear had reached 10,000 inches. He had hardly slept at all and he was very pleased with himself. He had made it! He was very happy and went back to his cozy den to sleep. He had done his best and was very proud of himself.

Nina and her mum went to the market. They walked around and looked at all the fruits, vegetables and sweets. Nina was so excited. 

Suddenly, she felt something slip out of her hand. She looked down and saw that she had lost her favourite toy. She started to cry.

Her mum could see that Nina was very upset. She quickly asked some of the people around the market if they had seen it. But no one had.

Nina's mum was becoming angry. She bought Nina some sweets and a balloon to cheer her up. 

They continued to look for Nina's toy. After some time they finally found it! Nina was so happy and hugged her mum tight.

Mia and her dad were walking down the street together, taking in all of the modern buildings. Overhead, the sun shone brightly in the sky. 

Suddenly, Mia felt unsteady on her feet. She stumbled, almost falling down. Her dad quickly caught her, his strong arms steadying her. "Are you okay Mia?" he asked, with a smile on his face. 

Mia nodded and the two of them continued walking. They stopped to look at a tall building, with a red roof and lots of windows. Mia's dad looked at the building and said, "Isn't this a modern building?" 

Mia nodded again, and the two of them talked about all of the different things the building might have inside it. Then, Mia spotted a bird perched on top of the roof. She pointed to it and said, "Look Daddy, the bird is so happy at the top of that roof!" 

Mia's dad laughed and they continued their walk, hand in hand.

Once there was a bright girl who enjoyed exploring the world. One day she was walking in the woods near her home when she came to a river. She had never seen a river before and she was amazed! She stood silently, watching the river rush by.

Suddenly, the girl heard a voice coming from the river. She listened carefully and realized that a fairy was speaking to her! The kind fairy told her that she could come to the river whenever she wanted and they could talk. 

From then on, the bright girl visited the river every day. She and the fairy would talk and play games together. The girl loved her time with the fairy and was so happy to have a friend.

The bright girl and the fairy became best friends and shared many great adventures together. Together, their imaginations could take them anywhere!

Sara and Ben like to play in the park. They have a ball and a bike. They have fun with their friends. One day, they see a big hole in the ground. They want to see what is inside.

They go near the hole and look down. They see something white and hard. It looks like a big stick. But it is not a stick. It is a skeleton. A skeleton is what is inside you when you have no skin or hair or eyes. Sara and Ben are scared. They want to run away.

But they are too late. A big dog comes out of the hole. It is angry and hungry. It has sharp teeth and long claws. It wants to eat Sara and Ben. It jumps on them and bites them. Sara and Ben scream and cry. They have no chance. The dog eats them and their ball and their bike. The dog is happy. Sara and Ben are gone. The end.

Once upon a time there was a green top. The green top glowed in the dark. It was so shiny and sparkly. Everyone wanted to have the green top.

One day, a little girl saw the green top. She was so happy and she wanted to keep it. She asked her mom if she could have the green top and her mom said yes.

The little girl kept the green top in her bedroom. Every night when it was dark, the green top glowed so brightly. It lit up her bedroom and she was never scared in the dark.

The little girl and the green top were best friends and they played together every day. The green top glowed and it was the best top in the whole world!

Amy was a young girl who loved to set the table. Every day, she would carefully place a plate at each of the four chairs. She was so happy when she got it right and felt successful.

One day, when Amy was setting the table, her little brother wandered over. He knocked the plate off of the chair and it clattered to the floor, smashing into pieces. 

Amy was very upset and started to cry. She asked her brother, "Why did you do that?" 

Her brother shrugged and explained, "I don't know. I wanted to see what would happen."

Amy was so angry and sad. She realised her brother would never understand how much it would have meant to her to set a successful table. What a bad ending!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his kite. He would run and run until the kite flew high in the sky.

One day, Timmy met a new friend named Billy. Billy was an ignorant boy who didn't know much about kites. Timmy tried to teach Billy how to fly the kite, but Billy didn't listen. He thought he knew everything.

Timmy decided to test Billy's knowledge by asking him questions about kites. Billy couldn't answer any of the questions. Timmy realized that Billy needed to learn more about kites before he could play with them. He decided to teach Billy everything he knew about kites so they could play together happily.

Once upon a time, there was a polar bear who was very weak. He wanted to build an igloo, but he was too weak to build it by himself. So he asked his closest friends for help. Everyone wanted to help him, but the polar bear was so weak that he could not even lift his paw.

He was so sad that it seemed like he would never find a way to build his igloo. But then an idea came to him. He was going to ask other animals who were strong and brave.

So the polar bear hoped and dreamed that the other animals would help him. He asked the fox, the owl, and the walrus. They all said yes to help him and together they started building his igloo.

The moral of this story is that if you hope and believe, anything is possible, even the impossible. You just need to keep asking for help and you will get it!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to eat cherries. She thought they were very delicious. One day, her mom gave her a big bowl of cherries to eat.

Sue was so happy. She sat down and started to eat the cherries one by one. She liked how they were red and sweet. She ate and ate until there was just one cherry left.

Sue wanted to finish all the cherries in the bowl. She picked up the last cherry and ate it. It was the most delicious cherry of all. Sue was very full and happy. She thanked her mom for the yummy cherries and went to play outside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to swing on her swing set in the backyard. One day, her friend Max came over to play. They both wanted to swing on the swing set, but there was only one swing. They started to argue and Lily became pale with anger. 

Suddenly, Lily's mom called them inside for lunch. As they were eating, Max had to go to the toilet. But when he tried to flush, the toilet wouldn't work! Lily's mom had to call a plumber to fix it. 

While they were waiting for the plumber, Lily and Max decided to play a game. They took turns swinging on the swing set and had so much fun that they forgot about their argument. When the plumber arrived, he fixed the toilet and they all lived happily ever after.

John was a big rabbit who loved to explore the forest. He jumped through the trees and hopped around in the grass, looking for interesting things. One day, he spotted a pattern on the ground and he wanted to get closer and have a look. He started hopping towards it, but then he saw something big and scary in the distance - a bear!

John was scared and wanted to escape, so he quickly hopped away. He hopped faster and faster, running away from the bear. He kept running until he couldn't run anymore, but he was still far away from the pattern he had been looking at. He was safe, but he couldn't get to the pattern.

Sadly, John had to give up and go home. He never got to explore the pattern and he was disappointed. He knew he had been brave to try, but he couldn't escape the bear.

Once upon a time, there was a man who was very compassionate. He cared for everyone no matter who they were. One day, he saw a little boy crying in the street. He went up to the little boy and asked him what was wrong.

The little boy told him that he had no food. The compassionate man said he would help. He went to the grocery store and bought a big onion. He gave it to the little boy, and the little boy thanked him.

The little boy was very happy. He went home and cooked the onion. He shared the onion with his family and everyone ate.

The little boy's family was very thankful for the compassionate man's kindness. They all thanked him for his kindly gift and for helping them when they were in need. The compassionate man smiled, happy to have helped.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy. He was looking for something special. He wanted to find soup. The boy looked everywhere. He looked in the kitchen but he couldn't find any. He climbed up onto a chair and looked in the cupboard, but still he couldn't find any soup. 

Then he had an idea. He grabbed his spade from the garden and went out the back door. He dug deep in the ground until he found something. He had discovered a big pot of soup filled with yummy things. It was thin and tasty. 

The little boy was very happy. He had found the soup that he was looking for. He took it inside and shared it with everyone. They all thought it was delicious. They ate it all up and had a big smile on their faces. 

The little boy was so pleased that he found the soup. From then on, he always remembered to look in the garden when he couldn't find something.

Once upon a time, there was an ancient sheep. She lived in a meadow filled with flowers. Every day, she would graze in the sun and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.

One day, a young lamb came to the meadow. He said to the ancient sheep, "Can I join you?" The ancient sheep was very happy. She smiled and said, "Yes, you are welcome here."

The two sheep started to explore the meadow together. They walked through the tall grass and watched the butterflies. They found a lake and admire the ripples of the water.

The ancient sheep and the young lamb became very good friends. They came back to the meadow every day to play together. The ancient sheep was so happy to have found a friend.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to observe the world around her. She would watch the birds in the sky, the fish in the pond, and the ants on the ground. Lily was always curious about everything.

One day, Lily saw a weak, old man with a staff. The staff helped the man walk because he was not strong. Lily wanted to help the man, so she walked up to him and asked if he needed help. The man smiled at Lily and said, "Thank you, little girl."

Together, they walked to the man's house. Lily held his hand and helped him walk. The man was very happy and gave Lily a big hug. From that day on, Lily and the man became good friends. They would observe the world together, and Lily would always help the man with his staff when he was weak.

Sam was a 3 year old boy. He loved to explore and would often wander away from his mom. One day, he was in the backyard playing with his toys. He suddenly heard something. Sam looked up and he saw a colorful bird. Its feathers were yellow, green, and purple. He wanted to get closer to the bird. He stepped slowly and carefully towards the bird. The bird flew away. Sam was sad, but he was excited to see what else he could explore.

He noticed a big tree with many colorful leaves. It was like a colorful rainbow. Sam stepped closer to the tree and noticed it had some tiny steps. He started to climb them. As he climbed higher, he could see farther away. He could see the clouds in the sky and the houses around him. It was so exciting! He was proud that he was able to see so much! 

Sam noticed a beautiful garden nearby. He wanted to explore it. He stepped towards the garden and soon he was surrounded by colorful flowers. He admired the different colors and shapes of the flowers. He could see a small pond nearby. He wanted to see the fish swimming inside! He stepped closer and saw the fish swimming. It was so fun! 

Sam smiled. He had had a colorful day of exploration!

Once there was a dad who was very hot. He had a fan but he couldn't find it. He asked his daughter if she had seen it. She said, "Sorry, dad. I don't see any fan."

Dad was sad, but then he had an idea. He went to his neighbour and asked if they had a fan. They said, "Yes! We have an extra fan."

Dad said, "Thank you so much! Could I share it with you?" The neighbour said, "Yes, thank you for asking. I would be happy to share it with you."

So dad took home the fan and he was very happy. He felt so much cooler with the fan. He said, "Thank you for sharing your fan with me."

The neighbour said, "You're welcome! It's always nice to share."

Once upon a time, there was a small girl who loved to walk around in nature. On one of her walks, she came across a bean in the grass. She was so excited, she shouted out loud, "Look what I found!" 

Her mother, who was walking behind her, answered her, "That's a bad bean, let's leave it alone."

The little girl didn't understand and picked up the bean in her hands. "Why is it bad mommy?" she asked. 

Her mother smiled and replied, "Because it won't grow into something special, like your other beans at home." 

The little girl smiled and said, "Ok, I'll leave it here then!" She put the bean back in the grass and they continued to walk together.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to chew gum. He thought it was cool to blow big bubbles. One day, Timmy was chewing gum in class. He blew a big bubble and it popped all over his face. Everyone laughed at him and he felt embarrassed.

Timmy didn't want to be embarrassed again, so he decided not to chew gum in class anymore. But then, his friend Billy showed up with a new kind of gum. It was so cool that Timmy couldn't resist. He took a piece and started chewing. But when he blew a bubble, it got stuck in his hair! Now Timmy was really embarrassed.

Timmy learned his lesson and decided to only chew gum outside of school. He didn't want to be embarrassed again. And from that day on, he always made sure to check his hair before leaving the house.

Once upon a time, there was a little red car. This car loved to drive all day long. It would drive up and down the long road, going fast and slow. The car was very happy when it could drive.

One day, the little red car felt a pain in one of its wheels. It could not drive as fast as before. The car was sad because it loved to drive. The car needed help to fix the pain.

A nice man saw the little red car and wanted to help. He looked at the wheel and found a small rock. The man took the rock out and the pain was gone. The little red car was so happy. It could drive up and down the long road again, all day long.

Once upon a time there was a boy called John. Every morning he would wake up and play in the meadow. One day he was so excited to get out of bed and explore. But when he tried to go outside he sneezed. It made a terrible noise that echoed across the meadow. 

John was scared. He ran inside to hide in his bedroom. All he could hear was the silence. He waited and waited until finally he heard a voice. It was his mum telling him that he was okay. He came out of his bedroom and his mum hugged him.

John was so relieved. He knew that everything was going to be okay. He went back outside and played in the meadow with no more sneezing. 

The end.

He was so excited to find what it was! He walked closer and closer until he seen it. A long yellow slide! He had never seen anything of the sort. He could hardly wait to try it out.

He was feeling a bit scared until he noticed something amazing. There was a beautiful view of the whole forest beneath him! The sight filled him with so much happiness that he forgot he was scared. Lily and Ben were having lunch with their mom. They liked to eat soup and bread. Lily wanted some salt on her bread, but the salt was on the other side of the table. She tried to reach for it, but she could not. She asked her mom to pass the salt, but her mom was busy talking on the phone.

"Mom, can you give me the salt, please?" Lily said.

But her mom did not hear her. Lily felt angry. She wanted the salt now. She stood up on her chair and stretched her arm. She almost touched the salt, but then she lost her balance. She fell off the chair and knocked over the soup bowl. The soup spilled all over the table and the floor. Lily cried out loud.

Mom heard the noise and dropped the phone. She ran to Lily and hugged her. She was frightened. She checked if Lily was hurt.

"Lily, are you okay? What happened?" Mom asked.

"I wanted the salt, but I could not reach it. I fell and made a mess. I'm sorry, Mom." Lily said.

Mom kissed Lily and said, "It's okay, sweetie. I'm glad you're not hurt. But you should not stand on the chair. That's dangerous. Next time, just wait for me or ask Ben to help you. Okay?"

Lily nodded and said, "Okay, Mom. I'm sorry, Ben."

Ben smiled and said, "It's okay, Lily. I'll help you clean up. And I'll share my salt with you."

Lily and Ben hugged each other. Mom smiled and said, "That's very nice of you, Ben. You're a good brother. Now let's finish our lunch and then we'll have some cookies. How does that sound?"

Lily and Ben said, "Yay! Cookies!"

They all laughed and ate their lunch. They were happy.

Anna loves her baby brother, Tom. He is very small and cute. He smiles and laughs when she plays with him. But sometimes he cries and makes a mess. Then Anna helps her mom to wipe his face and his bottom. She is a good big sister.

One day, Anna and Tom go to the park with mom. They see a big slide and a swing. Anna wants to try them. She runs to the slide and climbs up. She is strong and brave. She slides down fast and says, "Whee!" Tom claps his hands and giggles.

Mom puts Tom on the swing and pushes him gently. He likes the swing. He feels the wind and the sun. He says, "Woo!" Anna runs to the swing and pushes him too. She says, "I love you, Tom!" He says, "I love you, Anna!" They are happy.

But then a big boy comes to the swing. He is mean and rude. He says, "Get off the swing! It's mine!" He pushes Tom hard and makes him fall. Tom cries and hurts his head. Anna is angry and scared. She says, "No! You are bad! Go away!"

Mom runs to Tom and hugs him. She says, "It's okay, Tom. You are safe. I love you." She wipes his tears and his blood. She says, "You are strong and brave. You will be fine." She gives him a kiss and a band-aid.

Anna runs to Tom and hugs him too. She says, "I'm sorry, Tom. You are my brother. I love you." She wipes his nose and his dirt. She says, "You are small and cute. You are my friend." She gives him a kiss and a toy.

Tom smiles and laughs. He says, "Thank you, Anna. You are my sister. I love you." He wipes her cheek and her hair. He says, "You are strong and brave. You are my hero." He gives her a kiss and a hug.

They are happy. They love each other. They love mom. They are a family.

Once upon a time there were two puppies who lived in a house together. One puppy was wearing a collar and one was not.

The pup without the collar was sad and miserable. He wanted a collar like the other pup. So one day he decided to ask his friend if he could count the stars in the night sky with him.

The pup with the collar agreed and they both went outside together to count the stars. They lay together and counted the stars until it was time to go back inside. 

While they were lying there, the pup with the collar noticed the pup without the collar and was very sad. He thought it made the pup look miserable without his collar.

So the pup with the collar gave his own collar to the pup without the collar. The pup without a collar was so happy!

They both snuggled up together and counted the stars. After a while the pup with the collar said to the pup without the collar, "Let's go home now my friend. I'm glad you don't look miserable anymore." 

And so the two puppies went back inside with the pup without a collar now wearing the collar and both of them feeling very happy.

Sam and Tom are friends. They like to play outside. But today is a rain day. The sky is gray and wet. They cannot go out.

"Can we play with your toys?" Sam asks Tom.

"OK, but only the ones in my room. Mom says the ones in the living room are not for us." Tom says.

They go to Tom's room. They see many toys. They see cars, blocks, dolls, and books. They are happy. They start to play.

But then they hear a loud noise. It is Mom. She is angry.

"What are you doing?" Mom yells. "You made a big mess! You took out all the toys! You are not ready to play with them! You are too little!"

She takes away the toys. She puts them in a box. She locks the box. She says they cannot play with them anymore.

Sam and Tom are sad. They cry. They want to play. But they have no toys. They have no fun. They have a bad rain day.

One day, a little girl named Red had a unique idea. She wanted to invite a wolf to her house for tea. She liked wolves because they had big teeth and soft fur. She thought they would be fun to play with.

She put on her red coat and hat and went to the forest. She saw a big wolf hiding behind a tree. She said, "Hello, wolf. Do you want to come to my house for tea? I have cookies and milk."

The wolf was surprised. He had never been invited by a human before. He thought Red was very brave and kind. He said, "Yes, thank you. I would like to come to your house for tea. But are you not afraid of me? I am a wolf, and wolves eat humans."

Red shook her head. She said, "No, I am not afraid of you. You are a wolf, and wolves are unique. You have big teeth and soft fur. You can be my friend."

The wolf smiled. He said, "Okay, then. You can be my friend, too. But we have to be careful. Not all humans are nice like you. Some of them might hurt us."

Red nodded. She said, "Don't worry. I will protect you. Come on, let's go to my house."

She took the wolf's paw and led him to her house. They had tea and cookies and milk. They played with Red's toys and books. They had a lot of fun. They became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a monster. It was big and scary, and it made everyone feel uncomfortable. One day, the monster wanted to try something new. It wanted to learn how to fold.

So the monster found a piece of paper and put it flat on the floor. Then it slowly folded one side up. The monster was very happy that it had figured out how to fold!

But then a problem happened. The monster had folded the piece of paper too much and it no longer fit on the floor! The monster felt upset and uncomfortable. How could it get out of this?

At last, the monster had an idea. It carefully unfolded the paper until it was flat again and the monster was back on the floor. Everyone was happy that the monster had learned how to fold!

One day, a fat cat and a small dog were walking in the park. They saw a big jar of jam on a table. The cat said, "I want to eat that jam!" The dog said, "Me too! Let's unite and get it together."

They tried to jump up to the table, but they were too short. A little bird saw them and knew what they wanted. The bird said, "I can help you get the jam, but we must unite to do it." The cat and the dog agreed.

The bird flew up and pushed the jam off the table. The fat cat and the small dog caught it. They all shared the jam and were very happy. They learned that when they unite, they can do big things.

Once upon a time, there was a kind queen who ruled over a big castle. She had many helpers who were always useful to her. One day, a little girl came to the castle and asked the queen for help. 

"Can you help me find my lost toy?" asked the little girl. 

The queen smiled and said, "Of course, I'll send my helpers to search for it. Just wait here." 

The helpers searched high and low, but they couldn't find the toy. The little girl was sad and started to cry. 

Suddenly, the queen returned with the lost toy. "Here you go," she said with a smile. "I found your toy." 

The little girl was happy and thanked the queen for her help. "You're so kind," she said. 

The queen replied, "It's my pleasure to be useful to others."

John lay on the seat of the soft green car. He felt pale and tired. All around him was quiet and plenty of grass. 
John looked down at his heels. The old shoes were scuffed and worn, but he knew he could run with them. He wanted to try and run away from the car, across the grass and feel the warm sun. 

Just then, he spotted a bright red balloon in the distance. He quickly sat up and clapped his hands in excitement. He was determined to get that balloon no matter how far it floated.

John jumped out of the car and raced across the grass. He ran as fast and as hard as his heels could take him, his heart pounding in anticipation. 

Finally, John reached the balloon. He smiled as he caught it in his hands and lay back down in the car, the bright red balloon still in his grip. 

John lay there in happiness, knowing he had accomplished his goal. The wind gently pushed the balloon higher, taking John soaring through the air with it.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a boy named Tim. Tim was a happy boy who loved to play with his friends. He liked to learn new things but sometimes he was ignorant about the truth.

When the gift came, Tim opened it and found a book. The book taught him about the truth of the world and how to be kind to others. Tim learned many things from the book and was no longer ignorant. He shared the truth with his friends and they all became better people. And they all lived happily ever after.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. They like to swing on the swings. They swing high and low. They laugh and sing.

One day, Lily brings a book to the park. It is a novel. She likes to read novels. They have many words and stories. She tells Tom about the novel.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to sing and dance. One day, she went to the opera with her family. The music was very loud but Lily felt calm. Once upon a time, there was a cat. He was gentle and loved to play. One day, he decided to go for a walk. He walked and he walked until he came across an old tree. Inside the tree he found a jar of jam. He was so happy! He put the jam in his pocket and continued walking until it was time to go home.

On the way back, he heard a noise. He turned around and saw a little bird. The bird was scared so the cat was very gentle. He moved slowly and spoke softly to the bird. The bird decided to come with him and they began to walk back together.

They arrived home and the cat set the jar of jam down on the table. He remembered the bird and said goodbye. The bird thanked him and flew away.

The cat thought about the bird all night and the next day he decided to return to the old tree. He looked everywhere but the bird was nowhere to be seen. He left some of the jam for the bird and then he gently walked back home.

One day, a little boy named Tim found a big, red truck. The truck was very dirty. Tim thought, "I need to clean the truck to make it look nice."

Tim went to his mommy and said, "Mommy, I need water and soap to clean my truck." Mommy gave Tim a bucket of water and soap. Tim went outside and washed the truck. The truck was now clean and shiny.

After cleaning the truck, Tim felt hungry. He went inside and mommy gave him a yummy sandwich. Tim ate the sandwich and felt happy. He played with his clean, red truck all day long.

Once upon a time, there was a little baby named Lily. She loved to play in her crib and giggle with joy. One day, her mommy and daddy decided to take her to the park for a picnic. They packed sandwiches, fruit, and juice in a big basket.

As they were walking, they saw a group of ducks swimming in the pond. Lily's daddy said, "I bet we can feed the ducks and they will come close to us." So, they took out some bread and threw it in the water. The ducks came closer and closer, quacking with happiness.

After they finished their picnic, they started to walk back home. Suddenly, they saw a rainbow in the sky. Lily's mommy said, "This is a successful day! We had a fun picnic and saw a beautiful rainbow." Lily smiled and cooed happily, feeling grateful for her wonderful family.

One day, there were two little kids that wanted to go on an adventure. So, they slowly pulled their big red luggage and started walking down the road. Suddenly, they noticed a funny number written on a wall. It said '3'.

The kids thought that was funny and decided to find out what was so special about the number. So, they kept counting and counting, until they reached the number 3 again. When they did, a big surprise came out of the luggage! It was a giant clown with balloons!

The kids were so excited. The clown even picked up the big red luggage! He slowly carried it away, laughing the whole time. With the clown gone, all that was left was the special number 3. That will always remind the kids of their wonderful adventure!

Once upon a time, there was a copper. He wanted to go outside and play, but the day was very dangerous. He thought and thought about what to do. Suddenly he heard a call. It was his friend, a brave squirrel. 

The squirrel called out, "Come outside! We can have fun yet be safe from danger." The copper hesitated but then remembered that he was brave too. He stepped out into the sunshine and saw the squirrel waiting there with a smile.

"You can follow me," the squirrel said, and the copper felt excited to see his friend. They hopped and skipped over the ground, singing and playing all the way. Everywhere they looked the danger was gone, and the copper felt so free and happy. 

The copper and the squirrel enjoyed their time together and called out to one another. They ran around until the sun began to set, and when their time together was done, the copper waved goodbye with a grateful heart.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue lived in a small house with her mom and dad. Sue's room had a big window with a gloomy curtain. She did not like the curtain because it made her room dark.

One day, Sue asked her mom if they could make a new curtain. Her mom said yes. They went to the store and picked out a bright, happy fabric. Sue was very excited to make her new curtain.

Sue and her mom worked together to make the new curtain. They cut the fabric and sewed it together. When they were done, they hung the new curtain in Sue's room. The new curtain made Sue's room bright and happy. Sue loved her new curtain and was very proud that she helped make it.

Once upon a time, there was a small bug. He had a friend, who was an elderly bug. They liked to play together.

One day, they decided to go to a big tree. The tree had many leaves. They were very happy to play there. The elderly bug said, "I like this tree a lot!"

The small bug and elderly bug played all day. They had so much fun. Then, they went home to rest. They were very tired but happy.

Cody wanted to be ready for school.  He put on his shirt and pants.  He was very excited for his first day.  He grabbed his lunchbox and said goodbye to his mom.

On his way to the school, Cody passed lots of trees.  The leaves were falling from the trees.  Cody watched the leaves fall and laughed.
 
When he arrived at the school, Cody met his teacher.  He said hello and showed her his lunchbox.  Cody's teacher said that he looks ready to be a pupil.  She showed Cody where to go.

Cody saw many other pupils.  They were excited to meet him.  He smiled and said hello.  They all had fun together playing games.

Once upon a time, there lived a little boy who was brave and strong. He was always exploring the world around him, and one day while crawling through the grass he found something amazing! A rare bubble was perched on a blade of grass, and it shone in the sunlight.

The bubble seemed to be alive and was sparkling and twinkling like a tiny star. The boy was so excited and quickly tried to catch the bubble with his hands. But the bubble was too fast and it floated away! Then, it flew off and the boy chased the bubble. He crawled through the grass and bushes, reaching out and trying to get the bubble.

Finally, the little boy was able to catch the bubble in his hands. He carefully looked at the bubble and smiled. It was so beautiful and glittered like a diamond. Then, the boy popped the bubble and tiny droplets of soap flew up into the air.

The little boy laughed and clapped his hands. It was so much fun and he was so proud of himself for catching the rare bubble. He was happy to share the fun with everyone he knew. From that day, the little boy kept looking for rare bubbles to catch and enjoy.

Tiara was so excited to go to her birthday party. She loved birthdays - they were so fun! At the party, there were so many colorful decorations. Her favorite color was pink and she saw lots of pink balloons, streamers and cupcakes. 

Tiara couldn't believe that there was a cake with her name on it! It was pink and covered in sprinkles. It had colorful candles on top, which she was so excited to blow out. 

Then everyone sang "Happy Birthday" and Tiara blew out all the candles. She got to have a piece of the cake and it was so yummy and sweet. She ate it with a big smile on her face.

When it was time to go, Tiara was sad to leave. She told her friends she wanted to stay and eat cake forever! But it was time to go home. She said goodbye, hugged all her friends, and left the colorful party.

Once upon a time there lived a little boy named Jake. Jake lived near the sea and he loved to watch the boats sail past. One day Jake decided he wanted to sail his own boat. So he found a boat and climbed on. He pushed and pulled until he was out in the open sea. 

The sun was shining, the wind was blowing and the boat was rolling in the waves. When the boat reached the middle of the sea, Jake noticed an old cabin. He made his way to the cabin and saw it was very peaceful.

"I could stay here forever" thought Jake. He opened the door and heard a loud noise. A big scary monster was inside! The monster frowned and said "YOU CANNOT STAY HERE. THIS PLACE IS FOR ME AND ME ALONE!"

Jake was scared, but then he remembered something his father had told him. He said that peace comes from sharing and understanding. 

Jake looked the monster in the eye and said "Let me stay here a while. I can show you how to share and understand and we will both be happy."

The monster thought for a moment and said "OK. You can stay, but only if you show me how to be peaceful. Deal?" 

Jake smiled and said "Deal!" 

So Jake taught the monster how to share and understand and soon the two were living in peace and harmony in the old cabin.

Once upon a time there was an old car. But it was very stubborn. The old car just sat there and wouldn't listen to anyone. Everyone told it to go, but it just wouldn't.

But then one day a boy came along. He was just a little boy, only three years old. He had a toy car, but he wanted to drive the big old car.

The boy looked right at the old car and said, "Let's zoom!" And to everyone's surprise, the old car started to move! The boy made the car zoom all around the town. Everyone was amazed that the old car could still go so fast!

The boy and the old car had so much fun zooming around. They zoomed for a long time, until it was time for the boy to go home. But he was never too far away to come and visit the old, stubborn car!

Once upon a time, there was a funny queen who loved to sign songs. She had a big castle where she lived with her friends. One day, a bad dragon came and burned down the castle. The queen and her friends were very sad.

The queen said, "Oh no! What will we do now?"

Her friend replied, "Let's build a new castle!"

So they started to build a new castle, but it was taking a long time. The bad dragon came back and burned down the new castle too. The queen and her friends were very sad again.

The queen said, "We can't keep building castles. We need to find a way to stop the dragon."

But they couldn't find a way to stop the dragon, so they had to move away and find a new place to live. And they all lived happily ever after in their new home.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside, but one day his mom warned him that it was going to rain. Timmy didn't listen and went outside anyway.

As he was playing, he saw a big puddle and jumped in it with his foot. Suddenly, the rain started pouring down and Timmy got all wet. He ran back inside to his mom, who was not happy.

"I told you it was going to rain, Timmy. Now you're all wet and you'll catch a cold," his mom said impatiently.

Timmy learned his lesson and promised to listen to his mom's warnings from now on.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and pick flowers. One day, she found a beautiful lily in the garden. She picked it and brought it inside to show her mom.

"Look, Mommy! I found a pretty lily!" Lily said.

"That's lovely, dear. Why don't we paint a picture of it together?" her mom suggested.

Lily was excited to paint with her mom. They got out the paint and brushes and started to paint the lily. Lily was having so much fun, she didn't even notice how comfortable she was sitting next to her mom.

After they finished the painting, Lily's mom hung it up on the wall. Every time Lily looked at it, she remembered the fun she had painting with her mom. From then on, every time they saw a lily, they would smile and remember their special painting day.

Once upon a time, there was an old star in the sky. It was very special, because it was the oldest star in the universe. Every night, the old star shone so brightly that it lit up the whole sky.

The old star was so magical that it could grant wishes. One day, a little girl saw the old star in the night sky. She made a wish that she could write like a grown up. Suddenly, the old star sparkled and her wish came true.

The little girl was so happy that she ran to get a pencil and paper. She wrote and wrote and wrote. Soon, the little girl was writing stories about the old star in the sky. She wrote about all of its magic and how brightly it shone.

The little girl was thankful to the old star for making her wish come true. Every night, she would look up to the sky and say "Thank you!"

Jim was walking through the park. Suddenly, he saw a puppy wearing a bright green vest! He couldn't help himself, so he stopped to pet her. The puppy's fur was soft and deep brown. I have a home with my mommy and daddy." Jim smiled and said, "That's great. Be sure to stay close to home!"

Jim and Daisy continued to talk for a while until Daisy's daddy called her back home. Daisy waved goodbye to Jim and ran away. Jim was sad to see Daisy go but he knew she was safe with her family. As Jim turned to leave, he saw Daisy's bright green vest and smiled. He was happy to have met such a wonderful puppy.

The people loved it so much, they decided to let the bird stay forever. Every day, the people listened to its music and shared delicious treats with each other. It was the happiest nation of all! 

The end.

Then Danny went to the checkout and paid for the video game. As he was walking home with the new video game, he was so excited. 

Meanwhile, his dad was getting grumpy waiting for Danny to come home. As soon as Danny arrived home, he showed his dad the video game. His dad was then so happy, he forgot how grumpy he had been and told Danny to go play with it. 

Danny thanked his dad and went to his room to play the game, as he was so happy with his decision.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toys. One day, he brought his favorite toy car to school and showed it to his friend, Billy. Billy liked the car very much and asked if he could play with it. Timmy said yes and lent him the car.

After school, Timmy went to the classroom to get his toy car back. But when he arrived, he saw that the car was broken. He asked Billy what happened, and Billy said he accidentally dropped it. Timmy was very sad that his favorite toy was now broken.

The moral of the story is that we should be careful when we lend our things to others, and we should also be responsible for taking care of things that we borrow from others.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys every day. One day, Timmy found a locked box in his room. He wondered what was inside the box.

Once upon a time, there was an old lady. She was very old and her hair was white like snow. She lived in a big house with a garden full of flowers. One day, she went to the classroom to teach the children. The classroom was big and had lots of toys.

Once upon a time there was a naughty little boy. He did not listen to his parents and often made messes. One day his mum went to the field to get some wheat. She asked the naughty boy to help her lift the wheat, but he didn't want to!

Suddenly the trees began to move and the wind became strong. Jill was scared, until she realized it was only a big gust of wind that had sprung up.

But then she heard a loud noise, like thunder in the distance. She looked up and saw dark storm clouds rolling in. She started to worry she wouldn't be able to see the beautiful view anymore.
