Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the park with her friends. One day, they found a big green structure to climb on. 

Lily's friend, Timmy, said "Be careful, the edges are sharp!" 

Lily replied, "Don't worry, I'll be careful." She climbed up the structure and looked down at Timmy. "I can see everything from up here!" 

Timmy smiled and said, "Wow, you're so brave!" 

Lily felt proud of herself and they continued to play on the green structure for the rest of the day.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Ella. Ella was very curious and she loved exploring.

One day she went to her school and she saw a damaged blackboard near the entrance. She walked up to it and she looked around carefully.

Ella noticed that it was broken and so she wanted to repair it. She asked her teacher for help and her teacher said,
"That's an interesting challenge. Do you think you can fix it?"

Ella nodded eagerly and she got to work. She went looking for the tools she needed and eventually she managed to repair the blackboard.

"Wow, Ella. You did a great job!", her teacher said.

Ella smiled proudly. She was glad to see the blackboard fixed. It was such an interesting adventure!

Once, there were two friends named Andy and Rosy. They were best friends and promised to always stay together. One day, they went to the movies. It was incredible! They watched a funny film and the time flew by. 

When they left the theater, they asked their parents if they could watch movies together all the time. To their surprise, their parents promised to take them to the movies every weekend. Andy and Rosy were happy.

They kept their promise and went to the movies every weekend. They saw more incredible films and laughed out loud. At the end of each movie, they hugged each other tightly and promised never to forget their fun times together. They kept their promise and they are still best friends today.

Once upon a time there was a girl who loved to look at nature. She would go to the park every day and wonder at the plants. She saw so many kinds of plants in all sorts of colors. Her favorite was a pink one.

The girl wanted to have a pink plant of her own. She asked her mom to help her get one for her bedroom. Her mom was so happy that she went right away to look for one.

Soon, the girl had a pink plant in her bedroom. She watered it every day and it grew bigger and bigger. The girl was so excited to watch it grow.

She kept wondering if her pink plant would ever bloom. Soon, one day it began to produce some beautiful pink flowers. The girl was so happy!

She was so excited to show off her pink plant to all her friends. The girl was so proud of her pink plant. Every day she would take care of it and it kept blooming more and more.

Lily was very happy. She had a new friend at school. His name was Tom. He liked to play with cars and blocks. Lily liked to play with dolls and books. They had fun together.

One day, Lily invited Tom to her house. She wanted to show him her toys and her cat. Tom said yes. He was excited. He liked Lily's house. It was big and pretty.

Lily's mom was very nice. She said welcome to Tom. She gave him a mug of milk and a cookie. Tom said thank you. He drank the milk and ate the cookie. They were yummy.

Lily and Tom went to Lily's room. They played with her toys and her cat. They laughed and talked. They had a lot of fun.

But then, something terrible happened. Lily's cat knocked over the mug of milk. The milk spilled on the floor and on Tom's pants. Tom was wet and sticky. He felt sad and angry. He cried.

Lily was sorry. She said sorry to Tom. She said sorry to her mom. She said sorry to her cat. She wanted to make Tom happy again.

Lily's mom was kind. She said it was okay. She said it was an accident. She said she would clean the floor and Tom's pants. She said she would give Tom another mug of milk and another cookie.

Lily hugged Tom. She said she was still his friend. She said she still liked him. She said they could still play.

Tom smiled. He said he was still her friend. He said he still liked her. He said they could still play.

Lily and Tom were happy again. They played with her toys and her cat. They drank the milk and ate the cookie. They had fun together.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly lady who loved oranges. She would count them every day to make sure she had enough. One day, a little boy came to her house and saw all the oranges. He asked, "Why do you have so many oranges?"

The elderly lady replied, "I love oranges. They are sweet and juicy. I like to count them every day."

The little boy asked, "Can I count them too?"

The elderly lady smiled and said, "Of course, you can count them with me."

So, the little boy and the elderly lady counted all the oranges together. They had so much fun that the little boy came back every day to count oranges with the elderly lady. They became good friends and enjoyed each other's company.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Sarah wanted to visit her grandpa. She asked her mom if they could go on an adventure, and her mom said yes.

They got in the car and drove for a long time. As they drove, Sarah noticed the ground shaking. She asked her mom what it was, and her mom told her that it was an earthquake.

The car stopped in front of a big house. Sarah was so excited to see her grandpa. She knocked on the door and Grandpa opened it. His voice was soft and kind. He welcomed Sarah with a big hug.

They went inside, and Sarah couldn't believe how cozy it was. She saw a big kitchen and a soft bed. She played there with her grandpa all day, until it was time to go home. 

Before they left, Sarah gave her grandpa a big hug. It was the best visit ever!

Mama and Max were in the kitchen. Max saw something in the bowl. He ran to Mama and shouted "What is this?"

Mama smiled and said, "Max, it's sugar. I am going to add it to the cake. We will make it sweet!"

Max nodded and asked, "Can I help?" Mama agreed and gave Max a spoon.

Max scooped up some sugar and dropped it into the cake mix. Mama said, "Max, you need to stir it all together. Then it will be yummy!" 
Max grabbed the spoon and mixed the ingredients. When he was done, Mama smiled and said, "Good job, Max! Now it's time to taste it."

Max opened his mouth and tasted the cake. He smiled and said, "It tastes different!"

Mama nodded and said, "Yes, now it tastes sweet." Max smiled and said, "I like it!"

Once upon a time, there was a little kitten. She was very cute and fluffy. One day, she went outside to play. She saw a butterfly and tried to catch it, but it flew away. 

Then, she saw a little girl walking by. The little girl saw the kitten and said, "Oh, you are so lucky to be so cute!" The kitten didn't understand what the little girl meant, but she was happy to be called cute. 

Suddenly, the little girl took out a box of toys. She showed the kitten a ball and said, "Let's play catch!" The kitten didn't know how to play catch, but she tried her best. She jumped and chased the ball until she finally caught it. The little girl clapped her hands and said, "You did it! We match so well!" The kitten didn't know what "match" meant, but she was happy to play with her new friend.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little puppy named Max. He loved to play outside in the snow. One day, while Max was playing, he saw a big, scary cat. The cat didn't like Max and wanted to hurt him. Max got very scared and didn't know what to do. 

Suddenly, Max remembered that he had a special power. He could freeze! Max closed his eyes and focused very hard. Then, he froze in place. The cat couldn't see him and walked away. Max was safe! 

After that day, Max realized that he had a special gift. He could use it to protect himself and others. He decided to use his gift for good and always be a helpful friend. Max learned that being adorable was not enough to keep him safe, but with his special power, he could overcome any danger.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and dolls. One day, Lily's mom asked her if she wanted to have a fancy tea party with her dolls. Lily was very excited and said yes.

Lily's mom provided all the things they needed for the tea party. She brought out the tea cups, saucers, and a fancy teapot. They sat down and enjoyed their tea and cookies.

Suddenly, Lily saw some smoke coming from the kitchen. She got scared and ran to her mom. Her mom told her not to worry and that she would take care of it. She quickly put out the fire and everything was okay.

After the tea party, Lily's mom told her that it's important to always be careful with fire and to never play with matches or lighters. Lily learned that it's important to listen to her mom and always be safe.

Lily was a spoiled girl who always wanted new toys. She did not like to share or play with her old toys. She only wanted the toys that she saw on TV or in the store. One day, she saw a big, shiny car that could seat four dolls. She asked her mom to buy it for her, but her mom said no. It was too expensive and Lily had enough toys already.

Lily was very angry and sad. She cried and screamed and threw a tantrum. She did not listen to her mom or say sorry. She ran to her room and slammed the door. She looked at her toys and hated them. She wished she had the big, shiny car.

The next day, Lily's mom had to go to work at the factory. She made clothes and shoes for other people. She asked Lily to come with her, because she could not find a babysitter. Lily did not want to go, but she had no choice. She put on her coat and shoes and followed her mom.

At the factory, Lily saw many machines and people working hard. They were noisy and busy and dirty. Lily did not like it. She wanted to go home and play with her toys. She told her mom that she was bored and hungry and tired. Her mom said that she had to work for a few hours and then they could go home. She gave Lily a sandwich and a juice and told her to seat on a chair and be quiet.

Lily ate her sandwich and drank her juice, but she was still bored. She looked around and saw a big pile of boxes. She wondered what was inside them. She got up from her chair and walked to the boxes. She opened one and saw a big, shiny car that could seat four dolls. It was the same car that she wanted. She was very happy and excited. She took the car out of the box and put it on the floor. She found four dolls in another box and put them in the car. She pretended that she was driving the car and having fun. She did not care that the boxes and the car and the dolls belonged to the factory and not to her. She did not care that she was being naughty and selfish. She only cared about the car.

Once upon a time, there was a horse named Lucky. Lucky lived in a stable with his friends. The stable was big and had lots of hay to eat. One day, Lucky decided to race his friends. He ran very fast and won the race! Lucky was so happy to win.

But then, Lucky heard a scary noise. He looked around and saw a big, scary cat. Lucky was scared and didn't know what to do. But then, Lucky remembered he was a brave horse. He kicked his legs and chased the cat away. Lucky felt very proud and happy that he saved his friends from the scary cat.

Once upon a time there was an old man. He used to be strong and full of energy, but now he was very weak. He used to love to play in the garden, but now it was too hard for him to move. 

The old man was very sad. He not only felt tired and lonely, but he suffered greatly. Every day he looked around and saw other people playing and having fun, but he couldn't do the same.

One day, the old man found a disgusting old bug. He was so surprised and scared by it, he said "Hello old creepy bug - why you here?"

The old bug said, "I suffer too, just like you. Look around, there is suffering everywhere. We must try to be kind to each other, even when it is hard." 

The old man was very thankful for the old bug's wise words. They said goodbye and the old man went away feeling much happier than before.

Once upon a time, there was a bouncy kitten called Lucy who lived with her mom and dad in a cozy house. Every day, Lucy would go out and wander in the sunshine, looking for fun.

One day, when she was out exploring, she spotted something glinting in the grass. She went over to take a look and saw that it was a hoop! It was made of shiny metal and it made Lucy feel so excited.

She picked up the hoop and started to play with it, rolling it around and hopping over it too. She wiggled and jiggled and had the best time ever.

Nearby, her mom was watching and called out, "Lucy, come here! What's that you have there?"

Lucy proudly held up the hoop and announced, "Look! I found this hoop and it's so playful!"

Her mom smiled and said, "Yes it is. You can keep it and play with it whenever you want."

After that, Lucy was always seen wandering with her hoop, playing and having lots of fun. The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was three years old and so curious about the world. One day Jane wanted to learn about the tiny things all around her, so she asked her mom to get her a microscope.

When the microscope arrived, Jane was so excited and ran to her room to look through it. But when she turned it on, loud noises and flashing lights came out of it. Jane panicked and didn't know what to do. 

Luckily, Jane's mom heard the loud noises and came to her rescue. She quickly turned off the microscope and explained how to use it safely and correctly. Jane was happy because now she could learn about all the tiny things in the world.

The next day Jane used her microscope and was amazed by what she saw. She felt so lucky to have her mom who helped her when she panicked and taught her how to use the microscope.

Granny was writing in a big book. She had a picture of a soldier on the page and she was writing with a cold pencil. She said, "The soldier is very brave!" 
Then Granny wrote something else in the book. She wrote, "He is a brave soldier". 
After Granny finished writing, she said, "The soldier is very strong and he is good at fighting." 
Suddenly the door opened and Granny's grandson, Tim, came in. He said, "Granny, what are you writing about?" 
Granny said, "I'm writing about a brave soldier. He is strong and he fights for his country." Tim asked, "Do soldiers get cold?" Granny smiled and said, "Yes, sometimes they can get cold." 

Tim nodded as if he understood and he said, "I want to be a brave soldier when I get bigger!" Granny smiled and said, "That would be wonderful!"

Kara was a happy three year old. She loved to play with her toys, especially her big, red car. One day, she wanted to take it for a spin. She was so excited that she shoved it to the top of the slide. Kara climbed the slide, shouted "weee", and slid down.

Suddenly, the car slipped out of her hands and started to roll away. Kara watched from the top of the slide, feeling helpless. 

As the car made its way down the hill, finally came to a stop. Kara got off the slide and ran towards it, relieved to find it safe. 

But then, to her surprise, the car started rolling again. She chased after it, but the car kept rolling faster and faster. 

Kara started to feel even more helpless. But before the car could get away, a gleaming white car drove up and blocked its path. An old man stepped out of the car, bent down and picked it up. He smiled at Kara and said, "There you go, little one."

Kara thanked the man and accepted her car. She ran back home, feeling thankful and no longer helpless.

Tom is a boy who likes to play with cars. He has many cars of different colors and sizes. He likes to make them zoom and crash on the floor. He also likes to go to the shop with his mom and dad. The shop has many things to see and buy. Tom likes to look at the toys and the books and the candy.

They count to three and then push their cars as hard as they can. The cars zoom and whizz and race. Tom, Lily and Ben cheer and laugh. They have a lot of fun playing with cars at the shop.

John was playing catch with his dad. He threw the baseball and it landed deep in the grass. His dad said, "You need to run and get it, John."
John said, "But Daddy, it's too far away."
His dad said, "Nothing is too far away when you try. Please go get it."

Once there was a little farmer who had a grumpy cow. The cow didn't like to eat the grass in the farmer's field. The farmer felt bad for the cow, so he decided to restore the grass and make it look nice again.

The farmer got to work and began to cut down the old grass and plant new ones. After a few days the farmer was finished. The grass looked so lively and green, it made the farmer very happy.

The cow was also happy when it saw the new grass. She was no longer grumpy when she ate the fresh and tasty grass.

Everyday the farmer and his cow would go for long walks in the now restored field. They were both very happy and healthy.

Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a smelly dog named Max. Max liked to follow people and make friends. One day, Max saw a big building called a university. He wanted to go inside and see what was there.

Max walked through the door and saw many people. He started to follow a nice girl named Sue. Sue looked down and said, "Hi, smelly dog! What are you doing here?" Max wagged his tail and followed Sue into a big room with lots of chairs.

Sue sat down and Max sat next to her. They listened to a man talk about fun things. After the talk, Sue said, "Max, you are a good friend. Let's go outside and play!" Max and Sue went outside and played until the sun went down. They were very happy and had a great day at the university.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the zoo with her mommy and daddy. One day, when they went to see the zebras, Lily saw a unique zebra that was all white with black stripes. 

Lily said to her mommy, "Look at that zebra! It's so different from the others!" 

Her mommy replied, "Yes, it's very unique. Let's go fill up its water bucket." 

Lily and her mommy went to get some water and filled up the zebra's bucket. The zebra was very happy and said, "Thank you!" in zebra language. 

Lily was so excited that she got to help the zebra. She said to her mommy, "I love coming to the zoo and helping the animals." Her mommy smiled and said, "Me too, Lily. Let's go see what other animals we can help today." And so, they went off to explore the rest of the zoo.

Once there was a big pool. The water was shiny and one day a bell began to ring. Everyone was so excited because it meant that it was time to have fun.

The children ran to the pool and dashed in. They laughed and splashed around in the big pool. One of the kids found a big floaty and floated around for a while. Then they started playing games like diving for toys and having races.

When the bell rang again, it was time to get out and dry off. Everyone was so tired from the fun they had been having. They dried off know that they had had a great time in the big pool.

Jack was a very sleepy little boy. He was three years old and loved playing games. One day he was walking near a big oak tree. It was tall and strong. Jack wanted to play a game to repair the tree.

He gathered some mud, twigs, and leaves. He mixed the mud with water and used it to make a glue. He stuck the twigs and leaves onto the oak tree. When he was done, the tree was fixed.

Jack smiled and was happy. The oak tree was his proud repair job. He saw it standing tall again and was happy he helped it. He hugged the oak tree and said "There, now you're good as new!" 

The oak tree thanked Jack and the little boy went back home. He was very tired from his repair job and quickly fell into a deep and sleepy slumber.

Lila and Tom were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they found a big pile of pebbles near the river. They decided to make a game with them. They each took some pebbles and threw them into the water, trying to make the biggest splash.

"Look, I found a shiny pebble!" Lila said, holding up a smooth, black stone. "It looks like a star!"

"Let me see!" Tom said, reaching for the pebble. "Maybe it has magic!"

Lila did not want to share. She hid the pebble in her pocket and ran away. Tom was angry and chased her. They ran and ran, until they came to a dark forest.

"Stop, Lila!" Tom shouted. "Give me the pebble!"

"No, it's mine!" Lila shouted back. "Go away!"

They did not see the big bear that was sleeping behind a tree. The bear heard their noise and woke up. He was hungry and angry. He saw the two children and roared.

Lila and Tom were scared. They tried to run away, but the bear was faster. He caught them and ate them. The pebble fell out of Lila's pocket and rolled into the river. It was gone.

The moral of the story is: Do not be greedy and selfish. Share with your brother or sister. And do not disturb a sleeping bear.

Once upon a time, there was a fireman named Jack. Jack was always very hungry because he worked hard to put out fires. One day, Jack was eating his lunch when a little boy came up to him and asked, "Can I add some ketchup to your sandwich?"

Jack said, "Sure, that would be great!" The little boy added ketchup to Jack's sandwich and they started talking. The little boy said, "I want to be a fireman like you when I grow up."

Jack smiled and said, "That's great! We need more firemen to help keep people safe."

Later that day, Jack got a call that there was a big fire at a nearby building. He rushed over to help, but unfortunately, he didn't make it out. The little boy was sad when he heard the news, but he knew that Jack was a hero who had helped many people.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went to the park. She wore a pretty dress and a pink belt around her waist. She saw a boy playing with a ball and went to talk to him. 

"Hi, my name is Lily. What's your name?" she asked the boy.

"My name is Max. Do you want to play with me?" Max replied.

Lily nodded and they started playing together. They had so much fun that they both laughed and ran around lively. After a while, Lily's mom called her to go home. 

"I had so much fun playing with you, Max. Let's play again tomorrow!" Lily said.

"Sure, I'll see you tomorrow!" Max replied.

Lily went home happy and told her mom all about her new friend Max.

Once upon a time, there was a helpful bug. He lived in a big garden and he loved to sing songs. Every day, he would sing the same song - even when it was raining.

The bug wanted to help the other creatures in the garden so he came up with a plan. He decided to remain in the same spot so others could find him. He sang his song really loudly, so that everybody could hear him. 

One day, a baby bird in the garden heard the bugâ€™s song and became very happy, because she remembered that song. She called all her friends and they flew towards the bug because they wanted to meet him. 

The bug was so helpful and was really happy that his song was useful and he made many new friends. The bug, the baby bird and all their friends had so much fun together and sang the same song all day long!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lizzy. She was three years old and very excited for a big adventure. She had never been on a train before, so today was a very special day. When she arrived at the station, she gasped in amazement at how big it was. She waved goodbye to her mom and dad as they watched her board the train.

The conductor gave her a friendly smile and asked her where she was going. She smiled back, full of excitement, and told him she was going on an adventure. He nodded with a smile and left.

Lizzy watched the countryside pass by through the windows. Everywhere she looked, she saw something that took her breath away; a fresh lake surrounded with tall trees, a meadow with wildflowers, a small pond with ducks swimming. It was all so amazing. 

After a while, she got tired and decided to take a nap. She snuggled up in her seat and soon enough, she was sleeping. But then, something happened. The train screeched and Lizzy woke up with a start. She looked around and saw that the train had stopped at a station. She sighed in disappointment, for she had missed going on her adventure. 

That day, Lizzy learned her lesson: Donâ€™t miss an adventure by taking too long of a nap.

Once upon a time, in a land of sand, there lived a little boy named Tim. Tim liked to play with his toy cars in the sand. He had many different cars, some were big and some were small. Tim's favorite car was a bright red one that went very fast.

One day, while Tim was playing, he saw a little girl named Sue. Sue had a pretty doll. Tim wanted to play with Sue and her doll, so he went to her and made a request. "Can I play with your doll, please?" he asked. Sue said yes, and they both played together in the sand.

As they played, Tim and Sue found out that they liked the same things. They liked to make sand castles, play with their toys, and run around. They became good friends and played together every day. Tim and Sue learned that even if they had different toys, they could still have lots of fun together.

Sara and Tom are playing with blocks. They want to make a big tower. Sara puts a block on top of another block. Tom puts a block next to Sara's block. They are happy.

But then, Ben comes. Ben is not nice. He likes to break things. He sees Sara and Tom's tower. He runs to it and pushes it. The blocks fall down. Sara and Tom are sad and angry.

"Ben, why did you do that?" Sara asks. "That was our tower. We worked hard to make it."

"I don't care. I like to break things. It's fun." Ben says. He laughs.

Sara and Tom don't like Ben. They want to make him stop. They look around. They see a big box. They have an idea.

They pick up the box and carry it to Ben. They put the box over Ben. Ben is under the box. He can't see or move. He is scared.

"Help! Let me out!" Ben cries.

Sara and Tom smile. They say, "Now you know how it feels to have your things broken. Maybe next time you will be nice and not break things."

They leave Ben under the box. They go back to their blocks. They start to make a new tower. They are grateful for their blocks and for each other. They are happy.

Once upon a time there lived a unique yacht. It was so special because it was filled with lots of fun toys. Every day it would leave the dock early in the morning and sail away in the sea. 

One day, a little girl who was three years old wanted to come and visit. The yacht was so excited and welcomed her with open arms. The girl was amazed by all the colourful toys, the bright sunshine and the wind in her hair. 

The little girl and the yacht had so much fun together. They played games and even jumped into the sea. After a few hours, it was time for the little girl to leave. The yacht was sad to say goodbye, but was excited to have made a new friend. 

The little girl left with a smile on her face. She had such a lovely time and promised to come back soon. Until then the unique yacht sailed out into the sea, happy at last.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to paint and draw. One day, she went to her school and saw a big blackboard. It was so big that she couldn't see the top of it. She asked her teacher, "Can I paint on the blackboard?"

The teacher said, "Of course, Lily! You can use this pink chalk to draw whatever you want." Lily was so happy and started to draw a big pink flower on the blackboard. Her friends saw her drawing and said, "Wow, Lily! Your flower is so pretty!"

Lily smiled and said, "Thank you! I love to paint and draw. Maybe one day, I can be an artist!"

Once upon a time there was a big dream. Every night the dream would provide a special adventure to a little girl. One night she dreamed of going to a special land filled with grand castles and big animals. 

The little girl was so excited and she couldn't wait to go exploring! She traveled through the enchanted forest filled with singing birds and friendly bunnies. Later she came across a big river with a rainbow bridge for her to cross. 

The girl was so happy to explore the new land and she soon found a grand castle made of colourful glass. She went inside and discovered that a friendly dragon had been living there all along. The dragon was happy to provide the girl with a wonderful gift - a beautiful sparkly wand! 

The little girl smiled and thanked the dragon. She then waved goodbye, hopped on the rainbow bridge and returned home. 

The little girl kept visiting the big dream night after night. The dream always provided her with new adventures, new friends and so much fun!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. He loved to play hockey. Tim was a calm boy. His friends liked to play with him.

One day, Tim's mom said, "We need to mail a letter." Tim wanted to help. He took the letter and went to the mailbox. On the way, he saw his friends playing hockey.

Tim forgot about the letter. He played hockey with his friends. They had lots of fun. But the letter was still in his hand.

At the end of the day, Tim went home. His mom asked, "Did you mail the letter?" Tim looked at his hand. The letter was dirty and torn. Tim felt sad. He did not mail the letter, and now it was too late.

One day, Jason went out to the park. It was dark outside. He saw a big, shiny thing. It was a hockey stick. He wanted to reach it, but it was too far away.

Jason asked his mom, "Mommy, can I have the hockey stick?"

His mom said, "Yes, but you have to reach it yourself. Can you do that?"

Jason smiled and said, "I can try!" He stretched his little arms as far as he could and just barely grabbed the stick. He was so proud of himself.

He ran home with the stick and said, "Mommy, I reached it!"

His mom said, "That's great, sweetie! Now you have your very own hockey stick!"

Jason hugged his stick and smiled. He couldn't wait to play with it.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful butterfly named Bella. She loved to fly around and play with her friends. One day, Bella saw a newspaper on the ground. She thought it was ugly and wanted it to vanish.

But then, Bella's mommy told her that it's not nice to call things ugly and want them to vanish. She said that everything has a purpose and beauty in its own way. Bella felt bad and realized her mistake.

From that day on, Bella learned to appreciate all things, even if they didn't seem beautiful at first. She learned that everyone and everything has value and should be treated with kindness. And she never wanted anything to vanish again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a big farm with lots of animals. The farmer had a dog named Max. Max was a very obedient dog who always listened to the farmer. One day, the farmer told Max to fill up a bucket with water from the well. Max ran to the well and filled up the bucket.

Suddenly, a tornado came and started spinning around the farm. The farmer and the animals were scared. Max barked and ran around the farm to protect everyone. He was very brave.

After the tornado passed, the farmer saw that Max had filled up all the animal's water troughs before the tornado came. The farmer was so happy and gave Max a big bone as a reward. From that day on, Max was known as the hero of the farm.

Ben and Mia were hungry. They wanted to eat steak for dinner. But Mom said no. She said steak was too big and too hard for them. She said they had to eat soup and bread.

Ben and Mia did not like soup and bread. They liked steak. They were angry at Mom. They said they did not want soup and bread. They said they wanted steak.

Mom was angry too. She said they had to eat what she made. She said they had to be good and say thank you. She said they had to stop being rude and noisy.

Ben and Mia did not stop. They kept saying they wanted steak. They kept making loud noises. They kept throwing their spoons and napkins.

Mom had enough. She said they had to go to their room. She said they had to shut their mouths. She said they had to stay there until they were sorry.

Ben and Mia did not want to go to their room. They did not want to shut their mouths. They did not want to say sorry. They thought Mom was mean and unfair. They thought steak was yummy and soup was bitter.

They went to their room. They slammed the door. They cried and yelled. They said they hated soup and bread. They said they loved steak. They said they wished they had steak.

Once upon a time, there was a small bunny. The bunny loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, the sky turned dark and it started to rain. The bunny got scared and ran to find cover under a big tree. 

As the bunny waited for the rain to stop, it saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky. The bunny felt happy and wanted to play in the rainbow. But the rain kept falling and the bunny was sad. 

Suddenly, the bunny saw a small bird who was also stuck in the rain. The bunny felt sorry for the bird and invited it to share the cover under the tree. The bird was happy and they both watched the rainbow together until the rain stopped. From then on, the bunny and the bird became good friends and played together in the sunshine and rainbows.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who wanted to go outside and have some fun. He asked his mum if he could go out but she said no, because it was raining. He was so sorry that he couldn't go out and play, so he stayed inside and played instead.

Afterwards, he heard the rain slowing down, so he got very excited and asked his mum if he could go out and play now. His mum said yes, so he quickly put on his coat and boots and ran outside.

The bunny was so happy that he could go out and play, he laughed and jumped around in the rain. He ran around until he got so wet that he was almost swimming, then he ran back inside. His mum smiled as he came in, and said "Time for a nice warm bath!"

John had been outside playing all day. Suddenly, he heard a noise. He looked around and saw a brown powder twist around in the air. It made John so excited, he wanted to touch it. He slowly stretched out his hand and twisted the powder, then he saw something sparkle. He twisted more powder, and more sparkles appeared! He was so happy and he laughed as he continued to twist the powder. After some time, the powder was gone and the sparkles had disappeared. But John had lots of fun and he knew he would never forget the experience.

One cold day, Little Tim went outside to play. He saw a horse close by, and it seemed very friendly. He went up to the horse and said,"Hello, horse! I like your mane."

The horse smiled, then said, "Thank you! Can I have a hug?"

Little Tim was so happy that the horse wanted to be his friend. He wrapped his arms around it and gave it a big hug.

The horse said, "Let's go for a ride!" That sounded like so much fun to Little Tim.

The horse started running. At first Little Tim was scared, but he soon got used to it and even started to laugh with glee.

When the ride was over, Little Tim said goodbye to the horse. He hugged it one last time before he closed the gate to his backyard. Little Tim had had a wonderful time and looked forward to the next time he would be able to play with the horse.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. His name was Jack. He was very sad and miserable. 

One day, Jack heard a talking coming from outside. He went to the exit to see who it was. When he arrived, he saw two people - a prince and a princess. They were talking about marriage. 

Jack asked them, "What's marry?"

The prince answered, "Marriage is when two people love each other so much, they want to be together forever. They promise to always believe and trust in each other and make each other happy."

The princess held the prince's hand and said, "I am marrying you so that I'll never be miserable again."

Jack smiled. He realized that he could be happy too and he ran away, feeling much less miserable.

Once upon a time, there lived an impressive little girl. She was only three-years-old, but she was very brave and clever. Every day she would explore the world around her. 

One day, she came across something extra special. It was a big iron box with lots of exciting goodies inside. Much to her surprise, the box included sweets, toys, and books. She was so fascinated by everything inside the box.

The little girl opened the box and took out each item. She was so excited to learn about each new thing, and found it all very impressive. She played for hours, learning about each new discovery. 

At the end of the day she put everything back in the box, and tucked it away carefully. Every day she kept returning to explore the box and she kept learning new and exciting things. It was an adventure like no other!

Sara likes to wear her yellow dress. It has flowers on it and a big bow. She thinks it is pretty and sunny. She likes to play in the garden with her dress.

One day, she sees a bee on a flower. The bee is busy and noisy. Sara is curious and wants to say hello. She goes near the flower and smiles at the bee.

But the bee does not like Sara. The bee thinks Sara is too close and wants to take the flower. The bee is angry and scared. The bee stings Sara on her arm. Sara cries out loud. It hurts a lot.

Mama hears Sara and runs to her. She sees the bee and the sting. She hugs Sara and takes her inside. She puts some ice on her arm and gives her a kiss. She tells Sara that the bee was not helpful. The bee was mean and rude.

Sara feels better and learns a lesson. She still likes her yellow dress and the flowers. But she does not go near the bees anymore. She knows they are not her friends. She plays with her toys and her cat instead. They are helpful and nice.

Anna and Ben like to play in the snow. They make a big snowman with a hat and a scarf. They give him a carrot nose and two coal eyes. They are very happy.

"Look at our snowman!" Anna says. "He is so big and nice!"

"Yes, he is!" Ben says. "Let's take a picture of him. We can show it to Mom and Dad."

They run inside the house and get a camera. They come back and stand next to the snowman. They smile and say "Cheese!"

But then, a big dog comes. He sees the snowman and thinks it is a toy. He runs to the snowman and jumps on him. He bites the hat and the scarf. He pulls the carrot nose and the coal eyes. He makes the snowman fall down.

Anna and Ben are very sad. They cry and scream.

"Go away, bad dog!" Anna says. "You broke our snowman!"

"Leave us alone, bad dog!" Ben says. "You ruined our picture!"

But the dog does not listen. He is having fun. He covers the camera with snow. He scratches the image. He makes it icy and blurry.

Anna and Ben cannot see their snowman anymore. They cannot see their picture anymore. They have nothing to show to Mom and Dad. They have a bad day.

Once there was a small seed. It started growing but it was lonely and wanted to find a home. It looked around but everything seemed so big and hard. After a while the seed found a little sink. The sink was soft and warm and the seed decided to stay.

The seed began to grow and it was so happy! Every day, it grew bigger and bigger. Soon it was too big for the sink. It needed to move to a new home.

So the seed looked and looked. Finally, it found a place. It was a hard spot, but it was perfect. The seed started to grow again. Before long, it was a big and beautiful plant. The plant was so happy to have a new home. It waved in the wind and smiled in the sun.

The seed had grown so much since it was first planted. And it was so happy to have a place all its own.

The mommy put the zebra in the box. She gave it a kiss and made the zebra feel all happy. The zebra was so quiet, it slept in the box. The mommy was so happy, she put the box in the car and drove away. When she arrived at the park, she put the box gently on the ground.

When she opened the box, the zebra woke up and ran around the park. It was so excited and it ran around and around. It ran so fast, it was a blur.

The mommy laughed and said, â€œthat zebra sure is fast.â€ But when it saw a tree, it stopped and got very quiet. It saw a bunch of leaves on the tree and began to nibble them. The mommy laughed again and said, â€œI think it likes the leaves.â€

The mommy watched the zebra eat the leaves for a while and then put it back in the box. She gave it another kiss and drove it home. Then she put it back in the box and gave it one more kiss goodnight. The zebra went quietly back to sleep.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play at the beach. She would build sandcastles and collect seashells. One day, she saw a seagull on the shore. It looked uncomfortable with a plastic bag stuck on its foot. Lily wanted to help the seagull, so she tried to catch it. 

Suddenly, the wind started to spin the seagull around. Lily was worried but she didn't give up. She chased the seagull until it fell down on the sand. She carefully removed the plastic bag from its foot and set the seagull free. The seagull flew away, and Lily felt happy that she helped it. From that day on, Lily made sure to pick up any trash she saw on the shore to keep the beach clean for all the animals that lived there.

Once upon a time, there was a big farm with lots of animals. The farmer who lived on the farm had a naughty horse who liked to run away. One day, the horse ran so far away that it got hurt. The farmer had to repair the horse's leg with a bandage.

The next day, the farmer went to check on his ranch and saw that the fence was broken. Oh no! The animals could run away! The farmer quickly got his tools and started to repair the fence.

Finally, everything was fixed and the animals were safe. The horse was happy to be back in its stable and the farmer was happy that he could keep all his animals on his ranch. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a bright girl named Sally. She liked to talk to her friends and play games. One day, she wanted to play baseball. She asked her friends if they wanted to join her.

Her friends said yes and they all had lots of fun. Sally hit the ball so hard that it flew over the fence. Everyone cheered for her.

At the end of the game, Sally looked at the score. She had the highest score! She was so proud and she showed her friends her bright smile.

Sally talked about her amazing score all the way home. She knew she would win the next game too.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. Jane woke up one day and she was very dry. She wanted to stir something up to make it a bit more interesting. So she thought of an idea! She went to tell the news to her mom.

When she found her mom she said, "Mom, I have news!" Her mom said, "What is it, Jane?" Jane said, "I want to stir something up and make it more fun!" 

Her mom said, "What do you want to stir?" Jane said, "Let's make some cake! We can stir the flour and eggs and make something yummy!" 

Her mom smiled and said, "That sounds like a great idea, Jane!" They both went to the kitchen and stirred all of the dry ingredients until they had a big, delicious cake ready. 

The end.

One day, a little boy named Tim wanted to walk to his room. But his big sister, Sally, was in the room playing with her toys. Tim felt sad because he wanted to play in the room too.

Tim said to Sally, "Please let me walk into the room and play with you." But Sally said, "No, this is my room. You can't play here." Tim was very persistent. He did not give up. He kept asking Sally if he could play in the room.

Finally, Sally said, "Okay, you can walk into the room and play with me." Tim was happy. He walked into the room and played with Sally. They had a lot of fun together. The conflict was over, and they both learned to share their room.

Once upon a time there was a small rabbit. The rabbit was all alone, so he decided to make some friends. He found some tape and started to print little shapes on it. He made circle, triangles and stars. 

Just then, the rabbit noticed a mouse hiding in the corner. The rabbit said, "Hello! Do you want to be my friend?". The mouse was scared and said nothing. The rabbit asked again, "Please, can you be my friend?". 

The mouse began to smile and agreed. The rabbit was very happy and gave the mouse a present. He had printed a small heart on the tape. The mouse looked at it and thanked the rabbit. 

The two new friends played together every day. And they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time on a bright sunny day, two little pigs were racing in the meadow.

"Come on! You can do it!" said the smaller pig.

The larger pig smiled and said "I'm so fast, I'm gonna win!"

The small pig laughed and said "No way! I'm flexible and I'm gonna beat you!"

So the two pigs raced and ran faster than ever. They raced around the meadow, over the hill, and through the river.

At last the smaller pig crossed the finish line and won!

The big pig was very proud and said "That was an awesome race! You're so flexible!"

The small pig smiled and said "Thanks! I had a lot of fun!"

There were two friends, Alex and Anna. They were playing at the park and Alex saw a gem on top of the slide. He knew he wanted it, but could not reach it.

Alex told Anna about the gem, and wanted Anna to help him get it. But Anna said no, because it was too high up and she could not reach it either.

Alex was sad and wanted the gem, so he thought of a plan. He asked Anna if she would help him slide up the slide to reach the gem. Anna agreed and helped him climb up.

Alex was so excited and reached for the gem. He was just about to grab it when Anna told him that it was not a good idea as it was too high up and there was no way he could grab it without falling.

Alex was disappointed, but realized that while the gem was not available to him, he had a great friend who was always willing to help him. They both smiled, and returned to their game.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Bob and Amy. They were both playing around in an elevator. They were very excited and kept pushing all the buttons. 

Suddenly, the elevator started to move very fast! Amy and Bob were scared, but then Bob said, "Let's try to catch the buttons!"

They both tried to catch the buttons, but the elevator was going too fast. Amy said, "It's too hard to catch the buttons. What should we do?" Bob said, "Let's just make this elevator go the other way!"

So, Amy and Bob worked together and quickly grabbed the buttons. The elevator stopped and they were so happy. They ran out and started playing again. 

"That was a fast ride!" said Bob. Amy said, "Yes, but don't do it again without a grown-up, ok?" Bob said, "Yes, ok." And they laughed together until the sun went down.

Once upon a time, there lived a rare, little kitten. One day, the kitten heard a noise coming from behind a locked door. The kitten didnâ€™t know what was behind the door, but the noise made it want to go inside.

The kitten wanted to open the door, but the door was too heavy! So the kitten decided to ask for help.

The kitten was lucky because it found a nice lady who was strong and could open the door. The lady opened the door and the kitten ran inside.

To the kittenâ€™s surprise, there was a small toy box inside the room! The kitten opened the box and found lots of fun things inside. It was a great day for the rare, little kitten!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to read books, but she didn't have a bookcase to keep them in. One day, her parents surprised her with a big purple bookcase! Lily was so happy and excited. She quickly filled it with all her favorite books.

As she read more books, Lily gained more knowledge and imagination. She loved looking at the pictures and reading the words. Every night before bed, she would pick out a book from her bookcase and read it with her parents. They would ask her questions about the story and she would tell them what she learned.

Lily's bookcase became her favorite thing in her room. She loved how it looked and how it kept her books organized. She even showed it off to her friends when they came over to play. Lily was grateful for her bookcase and all the knowledge she gained from her books.

Once upon a time, there was a big elephant named Ellie. Ellie loved to eat healthy food like bananas and carrots. One day, she went on a long journey through the hot desert.

As she walked, Ellie grew very thirsty. She looked around and saw a beautiful oasis with lots of water. She ran over to the oasis and drank lots of water. It was so refreshing!

After drinking, Ellie felt much better and continued on her journey. She walked for a long time until she found a tree with strong branches. She used her trunk to hang from the branches and rest for a while.

Finally, Ellie arrived at her destination and was very happy. She had a great adventure and learned that staying healthy and finding an oasis can make a big difference!

Once upon a time there was a noisy rain. It was so noisy that everyone in the town believed it would never stop. 

One day, a young boy named Tim wanted to see what all the noise was about. He put on his raincoat and hat and stepped outside. 

Tim looked up at the sky and saw the rain falling down. He smiled and said, "It's fun!" 

As he danced in the rain, he heard someone say, "You don't really believe the rain won't stop, do you?" 

Tim turned around and saw his grandpa standing next to him. He shook his head and said, "No, I know the rain will stop soon." 

Grandpa smiled and said, "I'm glad you believe that." Then he put his arm around Tim and said, "But for now, let's just enjoy the noisy rain!"

Once upon a time, there was a wet dog and a dry cat. The cat was looking around the room and it noticed the dog had something behind its back. The cat asked the dog, "What do you hide?"

The dog said, "Nothing!" with a serious face. The cat laughed and said, "Why not hide it? We can play a game!"

So the cat and dog set up a game. The cat hid some treats and the dog had to find them. The cat went behind the couch and the dog started sniffing around. The cat called out "Ready, ready, come and find me!". But the dog needed help and asked, "Where, where?"

The cat laughed and said, "I'm behind the couch, come and find me!"

The dog followed the cat's voice and finally found the treats. The wet dog was so happy that it wagged its tail, and the cat was happy too. They played the hide-and-seek game many times and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a delicate teacup that she loved to drink her tea from. One day, she accidentally dropped the teacup on the table and it broke into many pieces. Lily was very sad and started to cry.

Her mom asked her, "Why are you crying, Lily?"

"Don't worry, we can fix it," said her mom.

"But how? It's in so many pieces," said Lily.

So, they carefully gathered all the broken pieces of the teacup and weighed them. Then, they used glue to put the teacup back together. Lily was so happy to have her teacup back on the table again.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She lived in a big city with her mom and dad.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved going to the zoo with his mommy and daddy. One day, they saw a big tiger. The tiger was very lively and ran around in its cage. Timmy was scared at first, but then he saw how beautiful the tiger was.

Lily was a wealthy girl who had many toys. She liked to play with her dolls, her blocks, and her cars. But she was not happy. She wanted more toys than anyone else.

Lily did not care. She grabbed the bike and ran away. She thought she would be happy with the bike. But she was not. The bike was hard to ride, and it made a lot of noise. She did not like the wheel or the stick. She threw the bike in a corner and forgot about it.

The next day, she saw the boy again in the park. He was playing with a ball and a stick. He was smiling and having fun. Lily felt sorry for what she did. She realized that she was greedy and mean. She ran to the boy and said, "I am sorry. I was wrong. Here is your bike. You can have it back."

Lily nodded and smiled. She played with the boy and had fun. She learned that having many toys does not make you happy. Sharing and being nice does. She also learned that a wheel and a stick can be a special bike, if you have a good imagination.

One day, a cat named Tom found a ball of yarn. The yarn was red and soft. Tom loved to play with yarn. He would roll it, toss it, and chase it around the house. Tom was very happy with his new toy.

Tom's friend, a bird named Sue, saw him playing with the yarn. Sue wanted to play too. She flew down and asked Tom, "Can I play with you?" Tom said, "Yes, you can play with me and my yarn."

They played with the yarn all day. They were very tired, but they had a lot of fun. As the sun went down, Tom and Sue stopped playing. They looked at the yarn. It was not red and soft anymore. It was dead and sad. Tom said, "We can find new yarn tomorrow." Sue agreed, and they went to sleep, dreaming of more fun days with new yarn.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play soccer with her friends in the park. One day, Lily and her friends decided to make a goal out of sticks and stones.

As they were playing, the wind started to blow and it became very cold. Lily shivered and said, "I'm cold. Can we stop playing and go home?"

Her friend, Timmy, replied, "No, we have to keep playing until we score a goal."

So, Lily and her friends continued to play and march around the field. Finally, Lily kicked the ball and it went straight into the goal they had made. Everyone cheered and Lily felt very happy. They all went home with big smiles on their faces, feeling warm and proud of themselves.

Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Benny. Benny loved to play outside in the garden. One day, Benny saw a big slide in the garden. He climbed up the ladder and slid down the slide. Wheeee!

Benny was hungry, so he looked for something to eat. He found a big, red radish. It was so yummy! Benny ate the whole radish.

After eating, Benny felt sleepy. He went to his regular spot under a bush and took a nap. When he woke up, it was time for dinner. Benny went back to the garden to look for more radishes. The end.

Grandpa was heading up the attic stairs as he heard a little voice calling for him. He smiled when he saw his grandson, Alex, enthusiastically waiting for him. 

â€œCome on, Grandpa! Letâ€™s go to the attic!â€

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside with her toys. One day, she saw a big van driving down the street. The van was very colorful and had pictures of animals on it. 

"Wow, that van is so cool!" exclaimed Lily. 

Just then, her mom came outside and said, "Lily, it's time to come inside. You look tired." 

Lily replied, "I'm not tired, Mommy. I just yawned because I saw the van." 

Her mom smiled and said, "Well, maybe it's time for a nap. You'll feel more useful and have more energy to play later." 

Lily agreed and went inside to take a nap. When she woke up, she felt refreshed and ready to play with her toys again. She remembered the colorful van and couldn't wait to see it again.

Once upon a time, there was a little kitten named Mittens. Mittens was very cute and adorable, with soft fur and big green eyes. One day, Mittens saw a pen with ink in it on the table. Mittens wanted to play with the pen, so he picked it up in his mouth and carried it away.

Mittens started to perform some tricks with the pen. He tried to write his name, but all that came out was a big blob of ink. Mittens didn't mind, though. He was having fun playing with the ink and the pen.

Suddenly, Mittens heard his owner coming. He quickly hid the pen under the couch and pretended to be sleeping. Mittens' owner saw him and thought he looked adorable. Mittens was happy that he didn't get in trouble for playing with the ink. From then on, Mittens knew he had to be careful when playing with things that weren't his.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Molly. Molly was a very happy little girl, always smiling and playing with her friends.

One day, Molly went to the park with her mom. Molly saw a big grey swan in the pond. She thought it was so beautiful, so she went up to it to give it a kiss. The swan had such a soft and puffy feathery weight. Molly loved it! 

Suddenly, an ugly old wizard appeared out of nowhere! He was really mad that Molly kissed the swan and he began waving his hands around, yelling and pointing angrily at Molly and her mom. Molly began to cry. 

But then something wonderful happened. The swan began to shine with a magical light and wrapped itself around Molly and her mom, making them feel very safe. Then, it flew away, taking the wizard with it.

Molly and her mom hugged each other tight and Molly smiled again. Molly knew that the swan had used its magical powers to save them. She learned that day to always be kind and loving.

Jack was very angry. He had been playing outside for hours and he was hot and thirsty. He couldn't find any juice, so he asked his Daddy for help. 

Daddy thought for a minute and then he recommended a cooler. He said it was a good way to keep drinks cold on hot days. Jack was very excited and he ran to the cooler. He reached inside and found a yummy cold drink. 

Jack took a big sip and smiled. It was the best cold drink he had ever had. He thanked his Daddy and then he ran outside to play some more. Daddy smiled and was glad that he had been able to recommend something that had made Jack so happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her backyard. One day, she saw a butterfly and she started to chase it. She ran and ran until she reached a big garden full of colorful flowers and herbs. She stopped to gaze at the beautiful flowers and smelled the sweet herbs.

Suddenly, she saw a snake hiding in the grass. The snake was very dangerous and Lily knew she had to be careful. She slowly backed away and ran back to her house to tell her mom. Her mom was proud of Lily for being brave and telling her about the dangerous snake. From that day on, Lily always remembered to be careful when she played outside.

One day, a little boy was walking through the hall. He noticed something strange; a funny object was attached to the wall. He had never seen it before; it was very unknown! He moved closer to examine it with curiosity. He saw that it had funny round shapes and lots of buttons. He felt the buttons, they were so shiny and smooth. He grabbed it and tried to attach it to the wall! After a few tries, he managed to attach it and he was so proud of himself. He ran back to the hall to show his mom what he had found. She was so amazed and she said, "You clever boy, you attached it all by yourself!"

Once upon a time, there were two magical creatures - a bear and an elephant. The bear was strong and the elephant was gentle. They were best friends and were always together.

One day, the two friends were walking through the forest and holding hands. Suddenly, the bear smelled something sweet. He looked around and saw a big, green lime! He was so excited! 

The bear and the elephant wanted to eat the yummy lime. But first, they wanted to play a game! The bear said, "Let's have a contest to see who's more powerful!" The elephant was so happy, she nodded her big head.

The bear and the elephant took turns trying to crush the lime in their hands. Neither could do it - the lime was so strong! After trying really hard, the bear and the elephant were both tired and ready for a nap. 

So, they both curled up under the tree and fell fast asleep. As the bear and the elephant snored gently, the lime rolled away into the forest. The end.

Once upon a time there was a brave knight called Jack. All day long he played in the woods and dreamed of rescuing the princess from the dragon's lair.

One evening, Jack asked his mum if he could be a knight for real. "Yes," said his mum, "go and be brave, be obedient and rescue someone who needs help."

So Jack put on his knight's armour and set off on his quest. He marched through the woods until he saw a baby rabbit stuck in a bush, too scared to move.

Jack said "Come here, little rabbit. I will rescue you." The rabbit hopped into his arms. Jack smiled proudly and carried the rabbit back home.

When he got home, his mum was waiting for him. She said "Well done, brave knight! You have been very obedient."

Jack smiled and replied "I rescued the princess, like you asked Mum."

Mum laughed and hugged him tight. "Yes, Jack, you did!", she said.

Lila and Ben were twins who liked to play with fire. They had a box of matches that they stole from their dad, who was a wealthy man. He had a big house, a big car, and a big safe where he kept his money and jewels. Lila and Ben wanted to see what was inside the safe, but they did not know the code.

One day, when their dad was out, they decided to try to open the safe with fire. They thought that if they rubbed the matches on the safe, it would get hot and melt. They took the box of matches and went to the safe, which was in their dad's office. They did not see the sign that said "Danger: Flammable".

Lila and Ben rubbed the matches on the safe, but nothing happened. They rubbed harder and faster, until one of the matches lit up. They were excited and scared. They dropped the match on the floor, where it met a pile of papers. The papers caught fire and soon the whole office was in flames.

"Help! Help!" Lila and Ben screamed. They ran out of the office and into the hall, where they saw their dad coming home. He smelled the smoke and saw the fire. He was angry and frightened. He grabbed Lila and Ben and took them outside, where he called the firemen.

The firemen came and put out the fire, but it was too late. The office was burned and the safe was ruined. Lila and Ben's dad lost his money and jewels. He was very sad and very mad. He looked at Lila and Ben and said, "What have you done? You have been very naughty and very foolish. You could have died and you have destroyed everything. You are in big trouble, young ones. You will never play with fire again." Lila and Ben cried and said they were sorry, but they knew they had made a big mistake. They learned their lesson the hard way.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to explore. One day, she was running around the garden when she saw something pink and sparkly. She immediately got curious, went closer and picked it up. To her surprise, it was a pill! 

The little girl wanted to keep it and show it to her mom. But when she got back to her house, her mom got really mad. She told the girl not to touch pills as it can be very dangerous. 

The little girl got sad and put the pink pill away. She learned that she needs to be careful when exploring so she won't be surprised like this again.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Billy. Billy loved to fly and play with his friends in the big blue sky. One day, while they were playing, they saw a fire in the forest. The fire was very hot and it started to burn the trees. Billy and his friends were sad to see the trees burn.

As the fire went away, Billy saw that the trees had turned into ash. The forest was not pretty anymore. It was all gray and black. Billy felt ashamed that he did not help to stop the fire. He wanted to make the forest pretty again.

Billy and his friends decided to help the forest grow back. They picked up seeds from other trees and dropped them in the ash. Soon, new trees started to grow. The forest was pretty again. Billy was happy that he helped and was not ashamed anymore.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Tim and Sue. They both wanted to go on an adventure. So, they decided to march together!

It was a sunny day and the sky was bright blue. Tim and Sue put on their shoes and marched through the forest. They passed tall trees and listened to the birds chirping.

Suddenly, the sun started to get bigger and brighter. Tim and Sue looked up and saw a big yellow and orange ball above them. They had never seen anything so bright and big before!

When they kept walking, they passed a bright blue pond and a big yellow flower. They felt excited and kept marching.

Finally, they reached the end of the forest and felt very proud of themselves. They had gone on a big adventure and seen some amazing things. They smiled and laughed at each other before marching home.

Tom and Ben are friends. They like to play with a ball in the park. One day, they see a man with a big cut on his head. He is bald and angry.

"Who did this to you?" Tom asks the man.

"A bad boy kicked me with his shoe. He ran away with my hat. He was mean and rude," the man says.

Tom and Ben feel sorry for the man. They want to help him.

"We have a ball. Do you want to play with us?" Ben asks the man.

The man smiles. He likes the ball. He nods and says, "Yes, thank you. That is very kind of you."

Tom and Ben give the ball to the man. They take turns to kick it and catch it. They have fun and laugh. The man forgets his cut and his hat. He is happy and friendly. He makes new friends.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Emily. Emily had a heavy shirt. She loved to play with it. Every day her mum would encourage her to put on her shirt. Emily was very happy to have it on because it made her look special and beautiful.

Emily and the little bird became best friends. From that day on, Emily would always encourage the little bird whenever it was scared. Emily was very happy to have a special friend and have her heavy shirt to play in.

Once upon a time, there was a grandma who loved to sew. She saw a special fabric and decided to make a dress. She wanted the dress to be unique, so she used thread to match the colors. Grandma was so excited to make the dress! 

However, when she tried the new dress on, she felt very uncomfortable. The colors did not match exactly as she wanted them and it made her look awkward. She wanted to make it better, but didnâ€™t know how. 

Suddenly, her granddaugther Lily came into the room. Lily saw the dress and said, â€œGrandma, why donâ€™t you mix some colors together? That way, the thread may match better.â€ Grandma smiled and thanked Lily for the advice. 

Using Lilyâ€™s advice, Grandma mixed some colors together and the dress became more interesting. Grandma was now comfortable wearing the dress.

The moral of the story is that it is good to listen to the advice that others give us. Sometimes, even the smallest advice can make things better.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to cook with her mom in the kitchen. One day, they decided to make some yummy soup. Lily helped her mom chop up the vegetables and put them in the pot. Then, her mom let her stir the soup with a big spoon.

While they were waiting for the soup to cook, Lily's mom showed her some pictures on her phone. Lily loved looking at the images of cute animals and pretty flowers. When the soup was ready, they poured it into bowls and sat down to eat. Lily's mom was happy to see that Lily had made a tidy mess in the kitchen.

Once upon a time there was a shy boy who was walking in the forest. He saw a bottle and he wanted to pick it up, but he was too scared. Just then, he heard a voice. It said "Stop!" The boy was so startled that he didn't move. 

He looked around and he saw a lion. The lion looked at him and said "I saw you try to pick up that bottle. I don't want you to get hurt so I wanted to stop you." The boy was so surprised that he didn't know what to say.

The lion smiled and said "It's ok, don't be shy. I just wanted to help you stay safe." The boy smiled back and thanked the lion. He was so happy that the lion was nice to him despite him being shy. Together, they walked back to the boy's home.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved lollipops and always wanted to eat them. One day, her mommy gave her a lollipop and said, "Lily, you can have this yummy lollipop, but you have to climb the stairs and go to your room to eat it."

Lily was so excited to eat her lollipop that she quickly climbed the stairs. But when she got to her room, she saw her little brother crying. He had fallen down and hurt his knee. Lily knew that she had to help her brother first, so she gave him the lollipop to make him feel better.

Her mommy saw what happened and said, "Lily, you did the right thing. It's always important to help others before we think about ourselves." Lily smiled and felt happy that she could make her brother feel better. From that day on, Lily learned that being kind and helpful to others is more important than having a yummy lollipop.

Once upon a time, there was a tall giraffe named Jerry. He liked to eat leaves from the trees. Yesterday, Jerry was very hungry and went to a tree to eat some leaves. But there was another giraffe there, and he wanted to eat the leaves too. They both tried to eat from the same tree, but there was not enough food for both of them. 

Jerry and the other giraffe started to argue and push each other. They didn't know what to do. Then, Jerry had an idea. He said, "Let's use our long necks to reach the leaves from different trees!" The other giraffe agreed and they both went to different trees. They were both happy and full. They learned that sometimes it's better to use their strengths to solve problems instead of fighting.

Once upon a time, there was a small mouse. He lived in a big house with lots of food. He saw some sugar on the side of the kitchen and he wanted to eat it! It was so sweet and looked so good. He started to eat it and it was the best thing he had ever tasted.

But then he started to feel very thirsty. He had finished all the sugar and he needed something to drink. He remembered he had seen a tap in the backyard and he ran to it. He put his hands in the tap and he splashed cool water all over himself. 

It felt so nice and refreshing. But soon the water dried up and he was all alone again. He wanted something else to drink but there was nothing! He wondered what he could do to find something to drink. He walked around the little garden and then he spotted something small. It was a small cup with a little bit of sugar in it!

He quickly ate the sugar and it tasted just as sweet as before. Now he was feeling full again, but he was still thirsty. He remembered the tap outside and he ran to it. He put his hands in the tap and he splashed cool water all over himself. And this time he didn't stop till he was all dry again!

Once upon a time, there was a big lion. He was very strong and could roar very loud. One day, he went for a walk and found a track in the forest. He followed the track and found a little rabbit who was lost.

"Hello little rabbit, are you lost?" asked the lion.

"Yes, I am lost. Can you help me find my way back home?" replied the rabbit.

"Of course, I can. I am very strong and independent. I can help you," said the lion.

So, the lion picked up the rabbit and carried him on his back. They walked through the forest and the lion roared to scare away any dangerous animals. Finally, they found the rabbit's home and the rabbit was very happy.

"Thank you, Mr. Lion. You are very kind and strong," said the rabbit.

"You are welcome, little rabbit. I am always happy to help," replied the lion.

And from that day on, the lion and the rabbit were good friends and went on many adventures together.

There was a little girl named Sadie who liked to lift cubes. Sadie liked to lift all kinds of cubes - big ones, small ones, red ones and blue ones. One day, she found a special cube. It was small and easy to lift. 

Sadie carefully lifted the cube and discovered something inside. It was a toy train! Sadie was so excited. She lifted the cube over and over again to play with the toy train. 

Sadie played with the cube and the train all morning. But eventually, she had to stop to go to lunch. She carefully lifted the cube and put the train back inside, then put the cube back where she had found it.

The next day, Sadie went back to find the cube. She found it again, and with an easy lift, discovered that it held another surprise - a stuffed bear! Sadie smiled as she lifted the cube, ready to start playing with her new toy.

Once upon a time there was a happy girl. Her name was Sarah. She loved to play with her friends in the park.

One day they all saw something sparkly and shiny in the sky. It was a silver balloon.

"Look!" called Sarah. "Let's rise up and follow it!"

So they all ran and chased the silver balloon. But try as they might, they couldn't catch it.

"I have an idea," said Sarah. "Let's get a ladder and rise up that way."

Her friends were excited. They got their ladder and rose up toward the silver balloon.

The ladder was just the right length, and Sarah's friends cheered as she reached out and grabbed the silver balloon.

"We did it!" shouted Sarah. They all felt very successful. 

The silver balloon flew away, and Sarah and her friends went back to the park. They talked about their adventure for many days, and Sarah was always happy she rose up and caught the silver balloon.

Dave was in a gloomy mood. He looked around his kitchen and saw the freezer. It was old and dull. He knew that he had to do something to make it look new again. 

Dave went to the store and collected all the things he needed: a cloth to wipe the freezer, some polish and a big smile. He was now ready to get to work.

Dave spread the polish over the freezer and wiped it with the cloth. He rubbed and polished until the freezer was shiny and bright.

Once his hard work was done, Dave stepped back and admired his freezer. He was pleased with his work and grinned from ear to ear. He sighed with contentment. 

The gloomy freezer was now gleaming and looking brand new. Dave had done a fantastic job!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to bake cakes with her mommy. One day, they were making a cake and they needed to measure the ingredients. Mommy got out the scale and put it on the table. Lily watched as mommy put the flour on the scale and measured it. 

After they finished baking, mommy asked Lily to shut the oven door. Lily was happy to help and she shut the door tightly. When the cake was done, they took it out of the oven and it smelled so sweet! They let it cool down and then they ate it together. It was the best cake they had ever made!

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play and eat together. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big truck with a picture of a waffle on it. They want to try a waffle.

"Mom, can we have a waffle, please?" Tom asks.

"Me too, me too!" Anna says.

Their moms smile and nod. They walk to the truck and wait in line. The man in the truck is very busy. He makes many waffles for many people. He is humble and kind. He says hello and thank you to everyone.

When it is Tom and Anna's turn, he asks them, "What kind of waffle do you want? I have chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla."

Tom and Anna look at each other. They do not know what to answer. They like all the kinds of waffles. They think hard.

"Um, can we have one of each?" Tom says.

"Yeah, one of each!" Anna says.

The man in the truck laughs. He says, "Sure, why not? You are very brave and curious. Here you go, one chocolate, one strawberry, and one vanilla waffle. Enjoy!"

Tom and Anna are very happy. They say thank you to the man and take their waffles. They sit on a bench and share their waffles. They taste each kind and say which one they like best.

"I like chocolate best. It is sweet and yummy," Tom says.

"I like strawberry best. It is pink and fruity," Anna says.

"I like vanilla best. It is white and creamy," the man in the truck says. He comes to the bench and sits with them. He has a waffle too.

Tom and Anna are surprised. They did not see him come. They smile and offer him some of their waffles.

"Thank you, that is very nice of you. But I have my own waffle. I like to eat one every day. It makes me happy," the man says.

Tom and Anna nod. They understand. They like to eat waffles too. They make them happy. They finish their waffles and lick their fingers. They say goodbye to the man and thank him again. They hug their moms and go home. They had a fun and tasty day. They are good friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to take pictures with his camera. One day, Timmy went to the park to take some pictures of the flowers and the trees. 

While he was taking pictures, a little girl came up to him and asked, "What are you doing?" Timmy replied, "I'm taking pictures with my camera." 

The little girl said, "I don't understand. Why do you take pictures?" Timmy explained, "I take pictures to remember all the pretty things I see." 

The little girl smiled and said, "That's so cool! I wish I had a camera too." Timmy felt proud and happy. He wasn't ashamed to love taking pictures anymore.

Mia and Mark were best friends. They did everything together. One day Mia and Mark were playing in the park. They saw an interesting circle on the ground. 

"What is that?" asked Mia to Mark.

"I don't know," replied Mark. 

Mark leaned in and listened. To Mia's surprise, a silly voice started to come from the circle! They both looked at each other and were surprised.

"Let's listen more," Mia said.

Mark and Mia listened to the silly voice coming from the circle. They heard jokes and funny stories that made them giggle and laugh. They listened to the voice until it was time to go home. 

Mia and Mark smiled and had fun. They loved the silly stories from the circle and thought it was the best day ever.

Once upon a time, there was a naughty little boy called Bert. He was always up to no good, no matter how much his mom tried to tell him to be a good boy.

One day, Bert was feeling particularly naughty and decided to steal his neighbour's hat. He snuck over to their house, quietly took the hat and ran away with it.

When he got back home, he was so proud that his mom asked him "What did you get, Bert?" He proudly showed her the hat and said "Mom, look what I brought!"

His mom was very angry and said "Bert! That was not nice! You must take that hat back to where it belongs!"

So Bert sadly went back to the neighbour's house to give the hat back. When he handed it over he said: "I'm sorry I took your hat, I will not do it again!"

The neighbour laughed and said: "You must have been feeling very naughty, that's why you took the hat!"

But Bert knew he had done something wrong, and that naughtiness is never a good thing. Because of this, he never went near the neighbour's hat again!

Once upon a time there was a big dragon. It had a huge head and fire would come out of its mouth. The dragon lived high up in a mountain and it always looked very angry.

One day, a brave knight rode up to the mountain and stood in front of the dragon. He was ready to fight the dragon, but he did not have to. The dragon said "it is time for me to release the fire inside me".

The knight was surprised. He wanted to know how the dragon was going to do that. The dragon said "Just wait a little bit." So the brave knight waited.

And then, a huge burst of light surrounded the dragon. It was like its head opened up, and all the fire inside was released out into the world. The dragon smiled and it looked very happy.

The brave knight was amazed. He said "you look so different". The dragon said "Yes, now I am free". Then the knight and the dragon became good friends.
