Once upon a time there was a little duck who loved to play in the sunshine. But one day the weather was very difficult. The sky was dark and cloudy and it was too rainy to go outside.

The little duck was sad and did not know what to do. He wanted to play, but the bad weather was delaying his plans. He tried to think of something else to do but nothing seemed very fun.

Then suddenly, the rain stopped and some of the clouds moved away. Suddenly there were blue skies!

The little duck was very excited and flew outside as fast as he could. He was happy to be able to enjoy the sun again and he spent the rest of the day playing.

Once upon a time, there was a big palace. It seemed very pretty and shiny. A little girl named Lily wanted to go inside and see what was in there. She walked closer and closer to the palace.

Suddenly, a scary dragon appeared! The dragon seemed angry and Lily got very scared. She tried to run away, but the dragon chased her. Lily tripped and fell, hurting her leg. The dragon came closer and closer until Lily was too scared to move.

The dragon took Lily to his cave and she never saw her family again. The big palace seemed like a good idea, but it was too dangerous.

Once upon a time there was a sleepy boy named Thomas. One night, he took his flashlight and went outside to explore. He was so excited. He wanted to go on a great adventure. 

Thomas walked in the dark and saw a pond. He spotted something shiny in the water. He thought it must be treasure!

Thomas yelled out, "What is it? What is it?"

His mom said, "It's a rock! You can't get it."

Thomas didn't want to give up. He said, "I'm going to dive in and get it."

His mom said, "No, it's too dark and too deep. You could get hurt."

But Thomas was brave. He put his flashlight in his pocket and jumped into the water. He grabbed the rock and held it tightly. 

When he came out of the water, his mom said, "I'm so proud of you for being brave. Now let's go inside and celebrate your great adventure." 

That night, Thomas went to sleep with a smile, happy that he had gone on a great dive with his flashlight.

Once upon a time, there was an angry lion. He was very big and strong. The lion roared through the forest. He was so mad that he shook the ground.

The lion had not eaten for days. He was very hungry. Everywhere he looked, he saw nothing to eat. 

Then, the lion saw something very strange. It was a pink bunny. The bunny was hopping around, looking for something to eat. The lion got very excited. He took a big leap and chased after the bunny. 

The bunny ran very fast, but the lion was faster. He got close very quickly and roared loudly. The bunny was so scared that it stopped moving. 

The lion was very hungry. But he was also very kind. He let the bunny go. Instead, he found a big apple tree and ate all the apples. He was satisfied and happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a rich little girl named Emily. Every day, Emily would climb up on the swing in her backyard. As she swung higher and higher, she imagined she was soaring high in the sky with the birds. One day, while Emily was on the swing, a big block of ice flew down from the sky and landed in her backyard! Emily was so excited! She hopped off the swing and ran up to the ice. She touched it and saw that the ice was very cold.

Emily shouted to her mom, "Mommy! I found some ice!" Her mom came running and said, "Oh wow! That is a big block of ice! What are you going to do with it?" Emily thought for a moment and said, "I'm going to swing it!" She grabbed the ice and used it like a swing. She swung it vigorously from side to side, laughing as the ice made a whooshing sound through the air. 

After a while, her mom said, "That's enough swinging for now, Emily. Let's put the ice in the freezer so we can enjoy an icy treat later!" Emily smiled and said, "Yes Mommy!"  She was happy to have her very own piece of ice that she could swing and enjoy!

Once upon a time there lived a big, strong bear. His name was Ben. He loved living in the forest and every day he would explore it.

One morning, he came across a small campfire. It was near a clearing. He got closer and saw two rabbits sitting by the fire. All of a sudden, Ben heard them talking about a strange, thin smoke.

He walked over to them and said, â€œWhatâ€™s that smoke?â€

The rabbits turned and saw Ben. One of them, whose name was Terry, said, â€œHello there! We were just discussing this thin smoke we can smell. It smells kind of weird. Do you know what it is?â€

Ben sniffed the air and said, â€œI think itâ€™s a campfire smoke. You know, like when you light a campfire. Itâ€™s smell is different to other smoke and itâ€™s very thin.â€

The rabbits thanked him and they all said goodbye. Ben went on his way, happy that he got to help the two little rabbits.

Once upon a time, there was a chubby bear named Ben. Ben loved to surf in the big blue ocean. One day, Ben went surfing but he fell off his board and got very dirty. He decided to clean himself up and went to take a bath. 

Ben used soap and water to clean himself. He scrubbed and scrubbed until he was all clean. After his bath, he felt very happy and went back to surfing. This time, he was able to stay on his board and ride the waves all the way to the shore. 

From that day on, Ben made sure to clean himself after every surf. He knew that being clean was important to stay healthy and happy. And he continued to surf every day, always having fun in the big blue ocean. The end.

Once upon a time there was a generous bulb. It was a very special bulb because it wanted to be part of something bigger. So one day it asked if it could join a new family.

The family said yes and welcomed the bulb into their home. Everyone was so happy. The bulb lit up the room with a warm light that everyone enjoyed.

The bulb was so excited to be part of the family. Every day it shared its light with them. It would light up their home and make them smile.

One day, the bulb suggested a special game. Every family member had to join in with the bulb. They ran, jumped and laughed. It was so much fun and everyone was happy to be part of the game.

The bulb was so pleased to be part of the family. The bulb knew it had found a special home and the family was filled with love and light.

One day, a little girl wanted to finish her snack. She saw something yummy on the table. It was yellow and round.

The little girl asked her mom, "What is this yellow thing?

Her mom replied, "It is butter. You can put it on your snack and finish it."

The little girl was delighted and she quickly spread the butter on her snack. She enjoyed her yummy snack so much that she finished it in no time. 

"Yum! That was great," said the little girl with a big smile. 

Her mom smiled too. She was happy that her little girl had finished her snack.

Once there was a man called Bill. He was a small but brave man. One day Bill was walking down the street when he saw two boys fighting. Bill felt that it was a foolish thing to do and wanted to stop them. So he approached them and said, "Stop, why are you fighting?"

One of the boys replied, "He said I was stupid and I had to do something about it!"

Bill was surprised and asked, "Why would you fight over something so silly?" He then added, "Let's turn away from this fight and work it out with words instead."

The boys looked at each other and then stopped fighting. They thanked Bill and agreed never to fight again. Bill smiled and said, "Good. That was the wise thing to do. Fighting is foolish and only leads to more trouble." The boys nodded and went home, happy that they avoided a fight.

Once upon a time there was a lady. She was a very noisy lady. Everywhere she went, it was noisy.

The lady wanted to be quiet. But every time she tried, something noisy happened.

One day the noisy lady found a place that was very quiet. It was a very quiet spot, but it was hidden away.

She went to the quiet spot everyday and wanted to stay there. It was her happy place.

But one day, the lady couldn't find the quiet spot. It was gone! She was so sad and looked everywhere, but it was no use.

The lady was sad, but she kept trying to find the quiet spot. She knew it was somewhere special.

Ben and Mia were playing with their toys in the living room. Ben had a big truck and Mia had a doll. They liked to make noises and pretend they were driving or talking.

"Vroom, vroom, my truck is fast and strong!" Ben said.

"My doll is pretty and nice, she likes to sing and dance!" Mia said.

They were having fun, but then Ben saw something on the floor. It was a piece of gum. It was pink and sticky and looked weird.

"Hey, what is this?" Ben asked, picking up the gum.

"Don't touch that, it's yucky!" Mia said. "Mommy said gum is for chewing, not for playing."

But Ben was curious. He wondered what would happen if he attached the gum to something. He looked around and saw Mia's doll. He had an idea.

"Watch this, Mia!" Ben said, and he stuck the gum on the doll's hair.

"Ben, no!" Mia shouted. "You ruined my doll! She has gum in her hair!"

Mia started to cry. Ben realized he had made a mistake. He tried to pull the gum off, but it was too sticky. It made the doll's hair worse.

"I'm sorry, Mia, I'm sorry!" Ben said. "I didn't mean to hurt your doll. I just wanted to see what the gum would do."

Mia was very sad and angry. She didn't want to play with Ben anymore. She ran to Mommy and showed her the doll.

"Mommy, look what Ben did!" Mia said. "He put gum in my doll's hair! He's mean!"

Mommy looked at the doll and the gum. She was not happy. She took the doll and the gum and told Ben to come with her.

"Ben, you know you shouldn't play with gum. It's not a toy. It's dirty and sticky and can make a mess. And you shouldn't attach it to Mia's doll. That was not nice. You hurt her feelings and her doll. You need to say sorry and help me fix it." Mommy said.

Ben felt bad. He knew Mommy was right. He said sorry to Mia and Mommy. He helped Mommy wash the doll's hair and get the gum out. It took a long time and a lot of soap.

Mia watched them. She saw that Ben was sorry and that he tried to help. She felt a little better. She still loved her doll, even with the weird gum hair.

"Thank you, Ben, for helping Mommy. And thank you, Mommy, for fixing my doll." Mia said.

"You're welcome, Mia. And thank you, Ben, for saying sorry and being a good brother." Mommy said.

Ben and Mia hugged each other and Mommy. They learned a lesson. They decided not to play with gum anymore. They went back to their toys and played nicely. They were happy again.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to play the drums. Every day she would go outside and practice. She found something incredible one day while she was playing. It was the most beautiful drum she had ever seen!

The little girl was so excited. She ran back to her house to tell her parents what she had seen. "Mommy, Daddy. I found an incredible drum while I was playing. Can I keep it?"

Her Mom and Dad both said "Yes, of course you can!", so the little girl went back outside to get her new drum.

She played for hours and hours that day. As the sun started to set, the girl decided it was time for a rest. She put her drum down, yawned and closed her eyes.

The little girl then had the most amazing dream of playing her magical drum all night long. When she woke up the next morning, she realized her dream was an incredible reality!

Ben is a brown dog who likes to nap. He naps on his soft bed, on the couch, on the rug, and sometimes on his owner's lap. He naps when it is sunny, when it is rainy, when it is quiet, and when it is noisy. He naps a lot.

One day, Ben hears a new sound. It is a loud and fast sound, like a big bee. He looks out the window and sees a yellow car. The car is in motion. It goes up and down the street, and makes a beep-beep noise. Ben is curious. He wants to see the car closer.

He jumps off the couch and runs to the door. He barks and scratches the door. His owner opens the door and lets him out. Ben runs after the car. He tries to catch it, but it is too fast. He runs and runs, but he cannot reach it. He gets tired and hot. He stops and lies down on the grass. He naps.

The car stops too. The driver gets out and sees Ben. He smiles and walks to him. He pets Ben and gives him a treat. He says, "Hello, little dog. You are a good runner. Do you want to ride in my car?" Ben wags his tail and barks. He likes the driver. He likes the treat. He likes the car.

The driver picks up Ben and puts him in the car. He drives him back to his house. He knocks on the door and gives Ben to his owner. He says, "I found your dog chasing my car. He is a brave and friendly dog. I gave him a ride and a snack. He napped in the car. He is a good napper." Ben's owner thanks the driver and hugs Ben. He says, "You are a silly and adventurous dog. I'm glad you are safe and happy. Now let's go inside and nap some more." Ben agrees. He naps.

Lily liked to play with her trumpet. It was a smooth toy that made loud noises when she blew into it. She liked to pretend she was in a band with her friends. She would march around the room and make music.

One day, she took her trumpet to the park. She wanted to show it to her friends and play with them. But when she got there, she saw a big boy with a real trumpet. It was shiny and had buttons and a long tube. The boy was playing it very well. He made beautiful sounds that everyone liked.

Lily felt sad. She thought her toy trumpet was not good enough. She thought the boy's trumpet was better. She wanted to have a real trumpet too. She walked up to the boy and asked him if she could try his trumpet. The boy looked at her and said no. He said it was his trumpet and he did not share. He said her toy trumpet was silly and she should go away.

Lily felt angry. She did not like the boy. She thought he was mean and rude. She grabbed his trumpet and ran away. She thought she could keep it and play with it. She thought it belonged to her now.

But the boy was faster. He chased after her and caught her. He took his trumpet back and shouted at her. He said she was a bad girl and a thief. He said she should never touch his trumpet again. He said it belonged to him and only him.

Lily felt scared. She did not like the boy. She did not like his trumpet. She did not like the park. She wanted to go home. She ran to her mom and hugged her. She told her what happened and cried. Her mom comforted her and said it was okay. She said she was sorry the boy was mean to her. She said she was proud of her for playing with her toy trumpet. She said it was a special toy that belonged to her and only her. She said she loved her and her trumpet.

Lily felt better. She liked her mom. She liked her toy trumpet. She liked to play with it. She did not care about the boy or his trumpet. She knew her toy trumpet was good enough. She knew it was smooth and loud and fun. She knew it was hers and she was happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Bella. Bella loved clapping her hands. She would clap them together as she danced around her house.

One day, Bella was playing in the kitchen. She found a special fork. It was shiny and new, so she decided to keep it.

Bella sat down in a chair and started to play with the fork. Suddenly, a smelly smell came from the fork. Bella covered her nose and jumped away from the chair.

She looked carefully at the fork again. This time, she noticed that something was stuck in the prongs. She carefully pulled out a smelly cheese.

Bella laughed, and then clapped her hands. She threw the smelly cheese away and kept the special fork. And she lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to sing and dance all around her house. One day, Lily's mommy took her to see an opera. Lily didn't know what an opera was, but she was excited to go.

When they got there, Lily saw lots of people sitting quietly in their seats. She didn't understand why they were being so quiet. Then the show started, and Lily realized that an opera is a kind of play where people sing instead of talk.

Lily listened carefully to the beautiful singing and loved it very much. After the show, she asked her mommy if they could come back and see another opera soon. From that day on, Lily knew that she loved opera and couldn't wait to see another one.

Once there was a little boy. He was walking in the park. The sun was shining and he was having fun. But then, he heard a noise. It was a freezing cold noise. 

He ran to find out what it was and he saw a puppy. The puppy was all alone and it was shaking. The little boy felt very upset.

He knew he had to help. He picked up the puppy and brought it home. When he got home, he gave it a warm blanket and some food. 

The puppy felt much better and the little boy was happy. Then they went back to the park together. But they had to stop when it got dark. 

The little boy said goodbye to the puppy and went home. He was happy he had made the puppy feel better.

Once there was a farmer named Jack who lived on a ranch. He had a horse named Brownie who was his best friend. One day, Jack went to the town to buy some food for Brownie. While he was away, a big storm came and Brownie got scared. He ran away from the ranch and got lost in the woods.

Jack searched for Brownie everywhere but he couldn't find him. He asked everyone he met if they had seen his horse, but no one replied. Jack was very sad and felt deaf because he couldn't hear Brownie's neighing. He missed his friend so much.

Days went by and Jack had to come back to the ranch without Brownie. He was very lonely and sad. He sat on his porch and cried. Suddenly, he heard a neighing sound. He got up and ran towards the sound. It was Brownie! He had come back! Jack was so happy and hugged his horse tightly. But then, he noticed that Brownie was hurt. He had a broken leg and couldn't walk anymore. Jack knew he had to put his friend down. He was heartbroken and cried all night long.

Once upon a time there was a brave girl called Amy. She was three years old and loved to explore. One day she took a walk in the woods near her house and stumbled across a beautiful lake.

Amy was brave and so she decided to go it alone and explore the lake. She carefully walked around the edge, admiring the sparkly water and watching the fish swimming. She could even see a huge frog jumping out of the water.

Suddenly, Amy stumbled and fell into the lake and all she could do was yell for help. Fortunately, her mother was walking nearby and came to help her. She jumped in and carried the brave little girl out of the lake and back home.

Amy was so thankful for her brave mother and by the end of the day, both of them were happily dried off and ready for a warm hug.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very sad. She wanted someone to comfort her. Her family was very poor, so they couldn't buy anything to help her feel better. 

One day, her father found some wood near their house. He decided to carve it into a toy for the little girl. He worked very hard, and the toy looked very nice when he was done! 

The little girl was very happy, and hugged the wooden toy. She hugged it so tightly that the wood started to crack. Before her father could do anything, the toy broke into pieces! 

The little girl felt terrible. She was sadder than before, and she didn't know what to do. She couldn't be comforted, and she cried and felt very alone. 

That was the end of the story. The little girl was never able to find comfort, and her sadness remained terrible forever.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to look up at the sky and see all the stars twinkling. He would point at them and say, "Look, Mommy, stars!"

One day, Timmy's mommy told him they were going to design a special surprise for his birthday. Timmy was very excited and couldn't wait to see what it was.

As they were walking home from the store, Timmy saw a small star on the ground. He picked it up and put it in his pocket. "Maybe this will bring me good luck," he thought.

On his birthday, Timmy's mommy gave him a present wrapped in shiny paper. When he opened it, he saw a beautiful star-shaped balloon. "Wow, Mommy, you designed this just for me!" Timmy exclaimed. And as he looked at the balloon, he remembered the small star he found on the ground and knew it was a sign of good luck.

Ollie was a very happy 3 year old boy. He went for a walk in the park one day and saw a big, beautiful tree. Ollie was so excited and he ran to it with a big smile on his face. He hugged the tree and said "I love you tree!".

As he hugged the tree, he felt like the tree was hugging him back. He stopped and thought to himself, "This tree must love me, too!". So Ollie hugged the tree and played around it for the entire afternoon.

But, one night, there was a big storm. Wind blew fiercely and thunder crashed loudly. Ollie knew his tree was in danger and he was so scared for it. He knew he had to help, so he ran to it and held it tightly to stop it from being blown away. But the tree was weak and the wind was too strong. Ollie hugged the tree tight as he felt it slowly being pulled away from him.

Finally, the wind stopped and the Tree was still there! Ollie was so relieved and hugged the tree again and said, "I love you, tree!". He knew he could always count on the tree to stay with him no matter what and that they would always love each other.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play by the river. She liked to watch the water flow and listen to the birds sing. One day, Lily's mommy asked her if she wanted to go on a boat ride down the river. Lily was very excited and said yes.

But mommy wanted to make sure they were safe on the boat, so she asked her friend who knows a lot about boats to recommend a reliable one. Her friend said she knew just the right boat and they set off down the river. Lily had so much fun waving at the ducks and feeling the wind in her hair. She was so happy mommy found a reliable boat.

Once there was a town with a small house in the middle. One day, the people in town heard a loud ringing sound coming from the house. Everyone in town thought the ringing was really weird and wondered what was making the noise.

A little boy in the town named Jack was very curious and wanted to find out what was making the sound. So he asked his dad if they could go inside the house. Jack's dad was a bit worried, but said yes because he wanted to help out the people in town.

When Jack and his dad opened the door, they saw a big bell in the middle of the room. Jack thought it was really weird and asked why it was ringing. His dad explained that it was the town's alarm system for when people needed help. 

Jack was excited! He offered to help anyone who needed it, but his dad said it was too late. The people of the town had already solved their problem.

Jack said goodbye to the bell and felt a lot better knowing that it was something good. He waved goodbye to the town and went back home feeling proud that he helped out the town with his dad.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw and color with her crayons. One day, she drew a picture of a flower and showed it to her mom. Her mom said, "Wow, Lily! You are becoming an intelligent artist!"

Lily was so happy to hear that. She decided to put her picture in a special folder to keep it safe. But her little brother, Max, wanted to see it too. When Lily refused to show him, Max became upset and started to cry.

Lily felt bad for making Max cry, so she decided to show him her picture. Max was so happy to see it and said, "Lily, you are the best artist ever!" From that day on, Lily and Max would draw and color together, filling their special folder with all their beautiful artwork.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends decided to play catch. They threw a ball back and forth, trying to catch it in their hands.

Timmy was very good at catching the ball. He caught it every time! His friends were impressed. They asked him how he did it. Timmy said, "I have a rare talent for catching things."

His friends were happy for Timmy, but one of them felt jealous. His name was Billy. Billy wanted to be the best at catching the ball. He tried and tried, but he couldn't catch it.

Billy got angry and threw the ball really hard. Timmy tried to catch it, but it hit him in the face. Timmy started to cry. His friends felt bad, but it was too late. Timmy had to go to the hospital and get stitches. From that day on, Timmy never played catch again.

Once upon a time there was a brave little girl called Anna. She wanted to go on an amazing journey but she had no idea how to get there.

One day, Anna saw a magical door in the forest. She opened the door and stepped inside to find a long, winding path. Anna bowed her head and started walking. 

The path was long and tricky but Anna was stubborn. She kept going until she reached the end of the path. At the end of the path there was a beautiful castle. 

Anna bowed when she entered the castle. Inside the castle she found her amazing journey. She met new friends, explored new places and made wonderful memories. 

Anna's journey was amazing and she never forgot it. She even told her grandchildren about it and they were so excited! Her journey was magical and something she would always remember.

Once upon a time there was an old, fancy house. It was very true and strong. Everyone who saw it was amazed.

One day a little mouse wanted to repair the house. He worked hard, but the house was too old to repair. He kept trying but it didn't work. The mouse was very sad.

The mouse told True, who owned the house, his bad news. True was so sad that the house couldn't be repaired. For the rest of his days, True never had a fancy house.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. One day, Tim went to the store with his mom. They bought some spicy food. Tim liked spicy food very much.

On their way home, Tim and his mom needed to take a taxi. They waited and waited for a taxi to come. Finally, Tim noticed a yellow taxi coming their way. They got in the taxi and told the driver where they lived.

As they got closer to their home, the sky turned dark and it started to rain. Tim and his mom ran inside their house. But they forgot the spicy food in the taxi. The taxi drove away, and they never saw the spicy food again. Tim was very sad because he wanted to eat the spicy food.

Tom and Lily were friends who liked to play outside. They both had wagons that they used to carry their toys and books. Tom had a new wagon that was shiny and red. Lily had an old wagon that was brown and rusty.

One day, Tom saw Lily's wagon and said, "Your wagon is ugly and bad. My wagon is pretty and good. You should throw your wagon away and get a new one like mine."

Lily felt sad and angry. She said, "My wagon is not ugly and bad. My wagon is old and loved. My grandpa gave me this wagon when I was a baby. He said it was his wagon when he was a boy. He said this wagon has a lot of stories and memories. I value my wagon very much. You are mean and rude. You don't value anything but yourself."

Tom felt ashamed and sorry. He said, "I'm sorry, Lily. I was mean and rude. I didn't know your wagon was so special to you. I don't value anything but myself. You are right. I should value things that have stories and memories, not things that are shiny and new. Can you forgive me and be my friend again?"

Lily smiled and nodded. She said, "I forgive you, Tom. You are my friend again. Do you want to play with me and my wagon? We can share our stories and memories."

Tom smiled and nodded. He said, "Yes, I want to play with you and your wagon. We can share our stories and memories. Thank you, Lily. You taught me a lesson. I learned to value things that are old and loved, not things that are shiny and new."

The end.

Lily and Ben were playing in the park. They saw a big dog with sharp teeth. The dog was barking and running towards them. Lily and Ben were scared. They trembled and cried.

"Help! Help!" they shouted. "The dog is dangerous!"

But no one heard them. The dog was too fast. It jumped on Lily and bit her arm. She screamed in pain. Ben tried to help her, but the dog bit him too. They fell to the ground, bleeding and hurt.

The dog ran away, looking for more food. Lily and Ben were alone. They wished their mom and dad were here. But they were not here yet. They did not know what to do. They were in trouble. They closed their eyes and hoped for help. But help did not come.

Gabby had a brown bear. She really loved him, and she would always cuddle him before bed and tell him stories. One day, her mom came into her bedroom and said, "Gabby, it's time to order dinner now."

Gabby got so excited. She put her bear in her bed and skipped to the table. When she got to the table, she saw a delicious pizza with cheese, pepperoni and mushrooms. Gabby's mouth started to water. 

Gabby asked her mom, "Can I have a slice of pizza please?" Her mom smiled and said, "Yes, of course!" Gabby was so happy that she clapped her hands together and took the biggest slice of pizza she could find. 

Gabby's mom told her that if she ate everything on her plate, she could have a special treat for dessert. Gabby was so excited that she ate all of her food in no time. 

Her mom smiled and gave her some chocolate in a brown wrapper. Gabby opened it up and put the treat in her mouth. She enjoyed every single bite and said the most delicious word ever â€“ "Yum!"

Once upon a time there was a very fancy zigzag. She was a magical zigzag who dreamed of going on an adventure.

Every day, she would sit and wait for something exciting to happen. One day, the magical zigzag had an idea. She wanted to go on a journey, but she didn't know how to get there.

Suddenly, the magical zigzag spotted something in the sky. It was a little paper airplane with a message inside. The paper airplane was mailed to her from far away.

The little zigzag was so excited! She opened up the message and found a map. The map showed a new place, with a path laid out in zig zags.

The magical zigzag followed the zigzag path on the map and soon she arrived at her dream destination. She had an amazing adventure and returned home feeling happy and fulfilled.

Once upon a time, there lived a bunny. He was very fast and loved to speed all around. One day, he was running really fast when he bumped into a twig on the ground. "Ouch!" he said, hopping around. It was a very long twig, so he wanted to take it with him.

The bunny picked up the twig and ran as fast as he could towards the far-away forest. He wanted to make a house with the twig. When he got to the forest, he looked around. The trees were so tall and distant.

"Oh wow!" the bunny said to himself. He started to move branches and leaves to make the walls of his house. He moved them so fast the twig seemed to fly. After he was done, he looked at the house proudly.

Suddenly, he heard a voice from inside the house. "Bunny! Is that you?" he called. The bunny ran inside the house and saw a little chipmunk. "Yes, it's me." he said. 
"I thought I heard someone speed by." the chipmunk said. "That was me carrying this twig to help me build my house." the bunny replied, hopping around with joy.

And ever since that day, the twig became a special home for the bunny and the chipmunk. The bunny's fast feet made a lovely home in the distant forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his toys. One day, he fell and hurt his knee. His mommy came outside and asked, "Are you okay, Timmy?" Timmy said, "Ouchie, mommy. My knee hurts." 

Mommy took Timmy inside and gave him a snack. She gave him some crackers and cheese. Timmy loved snacks! After his snack, mommy cleaned Timmy's knee and put a bandage on it. She said, "This will help your knee heal, Timmy." 

Timmy felt much better and wanted to go back outside to play. But mommy said, "Not yet, Timmy. Let's tidy up your toys first." So, Timmy and mommy tidied up his toys and then he was allowed to go back outside and play. Timmy was happy and grateful for his mommy's help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, her mommy asked her to clean up her room. Lily didn't want to do it because she wanted to keep playing. Her mommy said, "Lily, you have to choose. You can keep playing or clean up your room."

Lily thought about it for a moment and decided to clean up her room. She knew it would make her mommy happy. But as she started cleaning, she realized it was going to be a lot of trouble. Her toys were everywhere and it was hard to put them all away.

Just as she was getting frustrated, her little brother came into the room. He saw the mess and started playing with her toys, making an even bigger mess. Lily got upset and said, "No, no! Stop! You're making it messy again!"

Her brother didn't understand, so Lily had to show him how to clean up. Together, they worked hard and made the room tidy again. Lily was proud of herself for choosing to clean up and for teaching her brother how to help.

Once upon a time, there was a stubborn little rabbit named Remy. Remy loved to race with his friends. One day, he saw a big cauliflower in the garden. He thought it would be fun to play with it.

Remy had an idea. He told his friends to come and race with him in the garden. He said the winner would get the big cauliflower. His friends were excited and said yes. They did not know that Remy had a plan.

The race began and Remy ran very fast. His friends tried to catch up, but Remy was too quick. In the end, Remy won the race and got the big cauliflower. His friends were sad, but they knew Remy was a stubborn rabbit. They hoped that next time they could win the race and get the cauliflower.

Once upon a time, there was a big, fat cat named Fluffy. Fluffy loved to play with his toys, but he didn't like to share them with anyone. One day, Fluffy found a sparkly ball that he loved so much. He played with it all day and didn't let anyone else play with it.

One day, Fluffy's friend, a little mouse named Squeaky, came to visit. Squeaky saw the sparkly ball and asked Fluffy if he could play with it too. But Fluffy said no and kept playing with the ball all by himself. Squeaky felt sad and left.

Later that day, Fluffy was playing with the ball near a big river. He accidentally kicked the ball too hard and it fell into the river. Fluffy tried to reach for it, but he fell into the river too. Fluffy didn't know how to swim and he drowned. 

From that day on, Squeaky never saw his friend Fluffy again. He remembered how Fluffy didn't like to share, and he felt sad that he couldn't play with him anymore. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a monkey who lived in the jungle. One day, the monkey got confused and lost his way. He climbed up a tall tree to try and see where he was, but he still couldn't figure it out. Suddenly, he saw a bird flying by with a banana in its beak. The monkey knew that the bird must have come from the direction of the banana trees. So, he decided to follow the bird and see where it would lead him. 

After a while, the bird landed on a branch and the banana fell to the ground. The monkey quickly ran over and grabbed the banana. As he was eating it, he heard a loud noise. It was a hunter who had been tracking the monkey. The monkey knew he had to escape, so he quickly climbed up a nearby tree. The hunter tried to catch him, but the monkey was too quick. He used his strong arms to release himself from the hunter's grasp and ran away back into the jungle.

Once there was a little girl who loved to paint. She had so many different paints - blues, greens, yellows and more! One day the little girl had an operation, so she couldn't paint for a while. 

When she finally felt better, she was ready to paint again. She grabbed her paints and started mixing them together. She painted silly pictures of her cat, her dog and herself. She also painted some big trees, a big sun and lots of happy animals.

When she finished painting, the little girl felt so happy. Painting was so much fun! She wanted to keep painting more and more pictures, but it was time to go home.

But the little girl wasn't worried. She knew she'd have lots more chances to paint in the future.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sue. She was so excited because it was her birthday. She had been waiting all week for the special day to arrive. 

At her birthday party, Sue lay down on a new blanket. It was so soft. Then she saw something else on the blanket- a shiny menu. She opened it and inside she saw all her favorite things. There were cupcakes, chocolate bars, and ice cream. She couldn't believe her eyes. 

She grabbed a cupcake and lay back on the blanket. She had so much fun at her party eating all the new treats. Then she hugged all her friends goodbye and thanked them for coming to her special day. 

The next morning, Sue still couldn't believe it. She had the best birthday ever and of course she couldn't forget the special menu full of all her favorite things. She knew she would remember her special birthday for a long, long time.

Once upon a time there was a puppy with a sweet, scruffy fur collar. He had four furry paws and always wanted to go faster and faster. One day, he chased a rabbit and ran so fast that his collar flew off and he lost it. He whined sadly, he wanted his collar back.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was the rabbit! He had found the collar and put it around his neck. "It's all right, I found it again," the rabbit said. The puppy was so happy, he gave the rabbit a big wet lick on the nose and ran around in circles! They ran faster and faster, the rabbit holding on to the collar so it wouldn't disappear again.

The rabbit and puppy became best friends, running and playing together all the time. Whenever the puppy went a little too fast and the collar began to slide off, the rabbit was always there to put it back around his neck. His sweet, scruffy fur collar stayed with him forever.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to have fun and play all day. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a dictionary. Timmy didn't know what it was, but his mom said it was a book with lots of words.

Timmy loved his new dictionary and would carry it everywhere he went. He would show it to all his friends and they would look at the pictures inside. But one day, Timmy accidentally spilled juice on his dictionary. The pages got all sticky and the pictures were ruined. His dictionary was now spoiled.

Timmy was very sad and didn't know what to do. He tried to clean it, but it was too late. He didn't have another dictionary and he couldn't read his favorite stories anymore. Timmy learned a lesson that day, to take care of his things and not have accidents.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a big clock in her room that tick-tocked all day long. One day, Lily's mommy was very busy with work and couldn't play with her. So, Lily decided to study her favorite book about animals. She read about lions, tigers, and bears. The clock tick-tocked as she studied, and before she knew it, it was time for dinner. Lily was so happy that she learned so much from her book!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in a big world. Her name was Marie. Every morning, she would fill a bucket with water from the nearby river to bring back to her home. 

One day, Marie was very worried. She didn't know why, but for some reason she could not fill her bucket with water. No matter how hard she tried, she couldn't get the water to fill up the bucket. She had a feeling that something was wrong.

Marie told her mother about the problem. Her mother frowned. "I think something must have happened to the river," her mother said. 

So Marie and her mother went on a journey to the river. As they approached it, they saw that the river was much lower than normal. Marie's mother put a hand on her shoulder and said, "See, you were right to be worried. Something has happened to the river. We must fix it and fill it again." 

And so, with determination and hard work, Marie and her mother worked together to fill the river once again. The river sparkled, and Marie was filled with joy! 

The end.

Teddy was feeling happy today. He was ready to take a bath. He grabbed a towel and a cup. He hopped into the warm bathtub with a smile on his face.

His mommy was on the doorstep. She asked, "What do you need, Teddy?" Teddy happily replied, "Some soap, please!"

Mommy gave Teddy a big bar of soap that smelled delicious. He put it in the warm water and blew bubbles. He reached for the cup and splashed around, making waves in the tub.

Teddy splashed and played for a long time until it was time to go. He hugged his mommy goodbye and sadly said, "I miss the bathtub already!" Mommy answered, "I miss it too!"

Once there was a girl named Anna who loved to mix things. She had a special wild shirt that she liked to mix with her other clothes. One day, Anna was in her room mixing her shirt with the rest of her clothes when her Mom walked in. 

"Anna! What are you doing? That's my wild shirt, don't mix it with your other clothes," her Mom said.

Anna almost cried. She didn't want to stop mixing. "Please Mommy, let me mix," she begged.

Her Mom could tell that Anna really liked to mix, so she said, "Ok, but from now on you must ask me before you mix my shirt with your other clothes."

Anna smiled and nodded. She loved that she could still mix, but she also knew that it was important to be respectful and ask for permission.

One day, a cat and a dog had a quarrel. They were not happy with each other. The cat said, "You took my toy!" The dog said, "No, it is my toy!"

A girl saw them and felt sad. She took them to a veterinarian. The veterinarian was a nice man who helped animals. He looked at the cat and the dog. He said, "You need to be friends."

The cat and the dog felt excited. They wanted to be friends. They played with the toy together and had fun. The girl was happy to see them play. The cat and the dog did not quarrel anymore.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily's mommy asked her if she wanted to help clean the house. 

Lily thought for a moment and said, "I think I can help make the house strong." 

Her mommy smiled and said, "That's a great idea, Lily. Let's start by picking up all the toys." 

Lily picked up her dolls and blocks and put them away. As she was cleaning, she noticed her daddy fixing a broken chair. 

"Daddy, are you making the chair strong again?" she asked. 

"Yes, Lily. I'm using glue to make it strong," her daddy replied. 

Lily was happy she could help make the house strong and clean. She knew it was important to take care of her home.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the green grass. One day, she went to play in the park with her friend Tom.

Tom asked, "Lily, do you want to play on the swings?"

Lily replied, "Yes, but my shirt is wet from the rain. Can we wait for it to dry?"

Tom said, "Sure, let's wait until it's dry. That way we won't get sick."

Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Tom. It's important to stay healthy."

The moral of the story is that it's important to take care of ourselves and wait for things to dry before we play outside.

Once upon a time there was an old man who lived in the forest. One day, he saw a hoop lying on the ground. He asked the hoop, "What are you doing here?"
The hoop replied, "I was dropped by a little girl who was playing."
The old man looked around, but he couldn't see the girl anywhere. He asked the hoop, "Where did she go?"
The hoop replied, "She ran into the woods."
The old man said, "I will help you find her. Follow me!"
The old man and the hoop began running through the woods together. After a while, the old man found the little girl.
The old man asked, "What are you doing out here all alone?"
The little girl replied, "I wanted to find more hoops to play with."
The old man smiled and said, "Well, we found one!" He picked up the hoop and handed it to the little girl. She was so happy that she hugged the old man.

The old man winked and said, "Well, what are you waiting for? Let's play!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lizzie. She went out for a walk in the woods one day. She looked up in the sky and saw a beautiful raven. She wondered why the raven was there. 

Lizzie continued walking and soon heard some noises in the trees. She was starting to feel a little scared, but she was brave and decided to go and take a look. As she walked closer, she saw a big black raven. It was calm and still looking at her. Lizzie was so scared she wanted to run away. 

Suddenly, the raven flew down from its perch in the tree and attacked Lizzie. Lizzie screamed and ran away. She ran as fast as she could until she was safe. She was so scared and scared of the raven she never went near the woods again. 
The raven screeched behind her, and the bad memory always stayed in her mind.

Once upon a time, there was a big, slow turtle named Timmy. Timmy liked to go on tours around the forest to see all the animals. One day, Timmy saw a group of ants marching in a line. Timmy thought it looked like fun, so he decided to join the march. 

The ants were surprised to see a turtle marching with them, but they welcomed Timmy and let him join their tour. They showed him all their favorite places in the forest and Timmy was so happy to be a part of their group. 

After the tour was over, Timmy said goodbye to his new ant friends and went back to his home. He was so grateful for the fun day he had and couldn't wait to go on another tour with his new friends.

Tom and Mia were playing in the park. They saw a big bear. The bear was bald. He had no fur on his head. He looked sad and cold.

"Hello, bear," Tom said. "Why are you bald?"

The bear growled. He said, "I lost my fur. A bad man took it. He wanted to make a hat. He was mean and greedy."

"That's not fair," Mia said. "We want to help you. We want to solve your problem. How can we get your fur back?"

The bear smiled. He said, "Thank you, kids. You are kind and brave. The bad man lives in a house near the woods. He has a big fence and a big dog. But I know a secret way. Follow me."

Tom and Mia followed the bear. They crawled under a hole in the fence. They sneaked past the dog. They found the hat. It was made of the bear's fur. It was ugly and smelly.

"Here it is," the bear said. "This is my fur. I want it back."

Tom and Mia grabbed the hat. They ran back to the hole. The dog barked. The bad man shouted. But they were too fast. They escaped.

They gave the hat to the bear. He put it on his head. He looked happy and warm.

"Thank you, kids," the bear said. "You solved my problem. You are my friends. You can come and play with me anytime."

Tom and Mia hugged the bear. They said, "You're welcome, bear. You are our friend too. We're glad you have your fur back."

They played in the park until it was time to go home. They waved goodbye to the bear. They had a good day.

Once upon a time, there lived a brave little girl called Anna. Anna wanted to climb the highest mountain in the world, but everyone said it was too hard. Anna told them she wanted to try and believed she could reach the top.

The mountain was very tall and icy. Anna started to climb, but it was harder than she thought. Part way up, she slipped and slipped down again. Anna started to cry, but then she heard a voice. Someone was telling her to try again and to never stop believing.

So Anna tried again and just kept on trying, until one day she reached the top. Anna was so happy she burst into tears of joy. She had done it! All of her friends who had told her she couldn't do it were so happy for her. Everyone was very proud of Anna.

Anna had shown that if you believe in yourself and try your best, anything is possible.

Once there was a little girl named Sue. She was three years old and loved to share.

One day, Sue went to the park with her mom. She saw a group of children playing and went to join them.

As Sue arrived, she saw the children eating something. It smelled yummy!

The children saw Sue and waved her over. She smiled and asked, "What are you eating?"

One of the children said, "Try some of our ice cream! We got it to celebrate the new year."

Sue was so excited! She shared the ice cream with all of her new friends. They all had so much fun!

The children thanked Sue for sharing and invited her to come back and play with them again. Sue was so happy and she couldn't wait to come back and share more yummy treats with all her new friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to watch cartoons on TV. One day, his TV broke and he couldn't watch his favorite shows anymore. Timmy was sad.

Timmy's mom suggested they go to the store to buy a new TV. At the store, they found a cooler TV than Timmy's old one. It was bigger and had more colors. Timmy was happy and wanted to buy it.

But, Timmy's dad said they couldn't afford the cooler TV and they needed to get a reliable one instead. Timmy didn't understand what reliable meant, so his dad explained that it meant the TV would work well for a long time.

In the end, they bought the reliable TV and Timmy was happy again because he could watch his cartoons. Timmy learned that sometimes it's better to have something that works well for a long time than something that looks cool but might not last.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play in her backyard. One day, she found a key on the ground. She picked it up and asked her mom, "What is this?" Her mom replied, "That's a key. It can open doors."

Lily was excited and wanted to try the key. She ran to the front door and tried to put the key in the lock. But it wouldn't fit. She tried again and again, but it was too loud and woke up her baby brother.

Her mom came to see what was happening and said, "Let's try the key on the treasure box in the living room." They went inside and found the treasure box. Lily put the key in the lock and turned it. The box opened and inside was a shiny necklace. Lily was happy and said, "I got a treasure!"

Once upon a time, there was a boy named John. He was a very cheerful boy who loved celery. Every day, he would go to the fridge and get a big bunch of celery.

One day, John was eating his celery and he started to think. He wondered what it would be like to live in a place where everybody ate celery all the time. He thought it would be a lot of fun.

So, John decided to visit a magical land where everybody ate celery. He hopped on a bus, and soon he arrived at his destination. Everywhere he looked, he saw people eating celery! Everyone was happy and cheerful.

John smiled and realized that he had made the right decision. He enjoyed himself and ate a lot of celery. Then, he hopped back on the bus and went home. From that day forward, he was sure to always keep celery in the fridge.

One evening, Daisy looked outside her window and saw a big, bright moon. She was so excited that she skipped outside with her special polishing cloth. Daisy wanted to make the moon sparkle and shine so she used gentle strokes to polish the moon's surface. Every time Daisy moved her cloth, the moon twinkled even brighter in the sky. When Daisy was finished, the moon was glowing so brightly she had to use her hands to protect her eyes. Daisy smiled with joy and she decided to polish the moon every night.

Once upon a time there were two little friends, Sally and Billy. As they were walking through the forest, Sally saw something shiny in the distance. "Let's go see what it is," she said.

Billy wanted to go the other way, but Sally insisted. When they got closer, Sally was delighted when she saw it was a delicate woodland flower! But then, Billy heard something different. He heard a demand coming from behind them. They both turned around to see a man with a big weapon pointed at them. 

The man demanded they give him the flower. Sally started to cry, but Billy stepped in front of her to protect her. He told the man there was no way he was getting the flower.

The man got angry and said he would hurt them if they didn't give it to him. Sally and Billy thought quickly and made a plan to get away. Sally very quietly grabbed the flower and hid it in her pocket, and Billy yelled for help.

The man got scared and ran away. Sally and Billy hugged each other, happy to have outsmarted the man. They had saved the delicate flower and become heroes!

Once upon a time there was a boy named Mike. One day, Mike decided he wanted to try something new and went to explore in the desert. As he walked through the desert, he saw a funny looking cactus. He was very curious about it and decided to try touching it. Suddenly, he heard a loud noise! Mike was so embarrassed and quickly ran back home. That night, he told his mom what had happened. 

Mike's mom said, "That's weird, Mike! You should never touch a cactus!"

Mike replied, "I won't mom, I promise!" 

And ever since that day, Mike has been very careful to never touch a cactus again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she went to the park to play on the swings. She saw a boy named Max playing with a toy car.

"Hi Max, can I play with you?" asked Lily.

"Sure, you can play with me," said Max. "But you have to yield to my pattern. I want to play with the blue car first."

Lily agreed and they played together happily. The sun was shining and the birds were singing. Lily felt calm and happy playing with Max. They took turns playing with the toy car, and Lily noticed that Max had a special pattern for how he played.

"Max, your pattern is so cool! I like how you yield to it," said Lily.

"Thanks, Lily. I like playing with patterns. It helps me stay calm," said Max.

Lily smiled and they continued to play together, enjoying the beautiful day.

Davey was a little boy. He was only three years old. One day, Davey was very thirsty. He went to the kitchen and opened the fridge. Inside the fridge, he found an empty milk jug. He sighed and closed the fridge.

Just then, Davey heard a voice. "Hey Davey, let's go get some milk for the jug!" It was Davey's mom. She was smiling at him. Davey smiled back. He was happy to go out with his mom.

The two of them drove to the store. Inside the store, Davey saw a big glass jug filled to the top with milk. He was so excited that he started to clap. His mom smiled and said, "Come on, let's get some milk". She urged Davey to the cash register and they paid for the milk. 

Every step of the way home, Davey's mom urged him to hurry. When they got home, Davey carefully poured the milk into the empty jug. He put the jug back in the fridge and his mom hugged him. Davey was so happy that he got to go on an adventure with his mom and fill the empty milk jug!

Once upon a time, there was a girl with long hair who was playing with her friends. She was having a great time, until a rude man walked up to them. He pointed at her purse and said "Give me that." She got scared and her friends ran away. The girl kept her purse safe and ran away too. When the man realised the girl had run away, he got really mad and started to shout.

The girl ran all the way to her house and when she got there she called her mum. Her mum answered and she said, "Mum, a rude man wanted to take my purse but I said 'no' and ran away!" Her mum was so proud of her for standing up to the man and told her to stay safe inside the house. 

From then on, the girl always held on tight to her purse whenever she went out to play. She had learned a very important lesson that day - never talk to strangers!

Once upon a time there was a rich little girl called Amy. She loved to dream and every night she would have the most wonderful dreams. One night, she dreamed of a land filled with exciting things. She could see a path that seemed to take her to this place. It seemed so wonderful and so exciting to her.

The next day, she decided to take a step. She stepped out of her house. It was a big brave step. All around her she could see the most beautiful sights. She could see mountains and a big blue sky - it was so much better than she had ever imagined. 

Amy kept stepping and dreaming. She went further and further, until eventually she found the most wonderful place. It was filled with nature and beauty and it was even richer than she could have ever imagined from her dreams. 

She smiled and thought to herself that it was worth every step she had taken. Then Amy started to explore and it really was the most wonderful dream come true.

Once upon a time, a pale sun was in the sky. It was not very hot. A little boy named Tim and his dog, Spot, went outside to play. They saw a kite on the ground. Tim said, "Let's attach the string to the kite and fly it in the sky!"

Tim and Spot saw the weather change. The wind started to blow faster. Tim said, "This is perfect for our kite!" They ran with the kite and it went up in the sky. The kite was dancing in the wind. Spot barked happily.

But then, the wind blew too strong. The kite string broke. The kite flew away. Tim and Spot were sad. They looked for the kite, but could not find it. As they walked home, they saw a new kite in a tree. Tim said, "Look, Spot! A new kite for us to play with!" They attached the string and played with the new kite. They were happy again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside and run around. One day, she tripped and hurt her knee. It hurt a lot and she cried.

Her mom came to help and said, "Don't worry, it's just a little scrape. It's harmless." Lily tried to stand up, but it hurt too much. Her mom said, "Let's try to clean it up and put a band-aid on it."

Lily learned that sometimes we might fall and get hurt, but it's important to try and get back up. And sometimes, things might seem scary or dangerous, but they're actually harmless. Her knee felt better soon enough and she was able to go back to playing outside.

Once upon a time, there was a selfish little girl named Sally. Sally never wanted to share her toys with anyone, not even with her best friend. 

One day, Sally got a cold, and she sneezed and sneezed. She was so stuffy she couldn't even play with her toys anymore. Her mom got her a nice, soft rag and said, â€œSally, use this to wipe your nose and keep yourself clean.â€

But Sally, who was so selfish, wouldn't even share her rag with her friend when they made houses out of blocks together. She said, â€œThis rag is only for me.â€

Fortunately, Sally had a mom who was wise and kind. She reminded Sally that it's important to share and to not always be so selfish. So Sally finally shared her rag and they both felt happy. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a best friend named Timmy. They loved to play together all the time. One day, Timmy wanted to play with his toy trucks, but Lily wanted to play with her dolls. 

Timmy said, "I don't want to play with dolls. Let's play with my trucks." 

Lily felt sad because she really wanted to play with her dolls. But then she had an idea. "Let's complete our own game. We can play with your trucks and my dolls. It will be fun!" 

Timmy thought it was a good idea and they played together happily. Lily was happy that she didn't have to give up playing with her dolls and Timmy was happy that he could play with his trucks too. They were both friends and didn't want to be bossy to each other. They knew that playing together and being happy was more important than being bossy.

Peter was playing in his backyard when he noticed a fierce cloud in the sky. It was grey and bigger than any other clouds in the sky. He had never seen such a fierce cloud before. He watched it for a few minutes, wondering what it would do. 

Suddenly the fierce cloud started to spin and Peter knew something bad was going to happen. He quickly ran inside and warned his parents. His mom and dad tried to protect their house, but it was too late. Suddenly, the fierce cloud started to pay and it pelted their house with rain. The rain was so strong it caused damage to their house. 

Peter and his family were very sad. They worked hard to pay for the repairs, but it seemed like an impossible challenge. In the end, they had to leave their home and move to a new house because they could no longer afford to fix the damage caused by the fierce cloud.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue liked to play sport. Her favorite sport was to run and jump. She also liked to sleep a lot. Sue had a big friend named Bob. Bob was a big, strong boy. Sue and Bob liked to play together.

One day, Sue and Bob went to play sport in the park. They were running and jumping. But then, it started to get dark. Sue and Bob were scared. They did not like the dark. They wanted to go home and sleep.

They tried to find their way home, but they got lost. It was very dark and they were very scared. They could not find their way home. Sue and Bob began to cry. They wished they had not stayed out so late. In the end, Sue and Bob had to sleep in the park, cold and scared. They learned a lesson to never stay out too late.

Once there was a boy. His name was Tom. Tom was very weird. One day he spotted a knot on the ground. He bent down and slapped it. The knot started to move! Tom was so surprised. He couldn't believe it. He had never seen anything so weird. The knot kept bouncing around the room, slapping things, and making a lot of noise. Tom didn't know what to do. Just then, his mom came in the room. She saw Tom and the weird knot and quickly made it stop moving! Tom's mom was so relieved. She was glad Tom knew better than to slap strange knots.

Once upon a time, there was a march. A march is like a walk, but with more people. Everyone had something to do and they worked together. It was difficult to get everyone to settle in the right place, however.

Suddenly, they heard a fairy call out. "If you work together, you can make it happen!" Everyone listened, and started to help each other as they marched. 

It was still difficult, but the march eventually settled into the right place. Everyone clapped and cheered. It was a hard journey, but they had made it! 

The end!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She loved to play near the water. One sunny day, she went to the beach with her mom. The sand was warm and the water was perfect.

Mia saw a big wave coming. She was scared. "Mom, I don't like the big wave!" she said. Her mom hugged her and said, "Don't worry, my love. I will care for you. The wave won't hurt you."

Mia felt safe with her mom. They played in the water and laughed. The big wave came and went, but Mia was not scared anymore. She knew her mom would always care for her. And they had a perfect day at the beach.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, Lily's mom told her they were going to a march to prevent sickness. Lily didn't know what that meant, but she was excited to go with her mom.

At the march, Lily saw lots of people walking and holding signs. They all wanted to keep everyone healthy. Lily's mom explained that they were trying to stop germs from spreading.

Suddenly, Lily's friend sneezed. Lily's mom quickly gave her a tissue to cover her mouth. "That's how we can prevent germs from spreading," Lily's mom said. "We want everyone to be healthy."

Lily felt happy knowing that they were all working together to keep each other healthy. She held her mom's hand and continued walking in the march with a big smile on her face.

Tom and Sue like to bake with Mom. Mom says they can make a cake today. They get a big bowl and some eggs and flour and sugar. They mix everything with a spoon. Mom puts the bowl in the oven.

Tom and Sue have to wait for the cake to bake. They are bored. They want to play. Mom says they can go for a walk. They put on their shoes and coats. They go outside with Mom. They see a dog. The dog is brown and fluffy. It barks at them. Tom and Sue are scared. Mom says the dog is friendly. She lets them pet the dog. The dog licks their faces. Tom and Sue laugh.

They walk back to the house. They smell something good. The cake is ready. Mom takes it out of the oven. She lets it cool down. She puts some frosting on it. She gives Tom and Sue a slice each. The cake is yummy. It is brown and sweet. Tom and Sue are happy. They say thank you to Mom. They hug her. They love to bake with Mom.

Tom and Lily liked to play with blocks. They had many blocks of different colors and shapes. They could create anything they wanted with their blocks. One day, they decided to create a nation with their blocks.

They used purple blocks to make a big castle. The castle was the home of the king and the queen of their nation. They used yellow blocks to make a wall around the castle. The wall was to keep the nation safe from bad people. They used green blocks to make fields and trees. The fields and trees were for the animals and the food of their nation. They used blue blocks to make a river and a lake. The river and the lake were for the water and the fish of their nation.

Tom and Lily were very proud of their nation. They gave their nation a name. They called it Purple Land. They made a flag with a purple star on it. They put the flag on top of the castle. They pretended to be the king and the queen of Purple Land. They made rules and laws for their nation. They had fun and played with their blocks. They loved their nation. They loved Purple Land.

Once upon a time, there was a hunter named Tim. Tim was a kind hunter who loved to hunt animals in the forest. One day, Tim went on a hunt but it wasn't easy. He had to climb hills and cross rivers to find an animal to hunt. 

After a while, Tim saw a rabbit and he tried to catch it. But the rabbit was too fast and ran away. Tim felt sad and tired. He decided to rest and eat some fruits. 

While he was resting, he saw a bird flying above him. The bird was beautiful and had feathers of different colors. Tim felt happy and named the bird Rainbow. He realized that hunting was not easy but he could still enjoy the beauty of nature.

Bella was a three year old who loved to bathe. Every night, she would splash around and make bubbles. One night, however, Bella tried something new. She put a lemon in her bath water. It smelled really nice. She thought it was very impressive! It was so much fun that she continued to do it every night.

When her mom came to check on her, she couldn't help but be amazed. Bella had created such a wonderful bath for herself. She asked Bella why she had chosen a lemon and Bella said, "It makes the water smell so nice." Her mom was so proud of her and impressed with her creativity.

From then on, Bella always asked her mom to add a lemon in her bath water. She loved taking luxurious baths with the citrus scent. Bellas' baths had become quite impressive.

Alice was a restless 3 year old. She was always looking for a new game to play.
One day, when she was outside, she saw an arrow in the grass. She picked it up and thought of all the fun things to do with it.

Alice put the arrow in her pocket and went to the store. She picked out a bow and some bright feathers for it. She couldn't wait to go back home to make it.

When Alice arrived back home, she was quick to get the tools she needed. She stuck the feathers onto the bow and then used some string to attach the arrow. She was so excited when it was finished.

Alice took the bow outside and started shooting. She was so pleased with how far the arrows flew and how well she was able to aim. She had lots of fun being an arrow shooter. 

Alice was happy that she found such a fun way to use her restless energy. She couldn't wait to go back to the store to find some more amazing things.

Once upon a time, there was a young girl who loved to explore the world. She was curious and always wanted to learn new things.

One day, the girl went to a mysterious forest. She wanted to find out what it was like. She started walking through the trees and soon noticed something strange. There were two animals - a turtle and a bee - sitting on a log.

The strange thing was that the bee was going very fast, but the turtle was not. The girl wanted to understand why.

The turtle smiled and said, "Sometimes it's important to take your time and enjoy the moment. I'm not in a rush. The bee is very fast, but that doesn't mean it has the most fun. I sit and enjoy the peacefulness around me. Speed isn't the only way to have a good time."

The girl understood the turtle's message and promised to take time to enjoy the moment. She learned an important lesson that day - life isn't about rushing, it's about savouring the moment.

Once there was a little girl who wanted to go on an adventure. She wanted to be rich and see the world. So she walked to the beach and saw a big board. She was excited and grabbed it. She looked around and saw that the beach was filled with people wearing very nice clothes. She knew they were rich, so she used her board to paddle out to the ocean.

She paddled and paddled until she saw something floating in the water. It was a treasure chest! She opened it and saw lots of coins and jewels inside. She was so excited. She filled her pockets with the treasure and paddled back to the beach.

When she got back, the people at the beach were amazed. They had never seen such a little girl with so much treasure. The little girl was now rich and ready to explore the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to sing and dance, but she was very shy. One day, her mommy gave her a notebook to write down her thoughts and feelings. Lily loved her notebook and started to write in it every day.

One sunny day, Lily's mommy took her to the park. They saw a tall tree and Lily wanted to climb it, but she was too scared. Her mommy told her to take a deep breath and remember what she wrote in her notebook. Lily remembered that she wrote that she wanted to learn how to climb a tree.

Lily took a deep breath and started to climb the tree. It was hard at first, but she kept going. When she reached the top, she felt very proud of herself. She wrote a note in her notebook that said, "I learned how to climb a tree today!" Lily was very happy and felt very thin, like a feather in the wind.

Once upon a time, a small girl named Claire was walking through a forest. She looked all around, but it was so quiet and distant. Claire kept going until she came across a large tree made out of wood. She felt like the tree was special and called out: "Hello tree!"

She smiled, but then she noticed something strange. She heard someone praying beneath the tree. She was scared, but she wanted to see who it was. She tiptoed closer and noticed an old witch, murmuring strange words under her breath.

Claire was so scared that her legs started shaking and she couldn't move. "Help me please," she whispered, but the witch didn't hear her. The witch was too busy with her dark spells.

Finally, the witch turned around, looked at Claire and started running towards her. Claire was so afraid she couldn't even scream. The witch reached out and grabbed the poor girl, dragging her deeper and deeper into the dark forest. And Claire was never seen again.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird who loved to fly. One day, the bird saw a beautiful feather on the ground. The bird picked up the feather and felt very happy.

But then, a careless boy came running and stepped on the bird's wing. The bird couldn't fly anymore and was very sad. The boy felt bad and wanted to make it up to the bird.

So, the boy went to the store to buy some medicine for the bird. But when the boy came back, the bird was already gone. The boy felt very sad too.

Anna liked to read books. She had many books in her room. She read them every day. She read them on her bed, on her chair, on her floor. She read them with her toys, with her dolls, with her teddy.

One day, Anna wanted to read a new book. She saw it on the shelf. It was big and colorful. It had a picture of a princess on the cover. Anna reached for the book. But it was too high. She could not get it.

She tried to jump. She tried to climb. She tried to use a stool. But nothing worked. She was too small. She felt sad and angry. She wanted the book.

She saw her brother Tom. He was big and tall. He could get the book. She asked him for help.

"Tom, can you please get me that book?" she said.

Tom looked at the book. He looked at Anna. He smiled.

"Sure, I can get you that book," he said. "But what will you give me?"

Anna thought. She did not have much to give. She had her books, her toys, her dolls, her teddy. But she liked them all. She did not want to give them away.

"Nothing," she said. "Just get me the book. It is easy for you."

Tom shook his head.

"No, nothing is not enough," he said. "If you want the book, you have to give me something. How about your mattress? It is soft and comfy. I want it."

Anna gasped.

"My mattress? No, you can't have my mattress!" she said. "That is where I sleep. That is where I read. I need my mattress."

Tom shrugged.

"Then you can't have the book," he said. "It is too bad. It is a nice book. It has a princess and a dragon and a castle. I will read it myself."

He reached for the book. He took it from the shelf. He walked away.

Anna felt tears in her eyes. She wanted the book. She wanted to read it. She wanted to see the princess and the dragon and the castle. She did not want to give up her mattress. She did not know what to do.

She ran after Tom. She grabbed his arm. She pulled the book.

"Give it back! Give it back!" she shouted.

Tom pulled back. He held the book.

"No, it is mine! It is mine!" he shouted.

They tugged and pulled. They yelled and cried. They made a lot of noise.

Their mom heard them. She came to see what was wrong. She saw them fighting over the book. She saw the book tear. She saw the pages fall. She was not happy.

She took the book from them. She scolded them.

"What are you doing? Why are you fighting? Why are you ruining the book?" she said.

Anna and Tom looked down. They felt sorry. They felt ashamed. They told their mom what happened.

Their mom sighed. She hugged them.

"Anna, Tom, you are both wrong," she said. "Books are not for fighting. Books are for sharing. Books are for learning. Books are for enjoying. You should not be greedy or mean. You should be kind and generous. You should help each other and respect each other. Do you understand?"

Anna and Tom nodded. They understood. They said sorry to each other. They said sorry to their mom. They said sorry to the book.

Their mom smiled. She fixed the book. She gave it to them.

"Here, you can both read the book," she said. "But you have to take turns. And you have to be careful. And you have to say thank you."

Anna and Tom said thank you. They took turns. They were careful. They read the book. They saw the princess and the dragon and the castle. They liked the book. They liked each other. They were happy.

Once upon a time there was an old man. He was very generous. He liked to visit people and bring them presents. Every day he would get into his old vehicle and drive off looking for someone to visit.

One day he came across a small town and decided to stop and visit. He went from house to house looking for someone to give a present to. Finally, he found a little 3 year old girl. When she opened the door she was so excited to see the old man with a big smile on his face.

The old man was generous and gave the little girl a special toy. She was so happy and thanked him for the wonderful gift. He gave her a big hug and said goodbye. The old man drove away in his old vehicle, smiling thinking of the little girl's face filled with joy.

Once upon a time, there was a lovely stack of toys. All the toys were different shapes and colours. Imagine playing with all the lovely toys!

The stack reached up high as far as the eye could see. The toys were shiny and sparkly and so much fun to play with. Little ones loved to pick up the toys and show them to everyone.

Molly and her mom walked around the zoo, looking at the elephants and the monkeys. Suddenly, Molly saw the giraffes. She asked her mom in a loud voice, "Mom, can we stay to see the giraffes?"

Molly's mom answered, "Yes, Molly. We can remain here and watch the giraffes for a while."

Once there was a mommy and a baby. Mommy decided to go to the store and buy some food. She bought some peppers. They were pink and smelled nice.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Sarah. She was excited to go and play hockey. She put on her skates and grabbed her stick and off she went.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom liked to sleep in the sun all day long. One day, Tom met a dog named Max. Max asked Tom, "Why are you so lazy?" Tom replied, "I don't like to move around too much."

Max and Tom worked together to get the arrow out of the pit. Tom realized he had fun playing with Max and was happy he made a new friend. From then on, Tom was not so lazy anymore and played games with Max every day. The end.

Once there was a little girl named Jane. She really liked to play hide and seek in her house. One day, she came across a hidden vase! Jane was very excited and decided to wrap the vase in a blanket so that it would be safe. 

But then she had a great idea - why not wrap the vase up and give it to her mom as a surprise! So that's exactly what she did.

Jane sneakily wrapped the vase up in some pretty paper and left it under her mom's bed. On her mom's birthday, Jane waited patiently until she came home. When she saw the gift, her mom's eyes lit up and she was so happy.
