Once upon a time, there was a hairy neighbor who lived next door. Everyday, he rose early and went outside to do his chores.

One day, a curious three-year-old boy watched his neighbor as he left his house. He heard his neighbor say, "Good morning beautiful day!"

The curious boy followed him. When his neighbor heard the boy's footsteps, he turned around and smiled. "Oh hello there! How can I help you?" he asked.

The boy replied, "I just wanted to know why you rise so early everyday."

The neighbor replied, "Well, I wake up early so that I can do all my chores in the morning. Then I can have the rest of the day for fun!"

The boy smiled and thanked his neighbor for his wise advice. He went back home and thought about all the fun things he could do if he rose early. 

From that day on, the curious boy rose early everyday, happy with the knowledge his neighbor had shared.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was always very alert and always looking around. One day, she was out in the backyard. She noticed something shiny on the ground. It was a marble. She went to pick it up and mention it to her mom. 

Her mom was very happy and said it was a special marble. She told the little girl that she could keep it as a prize. 

The little girl was so excited. She held onto the marble tightly. She ran back out to the backyard, but this time she was even more alert. She wanted to see if she could find more marbles. 

The little girl spent the whole afternoon looking and searching, but all she found was an old shoe. She showed it to her mom and they laughed. 

The little girl kept the marble safely in her pocket. It became a special reminder of the day she was so alert and found something special.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was very obedient. He always did what his mom and dad told him to do. One day, Tim went to the park with his mom. The park was big and had lots of fun things to do.

At the park, Tim saw a big red ball. He wanted to touch it. But, his mom told him not to touch the ball because it belonged to someone else. Tim felt embarrassed because he didn't know he shouldn't touch it.

Tim was sad but he wanted to be obedient, so he didn't touch the ball. Then, a big dog came and took the ball away. Tim was sad because he didn't get to play with the ball. The dog ran away with the ball and Tim went home with his mom.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Emily and Joe. 

Joe said to Emily, "Let's pretend that we are going on a trip."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going on tours with her family. One day, her parents decided to make a special tour just for her. They took her to the park and showed her all the little animals like squirrels and birds. Lily was so happy!

Once upon a time, there were two best friends, Pat and Tim. Pat was a silly rabbit and Tim was a brave bear.

Every day the two friends played in the meadow, picking flowers, chasing butterflies and talking about their dreams. But one day, something changed between them. 

Pat had a large bubblegum bubble in his hand, and Tim wanted it.

"Give me bubble!" he growled.

But Pat wouldn't budge, he just shook his head and said, "No, it's mine!"

Tim was very angry, and he stomped away, yelling, "You don't want to be my friend anymore!"

When he was gone, Pat began to weep. He felt so lonely and distant without his friend. But soon, a soft voice called to him, "Pat! Pat! It's me, Tim! Come back, I made a new bubblegum bubble for you!"

Pat smiled and hugged his friend. They ran together in the meadow, happy to be best friends again.

Once upon a time, there lived a curious little girl named Lisa. She loved discovering new things and learning about the world. One day, Lisa woke up and saw something special in her bedroom. It was a cozy, warm blanket with big, colorful flowers all over it. 

"Ooh!" Lisa said as she touched the blanket. She felt so curious about it.

"Where did this blanket come from?" Lisa asked her mom.

"Well," her mom answered, "Mommy and Daddy wanted to get you something special, so they learned how to make this blanket for you."

"Wow!" said Lisa. She was so excited to learn that her parents had made this special blanket just for her.

From then on, Lisa and her blanket became best friends. With her blanket beside her, she felt safe, warm and most of all, learned something new.

Lila and Ben were at the beach with their mom and dad. They liked to play in the sand and look for shells. Sometimes they saw fish and crabs in the water. They were happy and had fun.

One day, they saw something big and gray in the water. It was a whale! The whale was swimming and splashing. Lila and Ben were excited and wanted to see it closer. They ran to the water and waved at the whale.

"Hello, whale!" they shouted. "Do you want to play with us?"

But their mom and dad were scared. They knew that whales were dangerous and could hurt them. They called Lila and Ben to come back.

"Lila, Ben, come here!" they said. "The whale is dangerous! You can't go near it!"

Lila and Ben did not listen. They thought the whale was friendly and wanted to be their friend. They kept running to the water.

Suddenly, the whale made a loud noise. It was a cry. The whale was sad and lonely. It wanted to find its family, but it was lost. It did not want to play with Lila and Ben. It wanted to go home.

Lila and Ben heard the whale's cry. They felt sorry for the whale. They stopped running and looked at the whale.

"Are you okay, whale?" they asked. "Why are you crying?"

The whale looked at Lila and Ben. It saw that they were kind and curious. It did not want to hurt them. It wanted to tell them its story.

But the whale could not talk to Lila and Ben. It could only make noises. It cried again and swam away.

Lila and Ben watched the whale go. They were sad and confused. They did not understand why the whale was crying. They wanted to help the whale.

They ran back to their mom and dad. They hugged them and told them what they saw.

"Mom, dad, the whale was crying!" they said. "It was not dangerous! It was sad!"

Their mom and dad listened to Lila and Ben. They were glad that they were safe and sorry that the whale was sad. They explained to Lila and Ben that whales were wild animals and that they had to be careful around them. They also told them that whales had feelings and that they needed their families.

Lila and Ben learned something new that day. They learned that whales were amazing and mysterious. They learned that whales could cry and that they could feel. They learned that whales were not dangerous, but they were different.

They hoped that the whale would find its family and be happy again. They wished that the whale would come back and visit them someday. They said goodbye to the whale and thanked it for showing them its world.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Elizabeth who was three years old. She was walking in the park one day when she noticed something exciting. She saw a big machine and went to take a look closer. She saw that it was a massage machine. She was eager to try it out and lay down on the bed.

When it was done, she thanked the machine then went to find her mommy.

"Mommy! I had a massage!" Elizabeth said excitedly as she hugged her mom.

Her mommy smiled and said, "That's great, darling! I'm glad you enjoyed it." 

Elizabeth smiled back, eager for next time.

Once upon a time, there was a little bird named Pip. Pip lived in a big tree with lots of branches. One day, Pip was flying around when he saw a big, bitter fruit on a branch. 

Pip landed on the branch and said, "What is this bitter fruit?" A wise old owl was sitting on another branch nearby and heard Pip's question. The owl said, "That's a persimmon fruit. It's very bitter, but some people like it. Would you like me to explain more about it?"

Pip nodded his head and the owl continued, "Persimmons are fruits that grow on trees. They are orange and round, but they taste very bitter until they are ripe. Then they become sweet and delicious to eat." 

Pip thanked the owl and flew away, feeling grateful for the new knowledge he had learned. He decided to try a persimmon fruit when it was ripe, so he could taste the sweetness for himself.

Once upon a time, there was a little pig. He was looking for his friend, the cow. He hopped and jumped to find her. But all he could find was mud. The mud was sticky and dirty.

The farmer saw the pig and yelled, "What are you doing here?! Go away!". He took out a big key and locked the gate.

Mom smiled and said, "We decided to leave the ship because it was time to try something new. Maybe we will find a much cleaner place to start a new life."

Once upon a time, there was a big, wealthy family who lived in a big house. They had a lot of money and toys. The toys had different textures, some were soft and some were hard. The family had a garden where they grew vegetables and fruits.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jenny. She was very creative and she loved to use her imagination in everything she did. She was in her bedroom one day and she noticed something strange.

Jenny: "Mommy, what is that?"

Mom: "That, Jenny, is a bed."

Jenny: "A bed? What's a bed?"

Mom: "Well, a bed is a place to sleep and rest. Now, why don't you climb into it and see what it feels like?"

So Jenny climbed into the bed and she recognized that it was very comfy. She snuggled in and it felt warm and cozy.
Jenny: "Mommy, I like this bed!"

Mom: "That's good, Jenny. You are so creative!"

Jenny smiled and snuggled into the bed even more. From then on, she always remembered the feeling of a bed, and it made her feel safe and secure.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Jen. These two friends liked to talk a lot and often discussed stories and books. Today, they were eager to talk about novels. Jack said, "I love novels because they tell exciting stories."

Jen smiled and agreed, "Yes! Novels are so cool! When I read stories, I feel like I'm an adventurer in the book!"

Jack was delighted, "I know! I'm so eager to read more adventures!"

Jen nodded and said, "Let's discuss our favorite novels together!"

The two friends talked and talked about their favorite novels. They both felt happy and excited to share their ideas. At the end of their chat, they were very content and eager to read more stories.

John loved to play in the pond. Every day he splashed around, feeling the cool water and smiling at all the fish he could see. John saw the shadow of a big bird fly past and he knew something special was about to happen.

He started to swim deeper into the pond and when he looked up, he saw a dragon! John was so scared he forgot how to swim and he started to sink. The dragon came closer and closer and John was too scared to move.

The dragon took one last deep breath and breathed fire over John. He screamed, but it was too late. Everything went dark and the dragon flew away.

The other children had seen what had happened and they were all in shock. Nothing like this had ever happened before, it was definitely not normal. The pond was quiet and dark now and nobody felt like splashing around anymore.

Once upon a time, there were two young sheep playing in a field. One was named Dave and the other was named Tina. The sun was shining and the grass was bright green.

Suddenly, Dave let out a loud scream! Tina looked around and saw a giant bear. She was scared and started to run away. Dave was so scared that he ran too. They ran and ran until they were out of the field. 

Tina was so tired that she collapsed on the ground. Dave came over to make sure she was ok. He said, â€œLetâ€™s never go back there again!â€ 

Tina agreed and said, â€œNever!â€ Then they both smiled and went off to find a new place to play without any bears. They were happy and never forgot the scary bear!

Once upon a time, there was a kind and compassionate King who ruled over a peaceful kingdom. Everyone in the kingdom loved the King and they knew he had a big heart. 

One day, a young boy from a nearby village came to the castle. The boy had done something wrong and he was jailed for it. The King wanted to be a forgiving ruler and he wanted to help the boy. 

The King asked the boy why he had done the wrong thing. The boy sadly replied, "I wanted to make my family happy. I wanted to provide for them." 

The King was moved by the boy's plight and his compassion kicked in. He said to the boy, "You have made a mistake but I know you have a good heart. I will provide you with an opportunity to make things right. 

The King let the boy out of jail and the villagers were very happy. The King was loved by all for being so compassionate and forgiving. Everyone admired the wise and kind heart of the King. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a family. The family had a nice house with a fireplace. But one day, the fireplace broke. The family was very sad and did not know what to do.

So the family asked their neighbor to lend them some money to pay for the repairs. The neighbor said yes and the family was so happy. They quickly paid someone to repair the fireplace and it was good again.

But then the family asked the neighbor for another favor. They wanted to borrow some money to buy some new toys. The neighbor said no and the family was very sad.

The family worked for days to try to earn enough money for new toys, but it was not enough. In the end, the fireplace remained broken and the family never got the toys.

Once upon a time, there was a happy dog named Max. Max loved to run and play outside. One day, Max found a trail in the woods. He was very excited to see where it went.

Max walked on the trail and saw many things. He saw big trees, pretty flowers, and little bugs. Max wanted to protect all his new friends in the woods. He barked at the birds to keep them safe.

At the end of the trail, Max found a big lake. He jumped in and splashed around. Max was very happy to find such a fun place. He knew he would come back to the trail and protect his friends every day. And Max lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside in the sun. One day, Timmy saw a big, thick tree in his backyard. He wanted to climb it, but he was too scared. 

Suddenly, Timmy saw his friend Sally waving to him from across the yard. Sally was holding a toy laser gun. Timmy thought it was cool and asked if he could play too. Sally said yes and they started to play together. 

As they played, Timmy forgot about the tree and had so much fun with Sally. They ran around and pretended to shoot lasers at each other. Timmy felt happy and grateful to have such a good friend like Sally.

Once upon a time a little girl called Daisy was playing with her toys. Suddenly, Daisy's mummy said it was time to go out shopping. Daisy didn't want to go and she started to insist that she should stay at home. But mummy was very firm and she said no, it was time to go. 

At the shop, Daisy wanted to take the first step inside but mummy asked her to be patient and wait until mummy gave her the green light to go in. Daisy didn't like this and started to get rude. She shouted and crossed her arms, refusing to move. 

Mummy stayed cool and calmly explained to Daisy that it was necessary to wait and not be rude. Eventually, Daisy understood and went into the shop with mummy. 

Daisy had a great time at the shop and even picked out a toy for herself to take home. From then on, Daisy was careful never to be rude again!

There were two friends, Jane and Sam. They liked to share things together. One day, they decided to make a sound. Jane thought it would be a difficult one. Sam thought it would be an easy one. They both tried to make the same sound.

At first, it was difficult for both of them, but they kept trying. They kept making the sound until they both got it right. Jane and Sam were so happy that they shared it with everyone. Everyone cheered when they heard the sound. 

Jane and Sam both smiled. They had done it! They had shared something together. Sharing was so much fun!

Tommy woke up early one morning. He was very excited because he had a special surprise. He raced to his room to get ready. 

When he went downstairs, he saw a big box on the table. His mom smiled and said, "Good morning, Tommy. Do you want to see what I have for you?" 

Tommy nodded. He opened the box and found an icy book. "This is for you," said Mom. "It's a book and you can read it." 

Tommy was very excited. He opened it and started reading straight away. He read and read, even after breakfast. He read until the sun was high in the sky and it was time to go outside. 

Tommy smiled. He was looking forward to reading more of his book in the morning.

Once upon a time, there was a mommy and a little girl who loved to perform. Every spring, they would go to the park and dance a special dance together.

One day they went to the park again, and the little girl was upset. She wanted to perform her dance all by herself, but mommy said she was too little to do it alone.

The little girl started to cry. She was so upset that she had to perform with mommy. Mommy tried to tell her it was ok and even gave her a hug, but the little girl kept crying.

Finally, mommy said they should leave the park. They got in the car and drove away. The little girl kept crying all the way home, and she was so upset that she never went back to the park to perform her special dance.

Once upon a time, there was a cute little girl named Jenny. She really enjoyed playing with her toys and loved the cold winter months. One winter, Jenny decided she wanted to go and visit a reindeer.

So, Jenny put her warmest coat on and set off to the nearest park. When she got there, she was very excited to see a big, beautiful reindeer. Jenny walked up to the reindeer, wanting to give it a big hug. 

The reindeer smiled at Jenny and said, â€œHello! Would you like to enjoy a ride on my back? Iâ€™m available to take you around the park.â€ Jenny was so excited, she couldnâ€™t contain her happiness. 

Jenny hopped onto the reindeer's back and held onto its antlers. The reindeer started to walk around the park and Jenny was so amazed at how fast it was going! They went around a few times before the reindeer said, â€œThat was fun! I hope you enjoyed it". 

Jenny smiled and said, â€œYes, thank you so much! I really enjoyed my ride.â€ She quickly hugged the reindeer before running back home, happy with her amazing adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a very cheerful cop. He loved his job and kept everyone safe. One day, he was having a tough time. He was trying to solve a difficult problem! 

Just then, a little three year old walked up to him. "What's wrong?" the little one asked with a smile.

The cop smiled too, happy to have help. He said, "I'm trying to solve this problem, but I can't figure it out. Can you help me?"

The little one frowned and kicked a rock. Then, all of a sudden, she had an idea. She clapped her hands and said, "I know! Let's go ask my mom!" 

The cop and the little one went to her mom and asked for her help. After a few minutes, the problem was solved! 

The cop smiled from ear to ear and thanked the little one, saying, "Thank you for being so cheerful and helping me solve the problem!" 

The little one smiled back, happy that she could help.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, her mommy said, "Lily, it's time to take a nap." But Lily didn't want to nap because she wanted to keep playing. 

Later that day, Lily's mommy was getting ready to go out. She was putting on her makeup, but Lily wanted to play with it too. Her mommy said, "No, Lily. You can't play with my makeup. It's not a toy." This made Lily sad.

Lily went to her room and sat on her bed. She thought about how she could make her mommy happy. Then, she had an idea. She went to her mommy's makeup and used her fingers to make it smooth. When her mommy saw what Lily had done, she was so happy and said, "Lily, you are such a good helper!" From then on, Lily knew that even though she didn't want to nap, she could still make her mommy happy by being helpful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to run. She ran so fast that she won a medal! It was shiny and made her very happy. One day, Lily went to the park to run and she saw a unique bird. It had bright colors and a long tail. The bird appeared out of nowhere and Lily was so amazed that she stopped running to watch it. After a while, the bird flew away and Lily continued to run, feeling grateful for the special moment she had just experienced.

Terry was a tall boy. He had a special jacket. It was made for stretching. Every morning, Terry put on his special jacket and started stretching. He would stretch his arms above his head, reach down to his toes, and twist from side to side. He loved stretching in his favorite jacket.

One day, Terry saw his friend Jack stretching too. He asked Jack, "Why are you stretching?" Jack said, "I'm stretching because it keeps me healthy!" Terry thought that was a great idea and decided to stretch more with his special jacket.

As Terry stretched, he felt his body getting stronger and taller. He kept stretching each morning and saw that he was growing taller and taller each day. He even convinced his friends to join him and stretch together.

Terry became very good at stretching and was proud of his special jacket. He kept stretching his arms, reaching his toes, and twisting from side to side. Terry always remembered one thing: stretching in his special jacket made him feel strong, healthy, and most of all, tall!

Once there was a little girl who was excited to go to the beach. As she ran onto the sand, she looked out and admired the sparkling blue sea. She saw a big boat on the horizon and she was amazed. She clapped her hands together and smiled with glee. 

The little girl spotted a lady walking along the beach. The lady was carrying a big basket and the little girl wondered what was inside. She skipped up to the lady and asked if she could take a peek. 

The lady grinned and said yes, so the little girl peered inside to find lots of beautiful shells. The lady said each one was unique and special, just like a person's heart. The little girl felt special too and was excited to find the special shell of her own. She looked around and admired the different shells until she found one with a pretty pattern. The little girl hugged it close and said thank you to the lady.

The little girl was excited to have her special shell. As she walked home along the beach, she kept admiring and admiring her precious shell and feeling the specialness in her heart.

Once upon a time there was a fit elephant. Every day he went for a long walk in the forest. He looked around and saw all the animals who were wild and free. The elephant loved feeling the sunshine on his back as he ambled around the woods.

One afternoon, the elephant felt exhausted. He stopped and lay down beneath a big tree. He was so tired, he decided to have a nap. He curled up and went to sleep.

The elephant slept for a long time and dreamed of the days ahead. When he woke up, he felt refreshed and ready to continue his journey. He stood up, stretched his trunk, and said goodbye to the forest. Then, he set off on his way again.

The fit elephant happily returned home after his nap. He had had a wonderful day exploring the forest and resting under a tree. He knew he was ready for more adventures ahead.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, Sam and Tess. Sam and Tess loved to play together every day. So, one day they decided to go to the park.

At the park, they saw a grape vine. Sam thought it would be fun to pick some grapes and eat them. Tess thought that was a silly idea and said no. But Sam kept asking and Tess finally said ok. 

They each picked two grapes and ate them. Then Sam said, "Let's pick some more. I'll own a bunch of grapes!" He picked four more grapes and Tess thought her friend was silly.

But it was a good idea, because when they got home, Sam's mom was so happy that he owned some grapes. She made them all a special snack with grape juice and a huge bowl of grapes to share.

It was the best snack ever and Tess and Sam had fun eating it. From then on, whenever Sam and Tess went to the park together, they picked some grapes for a snack. Of course, Tess thought it was still silly but it was also lots of fun!

Once upon a time there were two friends named Max and Molly. They both liked to play at the club together.

Max was a careful boy and Molly was very curious. They both wanted to try something new. So they thought they could start a club! 

They decided to call it, 'The Mind Club'. It was a place where they would use their minds to make new ideas. Each day they would come up with something that was creative and fun.

Molly and Max started their new club and they loved it. They both kept careful minds so that they would have lots of new ideas. They even shared them with their other friends at the club.

Max and Molly were so happy with their club. It was the perfect way to use their minds in creative ways.  They kept being careful to come up with new ideas and to have lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was an enormous bubble. But the little bubble was not happy. It wanted to improve. 

The bubble looked around and saw lots of other bubbles. As it watched them, it noticed they seemed to be getting bigger and bigger. 

The little bubble had an idea. â€œI want to get bigger too!â€ it shouted, and set off on its mission to find a way to improve. 

The bubble searched far and wide and came across a magical pond. Inside the pond was a hidden secret - a bright, sparkly potion. 

The bubble drank the potion and felt its body start to grow. It grew, and grew, and grew until it was enormous! 

The bubble was so happy with its transformation. It had improved! Now it was ready to go back and show off its new size to all the other bubbles.

Once there was a small girl who liked to collect. Everywhere she went she collected things. She was never without some item she was collecting.

One day, the girl found a brick. She thought it was so cool and wanted to add it to her collection. She picked it up, put it in her pocket, and kept collecting.

She soon realized that the brick made it hard to hear. She was almost deaf with the brick in her pocket!

The girl decided that the brick wasn't really a fun thing to have in her collection. She put it back down where she had found it, and kept collecting without it. From then on, her collection was much easier to hear!

Once upon a time, there lived a mighty mouse in a valley. Every day he would spin around the valley very fast. 

One day, he caught sight of a rabbit. He stopped his spinning and said, "Good day, Rabbit. What brings you here." 

The Rabbit replied, "I like watching you spin! You are so mighty and fast. I was wondering if you could teach me how to do the same." 

The mouse smiled and said, "Yes, I sure can! With some practice, you too can spin like me!" 

The rabbit was excited and tried to spin but found it difficult at first. But the mouse encouraged him to keep practicing and soon the rabbit was spinning around the valley like the mighty mouse!

Once upon a time there was a humble farmer. Every day he requested help from the animals on his farm, but they were too busy to help him.

One day he asked the animals to help him build a raft. The animals were excited and gathered some wood from the forest. They also gathered some strong rope to tie the raft together.

The farmer thanked the animals for their help as they finished building the raft. He happily said he would use the raft to move around the lake. 

The animals waved goodbye as the farmer requested, and the raft slowly moved away. He was so happy with the raft! 

The humble farmer thanked the animals every time he saw them, as they had helped him make his raft a reality.

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat onions, but his mom always said they were too strong for him. One day, Timmy saw a small onion in the kitchen and he wanted to try it. 

"Mommy, can I try this small onion?" Timmy asked. 

"Are you sure, Timmy? Onions can be very strong," his mom replied. 

But Timmy was determined to try the small onion. He took a bite and made a funny face. It was too strong for him! 

From that day on, Timmy listened to his mom and never tried to eat a small onion again. He learned that sometimes things that seem small can still be very powerful.

Once upon a time, there was a big and noisy lion. He liked to roar all the time and make a lot of noise. One day, he went into a cave and saw a knob. He started to play with it and turned it round and round. Suddenly, the knob came off and the lion got scared. 

He realized that he shouldn't have played with things that didn't belong to him. He felt bad and decided to go and apologize to the owner of the cave. The owner forgave him and told him that it's important to be careful with other people's things. 

From that day on, the lion learned to be more careful and not to make too much noise. He realized that being noisy all the time wasn't good and that it's important to be considerate of others.

Once upon a time there was a mighty superhero. She had special powers and could do anything. She was brave and never afraid of a challenge.

One day she saw some dust and wanted to touch it. She flew over to it and put her finger in the dust. Suddenly she felt a powerful energy coming from the dust.

The superhero asked, "What is this?"

The dust said, "I am powerful and I can hurt you."

The superhero said, "No way, I'm too mighty for you."

But the dust was too powerful, and with a puff of wind, it blew the superhero away, never to be seen again. 

The dust laughed and spread itself all over the land, haphazardly and undisciplined. The dust was mighty and had won the day.

Lily and Tom were twins who liked to play in the garden. One day, they saw a big jar of jelly on the table. They wanted to taste it, but they were too small to reach it.

"Let's crawl to the table and get the jelly," Tom said.

"OK, but be quiet. Mommy is sleeping in the sofa," Lily said.

They crawled slowly and quietly across the grass. They saw a lot of bugs and flowers on the way. They said hello to them, but the bugs and flowers did not answer.

They reached the table and climbed on a chair. They saw the jar of jelly shining in the sun. It looked yummy and colorful.

"Wow, look at the jelly. It is red and green and yellow," Tom said.

"Can I have some?" Lily asked.

"Sure, let me open the jar," Tom said.

He tried to open the jar, but it was too tight. He twisted and pulled, but the jar did not move.

"Help me, Lily," he said.

Lily helped him, but the jar was still too tight. They pushed and pulled, but the jar did not move.

They were so busy trying to open the jar that they did not hear Mommy waking up. She saw them on the table and smiled.

"What are you doing, my little ones?" she asked.

They looked at her and smiled back.

"We want some jelly, Mommy," they said.

Mommy laughed and hugged them.

"OK, let me help you with the jar. But first, let's wash your hands. They are dirty from crawling," she said.

She took them to the sink and washed their hands. Then she opened the jar and gave them each a spoon of jelly.

They tasted the jelly and made happy noises.

"Mmm, this is good jelly, Mommy," Tom said.

"Thank you, Mommy. We love you," Lily said.

Mommy kissed them and said, "I love you too, my sweeties. Now, let's go back to the sofa and have a peaceful nap. You must be tired from crawling."

They nodded and followed her to the sofa. They cuddled with her and fell asleep. They dreamed of jelly and bugs and flowers.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved going to his classroom. He liked playing with his friends and learning new things from his teacher. One day, Timmy's teacher asked the class to count how many pencils they had on their desk.

Timmy was excited to count the pencils, but he couldn't find his. He looked under his desk, in his backpack, and even asked his friends if they had taken it. But he still couldn't find it. When the teacher asked Timmy how many pencils he had, he felt embarrassed and sad. He didn't want to tell the truth that he lost his pencil.

The next day, Timmy's teacher surprised him with a new pencil. Timmy felt happy and grateful. He learned that it's okay to make mistakes and ask for help. From that day on, Timmy always made sure to count his pencils and keep them safe in his backpack.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Spot. Spot was very upset because he was lost and couldn't find his mommy. He walked and walked, but he couldn't find her. 

Just when Spot was about to cry, he saw another puppy. This puppy was lost too! Spot ran to the other puppy and they sniffed each other. They were happy to have found a friend. 

Spot and the other puppy decided to unite and look for their mommies together. They walked and walked, and finally, they found their mommies. Spot was so happy to be reunited with his mommy, and he was grateful for his new friend.

Once upon a time there was a naughty mouse. He was always looking for trouble. One day, he saw some cheese and decided to take it! He was so excited to take the cheese that he quickly scurried over to it.

But then he face a problem -- how could he eat the cheese? He didn't want to just bite into it -- it was too hard!

Then he had a clever idea. He grabbed a piece of wood and cut the cheese into small, bite-sized pieces. It was so easy to eat!

The naughty mouse gobbled up all the cheese. He was so happy that he had found a way to get the cheese that he ran off, his belly full and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mommy gave her a big blue candy. Lily was so happy and started eating it right away. But then, she saw her little brother looking at her with sad eyes. He wanted some candy too.

Lily knew she had to share, so she decided to wrap half of the candy and give it to her brother. He was so happy and gave her a big hug. Lily felt happy too, because she knew it was the right thing to do.

The moral of the story is that sharing is important and makes others happy too.

John was a curious boy. He had a guitar and he spent a lot of time rubbing it. One day, John wanted to take his guitar outside to show it off, but his mom said no. He was very sad, but still curious.

John's Dad had an idea. He said if John polished the guitar, it might make it look nicer. John liked the idea and started rubbing it with a soft cloth. He rubbed and rubbed until the guitar shined.

When he was done, his Dad asked him to play his guitar. John was so excited! He started strumming and soon the whole house was filled with music. Everyone was smiling.

John was so happy and he knew his guitar looked nice too. He was curious to see what other people thought of it. So he took it to the park to show it off. Everyone was amazed by John's guitar and he was so proud. The whole day, they admired it and asked questions.

John realized that sometimes, things don't work out the way you expect them to. But if you are curious and work hard, then you can make something beautiful.

Anna likes to play with her furry cat, Luna. Luna is black and white and has green eyes. Luna likes to chase balls and mice and nap in the sun. Anna and Luna are best friends.

One day, Anna and Luna go outside to play in the garden. The sun is shining and the flowers are pretty. Anna sees a butterfly and runs after it. Luna sees a bird and runs after it. They are having fun.

But then, Anna and Luna get hungry. They look for some food. Anna sees a basket of apples and pears. Luna sees a bowl of milk and fish. They run to the food and eat it. They are happy.

But then, Anna and Luna hear a loud noise. They look up and see a big dog. The dog is brown and has a long tail. The dog barks and runs to them. They are scared.

Anna and Luna run away from the dog. They run to the house and hide under the bed. They hug each other and wait for the dog to go away. They are safe.

Anna and Luna learn a lesson. They should not eat food that is not theirs. They should ask first. They should also be careful of big dogs. They should stay close to each other. They are still best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved roses and always wanted one for herself. One day, she saw a beautiful rose in her neighbor's garden and wanted it badly. She went to her neighbor and said, "I want your rose, please give it to me." 

The neighbor replied, "I'm sorry, but this rose is mine. You can't have it." Lily became very sad and miserable. She cried and cried because she wanted the rose so much. 

The next day, Lily decided to take the rose without asking for permission. She went to the neighbor's garden and picked the rose. But as soon as she picked it, she realized that it was wrong. She felt guilty and scared. 

When the neighbor found out, she was very angry and called Lily's parents. Lily's parents were disappointed and scolded her for taking something that wasn't hers. Lily learned that it's not right to take things that belong to others and that it's always better to ask nicely.

Henry stared at the wagon. It was big, red and filled with toys. He was impatient to go for a ride. He pulled at it but it wouldn't move. He shouted for help. 

His mom came running over. She put him in the wagon and held the handle. Henry smiled and shouted with joy.

The wagon began to move. Henry watched the houses and trees go by. He waved at some kids he saw playing in a garden.

Suddenly, the wagon stopped. Henry stared ahead. There was an ice cream shop! His mom took out some money and promised him a treat. Henry smiled and was no longer impatient.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved going to the beach with her family. One day, while playing in the water, she saw a cute little crab. She wanted to catch it and take it home with her.

Lily tried to grab the crab, but it quickly scurried away. She chased after it, but it disappeared into the waves. Lily was sad and disappointed. Her mom explained to her that it's not nice to take animals from their homes. It's important to order and respect nature.

Lily learned her lesson and promised to be kind to all creatures. From that day on, she enjoyed watching the waves and all the cute animals that lived in the ocean.

One day, Sam, a little boy, was walking along the beach. He saw a pretty little lake, with some frogs swimming in it. He waved to the frogs and they waved back.

Sam liked playing with the frogs and they liked playing with him too. Sam liked to take his name tag to the lake and show the frogs his name.

But one day, something bad happened. A big, mean bully saw Sam in the lake, playing with the frogs, and shouted his name. Sam was so scared that he tried to run away.

But it was too late. The bully caught up with Sam and shouted, "You're Mine!" Sam was so scared he couldn't move. The bully grabbed Sam and squeezed him so tightly that Sam couldn't breathe. The bully then threw Sam in a big, dark cave with no way out. 

Sam was never seen again.

One day, Bill went to the grocery store with his mom. He was excited because grocery stores were such a fun place filled with lots of tasty treats.

When Bill and his mom arrived, it was dark inside the grocery store. But Bill didn't let that stop him from having a good time. He kept running around the store and checking out all the cool things!

Suddenly, Bill heard someone shouting. He tried to remember where he was, but he couldn't. He looked around and saw that it was very dark in the store. He must have wandered away from his mom!

With a scared feeling in his chest, Bill yelled for help. Eventually, his mom found him and scolded him for wandering off. She reminded him that he should always remember to stay with her when they are in places like the grocery store. 

Bill nodded his head and promised he would stay close to his mom next time. But this time, the dark grocery store had taught him an important lesson - to always remember to stay close to his mom.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Sally. One day, she was feeling very busy because she had lots of things to do. Sally wanted to put all her things in the bin but the bin was too full. Sally tried to push the things down but this only made the bin more full. Sally was getting very angry because she was so busy and she didn't want her things to be all over the floor.

Suddenly, Sally had an idea. She went to the cupboard and she took out several smaller bins. She quickly put her things into the small bins, one by one. This made Sally very happy! She smiled and put the smaller bins in the big bin. Finally all her things were in the bin and she had more space!

Sally felt relieved. She was no longer busy and her things were all neat and tidy. From then on, Sally put all her things in the smaller bins and she was never busy again.

Once upon a time, there was a happy owl. The owl lived in a tree. One day, the owl saw a mouse on the ground. The owl wanted to catch the mouse, but the mouse was too fast. The owl thought of a plan.

The owl decided to lift a big rock and put it in the mouse's way. The mouse would have to go around the rock, and the owl could catch the mouse. The owl lifted the rock with its strong wings and put it in the mouse's way.

The mouse saw the rock and tried to go around it. But the owl was waiting and caught the mouse. The owl was very happy that it caught the mouse. From that day on, the owl knew how to catch its food.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily who loved to play in the forest. One day, she went on a walk with her mommy and they saw a cute bunny peek out from behind a tree. Lily got very excited and said, "Look mommy, the bunny is peeking at us!"

As they continued their walk, they noticed that the forest was not very tidy. There were leaves and sticks all over the ground. Lily's mommy said, "We should pick up the sticks and make the forest tidy again." Lily helped her mommy pick up the sticks and they put them in a pile.

Suddenly, they heard a loud noise and saw a big bear coming towards them. Lily got scared and said, "Mommy, what do we do?" Once upon a time, there were two friends named Leo and Fred. They loved playing together. One day, Leo asked Fred to come to  his house. Fred was excited and he immediately followed Leo.

Once upon a time there was a happy tank. He was eager to explore the world around him. So he began to swim and splash through the cool waters.

Lily ran home to get her wagon and came back to the park. She put the skeleton in the wagon and pulled him to the hospital. The doctors fixed his broken leg and the skeleton was able to walk again. 

From that day on, the skeleton and Lily became good friends and would often play together in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily went to the park with her mom. She saw a big, red strawberry and wanted to eat it. But her mom said, "Be careful, Lily! Don't be careless and hurt yourself."

Lily was very excited to eat the strawberry, so she started to hurry and pick it. But then, she saw a butterfly and chased after it. When she came back, the strawberry was gone! She felt sad because she didn't listen to her mom and was too careless.

But then, Lily's mom gave her another strawberry to eat. This time, Lily listened and ate it slowly and carefully. It was the sweetest strawberry she ever tasted! From that day on, Lily learned to be patient and not hurry, so she could enjoy all the yummy things in life.

Once upon a time, there was a little cat named Kitty. Kitty was a healthy cat who loved to play outside. One day, Kitty saw a big tree and wanted to climb it.

Kitty started to climb the tree, but it was hard. Kitty began to struggle. She tried and tried, but she could not climb the tree. Then, a friendly bird saw Kitty and said, "Hello Kitty, do you need help?"

Kitty said, "Yes, I want to go to the meeting at the top of the tree, but I can't climb." The bird said, "Hold on to me, I will help you." So, Kitty held onto the bird and they flew up to the top of the tree.

At the meeting, Kitty met many new friends. They all played and had fun together. When it was time to go home, Kitty thanked the bird for helping her. The bird said, "You're welcome, Kitty. I'm glad I could help you." From that day on, Kitty and the bird were the best of friends.

Lily and Ben were friends who lived in a small village. They liked to play together in the fields and the woods. One day, they found a big stick and decided to pretend it was a sword.

They took turns to hold the stick and say, "I am the king of the village! You have to do what I say!" Then they would fight with the stick and try to make the other one say, "You are the king, I give up!"

They had fun fighting with the stick, but they also got angry sometimes. They did not want to lose or share the stick. They shouted and pushed each other. They forgot to be nice and kind.

Soon, their mothers heard them and came to see what was wrong. They saw Lily and Ben fighting with the stick and making a lot of noise. They were not happy. They took the stick away and said, "You two have to stop fighting! Fighting is not a good way to play. You have to share and be gentle. Say sorry to each other and hug."

Lily and Ben felt bad. They knew their mothers were right. They said sorry to each other and hugged. They did not want to fight anymore. They wanted to be friends again. They said, "Let's go and play something else. Something that does not need a stick. Something that is fun and nice."

They ran off to find a new game. They were ready to play and laugh together. They were happy.

Once there was a little girl called Anna who liked to laugh. She was a very happy girl and always made her family smile.

One day, Anna and her family went to the modern park. She saw a big score board with lots of numbers and lights. Anna thought it was super fun and so she started playing with it.

When she pressed different numbers and buttons, the lights flashed and funny music played. Everyone in the park stopped to watch Anna laugh and play.

Anna's family was so happy to see her smiling. They watched her play with the score board for a long time. At the end of the day, the smiling little girl had made a high score!

Once upon a time there was an old factory. It was very big and very noisy with all the machines running. One day a little girl decided to visit the factory. As she stepped inside, she looked around and saw all the workers busy folding and packing boxes. 

Suddenly, the little girl got an idea and shouted, "I could help too!" The workers chuckled and told her to go ahead. So the little girl went to one of the station and started folding boxes alongside the workers. 

The worker next to her was impressed and said, "You are so clever." The little girl cheered and told the worker, "Thank you. This is so much fun!" And just like that, the little girl and the workers had a happy time in the noisy factory.

Once upon a time, there was a deaf little girl. She liked to celebrate things with her parents, so they decided to have a party. 

They set a table in the middle of the room and put a big, colourful cake on it. They blew up lots of party balloons and hung them around the room, too.

The little girl was so excited. She jumped up and down, clapping her hands, but she couldn't hear her parents laugh. They clapped their hands and smiled at her, so she knew they were celebrating with her.

When the party was over, the little girl smiled. She hugged her parents and waved goodbye to them as they left. Then she went back to the table, picked up a balloon, and stared at it. She couldn't hear the balloon's quiet humming sound, but she knew it was celebrating with her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a green dress and loved to play outside. One day, she went to the park and saw a man with a whistle. He blew the whistle and it made a loud noise. Lily was scared at first, but then she saw that the man was a coach for a soccer team.

The coach gave Lily a ticket to watch the game. She was so excited and ran home to tell her mom. "Mommy, mommy! I got a ticket to see the soccer game!" Lily said. Her mom was happy for her and they went to the game together. They cheered for the green team and had a lot of fun.

After the game, Lily went up to the coach and said, "Thank you for the ticket. I had so much fun watching the game and hearing your whistle." The coach smiled and said, "You're welcome, Lily. I'm glad you enjoyed it." From that day on, Lily loved soccer and always remembered the day she got a ticket to see her first game.

Tom is a cop. He has a big hat and a badge. He helps people and catches bad guys. He likes his job, but sometimes it is tough. He has to work at night and miss his family.

Today, Tom has to go to another town. He has to pack his bag. He puts in his clothes, his toothbrush, his gun and his teddy bear. He loves his teddy bear. He got it when he was a baby. He always takes it with him when he travels.

He says goodbye to his wife and his son. They hug him and kiss him. They tell him to be careful and come back soon. He gets in his car and drives away. He waves to them and smiles.

He hopes he will find the bad guys and make the town safe. He hopes he will not get hurt or scared. He hopes he will see his family again. He holds his teddy bear and feels better. He is a tough cop, but he is also a good dad.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy and his friends were getting ready to play hide-and-seek. Timmy said, "I'm ready to start playing!"

But then, Timmy's friend Johnny accidentally slapped him in the face while they were running. Timmy started to cry and said, "Why did you slap me, Johnny?" Johnny felt bad and said, "I'm sorry, Timmy. I didn't mean to."

Timmy forgave Johnny and they continued playing hide-and-seek. Timmy found the best hiding spot and won the game. Afterward, they all went home and Timmy's mom asked him how his day was. Timmy said, "It was fun, but Johnny accidentally slapped me. But it's okay, we're still friends."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to visit her grandma's house. One day, she asked her mom if she could go see her grandma. Her mom said yes and they went on their way.

When they got there, Lily's grandma gave her a coloring book. Lily loved to color and she picked out her favorite colors to use. She colored the pages with red, blue, and green.

After a while, Lily's mom said it was time to go home. When they stepped outside, Lily noticed that the ground was icy. She said, "Mommy, the ground is icy!" Her mom said, "Yes, be careful so you don't slip." They walked slowly to the car and drove home. Lily was happy to have visited her grandma's house and colored with her favorite colors.

Once upon a time, there was a big, mysterious box. It had many words on it. A little girl named Mia found the box. She was very curious. She wanted to know what was inside.

Mia rubbed the words on the box. She said, "Box, please open." The box opened! Inside, there were toys and books. Mia was very happy. She played with the toys and read the books.

Mia's friend, Tom, came to play. Tom saw the box and said, "Mia, can I play with the toys too?" Mia thought for a moment and then said, "Yes, Tom. We can share the toys and books." They played together and had lots of fun.

The moral of the story is to share with others and be kind.

One day, a little duck named Ducky wanted to cross the river. The river was big and wide. Ducky was scared but wanted to succeed.

Ducky saw a brilliant frog named Froggy. Ducky said, "Froggy, can you help me cross the river?" Froggy said, "Yes, Ducky, I will help you."

So, Ducky and Froggy went to the river. They jumped on the rocks and swam in the water. They crossed the river together. Ducky was happy and said, "Thank you, Froggy." They both smiled and played in the sun.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play basketball with his friends. One day, Timmy's dad bought him a new basketball. Timmy was so happy and couldn't wait to play with it.

When Timmy went to play with his friends, one of them asked to borrow his new basketball. Timmy didn't want to share because he was afraid it would get dirty or broken. But then, Timmy's dad reminded him that sharing is important and that he should let his friend play with the new basketball.

Timmy decided to share and let his friend play with the new basketball. His friend was so happy and thanked Timmy. Timmy felt good inside and realized that sharing is always the right thing to do. And after the game, Timmy and his friends went to get some ice cream. Timmy tried a new flavor and said, "Wow, this tastes great!"

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to sort his toys into different colors. He had a red pile, a blue pile, and a green pile. One day, Timmy's mom gave him a quiz to do. The quiz had pictures of animals and Timmy had to say what animal it was. Timmy did really well and got a clear sticker as a prize.

But then, Timmy's little sister came into the room and knocked over all of his toy piles. Timmy got really angry and started to yell. His sister started to cry and Timmy felt bad. He tried to sort his toys again, but he couldn't remember which toy went where. Timmy felt sad and went to bed without his clear sticker.

Once upon a time, there was a little radio. It was very heavy. The radio lived in a small room with a big window. The radio liked to be near the window so it could hear the birds sing.

One day, a little girl named Amy came to the room. She saw the heavy radio and said, "Oh, you are so heavy! Can you be my friend?" The radio was happy and said, "Yes, I can be your friend." Amy and the radio liked to play together.

Every day, Amy would come to the room and listen to the radio. They would sing songs and listen to stories. The heavy radio was happy to be Amy's friend. They had lots of fun together. And they lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was an ignorant baby. He was sitting in the garden and playing with some rocks. Suddenly, he noticed something strange and went over to take a look.

He saw a frog, sitting there in the dirt. The baby asked the frog, "What are you doing?"

The frog replied, "I'm just minding my own business."

The baby thought this was so funny. He laughed and said, "I like that. I'm going to mind my own business too!"

He then went back to playing with his rocks and the frog went back to minding its own business. The two were happy and content, each one doing what they were meant to do. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Clara and her mom. Clara was very sick and her mom wanted to see if her fever had gone down. Clara's mom thought that the best way to do that was to take out Clara's thermometer.

Clara's mom said to Clara, â€œI am going to pull out your thermometer sweetie, so that I can see if your fever is better.â€ Clara nodded and was very calm as her mom pulled the thermometer out of its box.

Once the thermometer was out, her mom smiled, â€œYour fever is much better now, let's go have a nice rest.â€

The moral of this story is - a little patience goes a long way! If we take our time, we can get things done calmly and efficiently. Plus it also encourages positive health outcomes.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a box of delicate shapes. She loved to play with them. The shapes were all different colors and sizes.

One day, Lily decided to match the shapes. She put the red circle with the red square, and the blue triangle with the blue star. She had so much fun matching them!

In the end, Lily had matched all of her delicate shapes. She was very happy. She put them back in the box and went to tell her mom about her fun game.

John was walking through the park, and he was starting to shiver. He was wearing a cheap sweater, so it wasn't keeping him very warm. He saw a pear tree and he decided to have a look. There were lots of pears growing on the tree, and they looked delicious. John picked the biggest pear he could find. It felt soft and smooth in his hands, and he was happy. He took a bite of the pear and it was so sweet and juicy! John suddenly stopped shivering, he was feeling much warmer. He was so pleased with his cheap find! John finished the pear and went home with a big smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved motorcycles and he always dreamed of having one. One day, he saw a man riding a big motorcycle and he asked him, "Can I ride your motorcycle?" The man replied, "No, it's not safe for a little boy like you."

Timmy was sad and tired of waiting to ride a motorcycle. Then, he met a girl named Lily. They became good friends and Timmy told her about his dream of riding a motorcycle. Lily said, "I know someone who can help you. He's my uncle and he has a motorcycle. Maybe he can teach you how to ride it."

Timmy was so happy and grateful to Lily. He went to meet her uncle and he taught him how to ride the motorcycle safely. Timmy was so excited that he said, "Lily, when I grow up, I'm going to marry you for being such a good friend and helping me achieve my dream." Lily smiled and said, "I'm happy to be your friend forever." The moral of the story is that true friendship can help you achieve your dreams.

Once upon a time, there were two friends named Sam and Jessie. Sam was a cool giraffe and Jessie was a brave lion.

One day, Sam and Jessie decided to go for a walk in the park. They were having so much fun that they didn't notice the sun had gone down and it was getting dark.

In the middle of the park, they saw a tree with lots of hearts hanging from its branches. Sam said: "I wonder what it is?" 

Jessie answered: "I think it's somebody's way of showing their love to the ones they care about. Do you want to hang one of your hearts?" 

Sam thought it was a great idea and took out a red heart from his pocket. He looked for the perfect branch and then hung it. He smiled and said: "That's my way of showing my love". 

Jessie smiled too, and said: "That's really cool Sam. Let's keep walking before it gets too dark". Sam and Jessie left the park with a big smile, because their hearts were full with love.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who lived in a house with a big hedge. She liked to play outside and run around the hedge. One day, she saw a bird sitting on the hedge and she wanted to catch it. She climbed up the hedge but she was clumsy and fell down. She hurt her leg and cried.

Her mother came outside and asked what happened. The little girl told her that she fell down from the hedge and hurt her leg. Her mother knew that she shouldn't have climbed the hedge because it was dangerous. She took her inside to make her feel better. Unfortunately, the little girl's leg got worse and she had to go to the hospital. The doctor said that she had broken her leg and needed a cast. The little girl was sad and couldn't play outside anymore. She knew she shouldn't have climbed the hedge.

Once upon a time there was a young musician. She played her music in the park every day. The musician was very polite and she always smiled at everyone.

One day while she was playing, she saw a little girl who looked very sad. The musician asked her what was wrong and the little girl said that she was tired and her legs hurt.

So the musician took the little girl to a shady spot for her to rest. She lay down and almost immediately fell fast asleep. 

The musician sat with the little girl until she woke up. The little girl was feeling better, and thanked the musician for being so kind. The little girl said that she had been having a bad day, but lying in the park with the polite musician had really made her feel better. 

The musician said it was no problem and they both smiled. The little girl waved goodbye and the musician went back to playing her music.

Once upon a time there was a big house with an attic. Daddy said it was time to move some of the things into the attic so they could provide more space to play. 

Mummy and Daddy took big boxes up the stairs and into the attic. They put old toys, clothes and chairs in the boxes and made them all neat. Then they went back downstairs. 

Mummy said the attic was flexible now they had put lots of things in there. Daddy said it was great because now they had lots of space to play. 

Every now and then if Mummy and Daddy needed something from the attic, they would go up the stairs to get it. But most of the time the attic was left alone. 

And the family was very happy because they had lots of space and the attic was very flexible. The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her backyard, but her mommy always told her to stay inside the fence. Lily didn't like the fence because it made her feel trapped, but she trusted her mommy and knew it was for her own safety.

One day, Lily was feeling very sleepy and wanted to take a nap. She asked her mommy if she could take a nap outside, but her mommy said no because she was afraid Lily would wander outside the fence while she was sleeping. Lily was sad, but she trusted her mommy and took a nap inside the house.

When she woke up, Lily saw that her mommy had put up a little tent inside the fence for her to play in. Lily was so happy and grateful that her mommy had thought of her and kept her safe. From then on, Lily never felt trapped by the fence again because she knew her mommy was always looking out for her.

One day, there was a bad man. He was a terrible man. He liked to steal things, like sunglasses. He crept into the house of a nice man and tried to steal his sunglasses.

But the nice man saw the bad man, and he was very angry. He shouted, "No! You must not steal!" The bad man was very scared and he ran away. He was very sad and he felt bad.

The nice man was happy. He was glad that the bad man had not stolen his sunglasses. He put them back on his head and enjoyed the sunshine. He was very glad that the bad man had not been successful.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She was 3 years old, and she was always very careful. She was never late and never slipped up. 

But one day, when she was playing in the park, she wasn't careful enough. All of a sudden, she slipped on the rough ground and fell. As she landed, she felt a sharp pain on her neck.

At first, Lily was scared, but her mom was there to help. She hugged Lily and told her that she was going to be okay. She also said to always be careful when playing.

The next day, Lily was very careful. She remembered her mom's words and did her best not to fall again. She kept her eyes on the ground and walked slowly. 

But then, when she felt something squishy beneath her feet, she accidentally fell again! This time, she was more prepared. She knew how to fall in a way that would better protect her neck. 

When she got up, she felt relieved. Thanks to her mom's advice, she had avoided getting hurt again. She learned that it was important to be careful and to always be prepared.

Once there was a poor family. One day, they saw an amazing luxury appear in the distance. It was a big, fancy house with a big garden behind it. They thought maybe they could stay there if they asked the owners nicely.

The family knocked on the door of the house. A kind old man opened the door and welcomed them in. He said they could stay in the house as long as they wanted. They were so happy and felt so peaceful now that they were going to have a luxury stay.

The old man offered them food and asked them what their plan was. But the family had no plan, so the old man said, "I'll tell you what, I'll give you this house, so you can stay here forever, and never worry about money again." The family was overjoyed and thanked the old man.

But when they went inside the house, they realized that their dream of a peaceful, luxurious stay was just an illusion. The old man had tricked them! Inside the house, there were many hidden cameras and microphones. The old man was watching and listening to everything they did!

The family was devastated. They had realized too late that the old man's generosity was only a trap. They had to escape the house before the old man caught them. The family ran away in the dark of night, never to appear in that house again.

Once upon a time, there was a big player named Max. He was enormous and loved to play with his friends. One day, he got a letter in the mail. It was a surprise from his grandma! Max was so happy and ran to show his friends. They all looked at the letter and smiled. 

Max's friends asked him what was inside the letter. Max didn't know, so he opened it up. Inside was a picture of his grandma and a toy for him to play with. Max was so excited and thanked his grandma by writing her a letter back. He put it in the mail and waited for her to get it. 

A few days later, Max's grandma wrote back to him. She said she was happy he liked the toy and that she loved him very much. Max was so happy to get another letter in the mail from his grandma. He showed his friends and they all smiled again. They loved getting letters too!

Jake was playing with his friends outside. He found something smelly in a bush nearby. It was a post! Jake was curious and wanted to see what was inside. He took a pair of scissors and started to cut the post open.

Inside the post was a package that was wrapped in bright coloured paper. Jake was excited and started to unwrap it. Inside he found a big smelly cheese.

It was a big surprise for Jake. He went inside and shared the cheese with his mom and dad. They all enjoyed the smelly cheese.

Jake was really happy he found the post and cut it open. He was very proud of his discovery.

It was a sunny morning and Jake was playing outside with his toy rake. He loved to use the rake to move the leaves around the garden, like a little farmer.

Suddenly, his dad came out to the garden and he had a big smile on his face.

"Hey, Jake! We have an important job to do", his dad said.

Jake was very excited. What was the important job?

His dad explained. "You need to help me rake all of the leaves in the garden. This is a very important job!"

So Jake and his dad got to work. They raked and raked and it wasn't long before all of the leaves had been collected. 

When they were finished, Jake was feeling very tired.

"That was hard work," he said.

His dad nodded and said, "Yes, it was! Why don't you have a nap now to rest up?"

So that is what Jake did. He had a nap and felt much better afterwards.

John was in the bathroom. He liked to observe the bathtub and was so curious about it. One day, he had a bright idea. He thought it would be fun to play in the bathtub, even though he was not allowed. So, he got inside to play. Suddenly, he heard his mother coming and he quickly got out of the bathtub.

His mother saw him and looked very surprised. She asked why he was in the bathtub and he was so ashamed that he did not answer. He knew he had done something wrong and now he was in trouble.

The next day, John's mother came back to the bathtub, but this time she had a surprise for him. She said she would let him play in the bathtub, but only for a little while and he must always listen to her when she told him not to get in. 

John was so happy and jumped in the bathtub. He was no longer ashamed and instead learned an important lesson. He promised his mother that he would always listen to her and only play in the bathtub when she allowed him.

Mummy and Bob were walking in the park. They saw a big yellow tire. Bob looked excited. He ran and tried to catch it.

Mummy said with a smile, "Be careful, Bob. The tire is very big."

But Bob was determined. He stretched his arms and tried his best. Suddenly, he caught the tire. He beamed with happiness.

Mummy said, "Good job, Bob! Let's take the tire home and play together."

Bob smiled and nodded his head. They took the tire home and played together. They rolled the tire, pushed it, and jumped on it. Bob laughed and giggled. They had so much fun. 

Then it was time to go home. Bob said sadly, "Bye bye, yellow tire!"

Mummy smiled and said, "We can come back and play with the tire again."

Bob smiled, happy for a new adventure.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toys all day long. One day, Timmy was playing with his toy hammer, but he realized that he needed a real tool to fix his broken toy. 

Timmy went to his dad and asked him for a tool. His dad gave him a real hammer and Timmy was so happy! He fixed his broken toy and it was like new again. 

Timmy thought it was funny how a real tool could fix things so easily. He decided that he wanted to be a builder when he grew up so he could fix things all the time. From that day on, Timmy played with his tools and fixed all his broken toys.

Once upon a time, there was a mole living on the cold hillside. The mole had a secret that he wanted to keep safe, so he kept it to himself and whispered softly when he wanted to talk about it. 

One day, while the mole was walking in the cold dust, he heard a sound behind him. He quickly turned around and saw a little girl. She was standing in the cold breeze and looking around until her eyes landed on mole.

The mole smiled and said, â€œFollow me!â€ And the mole showed her his secret spot. At the spot, the little girl found something amazing. The mole smiled and said, â€œThis is my secret, now it can be yours too!â€

Once there was a boy named Jack. He was very curious and loved exploring. One day he went on an adventure and saw something incredible. It was a big, white bathtub in the middle of the forest! Jack was amazed. He carefully stepped inside and began to explore. Everywhere he looked, there were beautiful colors and shapes. He couldn't believe his eyes! 

At the far end of the bathtub, Jack noticed something. Something was staring at him. He felt a little nervous and he slowly looked over. There was a big, fat frog looking right at him! Jack and the frog just stared at each other for a moment before the frog hopped away.

Jack knew he had discovered something really special. He couldn't believe what he had seen. He decided to come back to the incredible bathtub every day to explore more. He was excited to see who else he might meet!

Once upon a time, there was a little bird called Dove. Dove was very nervous because he had never flown before. He was so scared that he didn't want to leave his nest. One day, Dove met a friendly worm. The worm asked Dove why he was so nervous. Dove explained that he was afraid he would fall if he tried to fly.

The worm told Dove that he had to twist his wings and flap them really hard to fly. Dove was still nervous, but he decided to give it a try. He twisted his wings and flapped them as hard as he could. At first, he felt like he was going to fall, but then he started to soar through the sky.

Dove was so happy that he started to sing. A wise old owl heard Dove's song and came to see what was happening. When the owl saw Dove flying, he said, "Remember little Dove, sometimes we have to twist and turn to get where we want to go." Dove nodded and thanked the worm for his advice. From that day on, Dove was never nervous about flying again.

Once upon a time, there was an old painter. He was very busy because he wanted to make the world look beautiful. Every day he painted colourfully on walls and roofs.

One day, the old painter needed to count how many paint buckets he had. He searched high and low but still couldn't find them. He was feeling sad and had a big frown on his face.

Just then, a little 3 year old ran up to him. The old painter was so surprised to see the little one. The little one asked "What are you looking for?".  The old painter replied, "I'm looking for my paint buckets to count".

Seeing the painter's sad face, the 3 year old child said, "Don't worry, I can help you count", and he started counting the paint buckets in twos. With the little one's help, the old painter was able to count all the paint buckets. 

The old painter was so delighted, he thanked the 3 year old with a big hug! From then on, the old painter and the 3 year old were best friends.

Once there was a princess. She had long, beautiful hair and was very honest. She lived in a lovely castle and had many friends in the kingdom.

One day, a handsome prince arrived. The princess was so excited! He asked her to marry him, and she was overjoyed. She said 'yes' and there was a big celebration!

Everyone in the kingdom was very happy for the princess and prince. They married in a beautiful ceremony and danced the night away. Everyone was so happy to see the two of them so in love.

The princess and prince lived in the castle and were very happy together. They both stayed true to their promise of being honest and kind. They shared many wonderful adventures together, and the kingdom was very glad they had married.

Once upon a time, there was a duck named Quack. Quack loved to swim in the pond with his friends. One day, Quack's friend, Mr. Frog, came to him and said, "Quack, I need your help. My lily pad is too big and I can't cut it by myself." 

Quack said, "I can help you cut it, Mr. Frog." So, Quack and Mr. Frog went to the lily pad and Quack cut it with his sharp beak. But then, they realized that they made a mess and the pieces were everywhere.

Quack said, "We need to organize these pieces." So, they worked together to organize the pieces of the lily pad. They were happy and proud of their work. From that day on, Quack and Mr. Frog were even better friends.

Once upon a time, there was a pink puppy named Muffin. Muffin loved playing and running around, but she was often tired. Muffin's mommy noticed this and decided to do something special for her. 

The next afternoon, Muffin's mommy said, "Muffin, we're going to get a massage!" Muffin was excited and felt happy.

When they arrived at the spa, everybody was warm and friendly. They showed Muffin a pink massage bed, with lots of soft cushions. Muffin settled down and closed her eyes. As the massage lady's hands moved across her little body, Muffin felt an amazing calm. She was happy and snuggly, and she even fell asleep. 

At the end of the massage, Muffin opened her eyes and felt so refreshing. She leaped out of the pink massage bed and smiled wide. From then on, everytime Muffin needed a boost, her mommy took her for a massage!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved going to the festival with his family every year. The festival had games, rides, and lots of yummy food.

One day, Timmy's mom was worried because they had a lot of things to carry to the festival. She asked Timmy to help load the car with all the things they needed for the day.
