The man smiled and offered her a yummy carrot. He told the lamb that he would help her find her mommy. The lamb smiled and let the man carry her in his arms. 

They searched for a long time but finally, the man saw a sheep in the distance. He waved at the sheep and the lambâ€™s mommy started running towards them. The lamb and her mommy were so happy to be reunited.

The man smiled and gave the lamb a warm hug. She thanked him with a wave and a soft bleat. The man watched them go and wished the lamb a happy life. He turned around and disappeared into the meadow.

Johnny was a 3 year old boy who was always stretching his legs. He loved running and jumping around. But lately, he had noticed something very ugly in his backyard. It was an old fence that cost a lot of money. His family could not afford to replace it, so Johnny had a great idea.

He asked his dad if he could stretch the fence to make it bigger. His dad thought it was a good idea, so the two of them worked together. Johnny pulled and pulled on the fence until it was twice as long as it was before.

The ugly fence now looked much nicer. Johnny was very proud of what he had done and his dad was very proud of him too. From that day on, whenever there was a problem that was too expensive to fix, Johnny and his dad would always try to stretch it out and make it bigger.

Once upon a time, there was a group of animals who lived in a beautiful forest. There were rabbits, squirrels, and birds. They all played together and had fun.

One day, a mean wolf came to the forest. He wanted to take over and make all the animals pay him for protection. The animals didn't want to pay him because they knew he was mean and would hurt them.

The animals got together and made a plan to scare the wolf away. They all worked together and used their different skills to make loud noises and scary faces. The wolf got scared and ran away.

The animals were happy and continued to live in their beautiful forest without having to pay the mean wolf. They learned that working together can solve problems and keep them safe.

Molly and Jenny were best friends. One day they were playing together in the park when they saw a big cat. Molly was scared of the cat so Jenny said to her, "Don't worry Molly, I'll tell him to go away." Jenny told the cat to go away, and it did. Molly felt so happy that Jenny was so bossy with the cat.

The next day the girls were playing together again. This time they found a small white pill on the ground. Molly wanted to pick up the pill but Jenny said no. She was being bossy but she was doing it to help Molly. Jenny told Molly that the pill was not safe, and that she should not touch it. Molly was so happy that Jenny was looking out for her that she hugged her.

Molly and Jenny kept playing happily together for the rest of the day. They were having so much fun. They knew that being best friends meant that Jenny could always tell Molly when something wasn't safe. And Molly knew that Jenny would always look out for her and keep her safe.

Once upon a time there was a little girl, her name was Lily. She had long, blonde hair and she was always smiling. One day, she was at home playing when a loud thunder shook all the windows and the sky went dark. There was a storm coming and Lily was scared.

Her mom heard her crying and came to her. "It's allright, sweetheart" she said. Mommy held Lily and hugged her until she was calm. 
"The storm is loud, but it will soon pass" mom said softly. 

Lily nodded and wiped her tears. Mom and Lily went outside to look at the sky. The clouds were rolling fast across the sky and the rain was pouring. But in the sky above them, the sun was still shining. 

Lily smiled. Mom smiled back and said: "Let's go inside, sweetheart. We'll hold hands and go in together, okay?" Lily nodded and the two of them held hands and went inside. 

The storm was still outside, but it was nice and warm in the house. Mom hugged Lily again and said: "That was a strong storm, wasn't it? But it's nice and quiet now."

Lily nodded and smiled once more. She was happy that mommy was there to hold her during the storm.

Lily and Tom are friends. They like to play in the park. They see a big slide. They want to go on the slide.

"Let's rush to the slide!" Lily says. "It looks like fun!"

"OK!" Tom says. They run to the slide. They are fast. They pass by other kids. They get to the slide first.

They take turns to go on the slide. Lily goes first. She sits on the slide. She slides down. She laughs. She feels happy.

"Wow, that was fun!" Lily says. "Your turn, Tom!"

Tom goes next. He sits on the slide. He slides down. He smiles. He feels happy.

"Wow, that was fun!" Tom says. "Let's go again!"

They go on the slide again and again. They have fun. They are not small on the slide. They are big and brave. They love the slide.

Once there was a generous elephant who wanted to help everyone. He had a special horn and he used it to encourage everyone. Every morning he would wake up and blow his horn. The sound of his horn made the world full of love and joy. 

One day a little tiger needed help. He was scared and alone. The elephant used his horn to encourage the tiger and the tiger felt better. He was so happy he jumped into the air and cheered.

The elephant was so generous. He helped more and more animals every day. He would go around the jungle blowing his horn and encouraging everyone. 

The animals were very thankful for the elephant's help. They sang songs and cheered for him, thanking him for his generous gift. The elephant was so proud of himself and smiled from ear to ear. His generous heart and horn filled the jungle with happiness and joy.

Once upon a time, there was a pink otter named Rosie. Rosie loved to play in the water and catch fish to eat. One day, Rosie felt a tickle in her nose and she sneezed really loud! The fish in the water were scared and swam away.

Rosie's friend, a duck named Ducky, heard the sneeze and came to see what was wrong. Rosie explained that she just had a little tickle in her nose and needed to sneeze. Ducky thought it was funny and started to laugh.

Rosie didn't mind though, she was just happy to have a friend to play with. They continued to swim and play in the water together, catching fish and having fun. And even though Rosie sneezed a few more times, they still had a great day together.

Once upon a time, there was a filthy way that was very yucky. All the animals stayed away because their feet would get all muddy. One day, a strange thing happened. The way started to shrink! It got smaller and smaller, until everyone could only see a tiny little road. All the animals were so happy! They all danced and cheered as they crossed over the little way. The way was so tiny that it never got dirty again. Everyone was so happy they had a clean way to walk on. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a parrot named Polly. Polly was very colorful and loved to talk. One day, Polly met a little boy named Timmy. 

Timmy said, "Hello, Polly! You are a pretty bird. Can you shake your feathers?" 

Polly shook her feathers and said, "Squawk, squawk! Yes, I can shake my feathers!" 

Timmy was happy and said, "I wish my grandpa could hear you talk. He is deaf and can't hear anything." 

Polly felt sad for Timmy's grandpa. She said, "Squawk, squawk! I can't make your grandpa hear, but I can keep you company and talk to you anytime." 

Timmy smiled and said, "Thank you, Polly. You are a good friend." And from that day on, Polly and Timmy were the best of friends.

Mama and Ava went to the store. Mama said, "Let's go spend some money to get some yummy food."

Ava was excited. She loved shopping and getting yummy food like candy, ice cream, and cakes.

At the store, Mama and Ava looked at all the food. Ava saw a big box of chocolate chips. She asked Mama, "Can I have it? Please Mama!" Mama said, "No, it is too expensive. Let's look for something cheaper."

Then Ava saw something really tasty. It was a big, juicy lip. "I want the lip!" said Ava. Mama smiled and said, "Ok, that is a good idea. It looks very tasty."

They bought the lip and took it home. Ava was so excited to eat the tasty lip. She split it with Mama, and enjoyed every delicious bite!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One day, they walked to the mailbox to see if there was any mail. 

Lily's friend saw a lemon tree and picked a lemon. She gave it to Lily and said, "This lemon is sour! Do you want to try it?" 

Lily took a little bite, but it was too sour for her. She made a face and said, "Yuck!" 

Suddenly, a bee came and tried to pinch Lily. But Lily's friend saved her by waving the bee away. From that day on, Lily was always careful around bees.

Once upon a time, there was a silly prince who loved to drink juice. He drank so much juice that he got sick. His mommy said, "Prince, you need to drink water instead. Juice is not good for you."

But the prince did not listen. He kept drinking juice and got sicker and sicker. One day, he had to go to the doctor. The doctor said, "Prince, you need to stop drinking juice. It is not good for you."

The silly prince finally listened and started drinking water. He felt much better and learned that too much of anything is not good for you. The moral of the story is to listen to your mommy and the doctor, and to drink water instead of too much juice.

Once upon a time there was a beautiful river which ran perfectly through the countryside. Every day the river delivered a special surprise for the children of the village. One day, it was the turn of three-year old John. 

John was so excited to see what the river had delivered for him. He went to the riverbank, but he didn't know what to expect. Suddenly, he heard a voice from the river. 

"John, come closer. I have something for you," the voice said. 

John was scared and he asked, "Who are you?" 

The voice answered, "I am the river. I have something special for you. Come closer and you'll see."

John cautiously stepped closer, and to his amazement, the river gave him a big, perfect, shiny stone. 

"Look at it, John. It's perfect! I thought you might like it," said the river.

John was filled with joy. He thanked the river and went back to the village to show everyone his special surprise. 

From then on, John always knew that the river was a special place, full of surprises and perfect gifts!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She wanted to study and learn lots of things. So every day, she would get her stuff, like her books and pencils, and sit down to study.

Sometimes it would hurt her. The numbers and letters looked hard. But she kept studying and eventually she got better and better.

After awhile, she had learned lots of stuff. She was so proud of herself. Then, she started to teach her friends what she had learned. They all liked learning from her.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a poppy. It was a pretty flower with a red color. One day, a bee came to the poppy and zoomed around it. The bee liked the poppy because it was sweet. 

But then something weird happened. The poppy started to shake and dance. The bee got scared and flew away. The poppy was not hurt, it was just having fun. 

From that day on, the poppy would often dance and zoom around. The other flowers thought it was weird, but they still liked the poppy. And the bee would come back to visit, but this time it would watch from a safe distance. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a wide judge. He liked to give people answers.
One day, the judge was very tired. He decided to rest under a tree. He lay down in the grass and closed his eyes.

All of the animals came to watch the judge. They were curious! He was resting for so long that they started to get worried.

One brave little bird flew up to the judge and whispered in his ear to wake him up.
The judge opened his eyes and smiled. He thanked the bird for helping him and hopped up.

He said goodbye to all the animals and told them that it was time to get back to work.

The judge went on his way feeling more rested. He continued to make wise decisions with the help of the little bird.

Lila and Ben were playing in the backyard. They had a big box and some shiny paper. They wanted to make a pretend spaceship.

"Let's deliver some crystals to the moon," Lila said. She had a necklace with a blue crystal that sparkled in the sun.

"OK, but we have to be careful. There are fierce aliens on the moon," Ben said. He had a toy laser gun that made funny noises.

They climbed into the box and pretended to fly. They made whoosh and beep sounds. They saw the moon in the sky. It was round and white.

"Look, there's a landing spot," Lila said. She pointed to a patch of dirt. "Let's go and give the crystal to the moon people."

They got out of the box and walked slowly. They held hands. They saw something move behind a bush. It was green and hairy. It had big eyes and sharp teeth. It was an alien!

"Roar!" The alien jumped out and ran towards them. It wanted the crystal.

"Help!" Lila and Ben screamed. They dropped the crystal and ran back to the box. They closed the flap and locked it.

"Go away, you fierce alien!" Ben shouted. He waved his laser gun. "We don't want to play with you!"

The alien picked up the crystal and looked at it. It liked the shiny thing. It smiled and made a friendly noise. It wanted to play with Lila and Ben.

"Hello, I'm Zog. I'm not fierce. I'm lonely. Can I be your friend?" The alien said. It knocked on the box.

Lila and Ben heard the alien. They were scared, but also curious. They opened the flap and peeked out. They saw the alien holding the crystal. It looked sad.

"Hi, I'm Lila. This is Ben. We're sorry we ran away. We thought you were fierce," Lila said.

"I'm sorry I scared you. I just wanted to see the crystal. It's so pretty. Can I share it with you?" Zog said.

Lila and Ben nodded. They came out of the box and smiled. They gave Zog a hug. They played with the crystal and the laser gun. They had fun.

They became friends. They delivered the crystal to the moon people. They flew back to Earth. They had a great adventure.

Once upon a time there was a great explorer. She was famous and everyone wanted to be like her. Every day she went out on adventures, searching for mysterious places and lost treasures.

One day, the explorer decided to settle somewhere new. She found a small island and set up camp. She put her things on a hanger and unrolled her sleeping bag. 

"Maybe I can find something amazing on this island," she said to herself.

Little did she know, she was about to discover something even more amazing than she had imagined. As she explored the island, she found a magical pond filled with sparkles. She couldn't figure out what it was, but she did know one thing: it was beautiful.

The explorer settled down beside the lake and watched the sparkles for hours. "It's like there's some kind of power in this place," she thought.

The next day, she returned to the island and set up camp on the bank of the lake. She sat for hours, watching the sparkles. Suddenly, the explorer heard a voice coming from the lake. 

"If you're looking for something amazing, dive into the water," the voice said.

The explorer looked around, but no one was there. She was nervous but decided to take the risk. She stepped into the lake and was immediately engulfed in a glowing light. When she emerged, she found that she had been transformed

Once upon a time there was a whale. He was swimming in the deep blue sea, enjoying being free. Suddenly he felt something touch his fin. He looked around and noticed a big, empty bowl.

He swam closer and peeked inside the bowl. It was full of yummy things! He couldn't resist and tasted a little bit of everything. It was delicious.

The whale was so happy that he went up to the surface of the ocean and shouted with joy. He stayed up there for a while, until it was time to go back under the sea.

The whale swam away with a smile on his face, still tasting the delicious flavours of the things he had eaten from the empty bowl.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat steak because it was so tasty. One day, Timmy's mom cooked him a big juicy steak for dinner. Timmy was so happy and said, "Mommy, this steak is so yummy! Can we have it every day?"

His mom replied, "No, Timmy. We can't have steak every day. It's not good for our bodies."

Timmy didn't understand why he couldn't have steak every day, so his mom asked him to imagine eating only one thing every day. Timmy thought about it and said, "I don't want to eat the same thing every day. That would be boring!"

His mom smiled and said, "That's right, Timmy. Eating a variety of foods is important to keep our bodies healthy. So let's enjoy this tasty steak today, but remember to eat different foods every day." And Timmy learned that it's important to have a balanced diet.

Once upon a time, there was a shy leopard. The leopard was scared of other animals and didn't like to talk to them. One day, the leopard saw a group of animals playing together and having fun. The leopard wanted to join in, but was too shy to say hello.

The leopard went home feeling sad and lonely. The leopard hated feeling this way and wanted to make a change. The next day, the leopard decided to be brave and say hello to the other animals. To the leopard's surprise, the other animals were friendly and welcomed the leopard to play with them.

From that day on, the leopard wasn't shy anymore and made lots of new friends. The moral of the story is that it's okay to be shy, but sometimes we need to be brave and say hello to make new friends.

One day, there was a weird tiger. It was walking in the park. There were two children, Emma and Ben. They saw the tiger and they were so excited. They watched the tiger as it walked in the park. The tiger was so cool!

The tiger then stopped. It started to roar very loudly. Emma and Ben were scared but they couldn't look away. They kept watching the tiger. The tiger started to run around in circles. It was so fun to watch.

After a few minutes, the tiger stopped running. Ben and Emma laughed and said goodbye to the tiger. They waved as their parents took them away.

The tiger watched them go, too. It was so weird to see such a cool animal watching them go! But it was a very special moment for Emma and Ben. They will always remember the cool and weird tiger!

Once there were two friends named Sue and Sam. They loved to spend time together and do fun things. Today they decided to go to the park. When they got there, they saw a fantastic playground with lots of things to do. 

First, they ran across the grass as fast as they could. Sue laughed and Sam smiled. Then they went on the swings. Sue went higher and higher and laughed with joy. Sam felt so comfortable and happy too. 

After that, they decided to go on the slide. They climbed up the ladder and went down the slippery slide at lightning speed. Both of them laughed and had a lot of fun. 

When it was time to go home, Sue and Sam said goodbye. They hugged and promised to come back to the park soon.

One day, a little girl and her mom went for a walk. The mom carried a tray filled with treats. The girl observed the trees, the birds, and the flowers. 

When they came to a big field, the mom noticed a serious-looking dog. The girl was scared, so the mom put the tray on the ground. She said, "Let's observe the dog from here". 

The girl kept her eyes on the dog, who stayed very still. Then, the mom called out, "It's okay. Come closer." The dog wagged its tail and ate the treats from the tray. 

The girl felt brave and happy. She laughed when the dog chased her, and she hugged its neck. The girl learned that all dogs were not so serious.

Once upon a time, there was an enormous ranch. It had big green fields, lots of animals and a mysterious river. Two little birds were flying around the ranch. They did not have the same color. One was blue, the other one was yellow. The blue bird stopped for a moment and said: "Hey, yellow bird, did you know there is a secret around here?". The yellow bird looked at him and whispered back: "No, what is it?". The blue bird started to fly slowly and whispered: "I heard somebody saying that this ranch is magical!". The yellow bird looked amazed and said: "Wow, really?".

The blue bird nodded and the yellow bird said: "How can it be magical?". The blue bird talked very softly and said: "If you look closely on the river, you can see that some of the water sparkles at night". The yellow bird looked interested and asked: "Sparkles of what?". The blue bird smiled and whispered: "Sparkels of Magic!".

Once upon a time there was a cool bear who liked to take walks in the forest. One day, the bear was walking through the forest and he heard a loud noise in the distance. The bear wondered what it was, so he decided to take a look. 

When he got there, he discovered that the forest was flooded. The bear was not very happy when he saw this. The bear decided to search for help.

Soon enough, he ran into a cool frog. The bear asked the frog, "What is happening?" The frog replied, "There is a flood! But don't worry, it will end soon." The bear was relieved and thanked the frog for the good news. 

The bear and the frog then said goodbye and the bear went back home. Sure enough, the next day the flood had stopped and everything was back to normal. The bear was happy that the flood ended so quickly and his forest was safe again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy had a red bike with a flat tire. He wanted to ride his bike, but he couldn't because of the flat tire. Timmy's dad said he would fix it for him.

While his dad was fixing the tire, Timmy saw a bird. The bird was singing a pretty song. Timmy wanted to sing like the bird, so he tried to whistle. He tried and tried, but he couldn't whistle.

Finally, Timmy's dad finished fixing the tire. Timmy got on his bike and rode away. The wind was harsh on his face, but he was happy because he could ride his bike again. As he rode, he tried to whistle again. Maybe one day he would be able to whistle like the bird.

Once there was a little girl named Suzie. Suzie was three years old and loved to play outside in the sun.

One day, Suzie wanted to go outside and swing on the swing, but mum said no. She was worried about the big wind outside. 

"It's too windy today. You can't go out," said mum.

"But I want to swing," said Suzie.

Mum smiled and said, "Let's call Grandma. Maybe Grandma can come over and play with you inside. Would you like that?"

Suzie smiled. "Yes, please call Grandma," she said.

So Mum called Grandma and soon Grandma was there. She brought a game with her and they all played together. Suzie felt dizzy when she spun around and around, but she had lots of fun with Grandma.

Mum was relieved that Suzie was having so much fun and that she wasn't worried or sad with the wind outside. 
At the end of the day, they all had a big hug and Suzie said, "Thank you for coming, Grandma!" 
Grandma smiled and said, "You're welcome, Suzie!"

Once upon a time there was a boy named Ted. He loved to run and play. One day, Ted wanted to play hide-and-seek with his friends.

His friends all hid in different places while Ted counted to ten very slowly. He looked around but he couldn't see anyone. Where were they?

Ted heard someone giggle. He looked up to the sky and there they were, floating up high! They had used balloons to hide and were now floating up to the sky.

Ted yelled, "Come down! I can't reach you!" He saw his friends smiling and laughing.

One of his friends shouted, "Let's have a race! Last one there has to eat a sour apple!"

 Ted was so excited - he raced through the air, faster than ever before! Everyone had a great race and in the end, Ted won! Then, they all ate a sour apple. Yum!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to spin around and around in circles until she was dizzy. One day, she went to the park to play with her friends. 

Lily's friend, Timmy, was having trouble finding his toy car. "I can't find my car. It's lost!" he said. 

Lily had an idea. "Let's all look for it together. If we work together, we can find it faster," she said. 

So, they organized themselves and searched the playground. After a few minutes, Lily found the car under a bush. "I found it!" she said. 

Timmy was so happy and gave Lily a big hug. "Thank you for helping me find my car. You bring peace to my heart," he said. 

Lily smiled and felt happy too. She loved helping her friends and making them feel peaceful. And of course, she couldn't wait to spin around again!

Once upon a time there was a pirate, and he sailed far away in his boat. He had lots of fun, but he always regretted that he was away from his friends. The pirate sailed all over the world and soon, he found an island. He was very excited, so he made a loud noise and called out to the other pirates. 

The pirates heard him and gathered around to see what he had found. He showed them the island and they all burst out laughing. Even though the pirate was embarrassed, he was still very happy to have found the island and promised to share it with his friends. 

He took the other pirates exploring around the island, showing them the fun and interesting things he had found earlier. The pirates had a wonderful time and when the sun went down, they all sang loud, pirate songs before sailing away. 

The pirate was so happy to have found an enchanted island and share it with his friends. Even though he had to be away from them, he will always regret not having been able to explore and find that island earlier.

Lily and Tom were playing with their toys in the living room. Lily had a doll and Tom had a fireman. They pretended that the doll was in trouble and the fireman had to save her.

"Help, help!" Lily said in a high voice. "My doll is stuck in the tree!"

"Don't worry, I'm coming!" Tom said in a low voice. He ran to the closet and got a scarf. He tied one end of the scarf to the fireman and the other end to a chair. He threw the fireman up to the tree.

"Got you!" Tom said. He pulled the scarf and the fireman came down with the doll. "You are safe now!"

"Thank you, thank you!" Lily said. She hugged the doll and the fireman. "You are a brave fireman!"

Tom smiled. He was happy that he saved the doll. He looked at the scarf and had an idea. He tied the scarf around his neck and said, "Now I'm a fireman too!"

Lily laughed. She thought Tom looked silly with the scarf. She said, "No, you are not a fireman. You are a silly boy!"

They both giggled and continued to play. They had a lot of fun with their toys and their scarf.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the bakery to buy a muffin. She loved muffins, especially the blueberry ones. As she was walking home, she saw her friend Tommy.

"Hi Tommy, want to share my muffin?" Lily asked.

Tommy looked at the muffin and said, "No thanks, I don't like blueberries. They give me a serious tummy ache."

Lily was sad that Tommy didn't want to share her muffin. She felt like slapping him, but she knew that wouldn't solve anything. Instead, she decided to be kind and give him a banana instead.

"Here Tommy, have a banana. They're good for your tummy," Lily said.

Tommy was grateful and took the banana. Lily felt happy that she could help her friend and they walked home together, munching on their treats.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play the piano, which was a big, black instrument that made beautiful sounds. One day, Lily's mommy told her not to touch the piano when she wasn't around, but Lily didn't listen. She wanted to play a song for her mommy, so she sat down and started to play.

Suddenly, the piano started to shake and make a loud noise. Lily tried to resist, but she couldn't stop playing. Then, the piano fell over and hit Lily on the head. It was a harmless accident, but Lily was hurt. Her mommy came running in and saw what happened. "I told you not to touch the piano," she said, as she picked up her crying daughter.

From that day on, Lily never played the piano when her mommy wasn't around. She learned that sometimes it's important to listen to what grown-ups say, even if we don't want to. And the piano sat in the corner, waiting for someone to play it again, but no one ever did.

Once upon a time, there was a big dog named Max. Max liked to play and run outside with his friends. One day, Max's owner said they were going on a trip and they had to pack their bags. Max helped by putting his favorite toy in the bag.

When they got to their destination, Max saw a nurse who was very nice. She gave him a treat and petted him. Max was happy and alert because he liked the nurse.

At night, Max slept in his own bed and dreamt about playing with his friends again. The next day, they went on a walk and Max saw a squirrel. He barked and ran after it, but his owner told him to come back. Max listened and went back to his owner.

After their walk, they went back to their room and Max helped pack their bags again. He put his toy back in the bag and was ready to go home. Max had a great trip and couldn't wait to play with his friends again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play at the beach with her mommy and daddy. One day, they went to the beach and saw a crab walking on the sand. Lily said, "Look, a crab! It's so cool!" 

Her mommy said, "Be careful, Lily. Crabs have claws that can pinch you." 

Lily replied, "I won't touch it. I just want to watch it." 

After a while, Lily's tummy started to feel empty. She said, "Mommy, I'm hungry. Can we go get some food?" 

Her daddy said, "Sure, let's rush to the snack bar before it gets too crowded." 

Lily was happy to get some food and she said, "Thank you, mommy and daddy. This is yummy!"

Ben and Mia were playing in the tent in the backyard. It was dark outside and they had a flashlight to see. They liked to tell stories and make funny faces with the light.

Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. It was thunder. They saw a bright light in the sky. It was lightning. They were scared and hugged each other.

"Mommy! Daddy!" they cried.

Mommy and Daddy came running to the tent. They saw Ben and Mia and smiled.

"Don't be afraid, sweeties. It's just a storm. It will go away soon," Mommy said.

She gave them a big hug and a kiss.

"Here, take this flashlight. You can use it to make shadows on the wall. It will be fun," Daddy said.

He gave them a small flashlight and showed them how to make a rabbit and a bird.

"Wow, thank you, Daddy. You are so kind," Ben said.

"Yes, thank you, Daddy. You are the best," Mia said.

They took the flashlight and started to play. They forgot about the thunder and the lightning. They felt safe and happy in the tent with Mommy and Daddy.

Tommy liked to ride his bike in the park. He had a red bike with two big wheels and a shiny pedal. He could go very fast and make loud noises with his mouth. He felt happy and free on his bike.

But Tommy was not nice to other kids. He did not share his bike or his toys. He did not listen to his mom or his dad. He did not say sorry or thank you. He was ignorant and rude. He thought he was better than everyone else.

One day, he saw a little girl with a yellow bike. She had a basket with flowers and a bell that rang. Tommy wanted her bike. He rode up to her and said, "Give me your bike. It is mine now. You are stupid and ugly." The little girl was scared and sad. She said, "No, this is my bike. I got it for my birthday. Please go away." Tommy did not care. He pushed her off her bike and took it. He laughed and rode away.

But Tommy did not know how to ride the yellow bike. It was smaller and lighter than his red bike. It had a different pedal and a brake. Tommy did not pay attention to the road. He did not see the big truck that was coming. He did not hear the horn that was honking. He did not feel the bump that was ahead.

The family sailed and sailed and sailed, exploring different places. Finally they decided to go home. They put up their sail, and and headed back to the harbor. They were glad they had a safe and wonderful journey.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little girl named Yvonne who loved to explore the world around her. She was always outside, skipping and running around her yard and in the nearby park.

One autumn day, Yvonne was feeling extra alert and decided to go outside to look for something new. As she made her way through the park, Yvonne came across a huge pile of leaves. "What are these leaves doing here?", she wondered.

Suddenly, Yvonne's curiosity was answered by an older woman in the park. "Those leaves can be used to make a special kind of blanket. It's called a leaf blanket. It's warm and cozy for chilly days like today."

Yvonne listened intently to the woman's words. She excitedly began collecting different coloured leaves from the ground and placing them in a pile. With a little practice, Yvonne soon got the hang of it and soon enough she was folding the leaves together like a blanket. When she was finished, the leaf blanket served as a colourful reminder of the season.

Yvonne was thrilled. She had created something special and knew she would always have a warm and cozy blanket to snuggle into when the chilly autumn days came around.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved her blanket very much. It was soft and cozy and made her feel happy. One day, Lily's mommy said, "Lily, it's time to go to bed." But Lily said, "Mommy, I don't want to sleep with my blanket tonight. It feels uncomfortable."

Mommy asked, "Why does it feel uncomfortable, Lily?" Lily replied, "I don't know, mommy. It just feels weird." Mommy said, "That's okay, Lily. You don't have to use your blanket if you don't want to. Maybe you can try sleeping with your stuffed animal instead." Lily thought about it and said, "Okay, mommy. I'll try that. Thank you for understanding."

Lily hugged her stuffed animal and closed her eyes. She felt happy again, knowing that she had a new way to sleep. From that day on, Lily knew that if her blanket ever made her feel uncomfortable, she could always find another way to feel cozy and happy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved to play with his toy cars and make them zoom around the room. One day, Timmy's mom took him to a big building called a museum. Timmy saw lots of cool things like big bones and shiny rocks. He liked the museum a lot.

But then, Timmy saw a man who couldn't hear anything. His mom told him the man was deaf, which meant he couldn't hear. Timmy felt sad for the man and wanted to help him. So, Timmy took out one of his toy cars and made it zoom around in front of the man. The man smiled and clapped his hands.

From that day on, Timmy always brought a toy car with him whenever he went to the museum. He liked to make them zoom around for the deaf man and make him smile. And Timmy learned that even though someone couldn't hear, they could still have fun and be happy.

Once upon a time there were two friends named Bobby and Jimmy. Bobby was a very naughty boy and he liked to buy things. One day, Jimmy told Bobby that he shouldn't buy so many things because he was being naughty. 

Bobby didn't want to listen to Jimmy and he kept buying whatever he wanted. This made Jimmy really mad, so he decided to take away all of Bobby's money.

Bobby cried and said he was sorry to Jimmy, and promised to not buy any more things without his friend's permission. Jimmy was happy to hear this and they hugged and made up.

From then on, Bobby and Jimmy would always check with each other before buying anything. They were friends again, and they lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a thick stream. Everyday it gurgled and bubbled. One day, something magical happened. Two little fish swam up the stream and got married! The other fish in the stream were so happy for them. They gathered around and cheered as they said their vows.

After the wedding, they shared lots of yummy treats. There was ice cream and candy, and the other fish all had a wonderful time. It was the best day ever!

The little married fish stayed in the stream and were very happy. They laughed and played together, and the other fish watched them with pleasure.

So that's what happened when two fish got married in the thick stream!

Once upon a time, there was a big furry bear. He liked to sit in the sun and feel the warm rays on his fur. One day, he saw some clothes hanging on a clothesline. The clothes were colorful and bright. The bear wanted to try them on, so he sat down and put them on. He looked silly in the clothes, but he didn't care. He was having fun!

Once there was a happy farmer called Dave who lived on a farm with lots of animals. He had two chickens, Gertrude and Gloria, and each day they supplied him with eggs. Dave was very pleased that the chickens were so helpful and were able to give him lots of eggs.

One day, Gertrude decided she wanted to surprise Dave, so she worked extra hard and produced an impressive number of eggs.

When Dave came to collect the eggs, he was amazed. "Wow Gertrude, these eggs are very impressive," he said. "Thank you so much for all your hard work!"

Gertrude was delighted to know that her efforts had not gone unnoticed. From then on she worked extra hard to make sure Dave had a great supply of eggs.

The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a dog named Max. Lily loved to treat Max with yummy snacks. Max loved Lily too. One day, Lily was playing with Max and she accidentally hurt him. Max yelped and ran away. Lily felt worried that Max was hurt and sad that he didn't want to play with her anymore. 

Lily knew she had to say sorry and ask Max to forgive her. She found Max under a tree and said sorry. She also gave him a special treat. Max forgave Lily and they played together again. From that day on, Lily was more careful when playing with Max. She loved Max and didn't want to hurt him again.

Once upon a time there was a boy. His name was Jake. Jake was three-years-old. One day, he wanted to explore so he entered a big room. He saw a long, comfy couch. It looked so cozy that he lay down on it.

Suddenly, he felt something cold! He jumped off the couch. He looked under the couch and saw a small, white kitten.

"Hi," said the kitten, "I'm so cold. Can I come stay with you?"

Jake smiled. He said, "Yes! You can stay with me. Come up here and warm up next to me on the couch."

The kitten curled up on the couch next to Jake and they snuggled together until they were both nice and warm again. From that day on, Jake and the kitten were best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Tim. Tim loved to play with his toys and go on adventures. One day, Tim went on a boat ride with his family to an island. The island was very pretty with lots of trees and flowers. Tim thought it was so attractive!

While on the island, Tim found a shiny rock. He picked it up and showed it to his mom. She told him that the rock was very valuable and he should keep it safe. Tim was so happy to have something so special. He put the rock in his pocket and continued to explore the island with his family. 

When it was time to leave, Tim didn't want to go. He wanted to stay on the island forever because he loved it so much. But his mom told him they had to go home. Tim was sad, but he knew he could always come back and visit his special island and his valuable rock.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She had a violin that she loved to play. One day, she was going to play at her friend's house.

On her way, she saw a big dog. The dog said, "Hi Lily! Can you play your violin for me?" Lily said, "Yes, I can play for you, but first I need to go to my friend's house. I will play for you after that." The dog was happy and said, "Thank you, Lily! I will wait here."

Lily went to her friend's house and played the violin. They had lots of fun. But then, Lily forgot her violin at her friend's house when she left. She went back to the big dog, but she did not have her violin.

The dog asked, "Where is your violin, Lily?" Lily was sad and said, "I forgot it at my friend's house. I am sorry." The dog said, "That's okay, Lily. We can go get it together, and I will keep you safe."

So, Lily and the big dog went back to her friend's house. They got the violin, and Lily played a beautiful song for the dog. They were both happy, and Lily knew her violin was safe with her new friend, the big dog.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tim. Tim loved to play baseball. One day, he found a big, high tree in his yard. Tim had an idea. He would pretend the tree was a baseball bat!

Tim ran inside his house and got a ball. He stood in front of the high tree with the ball in his hand. He threw the ball up in the air and then hit it with the tree. The ball went very far! Tim was so happy.

Every day, Tim would go outside and pretend the high tree was his baseball bat. He played and played until the sun went down. Tim had lots of fun with his tree baseball bat. And that is how Tim became the best baseball player in his town.

One day, Mary went to the store to pick some juice. She saw lots of different kinds of juice but she chose the apple juice. She grabbed a bottle and went to the check-out. The cashier was very friendly and calm.

After Mary left the store, she went home. There, she opened the bottle and took a sip. The juice was delicious! She smiled and drank some more.

When she finished the juice, she put the bottle in the sink. Then she washed her hands and went to her room to watch her favorite show. It was so nice and calm.

The next day, Mary went to the store again. She was excited to pick some more juice.

Once upon a time, there was a cozy house with a fireplace. The fireplace made the room warm and toasty. The family loved to sit by the fireplace and tell stories. 

One night, the fire in the fireplace started to glow brighter and brighter. The family didn't notice anything strange. But then, the fire started to get crazy and the flames grew bigger and bigger. 

Suddenly, the family realized that the fireplace was on fire! They tried to put it out, but it was too late. The fire spread and soon the whole house was on fire. The family had to run outside and call the firefighters. 

In the end, the house was completely destroyed. The family was sad and had to find a new place to live. They learned a lesson to always be careful with fireplaces, and to never ignore when something starts to glow or act crazy.

Once upon a time, there was a big, generous dog named Max. Max had a pretty bow on his neck. He liked to play and share with his friends. One day, Max and his friends wanted to celebrate because it was his birthday.

Max said, "Let's have a party!" His friends were happy and said, "Yes, let's celebrate!" They played games and ate yummy food. Max shared his toys with everyone. They were all having a good time.

But then, Max saw a big cake. He wanted to eat it all by himself. He forgot to share with his friends. Max ate the whole cake very fast. After eating the cake, Max felt sick. His friends were sad because they didn't get any cake. Max learned that it is important to share with friends, even on his birthday.

Once there was a baby who liked to crawl. She loved scooting around on the ground, exploring all sorts of new places.

One day, the baby found a big, bright yellow cone. It was great! She could just barely reach it with her little hands. The baby grabbed the cone and crawled around the house with it.

The baby crawled under the table, around the chair, and even through the door. Everywhere the baby crawled, the cone followed.

Pretty soon, the baby was getting tired. But she wasnâ€™t done playing with her cone yet! So she crawled into the kitchen and grabbed a big spoon. She scooped up some food and put it into the cone.

The baby thought the cone filled with food was great! She crawled around the house, munching on her snack.

When the baby had finished eating, she put the cone back where she found it. Then she crawled to her bed, content after a fun day of crawling and exploring.

Lily was a big girl who liked to play with her dolls and her blocks. She had a rare doll that was very pretty and had long hair. She loved to brush her hair and dress her up. One day, she was playing with her doll in her room when she felt an urge in her tummy. She knew what that meant. She had to go to the bathroom.

She put her doll on her bed and ran to the door. But the door was closed and she heard water running. Her brother was in the bathroom. He always took a long time. Lily knocked on the door and said, "I need to go! Hurry up!" But her brother did not answer. He was singing a loud song.

Lily felt the urge get stronger. She did not want to wet her pants. She looked around her room for a place to go. She saw her doll on her bed. She had an idea. She grabbed her doll and ran to the corner. She pulled down her pants and sat on her doll. She peed on her doll.

She felt better. She got up and pulled up her pants. She looked at her doll. Her doll was wet and smelled bad. She felt sorry for her doll. She did not mean to hurt her. She heard the bathroom door open. Her brother came out. He saw her doll in the corner. He said, "What did you do to your doll?"

Lily started to cry. She said, "I had to go and you were in the bathroom and I peed on my doll. I'm sorry. I'm sorry." Her brother looked at her. He felt sorry for her too. He said, "It's okay. Don't cry. We can wash your doll and make her clean. She will be fine. Come on, let's go to the bathroom and wash her." He took her hand and her doll and led her to the bathroom. He helped her wash her doll and dry her hair. He said, "See? She looks pretty again. She is a rare doll. She is strong and brave. Just like you." He gave her a hug and a kiss. Lily smiled. She said, "Thank you. You are a good brother. I love you." They hugged and kissed. They went back to her room and played with her doll and her blocks. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there lived two little friends, Jack and Lily. They were always together and loved to explore. One day they decided to go to the big city and have an adventure. 

They got on the train and it took them to the city. As soon as they stepped off, Jack said, "Lily, let's go look around!"

Lily nodded and smiled. They wandered around the city looking at all the tall buildings. Then they saw a beautiful park.

"Let's go over there," said Lily.

When they got to the park, they found a thin fence around it. Jack said, "Oh, this fence is locked. Let's try to find a way in." 

Lily thought for a minute and said, "I know! Let's climb over the fence, it's thin enough!" So Jack and Lily scaled the thin fence, and soon they were having lots of fun in the park. 

At the end of the day, they waved goodbye to the city and happily went home.

Once upon a time, there was a big tree. It had many leaves and birds liked to sit on its branches. One day, a big wind came and split the tree in two. The birds were sad because they didn't have a place to sit anymore.

But then, they had a meeting with all the other animals in the forest. They talked about how they could fix the tree so the birds could have a place to sit again. Everyone was enthusiastic about helping.

They all worked together and fixed the tree. The birds were happy again and sang a beautiful song to thank everyone for their help. From that day on, the animals learned that when they work together, they can do amazing things.

Bob was a bald man. He loved to go outside and do things. One day he decided to go to the park to feed the birds. He put some birdseed into a teaspoon and he held it out to the birds.

"Hello little birds," said Bob. "Would you like something to eat?"

The birds were very happy and they landed on Bob's hand. They pecked away at the birdseed in the teaspoon. Soon there was no more and the birds flew away.

Bob watched them fly away and smiled. He put the teaspoon back in his pocket and went home with a smile on his face.

Once upon a time, there was a dog named Max. Max was a wild dog who loved to run and play outside. One day, Max went for a walk and got lost. He was scared and didn't know what to do. Suddenly, he saw a kind lady who wanted to help him. She put a collar on Max and took him home. Max was so happy to have someone to help him. From that day on, Max never wandered off again.

Lily liked to play with her mom's makeup. She wanted to look like a princess. She took the lipstick, the eyeshadow, and the blush from the drawer and put them on her face. She looked in the mirror and smiled. She thought she was very pretty.

She went to show her mom what she had done. Her mom was in the kitchen, making cookies. When she saw Lily, she was surprised. She said, "Lily, what did you do to your face? You look like a clown!"

Lily felt sad. She did not want to look like a clown. She wanted to look like a princess. She said, "I'm sorry, mom. I wanted to play with your makeup. I wanted to be like you."

Her mom hugged her and said, "Lily, you don't need makeup to be like me. You are beautiful just the way you are. Makeup is for grown-ups, not for little girls. And makeup does not change who you are inside. You are my sweet and humble daughter, and I love you very much."

Lily hugged her mom back and said, "I love you too, mom. Can I help you make cookies?"

Her mom said, "Of course, you can. But first, let's go wash your face. You will look much better without makeup."

Jack and Mommy walked to the church. It was cheap. They wanted to buy something. But it was gone. 

Jack felt sad but Mommy smiled and said they would try again. They went to two more stores. Nothing was complete. 

At the last store, Mommy found a cheap toy. Yay! Jack was excited. He wanted to take it home. But then it broke. 
Jack was so sad. Mommy said it was ok. She said they would try again next time. 

But, Jack was still sad. He was worried he would never find something complete.

Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Fin. Fin loved to swim in the big blue ocean all day long. One day, Fin saw a big shark swimming towards him. Fin was scared and didn't know what to do. 

Just then, a friendly crab named Claw came along. Claw said, "Don't be afraid, Fin. Sharks are not always mean. This one might just want to say hello." Fin stood still, alert and ready to swim away if the shark tried to hurt him. 

The shark swam closer and closer, but instead of attacking, he just wanted to play. Fin and the shark swam and played together for hours. Fin was so happy that he made a new friend, and he learned that sometimes it's good to be alert, but not always scared. From that day on, Fin and the shark swam together every day.

One day, a little boy named Joey went to the beach with his dad. He was so excited! He couldn't wait to get in the water. 

When they got there, Joey ran to the edge of the water and looked in. He saw some colorful fish swimming around and he wanted to catch them. 

Joey's dad said, "Ready to dive in and get those fish?" 

Joey nodded eagerly and said, "Yes!" He waded in until the water was up to his waist and then he held his nose and jumped in. He swam around and all the fish swam away. 

Joey got out, feeling a bit sad. His dad hugged him and said, "I have an idea. Why don't you use a rag to catch the fish?"

Joey smiled. He grabbed a rag from his dad and threw it into the water. He waited and waited, but all that came up was a bitter tasting seaweed. 

He laughed and said to his dad, "Let's try again!" 

With that, he ran back into the water, rag in hand. He was ready to dive in and catch some fish. 

The end.

Once upon a time there was a friend. His name was Jack. Jack was very fierce. He liked to growl like a tiger.

One day Jack went to the park with his friend. As they were walking around they heard a loud noise. It sounded like someone was in trouble.

Jack and his friend ran over to see what was happening. They saw a tiger near a little girl. The tiger was growling.

Jack was brave. He stepped forward and said, "Go away, tiger! You're too fierce for this girl."

The tiger listened and left. The girl was safe.

Jack and his friend were happy. They smiled and hugged each other. They had saved the day!

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Spot. Spot loved to play with his ball in the park. One day, he saw a big tree and wanted to get a closer look. Spot leaned on the tree to sniff it, but the tree was not strong. The tree fell down with a loud crash!

A little girl named Lily saw what happened. She felt sorry for the tree and for Spot. She knew that they should not lean on things that are not strong. Lily decided to help Spot learn a lesson.

Together, they planted a new tree in the park. Spot and Lily took care of the tree every day. As the tree grew, they learned to be careful and respect nature. They also learned that when they make a mistake, they can fix it by doing something good. And from that day on, Spot never leaned on a tree again.

Once upon a time, there was a silly doctor named Dr. Cut. He liked to dance and make people laugh. He lived in a small town with many happy kids.

One day, a little girl named Lily had a cut on her finger. She was sad and scared. Her mom took her to see Dr. Cut. Dr. Cut saw the cut and knew just what to do.

He put a fun band-aid on Lily's cut and told her a silly joke. Lily laughed and felt better. Dr. Cut made her smile and forget about her hurt finger. From that day on, everyone in the town loved the silly doctor who could make cuts feel better.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She lived in a big house with her mommy and daddy. One day, Lily was playing in her room when she saw a shiny knob on her closet door. She wanted to look at it up close, so she went over to the closet.

As she reached for the knob, she noticed that the door was moving all by itself. It was restless, like something was trying to get out. Lily felt scared and didn't know what to do. She decided to go get her mommy and daddy to help her.

When they came back to the room, they saw that the closet door was wide open. Inside, they found a mischievous little kitten who had been hiding in there. Lily was so happy to have found a new friend, and the kitten was happy to have found a new home. From that day on, they played together every day and had lots of fun.

Once upon a time, there was a fair princess named Lucy. She had golden hair and rosy cheeks. Lucy was playing in the garden when suddenly a big cloud of smoke appeared! She was very scared, but the smoke began to change. It turned into a big, fluffy, white dog.

"Hello, Princess Lucy", said the dog.

Lucy was very surprised. "Hi, Dog. What's your name?"

"My name is Cloudy. I'm here to take you on an adventure!", said the dog.

"Really?", asked Lucy.

Cloudy nodded his head.

So, Lucy and Cloudy flew off in the sky. They saw many things that were beautiful and strange. Everywhere they went, people said how fair Lucy looked, with her golden hair and rosy cheeks. 

At the end of the day, Cloudy flew Lucy back to her garden. She gave him a big hug and thanked him for the wonderful adventure. 

Cloudy smiled and said, "It was my pleasure. I'll come back soon!" Then he flew off into the sky, leaving a trail of fluffy white smoke behind him. 

Lucy watched until the smoke faded away. 

The end.

Once there was a bossy little figure named Jenny. She was playing in the park one day when she stumbled and fell down. She started to cry, feeling embarrassed, and a kind old lady came over to help her. 

The kind old lady said, "Don't be afraid, Jenny. Everyone stumbles now and then. What's important is that you get back up, dust yourself off and keep going. That's how you learn and grow." 

Jenny thought about what the old lady said. She then took a deep breath and got herself back up. She was feeling brave and proud of herself. 

At the end of the day, Jenny learned that it was okay to stumble as long as she never gave up.

The moral of the story is that everyone makes mistakes, but it's okay to make them as long as you learn from them and keep trying.

Once upon a time, there was a rail. It was so long, the end couldn't be seen! One day, a little girl wanted to manage it. She wanted to find out where it went! So off she went, walking down the rail.

It seemed like a long journey. Everything was dull and boring, until, oops! The girl slipped and slid right off the edge of the rail. She got back up and kept walking.

But then she saw something. What was it? It was a big, bright button! She pressed it, and all of a sudden, the rail started to move! It was so cool! The girl was thrilled!

The little girl had managed the rail! She got to ride on it and see where it went. When the ride was over, she was so proud of herself! She had managed the rail by herself.

Once upon a time, there was a mummy and daddy. The daddy went out and brought something special. It was a very big story! It was full of tasty words.

The mummy and daddy sat down and opened the story. They read it together and it was really fun. There were lots of adventures, and even a dragon. It was a tasty story.

The mummy and daddy laughed and laughed when they read the story. They were having so much fun.

Afterwards, the mummy said, "Let's bring this story back to the shop. We can't keep it forever".

So the daddy brought the story back to the shop, and the mummy and daddy were happy. They liked the tasty story, so they said goodbye and thanked the shopkeeper. They left feeling happy and content.

Once upon a time, there was a great little girl. Her name was Lily. Every day, Lily liked to walk through the park with her mom.

Lily saw lots of wonderful things in the park - big trees, happy birds, sparkling lakes and zero strange noises.

One day, Lily and her mom saw something truly great. It was a big playground with swings and slides! Lily couldn't believe it and ran to the playground.

But as soon as she got there, her mom said, "Wait, you can't walk on the swings. It's not safe."

Lily listened to her mom and she walked off the swing. That was when they noticed something even greater - a tall slide in the shape of a spiral!

Lily couldn't wait to try it. She ran to the top and said with a big smile, "This looks great!"

Lily had a great time sliding down the spiral and she and her mom walked home with big smiles on their faces.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny named Benny. Benny was gray and he liked to hop around in the meadow. One day, Benny saw a carrot that he wanted to eat. But the carrot was stuck in the ground and Benny couldn't pull it out.

Benny's friend, a little bird named Billy, saw Benny struggling and asked, "What's wrong, Benny?"

"I want to eat this carrot, but it won't come out of the ground," Benny said, feeling frustrated.

Billy thought for a moment and said, "I think I can help you. Let me peck at the ground around the carrot to loosen it up."

Benny watched as Billy pecked at the ground. Soon, the carrot popped out and Benny was so happy! "Thank you, Billy! You are such a good friend," Benny said.

And from that day on, Benny and Billy played together every day, hopping and flying around the meadow.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to help her mom in the kitchen. One day, Lily's mom asked her to organize the kitchen utensils. Lily was excited to help and started to put the spoons, forks, and knives in their proper places.

As she was organizing, Lily noticed an apron hanging on the wall. It was pink and had flowers on it. Lily asked her mom if she could wear the apron while she helped in the kitchen. Her mom said yes and helped her put it on.

While wearing the ancient apron, Lily felt like a chef from a long time ago. She continued to help her mom in the kitchen, feeling proud of herself for organizing the utensils and wearing the special apron. From that day on, Lily wore the apron every time she helped her mom in the kitchen.

Once upon a time there were two little friends, Ben and Lola. Both of them loved to take naps in the afternoon.

One day, Lola took Ben to her garden. She showed him the radishes she had grown. The radishes were big and red and round. They were very fair!

Ben said he'd like to take a nap, so Lola made a bed for him out of radish leaves. Then she tucked him in, and away he went to dreamland!

When he woke up, the sun was setting and Lola was munching on radishes. Ben ate one too, and he said it was delicious!

The two little friends spent the rest of the day playing, until the sky turned dark and it was time for them to go home. But they knew they would come back again soon to take another nap in the garden.
